6873.Name: Crash of Rhinos
6873.FlavorText:
Love is like a rhino, short-sighted and hasty; if it cannot find a way, it will make a way.
—Femeref adage

13491.Name: Ancestral Mask
13491.FlavorText: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

14717.Name: Captain Sisay
14717.FlavorText: Her leadership forged the Weatherlight's finest crew.

15281.Name: Stratadon
15281.FlavorText: Designed like the gargadons of Keld—big and brutal.

16334.Name: Putrid Warrior
16334.FlavorText: "I do not like it," said Grizzlegom, "but I will take every soldier I can get."

17027.Name: Shelter
17027.FlavorText: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

17205.Name: Chainer's Edict
17205.FlavorText: The pits have their own form of mercy.

17618.Name: Mirari's Wake
17618.FlavorText: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

18187.Name: Enchantress's Presence
18187.FlavorText: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

18902.Name: Stifle
18902.FlavorText:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

19577.Name: Phyrexian Arena
19577.FlavorText: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

19689.Name: Leonin Skyhunter
19689.FlavorText: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

19893.Name: Mass Hysteria
19893.FlavorText: The sooner you see the whites of their eyes, the sooner you'll spill the red of their blood.

20367.Name: Echoing Decay
20367.FlavorText: A single fear unleashes a torrent of nightmares.

20760.Name: Hoverguard Sweepers
20760.FlavorText: They only appear in emergencies, and emergencies never last long.

21287.Name: Night of Souls' Betrayal
21287.FlavorText:
"How can we wage war against ourselves? What happens when the kami of our very souls rise against us? I answer simply: We cannot. We die. There can be no victory in this war."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

21339.Name: Honden of Night's Reach
21339.FlavorText: To the sorrow of all, its dark reach grasped and crushed those who guarded its silent vigil.

21343.Name: Honden of Infinite Rage
21343.FlavorText: To the sorrow of all, its rage became focused on those who once stoked it.

21375.Name: Honden of Cleansing Fire
21375.FlavorText: To the sorrow of all, its fire was turned toward those who worshipped it.

21381.Name: Honden of Seeing Winds
21381.FlavorText: To the sorrow of all, its winds found sin in the hearts of those who once learned from its wisdom.

21387.Name: Honden of Life's Web
21387.FlavorText: To the sorrow of all, its web became a net that strangled those who helped weave it.

22224.Name: One with Nothing
22224.FlavorText: When nothing remains, everything is equally possible.

22226.Name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
22226.FlavorText: Hidetsugu never relinquished a grudge. He let it burn within him, gathering ever greater intensity until the final moment of vengeance.

22911.Name: Scaled Wurm
22911.FlavorText: The wurms become so big, a single scale can be used as a roof for a human dwelling.

23012.Name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
23012.FlavorText:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek

23600.Name: Blazing Archon
23600.FlavorText:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

24113.Name: Spell Snare
24113.FlavorText: Every culture has its unlucky numbers. In a city where you're either alone, in a crowd, or being stabbed in the back, two is the worst number of all.

24207.Name: Tidespout Tyrant
24207.FlavorText: He unmakes the world in his own image.

24255.Name: Ghost Quarter
24255.FlavorText: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

24529.Name: Coldsteel Heart
24529.FlavorText: The Phyrexian death machine awoke, its coldsteel heart imbuing it with sinister new power.

24649.Name: Into the North
24649.FlavorText:
"Our border lands fall under the grip of Heidar's second winter. Go forth and reclaim them for Yavimaya."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

27212.Name: Colossus of Sardia
27212.FlavorText: [Buried under a thin layer of dirt, it was known for centuries as Mount Sardia.]

28215.Name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
28215.FlavorText: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

28373.Name: Imperious Perfect
28373.FlavorText: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

28393.Name: Merrow Reejerey
28393.FlavorText: Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.

29172.Name: Distant Melody
29172.FlavorText: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

29196.Name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
29196.FlavorText: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

29535.Name: Rhys the Redeemed
29535.FlavorText: Whole again in honor and horn.

29621.Name: Ghastlord of Fugue
29621.FlavorText:
"He is a ghost that has never known life."
—The Seer's Parables

30893.Name: Ranger of Eos
30893.FlavorText: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.

30895.Name: Relic of Progenitus
30895.FlavorText: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

31061.Name: Wild Nacatl
31061.FlavorText: "The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."

32276.Name: Meddling Mage
32276.FlavorText: "This violent wasteland is an indictment of its people. These cowards lack the will to oppose disorder."

32388.Name: Maelstrom Pulse
32388.FlavorText: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

32426.Name: Enlisted Wurm
32426.FlavorText: A match for any army—even its own.

32601.Name: Tendrils of Corruption
32601.FlavorText: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

32675.Name: Soul Warden
32675.FlavorText: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

32925.Name: Merfolk Looter
32925.FlavorText: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

32951.Name: Ornithopter
32951.FlavorText: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

33035.Name: Platinum Angel
33035.FlavorText: In its heart lies the secret of immortality.

33069.Name: Hypnotic Specter
33069.FlavorText: Its victims are known by their eyes: shattered vessels leaking broken dreams.

35537.Name: Leatherback Baloth
35537.FlavorText: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

35569.Name: Dragonmaster Outcast
35569.FlavorText: "Cast out by my tribe, I am a pariah trapped in this mammal's carcass. Only my true kin hear my cries."

35573.Name: Death's Shadow
35573.FlavorText: The shadow of the candle looms tall even as its light grows dim.

35611.Name: Treasure Hunt
35611.FlavorText:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker

36668.Name: Kiln Fiend
36668.FlavorText: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

36740.Name: Gigantomancer
36740.FlavorText: "All life is driven by an indomitable will to survive. I simply turn that into something more . . . tangible."

37406.Name: Sun Titan
37406.FlavorText: A blazing sun that never sets.

37456.Name: Fauna Shaman
37456.FlavorText: She wears the talismans of every creature she can evoke.

37486.Name: Demon of Death's Gate
37486.FlavorText: The locks on the cages of the damned are opened with keys of marrow, sinew, and blood.

38043.Name: Kuldotha Rebirth
38043.FlavorText: All goblin rituals serve a dual purpose as fertility rites, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.

38091.Name: Inexorable Tide
38091.FlavorText:
"See how gratefully this world accepts our blessings."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

38095.Name: Goblin Gaveleer
38095.FlavorText:
"When everything looks like a nail, you really need to get yourself a hammer."
—Krol, goblin furnace-priest

38103.Name: Tempered Steel
38103.FlavorText:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper

38970.Name: Thing from the Deep
38970.FlavorText: Seafarers fear sailing off the world's edge not so much as down its gullet.

39339.Name: Ichor Wellspring
39339.FlavorText:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

39738.Name: Urabrask the Hidden
39738.FlavorText: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

39770.Name: Vault Skirge
39770.FlavorText: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

40555.Name: Dread Cacodemon
40555.FlavorText: Those who hear its roar perish. The lucky ones only feel its fetid breath.

40622.Name: Magmatic Force
40622.FlavorText:
"Granted, it's the pinnacle of utter destructiveness. So what would you call two of them?"
—Riku of Two Reflections

41355.Name: Timely Reinforcements
41355.FlavorText: The gods are not always kind, but they do have a soft spot for plucky underdogs.

42284.Name: Silent Departure
42284.FlavorText: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

42482.Name: Unburial Rites
42482.FlavorText: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

42534.Name: Think Twice
42534.FlavorText: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

42618.Name: Ancient Grudge
42618.FlavorText: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

42684.Name: Intangible Virtue
42684.FlavorText: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

42818.Name: Devil's Play
42818.FlavorText: A devil's hands are never idle.

43257.Name: Ray of Revelation
43257.FlavorText:
"May angels carry him into the Blessed Sleep with dreams of sunlit days and moonless nights."
—Tomb inscription of Saint Raban

43331.Name: Stromkirk Captain
43331.FlavorText:
"No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass."
—Runo Stromkirk

43459.Name: Burden of Guilt
43459.FlavorText:
"Grab an axe and defend the gate! Your despair is an extravagance we can ill afford."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

44125.Name: Griselbrand
44125.FlavorText:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

46669.Name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
46669.FlavorText: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

46873.Name: Court Homunculus
46873.FlavorText: Mages of Esper measure their wealth and status by the number of servants in their retinues.

46897.Name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
46897.FlavorText: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

47087.Name: Knight of the Reliquary
47087.FlavorText:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth

47143.Name: Ancient Ziggurat
47143.FlavorText: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

47485.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
47485.FlavorText: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

48499.Name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
48499.FlavorText: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

49077.Name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
49077.FlavorText: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

49109.Name: Disciple of Bolas
49109.FlavorText: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

49333.Name: Akroma's Memorial
49333.FlavorText:
"No rest. No mercy. No matter what."
—Memorial inscription

50871.Name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
50871.FlavorText: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

50873.Name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
50873.FlavorText: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

50895.Name: Ixidor, Reality Sculptor
50895.FlavorText: "Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws."

50943.Name: Body Double
50943.FlavorText: Where the dead outnumbered the living, mimics scavenged faces from the fallen.

51273.Name: Duskmantle, House of Shadow
51273.FlavorText: In a space where there is no room, in a structure that was never built, meets the guild that doesn't exist.

51307.Name: Ethereal Armor
51307.FlavorText: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

51359.Name: Cyclonic Rift
51359.FlavorText: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

51617.Name: Golgari Charm
51617.FlavorText:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

51619.Name: Grisly Salvage
51619.FlavorText: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

51691.Name: Supreme Verdict
51691.FlavorText: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

51725.Name: Judge's Familiar
51725.FlavorText:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

52781.Name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
52781.FlavorText: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

53405.Name: Simic Charm
53405.FlavorText:
"We measure our progress in heartbeats."
—Prime Speaker Zegana

53447.Name: Burning-Tree Emissary
53447.FlavorText: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

53511.Name: Thespian's Stage
53511.FlavorText: Amid rumors of war, the third act of The Absolution of the Guildpact was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

54163.Name: Elvish Mystic
54163.FlavorText:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

54233.Name: Accorder's Shield
54233.FlavorText: An Auriok shield is polished to a mirror finish even on the inside, enabling its bearer to watch foes ahead and behind.

54251.Name: Millstone
54251.FlavorText: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

54281.Name: Mutavault
54281.FlavorText: Some worlds possess a hidden core where life's essence constantly surges.

54347.Name: Fabled Hero
54347.FlavorText: "You. Poet. Be sure to write this down."

54387.Name: Soldier of the Pantheon
54387.FlavorText: "I hear the gods' voices in my dreams each night, and I offer bloody trophies on their altars each day."

54395.Name: Wingsteed Rider
54395.FlavorText: Trust is the only bridle a pegasus will accept.

54407.Name: Bident of Thassa
54407.FlavorText: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

54453.Name: Swan Song
54453.FlavorText:
"The most enlightened mages create beauty from violence."
—Medomai the Ageless

54503.Name: Hero's Downfall
54503.FlavorText: Destiny exalts a chosen few, but even heroes break.

54525.Name: Read the Bones
54525.FlavorText: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

55043.Name: Searing Blood
55043.FlavorText: Purphoros's blessing: sometimes a boon, sometimes a bane. Always ablaze.

55093.Name: Satyr Wayfinder
55093.FlavorText: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

55187.Name: Nyx-Fleece Ram
55187.FlavorText: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.

55283.Name: Doomwake Giant
55283.FlavorText: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

55395.Name: Eidolon of Blossoms
55395.FlavorText: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

55477.Name: Mana Confluence
55477.FlavorText: Five rivers encircle Theros, flowing with waters more ancient than the world itself.

55621.Name: Baleful Force
55621.FlavorText:
"As with any malevolent being, the trick is knowing how long you can afford to keep it in your service."
—Liliana Vess

57217.Name: Tribal Flames
57217.FlavorText:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

57507.Name: Ensoul Artifact
57507.FlavorText: Too often, some self-described genius comes up with a "labor-saving device" that ends up creating far more work.

57721.Name: Shrapnel Blast
57721.FlavorText: It requires immense pressure to imbue an item with magic. If the spell is broken . . .

57737.Name: Back to Nature
57737.FlavorText: There will always be those who presume to improve nature, or dare to befoul it. And nature will always have a response.

57821.Name: Sliver Hivelord
57821.FlavorText:
"This is the source, the line unbroken since the calamity that brought such monsters to our shores."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

57883.Name: Darksteel Citadel
57883.FlavorText: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

57939.Name: Abzan Battle Priest
57939.FlavorText: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."

57941.Name: Abzan Falconer
57941.FlavorText: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

57943.Name: Ainok Bond-Kin
57943.FlavorText: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

57945.Name: Alabaster Kirin
57945.FlavorText: The appearance of a kirin signifies the passing or arrival of an important figure. As word of sightings spread, all the khans took it to mean themselves. Only the shaman Chianul thought of Sarkhan Vol.

57947.Name: Brave the Sands
57947.FlavorText: Enduring the most desolate and dangerous conditions, Abzan sentries unfailingly guard the stronghold gates.

57949.Name: Dazzling Ramparts
57949.FlavorText: When Anafenza holds court under the First Tree, the gates of Mer-Ek are sealed. No safer place exists in all of Tarkir.

57951.Name: Defiant Strike
57951.FlavorText:
"Stand where the whole battle can see you. Strike so they'll never forget."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan

57953.Name: End Hostilities
57953.FlavorText: Her palm flared like the eye of a waking dragon. Then all was calm.

57955.Name: Erase
57955.FlavorText:
"Truth is hard enough to see, let alone understand. We must remove all distractions to find clarity."
—Zogye, wandering sage

57957.Name: Feat of Resistance
57957.FlavorText: Dragons are extinct on Tarkir, but Abzan magic still emulates their endurance.

57959.Name: Firehoof Cavalry
57959.FlavorText: "What warrior worth the name fears to leave a trail? If my enemies seek me, let them follow the ashes in my wake."

57965.Name: Jeskai Student
57965.FlavorText: Discipline is the first pillar of the Jeskai Way. Each member of the clan trains in a weapon, perfecting its use over a lifetime.

57967.Name: Kill Shot
57967.FlavorText: Mardu archers are trained in Dakla, the way of the bow. They never miss their target, no matter how small, how fast, or how far away.

57971.Name: Mardu Hordechief
57971.FlavorText: The horde grows with each assault.

57975.Name: Rush of Battle
57975.FlavorText: The Mardu charge reflects the dragon's speed—and its hunger.

57977.Name: Sage-Eye Harrier
57977.FlavorText: These winged warriors meditate in flight, tracing mandalas in the clouds.

57979.Name: Salt Road Patrol
57979.FlavorText:
"Soldiers win battles, but supplies win wars."
—Kadri, Abzan caravan master

57981.Name: Seeker of the Way
57981.FlavorText: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

57983.Name: Siegecraft
57983.FlavorText:
"They thought their fortress impregnable . . . until we marched up with ours, and blocked out the sun."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

57985.Name: Smite the Monstrous
57985.FlavorText:
"The dragons thought they were too strong to be tamed, too large to fall. And where are they now?"
—Khibat the Revered

57989.Name: Take Up Arms
57989.FlavorText:
"Many scales make the skin of a dragon."
—Abzan wisdom

57993.Name: Venerable Lammasu
57993.FlavorText: Lammasu are the enigmatic travelers of Tarkir, soaring high above all lands in all seasons. None know their true purpose, but they often arrive on the eve of great conflicts or turning points in history.

57995.Name: War Behemoth
57995.FlavorText:
"The Houses always hope for peace, but we always pack for war."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar commander

58001.Name: Blinding Spray
58001.FlavorText:
"The stronger our enemies seem, the more vulnerable they are."
—Sultai secret

58003.Name: Cancel
58003.FlavorText:
"Even the greatest inferno begins as a spark. And anyone can snuff out a spark."
—Chanyi, mistfire sage

58005.Name: Clever Impersonator
58005.FlavorText:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

58007.Name: Crippling Chill
58007.FlavorText: In the silence of the ice, even dreams become still.

58011.Name: Disdainful Stroke
58011.FlavorText: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

58015.Name: Embodiment of Spring
58015.FlavorText: Arel dreamed of winter's end. The next morning she followed a strange trail and found a seedling in the snow.

58017.Name: Force Away
58017.FlavorText: Where an enemy once rode, not even a whisper remains.

58019.Name: Glacial Stalker
58019.FlavorText:
"Have you spent a winter high in the mountains, where the ice walks and speaks to the wind? It is not a place for those who have not learned respect."
—Ulnok, Temur shaman

58021.Name: Icy Blast
58021.FlavorText: "Do not think the sand or the sun will hold back the breath of winter."

58025.Name: Jeskai Windscout
58025.FlavorText: They range from Sage-Eye Stronghold to the farthest reaches of Tarkir.

58031.Name: Monastery Flock
58031.FlavorText:
"The arrow strikes one bird down, but the flock remains."
—Jeskai teaching

58033.Name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
58033.FlavorText: "There are no obstacles, only different paths."

58039.Name: Riverwheel Aerialists
58039.FlavorText: Adepts of the Riverwheel Stronghold can run through rain and never get wet; masters use the raindrops as stepping stones.

58041.Name: Scaldkin
58041.FlavorText: The Temur believe that scaldkin are born when eruptions melt the frozen whispers of sleeping ancestors.

58043.Name: Scion of Glaciers
58043.FlavorText:
"There is nothing so free as the spring river born of winter's ice."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller

58045.Name: Set Adrift
58045.FlavorText: The envoy spoke, and Sidisi replied.

58049.Name: Stubborn Denial
58049.FlavorText: The Temur have no patience for subtlety.

58051.Name: Taigam's Scheming
58051.FlavorText: "The Jeskai would have me bow in restraint. So I have found a people unafraid of true power."

58055.Name: Treasure Cruise
58055.FlavorText: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

58057.Name: Waterwhirl
58057.FlavorText:
"Be as water: untamed and unheld, yet inexorably flowing toward a greater goal."
—Shensu, Riverwheel mystic

58059.Name: Weave Fate
58059.FlavorText: Temur shamans speak of three destinies: the now, the echo of the past, and the unwritten. They find flickering paths among tangled possibilities.

58061.Name: Wetland Sambar
58061.FlavorText: As a test of calm and compassion, a Jeskai monk softly approaches a grazing sambar and offers it a lotus from their hand. If the creature eats, the student ascends to the next level of training.

58063.Name: Whirlwind Adept
58063.FlavorText: The Flowing Staff technique does not differentiate between offense and defense.

58067.Name: Bitter Revelation
58067.FlavorText:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov

58069.Name: Bloodsoaked Champion
58069.FlavorText: "Death is merely another foe the Mardu will overcome."

58071.Name: Dead Drop
58071.FlavorText:
Got a diving lesson
—Sultai expression meaning
"was fed to the crocodiles"

58073.Name: Debilitating Injury
58073.FlavorText:
"If weakness does not exist within the Temur then we shall force it upon them."
—Sidisi, khan of the Sultai

58075.Name: Despise
58075.FlavorText:
"You have returned from fire, traitor. This time I will see you leave as ashes."
—Zurgo, to Sarkhan Vol

58077.Name: Disowned Ancestor
58077.FlavorText: Long after death, the spirits of the Disowned continue to seek redemption among their Abzan kin.

58085.Name: Gurmag Swiftwing
58085.FlavorText:
"Anything a falcon can do, a bat can do in pitch darkness."
—Urdnan the Wanderer

58087.Name: Kheru Bloodsucker
58087.FlavorText: It stares through the empty, pain-twisted faces of those it has drained.

58089.Name: Kheru Dreadmaw
58089.FlavorText: Its hunting instincts have long since rotted away. Its hunger, however, remains.

58091.Name: Krumar Bond-Kin
58091.FlavorText: "The Abzan replaced my savagery with a noble heritage. I would give my life for my House."

58097.Name: Molting Snakeskin
58097.FlavorText: Flesh wounds are meaningless to those who discard their flesh so readily.

58103.Name: Raiders' Spoils
58103.FlavorText:
"To conquer is to eat."
—Edicts of Ilagra

58107.Name: Retribution of the Ancients
58107.FlavorText: Abzan ancestors died to protect their Houses, and they protect them still.

58111.Name: Rotting Mastodon
58111.FlavorText: Mastodons became extinct long ago, but foul forces of the Gurmag Swamp sometimes animate their decaying remains. The Sultai happily exploit such creatures but consider them inferior to their own necromantic creations.

58119.Name: Sultai Scavenger
58119.FlavorText: Since they guard armies of walking carrion, Sultai aven are never far from a meal.

58123.Name: Throttle
58123.FlavorText:
"The best servants are made from those who died without a scratch."
—Sidisi, khan of the Sultai

58125.Name: Unyielding Krumar
58125.FlavorText: "The man whom I call father killed the orc who sired me, offering his world and his blade in return."

58129.Name: Ainok Tracker
58129.FlavorText: Some ainok of the mountains are accepted among the Temur as trusted hunt-mates.

58133.Name: Arrow Storm
58133.FlavorText: First the thunder, then the rain.

58137.Name: Barrage of Boulders
58137.FlavorText: Crude tactics can be effective nonetheless.

58139.Name: Bloodfire Expert
58139.FlavorText: Some efreet abandon their homes in the volcanic Fire Rim to embrace the Jeskai Way and discipline their innate flames.

58141.Name: Bloodfire Mentor
58141.FlavorText: The adept underwent months of preparation to withstand pain, until he was finally ready to receive the efreet master's teachings.

58143.Name: Bring Low
58143.FlavorText:
"People are often humbled by the elements. But the elements, too, can be humbled."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

58145.Name: Burn Away
58145.FlavorText:
"Your corruption will burn, serpent, until there is nothing left to defile."
—Asmala, bloodfire mystic

58147.Name: Canyon Lurkers
58147.FlavorText: The broken Qal Sisma foothills make poor terrain for cavalry, but a perfect setting for ambushes.

58153.Name: Dragon-Style Twins
58153.FlavorText: "We are the flicker of the flame and its heat, the two sides of a single blade."

58155.Name: Goblinslide
58155.FlavorText: Goblins, like snowflakes, are only dangerous in numbers.

58159.Name: Hordeling Outburst
58159.FlavorText:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

58165.Name: Leaping Master
58165.FlavorText: "Strength batters down barriers. Discipline ignores them."

58167.Name: Mardu Blazebringer
58167.FlavorText:
"Make sure he's pointed in the right direction before you light him. And don't let the goblins anywhere near the torch."
—Kerai Suddenblade, Mardu hordechief

58169.Name: Mardu Heart-Piercer
58169.FlavorText: "Those who have never ridden before the wind do not know the true joy of war."

58171.Name: Mardu Warshrieker
58171.FlavorText:
"No body can contain so much fury. It reminds me of another battle, long past."
—Sarkhan Vol

58173.Name: Monastery Swiftspear
58173.FlavorText: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

58177.Name: Shatter
58177.FlavorText: The ogre's mind snapped. The bow was next. The archer followed quickly after.

58179.Name: Summit Prowler
58179.FlavorText:
"Do you hunt the yetis of the high peaks, stripling? They are as fierce as the bear that fears no foe and as sly as the mink that creeps unseen. You will be as much prey as they."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller

58181.Name: Swift Kick
58181.FlavorText: Shintan sensed the malice in his opponent, but he did not strike until the orc's muscles tensed in preparation to throw the first punch.

58183.Name: Tormenting Voice
58183.FlavorText:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol

58185.Name: Trumpet Blast
58185.FlavorText:
"Do you hear that, Sarkhan? The glory of the horde! I made a legend from what you abandoned."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

58187.Name: Valley Dasher
58187.FlavorText: Mardu riders' greatest fear is that a battle might end before their weapons draw blood.

58189.Name: War-Name Aspirant
58189.FlavorText: No battle means more to a Mardu warrior than the one that earns her war name.

58191.Name: Alpine Grizzly
58191.FlavorText: The Temur welcome bears into the clan, fighting alongside them in battle. The relationship dates back to when they labored side by side under Sultai rule.

58193.Name: Archers' Parapet
58193.FlavorText: Every shaft is graven with a name from a kin tree, calling upon the spirits of the ancestors to make it fly true.

58195.Name: Awaken the Bear
58195.FlavorText: When Temur warriors enter the battle trance known as "awakening the bear," they lose all sense of enemy or friend, seeing only threats to the wilderness.

58199.Name: Dragonscale Boon
58199.FlavorText:
"When we were lost and weary, the ainok showed us how to survive. They have earned the right to call themselves Abzan, and to wear the Scale."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan

58201.Name: Feed the Clan
58201.FlavorText: The Temur believe three things only are needed in life: a hot fire, a full belly, and a strong companion.

58203.Name: Hardened Scales
58203.FlavorText:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

58205.Name: Heir of the Wilds
58205.FlavorText: In the high caves of the Qal Sisma mountains, young hunters quest to hear the echoes of their fierce ancestors.

58207.Name: Highland Game
58207.FlavorText:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon her head. This one hears the whispers."
—Chianul, at the weaving of Arel

58211.Name: Hooting Mandrills
58211.FlavorText: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.

58213.Name: Incremental Growth
58213.FlavorText: The bonds of family cross the boundaries of race.

58215.Name: Kin-Tree Warden
58215.FlavorText: "The amber of the tree and the blood of my veins are the same."

58221.Name: Naturalize
58221.FlavorText: The remains of ancient sky tyrants now feed the war-torn land.

58229.Name: Sagu Archer
58229.FlavorText: His arrows whistle like a serpent's hiss.

58233.Name: Scout the Borders
58233.FlavorText:
"I am in my element: the element of surprise."
—Mogai, Sultai scout

58237.Name: Seek the Horizon
58237.FlavorText: The Temur call the flickering lights the Path of Whispers, believing that they lead the way to ancestral knowledge.

58239.Name: Smoke Teller
58239.FlavorText: "See your enemies from a thousand sides. Then you will find a thousand ways to kill them."

58241.Name: Sultai Flayer
58241.FlavorText: "You can have the body, necromancer. I just want the skin."

58247.Name: Tusked Colossodon
58247.FlavorText: A band of Temur hunters, fleeing the Mardu, dug a hideout beneath such a creature as it slept. The horde found them and attacked. For three days the Temur held them at bay, and all the while the great beast slumbered.

58249.Name: Tuskguard Captain
58249.FlavorText: One quiet word sets off the stampede.

58251.Name: Windstorm
58251.FlavorText:
"When the last dragon fell, its spirit escaped as a roar into the wind."
—Temur tale

58253.Name: Woolly Loxodon
58253.FlavorText: Even among the hardiest warriors of the Temur, loxodons are respected for their adaptation to the mountain snows.

58261.Name: Abzan Guide
58261.FlavorText: "These roads are desolate and changeable. Follow me, or die in the wastes."

58263.Name: Anafenza, the Foremost
58263.FlavorText: Rarely at rest on the Amber Throne, Anafenza always leads the Abzan Houses to battle.

58265.Name: Ankle Shanker
58265.FlavorText: The stature of the fighter matters less than the depth of the cut.

58267.Name: Armament Corps
58267.FlavorText: The Abzan avoid extended supply lines by incorporating weapons stores into their battle formations.

58269.Name: Avalanche Tusker
58269.FlavorText:
"Hold the high ground, then bring it to your enemy."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

58271.Name: Bear's Companion
58271.FlavorText: "The Sultai came hunting for a bear hide. Now I have a belt of naga skin, and my friend has a full belly."

58275.Name: Chief of the Edge
58275.FlavorText: "We are the swift, the strong, the blade's sharp shriek! Fear nothing, and strike!"

58277.Name: Chief of the Scale
58277.FlavorText: "We are the shield unbroken. If we fall today, we will die well, and our trees will bear our names in honor."

58279.Name: Crackling Doom
58279.FlavorText: Do not fear the lightning. Fear the one it obeys.

58281.Name: Death Frenzy
58281.FlavorText: The crocodiles' putrid jaws swallow everything but the screams.

58285.Name: Duneblast
58285.FlavorText: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

58289.Name: Flying Crane Technique
58289.FlavorText: There are many Jeskai styles: Riverwalk imitates flowing water, Dragonfist the ancient hellkites, and Flying Crane the wild aven of the high peaks.

58291.Name: Highspire Mantis
58291.FlavorText: Its wings produce a high-pitched, barely audible whirring sound in flight. Only Jeskai masters are quiet enough to hear one coming.

58295.Name: Ivorytusk Fortress
58295.FlavorText: Abzan soldiers march to war confident that their Houses march with them.

58303.Name: Kin-Tree Invocation
58303.FlavorText: The passing years add new rings to the tree's trunk, bolstering the spirits that dwell within.

58305.Name: Mantis Rider
58305.FlavorText: Mantis riders know their mounts owe them no allegiance. Even a mantis ridden for years would consume a rider who loses focus for only a moment.

58311.Name: Mardu Roughrider
58311.FlavorText: The most ferocious saddlebrutes lead the assault, ramming through massed pikes and stout barricades as if they were paper and silk.

58313.Name: Master the Way
58313.FlavorText:
"The Way has no beginning and no end. It is simply the path."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

58315.Name: Mindswipe
58315.FlavorText:
"The past and the unwritten are frozen. To understand their meaning requires heat."
—Arel the Whisperer

58325.Name: Ride Down
58325.FlavorText:
"I will wash you from my hooves!"
—Mardu taunt

58327.Name: Sage of the Inward Eye
58327.FlavorText: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

58329.Name: Sagu Mauler
58329.FlavorText: The Sagu Jungle's thick undergrowth conceals even the largest predators—if they wish to remain hidden.

58337.Name: Siege Rhino
58337.FlavorText: The mere approach of an Abzan war beast is enough to send enemies fleeing in panic.

58339.Name: Snowhorn Rider
58339.FlavorText: Sure-footed, strong-willed, and ill-tempered—and so is the ram.

58345.Name: Sultai Charm
58345.FlavorText: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

58347.Name: Sultai Soothsayer
58347.FlavorText: The naga of the Sultai Brood made deals with dark forces to keep their power.

58349.Name: Surrak Dragonclaw
58349.FlavorText: Both his rank and his scars were earned in single combat against a cave bear.

58355.Name: Trap Essence
58355.FlavorText:
"Meat sustains the body. The spirit requires different sustenance."
—Arel the Whisperer

58357.Name: Utter End
58357.FlavorText:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

58361.Name: Warden of the Eye
58361.FlavorText: The wardens guard the sacred documents of Tarkir's history, though they are forbidden to read the words.

58363.Name: Winterflame
58363.FlavorText:
"The mountains scream with the dragons' throats."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

58367.Name: Abzan Banner
58367.FlavorText: Stone to endure, roots to remember.

58369.Name: Altar of the Brood
58369.FlavorText: Supplicants offer flesh and silver, flowers and blood. The altar takes what it will, eyes gleaming with unspoken promises.

58371.Name: Briber's Purse
58371.FlavorText: Victory is certain. The price, negotiable.

58375.Name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
58375.FlavorText: What once soared high above Tarkir is now reduced to a seat.

58377.Name: Ghostfire Blade
58377.FlavorText: If you fear the dragon's fire, you are unworthy to wield it.

58379.Name: Heart-Piercer Bow
58379.FlavorText: Designed by an ancient artificer, the finest Mardu bows are carved from dragon bone and strung with the wind itself.

58381.Name: Jeskai Banner
58381.FlavorText: Discipline to persevere, insight to discover.

58383.Name: Lens of Clarity
58383.FlavorText:
"Water shifts and confuses, but as ice it holds the stillness of truth."
—Arel the Whisperer

58385.Name: Mardu Banner
58385.FlavorText: Speed to strike, fury to smash.

58387.Name: Sultai Banner
58387.FlavorText: Power to dominate, cruelty to rule.

58389.Name: Temur Banner
58389.FlavorText: Savagery to survive, courage to triumph.

58391.Name: Ugin's Nexus
58391.FlavorText: All at once Sarkhan's mind fell silent.

58393.Name: Witness of the Ages
58393.FlavorText: It strode through the clash of dragons, the fall of Ugin, and the rise of the khans.

58397.Name: Bloodstained Mire
58397.FlavorText: Where dragons once triumphed, their bones now molder.

58403.Name: Flooded Strand
58403.FlavorText: Where dragons once slept, their bones now rest.

58405.Name: Frontier Bivouac
58405.FlavorText:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

58411.Name: Nomad Outpost
58411.FlavorText:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

58413.Name: Opulent Palace
58413.FlavorText: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

58415.Name: Polluted Delta
58415.FlavorText: Where dragons once prevailed, their bones now sink.

58427.Name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
58427.FlavorText:
"The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones. Is this more dragon trickery?"
—Sarkhan Vol

58433.Name: Windswept Heath
58433.FlavorText: Where dragons once roared, their bones now keen.

58435.Name: Wooded Foothills
58435.FlavorText: Where dragons' breath once burned, their bones now freeze.

59193.Name: Rally the Ancestors
59193.FlavorText:
"The family is a tree, and in times of need, every branch can be a weapon."
—Daghatar the Adamant

59771.Name: Swords to Plowshares
59771.FlavorText: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

59795.Name: Control Magic
59795.FlavorText:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

60235.Name: Sol Ring
60235.FlavorText: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

60783.Name: Virulent Plague
60783.FlavorText:
"This pestilence robs us of glorious death in battle. We starve to death with full bellies and drown trying to slake our unnatural thirst."
—Kerai Hatesinger, Kolaghan warrior

60833.Name: Rending Volley
60833.FlavorText: The sky offers few hiding places.

61307.Name: Tainted Remedy
61307.FlavorText:
"Drink this, brother. It will bring you rest."
—Liliana Vess

61419.Name: Elvish Visionary
61419.FlavorText: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

61421.Name: Evolutionary Leap
61421.FlavorText: The essence of nature is change.

61505.Name: Shaman of the Pack
61505.FlavorText: To the elves, her spear is a compass; to the boggarts, a harbinger of doom.

61641.Name: Scour from Existence
61641.FlavorText:
"Our people and our very lands disappear as if they never were. We no longer fight for glory, or honor. We battle now for the right to exist."
—General Tazri, allied commander

61645.Name: Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger
61645.FlavorText: A force as voracious as time itself.

61767.Name: Dispel
61767.FlavorText:
"I said we should destroy the Eldrazi. Ugin wanted to return them to stasis. Ugin's arguments were . . . unconvincing."
—Jace Beleren

61867.Name: Zulaport Cutthroat
61867.FlavorText: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now that's dangerous."

61999.Name: Sylvan Scrying
61999.FlavorText:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

62083.Name: Canopy Vista
62083.FlavorText: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

62085.Name: Cinder Glade
62085.FlavorText: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

62097.Name: Prairie Stream
62097.FlavorText: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

62109.Name: Smoldering Marsh
62109.FlavorText: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

62113.Name: Sunken Hollow
62113.FlavorText: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

62171.Name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
62171.FlavorText: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

62561.Name: Declaration in Stone
62561.FlavorText: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

62569.Name: Eerie Interlude
62569.FlavorText: The barrier between existence and oblivion is thinner than you know.

62629.Name: Thraben Inspector
62629.FlavorText: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

64261.Name: Reverse Engineer
64261.FlavorText: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

64663.Name: Inspiring Statuary
64663.FlavorText: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

64969.Name: Cursed Minotaur
64969.FlavorText:
"Look! That is why we must never waver. That is what awaits us if we fail."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop

64979.Name: Faith of the Devoted
64979.FlavorText:
"The more I see of this place, the less I want to."
—Chandra Nalaar

65061.Name: Flameblade Adept
65061.FlavorText:
"Allow zealous flames to light your path and the glory you seek will be revealed."
—Hazoret, god of zeal

65633.Name: Torment of Scarabs
65633.FlavorText: Like a carpet unrolling for their god, the scarabs poured out from the necropolis.

65963.Name: Ashes of the Abhorrent
65963.FlavorText: "Let no trace of the vampires' foulness remain."

65965.Name: Axis of Mortality
65965.FlavorText: The Church of Dusk teaches there is no gain without loss, no triumph without sacrifice, no drink of exquisite crimson without a dying gasp.

65967.Name: Bellowing Aegisaur
65967.FlavorText: Its roaring challenge is punctuated by the slam of its tail on the earth, rousing the herds of the plains.

65969.Name: Bishop of Rebirth
65969.FlavorText: "In the death of the foe lies the resurrection of the faithful."

65971.Name: Bishop's Soldier
65971.FlavorText: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

65973.Name: Bright Reprisal
65973.FlavorText: Vampires know blood and the systems that carry it. And they know exactly where to strike to set it free.

65975.Name: Demystify
65975.FlavorText: "The River Heralds carve spells into jade, hoping to steer us from our course. But what right do they have to keep us from that which once was ours?"

65981.Name: Encampment Keeper
65981.FlavorText: Paladins of the Sanctum Seeker order are an adventurous lot, venturing into the wilds with monstrous mastiffs at their side.

65983.Name: Glorifier of Dusk
65983.FlavorText: "The blood of the enemy is a sacrament. The strength it gives is proof that our cause is just."

65985.Name: Goring Ceratops
65985.FlavorText:
"Follow her footsteps and she will show you the way."
—Itzama the Crested

65987.Name: Imperial Aerosaur
65987.FlavorText: Its assistance is unnervingly similar to its hunting technique.

65989.Name: Imperial Lancer
65989.FlavorText: "Together my mount and I are stronger than either of us apart."

65991.Name: Inspiring Cleric
65991.FlavorText: "The Immortal Sun will bring us true eternal life to replace the everlasting shadow of undeath."

65993.Name: Ixalan's Binding
65993.FlavorText: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.

65995.Name: Kinjalli's Caller
65995.FlavorText: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects. Kinjalli is the Wakening Sun, who created humans from clay and baked them in the sun's warmth.

65997.Name: Kinjalli's Sunwing
65997.FlavorText:
"There are moments when I feel I could fly like the sunwing. Far away I would soar, but always a golden gale pushes me back."
—Huatli

65999.Name: Legion Conquistador
65999.FlavorText: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

66001.Name: Legion's Judgment
66001.FlavorText: "My lance was once wielded by Venerable Tarrian. In his name and by his might, I cast you down!"

66003.Name: Legion's Landing
66003.FlavorText:
"I claim this land in the name of the queen."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

66007.Name: Looming Altisaur
66007.FlavorText: Nature can't be tamed, but the Sun Empire believes that humans are made stronger when they test themselves against the wild strength of the dinosaurs.

66009.Name: Mavren Fein, Dusk Apostle
66009.FlavorText: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

66011.Name: Paladin of the Bloodstained
66011.FlavorText: Closely linked to the Church of Dusk, the paladins of the Bloodstained order are devout to the point of fanaticism.

66013.Name: Pious Interdiction
66013.FlavorText: "Ours is the true and righteous path. You will bow before our might."

66017.Name: Pterodon Knight
66017.FlavorText: "To rise like the sun—there is no greater feeling."

66019.Name: Queen's Commission
66019.FlavorText:
"Let the blood of the impure flow through you. Only the blessings of the golden city will purge its acrid taste from your mouth."
—High Marshal Arguel

66021.Name: Rallying Roar
66021.FlavorText:
"The sun's strength sings in our hearts! I have never been more proud of my home and my people."
—Huatli

66023.Name: Raptor Companion
66023.FlavorText: A raptor will follow any order as long as that order is "hunt," "kill," or "go for the guts."

66025.Name: Ritual of Rejuvenation
66025.FlavorText: "Nothing is more sacred than the gift of blood. Blessed are the vein that empties and the heart that is renewed."

66027.Name: Sanguine Sacrament
66027.FlavorText: "As the sun sets to make way for dawn, so we turn to darkness to bring about the coming salvation."

66031.Name: Sheltering Light
66031.FlavorText: Those who wield the power of the sun protect the Empire from darkness.

66033.Name: Shining Aerosaur
66033.FlavorText:
"The invaders cloak themselves in the shadows of dusk. Aerosaurs hide in the brilliance of the noonday sun."
—Caparocti Sunborn

66035.Name: Skyblade of the Legion
66035.FlavorText: Vampires call the gift of flight "exultation." For their enemies, it brings only sorrow.

66037.Name: Slash of Talons
66037.FlavorText:
"The amber sun smokes with fury, gazing on foes that gather like ants invading our home. We are ready! Blade and claw strike as one."
—Huatli

66039.Name: Steadfast Armasaur
66039.FlavorText:
"Like the mighty armasaur, we will defend against all who invade our shores."
—Itzama the Crested

66043.Name: Territorial Hammerskull
66043.FlavorText: From the eyes up, it's solid bone and stubbornness.

66045.Name: Tocatli Honor Guard
66045.FlavorText: The glorious city of Pachatupa is the center of the Sun Empire, and Tocatli, the emperor's palace, is its glowing heart.

66047.Name: Vampire's Zeal
66047.FlavorText: The Feast of Blood sends new life essence flowing through the vampire who partakes, manifesting as even greater strength and speed.

66049.Name: Wakening Sun's Avatar
66049.FlavorText:
"Kinjalli's encompassing rays herald new life in the moment of the sun's dawning."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

66051.Name: Air Elemental
66051.FlavorText: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

66057.Name: Chart a Course
66057.FlavorText: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

66061.Name: Deadeye Quartermaster
66061.FlavorText: "Welcome aboard, mate! You're going to need this."

66063.Name: Deeproot Waters
66063.FlavorText: A visit to the Deeproot Tree and its ancient spring replenishes a merfolk's connection to nature.

66065.Name: Depths of Desire
66065.FlavorText: Pockets full of gold, lungs full of brine.

66067.Name: Dive Down
66067.FlavorText: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

66071.Name: Entrancing Melody
66071.FlavorText: The stronger the will, the more bewitching the song.

66073.Name: Favorable Winds
66073.FlavorText:
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will."
—Huatli

66075.Name: Fleet Swallower
66075.FlavorText: "Captain, I think that island is following us."

66077.Name: Headwater Sentries
66077.FlavorText: "The elders say that if the intruders discovered the secret of the golden city, it would mean an end to our people."

66079.Name: Herald of Secret Streams
66079.FlavorText: "You might as well try to stop the waterfall."

66083.Name: Kopala, Warden of Waves
66083.FlavorText: "I know these waters better than you know yourselves."

66085.Name: Lookout's Dispersal
66085.FlavorText: Her song plucks the strings of the storm, shifting wind and storm into a harmony that will carry her ship to safety.

66087.Name: Navigator's Ruin
66087.FlavorText: "You won't be needing this. Or this. Or these . . ."

66089.Name: One With the Wind
66089.FlavorText:
"River and sea, jungle and sky. Water flows freely between the two halves of the world. We are creatures of the water."
—Shaper Tuvasa

66091.Name: Opt
66091.FlavorText: "It's easy to anticipate Captain Storm's orders: take the more dangerous route."

66093.Name: Overflowing Insight
66093.FlavorText: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

66095.Name: Perilous Voyage
66095.FlavorText: For the first time in her life, Vraska tried to prevent death.

66097.Name: Pirate's Prize
66097.FlavorText: Nothing warms the heart like plunder.

66099.Name: Prosperous Pirates
66099.FlavorText: The floating city of High and Dry hasn't yet sunk under the weight of gold, but it's not for want of trying.

66101.Name: River Sneak
66101.FlavorText: No ripples, no splashes, no warning.

66103.Name: River's Rebuke
66103.FlavorText: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

66105.Name: Run Aground
66105.FlavorText:
"That's the first time I've seen the ground do the running."
—Captain Brinely Rage

66107.Name: Sailor of Means
66107.FlavorText: In the Brazen Coalition, the wheels of business are greased with plunder.

66109.Name: Search for Azcanta
66109.FlavorText: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

66113.Name: Shaper Apprentice
66113.FlavorText: The River Heralds would wreck a thousand ships to keep intruders from finding the golden city.

66115.Name: Shipwreck Looter
66115.FlavorText: One pirate's wreck is another's reward.

66117.Name: Shore Keeper
66117.FlavorText: Over their long life spans, the larger trilobites accumulate vast treasure troves in their guts.

66121.Name: Siren Stormtamer
66121.FlavorText: He's the calm that hides the coming storm.

66123.Name: Siren's Ruse
66123.FlavorText: Deception and misdirection are the heart of the pirate's arsenal.

66125.Name: Spell Pierce
66125.FlavorText:
"A fool's fire is quickly quenched."
—Shaper Kumena

66129.Name: Storm Fleet Aerialist
66129.FlavorText: "Only one thing beats the freedom of the sea: the freedom of the sky."

66131.Name: Storm Fleet Spy
66131.FlavorText: "They're searching in the same direction we are. And for the same thing, I'll wager."

66133.Name: Storm Sculptor
66133.FlavorText: In his hands, the wind can become a weapon or a means of escape.

66137.Name: Watertrap Weaver
66137.FlavorText: The river is a powerful friend.

66139.Name: Wind Strider
66139.FlavorText: "Currents are currents, whether in sea or sky."

66141.Name: Anointed Deacon
66141.FlavorText: Inspiration is red as rubies, flowing like honeyed wine.

66143.Name: Arguel's Blood Fast
66143.FlavorText: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

66145.Name: Temple of Aclazotz
66145.FlavorText: . . . to the lost temple of a bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun.

66147.Name: Bishop of the Bloodstained
66147.FlavorText: "They shall give us all they have as penance for their resistance. Their ships. Their goods. Their rebellious blood."

66149.Name: Blight Keeper
66149.FlavorText: It withers fruit and flesh alike.

66151.Name: Bloodcrazed Paladin
66151.FlavorText: When a paladin undertaking the Blood Fast finally gives in to hunger, the violence is sudden, explosive, and complete.

66155.Name: Contract Killing
66155.FlavorText: For a price, the floating city of High and Dry offers all the amenities a pirate could want: rest, recreation, and revenge.

66157.Name: Costly Plunder
66157.FlavorText: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

66159.Name: Dark Nourishment
66159.FlavorText: Demons lurk in the shadows of ancient ruins, spreading plague and corruption across the land.

66161.Name: Deadeye Tormentor
66161.FlavorText: Despite their noble heritage, the pirates of the Deadeye Fleet are known for underhanded tactics and despicable trickery.

66165.Name: Deathless Ancient
66165.FlavorText: "Ancient one, we have reached the promised shore. The Immortal Sun is near. Drink and awake."

66167.Name: Desperate Castaways
66167.FlavorText: A pirate crew without a ship is a crew that will do anything to get one.

66169.Name: Dire Fleet Hoarder
66169.FlavorText: Among the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, the only thing more dangerous than failure is success.

66173.Name: Dire Fleet Ravager
66173.FlavorText: His fists fume with the decay of death, each strike a plague on the hearts of his enemies.

66175.Name: Duress
66175.FlavorText: Solitude and starvation are brutal punishments, but even worse is all that time to think.

66177.Name: Fathom Fleet Captain
66177.FlavorText: "Join me, and take the world for yourself!"

66179.Name: Fathom Fleet Cutthroat
66179.FlavorText: "It was a bad evening for you, mate. Now it's chow time for the sharks."

66181.Name: Grim Captain's Call
66181.FlavorText: When the battle is over, the bitterest foes at last find common ground.

66187.Name: Lurking Chupacabra
66187.FlavorText:
"Shadow birthed it. The moon gave it eyes, and the jungle gave it teeth. But it was Death that taught it cruelty."
—Huatli

66191.Name: Mark of the Vampire
66191.FlavorText:
"Through your sacrifice of self, you become holy. Through your strength, all will be saved."
—From the Rite of Redemption

66195.Name: Queen's Bay Soldier
66195.FlavorText: The soldiers of the Legion of Dusk have come to the colonies at Queen's Bay in search of glory and riches. They are veterans of centuries of warfare, and they thirst for conquest.

66197.Name: Raiders' Wake
66197.FlavorText: One was spared to tell the gruesome tale.

66203.Name: Ruthless Knave
66203.FlavorText: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."

66205.Name: Sanctum Seeker
66205.FlavorText: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

66209.Name: Skittering Heartstopper
66209.FlavorText: It flows like water over the forest floor, as deadly as the swiftest current.

66211.Name: Skulduggery
66211.FlavorText: "They're so much more willing to parley once they're hanging from a boom by the ankle!"

66213.Name: Skymarch Bloodletter
66213.FlavorText: From the perpetual shadowsmoke that hung above the ship, a silent form emerged, lips curled with malice and anticipation.

66215.Name: Spreading Rot
66215.FlavorText:
"What is this foul presence that defies the sun's cleansing rays?"
—Itzama the Crested

66217.Name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
66217.FlavorText: "Take my blood if you want. Just don't take my gold!"

66219.Name: Vanquish the Weak
66219.FlavorText: The clerics known as condemners punish those who do not recognize the righteous authority of the church.

66221.Name: Vicious Conquistador
66221.FlavorText:
"He is ambitious. Tireless. And utterly ruthless. Ideal for the frontier."
—Viceroy Elia Sotonores, report to the queen

66223.Name: Vraska's Contempt
66223.FlavorText: It wasn't long before the taverns of High and Dry were full of whispers about the new captain who could turn a person to stone with a glance.

66225.Name: Walk the Plank
66225.FlavorText: When Captain Thorn adds a new ship to his fleet, he gives the crew a simple choice: follow me, or fall in the sea.

66227.Name: Wanted Scoundrels
66227.FlavorText: "Trust me. The reward's not worth it."

66229.Name: Angrath's Marauders
66229.FlavorText: Captain Angrath cares less about treasure than mayhem. If he can't leave Ixalan, he'll burn the plane down.

66231.Name: Bonded Horncrest
66231.FlavorText:
"You don't tame a horncrest. You convince it that it's easier to destroy something else."
—Amautl, knight of Atzocan

66235.Name: Burning Sun's Avatar
66235.FlavorText:
"Tilonalli's searing rays carry the spark of life's eventual destruction as all light fades."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

66239.Name: Captivating Crew
66239.FlavorText: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

66241.Name: Charging Monstrosaur
66241.FlavorText: "I knew I should have stayed with the boat. Always stay with the boat!"

66243.Name: Demolish
66243.FlavorText: What took months for human hands to carve took just seconds for the dinosaur's tail to ruin.

66245.Name: Dinosaur Stampede
66245.FlavorText: If you're in the way of a ceratops charge and you're made of mere flesh and bone, then you're not really in the way.

66247.Name: Dual Shot
66247.FlavorText: "Through me the rage of Tilonalli burns twice as bright."

66249.Name: Fathom Fleet Firebrand
66249.FlavorText: As she charges into battle, her arcane tattoos stir and crawl like fiery serpents.

66251.Name: Fiery Cannonade
66251.FlavorText: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

66253.Name: Fire Shrine Keeper
66253.FlavorText: Though grimed with the dust of centuries, the ancient shrine was not unguarded.

66255.Name: Firecannon Blast
66255.FlavorText: Goblins' fearlessness and diminutive size make them the perfect cannoneers.

66257.Name: Frenzied Raptor
66257.FlavorText: Sun Empire warriors are taught to emulate the fearless raptors that fling themselves against towers of horn and muscle a hundred times their size.

66259.Name: Headstrong Brute
66259.FlavorText:
"Watch your backs, keep your blades at hand, and let the orc go first!"
—Captain Brandis Thorn

66261.Name: Hijack
66261.FlavorText: Trapped on Ixalan, the Planeswalker Angrath is the only minotaur sailing the seas. No matter how many ships he captures, he cannot break free.

66263.Name: Lightning Strike
66263.FlavorText:
"Storm on the horizon, cap'n!"
—Grick Doobin, last words

66265.Name: Lightning-Rig Crew
66265.FlavorText: A pirate ship in battle is a storm of activity.

66267.Name: Makeshift Munitions
66267.FlavorText: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

66269.Name: Nest Robber
66269.FlavorText:
"These sailors on our shores are like the dinosaurs that plunder eggs from nests. They live on the labors of others."
—Itzama the Crested

66271.Name: Otepec Huntmaster
66271.FlavorText: "Forward! Let the Burning Sun's light guide you to deserving prey!"

66273.Name: Rampaging Ferocidon
66273.FlavorText: All raptors are aggressive, but ferocidons seem to enjoy their prey's pain.

66275.Name: Raptor Hatchling
66275.FlavorText:
"Every little hatchling has a parent's claws to guard it."
—Sun Empire saying

66279.Name: Rigging Runner
66279.FlavorText: The hook makes him feel brave, and the hat makes him feel fancy.

66281.Name: Rile
66281.FlavorText: The enormous can still be at the mercy of the small.

66285.Name: Rummaging Goblin
66285.FlavorText: Goblins' eager curiosity leads them to scavenging, petty theft, and the rigging of sleek pirate ships. Some stop at scavenging.

66287.Name: Star of Extinction
66287.FlavorText:
"The visions haunt me. I see the end of the world, brought on by the search for the Immortal Sun."
—Shaper Pashona

66289.Name: Storm Fleet Arsonist
66289.FlavorText: "Go ahead, build another. I'll burn that down as well."

66293.Name: Sun-Crowned Hunters
66293.FlavorText: One alone is dangerous, and they are never alone.

66299.Name: Swashbuckling
66299.FlavorText: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition are the descendants of those displaced by the Legion of Dusk, and they are eager for vengeance.

66301.Name: Thrash of Raptors
66301.FlavorText: They glide through the undergrowth, drawn to sounds of disturbance. They attack in unison and all share in the kill. And then they move on.

66303.Name: Tilonalli's Knight
66303.FlavorText: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects. Tilonalli is the Burning Sun, associated with ferocity, fire, and passion.

66305.Name: Tilonalli's Skinshifter
66305.FlavorText: "I am the ferocity of the Burning Sun. I am hide and feather, fang and claw."

66309.Name: Unfriendly Fire
66309.FlavorText: Disputes within the Brazen Coalition can escalate from insult to broadside in the blink of an eye.

66311.Name: Vance's Blasting Cannons
66311.FlavorText: With a broadside assault, Captain Vance carved the cliffs to form her new home.

66313.Name: Spitfire Bastion
66313.FlavorText: Now instead of a ship, Ripley Vance commands a fortress.

66315.Name: Wily Goblin
66315.FlavorText: Goblins climb and swing with ease, whether through a pirate ship's rigging or a tree's branches.

66317.Name: Ancient Brontodon
66317.FlavorText: It is taller than all but the tallest trees, and older than all but the oldest.

66319.Name: Atzocan Archer
66319.FlavorText: His arrows are fletched with feathers from the greatest of the winged dinosaurs.

66321.Name: Blinding Fog
66321.FlavorText: "I see you, shiny soldiers, but you won't see me."

66323.Name: Blossom Dryad
66323.FlavorText: The only force on Ixalan not interested in finding the golden city is Ixalan itself.

66325.Name: Carnage Tyrant
66325.FlavorText: Sun Empire commanders are well versed in advanced martial strategy. Still, the correct maneuver is usually to deploy the giant, implacable death lizard.

66327.Name: Colossal Dreadmaw
66327.FlavorText: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

66331.Name: Crash the Ramparts
66331.FlavorText: The Legion's conquistadors could endure Ixalan's sun. Their forts could withstand a charging ceratops. But nothing can stop a ceratops strengthened by the sun.

66333.Name: Crushing Canopy
66333.FlavorText:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

66337.Name: Deeproot Champion
66337.FlavorText: "No good will come from what you seek. Turn back now or suffer an ignoble death far from your home."

66339.Name: Deeproot Warrior
66339.FlavorText:
"We breathe from our soul and bones to give strength to the jungle. The jungle breathes from its roots and rivers to give strength to us."
—Shaper Falani

66341.Name: Drover of the Mighty
66341.FlavorText: "I do not lead. They do not follow. We walk together."

66343.Name: Emergent Growth
66343.FlavorText: "By accepting my smallness I am vast."

66347.Name: Grazing Whiptail
66347.FlavorText: Often found browsing on the upper canopies of Ixalan's jungles, whiptails are known to absently bat away anything foolish enough to interrupt their meal.

66351.Name: Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
66351.FlavorText: Before the Sun Empire was born, humans and merfolk joined their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility on the land.

66355.Name: Ixalli's Keeper
66355.FlavorText: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects. Ixalli is the Verdant Sun, who fosters growth in all things.

66357.Name: Jade Guardian
66357.FlavorText: The River Heralds believe that jade gives weight to their magic.

66359.Name: Jungle Delver
66359.FlavorText: "There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."

66361.Name: Kumena's Speaker
66361.FlavorText: "The same power that drives the river ever onward flows through the roots and branches—to me."

66367.Name: Old-Growth Dryads
66367.FlavorText: "The jungle was here before any city. It will be here after the last city falls."

66369.Name: Pounce
66369.FlavorText: The drive to hunt and feed is raw instinct for dinosaurs. The trick is simply to channel it in the right direction.

66371.Name: Ranging Raptors
66371.FlavorText: They cover their territory like a tide of teeth and claws.

66373.Name: Ravenous Daggertooth
66373.FlavorText: A daggertooth's triumphant roar makes all the sounds of jungle life fall silent.

66375.Name: Ripjaw Raptor
66375.FlavorText: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

66377.Name: River Heralds' Boon
66377.FlavorText: "We are kin to the trees, and their strength is our own."

66381.Name: Shapers' Sanctuary
66381.FlavorText: Protection is woven into every vine and branch.

66383.Name: Slice in Twain
66383.FlavorText: The magic of the River Heralds is so great that even a single shaman can fend off a pirate landing party.

66385.Name: Snapping Sailback
66385.FlavorText: Lurking beneath the murky waters of Ixalan's rivers, sailbacks can rip a meal off the shore in the blink of an eye.

66387.Name: Spike-Tailed Ceratops
66387.FlavorText: The conquistadors surrounded the dinosaur only to find that it had outflanked them.

66389.Name: Thundering Spineback
66389.FlavorText:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

66393.Name: Verdant Rebirth
66393.FlavorText: The dryads of the forest have no stake in Ixalan's conflict, but they hate to see any living being suffer.

66395.Name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
66395.FlavorText:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

66397.Name: Vineshaper Mystic
66397.FlavorText: She has never touched a loom, yet the tapestries she weaves are vast and beautiful.

66399.Name: Waker of the Wilds
66399.FlavorText: "Our foes are many and mighty, but not as many as the trees or as mighty as the sea."

66401.Name: Wildgrowth Walker
66401.FlavorText:
"Hear me, stone, root, branch: be the fist of this land. Turn back those who trample upon your domain."
—Song of the Shaper

66403.Name: Admiral Beckett Brass
66403.FlavorText: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

66405.Name: Belligerent Brontodon
66405.FlavorText: Predators try to separate the young, old, or injured from the rest of the herd. The alternative is crushing defeat.

66407.Name: Call to the Feast
66407.FlavorText: By the law of church and crown, vampires feed only on the blood of the guilty—those declared heretics, rebels, or enemies of war.

66409.Name: Deadeye Plunderers
66409.FlavorText: "Keep your friends close and your enemies within range."

66411.Name: Dire Fleet Captain
66411.FlavorText: Orcs are happiest under captains who steer toward battle. Orcs of the Dire Fleet are downright jovial.

66421.Name: Raging Swordtooth
66421.FlavorText: Carnivorous dinosaurs developed a taste for undead flesh, tracking the vampires by the scent of blood on their breath.

66423.Name: Regisaur Alpha
66423.FlavorText:
"Seeing a pack of these monsters hunt together, I'm at a loss to imagine the size of their prey."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

66425.Name: Shapers of Nature
66425.FlavorText: Shapers adapt nature to fit their needs and then return it to the way it was, leaving no trace of their passing.

66427.Name: Sky Terror
66427.FlavorText:
"Wherever the Threefold Sun shines, great wings may go."
—Emperor Apatzec Intli III

66431.Name: Vona, Butcher of Magan
66431.FlavorText: "For four hundred years, I have led armies of conquest. These lands hold nothing that can stand against me."

66443.Name: Lost Vale
66443.FlavorText: The pirates had ventured into the interior for treasure. They found something far greater.

66445.Name: Dusk Legion Dreadnought
66445.FlavorText: It loomed up over the horizon, silent and dark as a grave.

66451.Name: Gilded Sentinel
66451.FlavorText: The River Heralds fight to keep all others from reaching the golden city. The city has its own defenses.

66453.Name: Hierophant's Chalice
66453.FlavorText: In the Rite of Redemption, nobles take the same vows as Elenda, the first vampire, and make the same eternal sacrifice.

66469.Name: Sleek Schooner
66469.FlavorText: The pirates had left the open sea behind, but they were still in their element: reckless adventure.

66473.Name: Thaumatic Compass
66473.FlavorText:
"Clearly, it indicates the aetheric azimuth of . . ."
—Jace Beleren

66479.Name: Treasure Cove
66479.FlavorText: Half the treasure is the glory of finding it.

66483.Name: Dragonskull Summit
66483.FlavorText: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

66485.Name: Drowned Catacomb
66485.FlavorText: None can tell how many vessels are tangled up on the sea floor—or how much treasure remains unclaimed.

66489.Name: Glacial Fortress
66489.FlavorText: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

66491.Name: Rootbound Crag
66491.FlavorText: Cliffs echo and branches quake at the roar of life.

66493.Name: Sunpetal Grove
66493.FlavorText: To the Sun Empire, any place where daylight brightens the jungle floor is sacred ground.

66497.Name: Unknown Shores
66497.FlavorText:
"Just imagine what's waiting around the bend. Adventure. Discovery. Riches for the taking. This is why I sail."
—Captain Lannery Storm

66547.Name: Jace's Sentinel
66547.FlavorText: "We drove the Sun Empire out of the forest long ago, and we will not let them return."

66549.Name: Woodland Stream
66549.FlavorText: Countless streams flow into the nine rivers, and the nine rivers flow into the Great River. The River Heralds guard them all.

66553.Name: Huatli's Snubhorn
66553.FlavorText: Don't make the mistake of thinking blunt horns can't kill.

66555.Name: Huatli's Spurring
66555.FlavorText: "Run like the wind, fierce one. The hunt has begun."

66557.Name: Sun-Blessed Mount
66557.FlavorText: When Huatli chooses a mount, its eyes glow with the flames of the sun.

66559.Name: Stone Quarry
66559.FlavorText: The Sun Empire's cities are built from the bones of the earth.

66623.Name: Blazing Hope
66623.FlavorText:
"No shadow remains for you to hide in."
—Caparocti Sunborn

66625.Name: Cleansing Ray
66625.FlavorText:
"The sun creates, sustains, and consumes so it can create again."
—Caparocti Sunborn

66627.Name: Divine Verdict
66627.FlavorText: Cunning warriors and dim-witted beasts alike fall under the church's harsh judgment.

66629.Name: Everdawn Champion
66629.FlavorText:
"Undefeated in battle, she is the shining future our empire deserves."
—Huatli

66631.Name: Exultant Skymarcher
66631.FlavorText: "We have come at last to this holiest of holy places. What was stolen from us long ago is ours once again."

66633.Name: Famished Paladin
66633.FlavorText: Loyal to his queen, slave to his thirst.

66637.Name: Imperial Ceratops
66637.FlavorText:
"The music of blades against its silver armor merely inspires it to bellow more full-throated melodies."
—Huatli

66639.Name: Legion Conquistador
66639.FlavorText: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

66641.Name: Luminous Bonds
66641.FlavorText: "Your part in this fight is done, vampire. Get used to your thirst."

66643.Name: Majestic Heliopterus
66643.FlavorText:
"Its rise is like the sun's, a beautiful beginning. Its descent is like the sun's, a frightful ending."
—Huatli

66645.Name: Martyr of Dusk
66645.FlavorText: "Should I fall, take up our standard and carry on. The Legion must always prevail."

66647.Name: Moment of Triumph
66647.FlavorText: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

66649.Name: Paladin of Atonement
66649.FlavorText: For every wound there is a blessing; for every death, a reckoning.

66655.Name: Raptor Companion
66655.FlavorText: The abundance of foes in Orazca means the raptors no longer need any orders.

66657.Name: Sanguine Glorifier
66657.FlavorText: For the Legion of Dusk, the Immortal Sun is a source of eternal life. When they reclaim it, they will no longer be forced to subsist on the blood of the wicked.

66661.Name: Slaughter the Strong
66661.FlavorText:
"Cut the beasts out from under them and their strength is nothing."
—Vona of Iedo, Butcher of Magan

66663.Name: Snubhorn Sentry
66663.FlavorText: They're fun to train—if you like stubborn, aggressive, and fiercely territorial.

66669.Name: Sun Sentinel
66669.FlavorText: "I will not sleep until Orazca is ours once more."

66671.Name: Sun-Crested Pterodon
66671.FlavorText:
"Pterodons tolerate no intrusion into their skies. Even the clouds must ask permission."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

66673.Name: Temple Altisaur
66673.FlavorText:
"Kinjalli sculpted humans from clay, but the dinosaurs were carved from unyielding stone."
—Itzama the Crested

66675.Name: Trapjaw Tyrant
66675.FlavorText:
"I would advise you not to struggle."
—Huatli

66677.Name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
66677.FlavorText: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

66683.Name: Crafty Cutpurse
66683.FlavorText: Possession is eleven-tenths of the pirate code.

66693.Name: Flood of Recollection
66693.FlavorText: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.

66695.Name: Hornswoggle
66695.FlavorText: Being a merciful pirate, she saved the vampire's gold from falling overboard.

66699.Name: Kitesail Corsair
66699.FlavorText: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

66703.Name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
66703.FlavorText: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against the three enemy forces.

66705.Name: Negate
66705.FlavorText: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: ‘No.'"

66709.Name: Release to the Wind
66709.FlavorText: "Here and gone like a fleeting breeze."

66713.Name: Riverwise Augur
66713.FlavorText: "Time flows as the rivers do, toward an unknown sea. The wise know to look downstream."

66715.Name: Sailor of Means
66715.FlavorText: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

66717.Name: Sea Legs
66717.FlavorText: "When the waves pick up, either you find your feet or you lose your lunch."

66719.Name: Seafloor Oracle
66719.FlavorText: Where the light falls dim and blue on broken ships, secrets lie unclaimed.

66721.Name: Secrets of the Golden City
66721.FlavorText: Stolen knowledge can never be stolen back.

66723.Name: Silvergill Adept
66723.FlavorText: "If you keep to the shallows, you'll never learn the secrets of the depths."

66727.Name: Slippery Scoundrel
66727.FlavorText: "I'd rather be caught red-handed than leave empty-handed!"

66729.Name: Soul of the Rapids
66729.FlavorText: With Kumena in control of the Immortal Sun, the rapids rose from their riverbeds and the waterfalls took flight.

66733.Name: Sworn Guardian
66733.FlavorText: For the River Heralds, the Immortal Sun is an object of terror and devastation. The idea that anyone would retrieve it for their own use is utterly abhorrent.

66741.Name: Arterial Flow
66741.FlavorText: "It is impious to admit, but I do enjoy pirate blood. Something in the salty tang of it, the spice of rebellion."

66743.Name: Canal Monitor
66743.FlavorText: The first goblin tried to swim the canal. The second built a raft. The last and craftiest goblin launched herself from a firecannon and soared over the canal, trailing smoke. All were eaten, but only one was cooked.

66745.Name: Champion of Dusk
66745.FlavorText: "Drench these golden streets in the blood of our enemies."

66747.Name: Dark Inquiry
66747.FlavorText: "Your mind is no longer yours to waste."

66751.Name: Dinosaur Hunter
66751.FlavorText: "Aye, the foul beast chomped me, but I got away. You'd best believe when I find it again, it won't get away so easy."

66755.Name: Dusk Charger
66755.FlavorText: Stories say demon blood runs in its veins, making it fearless and bloodthirsty.

66757.Name: Dusk Legion Zealot
66757.FlavorText: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

66759.Name: Fathom Fleet Boarder
66759.FlavorText: Without frequent raids, orcs sometimes get bored and plunder their own ships.

66765.Name: Grasping Scoundrel
66765.FlavorText: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."

66767.Name: Gruesome Fate
66767.FlavorText:
"You were keen enough to sink your fangs into us, vampire! And now you're afraid of a few little nibbles?"
—Udvil "Ratty" Ratlock

66769.Name: Impale
66769.FlavorText: Never let the glitter of gold distract you from the gleam of steel in the shadows.

66771.Name: Mastermind's Acquisition
66771.FlavorText: Another piece of a nefarious puzzle.

66775.Name: Moment of Craving
66775.FlavorText: "The time of condemnation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and I consign you to eternal darkness!"

66777.Name: Oathsworn Vampire
66777.FlavorText:
"My conquistadors are never slain, merely laid to rest."
—Queen Miralda the Pious

66779.Name: Pitiless Plunderer
66779.FlavorText: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

66781.Name: Ravenous Chupacabra
66781.FlavorText: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

66783.Name: Reaver Ambush
66783.FlavorText: Onora knew with sudden, grim certainty he would never see the Great River again.

66785.Name: Recover
66785.FlavorText:
"No more fear of death's oblivion—is this not the greatest treasure of all?"
—Gurezan, Legion resurrectionist

66787.Name: Sadistic Skymarcher
