66787.FlavorText: "I will catch you, child of the sun. I will drink your life and leave you a husk, discarded in the shadows."

66795.Name: Vampire Revenant
66795.FlavorText:
"A thick fog obscures the port of Leor, but it's not thick enough to muffle the screams."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

66799.Name: Voracious Vampire
66799.FlavorText: The purest devotion isn't the Blood Fast itself, but the craving that follows.

66801.Name: Blood Sun
66801.FlavorText: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.

66803.Name: Bombard
66803.FlavorText:
"Want to sink a ship? Blow a hole in the hull. Want to kill a regisaur? Same answer."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

66805.Name: Brass's Bounty
66805.FlavorText:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

66809.Name: Buccaneer's Bravado
66809.FlavorText: Never underestimate the power of panache.

66811.Name: Charging Tuskodon
66811.FlavorText: It doesn't hold grudges. It runs them down and impales them.

66813.Name: Daring Buccaneer
66813.FlavorText: No ancient lore ties the pirates of the Brazen Coalition to the Immortal Sun. But it's a powerful ancient artifact in a city of gold—what's not to covet?

66817.Name: Etali, Primal Storm
66817.FlavorText: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

66819.Name: Fanatical Firebrand
66819.FlavorText:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

66825.Name: Frilled Deathspitter
66825.FlavorText: Nothing says trouble like a reedy hiss with a hint of liquid gurgle.

66827.Name: Goblin Trailblazer
66827.FlavorText:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, Diremore first mate

66829.Name: Mutiny
66829.FlavorText: Pirate captains rarely enjoy a peaceful retirement.

66831.Name: Needletooth Raptor
66831.FlavorText: It hatches with its ferocity fully grown.

66833.Name: Orazca Raptor
66833.FlavorText:
"If you come across a raptor in the city, stay perfectly still. At least then you'll be well rested when you die."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

66835.Name: Pirate's Pillage
66835.FlavorText: Goblins can carry their body weight in loot.

66837.Name: Reckless Rage
66837.FlavorText: "Hard to starboard! Starb— Abandon ship! Abandon ship!"

66843.Name: Shake the Foundations
66843.FlavorText: A threefold calamity with a single will.

66845.Name: Shatter
66845.FlavorText: Today it's a miracle of architecture, a marvel of stained glass, a symbol of the Legion's power. Tomorrow, driftwood.

66847.Name: Silverclad Ferocidons
66847.FlavorText:
"Control them? No. I gird them in armor and let them loose."
—Yacha, Otepec huntmaster

66849.Name: Stampeding Horncrest
66849.FlavorText: When the golden city opened, the dinosaurs inside were eager to greet the new visitors.

66851.Name: Storm Fleet Swashbuckler
66851.FlavorText: "A bolt to the eye, a blade to the neck. That's the way to clear the deck!"

66853.Name: Sun-Collared Raptor
66853.FlavorText:
"With Tilonalli's gifts, even the smallest of us can become great."
—Huatli

66855.Name: Swaggering Corsair
66855.FlavorText: "I'm about to make you famous. From the golden city to High and Dry, they'll talk about how fast you died!"

66861.Name: Aggressive Urge
66861.FlavorText: "Our lives, our homes, and all our history are at risk. Do not speak to me of peace."

66863.Name: Cacophodon
66863.FlavorText: When a cacophodon is angry, the whole jungle knows.

66865.Name: Cherished Hatchling
66865.FlavorText: Despite its appearance, it's anything but defenseless.

66867.Name: Colossal Dreadmaw
66867.FlavorText:
"Remember when it was the most terrifying thing you'd ever seen?"
—Captain Lannery Storm

66869.Name: Crested Herdcaller
66869.FlavorText:
"Our survival, like theirs, depends on our ability to work together."
—Huatli, to Tishana

66871.Name: Deeproot Elite
66871.FlavorText: "You think I stand alone? I have the forest at my call, the waters at my back. I outnumber you."

66877.Name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
66877.FlavorText: The earth walks, strongest of all.

66879.Name: Giltgrove Stalker
66879.FlavorText: "The only gold I need is the sheltering shimmer of the trees."

66881.Name: Hardy Veteran
66881.FlavorText: For the Sun Empire, the Immortal Sun is a symbol of national identity. When they reclaim it, the Empire will flourish once more.

66883.Name: Hunt the Weak
66883.FlavorText:
"Death lizard approaching, cap'n!"
—Brint Doobin, last words

66885.Name: Jade Bearer
66885.FlavorText: "Sisora wore this, who defeated the tyrant of Azcanta, and before her Natena of Vuhana's band. May it bring you their strength."

66887.Name: Jadecraft Artisan
66887.FlavorText: "A blade is not fully forged until it is given."

66891.Name: Jungleborn Pioneer
66891.FlavorText: "We fought so long to hide this place. Let us be first to learn its wonders!"

66895.Name: Naturalize
66895.FlavorText:
"Better to let the sword go than to lose the arm with it."
—Captain Lannery Storm

66897.Name: Orazca Frillback
66897.FlavorText: The frillbacks of Orazca soak up the sun on their tall spinal fins. They look slow and sleepy—until they catch the scent of prey.

66899.Name: Overgrown Armasaur
66899.FlavorText: It embodies the riotous growth of the jungle, where creatures crowd upon creatures, where roots sprawl and vines swarm.

66903.Name: Plummet
66903.FlavorText:
"Still, the pterodon chasing the clouds from its skies must bow to the great forest below."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

66905.Name: Polyraptor
66905.FlavorText: An innumerable pack is concealed in a single reflection.

66907.Name: Strength of the Pack
66907.FlavorText: The pack that ambushes, eviscerates, and devours together stays together.

66909.Name: Swift Warden
66909.FlavorText: A warning shout would take too long.

66913.Name: Thrashing Brontodon
66913.FlavorText: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

66915.Name: Thunderherd Migration
66915.FlavorText: The herds follow as new growth arises.

66919.Name: World Shaper
66919.FlavorText: "The Great River will not be tamed."

66923.Name: Atzocan Seer
66923.FlavorText: Streams of gold and bright feathers flash in the orb, visions of past and future.

66929.Name: Dire Fleet Neckbreaker
66929.FlavorText: The buccaneers scaled the sides of buildings as easily as they boarded enemy ships.

66933.Name: Hadana's Climb
66933.FlavorText: Hadana seeks power in the service of peace.

66939.Name: Journey to Eternity
66939.FlavorText: Every journey has its inevitable end . . .

66941.Name: Atzal, Cave of Eternity
66941.FlavorText: . . . but every end is a new beginning.

66943.Name: Jungle Creeper
66943.FlavorText:
"You cannot kill it, not for long. It ripens where the ground is soaked with the blood of the slaughtered."
—Atiuru, priest of the Verdant Sun

66947.Name: Legion Lieutenant
66947.FlavorText: "We long ago abandoned the things that make humans weak: friendship, marriage, family. All that remains is the strength of our devotion."

66949.Name: Merfolk Mistbinder
66949.FlavorText:
"The mist clothes us when we are bare, hides us when we are alone, and unites us when we are together."
—Nirit of Pashona's band

66955.Name: Profane Procession
66955.FlavorText: Vona sought a conqueror. Mavren sought a savior. Both found what they sought . . .

66957.Name: Tomb of the Dusk Rose
66957.FlavorText: . . . resting in the splendor of the dead.

66959.Name: Protean Raider
66959.FlavorText: Imitation is the sincerest form of piracy.

66961.Name: Raging Regisaur
66961.FlavorText: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.

66963.Name: Relentless Raptor
66963.FlavorText: As the battle for Orazca unfolded, the contenders discovered that others had already staked a claim.

66967.Name: Siegehorn Ceratops
66967.FlavorText: To a siegehorn, there is no such thing as a dead end.

66969.Name: Storm Fleet Sprinter
66969.FlavorText:
"Charge like a red-hot cannonball straight to your target. You slow down, you sink."
—Captain Lannery Storm

66973.Name: Vault of Catlacan
66973.FlavorText: Swimming in coins proved harder than they'd hoped, but dancing was a jingling delight.

66981.Name: Sanctum of the Sun
66981.FlavorText: As soon as Jace laid eyes on the great sphinx's chamber, the shards of memory began sliding into place.

66985.Name: Gleaming Barrier
66985.FlavorText:
"Gold without freedom might as well be lead."
—Angrath

66989.Name: Gold-Forge Garrison
66989.FlavorText: An army of living gold for the golden city.

66995.Name: Silent Gravestone
66995.FlavorText: Made to ward off the Grim Captain and silence the lure of undeath.

66997.Name: Strider Harness
66997.FlavorText:
"Because the giant, implacable death lizard wasn't scary enough already."
—Captain Brinely Rage

66999.Name: Traveler's Amulet
66999.FlavorText:
"The best kind of treasure is the kind that leads to more treasure!"
—Captain Lannery Storm

67003.Name: Evolving Wilds
67003.FlavorText: The Sun Empire bends nature—rivers, mountainsides, dinosaurs—to its unyielding will.

67005.Name: Forsaken Sanctuary
67005.FlavorText: In the galleon's grand cathedral, conquistadors swore vows of faith. In its wreckage, they swore vows of revenge.

67007.Name: Foul Orchard
67007.FlavorText: The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.

67009.Name: Highland Lake
67009.FlavorText:
"A place like this makes me wonder if there's more to life than blood and treasure . . . Nah."
—Boyl Bucksalt, Storm Fleet swab

67011.Name: Stone Quarry
67011.FlavorText: The Sun Empire's cities are built from the bones of the earth.

67013.Name: Woodland Stream
67013.FlavorText: Countless streams flow into the nine rivers, and the nine rivers flow into the Great River. The River Heralds guard them all.

67027.Name: Vampire Champion
67027.FlavorText: "These pirates must answer for their ancestors, who renounced the Church of Dusk and sailed from Torrezon as heretics."

67029.Name: Vraska's Conquistador
67029.FlavorText: Abandoning both queen and church, he chose to follow power.

67035.Name: Angrath's Ambusher
67035.FlavorText: Orcs have been enemies of the Legion of Dusk since it was formed, and the entire race has been declared anathema.

67037.Name: Swab Goblin
67037.FlavorText: Though small, goblins can hold their own in a fight. Foolhardy confidence goes a long way.

67041.Name: Cinder Barrens
67041.FlavorText:
"Burn their fleet to the waterline, and sink whatever's left."
—Angrath

67068.Name: Clue
67068.FlavorText:
"Their chanting grows louder as the tide rises."
—Tamiyo's journal
67068.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

67071.Name: Clue
67071.FlavorText:
"Remember to have Jenrik research Markov Manor."
—Tamiyo's journal
67071.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

67082.Name: City's Blessing
67082.FlavorText: Once you have ascended to the highest temple of Orazca, the power of the Immortal Sun is yours to wield forever.

67108.Name: Adamant Will
67108.FlavorText: The shield took a year to craft, a month to enchant, and a decade to master—all for one glorious moment.

67110.Name: Aven Sentry
67110.FlavorText: "My flock flew from a distant continent ruined by cataclysm and war. Benalia gave us shelter to end our exodus."

67112.Name: Baird, Steward of Argive
67112.FlavorText: "The walls of Argive were built by a peaceful dynastic union that has guarded us against war for fifteen centuries. The lesson is clear."

67114.Name: Benalish Honor Guard
67114.FlavorText:
"The true measure of all heroes is not what they achieve, but who they inspire."
—Triumph of Gerrard

67116.Name: Benalish Marshal
67116.FlavorText:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—History of Benalia

67118.Name: Blessed Light
67118.FlavorText: Enchanted by mage-smiths and blessed by priests, Benalish windows let in light and cast out darkness.

67120.Name: Board the Weatherlight
67120.FlavorText: A new gathering for a new age.

67122.Name: Call the Cavalry
67122.FlavorText: Benalish citizens born under the same constellations share a star-clan. Their loyalty to one another interlaces the Seven Houses.

67124.Name: Charge
67124.FlavorText:
"Honor rides before us. All we have to do is catch up."
—Danitha Capashen

67126.Name: D'Avenant Trapper
67126.FlavorText:
"Go swiftly, clever arrow, and teach
The philosophy of stillness."
—D'Avenant verse

67128.Name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
67128.FlavorText: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

67132.Name: Dauntless Bodyguard
67132.FlavorText: The Benalish aristocracy is hereditary, but the loyalty of its subjects is earned.

67136.Name: Evra, Halcyon Witness
67136.FlavorText:
"Light from the Null Moon took form—a mirage made real, alone in grandeur, isolated in a world that once had been its own."
—Fall of the Thran

67142.Name: Gideon's Reproach
67142.FlavorText: On Amonkhet, Gideon lost both his sural and his faith in himself. But he can still throw a punch, and he still knows a bad guy when he sees one.

67144.Name: Healing Grace
67144.FlavorText:
"Whatever faith you have in Serra, she has more in you."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

67148.Name: Invoke the Divine
67148.FlavorText:
"Let go of all that harms you. Cast your burdens into the darkness, and build for the faithful a house of light."
—Song of All, canto 1008

67150.Name: Knight of Grace
67150.FlavorText: A light to pierce the shadows.

67152.Name: Knight of New Benalia
67152.FlavorText: The mage-smiths of New Benalia have perfected the art of blending fine steel and enchanted glass into weapons that are both beautiful and deadly. Only elite knights are entrusted with these martial works of art.

67154.Name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
67154.FlavorText: Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.

67156.Name: Lyra Dawnbringer
67156.FlavorText: "You are not alone. You never were."

67158.Name: Mesa Unicorn
67158.FlavorText: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

67160.Name: On Serra's Wings
67160.FlavorText:
"The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance."
—Song of All, canto 524

67162.Name: Pegasus Courser
67162.FlavorText: A pegasus chooses its rider, bearing the worthy into the clouds and tossing all others to the ground.

67164.Name: Sanctum Spirit
67164.FlavorText:
"When history becomes too mournful, even good souls may choose to forget."
—Shalai, voice of Plenty

67166.Name: Seal Away
67166.FlavorText: An ancient nemesis rendered harmless long ago.

67168.Name: Sergeant-at-Arms
67168.FlavorText: Knights get the glory. Soldiers get things done.

67170.Name: Serra Angel
67170.FlavorText: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

67172.Name: Serra Disciple
67172.FlavorText: Theologians now believe the Ancestor was another divine form of Serra.

67176.Name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
67176.FlavorText: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

67178.Name: Tragic Poet
67178.FlavorText: "In a healing world I write—I, who will never be healed. Let my last gift be one of memory: from a thousand lost thoughts, choose one, and remember my name."

67182.Name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
67182.FlavorText: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

67186.Name: Academy Journeymage
67186.FlavorText: "We don't choose who comes here. We choose how long they stay."

67190.Name: Arcane Flight
67190.FlavorText: The Tolarian Academies are known for their magical research, powerful sorcerers, and accidental destruction of ecosystems.

67194.Name: Befuddle
67194.FlavorText:
"The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still. I learned that from Radha."
—Jhoira

67200.Name: Cold-Water Snapper
67200.FlavorText: For generations, the inhabitants of Orvada have hungered for turtle soup. For generations, the turtles have frustrated their ambitions.

67204.Name: Deep Freeze
67204.FlavorText: For cryomancers, studying the Ice Age isn't just an academic exercise.

67206.Name: Diligent Excavator
67206.FlavorText: Archaeologists don't just dig in the dirt. They excavate time, scraping off the years grain by grain.

67208.Name: Divination
67208.FlavorText:
"Half your studies will be learning the laws of magic. The other half will be bending them."
—Naru Meha, master wizard

67210.Name: Homarid Explorer
67210.FlavorText:
"Homarids spread northward from Sarpadia as the climate cooled, raiding coastal settlements for supplies."
—Time of Ice

67212.Name: In Bolas's Clutches
67212.FlavorText:
"Your contract is in default. You belong to me now. Serve, or die."
—Nicol Bolas

67214.Name: Karn's Temporal Sundering
67214.FlavorText: Centuries ago, a quest to harness time became a spiral into chaos.

67216.Name: Merfolk Trickster
67216.FlavorText: Saved from destruction by one planeswalker's sacrifice, the Eliterate colony forswore the taking of life.

67224.Name: Opt
67224.FlavorText: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

67228.Name: Relic Runner
67228.FlavorText: Her knack for tampering with wards got her kicked out of the academy, but they also got her back in.

67230.Name: Rescue
67230.FlavorText: With just a few seconds to escape, Deryan saved Hurkyl's editions on restoring physical objects from ash.

67232.Name: Sage of Lat-Nam
67232.FlavorText: Though it was laid to waste by the brothers, many schools of magic trace their origins to the College of Lat-Nam, including the first Tolarian Academy.

67238.Name: Syncopate
67238.FlavorText: The fire spell stuttered and broke. Its pieces reached Teferi out of rhythm, meaningless.

67240.Name: Tempest Djinn
67240.FlavorText: The first to arrive on Dominaria from their distant home, the marids are the oldest tribe of djinn and the most respected by storm and sea.

67242.Name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
67242.FlavorText: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, ‘Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

67246.Name: Tolarian Scholar
67246.FlavorText: The Tolarian Academies embrace a tradition of study and research while discouraging the kinds of experiments that ruined the original island of Tolaria.

67248.Name: Unwind
67248.FlavorText:
"A problem is only a problem if you don't have the tools to correct it."
—Jhoira

67250.Name: Vodalian Arcanist
67250.FlavorText: The Vodalian Empire tends to be insular. The scholarly Volshe caste are the exception, using education as an antidote to xenophobia.

67252.Name: Weight of Memory
67252.FlavorText: In lives that have stretched for centuries, there are bound to be a few awkward silences.

67254.Name: Wizard's Retort
67254.FlavorText:
"The second mage learned to dissipate blasts of lightning. Threat and response: thus did the study of magic progress."
—Naban, dean of iteration

67256.Name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
67256.FlavorText: "I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."

67258.Name: Blessing of Belzenlok
67258.FlavorText:
"My heart is not mine, it is Belzenlok's. All hearts are his, and all blood."
—"Rite of Belzenlok"

67260.Name: Cabal Evangel
67260.FlavorText: "All hail the Demonlord Belzenlok, Evincar of the Stronghold, Scion of Darkness, Doom of Fools, Lord of the Wastes, Master of the Ebon Hand, Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal . . ."

67262.Name: Cabal Paladin
67262.FlavorText:
"The Demonlord has ruled every age. Every ruin, myth, and nightmare proves his power."
—"Rite of Belzenlok"

67264.Name: Caligo Skin-Witch
67264.FlavorText: "Take their faces. The lips of these unbelievers may yet honor the Demonlord."

67266.Name: Cast Down
67266.FlavorText:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—Chainer's Torment

67270.Name: Dark Bargain
67270.FlavorText: "I have pustules of the great Ratadrabik, very cheap. No? Surely you'll want a tincture of Nevinyrral's pulverized remains. Genuine!"

67272.Name: Deathbloom Thallid
67272.FlavorText:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

67274.Name: Demonic Vigor
67274.FlavorText: In the Cabal, death is just another mark of devotion.

67278.Name: Divest
67278.FlavorText: Flittersprites collect unusually valuable things: coins of fallen empires, baby teeth, and memories of treasured names.

67280.Name: Dread Shade
67280.FlavorText:
"The forest surrounding the Vess estate became the Caligo Morass, a vast bog stalked by horrors too terrible to name."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

67282.Name: Drudge Sentinel
67282.FlavorText: The Cabal assured the Seven Houses that hostages receive all the food and rest they require.

67286.Name: Eviscerate
67286.FlavorText:
"Fear the dark if you must, but don't mistake sunlight for safety."
—Josu Vess

67288.Name: Feral Abomination
67288.FlavorText:
"Urborg used to be lovely—scenic volcanoes, respectable lich lords. Since the Cabal came with their nightmares and thrulls, it's all gone to the worms."
—Mister Lostspoons, Skulltown gossip

67290.Name: Final Parting
67290.FlavorText:
"Sleep now, brother. That is the one gift I can give you."
—Liliana Vess

67292.Name: Fungal Infection
67292.FlavorText: To thallids, the whole world is just a pile of mulch to grow saprolings in.

67298.Name: Knight of Malice
67298.FlavorText: A shadow to swallow the light.

67302.Name: Lingering Phantom
67302.FlavorText:
"True power never dies, but lies awake, waiting for its name to be spoken."
—The Eldest Reborn

67306.Name: Rat Colony
67306.FlavorText: Wreckage from the Phyrexian Invasion provided the rats with a seemingly unlimited number of breeding grounds.

67310.Name: Settle the Score
67310.FlavorText:
"You bound me with a contract only your death could end—and you thought me the fool?"
—Liliana Vess

67312.Name: Soul Salvage
67312.FlavorText: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

67316.Name: Thallid Omnivore
67316.FlavorText: Thelon of Havenwood created thallids as a food source in times of darkness. Thallids did the same with saprolings.

67318.Name: Thallid Soothsayer
67318.FlavorText: Some of the thallids that escaped into the fens of Urborg began emulating the Cabal's bloodsoaked rituals in their own peculiar way.

67322.Name: Urgoros, the Empty One
67322.FlavorText: As the phantom flies overhead, the city of Vhelnish screams in silence.

67326.Name: Whisper, Blood Liturgist
67326.FlavorText: "Look how they beg for the knife! The Demonlord has trained them well."

67328.Name: Windgrace Acolyte
67328.FlavorText: Acolytes of the lost Lord Windgrace fight to keep Urborg relics out of Cabal hands.

67330.Name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
67330.FlavorText: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

67332.Name: Yawgmoth's Vile Offering
67332.FlavorText: Centuries ago, a mad god offered a simple trade.

67334.Name: Bloodstone Goblin
67334.FlavorText: The stone whispers tales of darkness and fire. She replies, "Tell me more."

67336.Name: Champion of the Flame
67336.FlavorText: Grand Warlord Radha's challengers are always defeated, but she rewards the most passionate with the Flame of Keld. After that, they burn for her.

67338.Name: Fervent Strike
67338.FlavorText:
"The flame paints a bright wheel on the sky, then shifts into a stabbing spark. The enemy falls; the smoke of victory rises."
—"Legends of the Firedancer"

67340.Name: Fiery Intervention
67340.FlavorText: Burning something is easy. Choosing a target can be more difficult.

67344.Name: Fire Elemental
67344.FlavorText:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

67346.Name: Firefist Adept
67346.FlavorText: The versatile "fiery gauntlet" is among the first spells young Ghitu mages learn.

67352.Name: Frenzied Rage
67352.FlavorText:
"The heat in our hearts sometimes rises to the surface."
—Valduk, keeper of the Flame

67356.Name: Ghitu Journeymage
67356.FlavorText: The Ghitu of Shiv are as fierce and uncompromising as their volcanic home.

67358.Name: Ghitu Lavarunner
67358.FlavorText: Tolarians teach the theory of pyromancy. The Ghitu prefer applied research.

67362.Name: Goblin Chainwhirler
67362.FlavorText: "The trick is, once you get moving, don't stop!"

67364.Name: Goblin Warchief
67364.FlavorText: Not since the days of Pashalik Mons have the Rundvelt goblins been so united or effective.

67370.Name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
67370.FlavorText: Centuries ago, a pyromancer's spark ignited a fiery conflagration.

67374.Name: Keldon Raider
67374.FlavorText: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

67376.Name: Keldon Warcaller
67376.FlavorText:
"The Mountain gave the Flame to Kradak to light the furnaces of his people's hearts. The wanderers became Keldons, and he the first warlord."
—"The Flame of Keld"

67378.Name: Orcish Vandal
67378.FlavorText: Every ancient relic is a weapon if you throw it hard enough.

67380.Name: Radiating Lightning
67380.FlavorText: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

67382.Name: Rampaging Cyclops
67382.FlavorText: Keldon warriors take advantage of the cyclops's inability to focus on more than one thing at a time.

67384.Name: Run Amok
67384.FlavorText: Keld faced an apocalypse to fulfill a dire prophecy. Now Keldons have nothing left to believe in except themselves.

67386.Name: Seismic Shift
67386.FlavorText:
"Shiv is a restless land. It heaves ash, bleeds lava, and scabs over in black obsidian."
—The First Eruption

67388.Name: Shivan Fire
67388.FlavorText: Sometimes Shivan dragons toy with their food. Other times they just cook it.

67392.Name: Skirk Prospector
67392.FlavorText: Deep beneath the ruined continent of Otaria, there's a mine where goblins still work, ignorant of the destruction above.

67394.Name: Skizzik
67394.FlavorText: It skitters across Shiv, each tendril hitting the ground with a sharp snap.

67396.Name: Squee, the Immortal
67396.FlavorText: "You gotta be pretty smart to live long as me, but not being able to die helps."

67398.Name: Two-Headed Giant
67398.FlavorText: He watches the pass in both directions, and all must pay his toll.

67400.Name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
67400.FlavorText: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

67404.Name: Warcry Phoenix
67404.FlavorText: War begins with one red ember.

67406.Name: Warlord's Fury
67406.FlavorText:
"The old ways were for a winter world. We do what's best for us, not for the past. We are Keldons!"
—Grand Warlord Radha

67408.Name: Wizard's Lightning
67408.FlavorText:
"The study of magic began when the first mage taught herself to throw lightning."
—Naban, dean of iteration

67410.Name: Adventurous Impulse
67410.FlavorText: Every odyssey begins with a single step.

67412.Name: Ancient Animus
67412.FlavorText: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

67414.Name: Arbor Armament
67414.FlavorText:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

67416.Name: Baloth Gorger
67416.FlavorText: A baloth only cares about the many things it eats and the few things that eat it.

67418.Name: Broken Bond
67418.FlavorText: "I can't bear to see another plane broken before I make my own home whole. I'm sorry, but my watch is over."

67420.Name: Corrosive Ooze
67420.FlavorText: Nothing tastes finer to an ooze than a priceless family heirloom.

67422.Name: Elfhame Druid
67422.FlavorText: The bond between Llanowar elves and their kavu empowers both.

67424.Name: Fungal Plots
67424.FlavorText: Thallids nurture saprolings, entertain them, and eat them.

67428.Name: Gaea's Protector
67428.FlavorText: Fallen Phyrexians were transmuted into elementals by Gaea long ago, but Yavimaya's other inhabitants still regard them with unease.

67436.Name: Kamahl's Druidic Vow
67436.FlavorText: Centuries ago, a barbarian laid his rage to rest.

67438.Name: Krosan Druid
67438.FlavorText: "Druids endure disaster as seeds endure winter. Now Krosa blooms once more."

67440.Name: Llanowar Elves
67440.FlavorText: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

67442.Name: Llanowar Envoy
67442.FlavorText:
"Cherish this world in honor of the martyrs who saved it. We too must be prepared to give our lives."
—The Mending of Dominaria

67444.Name: Llanowar Scout
67444.FlavorText: Llanowar elfhames occupy different heights within the great forest. Elves of the Loridalh and Kelfae hames can see neither earth nor sky.

67446.Name: Mammoth Spider
67446.FlavorText: Most spiders of Llanowar disdain elvish alliances. No elf has as many beautiful eyes or as many strong arms.

67448.Name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
67448.FlavorText: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

67454.Name: Nature's Spiral
67454.FlavorText:
"As Argoth's last defenders fell to Urza's juggernauts, Titania said, ‘Nature cannot be destroyed, only changed.'"
—The Antiquities War

67456.Name: Pierce the Sky
67456.FlavorText: Llanowar elves conceal their ballistae in the upper canopy of the forest, ready to clear the skies of any intruder.

67458.Name: Primordial Wurm
67458.FlavorText:
"You can hear its tail thrashing from a mile away. Keep in mind that its jaws may already be half a mile closer."
—Jenson Carthalion, Yavimaya exile

67460.Name: Saproling Migration
67460.FlavorText: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

67464.Name: Spore Swarm
67464.FlavorText: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

67466.Name: Sporecrown Thallid
67466.FlavorText:
"The identifying ornamental growths of alpha thallids may be hereditary, or catalyzed by some chemical signal."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. III

67468.Name: Steel Leaf Champion
67468.FlavorText: One eye open to see the truth of the world. One eye covered to gaze at the goddess within.

67470.Name: Sylvan Awakening
67470.FlavorText:
"Yavimaya is aware, but not always awake. You will know the difference when you see it."
—Karn

67472.Name: Territorial Allosaurus
67472.FlavorText: A living remnant of the Ice Age.

67474.Name: Thorn Elemental
67474.FlavorText: The first law of Yavimaya is that guests may kill only to survive. As fires aren't needed in the warm weather, cutting trees for wood means death.

67478.Name: Verdant Force
67478.FlavorText: The bower shuddered. The stillness broke. The scurf shifted, and a being emerged from the flowers and ferns.

67482.Name: Yavimaya Sapherd
67482.FlavorText:
"When their community grows cluttered, thallids begin a traditional bobbing dance, then trek out in all directions."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. III

67484.Name: Adeliz, the Cinder Wind
67484.FlavorText: The passionate intensity of the Ghitu tempered by the cool insight of Tolarian training.

67486.Name: Arvad the Cursed
67486.FlavorText: "I won't abandon the Weatherlight. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This ‘illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."

67494.Name: Grand Warlord Radha
67494.FlavorText: "The future is my gift to Keld."

67498.Name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
67498.FlavorText: As she took the wheel of the Weatherlight for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

67500.Name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
67500.FlavorText:
"Chronicles across the ages describe Jodah. They likely refer not to one mage, but to a family or an arcane title."
—Arkol, Argivian scholar

67502.Name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
67502.FlavorText:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

67504.Name: Oath of Teferi
67504.FlavorText: "For the lost and forgotten, I will keep watch."

67506.Name: Primevals' Glorious Rebirth
67506.FlavorText: Centuries ago, five dragons conquered death to rule the living.

67512.Name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
67512.FlavorText: "I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."

67514.Name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
67514.FlavorText: As Jhoira restored the Weatherlight, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

67516.Name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
67516.FlavorText: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

67522.Name: Aesthir Glider
67522.FlavorText: An ancient device recovered from a thawing glacier high in the Karplusan mountains.

67524.Name: Amaranthine Wall
67524.FlavorText: Neither its appearance nor its temperature varies as the years pass, an eternal testament to the forces that shaped Dominaria.

67526.Name: Blackblade Reforged
67526.FlavorText: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

67528.Name: Bloodtallow Candle
67528.FlavorText:
"Bring me an angel feather, and I will give you one death in return. There can be no turning back once the candle is lit."
—Whisper, blood liturgist

67530.Name: Damping Sphere
67530.FlavorText: A Thran relic, it has spent ten thousand years doing absolutely nothing.

67534.Name: Gilded Lotus
67534.FlavorText:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

67536.Name: Guardians of Koilos
67536.FlavorText: Archaeologists depend on automatons inspired by their previous discoveries at Koilos to guard the excavations.

67538.Name: Helm of the Host
67538.FlavorText: Forged out of flowstone for the queen of Vesuva.

67540.Name: Howling Golem
67540.FlavorText: It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.

67542.Name: Icy Manipulator
67542.FlavorText: Ice may thaw, but malice never does.

67544.Name: Jhoira's Familiar
67544.FlavorText:
"You could say it was my pet project."
—Jhoira

67548.Name: Juggernaut
67548.FlavorText:
"Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves."
—Rona, disciple of Gix

67550.Name: Mishra's Self-Replicator
67550.FlavorText: It has witnessed history's most significant events, one incarnation after another.

67552.Name: Mox Amber
67552.FlavorText: A moment in time made tangible, it has the power to realize epic visions.

67554.Name: Navigator's Compass
67554.FlavorText: The Weatherlight can no longer planeshift, but it can traverse Dominaria with ease.

67556.Name: Pardic Wanderer
67556.FlavorText:
"To the head of Archaeological Findings: The excavation schedule at dig site 93-beta must be revised. Part of the site has walked off."
—Tolarian field dispatch

67558.Name: Powerstone Shard
67558.FlavorText:
"Light passing through a powerstone is refracted by eternity and colored by planar energy. I wonder how the world appeared through Urza's eyes?"
—Teferi

67560.Name: Shield of the Realm
67560.FlavorText: Benalish glazeplate is stained with salts from the Rift Era and enchanted to deflect blows.

67562.Name: Short Sword
67562.FlavorText:
"Sometimes the only difference between a martyr and a hero is a sword."
—Captain Sisay, Memoirs

67564.Name: Skittering Surveyor
67564.FlavorText: Like a cross between a spider and a spyglass, but friendlier.

67568.Name: Sparring Construct
67568.FlavorText: The trainers were a gift of gratitude from the wizards of Tolaria West to the knights of New Benalia for their aid during the Talas Incursion.

67570.Name: Thran Temporal Gateway
67570.FlavorText: The portal opens not to the past, but from it. Those who step through discover an unimaginable future.

67574.Name: Urza's Tome
67574.FlavorText:
"Truly understanding even one volume can be a life's work."
—Naru Meha, master wizard

67576.Name: Voltaic Servant
67576.FlavorText: A missing piece in search of a puzzle.

67580.Name: Cabal Stronghold
67580.FlavorText: The seat of Belzenlok's power, the Stronghold serves as the gathering place for the Cabal as their dark influence spreads from Urborg.

67582.Name: Clifftop Retreat
67582.FlavorText: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

67584.Name: Hinterland Harbor
67584.FlavorText:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

67586.Name: Isolated Chapel
67586.FlavorText: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as the Cabal encroaches.

67598.Name: Sulfur Falls
67598.FlavorText:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

67600.Name: Woodland Cemetery
67600.FlavorText:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

67602.Name: Zhalfirin Void
67602.FlavorText:
"The wind whispers, ‘come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

67646.Name: Temporal Machinations
67646.FlavorText: The Cabal soldier blinked and found day had become night, he had a face full of thistle seeds, and the old man was nowhere to be seen.

67648.Name: Niambi, Faithful Healer
67648.FlavorText: "My father will be happy to see you."

67650.Name: Teferi's Sentinel
67650.FlavorText:
"Long ago, I enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir. My homeland is gone, but its protectors remain."
—Teferi

67652.Name: Meandering River
67652.FlavorText:
"Everywhere you look, this world is healing from its wounds. Aren't you ready to do the same?"
—Jhoira, to Teferi

67658.Name: Karplusan Hound
67658.FlavorText:
"Don't worry, they don't bite. They much prefer setting people on fire."
—Jaya Ballard, to Chandra

67660.Name: Pyromantic Pilgrim
67660.FlavorText: "From the volcanoes of Shiv to the Balduvian steppes, I have sought a worthy teacher. At last, I have found one."

67662.Name: Timber Gorge
67662.FlavorText: Glaciers, torrential floods, and temporal disturbances came and went. The mountains yet stood, unchanged.

67670.Name: Demon
67670.RawFrameDetail: B token, has large text box

67673.Name: Karox Bladewing
67673.RawFrameDetail: R token legendary, has text box

67682.Name: Aegis of the Heavens
67682.FlavorText: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.

67684.Name: Aethershield Artificer
67684.FlavorText: Most smiths shape metal, but some prefer more delicate materials.

67690.Name: Ajani's Pridemate
67690.FlavorText:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

67692.Name: Ajani's Welcome
67692.FlavorText: "You cannot defend others if your own well-being is neglected."

67694.Name: Angel of the Dawn
67694.FlavorText: She sings for all those who have been silenced.

67698.Name: Cleansing Nova
67698.FlavorText: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

67700.Name: Daybreak Chaplain
67700.FlavorText: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."

67702.Name: Dwarven Priest
67702.FlavorText: "These storied halls are under my protection."

67704.Name: Gallant Cavalry
67704.FlavorText: "Our duty does not stop at our borders."

67706.Name: Herald of Faith
67706.FlavorText: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.

67710.Name: Inspired Charge
67710.FlavorText:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants, . . . and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora

67712.Name: Invoke the Divine
67712.FlavorText:
"Let go of all that harms you. Cast your burdens into the darkness, and build for the faithful a house of light."
—Song of All, canto 1008

67714.Name: Isolate
67714.FlavorText: Threefold were his crimes, doubled were his pleas, singular was his fate.

67718.Name: Knight's Pledge
67718.FlavorText: "As long as my faith persists, so shall I."

67722.Name: Lena, Selfless Champion
67722.FlavorText: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."

67724.Name: Leonin Vanguard
67724.FlavorText: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

67726.Name: Leonin Warleader
67726.FlavorText: When one leonin hunts, many more are surely nearby.

67728.Name: Loxodon Line Breaker
67728.FlavorText: Loxodons are firm in stature and spirit. No matter the odds, they are always first into battle.

67730.Name: Luminous Bonds
67730.FlavorText: "Your part in this fight is done, vampire. Get used to your thirst."

67732.Name: Make a Stand
67732.FlavorText: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

67734.Name: Mentor of the Meek
67734.FlavorText: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

67736.Name: Mighty Leap
67736.FlavorText: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

67740.Name: Novice Knight
67740.FlavorText: Even the greatest hero begins with nothing.

67742.Name: Oreskos Swiftclaw
67742.FlavorText: The leonin of Oreskos are quick to take offense—not because they are thin-skinned, but because they are always ready for a fight.

67744.Name: Pegasus Courser
67744.FlavorText: A pegasus chooses its rider, bearing the worthy into the clouds and tossing all others to the ground.

67746.Name: Remorseful Cleric
67746.FlavorText: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

67750.Name: Revitalize
67750.FlavorText:
"A potion is no substitute for a skilled surgeon, but it will hold your bits in."
—Torricks, battlefield medic

67752.Name: Rustwing Falcon
67752.FlavorText: Native to wide prairies and scrublands, falcons occasionally roost in dragon skeletons.

67754.Name: Shield Mare
67754.FlavorText: When it passes, order defeats chaos.

67756.Name: Star-Crowned Stag
67756.FlavorText: White as starlight on snow, it appears only on the eve of the winter solstice.

67760.Name: Take Vengeance
67760.FlavorText: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."

67762.Name: Trusty Packbeast
67762.FlavorText:
"Margaret has traveled with me to the end of the world and back."
—Hewen Frit, merchant

67764.Name: Valiant Knight
67764.FlavorText: "Defeat is no reason for retreat. It is a sign we must redouble our efforts to win this fight."

67766.Name: Aether Tunnel
67766.FlavorText: If you can't find a doorway, make one.

67768.Name: Anticipate
67768.FlavorText: Divining the future is easy when you hold the power to sway it.

67770.Name: Aven Wind Mage
67770.FlavorText: "My skill sharpens with each beat of my wings."

67772.Name: Aviation Pioneer
67772.FlavorText: "They say perfection is unattainable, but they said that about flight too."

67774.Name: Bone to Ash
67774.FlavorText:
"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

67776.Name: Cancel
67776.FlavorText: "I decide what stands in my way."

67780.Name: Disperse
67780.FlavorText: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

67782.Name: Divination
67782.FlavorText: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."

67786.Name: Dwindle
67786.FlavorText: The collection didn't have room to expand, so the wizard improvised a solution.

67788.Name: Essence Scatter
67788.FlavorText: Dependence on luck is anathema to Kefnet's rigorous studies. Those who hope to escape his maze by chance never succeed.

67790.Name: Exclusion Mage
67790.FlavorText: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

67792.Name: Frilled Sea Serpent
67792.FlavorText:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler

67794.Name: Gearsmith Prodigy
67794.FlavorText: Young artificers on Kaladesh let their imaginations run wild.

67802.Name: Mirror Image
67802.FlavorText: The life of a shapeshifter is one of constant change.

67804.Name: Mistcaller
67804.FlavorText: Hospitality is of little concern to those who do not wish to be disturbed.

67806.Name: Mystic Archaeologist
67806.FlavorText: The delight of discovery drives the pursuit of knowledge.

67808.Name: Omenspeaker
67808.FlavorText: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

67810.Name: Omniscience
67810.FlavorText:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

67812.Name: One with the Machine
67812.FlavorText:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

67814.Name: Patient Rebuilding
67814.FlavorText: Nicol Bolas would not rest until he was restored to his former glory.

67816.Name: Psychic Corrosion
67816.FlavorText:
"To break another's mind is to deliver a fate worse than death. It is a terrifying power."
—Jace Beleren

67818.Name: Sai, Master Thopterist
67818.FlavorText: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

67820.Name: Salvager of Secrets
67820.FlavorText: The greatest treasure of the deep is an echo from above.

67822.Name: Scholar of Stars
67822.FlavorText: "The path of the stars is as reliable as the instruments that measure them."

67824.Name: Sift
67824.FlavorText: Dwell longest on the thoughts that shine brightest.

67828.Name: Sleep
67828.FlavorText:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

67830.Name: Snapping Drake
67830.FlavorText: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

67832.Name: Supreme Phantom
67832.FlavorText: A king's knowledge does not vanish when the heart stops beating.

67834.Name: Surge Mare
67834.FlavorText: When it passes, waves touch the sky.

67836.Name: Switcheroo
67836.FlavorText: Say hello to your new friend.

67840.Name: Tolarian Scholar
67840.FlavorText: The Tolarian Academies embrace a tradition of study and research while discouraging the kinds of experiments that ruined the original island of Tolaria.

67844.Name: Uncomfortable Chill
67844.FlavorText: The cold slowed their movements until only their panicked eyeballs swiveled beneath the ice.

67846.Name: Wall of Mist
67846.FlavorText: The seafloor is flecked with the bones of fools who dared to sail into the mist.

67848.Name: Windreader Sphinx
67848.FlavorText: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

67852.Name: Blood Divination
67852.FlavorText: Predicting the future is a messy business.

67854.Name: Bogstomper
67854.FlavorText:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

67856.Name: Bone Dragon
67856.FlavorText: Its roar is the clatter of a thousand bones.

67858.Name: Child of Night
67858.FlavorText: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

67860.Name: Death Baron
67860.FlavorText: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

67862.Name: Demon of Catastrophes
67862.FlavorText: A pit yawned open, a column of oily smoke arose, and a towering form hissed, "I accept this offering."

67864.Name: Diregraf Ghoul
67864.FlavorText:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

67866.Name: Doomed Dissenter
67866.FlavorText: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

67868.Name: Duress
67868.FlavorText:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

67870.Name: Epicure of Blood
67870.FlavorText: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

67874.Name: Fraying Omnipotence
67874.FlavorText: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.

67876.Name: Gravedigger
67876.FlavorText: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

67878.Name: Graveyard Marshal
67878.FlavorText:
"Rise and shine, my dears. We have work to do."
—Isareth the Awakener

67880.Name: Hired Blade
67880.FlavorText: "If you want them dead, buy some poison. If you want them to have the worst day of their life before dying, then let's talk price."

67882.Name: Infectious Horror
67882.FlavorText: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

67884.Name: Infernal Reckoning
67884.FlavorText: "When these intruders are gone, Zendikar will be my throne, my palace, my playground."

67886.Name: Infernal Scarring
67886.FlavorText: One who is marked by a demon in life is sure to be remembered as one in death.

67890.Name: Lich's Caress
67890.FlavorText: A lich must consume mortal souls to feed its eternal life.

67896.Name: Macabre Waltz
67896.FlavorText: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

67898.Name: Mind Rot
67898.FlavorText: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

67900.Name: Murder
67900.FlavorText: "It's not work if you enjoy it."

67902.Name: Nightmare's Thirst
67902.FlavorText: That feeling of something on your chest is usually sleep paralysis. Occasionally, it's something else.

67904.Name: Open the Graves
67904.FlavorText: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

67908.Name: Plague Mare
67908.FlavorText: When it passes, those who sleep dream of sickness and death.

67910.Name: Ravenous Harpy
67910.FlavorText: A harpy's hoard is a filthy, bloodstained pile of trinkets and corpses.

67912.Name: Reassembling Skeleton
67912.FlavorText:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

67914.Name: Rise from the Grave
67914.FlavorText:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

67916.Name: Skeleton Archer
67916.FlavorText:
"When it comes to killing with precision, a soul is but a hindrance."
—Isareth the Awakener

67918.Name: Skymarch Bloodletter
67918.FlavorText: From the perpetual shadowsmoke that hung above the ship, a silent form emerged, lips curled with malice and anticipation.

67920.Name: Sovereign's Bite
67920.FlavorText:
"You have given all to your kingdom, dear knight. Serenity shall be your prize."
—Queen Lian

67924.Name: Strangling Spores
67924.FlavorText: Imagine a thousand tiny mushrooms cropping up within your lungs.

67926.Name: Two-Headed Zombie
67926.FlavorText:
"Thread the torsos together with angel hair to ensure they will cooperate in battle."
—The Stitcher's Tome

67928.Name: Vampire Neonate
67928.FlavorText: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.

67932.Name: Walking Corpse
67932.FlavorText:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

67934.Name: Act of Treason
67934.FlavorText: She learned a tragic lesson that day: even the purest can be corrupted when the heart's emotions are twisted.

67938.Name: Apex of Power
67938.FlavorText:
"As I desire, so it shall be."
—Nicol Bolas

67940.Name: Banefire
67940.FlavorText: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

67942.Name: Boggart Brute
67942.FlavorText: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

67944.Name: Catalyst Elemental
67944.FlavorText: As the hyperstormic generator crept past redline, a being emerged from the arc.

67948.Name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
67948.FlavorText: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

67950.Name: Demanding Dragon
67950.FlavorText: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

67954.Name: Doublecast
67954.FlavorText: First the insult, then the encore.

67956.Name: Dragon Egg
67956.FlavorText: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

67958.Name: Electrify
67958.FlavorText: "Some hid from the storm. I embraced it and learned its name."

67962.Name: Fire Elemental
67962.FlavorText: It treads on feet of coals and strikes with the force of a volcano.

67968.Name: Goblin Trashmaster
67968.FlavorText: "Folks 'round here are too in love with their contraptions. Does them some good if we smash one every so often."

67970.Name: Guttersnipe
67970.FlavorText: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

67972.Name: Havoc Devils
67972.FlavorText: For devils, burning things is the highest form of comedy, diversion, and artistic expression.

67974.Name: Hostile Minotaur
67974.FlavorText: The bellow of a minotaur always translates to "charge."

67982.Name: Lightning Mare
67982.FlavorText: When it passes, storm clouds bolt across the land.

67984.Name: Lightning Strike
67984.FlavorText: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

67986.Name: Onakke Ogre
67986.FlavorText: The ogres you know are nothing like the Onakke. Possessing both intellect and industry, they had brute strength without being brutish.

67992.Name: Shock
67992.FlavorText: The tools of invention became the weapons of revolution.

67994.Name: Siegebreaker Giant
67994.FlavorText: No rampart can withstand the fury of a giant.

67996.Name: Smelt
67996.FlavorText: The creation of new weapons demands the destruction of others.

67998.Name: Sparktongue Dragon
67998.FlavorText: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

68002.Name: Sure Strike
68002.FlavorText: To survive imminent doom, it sometimes takes a foolhardy soul who acts first and fears later.

68004.Name: Tectonic Rift
68004.FlavorText:
"You will kneel before me, even if I have to split the earth under your feet!"
—Ash Kronor, Keldon warlord

68008.Name: Tormenting Voice
68008.FlavorText:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol

68010.Name: Trumpet Blast
68010.FlavorText: The sound of the trumpets lights a fire in the hearts of the bold and snuffs the courage of the cowardly.

68012.Name: Viashino Pyromancer
68012.FlavorText: "I trained with the Ghitu, and I respect the fire as they do."

68014.Name: Volcanic Dragon
68014.FlavorText: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

68020.Name: Bristling Boar
68020.FlavorText:
"Nicol Bolas destroyed my world. I owe it to Skalla to celebrate all life, no matter how dangerous."
—Vivien Reid

68022.Name: Centaur Courser
68022.FlavorText:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

68024.Name: Colossal Dreadmaw
68024.FlavorText: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

68026.Name: Colossal Majesty
68026.FlavorText:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

68028.Name: Daggerback Basilisk
68028.FlavorText: Its ventricles weep venom, and it consumes only poison.

68030.Name: Declare Dominance
68030.FlavorText:
"If you think yourself a chief, then prove your might."
—Gar-Tun, Mistvalley silverback

68032.Name: Druid of Horns
68032.FlavorText: No welcome for those who trespass. Only fang and horn and claw.

68034.Name: Druid of the Cowl
68034.FlavorText: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

68036.Name: Dryad Greenseeker
68036.FlavorText: "The land already knows its destiny. I simply ask it to share the tale with me."

68038.Name: Elvish Clancaller
68038.FlavorText: No single root feeds the forest.

68042.Name: Ghastbark Twins
68042.FlavorText: They grow closer with every passing season.

68044.Name: Ghirapur Guide
68044.FlavorText: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

68046.Name: Giant Spider
68046.FlavorText:
"After everything I've survived, it's hard to be frightened by anything anymore."
—Vivien Reid

68050.Name: Gigantosaurus
68050.FlavorText:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid

68052.Name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
68052.FlavorText: You don't want to know how she got that name.

68054.Name: Greenwood Sentinel
68054.FlavorText: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

68056.Name: Highland Game
68056.FlavorText:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon Arel's head. She hears the wisdom of our ancestors."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

68060.Name: Naturalize
68060.FlavorText:
"And if you threaten me again, your shiny steel trousers will be sprouting daggerthorn vines."
—Iveta, rooftop runner

68062.Name: Oakenform
68062.FlavorText:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

68064.Name: Pelakka Wurm
68064.FlavorText: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

68066.Name: Plummet
68066.FlavorText:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

68068.Name: Prodigious Growth
68068.FlavorText:
"Look how cute it is now!"
—Vivien Reid

68070.Name: Rabid Bite
68070.FlavorText:
"You should have seen the look on both their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

68072.Name: Reclamation Sage
68072.FlavorText: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

68074.Name: Recollect
68074.FlavorText: "The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."

68076.Name: Rhox Oracle
68076.FlavorText: "The further into the future I look, the less certain my vision. Even now, the middle distance is obscured by fire."

68078.Name: Root Snare
68078.FlavorText: The only casualties were a snapped spear, a lost helmet, and some bruised egos.

68080.Name: Runic Armasaur
68080.FlavorText: The Sun Empire's most sacred sites are protected by more than prayers.

68082.Name: Scapeshift
68082.FlavorText:
"Whether we like it or not, our arrival has altered the landscape."
—Malcolm, navigator of the Belligerent

68088.Name: Thornhide Wolves
68088.FlavorText:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

68090.Name: Titanic Growth
68090.FlavorText: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

68092.Name: Vigilant Baloth
68092.FlavorText: Villagers employ watchdogs as guardians and companions. Druids prefer something a little bigger.

68094.Name: Vine Mare
68094.FlavorText: When it passes, the dead are displaced by flourishing life.

68100.Name: Wall of Vines
68100.FlavorText: Like all jungle plants, the vines must fight and claw for sunlight. Once their place is secured, they grow strong, sharp, and impenetrable.

68102.Name: Aerial Engineer
68102.FlavorText: The best of their trade know every bolt of their rigs, stem to stern.

68110.Name: Draconic Disciple
68110.FlavorText: "If I am to die, I will die in the embrace of immeasurable flame."

68112.Name: Enigma Drake
68112.FlavorText: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets beyond imagining. Many have become meals trying to learn them.

68114.Name: Heroic Reinforcements
68114.FlavorText: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.

68120.Name: Palladia-Mors, the Ruiner
68120.FlavorText: Sister of Nicol Bolas. Survivor of the Elder Dragon War. The most vicious of her kin.

68124.Name: Psychic Symbiont
68124.FlavorText: "I turn around and see nothing, yet I know it is behind me. Its fingers rummage in my mind, crafting new ideas."

68126.Name: Regal Bloodlord
68126.FlavorText: Those of esteemed birth earn a most esteemed death.

68128.Name: Satyr Enchanter
68128.FlavorText: "The threads of magic that protect this place were woven by my will."

68134.Name: Amulet of Safekeeping
68134.FlavorText: Whether it is magical, lucky, or merely old, it is cherished, and that gives it power.

68136.Name: Arcane Encyclopedia
68136.FlavorText: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.

68140.Name: Crucible of Worlds
68140.FlavorText: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

68142.Name: Desecrated Tomb
68142.FlavorText: The grave robbers were startled, for the door to the mausoleum was already open.

68148.Name: Explosive Apparatus
68148.FlavorText:
"Souls are volatile things. When compressed and loaded into a handheld device, their destructive potential is quite impressive."
—Dierk, geistmage

68150.Name: Field Creeper
68150.FlavorText: As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

68152.Name: Fountain of Renewal
68152.FlavorText: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.

68154.Name: Gargoyle Sentinel
68154.FlavorText:
"Do not mistake a quiet rampart for one that is unguarded. Some things stir only when they need to."
—Bonovar, siege commander

68156.Name: Gearsmith Guardian
68156.FlavorText: Made in its creator's image, though slightly more clangy.

68160.Name: Manalith
68160.FlavorText: Planeswalkers seek out great monuments throughout the Multiverse, knowing that their builders were unwittingly drawn by the convergence of mana in the area.

68162.Name: Marauder's Axe
68162.FlavorText: A sharp axe solves most problems.

68164.Name: Meteor Golem
68164.FlavorText: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

68166.Name: Millstone
68166.FlavorText: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

68168.Name: Rogue's Gloves
68168.FlavorText: Thievery requires subtlety, from the beginning of the heist to the end.

68172.Name: Skyscanner
68172.FlavorText: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.

68174.Name: Suspicious Bookcase
68174.FlavorText: All the books were dusty with disuse, save the one titled Camouflage and Its Practical Applications.

68178.Name: Cinder Barrens
68178.FlavorText:
"I do as I choose with what is mine. And it is all mine."
—Nicol Bolas

68180.Name: Detection Tower
68180.FlavorText: Its light exposes enemies and lays secrets bare.

68182.Name: Forsaken Sanctuary
68182.FlavorText:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

68184.Name: Foul Orchard
68184.FlavorText: The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.

68186.Name: Highland Lake
68186.FlavorText:
"A place like this makes me wonder if there's more to life than blood and treasure . . . Nah."
—Boyl Bucksalt, Storm Fleet swab

68188.Name: Meandering River
68188.FlavorText: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

68190.Name: Reliquary Tower
68190.FlavorText: The most holy treasures are kept far from unclean soil.

68194.Name: Stone Quarry
68194.FlavorText: The bedrock has many gifts to give.

68196.Name: Submerged Boneyard
68196.FlavorText:
"Long after the land has given up the last of its secrets, there will still be mysteries in the depths of the sea."
—Kiora

68198.Name: Timber Gorge
68198.FlavorText: Tazeem's embrace is harsh, but for those that call it home, nothing else will do.

68200.Name: Tranquil Expanse
68200.FlavorText: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.

68202.Name: Woodland Stream
68202.FlavorText: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

68248.Name: Court Cleric
68248.FlavorText:
"The healers of Bant are second to none. I owe them a great deal for their tutelage."
—Ajani Goldmane

68250.Name: Serra's Guardian
68250.FlavorText: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.

68252.Name: Silverbeak Griffin
68252.FlavorText: A pair of domesticated griffins escaped from captivity a century ago. Now the skies are filled with the songs of their descendants.

68256.Name: Riddlemaster Sphinx
68256.FlavorText: "Safe passage requires only a simple answer to a simple question, traveler."

68258.Name: Pendulum of Patterns
68258.FlavorText: Its elaborate designs reveal secrets of aether's flow.

68266.Name: Arisen Gorgon
68266.FlavorText:
"I'm not picky about what comes up, but the less decay, the better."
—Liliana Vess

68268.Name: Gravewaker
68268.FlavorText: Once every seven years it flies on spectral wings over the moors of ancient battlefields.

68272.Name: Tattered Mummy
68272.FlavorText: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city of Naktamun crave only to spread their curse.

68276.Name: Kargan Dragonrider
68276.FlavorText: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

68278.Name: Sarkhan's Dragonfire
68278.FlavorText: "I am most myself when I am least human."

68282.Name: Shivan Dragon
68282.FlavorText: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

68286.Name: Aggressive Mammoth
68286.FlavorText:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

68288.Name: Skalla Wolf
68288.FlavorText:
"This imprint was the familiar of a friend."
—Vivien Reid

68290.Name: Ursine Champion
68290.FlavorText: "Would you rather feel the edge of my blade or the sharpness of my fangs?"

68292.Name: Vivien's Jaguar
68292.FlavorText: Each of Vivien's arrows is an invocation of a species.

68294.Name: Nexus of Fate
68294.FlavorText: Sarkhan wandered into a tomb and back in time.

68296.Name: Sun Sentinel
68296.FlavorText: Just as the sun rises at dawn and the days lengthen in summer, the Sun Empire has awakened after long years of quiet.

68298.Name: Air Elemental
68298.FlavorText: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

68300.Name: Befuddle
68300.FlavorText: The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still.

68302.Name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
68302.FlavorText: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against enemy forces.

68306.Name: Grasping Scoundrel
68306.FlavorText: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."

68308.Name: Radiating Lightning
68308.FlavorText: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

68310.Name: Llanowar Elves
68310.FlavorText: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

68369.Name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
68369.FlavorText: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.

68409.Name: Angelic Guardian
68409.FlavorText: "No single arrow can pierce an entire flock."

68410.Name: Angler Turtle
68410.FlavorText: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.

68411.Name: Vengeant Vampire
68411.FlavorText: "Those who stood in my path now lay behind me."

68412.Name: Immortal Phoenix
68412.FlavorText: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

68413.Name: Rampaging Brontodon
68413.FlavorText: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

68462.Name: Blade Instructor
68462.FlavorText: "Watch carefully. The gap between death and victory is thinner than your blade."

68463.Name: Bounty Agent
68463.FlavorText: "Lately I've seen the biggest bounties of my career—and for the biggest names."

68464.Name: Candlelight Vigil
68464.FlavorText: Selesnya guildmages do not sleep so the rest of the Conclave can.

68465.Name: Citywide Bust
68465.FlavorText:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

68466.Name: Collar the Culprit
68466.FlavorText:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

68468.Name: Crush Contraband
68468.FlavorText: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.

68469.Name: Dawn of Hope
68469.FlavorText:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

68470.Name: Demotion
68470.FlavorText: There's no greater honor than joining your chosen guild, and no greater shame than failing it.

68471.Name: Divine Visitation
68471.FlavorText: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

68472.Name: Flight of Equenauts
68472.FlavorText: "Yes, there's competition between our equenauts and the Boros skyjeks. At least they think it's a competition."

68473.Name: Gird for Battle
68473.FlavorText:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia

68474.Name: Haazda Marshal
68474.FlavorText: Ravnica's convoluted power structure often boils down to who can muster the most swords on a given block.

68475.Name: Healer's Hawk
68475.FlavorText: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

68476.Name: Hunted Witness
68476.FlavorText: He ferried weapons, spells, exotic animals—but his most dangerous cargo was the truth.

68477.Name: Inspiring Unicorn
68477.FlavorText: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.

68478.Name: Intrusive Packbeast
68478.FlavorText: Good at carrying things. Really good at knocking them down.

68479.Name: Ledev Guardian
68479.FlavorText: "I've raised her since she was a pup, and she's raised me since I was a recruit."

68482.Name: Luminous Bonds
68482.FlavorText:
"Article 5.8.2. Ensure proper restraint of any and all arms, legs, claws, jaws, tails, tentacles, and tendrils as appropriate."
—Azorius Arrester Procedure, Appendix B

68483.Name: Parhelion Patrol
68483.FlavorText: "Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."

68484.Name: Righteous Blow
68484.FlavorText:
"The Golgari believe they should be given what they deserve. On this we agree."
—Tajic

68485.Name: Roc Charger
68485.FlavorText: Rocs' innate fearlessness makes them ideal mounts for emergency response.

68486.Name: Skyline Scout
68486.FlavorText: "Sometimes an angel passes by and gives me a little nod, like, ‘You're a daring one!' That always makes my day."

68487.Name: Sunhome Stalwart
68487.FlavorText: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"

68488.Name: Sworn Companions
68488.FlavorText:
"The trouble with youths these days is that, in outright defiance of their elders, they refuse to be bought."
—Karlov of the Ghost Council

68489.Name: Take Heart
68489.FlavorText: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.

68490.Name: Tenth District Guard
68490.FlavorText: "The Tenth has always been my home. This city is constantly embroiled in one crisis or another, but I'm determined to protect my piece."

68493.Name: Chemister's Insight
68493.FlavorText: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."

68494.Name: Citywatch Sphinx
68494.FlavorText: All those who trade in questions must answer to the Dimir.

68496.Name: Devious Cover-Up
68496.FlavorText: First, dispose of the evidence. Then dispose of your knowledge of its disposal.

68497.Name: Dimir Informant
68497.FlavorText: The letters arrive, all sealed and read.

68498.Name: Disdainful Stroke
68498.FlavorText: "Laws apply only to those who lack the vision to see past them."

68500.Name: Drowned Secrets
68500.FlavorText: Beneath Ravnica's streets runs a layer of tunnels, then caverns and waterways, then terrors and nightmares.

68501.Name: Enhanced Surveillance
68501.FlavorText:
"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav

68502.Name: Guild Summit
68502.FlavorText: In a climate of suspicion, Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.

68503.Name: Leapfrog
68503.FlavorText:
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

68506.Name: Murmuring Mystic
68506.FlavorText: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

68507.Name: Muse Drake
68507.FlavorText: A composer wrote a symphony based on the drakes screeching outside her window. Reviews were mixed—except among the drakes.

68508.Name: Narcomoeba
68508.FlavorText:
"What bait do you cast to catch a dream?"
—Ravnican riddle

68509.Name: Nightveil Sprite
68509.FlavorText:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

68510.Name: Omnispell Adept
68510.FlavorText: She memorized every arcane text in the Ismeri Library by the time she was sixteen. Now she quizzes sphinxes in her spare time.

68511.Name: Passwall Adept
68511.FlavorText: "My doors are called trespassing, my signatures, forgeries. They don't respect my talents, and I don't respect their labels."

68513.Name: Radical Idea
68513.FlavorText: Genius is finding the edge of what's possible, then jumping over it.

68514.Name: Selective Snare
68514.FlavorText:
"How thoughtful of the Legion to train its soldiers to fit our spell's specifications."
—Nefara, Dimir agent

68515.Name: Sinister Sabotage
68515.FlavorText:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav

68517.Name: Unexplained Disappearance
68517.FlavorText: The first thing the mist chills is the mind. Victims never cry out or even murmur in surprise.

68518.Name: Vedalken Mesmerist
68518.FlavorText: "There's no need to sound the alarm. You are minding your post admirably. I am authorized. All is well."

68519.Name: Wall of Mist
68519.FlavorText: Fog haunts the streets, rendering the familiar as otherworldly, changing neighbors into shadows, and muffling cries for help.

68521.Name: Wishcoin Crab
68521.FlavorText:
"What wishes do they grant? Mostly pinching-related ones."
—Omik, superintendent of waterworks

68522.Name: Barrier of Bones
68522.FlavorText: The Dimir rarely make statements, but when they do, the message is clear.

68523.Name: Bartizan Bats
68523.FlavorText:
"Bats are welcome to eat thousands of my pets. I have multitudes more that will ultimately eat the bats."
—Izoni

68525.Name: Burglar Rat
68525.FlavorText:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

68526.Name: Child of Night
68526.FlavorText: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.

68528.Name: Dead Weight
68528.FlavorText: All things considered, his first day on patrol could have gone better.

68530.Name: Doom Whisperer
68530.FlavorText: The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.

68531.Name: Douser of Lights
68531.FlavorText: The party of Rakdos revelers cackled and capered as the thing approached. It hissed, and they jabbed their torches at it, giggling when it recoiled. Then, one by one, the torches went out—and the screaming began.

68532.Name: Gruesome Menagerie
68532.FlavorText:
"Variety is also the spice of death."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

68533.Name: Hired Poisoner
68533.FlavorText: "They don't even feel the cut. I'm ordering a drink in a nearby tavern before anyone notices something's wrong."

68534.Name: Kraul Swarm
68534.FlavorText: The hive has a long memory. It knows how every member ever died, and to whom it owes the grudge.

68535.Name: Lotleth Giant
68535.FlavorText:
"I prefer the big and looming to the small and skittering."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

68537.Name: Mephitic Vapors
68537.FlavorText: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

68538.Name: Midnight Reaper
68538.FlavorText: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

68540.Name: Necrotic Wound
68540.FlavorText: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

68541.Name: Never Happened
68541.FlavorText: Dimir assassins have the precision to slay a single memory.

68543.Name: Plaguecrafter
68543.FlavorText: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

68545.Name: Ritual of Soot
68545.FlavorText: Only the patrol's armor was found, so tainted with the acrid smell of sudden death that it could never be worn again.

68546.Name: Severed Strands
68546.FlavorText: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

68547.Name: Spinal Centipede
68547.FlavorText: The Golgari adorn themselves with the exoskeletons of iridescent insects. It's only fair the insects do likewise.

68548.Name: Undercity Necrolisk
68548.FlavorText: In its territory, living is an affront.

68549.Name: Veiled Shade
68549.FlavorText:
"I sang songs of sorrow for my lost love. Imagine my horror when, one night, they were answered."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

68550.Name: Vicious Rumors
68550.FlavorText:
"The alliances were already frayed. All we do is find the loose threads and pluck."
—Lazav

68551.Name: Whispering Snitch
68551.FlavorText: "Sure, I hear things. I hear plenty. But how am I to talk with this parched throat?"

68553.Name: Barging Sergeant
68553.FlavorText: "Don't stop till your horns come out their back."

68554.Name: Book Devourer
68554.FlavorText: "Not my first edition of The Advokist and the Urchin!"

68555.Name: Command the Storm
68555.FlavorText: In the wake of Niv-Mizzet's disappearance, Ral found himself leading the guild. He had dreamed of this day, but couldn't help feeling like a pawn in someone else's game.

68556.Name: Cosmotronic Wave
68556.FlavorText: "This sort of innovation occurs when you set out to improve an electric tea kettle and misplace a decimal."

68558.Name: Electrostatic Field
68558.FlavorText:
"It's both an ingress-denial mechanism and an attractive hallway light!"
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer

68559.Name: Erratic Cyclops
68559.FlavorText:
"The League accepts no responsibility for former members and the damage they may cause."
—Maree, Izzet chamberlain

68560.Name: Experimental Frenzy
68560.FlavorText: Turns out coffee is the weird aunt of invention.

68561.Name: Fearless Halberdier
68561.FlavorText: "I spent some time in the Legion, but I'm done taking orders all day."

68562.Name: Fire Urchin
68562.FlavorText: Rain runoff in the Smelting District is known to spontaneously burst into flame.

68563.Name: Goblin Banneret
68563.FlavorText: The Boros banner stands tall even if its bearer doesn't.

68565.Name: Goblin Locksmith
68565.FlavorText:
"He's got more finesse than most goblins. He smashes windows with his fist rather than his forehead."
—Arrester Polgar

68567.Name: Hellkite Whelp
68567.FlavorText:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
