—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler

68568.Name: Inescapable Blaze
68568.FlavorText:
"The Izzet are blamed for every little disaster, which is unfair because we only cause most of them."
—Mizzix of the Izmagnus

68569.Name: Lava Coil
68569.FlavorText:
"Commander, we caught the Dimir spy and took her ashes into custody."
—Kramm, Wojek security officer

68571.Name: Maniacal Rage
68571.FlavorText:
"They tell us the wilds are ours, then they brick them over. They can lie to our faces but not to our fists."
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

68573.Name: Ornery Goblin
68573.FlavorText: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."

68575.Name: Rubblebelt Boar
68575.FlavorText: Some Gruul druids believe that boars are spawn of the great Ilharg, the mighty Raze-Boar who will one day rise and level the city.

68578.Name: Street Riot
68578.FlavorText:
"They said obey and you'll be happy. They said you'll be safe. But we're not safe. We're not happy. And we will not obey."
—Domri Rade

68579.Name: Sure Strike
68579.FlavorText: "I packed three more electroconduits into each test wand. You'll experience a brief tingling sensation."

68580.Name: Torch Courier
68580.FlavorText: "Light a torch and deliver this letter" were his instructions, which he unfortunately reversed.

68581.Name: Wojek Bodyguard
68581.FlavorText: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."

68582.Name: Affectionate Indrik
68582.FlavorText: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

68584.Name: Beast Whisperer
68584.FlavorText: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

68585.Name: Bounty of Might
68585.FlavorText:
"I am the very soul of battle, but even I would never advise open war with the Conclave."
—Aurelia

68586.Name: Circuitous Route
68586.FlavorText:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide

68587.Name: Crushing Canopy
68587.FlavorText:
"The Dimir may look all they want. We never grow tired of swatting their bugs."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

68588.Name: Devkarin Dissident
68588.FlavorText: "This is Mileva, in the Tenth. We've got an elf in the plaza with a chip on her shoulder. Actually, it's more of a morningstar."

68589.Name: District Guide
68589.FlavorText: "The route is direct but challenging. Incidentally, how are you with heights?"

68590.Name: Generous Stray
68590.FlavorText: Cats place their gifts with care, so that a bare foot will step on them in the middle of the night.

68591.Name: Golgari Raiders
68591.FlavorText: What the Golgari can't claim through patient undercity expansion, they seize in brazen topside sorties.

68592.Name: Grappling Sundew
68592.FlavorText: Some rooftop gardens attract bees; others capture dragons.

68594.Name: Hitchclaw Recluse
68594.FlavorText: Nearly invisible strands of web reach far beyond its lair to alert it of the approach of prey.

68595.Name: Ironshell Beetle
68595.FlavorText:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

68596.Name: Kraul Foragers
68596.FlavorText:
Feed on food, you eventually rot. Feed on rot, you live forever.
—Kraul saying

68598.Name: Might of the Masses
68598.FlavorText:
"There is nothing stronger than many hearts united for a single cause."
—Emmara

68600.Name: Pack's Favor
68600.FlavorText: Selesnya grows its ranks in more ways than one.

68603.Name: Portcullis Vine
68603.FlavorText: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."

68604.Name: Prey Upon
68604.FlavorText:
"Light up the dark to find your way, and the dark may seek you out."
—Zalin the Gutter Bard

68605.Name: Siege Wurm
68605.FlavorText: Suddenly, all the haggling didn't seem so important.

68607.Name: Urban Utopia
68607.FlavorText: Ravnica's diversity produces blossoms of opinion in a rich soil of perspectives.

68609.Name: Vivid Revival
68609.FlavorText: Golgari crops bloom in strange soils, touched only by long-traveled light.

68610.Name: Wary Okapi
68610.FlavorText:
"Be like the grazers of the Saruli. Keep your herd close, and stay alert for encroaching danger."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad

68611.Name: Wild Ceratok
68611.FlavorText: Once part of a wealthy merchant's private zoo, the herd roams feral throughout the Tenth, where it will remain until the guilds can agree to relocate, cull, or befriend it.

68612.Name: Artful Takedown
68612.FlavorText: Dimir assassinations are choreographed like dance routines. Each challenge is anticipated and countered with graceful ease.

68613.Name: Assassin's Trophy
68613.FlavorText: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.

68617.Name: Boros Challenger
68617.FlavorText: "Send your champion. I could use a light workout."

68618.Name: Camaraderie
68618.FlavorText:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

68619.Name: Centaur Peacemaker
68619.FlavorText: "Please accept this offering. I sincerely hope to leave my mace at my side."

68620.Name: Chance for Glory
68620.FlavorText: "It is not your time. The Legion still needs your blade."

68622.Name: Conclave Cavalier
68622.FlavorText: "Just as leaves fall and the tree blooms again, one day I will fall and the Conclave will endure."

68625.Name: Darkblade Agent
68625.FlavorText: "I've seen your house, and you've been a lovely, if unwitting, host. But at last it's time for farewells."

68626.Name: Deafening Clarion
68626.FlavorText:
"Commander, what's the signal to attack?"
"You'll know."

68627.Name: Dimir Spybug
68627.FlavorText: Just assume every conversation is on record.

68628.Name: Disinformation Campaign
68628.FlavorText:
"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav

68629.Name: Emmara, Soul of the Accord
68629.FlavorText: "Whatever hatred destroys, a single act of trust can revive."

68630.Name: Erstwhile Trooper
68630.FlavorText:
"The Erstwhile—rotten of body and outmoded in dress, but unfailing in loyalty."
—Vraska

68633.Name: Garrison Sergeant
68633.FlavorText: In the Legion, no flagpole is merely decorative, and every ceremonial sword bears an edge.

68634.Name: Glowspore Shaman
68634.FlavorText: From death she grows living grandeur.

68635.Name: Goblin Electromancer
68635.FlavorText:
"Result 752: Rapid mass redistribution.
"Result 753: Calamitous reverse synthesis.
"Result 754: Acute disarrayment."
—Izzet research notes

68636.Name: Golgari Findbroker
68636.FlavorText: "We gather the past from surface dwellers and sell it right back to them."

68637.Name: Hammer Dropper
68637.FlavorText: Giants know a solid hit is one part strength, four parts leverage.

68639.Name: Hypothesizzle
68639.FlavorText:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

68640.Name: Ionize
68640.FlavorText: "Countermagic is a simple process of breaking matter into its elementary particles."

68642.Name: Join Shields
68642.FlavorText: "We are the shield that never breaks, the bough that never burns, the song that can never be silenced."

68643.Name: Justice Strike
68643.FlavorText:
"Those who show no mercy to the weak deserve no mercy from the strong."
—Firemane Kavrova

68649.Name: March of the Multitudes
68649.FlavorText: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."

68652.Name: Nightveil Predator
68652.FlavorText:
"Three daggers left in an angel's back, three enforcers with memory loss, three keys stolen from my own belt—and you talk of peace?"
—Tajic, to Aurelia

68654.Name: Notion Rain
68654.FlavorText: City air is a constant drizzle of private thoughts.

68655.Name: Ochran Assassin
68655.FlavorText: "The dagger is just the distraction. I carry the real killer in a vial at my side."

68657.Name: Rhizome Lurcher
68657.FlavorText:
"The dead gain new purpose here. What is strange in the eyes of other guilds is harmonious in ours."
—Devesh, Golgari shaman

68658.Name: Rosemane Centaur
68658.FlavorText: "I long for peaceful times, when I may tend to my garden instead of our borders."

68659.Name: Skyknight Legionnaire
68659.FlavorText: Squadrons of skyknights are available for deployment around the clock, capable of reaching any district in the city within minutes.

68660.Name: Sonic Assault
68660.FlavorText: He heard stars and saw thunder.

68663.Name: Swathcutter Giant
68663.FlavorText:
"Now do you understand what we meant when we said disperse?"
—Eksari, Boros patrol leader

68664.Name: Swiftblade Vindicator
68664.FlavorText: A swiftblade is an artist, each fiery trail of their blades a fleeting masterpiece traced on the air.

68667.Name: Thought Erasure
68667.FlavorText: "It's truly the highest honor, isn't it? To be remembered? Pity for you."

68668.Name: Thousand-Year Storm
68668.FlavorText: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

68673.Name: Unmoored Ego
68673.FlavorText: A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.

68675.Name: Wee Dragonauts
68675.FlavorText:
"Something's causing electrospheric disruption in the blazekite's spire-vanes. Find the cause, and tell them to keep it up!"
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

68677.Name: Fresh-Faced Recruit
68677.FlavorText:
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade."
—Tajic

68678.Name: Piston-Fist Cyclops
68678.FlavorText: Its hyperpneumatics can punch through a wall and the spy on the other side.

68679.Name: Pitiless Gorgon
68679.FlavorText: "The reign of the Swarm begins. Let us rise now and dress ourselves in vengeance."

68680.Name: Vernadi Shieldmate
68680.FlavorText: "Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."

68681.Name: Whisper Agent
68681.FlavorText: He has a job to finish, and it's you.

68682.Name: Assure // Assemble
68682.RawFrameDetail: X, left GW hybrid, right GW gold, both with g/w guildmark

68685.Name: Connive // Concoct
68685.RawFrameDetail: X, left UB hybrid, right UB gold, both with u/b guildmark

68688.Name: Discovery // Dispersal
68688.RawFrameDetail: X, left UB hybrid, right UB gold, both with u/b guildmark

68691.Name: Expansion // Explosion
68691.RawFrameDetail: X, left UR hybrid, right UR gold, both with u/r guildmark

68694.Name: Find // Finality
68694.RawFrameDetail: X, left BG hybrid, right BG gold, both with b/g guildmark

68697.Name: Flower // Flourish
68697.RawFrameDetail: X, left GW hybrid, right GW gold, both with g/w guildmark

68700.Name: Integrity // Intervention
68700.RawFrameDetail: X, left RW hybrid, right RW gold, both with r/w guildmark

68703.Name: Invert // Invent
68703.RawFrameDetail: X, left UR hybrid, right UR gold, both with u/r guildmark

68706.Name: Response // Resurgence
68706.RawFrameDetail: X, left RW hybrid, right RW gold, both with r/w guildmark

68709.Name: Status // Statue
68709.RawFrameDetail: X, left BG hybrid, right BG gold, both with b/g guildmark

68712.Name: Boros Locket
68712.FlavorText:
"We pass these along to our fellow soldiers to recognize deeds of valor. It won't stay with you for long."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

68714.Name: Chromatic Lantern
68714.FlavorText: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

68715.Name: Dimir Locket
68715.FlavorText:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster

68716.Name: Gatekeeper Gargoyle
68716.FlavorText: Each night it visits a different guildgate around the city, digging its talons into fresh stone.

68718.Name: Golgari Locket
68718.FlavorText:
"Wear it at all times. It will guide our reanimators to your corpse."
—Mazirek, kraul death priest

68719.Name: Izzet Locket
68719.FlavorText:
"Remember to discharge your locket every seven hours. Unless you prefer the spontaneous aether overload, of course."
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer

68720.Name: Rampaging Monument
68720.FlavorText: "Be advised: suspect is nine stories tall, marble hair, answers to Saint Gusztav."

68721.Name: Selesnya Locket
68721.FlavorText:
"Think of the locket as a seed you bear, spreading life from Vitu-Ghazi across all of Ravnica."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

68722.Name: Silent Dart
68722.FlavorText: "These terms are acceptable to House Dimir. Shall we shake on it?"

68723.Name: Wand of Vertebrae
68723.FlavorText: Made by the mad for the work of the wicked.

68724.Name: Boros Guildgate
68724.FlavorText:
"The more trust breaks down, the more we must throw open the front gates."
—Aurelia

68725.Name: Boros Guildgate
68725.FlavorText:
"It is our duty to protect all those in need. But the other guilds have never shown themselves worthy of that protection."
—Tajic

68726.Name: Dimir Guildgate
68726.FlavorText:
"Every guild dreads infiltration. I should know—I've been a member of all of them."
—Lazav

68727.Name: Dimir Guildgate
68727.FlavorText:
"You've found this place only because you were summoned. Pray you're worthy of the invitation."
—Etrata

68728.Name: Gateway Plaza
68728.FlavorText: The Chamber of the Guildpact stands as a reminder that even the bitterest struggles can end in cooperation.

68729.Name: Golgari Guildgate
68729.FlavorText:
"Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom."
—Vraska

68730.Name: Golgari Guildgate
68730.FlavorText:
"Jarad was a friend to the Devkarin. Now we slink through neglected tunnels, befriending those who crawl them."
—Izoni

68732.Name: Izzet Guildgate
68732.FlavorText: Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.

68733.Name: Izzet Guildgate
68733.FlavorText:
"Yesterday I didn't recognize my own guild. Today I see why. And for tomorrow I must be prepared."
—Niv-Mizzet

68734.Name: Overgrown Tomb
68734.FlavorText: Cradle of the Golgari's new kingdom. Grave of those who wronged its queen.

68735.Name: Sacred Foundry
68735.FlavorText:
"You will not be trained here. You will be forged."
—Commander Yaszen

68736.Name: Selesnya Guildgate
68736.FlavorText:
"Everyone who crosses that threshold is our most cherished friend. Everyone who crosses it again is our bitterest enemy."
—Trostani

68737.Name: Selesnya Guildgate
68737.FlavorText:
"We leave our gardens open, so all may know wonder, but guarded, so all may know peace."
—Emmara

68738.Name: Steam Vents
68738.FlavorText:
"A massive new Izzet building project with an unstated purpose? Probably fine."
—Zija, Simic mutationist

68739.Name: Temple Garden
68739.FlavorText:
"Where the roots reach, there the temple rises."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

68740.Name: Watery Grave
68740.FlavorText: Few believe Duskmantle exists. Fewer find it. None live to bear witness.

68748.Name: Precision Bolt
68748.FlavorText: Ral had wielded lightning all his life but had never harnessed the power of an entire guild.

68751.Name: Kraul Raider
68751.FlavorText: The kraul once skulked in the outskirts of Golgari society, but with Vraska's rise, they became valued forces of the Swarm.

68752.Name: Attendant of Vraska
68752.FlavorText: When the Erstwhile were unearthed from their tombs, they became a ready-made army for Vraska.

68754.Name: Impervious Greatwurm
68754.FlavorText: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

68760.Name: Elf Knight
68760.RawFrameDetail: GW token, text box, g/w guildmark

68787.Name: Take Vengeance
68787.FlavorText: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."

68788.Name: Knight's Pledge
68788.FlavorText: "As long as my faith persists, so shall I."

68789.Name: Loxodon Line Breaker
68789.FlavorText: Loxodons are firm in stature and spirit. No matter the odds, they are always first into battle.

68790.Name: Volcanic Dragon
68790.FlavorText: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

68791.Name: Rise from the Grave
68791.FlavorText:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

68793.Name: Serra Angel
68793.FlavorText: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

68794.Name: Chaos Maw
68794.FlavorText: The food chain doesn't end at sandwurms.

68795.Name: Miasmic Mummy
68795.FlavorText: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.

68796.Name: Overflowing Insight
68796.FlavorText: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

68798.Name: Ambition's Cost
68798.FlavorText:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

68800.Name: Divination
68800.FlavorText:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

68801.Name: Rumbling Baloth
68801.FlavorText: In the dim light beneath the vast trees of Deepglade, baloths prowl in search of prey. Their guttural calls are more felt than heard, but their attack scream carries for miles.

68802.Name: Goblin Grenade
68802.FlavorText: Don't underestimate the aerodynamic qualities of the common goblin.

68803.Name: Renegade Demon
68803.FlavorText:
"Have you ever cornered a wounded vampire? That's a walk in the cathedral garden in comparison."
—Tristen, Cathar Marshal

68804.Name: Sanctuary Cat
68804.FlavorText: Cats prowl the corridors of Avacyn's churches in search of devils or signs of their mischief.

68806.Name: Altar's Reap
68806.FlavorText:
"The demons don't care if we mutter niceties and act out ceremonies. Just kill him."
—Bishop Volpaig, servant of Griselbrand

68811.Name: Seismic Rupture
68811.FlavorText: The shaman opened the earth beneath their feet, trapping the survivors within the crevices of Ayagor for Atarka to devour at her leisure.

68814.Name: Doublecast
68814.FlavorText: First the insult, then the encore.

69130.Name: Angelic Exaltation
69130.FlavorText:
"If we cannot have peace, we will have justice."
—Aurelia

69131.Name: Archway Angel
69131.FlavorText: A ray of hope breaks through the shroud of rain.

69132.Name: Arrester's Zeal
69132.FlavorText: Law is the light of civilization.

69133.Name: Bring to Trial
69133.FlavorText: "In you go, big guy. Watch your head."

69134.Name: Civic Stalwart
69134.FlavorText: "These are your streets. Defend them! This is your neighborhood. Honor it! This is your city. Save it!"

69135.Name: Concordia Pegasus
69135.FlavorText:
"What makes a frog lizard any worse than a bird horse? Prejudice against the Simic, that's what. It's unfair!"
—Thados Arquef, Guardian Project biomancer

69136.Name: Expose to Daylight
69136.FlavorText:
"Lies cannot long withstand the harsh light of day."
—Lavinia

69138.Name: Haazda Officer
69138.FlavorText: "You two, cover the alley! You, with me! Eyes on windows, balconies, and rooftops. Who knows what a fish-octopus-crab can do!"

69139.Name: Hero of Precinct One
69139.FlavorText: When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.

69140.Name: Impassioned Orator
69140.FlavorText: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.

69141.Name: Justiciar's Portal
69141.FlavorText: With the new guildmaster's innovations, arresters can arrive on the scene moments before a crime is committed.

69142.Name: Knight of Sorrows
69142.FlavorText: The helmet reveals no eyes to witness your penance, no mouth to offer absolution.

69144.Name: Ministrant of Obligation
69144.FlavorText: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.

69145.Name: Prowling Caracal
69145.FlavorText: A hunter in the city requires the utmost cunning to survive. It must pounce only if the kill is certain, and leave the remains where no one will see.

69146.Name: Rally to Battle
69146.FlavorText: The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.

69147.Name: Resolute Watchdog
69147.FlavorText: A friend in good times, a guardian in bad times, and a savior when all else fails.

69149.Name: Sky Tether
69149.FlavorText:
"If you can't control your mount, I will control it for you."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

69151.Name: Spirit of the Spires
69151.FlavorText: She breathes fair winds to tired griffins and lifts songbirds beyond the reach of stalking cats.

69152.Name: Summary Judgment
69152.FlavorText: Any challenge to Azorius authority is met with swift and potent retribution.

69153.Name: Syndicate Messenger
69153.FlavorText:
"Many wings haunt the skies these days. Few of them bear good tidings."
—Lavinia

69154.Name: Tenth District Veteran
69154.FlavorText: "I keep reminding myself we do this because others can't, because we love this city. If we don't save it, no one will."

69156.Name: Twilight Panther
69156.FlavorText: A pet that can hunt both flesh and spirit is precious in a place where smiling assassins keep company with ghostly shadows.

69158.Name: Watchful Giant
69158.FlavorText: Loitering is not only illegal but unwise, since those who stay too long in one place are apt to be stepped on.

69159.Name: Arrester's Admonition
69159.FlavorText: Law is the voice of reason.

69161.Name: Chillbringer
69161.FlavorText: If you can see your breath, it's too late to run.

69162.Name: Clear the Mind
69162.FlavorText:
"The best way to keep a secret is to forget it."
—Lazav

69164.Name: Coral Commando
69164.FlavorText: Few Ravnicans are aware of the vast reefs in their world's hidden ocean. Far beneath the great sinkholes, where the light is blue and dim, merfolk tend the coral labyrinths that feed the benthic ecosystem.

69165.Name: Essence Capture
69165.FlavorText:
"It's not enough to defeat our foes. We must learn from them, too."
—Vannifar

69167.Name: Faerie Duelist
69167.FlavorText: Faeries are easily offended and quick to exact a quirky revenge.

69168.Name: Gateway Sneak
69168.FlavorText: "I've been through every guildgate in this city, and no one sees me come or go."

69169.Name: Humongulus
69169.FlavorText: Searching the city for Fblthp felt like sifting the rain for a single drop of blood.

69170.Name: Mass Manipulation
69170.FlavorText: Those who cross the Dimir find enemies everywhere they turn.

69173.Name: Precognitive Perception
69173.FlavorText: "To control the present we must master the future."

69174.Name: Prying Eyes
69174.FlavorText: "Citizen! Your crime has been recorded. Cease movement and await arrest, or further penalties will be immediately imposed."

69176.Name: Quench
69176.FlavorText: "When properly invoked, the plasma globule encloses the offensive spell with a satisfying slurp."

69177.Name: Sage's Row Savant
69177.FlavorText: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.

69178.Name: Senate Courier
69178.FlavorText:
"This Dovin Baan came from nowhere. Watch him. Read his letters. He is more than he appears."
—Lazav

69179.Name: Shimmer of Possibility
69179.FlavorText:
"There's something peculiar about the rain today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker

69180.Name: Skatewing Spy
69180.FlavorText:
"A better Ravnica begins with a better Simic."
—Vannifar

69181.Name: Skitter Eel
69181.FlavorText:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

69182.Name: Slimebind
69182.FlavorText:
"Relax. It's quite harmless. And it will dissolve completely in a month or two."
—Navona, Simic field tester

69183.Name: Sphinx of Foresight
69183.FlavorText: "I do not understand the future I see: the guilds subverted, the world at war, armies bent to a cruel conqueror's will."

69185.Name: Thought Collapse
69185.FlavorText:
"I can think of no greater punishment than answering your question in full."
—Lazav

69186.Name: Verity Circle
69186.FlavorText:
"Here, there is only truth."
—Barvisa, Azorius emissary

69187.Name: Wall of Lost Thoughts
69187.FlavorText: Those who intrude upon the Dimir seldom remember that they have done so.

69188.Name: Windstorm Drake
69188.FlavorText: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

69189.Name: Awaken the Erstwhile
69189.FlavorText: In preparation for the conflict all foresaw, the Golgari called upon an army that had slept for millennia beneath the city.

69190.Name: Bankrupt in Blood
69190.FlavorText: "Your spirits can rest in peace, for your debts are paid."

69192.Name: Bladebrand
69192.FlavorText:
"The pain of searing iron and razor edges pales beside the pleasure of performance."
—Judith

69193.Name: Bloodmist Infiltrator
69193.FlavorText: Blood seeks blood, and nothing shall hold back its hunger.

69194.Name: Carrion Imp
69194.FlavorText: No scrap of nutrition goes to waste in the undercity.

69195.Name: Catacomb Crocodile
69195.FlavorText:
"I am sewer-king!" said Rat. "I am quick and cunning and I know every tunnel."
"No, I am king!" said Zombie. "I am cold and deadly and no rot can harm me."
Then Croc came and ate them both.

69196.Name: Clear the Stage
69196.FlavorText: "Make way! It's time for the final act!"

69197.Name: Consign to the Pit
69197.FlavorText: First your whole life flashes before your eyes. Then you have considerable time to reflect on every regret as you plummet.

69198.Name: Cry of the Carnarium
69198.FlavorText: If your ears bleed, it's a party. If your eyes bleed, it's a Rakdos party.

69199.Name: Dead Revels
69199.FlavorText: You're only as dead as you feel.

69200.Name: Debtors' Transport
69200.FlavorText: By design, the sarcophagus muffles the debtors' moans but does not silence them.

69202.Name: Font of Agonies
69202.FlavorText:
"No worthwhile reward is easily gained."
—Nicol Bolas

69203.Name: Grotesque Demise
69203.FlavorText:
"A debtor's soul has little value, except as a warning to others who might consider defaulting on their loans."
—Ubea, Orzhov ministrant

69205.Name: Ill-Gotten Inheritance
69205.FlavorText: "The suffering of others is not my concern."

69206.Name: Noxious Groodion
69206.FlavorText:
"Behold the groodion! Ichor-slurper, oozing fiend. Foulest wonder underground. Grandest vermin of them all!"
—Zalin the Gutter Bard

69207.Name: Orzhov Enforcer
69207.FlavorText: "You'll pay what you owe, with your money or your life."

69209.Name: Pestilent Spirit
69209.FlavorText: Its stench corrodes steel. Its miasma sickens angels. Its finality ends hope.

69210.Name: Plague Wight
69210.FlavorText: For some goods, the best couriers are the dead.

69211.Name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
69211.FlavorText: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

69212.Name: Rakdos Trumpeter
69212.FlavorText:
"The louder their performance, the quieter we become in comparison. They are the perfect distractions, for only fools ignore the Rakdos."
—Lazav

69214.Name: Spire Mangler
69214.FlavorText: Its mandibles can leave a rider in the clouds astride a headless griffin.

69215.Name: Thirsting Shade
69215.FlavorText:
"Your life is a blinding light, your breath a gale, your pulse a deafening drum. Be still. Be still."
—Dahlya Trul, "Irbitov Lament"

69216.Name: Undercity Scavenger
69216.FlavorText:
"We grow strong by feasting on failure."
—Izoni

69218.Name: Vindictive Vampire
69218.FlavorText: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.

69219.Name: Act of Treason
69219.FlavorText: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

69221.Name: Burn Bright
69221.FlavorText:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

69222.Name: Burning-Tree Vandal
69222.FlavorText: The ostentatious splendor of the Orzhov church was just asking to be smashed.

69223.Name: Cavalcade of Calamity
69223.FlavorText: Let the Dimir worry about witnesses. For the Rakdos, screams count as applause.

69225.Name: Dagger Caster
69225.FlavorText: "Keep coming. I have knives enough for everyone."

69227.Name: Electrodominance
69227.FlavorText: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."

69228.Name: Feral Maaka
69228.FlavorText:
"Lost are the lush meadows and verdant forests, where maaka prowled and lammasu soared. Lost are the wilds, where our hearts were free."
—Daiva, Gruul storyteller

69229.Name: Flames of the Raze-Boar
69229.FlavorText: "Fire will cure a multitude of ills."

69230.Name: Gates Ablaze
69230.FlavorText: When the Izzet's spirit of invention extends to the city's infrastructure, the results are sometimes explosive.

69231.Name: Ghor-Clan Wrecker
69231.FlavorText: "Today the Rubblebelt is a bit larger. That's a good day's work."

69232.Name: Goblin Gathering
69232.FlavorText: Two's a party. Three's a felony.

69233.Name: Gravel-Hide Goblin
69233.FlavorText:
"No peace accord will save Ravnica. You don't build on rot. You burn it down and start again."
—Domri Rade

69238.Name: Rubble Reading
69238.FlavorText: Gruul oracles see omens in all forms of destruction: the entrails of a maaka's prey, the flight of vultures over a battlefield, the scattering of toppled stone.

69239.Name: Rubblebelt Recluse
69239.FlavorText: Joining a guild, even the Gruul, would mean giving up some of his independence. He'd rather smash what he wants to smash.

69241.Name: Scorchmark
69241.FlavorText: "Have you seen your face? Trust me, this will be an improvement."

69243.Name: Skewer the Critics
69243.FlavorText: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.

69245.Name: Spear Spewer
69245.FlavorText:
"Don't waste time aiming, you lazy gob-slug! Fire!"
—Krenko, mob boss

69246.Name: Spikewheel Acrobat
69246.FlavorText: "Every street's a stage, and every screaming bystander's an audience."

69247.Name: Storm Strike
69247.FlavorText: "My shout is thunder and my fist is lightning!"

69248.Name: Tin Street Dodger
69248.FlavorText: "That giant didn't even see me, let alone catch me! And I was close enough to smell him! Of course, that's not saying much."

69249.Name: Axebane Beast
69249.FlavorText:
"Imagine a gigantic pine cone that's extremely territorial and always in a foul mood."
—Zhosmir, urban huntmaster

69251.Name: Biogenic Upgrade
69251.FlavorText:
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means."
—Vannifar

69253.Name: Enraged Ceratok
69253.FlavorText: "There's no time to calm it down! Run!"

69254.Name: Gatebreaker Ram
69254.FlavorText: So-called "battering rams" pale in comparison to the real thing.

69255.Name: Gift of Strength
69255.FlavorText:
"When the sky screams, when the ground groans, the End-Raze will soon begin."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

69258.Name: Guardian Project
69258.FlavorText: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.

69260.Name: Mammoth Spider
69260.FlavorText:
"The good news is that the migrating drakes are no longer a problem."
—Bell Migellic, Azorius hussar

69261.Name: Open the Gates
69261.FlavorText:
"If you don't have a destination in mind, the route is all that matters."
—Tamina, district guide

69262.Name: Rampage of the Clans
69262.FlavorText: "Rage! Rage until the whole world burns!"

69264.Name: Regenesis
69264.FlavorText:
"When you get right down to it, the difference between death and life is just a membrane-enclosed environment maintained by a metabolic process."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

69265.Name: Root Snare
69265.FlavorText: The roots run deep under stone and street, with strength that needs but a whisper to awaken.

69266.Name: Sagittars' Volley
69266.FlavorText:
"My bowstring hums in tune with the song of the Worldsoul."
—Alcarus, Selesnya sagittar

69267.Name: Saruli Caretaker
69267.FlavorText: "I hold the seed of our new beginning."

69268.Name: Sauroform Hybrid
69268.FlavorText:
"Within each of us, the potential for great power waits to be released."
—Zija, Simic mutationist

69269.Name: Silhana Wayfinder
69269.FlavorText: "Stay close! It's just a little farther."

69270.Name: Steeple Creeper
69270.FlavorText:
"If the Fin Clade cannot produce a reliable venomous krasis, mobile in both air and water, then the Guardian Project will absorb its resources."
—Vannifar

69271.Name: Stony Strength
69271.FlavorText: "What you build, we will destroy . . . and bury you in the rubble!"

69272.Name: Sylvan Brushstrider
69272.FlavorText: The mournful lowing of brushstriders warns of changing weather and ill winds.

69273.Name: Territorial Boar
69273.FlavorText:
"The presence of the strong will make you stronger."
—Yeva, Nature's Herald

69275.Name: Tower Defense
69275.FlavorText:
"We've been practicing for this all our lives. This is the final test!"
—Korun Nar, Rubblebelt hunter

69277.Name: Wilderness Reclamation
69277.FlavorText:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade

69278.Name: Wrecking Beast
69278.FlavorText:
"The best construction makes the most satisfying destruction."
—Domri Rade

69279.Name: Absorb
69279.FlavorText: "In your misguided attempt to subvert the law, you have eloquently explained why the law must exist."

69280.Name: Aeromunculus
69280.FlavorText:
"The absence of binocular vision imposes certain challenges for a flying creature, which are overcome via echolocation."
—Simic research notes

69282.Name: Azorius Knight-Arbiter
69282.FlavorText: Thanks to the magic in his Writ of Passage, alms beasts lumbered aside, anarchs bowed their heads, and even Rakdos acrobats rolled their spikewheels out of his way.

69283.Name: Azorius Skyguard
69283.FlavorText: "These new thopters are all well and good, but four eyes are better than none."

69284.Name: Basilica Bell-Haunt
69284.FlavorText: You can hear their tolling only when your debt is due.

69285.Name: Bedevil
69285.FlavorText:
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger."
—Tajic

69287.Name: Bolrac-Clan Crusher
69287.FlavorText: Jaharg discovered that the shapes and symmetries so pleasing to the sculptor's eye also yielded a well-balanced bludgeon.

69296.Name: Dovin's Acuity
69296.FlavorText: Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska . . . and Bolas made an even six.

69298.Name: Ethereal Absolution
69298.FlavorText:
"Time to let the dead be dead."
—Kaya, to Teysa

69299.Name: Final Payment
69299.FlavorText: There's nothing quite like the feeling of paying off a large debt.

69300.Name: Fireblade Artist
69300.FlavorText: "Let's find out what kind of audience you are. Festive? Fearless?"

69303.Name: Galloping Lizrog
69303.FlavorText:
"I might have overfed him."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

69304.Name: Get the Point
69304.FlavorText:
"Vraska sees the grandeur in death but misses the hilarity."
—Judith

69305.Name: Grasping Thrull
69305.FlavorText: "Debt due! Debt due!" The thrull's screeching makes children flinch and debtors quail. "Debt due!"

69306.Name: Growth Spiral
69306.FlavorText: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

69307.Name: Gruul Spellbreaker
69307.FlavorText: She displays her scars with pride.

69308.Name: Gyre Engineer
69308.FlavorText: "As I contemplate what is, I dive ever deeper into the depths of possibility. Then I set an experiment in motion and watch the truth rise to the surface."

69309.Name: Hackrobat
69309.FlavorText: "They all want to see me fall."

69311.Name: Hydroid Krasis
69311.FlavorText: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

69312.Name: Imperious Oligarch
69312.FlavorText: The rights of ghosts are strictly protected under Orzhov bylaws, and those who enforce them can count on the ghosts' assistance.

69313.Name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
69313.FlavorText: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

69315.Name: Kaya's Wrath
69315.FlavorText: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

69317.Name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
69317.FlavorText: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

69321.Name: Nikya of the Old Ways
69321.FlavorText: "The hooves of the Raze-Boar will trample the weak—and their city—to dust!"

69322.Name: Pitiless Pontiff
69322.FlavorText: "Pay in gold. Pay in blood. Pay with the servitude of your spirit kin. But pay you must."

69325.Name: Rakdos Firewheeler
69325.FlavorText: Ever wonder why you never see an old Rakdos cultist?

69326.Name: Rakdos Roustabout
69326.FlavorText:
"That one has a bright future—perfect instincts for the rhythm of mayhem."
—Judith

69329.Name: Rhythm of the Wild
69329.FlavorText: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

69330.Name: Rubblebelt Runner
69330.FlavorText: The sly, stealthy warriors of the Slizt Clan survive by hiding in high ground and ambushing their enemies. Other Gruul call them skulkers and cowards, but only from a safe distance.

69331.Name: Savage Smash
69331.FlavorText: A Gruul berserker is never unarmed.

69336.Name: Sphinx of New Prahv
69336.FlavorText: Azorius sphinxes are loyal to the precepts of the law, not to any particular guildmaster—even one of their own kind.

69337.Name: Sphinx's Insight
69337.FlavorText: "Do not think me blind to your true mission . . . or your true master, Grand Arbiter."

69338.Name: Sunder Shaman
69338.FlavorText: "You take our wilds, we take your city."

69340.Name: Teysa Karlov
69340.FlavorText: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

69343.Name: Zhur-Taa Goblin
69343.FlavorText: Among the Zhur-Taa Clan, goblins are the first to enter battlefury. When the battle is over, the survivors are still frothing at the mouth, looking for someone to hit.

69344.Name: Footlight Fiend
69344.FlavorText:
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!"
—Judith

69345.Name: Rubble Slinger
69345.FlavorText:
"Tear down the city, lie by lie. Then throw it back at the liars, stone by stone."
—Domri Rade

69347.Name: Senate Griffin
69347.FlavorText:
"The Senate griffins overhead used to make people think of order and safety. Not anymore."
—Lavinia

69348.Name: Vizkopa Vampire
69348.FlavorText: Orzhov vampires look for allies in unlikely places in case their new guildmaster turns on them. The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

69349.Name: Bedeck // Bedazzle
69349.RawFrameDetail: X, left BR hybrid, right BR gold, both with b/r guildmark

69352.Name: Carnival // Carnage
69352.RawFrameDetail: X, left BR hybrid, right BR gold, both with b/r guildmark

69355.Name: Collision // Colossus
69355.RawFrameDetail: X, left RG hybrid, right RG gold, both with r/g guildmark

69358.Name: Consecrate // Consume
69358.RawFrameDetail: X, left WB hybrid, right WB gold, both with w/b guildmark

69361.Name: Depose // Deploy
69361.RawFrameDetail: X, left WU hybrid, right WU gold, both with w/u guildmark

69364.Name: Incubation // Incongruity
69364.RawFrameDetail: X, left GU hybrid, right GU gold, both with g/u guildmark

69367.Name: Repudiate // Replicate
69367.RawFrameDetail: X, left GU hybrid, right GU gold, both with g/u guildmark

69370.Name: Revival // Revenge
69370.RawFrameDetail: X, left WB hybrid, right WB gold, both with w/b guildmark

69373.Name: Thrash // Threat
69373.RawFrameDetail: X, left RG hybrid, right RG gold, both with r/g guildmark

69376.Name: Warrant // Warden
69376.RawFrameDetail: X, left WU hybrid, right WU gold, both with w/u guildmark

69379.Name: Azorius Locket
69379.FlavorText:
"Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency."
—Dovin Baan

69381.Name: Glass of the Guildpact
69381.FlavorText:
"Counterbalanced forces sustain this city. No faction above others. A beautiful idea."
—Emmara

69382.Name: Gruul Locket
69382.FlavorText:
"In life, it was a cunning survivor, fearless and quick. May its power pass to you who as you wear its skull."
—Gna, Gruul shaman

69383.Name: Junktroller
69383.FlavorText:
"Hey, wait! That's my boot!"
—Darijo, Ivy Street ruffian

69384.Name: Orzhov Locket
69384.FlavorText:
"It looks expensive, doesn't it? You have no idea . . ."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

69385.Name: Rakdos Locket
69385.FlavorText:
"This trinket will gain you admittance to some painfully exclusive gatherings."
—Exava, blood witch

69386.Name: Scrabbling Claws
69386.FlavorText: Feed it steel. Feed it gold. Feed it bone. In the belly of the furnace, the flames know no difference.

69388.Name: Simic Locket
69388.FlavorText:
"Like our guild itself, this locket can stand for many things. You must discern what it means for you."
—Vannifar

69390.Name: Tome of the Guildpact
69390.FlavorText:
"Reading it has given me a glimpse of what makes this deeply flawed city so very magnificent."
—Dovin Baan

69391.Name: Azorius Guildgate
69391.FlavorText:
"If the populace fears our authority, then I'd say we have an appropriately sensible populace."
—Dovin Baan

69392.Name: Azorius Guildgate
69392.FlavorText:
"If you want to know what's really going on in any building, you don't walk in the front door. You stake out the back."
—Lavinia

69393.Name: Blood Crypt
69393.FlavorText: Life is a show, and death its final performance.

69395.Name: Gateway Plaza
69395.FlavorText: The Chamber of the Guildpact has fallen silent, its bright promise broken.

69396.Name: Godless Shrine
69396.FlavorText: Sin is debt, and absolution is paid in tithes of gold and blood.

69397.Name: Gruul Guildgate
69397.FlavorText:
"Beyond this gate there are no citizens, only predators and prey."
—Domri Rade

69398.Name: Gruul Guildgate
69398.FlavorText:
"Old turf. Powerful turf. Much good blood spilled here."
—Ruric Thar

69399.Name: Hallowed Fountain
69399.FlavorText: The ever-watchful center of a growing web of eyes.

69400.Name: Orzhov Guildgate
69400.FlavorText:
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie."
—Kaya

69401.Name: Orzhov Guildgate
69401.FlavorText:
"If you think the cathedral is impressive, you should see what's down below."
—Teysa

69403.Name: Rakdos Guildgate
69403.FlavorText:
"My servants take pains for your pleasure, and take pleasure in your pain!"
—Rakdos

69404.Name: Rakdos Guildgate
69404.FlavorText:
"Slip in the back if you don't want to be recognized. Don't worry—we'll make sure you're never found!"
—Judith

69405.Name: Simic Guildgate
69405.FlavorText:
"Mystery is beauty. Within the unknown we plumb revelation."
—Vannifar

69406.Name: Simic Guildgate
69406.FlavorText:
"When the Prime Speaker goes too far, I will be here in the safety of the deeps to correct her."
—Zegana

69407.Name: Stomping Ground
69407.FlavorText:
"What we begin, the End-Raze will finish. Then we will dance in Ravnica's rubble."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

69414.Name: Elite Arrester
69414.FlavorText: "Hold it! I need to see your papers."

69416.Name: Dovin's Automaton
69416.FlavorText: It was made for battle, but that doesn't mean it's unsophisticated.

69418.Name: Ragefire
69418.FlavorText: "Your precious laws can't save you now!"

69421.Name: The Haunt of Hightower
69421.FlavorText: It drains vitality from those it touches.

69429.Name: Beast
69429.RawFrameDetail: RG token, has text box, r/g guildmark

69430.Name: Sphinx
69430.RawFrameDetail: WU token, has text box, w/u guildmark

69431.Name: Spirit
69431.RawFrameDetail: WB token, has text box, w/b guildmark

69432.Name: Thopter
69432.RawFrameDetail: A token, has text box, w/u guildmark

69441.Name: Ancient Crab
69441.FlavorText: The banks of the Luxa River attract all manner of predator but only the most resilient of prey.

69455.Name: Ajani's Pridemate
69455.FlavorText: Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.

69456.Name: Battlefield Promotion
69456.FlavorText: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

69457.Name: Bond of Discipline
69457.FlavorText: "We agree that order benefits everyone, but not until you enforce it."

69458.Name: Bulwark Giant
69458.FlavorText:
"Where did she come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura

69459.Name: Charmed Stray
69459.FlavorText:
"There's something peculiar about the cats today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker

69460.Name: Defiant Strike
69460.FlavorText: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

69461.Name: Divine Arrow
69461.FlavorText: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

69462.Name: Enforcer Griffin
69462.FlavorText:
"A company of infantry is trapped behind the lines. We need to strike hard and fast to free them, or the casualties will be horrific. Send the griffins."
—Tajic

69463.Name: Finale of Glory
69463.FlavorText: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.

69465.Name: Gideon's Sacrifice
69465.FlavorText: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

69466.Name: Gideon's Triumph
69466.FlavorText: His triumph came not from victory over his enemies, but from the salvation of those who survived.

69469.Name: Ignite the Beacon
69469.FlavorText:
"If you can't save yourself, you fight to give someone else a chance."
—Ajani Goldmane

69470.Name: Ironclad Krovod
69470.FlavorText:
"We need to block the exits from the plaza! What's big, heavy, and available?"
—Gideon Jura

69471.Name: Law-Rune Enforcer
69471.FlavorText:
"See that no one enters or leaves New Prahv today. And notify me at once of any Planeswalker activity."
—Dovin Baan

69472.Name: Loxodon Sergeant
69472.FlavorText: His voice is both war horn and rallying cry, a trumpeting call that stirs even the faintest heart.

69473.Name: Makeshift Battalion
69473.FlavorText: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.

69474.Name: Martyr for the Cause
69474.FlavorText: "If I am to die in service, there is no more worthy fight than this."

69476.Name: Pouncing Lynx
69476.FlavorText: "I don't understand. He's normally so well behaved!"

69477.Name: Prison Realm
69477.FlavorText: After millennia to craft victory, Bolas had eternity to contemplate defeat.

69478.Name: Rally of Wings
69478.FlavorText: Even the clouds became a field of battle. Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.

69479.Name: Ravnica at War
69479.FlavorText: The heart of Ravnica disappeared before anyone could strike a blow in its defense.

69480.Name: Rising Populace
69480.FlavorText: Grief is a crucible where resolve is tempered.

69481.Name: Single Combat
69481.FlavorText:
Not even a threat to the entire Multiverse
could persuade them to put aside their feud.

69482.Name: Sunblade Angel
69482.FlavorText: At Feather's command, squadrons of battle angels swarmed out of the Parhelion II, unsheathing blades made of molten dawn.

69484.Name: Teyo's Lightshield
69484.FlavorText: Teyo gifted his shields to as many allies as possible, knowing he could not always be there to protect them himself.

69485.Name: Tomik, Distinguished Advokist
69485.FlavorText: "Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."

69486.Name: Topple the Statue
69486.FlavorText: Bolas cared little when his statue fell, thinking it a useful distraction, underestimating the surge of resolve it gave his opponents.

69487.Name: Trusted Pegasus
69487.FlavorText: "Would you give your life to save this world?" Gideon murmured. The pegasus snorted and spread wide its mighty wings.

69489.Name: Wanderer's Strike
69489.FlavorText:
"Precise, clean cuts. No one saw anything. Again. Tag the report with my code and file it."
—Lavinia

69490.Name: War Screecher
69490.FlavorText: Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.

69491.Name: Ashiok's Skulker
69491.FlavorText:
"Fear writhes and whispers in the shadows of your mind. It is the enemy you always knew would come."
—Ashiok

69492.Name: Augur of Bolas
69492.FlavorText: "There is no future save the one my master wills."

69493.Name: Aven Eternal
69493.FlavorText:
"I've never seen the firemane angels so anxious."
—Tajic

69494.Name: Bond of Insight
69494.FlavorText: "Together we can unlock secrets no one has even dreamed of. I might even let you remember some of them."

69495.Name: Callous Dismissal
69495.FlavorText:
"They make it clear we are nothing to them."
—Lavinia

69497.Name: Contentious Plan
69497.FlavorText: Niv-Mizzet had perfected a plan, but he had no control over the mortal minds who had to agree to implement it.

69498.Name: Crush Dissent
69498.FlavorText:
"All I ask is complete obedience."
—Nicol Bolas

69499.Name: Erratic Visionary
69499.FlavorText: An Izzet experiment begins with a "what if," gets approved with a "why not," and concludes with a "eureka!"

69502.Name: Finale of Revelation
69502.FlavorText: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

69503.Name: Flux Channeler
69503.FlavorText: "Inform our allies in the Tenth and throw the circuit. It's about to get weird."

69506.Name: Jace's Triumph
69506.FlavorText: His triumph was not in outsmarting Bolas's plan, but in understanding why ultimate power is self-defeating.

69508.Name: Kasmina's Transmutation
69508.FlavorText:
"Hop away now, little Eternal. Go eat some flies."
—Kasmina

69509.Name: Kiora's Dambreaker
69509.FlavorText:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora

69511.Name: Naga Eternal
69511.FlavorText:
"I recognize that headdress. This one was feared even by her fellow initiates."
—Samut

69513.Name: Narset's Reversal
69513.FlavorText:
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon."
—Narset

69514.Name: No Escape
69514.FlavorText: Jace surmised that they were walking into Bolas's trap. He felt no joy in being right.

69515.Name: Relentless Advance
69515.FlavorText: They approach in formation, every movement efficient and sure. They halt, listen, and then press on in silent unison.

69516.Name: Rescuer Sphinx
69516.FlavorText: "Now, little fighter, show me you deserved this second chance."

69518.Name: Sky Theater Strix
69518.FlavorText: Courier owls joined the fray, attacking the Dreadhorde with a viciousness usually reserved for mail thieves.

69520.Name: Spellkeeper Weird
69520.FlavorText: They worked well as a team, but they knew it couldn't last forever.

69521.Name: Stealth Mission
69521.FlavorText:
"What they don't know will definitely hurt them."
—Lazav

69522.Name: Tamiyo's Epiphany
69522.FlavorText: Tamiyo wished only to observe the war, but she soon realized neutrality was not an option.

69523.Name: Teferi's Time Twist
69523.FlavorText: "The safest place for you is not now."

69524.Name: Thunder Drake
69524.FlavorText: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.

69525.Name: Totally Lost
69525.FlavorText: At least this was better than that week at the Juri Revue.

69526.Name: Wall of Runes
69526.FlavorText:
"It's strangely satisfying seeing an undead killing machine from another world standing befuddled in front of a wall of text."
—Lavinia

69527.Name: Aid the Fallen
69527.FlavorText: "I never liked you. Now get up—we have a fight to finish."

69528.Name: Banehound
69528.FlavorText:
"I wish I could train a pack of them for hunting in the undercity. But I'd never dare turn my back, and I hate to think what I'd have to feed them."
—Zhosmir, urban huntmaster

69531.Name: Bond of Revival
69531.FlavorText: "Today we throw off the yoke of death. Either this is an affirmation of the eternal cyclical nature of life, or it's just hilarious—depends on which of us you ask."

69532.Name: Charity Extractor
69532.FlavorText: "War or no war, your donations are due, as always."

69533.Name: Command the Dreadhorde
69533.FlavorText: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army, gritting her teeth behind the Chain Veil.

69535.Name: Davriel's Shadowfugue
69535.FlavorText: Shadows coiled around the witness's mind. Then the moment vanished, leaving only the sting of its loss.

69538.Name: Dreadmalkin
69538.FlavorText: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.

69539.Name: Duskmantle Operative
69539.FlavorText:
Gideon eyed the Dimir emissary warily. "Could your agents slip inside Bolas's citadel?"
The figure met his gaze with icy resolve. "We already have."

69540.Name: The Elderspell
69540.FlavorText: The path to power is often paved with atrocities.

69541.Name: Eternal Taskmaster
69541.FlavorText:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren

69542.Name: Finale of Eternity
69542.FlavorText: When you rule by fear, your greatest weakness is one who's no longer afraid.

69544.Name: Herald of the Dreadhorde
69544.FlavorText: Amonkhet's dead flowed into a new world in service to their God-Pharaoh.

69545.Name: Kaya's Ghostform
69545.FlavorText: The Eternals found some sparks to be quite slippery.

69546.Name: Lazotep Behemoth
69546.FlavorText:
"I know I should be more concerned. But a big, blue zombie-potamus from beyond the stars? This is what they're invading us with?"
—Mileva, Boros legionnaire

69547.Name: Lazotep Reaver
69547.FlavorText: Despite their many forms, the Eternals worked in chilling harmony, unburdened by instinct or emotion.

69549.Name: Liliana's Triumph
69549.FlavorText: Her triumph came not from escaping her death, but in claiming her independence.

69552.Name: Ob Nixilis's Cruelty
69552.FlavorText: Trapped on Ravnica with no affection for either side, Ob Nixilis sought gratification in random acts of torment.

69553.Name: Price of Betrayal
69553.FlavorText: The moment Liliana defied Nicol Bolas, her contract was broken, and her life was forfeit. But she was free to choose her fate, and she decided it was worth the price.

69554.Name: Shriekdiver
69554.FlavorText:
"It's faster than we are. Draw its attention while the Ledev take aim!"
—Shauntal, Boros legionnaire

69555.Name: Sorin's Thirst
69555.FlavorText:
"I see you're out of the wall."
—Nahiri

69556.Name: Spark Harvest
69556.FlavorText: With the harvest of Domri's spark, the Elderspell began to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.

69557.Name: Spark Reaper
69557.FlavorText:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

69558.Name: Tithebearer Giant
69558.FlavorText:
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them."
—Teysa

69560.Name: Unlikely Aid
69560.FlavorText:
"No one will ever ride me again, Gideon. Expect no further favors."
—Rakdos

69563.Name: Vraska's Finisher
69563.FlavorText: "You might have pleaded your case with my queen earlier. Now I am here, and it is far too late."

69564.Name: Ahn-Crop Invader
69564.FlavorText:
"Give me a crew like this one and I'd rule any sea I sailed."
—Angrath

69565.Name: Blindblast
69565.FlavorText:
"Peril is in the eye of the beholder. At least, if your aim is good."
—Jaya Ballard

69566.Name: Bolt Bend
69566.FlavorText:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

69567.Name: Bond of Passion
69567.FlavorText: "Why don't we fight for what's right and let bureaucrats argue over details?"

69568.Name: Burning Prophet
69568.FlavorText: "This day will end in death, but not the one you hoped for. This day will end in victory, but not the one you expected."

69569.Name: Chainwhip Cyclops
69569.FlavorText:
"You say this Tenth District, not Rubblebelt. But where smash happen, that Rubblebelt. Rubblebelt state of mind."
—Urgdar, cyclops philosopher

69571.Name: Chandra's Pyrohelix
69571.FlavorText:
"Now that I've dealt with your little toys, I can focus on the real problem: you."
—Chandra Nalaar, to Dovin Baan

69572.Name: Chandra's Triumph
69572.FlavorText: Her triumph came not from achieving her ideal self, but from rejecting the idea of perfection.

69574.Name: Demolish
69574.FlavorText:
"For every inch of land they take from us, we take it back or we burn it. Give them nothing."
—Aurelia

69575.Name: Devouring Hellion
69575.FlavorText: There's no crisis a hellion can't make worse.

69579.Name: Goblin Assailant
69579.FlavorText: What he lacks in patience, intelligence, empathy, lucidity, hygiene, ability to follow orders, self-regard, and discernible skills, he makes up for in sheer chaotic violence.

69580.Name: Goblin Assault Team
69580.FlavorText: Under the veneer of the various guilds, each goblin has the same basic need: to run screaming at the enemy and hit a bunch of stuff.

69581.Name: Grim Initiate
69581.FlavorText: Beneath each gleaming mineral shell rots a once-proud warrior of Amonkhet.

69582.Name: Heartfire
69582.FlavorText: The mage looked within and realized there was still one piece of fuel to burn.

69583.Name: Honor the God-Pharaoh
69583.FlavorText: In life, they revered a diverse pantheon of gods. Now they revere only the God-Pharaoh.

69585.Name: Invading Manticore
69585.FlavorText:
"Fall back! You are no match for this."
—Samut

69587.Name: Jaya's Greeting
69587.FlavorText: "We have visitors? Well, it'd be rude not to give them a traditional Keral Keep welcome."

69588.Name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
69588.FlavorText: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

69590.Name: Nahiri's Stoneblades
69590.FlavorText: The ancient Planeswalkers Sorin and Nahiri battled across Ravnica, their blows cutting as deep as their grudge.

69592.Name: Raging Kronch
69592.FlavorText:
"Seeing so much easy prey makes her crazy. See how she snorts and drools?"
—Dhuuz, kronch wrangler

69593.Name: Samut's Sprint
69593.FlavorText: Samut's war was intensely personal. Every hour she faced enemies she once loved as friends and horrors she once revered as gods.

69595.Name: Sarkhan's Catharsis
69595.FlavorText: "You once brought havoc to my home and ruined my mind. I'm here to return the favor, Bolas."

69596.Name: Spellgorger Weird
69596.FlavorText: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

69598.Name: Tibalt's Rager
69598.FlavorText:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

69599.Name: Turret Ogre
69599.FlavorText: Common Gruul career aspirations: berserker, shaman, catapult.

69600.Name: Arboreal Grazer
69600.FlavorText:
"We fight to stop a tyrant, but we also fight for the gentle creatures who have no concept of what befalls their world."
—Vivien Reid

69602.Name: Arlinn's Wolf
69602.FlavorText:
"If you don't speak Wolf, allow me to translate: ‘One step closer and I'll rip out your throat.'"
—Arlinn Kord

69603.Name: Awakening of Vitu-Ghazi
69603.FlavorText: The Eternal armies advanced on Vitu-Ghazi. At Nissa's command, Vitu-Ghazi advanced on them.

69604.Name: Band Together
69604.FlavorText: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

69605.Name: Bloom Hulk
69605.FlavorText:
"Tread upon these flower beds at your own peril."
—Emmara

69606.Name: Bond of Flourishing
69606.FlavorText: "We agree that life should flourish. We disagree on the optimal number of limbs."

69607.Name: Centaur Nurturer
69607.FlavorText: "I call upon the vigor of the grasses, the hopes of the flowers, and the dreams of the trees."

69608.Name: Challenger Troll
69608.FlavorText: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

69609.Name: Courage in Crisis
69609.FlavorText: "Thanks to my father, I know how to fight. He also showed me why I must."

69610.Name: Evolution Sage
69610.FlavorText: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

69611.Name: Finale of Devastation
69611.FlavorText: Some spells sing a quiet tune. Others roar.

69612.Name: Forced Landing
69612.FlavorText: The druid knew only one spell, a charm to encourage rapid plant growth. When airborne Eternals invaded her arboretum, she had to get creative.

69613.Name: Giant Growth
69613.FlavorText:
"Sometimes Mowu is content to gnaw on a bone. Sometimes he wants the whole skeleton."
—Jiang Yanggu

69616.Name: Kraul Stinger
69616.FlavorText: He listens to the sounds of battle filtering down from above, waiting for silence, waiting for his time to claim the streets.

69617.Name: Kronch Wrangler
69617.FlavorText: Looking over two city blocks of destruction, he could only cackle with pride.

69618.Name: Mowu, Loyal Companion
69618.FlavorText: Wherever Yanggu goes, Mowu follows—sometimes at his side, sometimes obscuring him from view entirely.

69621.Name: Nissa's Triumph
69621.FlavorText: Her triumph came not from destroying the unnatural, but from fostering life.

69622.Name: Paradise Druid
69622.FlavorText: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

69625.Name: Primordial Wurm
69625.FlavorText: Elite training, single-minded devotion, and lazotep coating help only so much for invaders who are fundamentally bite-sized.

69626.Name: Return to Nature
69626.FlavorText:
"Yes, nature is stronger. You don't see little buildings sprouting on trees."
—Emmara

69627.Name: Snarespinner
69627.FlavorText:
"Let's lure the drakes to the webs over the Samok Stand. Keep the spiders content."
—Aurelia

69628.Name: Steady Aim
69628.FlavorText: The archer's heart broke seeing her compatriots die far below, but she held position until the enemy was in range.

69629.Name: Storm the Citadel
69629.FlavorText:
"If we die, we die. But we cannot let him win."
—Ajani Goldmane

69630.Name: Thundering Ceratok
69630.FlavorText:
"I thought this was a civilized plane. How are there so many feral beasts?"
—Dovin Baan

69634.Name: Wardscale Crocodile
69634.FlavorText:
"The Eternals had to endure Amonkhet's five trials. Let's see if they can pass the Trial of Ravnica."
—Jace Beleren

69636.Name: Angrath's Rampage
69636.FlavorText: "Grand city? No. This is nothing but another squalid cage."

69639.Name: Cruel Celebrant
69639.FlavorText: "Whichever side wins, I'm sure the banquet will be superb."

69640.Name: Deathsprout
69640.FlavorText:
"They say nothing lasts forever. I say everything lasts forever, just not in the form you may be accustomed to." 
—Vraska

69642.Name: Domri's Ambush
69642.FlavorText: "When civilization teeters on the brink, I'll be there to kick it the rest of the way."

69643.Name: Dovin's Veto
69643.FlavorText: "I see you've learned nothing, Chandra. You'd still put a match to something rather than understand it."

69645.Name: Elite Guardmage
69645.FlavorText:
"Be careful. You'll have more than Dovin to contend with if you hope to breach New Prahv."
—Lavinia, to Chandra Nalaar

69649.Name: Heartwarming Redemption
69649.FlavorText: Kytheon had known war every day of his life. Now he finally knew peace.

69650.Name: Huatli's Raptor
69650.FlavorText: The essence of Ixalan was never far from Huatli's heart.

69652.Name: Leyline Prowler
69652.FlavorText: It feeds on the dark energies that course through the deep world—and on any other creature lured by the leyline's pull.

69653.Name: Mayhem Devil
69653.FlavorText: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

69658.Name: Oath of Kaya
69658.FlavorText: "So everyone gets what they truly deserve, I will keep watch."

69659.Name: Pledge of Unity
69659.FlavorText:
"No one hero will save this day. Today we must all be heroes."
—Gideon Jura

69661.Name: Ral's Outburst
69661.FlavorText:
"Time to find the melting point of lazotep."
—Ral Zarek

69663.Name: Role Reversal
69663.FlavorText: Uthlon the Wise scandalized sphinx society, hooting the answers to riddles as he rampaged through Tin Street. Grangle, on the other hand, sat for hours, deep in thought, largely ignored by fellow goblins.

69664.Name: Rubblebelt Rioters
69664.FlavorText:
"If the system is broken, break the system."
—Domri Rade

69665.Name: Solar Blaze
69665.FlavorText:
"The primary weapon is nothing more than light. It shows them what they are, and they burn of their own accord."
—Aurelia

69667.Name: Soul Diviner
69667.FlavorText: As the Eternal's cold fingers tightened around his throat, Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

69668.Name: Storrev, Devkarin Lich
69668.FlavorText: In times of war, only death flourishes.

69671.Name: Tenth District Legionnaire
69671.FlavorText:
"The Tenth is under heavy attack, but it's being handled. I sent Mileva."
—Tajic

69672.Name: Time Wipe
69672.FlavorText:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

69676.Name: Tyrant's Scorn
69676.FlavorText:
"The hero with the magic sword slays the dragon? Not this time."
—Nicol Bolas

69688.Name: Firemind Vessel
69688.FlavorText: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

69689.Name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
69689.FlavorText: A dictator's infuriating smirk, an affront to everything Ravnica stood for.

69690.Name: Guild Globe
69690.FlavorText:
"Hopefully Ravnica will prove harder to break."
—Karn

69691.Name: Iron Bully
69691.FlavorText:
"Why would someone have built . . . wait, never mind. Send it to the front lines!"
—Commander Grozdan

69692.Name: Mana Geode
69692.FlavorText:
"I don't care if it's an all-powerful relic or a street vendor's lucky charm. If it brings you courage, wear it."
—Saheeli Rai

69693.Name: Prismite
69693.FlavorText: It didn't budge when the portal opened, nor when the ancient gods emerged. It came to life only when all ten guilds came together to face a common threat.

69694.Name: Saheeli's Silverwing
69694.FlavorText: "Track the source of those thopters," Saheeli told her creation. "And feel free to snack on as many as you want."

69695.Name: Emergence Zone
69695.FlavorText: The Planar Bridge opened over the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing the symbol of Ravnica's endurance to rubble.

69696.Name: Gateway Plaza
69696.FlavorText: Guild leaders focused their magic on the portal scar. Where the Chamber perished, a parun could be reborn.

69698.Name: Karn's Bastion
69698.FlavorText:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

69699.Name: Mobilized District
69699.FlavorText: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

69717.Name: Desperate Lunge
69717.FlavorText: Ravnica held its breath as the hero of the resistance—their last hope—flew through the sky, his dark sword ready to strike a god.

69718.Name: Gideon's Battle Cry
69718.FlavorText: "Break their formation! Thin their ranks! I'm right behind you!"

69720.Name: Orzhov Guildgate
69720.FlavorText:
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie."
—Kaya

69723.Name: Jace's Projection
69723.FlavorText: "Pardon me if I seem distracted. Part of me is reconnoitering the Tenth District."

69724.Name: Jace's Ruse
69724.FlavorText: "The Eternals can recognize faces. They just think I look like a blue minotaur."

69725.Name: Simic Guildgate
69725.FlavorText:
"Mystery is beauty. Within the unknown we plumb revelation."
—Vannifar

69743.Name: Voja, Friend to Elves
69743.RawFrameDetail: GW legendary token, no text box

69762.Name: Despark
69762.FlavorText: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

69763.Name: Invade the City
69763.FlavorText: Death greeted the world with a roar of desert air.

69764.Name: Living Twister
69764.FlavorText:
"The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!"
—Nikya of the Old Ways

69786.Name: Aerial Assault
69786.FlavorText:
"Oh, you must be mistaken. Hawks are solitary hunters, you see."
—Bunder Diedreck, ornithologist

69791.Name: Apostle of Purifying Light
69791.FlavorText: Waves of gloom crash in vain against his unyielding light.

69792.Name: Battalion Foot Soldier
69792.FlavorText: "With me! Break this line and the rest will fall!"

69793.Name: Bishop of Wings
69793.FlavorText: "Within every angel is a spirit of light that will fight as long as there is darkness."

69794.Name: Brought Back
69794.FlavorText:
"As long as your courage remains, your life will not falter."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

69796.Name: Dawning Angel
69796.FlavorText:
"As the sun rose behind the Bone Spire, an angel appeared over the charnel fields, bringing a surge of new hope."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire

69797.Name: Daybreak Chaplain
69797.FlavorText: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."

69798.Name: Devout Decree
69798.FlavorText:
"It is not punishment. I am simply making things as they should be."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

69799.Name: Disenchant
69799.FlavorText: Where the holy light of the angels has shone, only purity remains.

69800.Name: Eternal Isolation
69800.FlavorText: "Well, at least it's a lovely view."

69801.Name: Fencing Ace
69801.FlavorText: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

69805.Name: Griffin Protector
69805.FlavorText:
"Here is a companion who will never falter, no matter how desperate the battle!"
—Ajani Goldmane

69806.Name: Griffin Sentinel
69806.FlavorText: Once a griffin sentinel adopts a territory as its own, only death can force it to betray its post.

69808.Name: Herald of the Sun
69808.FlavorText: "Fear neither clouds nor darkness. The light shall overcome them all."

69809.Name: Inspired Charge
69809.FlavorText: "We are armed with light and steel. Who can stand against us?"

69810.Name: Inspiring Captain
69810.FlavorText: "Time to show the foe our true mettle."

69813.Name: Loyal Pegasus
69813.FlavorText:
"Even if I should die in the saddle, she will not let me fall to the ground."
—Hypatia of the Winged Horse

69814.Name: Master Splicer
69814.FlavorText: Phyrexian artificers remove the flesh they no longer need and use it to bring their unholy creations to a greater semblance of life.

69815.Name: Moment of Heroism
69815.FlavorText: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

69816.Name: Moorland Inquisitor
69816.FlavorText: Inquisitors are taught scripture, philosophy, and the fine art of sharpening an axe.

69817.Name: Pacifism
69817.FlavorText: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

69819.Name: Raise the Alarm
69819.FlavorText: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

69820.Name: Rule of Law
69820.FlavorText: The law is meant to ensure that people kill each other with only the utmost fairness.

69822.Name: Soulmender
69822.FlavorText: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

69823.Name: Squad Captain
69823.FlavorText: The strength of the one is the strength of the many.

69824.Name: Starfield Mystic
69824.FlavorText: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

69825.Name: Steadfast Sentry
69825.FlavorText: "Get up, slugabeds! We've got company, and they're not dressed for a party!"

69826.Name: Yoked Ox
69826.FlavorText: The courage of those who work the land is born of long days of labor in the hot summer sun and the cold winter wind. It is the courage of the earth itself.

69827.Name: Aether Gust
69827.FlavorText: The chill wind extinguishes flame, and frosts the leaf on the branch.

69828.Name: Agent of Treachery
69828.FlavorText: "The more secrets you have, the more easily you become my pawn."

69829.Name: Air Elemental
69829.FlavorText: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

69830.Name: Anticipate
69830.FlavorText: Divining the future is easy when you hold the power to sway it.

69832.Name: Befuddle
69832.FlavorText: The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still.

69833.Name: Bone to Ash
69833.FlavorText:
"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

69835.Name: Brineborn Cutthroat
69835.FlavorText: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

69838.Name: Cerulean Drake
69838.FlavorText: Dragons avoid the bright colors of its wings.

69839.Name: Cloudkin Seer
69839.FlavorText: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

69840.Name: Convolute
69840.FlavorText: "Let's see how badly you want what you came for!"

69841.Name: Drawn from Dreams
69841.FlavorText:
"From a sea of infinite possibilities, our choices create the future."
—Mu Yanling

69843.Name: Faerie Miscreant
69843.FlavorText: One faerie distracts the judge while a second steals the law.

69844.Name: Flood of Tears
69844.FlavorText:
"I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean."
—Mu Yanling

69845.Name: Fortress Crab
69845.FlavorText: Unbreakable and unappetizing, the crab grows uninterrupted, sometimes to the size of a cottage and beyond.

69846.Name: Frilled Sea Serpent
69846.FlavorText:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler

69847.Name: Frost Lynx
69847.FlavorText: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

69848.Name: Hard Cover
69848.FlavorText: A good book is a refuge, but a great book is a fortress.

69851.Name: Metropolis Sprite
69851.FlavorText: "Well, if that goblin didn't want his tongue pierced, he shouldn't have stuck it out at me."

69852.Name: Moat Piranhas
69852.FlavorText:
"Come on, it's not even that deep!"
—Gorin the Brazen

69854.Name: Negate
69854.FlavorText: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: ‘No.'"

69855.Name: Octoprophet
69855.FlavorText: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

69856.Name: Portal of Sanctuary
69856.FlavorText:
"If you need to disappear for a while, I know a place."
—Bilivus, master archivist

69858.Name: Sage's Row Denizen
69858.FlavorText: "Forget what you have learned from other teachers. I bring you the truth."

69859.Name: Scholar of the Ages
69859.FlavorText: "I study the past to find hope for the future."

69861.Name: Spectral Sailor
69861.FlavorText:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

69862.Name: Tale's End
69862.FlavorText:
"When you are gone, will anyone remember your story?"
—Unknown

69863.Name: Unsummon
69863.FlavorText:
"Don't you have somewhere else to be?"
—Sharuum the Hegemon

69864.Name: Warden of Evos Isle
69864.FlavorText: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

69865.Name: Winged Words
69865.FlavorText: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

69866.Name: Yarok's Wavecrasher
69866.FlavorText:
"Yarok's waters rush and rage
Where armies bled into the sand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 2

69867.Name: Zephyr Charge
69867.FlavorText:
"The knights charged forward on wings of wind, and the necromancer's horde roared in helpless rage."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire

69868.Name: Agonizing Syphon
69868.FlavorText:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

69869.Name: Audacious Thief
69869.FlavorText: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."

69870.Name: Barony Vampire
69870.FlavorText: "Poor little sun-dweller out past curfew. And to think, you might have survived if it wasn't so close to suppertime."

69871.Name: Bladebrand
69871.FlavorText: "One knife, two knives, three knives, four—which will drop you to the floor?"

69872.Name: Blightbeetle
69872.FlavorText: Leaf and soul alike wither at its touch.

69873.Name: Blood Burglar
69873.FlavorText:
"You've heard that a vampire can't enter a home without an invitation? A lie meant to help you sleep at night."
—Kerin, watch sergeant

69875.Name: Bloodsoaked Altar
69875.FlavorText: Blood seeps into the stone, and darkness emerges.

69876.Name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
69876.FlavorText: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

69877.Name: Bone Splinters
69877.FlavorText:
"I will make your bones into a weapon that will lay even the mighty low."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

69878.Name: Boneclad Necromancer
69878.FlavorText: "Living or dead, everyone responds to the proper motivation."

69880.Name: Disfigure
69880.FlavorText:
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure."
—Exdratha, bog witch

69881.Name: Dread Presence
69881.FlavorText: It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.

69884.Name: Epicure of Blood
69884.FlavorText: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

69885.Name: Fathom Fleet Cutthroat
69885.FlavorText: "It was a bad evening for you, mate. Now it's chow time for the sharks."

69886.Name: Feral Abomination
69886.FlavorText:
"If you manage to get to the heart of the bog, you'll find things there that make zombies seem downright lovable."
—Byaras, backwoods guide

69888.Name: Gravedigger
69888.FlavorText: In Amonkhet's ever-shifting sands, nothing stays buried for long.

69889.Name: Gruesome Scourger
69889.FlavorText: His whips twist and tremble like living things, moved by the fury of the horde he commands.

69891.Name: Legion's End
69891.FlavorText:
"With a single word, they were unmade."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire

69893.Name: Mind Rot
69893.FlavorText: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

69894.Name: Murder
69894.FlavorText:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

69895.Name: Noxious Grasp
69895.FlavorText:
"The bog doesn't give a stinking bubble about your title, wealth, or piety. It's just hungry."
—Byaras, backwoods guide

69896.Name: Rotting Regisaur
69896.FlavorText:
"Now, that's a zombie!"
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

69897.Name: Sanitarium Skeleton
69897.FlavorText: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

69898.Name: Scheming Symmetry
69898.FlavorText:
"One for you, one for me. What could be more fair?"
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

69899.Name: Sorcerer of the Fang
69899.FlavorText: "The Great Serpent slumbers now, but all warmbloods will grovel in the dirt at its awakening!"

69901.Name: Soul Salvage
69901.FlavorText: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

69902.Name: Thought Distortion
69902.FlavorText:
"The skull is rigid, but the mind is so deliciously supple."
—Eromena the Mind Render

69903.Name: Undead Servant
69903.FlavorText:
"There are always more like you."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

69904.Name: Unholy Indenture
69904.FlavorText:
"Don't think of it as selling your soul. It's more like you're bequeathing it to me."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

69905.Name: Vampire of the Dire Moon
69905.FlavorText: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."

69906.Name: Vengeful Warchief
69906.FlavorText: "Try to steal from me and I'll add your skull to my collection."

69907.Name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
69907.FlavorText: "You can sign, or you can spend your life imagining what might have been yours."

69908.Name: Yarok's Fenlurker
69908.FlavorText:
"Yarok's nightmares lurk and wait
Where dark despair is near at hand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 3

69909.Name: Act of Treason
69909.FlavorText: She learned a tragic lesson that day: even the purest can be corrupted when the heart's emotions are twisted.

69915.Name: Chandra's Outrage
69915.FlavorText:
"There's plenty of fire to go around."
—Chandra Nalaar
