69917.Name: Chandra's Spitfire
69917.FlavorText: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

69919.Name: Destructive Digger
69919.FlavorText: "I love digging. It gives me lots of time to think about how much I love digging."

69920.Name: Dragon Mage
69920.FlavorText:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words

69921.Name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
69921.FlavorText:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

69922.Name: Ember Hauler
69922.FlavorText: Not every job in the goblin army is glamorous. Actually, no job in the goblin army is glamorous.

69923.Name: Fire Elemental
69923.FlavorText:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

69924.Name: Flame Sweep
69924.FlavorText:
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—"
—Thaedus the Clever, last words

69925.Name: Fry
69925.FlavorText:
"I'm afraid your dinner got a little . . . overcooked."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper

69927.Name: Goblin Bird-Grabber
69927.FlavorText: "I opens my mouth to catches the bugs!"

69929.Name: Goblin Smuggler
69929.FlavorText: "I am but a humble traveler. I have no taste for sneakery nor thiefiness."

69930.Name: Infuriate
69930.FlavorText:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign

69931.Name: Keldon Raider
69931.FlavorText: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

69932.Name: Lavakin Brawler
69932.FlavorText: She swings with the ease of flowing lava and hits with the force of a meteor.

69934.Name: Maniacal Rage
69934.FlavorText: Rage is the culmination of an accelerating cycle of anger and violence that feeds itself in battle, spreading like a flame from one warrior to another.

69935.Name: Marauding Raptor
69935.FlavorText:
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!"
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

69937.Name: Pack Mastiff
69937.FlavorText: Their loyalty is not to any master, but to the pack.

69938.Name: Rapacious Dragon
69938.FlavorText:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

69940.Name: Reduce to Ashes
69940.FlavorText:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator

69941.Name: Repeated Reverberation
69941.FlavorText: It's in the nature of fire to grow.

69942.Name: Ripscale Predator
69942.FlavorText: Dinosaurs rarely understand the idea of boundaries between the wild and the urban landscape.

69943.Name: Scampering Scorcher
69943.FlavorText:
"Keep your flammables out of reach."
—Kerin, watch sergeant

69944.Name: Scorch Spitter
69944.FlavorText:
"Yes, she can be a nuisance. But at least my tea never gets cold."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper

69945.Name: Shock
69945.FlavorText: "I love this thing! It's my best invention since the boulderfist gauntlet!"

69946.Name: Tectonic Rift
69946.FlavorText:
"You will kneel before me, even if I have to split the earth under your feet!"
—Ash Kronor, Keldon warlord

69948.Name: Uncaged Fury
69948.FlavorText: The cage is a crucible for the rage that builds inside, refining it into something pure and terrible.

69949.Name: Unchained Berserker
69949.FlavorText: Sathros turned his restraints to revenge.

69951.Name: Brightwood Tracker
69951.FlavorText: "Many have walked here, but there is only one trail I seek."

69953.Name: Centaur Courser
69953.FlavorText:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

69955.Name: Feral Invocation
69955.FlavorText: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

69956.Name: Ferocious Pup
69956.FlavorText: The strongest pack has the fiercest pups.

69959.Name: Greenwood Sentinel
69959.FlavorText: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

69960.Name: Growth Cycle
69960.FlavorText:
"Shed your faded husk! Emerge sleeker and stronger!"
—Tyris, fauna shaman

69961.Name: Healer of the Glade
69961.FlavorText:
"Grief and rage and nightmares fade
Where hope and comfort make their stand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 4

69962.Name: Howling Giant
69962.FlavorText: He and his pack sing the same mournful song to the moon.

69963.Name: Leafkin Druid
69963.FlavorText: "I am rooted in the life of all that thrives around me. You cannot move me."

69965.Name: Loaming Shaman
69965.FlavorText:
"The living don't ever stay living, and the dead don't always stay dead."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

69966.Name: Mammoth Spider
69966.FlavorText:
"If a careless elf ends up caught in a spider's web, we must expect nature to take its course. Do not blame the spider for being a spider."
—Dellin Berting, Tolarian entomologist

69967.Name: Might of the Masses
69967.FlavorText: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

69968.Name: Natural End
69968.FlavorText: The haunted blade shattered, and the geist drifted gratefully to the Blessed Sleep.

69969.Name: Netcaster Spider
69969.FlavorText: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

69970.Name: Nightpack Ambusher
69970.FlavorText: A strong leader means a growing pack.

69971.Name: Overcome
69971.FlavorText:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

69973.Name: Plummet
69973.FlavorText:
"Even the pterodon, who chases the clouds from its skies, must bow to the great forest below."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

69974.Name: Pulse of Murasa
69974.FlavorText: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

69975.Name: Rabid Bite
69975.FlavorText:
"You should have seen the look on both their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

69976.Name: Season of Growth
69976.FlavorText: "Awake, and lift your faces to the sun."

69977.Name: Sedge Scorpion
69977.FlavorText:
Thakolides the Mighty
Slayer of minotaurs
Vanquisher of giants
Killed by a scorpion
—Inscription on an Akroan grave

69978.Name: Shared Summons
69978.FlavorText:
"In times of need, the forest creates its own protectors."
—Vivien Reid

69980.Name: Silverback Shaman
69980.FlavorText: The apes of Yavimaya draw strength from the spirits of their ancestors.

69981.Name: Thicket Crasher
69981.FlavorText:
"Tread too hard in the forest and it will tread on you in return."
—Vivien Reid

69982.Name: Thrashing Brontodon
69982.FlavorText: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

69986.Name: Vorstclaw
69986.FlavorText: Roots reach deep, and sometimes they tap into things better left undisturbed.

69987.Name: Wakeroot Elemental
69987.FlavorText:
"When the forest walks, it's too late to run."
—Horent, Khalni druid

69990.Name: Woodland Champion
69990.FlavorText: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

69991.Name: Corpse Knight
69991.FlavorText:
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire

69992.Name: Creeping Trailblazer
69992.FlavorText: The destruction of a wildfire with the tenacity of a jungle vine.

69993.Name: Empyrean Eagle
69993.FlavorText: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

69994.Name: Ironroot Warlord
69994.FlavorText:
"Alone, it's a fortification. At the head of its troops, it's a battering ram."
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

69996.Name: Kethis, the Hidden Hand
69996.FlavorText: "The pen is mightier than the crown."

69997.Name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
69997.FlavorText: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

69998.Name: Lightning Stormkin
69998.FlavorText: "I strike in the same place as many times as necessary."

69999.Name: Moldervine Reclamation
69999.FlavorText:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

70000.Name: Ogre Siegebreaker
70000.FlavorText:
"What he doesn't burn, he smashes."
—Captain Wellis, ogre wrangler

70002.Name: Risen Reef
70002.FlavorText:
"No, not ‘washed' ashore. It walked ashore."
—Shafring Hulm, beachcomber

70005.Name: Yarok, the Desecrated
70005.FlavorText:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 1

70006.Name: Anvilwrought Raptor
70006.FlavorText:
"I know its lightness, for I have seen it fly. I know its weight, for I have seen it strike."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

70008.Name: Colossus Hammer
70008.FlavorText: "There's only one way to be sure it's really dead."

70010.Name: Diviner's Lockbox
70010.FlavorText:
"I see it taunting me whenever I close my eyes."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

70012.Name: Grafdigger's Cage
70012.FlavorText:
"Best bury them right. We don't want any gruesome encores."
—Constable Trosk

70015.Name: Manifold Key
70015.FlavorText:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

70016.Name: Marauder's Axe
70016.FlavorText: A sharp axe solves most problems.

70017.Name: Meteor Golem
70017.FlavorText: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

70019.Name: Pattern Matcher
70019.FlavorText:
"Good! Now put it with the other widdle bunnies."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

70020.Name: Prismite
70020.FlavorText: Even its shadow is a dazzling rainbow.

70021.Name: Retributive Wand
70021.FlavorText:
"The last blast is the biggest."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

70022.Name: Salvager of Ruin
70022.FlavorText:
"The next model should be able to achieve a rescue without self-destruction."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

70023.Name: Scuttlemutt
70023.FlavorText: With five lenses on its "head," it sees the world in a range of colors beyond ordinary perception.

70024.Name: Steel Overseer
70024.FlavorText:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

70025.Name: Stone Golem
70025.FlavorText: The sculptor, like most artists, put his heart and soul into his work. But the newly awakened golem decided it wanted its creator's other, more tangible parts.

70026.Name: Vial of Dragonfire
70026.FlavorText:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words

70029.Name: Cryptic Caves
70029.FlavorText: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

70031.Name: Evolving Wilds
70031.FlavorText: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

70068.Name: Savannah Sage
70068.FlavorText: "Now is not the time for your light to fade."

70071.Name: Celestial Messenger
70071.FlavorText:
"It soars on the winds of dreams."
—Mu Yanling

70072.Name: Waterkin Shaman
70072.FlavorText: "They come to drink, to bathe, and—I believe—to play."

70075.Name: Savage Gorger
70075.FlavorText: "I have no patience for sipping blood from crystal goblets. I want to bite and tear."

70076.Name: Sorin's Guide
70076.FlavorText: "My people serve the dragon Kolaghan, but I give my blood for a greater lord."

70077.Name: Thirsting Bloodlord
70077.FlavorText: "A whole life, full of memories and experience, love and sorrow, drained drop by drop into this bottle. Could any feast be more glorious?"

70080.Name: Pyroclastic Elemental
70080.FlavorText:
"Whoever thought of making mobile volcanoes was a genius."
—Chandra Nalaar

70081.Name: Wildfire Elemental
70081.FlavorText:
"Fire is always dancing, leaping and whirling, seeking more fuel. It never rests, so why should I?"
—Chandra Nalaar

70084.Name: Gnarlback Rhino
70084.FlavorText:
"I think it's trying to tell us that the forest is angry."
—Vivien Reid

70085.Name: Vivien's Crocodile
70085.FlavorText:
"Regardless of where they come from, crocs are usually able to find their way home. For this one, home is me."
—Vivien Reid

70087.Name: Bastion Enforcer
70087.FlavorText: Headquartered at the Bastion of the Honorable, the soldiers of Ghirapur are charged with the task of keeping peace in the city.

70088.Name: Concordia Pegasus
70088.FlavorText: In the cloudy skies and dim light of autumn, a flash of white wings is a reminder that better times lie ahead.

70089.Name: Haazda Officer
70089.FlavorText: "You two, cover the alley! You, with me! Eyes on windows, balconies, and rooftops. Who knows what a fish-octopus-crab can do!"

70090.Name: Impassioned Orator
70090.FlavorText: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.

70091.Name: Imperial Outrider
70091.FlavorText: Her mount's hollow crest can produce a trumpeting warning that carries for miles, summoning more knights to her aid.

70092.Name: Ironclad Krovod
70092.FlavorText:
"We need to block the exits from the plaza! What's big, heavy, and available?"
—Gideon Jura

70093.Name: Prowling Caracal
70093.FlavorText: A hunter in the city requires the utmost cunning to survive. It must pounce only if the kill is certain, and leave the remains where no one will see.

70094.Name: Serra's Guardian
70094.FlavorText: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.

70095.Name: Show of Valor
70095.FlavorText:
"As the knight struggled to stand, his squire took up his blade. The foe advanced not a single step."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire

70096.Name: Siege Mastodon
70096.FlavorText:
"The walls of the wicked will fall before us. Ready the siege engines. We proceed to war!"
—General Avitora

70097.Name: Take Vengeance
70097.FlavorText: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."

70099.Name: Coral Merfolk
70099.FlavorText: The merfolk know every contour of their coral homes; each reef is a garden in times of peace, and a refuge and fortress in times of war.

70100.Name: Phantom Warrior
70100.FlavorText:
"Only when I saw my enemy walk through all my defenses, untouchable as the moon in the sky, did I truly know what it is to be afraid."
—King Ixes

70101.Name: Riddlemaster Sphinx
70101.FlavorText: "Safe passage requires only a simple answer to a simple question, traveler."

70102.Name: Snapping Drake
70102.FlavorText: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

70103.Name: Bartizan Bats
70103.FlavorText: At night, bats will feast on whatever is drawn to lanterns and streetlights.

70104.Name: Bogstomper
70104.FlavorText:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

70105.Name: Dark Remedy
70105.FlavorText:
"Writhing tendrils of darkness stitched him back together. Though his will and body both were broken, the necromancer's magic would not let him rest."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire

70106.Name: Disentomb
70106.FlavorText:
"If we've run out of warm bodies, then cold bodies will have to do."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

70107.Name: Gravewaker
70107.FlavorText: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

70108.Name: Skeleton Archer
70108.FlavorText:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

70109.Name: Sorin's Thirst
70109.FlavorText: "All your steel won't protect you if your will is weak."

70111.Name: Walking Corpse
70111.FlavorText:
"What does it mean when the dead feed on the dead? When no new life emerges, but only more death? Is it not an endless spiral into annihilation?"
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

70112.Name: Engulfing Eruption
70112.FlavorText:
"Compared to the hunger of the fires within the earth, the appetite of a mere wurm is nothing."
—Phelgis Ojin, Keral Keep acolyte

70113.Name: Fearless Halberdier
70113.FlavorText: "I spent some time in the Legion, but I'm done taking orders all day."

70114.Name: Goblin Assailant
70114.FlavorText: What he lacks in patience, intelligence, empathy, lucidity, hygiene, ability to follow orders, self-regard, and discernible skills, he makes up for in sheer chaotic violence.

70115.Name: Hostile Minotaur
70115.FlavorText: The bellow of a minotaur always translates to "charge."

70116.Name: Immortal Phoenix
70116.FlavorText: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

70118.Name: Rubblebelt Recluse
70118.FlavorText: Joining a guild, even the Gruul, would mean giving up some of his independence. He'd rather smash what he wants to smash.

70119.Name: Shivan Dragon
70119.FlavorText:
"It's just playing with us, Marsden."
—Dafynne the Radiant, last words

70120.Name: Volcanic Dragon
70120.FlavorText:
"That's no ordinary eruption!"
—Grazlash Stonehold, last words

70121.Name: Aggressive Mammoth
70121.FlavorText:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

70122.Name: Bristling Boar
70122.FlavorText: The spikes of bone protruding from its hide serve primarily as protection, but as they accumulate bits of foliage from the surrounding forest, they also provide camouflage.

70123.Name: Canopy Spider
70123.FlavorText: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

70124.Name: Frilled Sandwalla
70124.FlavorText:
"Even the smallest creatures are fierce in defense of their own territory."
—Vivien Reid

70125.Name: Oakenform
70125.FlavorText:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

70126.Name: Prized Unicorn
70126.FlavorText:
"Friend and foe alike are irresistibly drawn to its beauty—the good, to their lasting reward, and the evil, to their brief and painful regret."
—Vivien Reid

70127.Name: Titanic Growth
70127.FlavorText: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

70128.Name: Woodland Mystic
70128.FlavorText: "I sing to the branches, and they reach to the sky. I sing to the leaves, and they open to the sun. I sing to the roots, and they dig their fingers deep. I sing the song that creation sung."

70149.Name: All That Glitters
70149.FlavorText: A faerie's glee at her trove quickly fades to contentment, then to boredom, then to an urge to steal more.

70151.Name: Ardenvale Paladin
70151.FlavorText: "Even when hope is but a small flame fighting the night, I will serve the absent king."

70152.Name: Ardenvale Tactician
70152.FlavorText: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.

70153.Name: Bartered Cow
70153.FlavorText: At the market, no one heeded Hilda's frantic mooing. The fae curse was turning out even worse than she had feared.

70154.Name: Beloved Princess
70154.FlavorText: Sometimes a gentle slipper can travel where an armored boot's been denied.

70157.Name: Deafening Silence
70157.FlavorText:
"They have forsaken their vows. The edict of the Circle demands their voices be silenced."
—Syr Tasdale, knight of Ardenvale

70158.Name: Faerie Guidemother
70158.FlavorText: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

70159.Name: Flutterfox
70159.FlavorText:
"The fox grinned. ‘How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—Tales of the Fae

70160.Name: Fortifying Provisions
70160.FlavorText: "To the king, to the Circle, and to the realm! And to not dying."

70161.Name: Giant Killer
70161.FlavorText: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

70162.Name: Glass Casket
70162.FlavorText: Fate will decide whether it's a bed or a tomb.

70165.Name: Hushbringer
70165.FlavorText: "Let's begin this conversation again, and this time you will only listen."

70166.Name: Knight of the Keep
70166.FlavorText: "What good is loyalty to the crown if we are not also in service to those less fortunate? I fight for all of us."

70167.Name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
70167.FlavorText: "Until my last breath, I will defend the realm."

70169.Name: Mysterious Pathlighter
70169.FlavorText: For good or ill, most fae can't resist meddling in the adventures of any knight they meet.

70170.Name: Outflank
70170.FlavorText:
"With the drum of hooves and a flash of blades, the monster's terrifying roar changed to a cry of fear."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights

70171.Name: Prized Griffin
70171.FlavorText:
"I wrote these tales with a quill made from a griffin's feather. And the winning of that feather is quite a tale itself."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

70172.Name: Rally for the Throne
70172.FlavorText:
"If you're as loyal as you claim, now is the time to show it."
—Queen Linden of Ardenvale

70174.Name: Righteousness
70174.FlavorText: Syr Damon looked at the dragon and saw the faces of every innocent it had devoured. Suddenly, his sword blazed like the sun.

70177.Name: Silverflame Ritual
70177.FlavorText: Tempered by fire and united in virtue, the knights of Ardenvale fight with a single, unbreakable will.

70178.Name: Silverflame Squire
70178.FlavorText: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

70179.Name: Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
70179.FlavorText: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."

70180.Name: Trapped in the Tower
70180.FlavorText: "At least up here I have some peace and quiet."

70181.Name: True Love's Kiss
70181.FlavorText:
"Be careful, dear. Some people deserve their curses."
—Marawen, barrow witch

70182.Name: Venerable Knight
70182.FlavorText: "May this blade guide you on your great journey, as it did me on mine."

70183.Name: Worthy Knight
70183.FlavorText: Every Ardenvale aspirant must step through the flame. Their honor determines whether they burn or shine.

70184.Name: Youthful Knight
70184.FlavorText:
"In the wilds, your true training will begin."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

70185.Name: Animating Faerie
70185.FlavorText: A true puppet master has no need for strings.

70188.Name: Corridor Monitor
70188.FlavorText: Castle Vantress has no locks on its doors, but interlopers rarely make it past the foyer.

70189.Name: Didn't Say Please
70189.FlavorText: "If you're in our home, we expect you to mind your manners."

70192.Name: Faerie Vandal
70192.FlavorText: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.

70194.Name: Frogify
70194.FlavorText: That gnat was still hovering by the venison, and now both looked delicious.

70195.Name: Gadwick, the Wizened
70195.FlavorText: His name is spoken only in whispers—but he hears just the same.

70197.Name: Into the Story
70197.FlavorText: The boundary between real and imaginary is as thin as the page, and just as easily torn.

70200.Name: Merfolk Secretkeeper
70200.FlavorText: Merfolk curiosity usually has dire consequences, but rarely for the merfolk.

70202.Name: Mirrormade
70202.FlavorText:
"Share your darkest secret and the Mirror will reveal your soul's essence."
—Ceri, royal mirrorkeeper

70203.Name: Mistford River Turtle
70203.FlavorText: The fae raised the turtle from a tiny hatchling. They taught it whom to ferry—and whom to drown.

70204.Name: Moonlit Scavengers
70204.FlavorText: They comb the shallows of Lochmere for relics of a bygone era. And if they happen upon a lone traveler, all the better.

70205.Name: Mystical Dispute
70205.FlavorText: "Poor, lost mage. Your feet are on land, yet you're in over your head, aren't you?"

70206.Name: Opt
70206.FlavorText:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

70209.Name: Run Away Together
70209.FlavorText:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

70210.Name: Sage of the Falls
70210.FlavorText: Ask a merfolk even a simple question and the answer is a journey far beyond the known.

70211.Name: So Tiny
70211.FlavorText: His sword sounded like a silver chime on the glass jar, and the sprite laughed with delight.

70212.Name: Steelgaze Griffin
70212.FlavorText:
"If we didn't guard our secrets, they wouldn't remain secrets for long."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

70213.Name: Stolen by the Fae
70213.FlavorText: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

70215.Name: Tome Raider
70215.FlavorText: "Humans are so forgetful. Every page I steal becomes a secret they can't remember."

70217.Name: Unexplained Vision
70217.FlavorText: Rowan and Will exchanged a baffled glance. Could the stag in the vision lead them to their father?

70219.Name: Vantress Paladin
70219.FlavorText: "Someone knows where the king is. They can't expect to keep it a secret from us."

70220.Name: Wishful Merfolk
70220.FlavorText: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.

70221.Name: Witching Well
70221.FlavorText: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

70222.Name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
70222.FlavorText: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

70223.Name: Bake into a Pie
70223.FlavorText: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

70224.Name: Barrow Witches
70224.FlavorText:
"Taste the sweetness, breath for breath.
Keep the balance, death for death."
—Barrow witch incantation

70225.Name: Belle of the Brawl
70225.FlavorText: Locthwain knights take pride in being the last ones standing in a fight or on a dance floor.

70226.Name: Blacklance Paragon
70226.FlavorText: The Blacklances travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years at a time, in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.

70227.Name: Bog Naughty
70227.FlavorText:
"The faerie plucked an acorn off the ground. One knight's quest was about to come to a bitter end."
—Tales of the Fae

70228.Name: Cauldron Familiar
70228.FlavorText: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

70232.Name: Epic Downfall
70232.FlavorText: The dragon had a lot of things going through his mind that day. He didn't expect a sword to be one of them.

70233.Name: Eye Collector
70233.FlavorText: "Lord Rankle will see you now—all he asks is a small token of tribute."

70234.Name: Festive Funeral
70234.FlavorText:
"Even as we mourn the last, we look to the next with joy. Hopefully, my new suitor will bring the Cauldron home."
—Ayara, First of Locthwain

70236.Name: Forever Young
70236.FlavorText: Those who say you only live once have never been touched by the Cauldron of Eternity.

70239.Name: Lash of Thorns
70239.FlavorText:
"Another angry mob? When will they learn to leave me be?"
—Terryn, Edgewall outcast

70240.Name: Locthwain Paladin
70240.FlavorText: "I will find the king if I have to ride from summer to winter and back again."

70241.Name: Lost Legion
70241.FlavorText: Even death cannot diminish the persistence of the knights of Locthwain.

70242.Name: Malevolent Noble
70242.FlavorText: He has slain a dozen witches, luring each with a promise of fresh children's bones.

70243.Name: Memory Theft
70243.FlavorText: In the wilds, the ravens steal far more than baubles.

70247.Name: Piper of the Swarm
70247.FlavorText: "If it has ears, it will dance to my tune."

70250.Name: Reave Soul
70250.FlavorText:
"Into amethyst, I pour
Envy's shadow, sorrow's gleam.
Lure the one whose scorn I bore
That I may hear one final scream."
—Barrow witch incantation

70251.Name: Revenge of Ravens
70251.FlavorText: Syr Tasdale declared that he never wanted to see the witch Ygretta again. Her familiars quickly granted his request.

70252.Name: Smitten Swordmaster
70252.FlavorText: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

70253.Name: Specter's Shriek
70253.FlavorText:
"Imagine having your skeleton extracted through your ear, one bone at a time."
—Corliss the Wanderer

70255.Name: Tempting Witch
70255.FlavorText:
"Murder clad in crimson beauty,
An end to life and love and duty."
—Barrow witch incantation

70256.Name: Wicked Guardian
70256.FlavorText: "Some are born to greatness. You were born to scrub greatness's floors."

70258.Name: Witch's Vengeance
70258.FlavorText: The hex swept through the village, its citizens falling one by one.

70259.Name: Barge In
70259.FlavorText: The giant had heard of locks, but he had yet to discover a door he couldn't open.

70260.Name: Bloodhaze Wolverine
70260.FlavorText:
"Build a moat. If we're lucky, it can't swim."
—Syr Branigan, knight of Ardenvale

70261.Name: Blow Your House Down
70261.FlavorText:
"You think these walls will protect you? My, you have a dim view of the power of the wilds."
—Marawen, barrow witch

70262.Name: Bonecrusher Giant
70262.FlavorText: Not every tale ends in glory.

70264.Name: Burning-Yard Trainer
70264.FlavorText: "For every scar I've received, I've given ten back."

70265.Name: Claim the Firstborn
70265.FlavorText:
"The deal was struck and the favor had been done. And so, under the cover of night, the debt was paid."
—Tales of the Fae

70266.Name: Crystal Slipper
70266.FlavorText:
"After the death of her mother, Cassia found that things that appear fragile can be very strong indeed."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70268.Name: Embereth Paladin
70268.FlavorText: "The king would die for the realm. I would not hesitate to do the same for him."

70269.Name: Embereth Shieldbreaker
70269.FlavorText: "Courage is the only shield I need."

70270.Name: Ferocity of the Wilds
70270.FlavorText: Knights who excel in tournaments sometimes underestimate threats beyond the realm.

70272.Name: Fires of Invention
70272.FlavorText: "Just tell us how many you want and get out of the way."

70273.Name: Fling
70273.FlavorText: Giants believe that tossing redcaps at knights is the best way to deal with both.

70274.Name: Irencrag Feat
70274.FlavorText: The greatest challenge isn't the stifling heat but the crushing weight of those who failed before.

70275.Name: Irencrag Pyromancer
70275.FlavorText: "Fear of fire is a sensible instinct. If I were you, I'd be terrified."

70276.Name: Joust
70276.FlavorText:
"Life is a tournament that rewards the bold."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth

70277.Name: Mad Ratter
70277.FlavorText: "Gather round and tell me all from the courts and castles."

70278.Name: Merchant of the Vale
70278.FlavorText: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

70279.Name: Ogre Errant
70279.FlavorText: Knights kept returning from Ogre's Pass wearing nothing but bruises, so they decided to just pretend it was on their side.

70281.Name: Raging Redcap
70281.FlavorText: Many tales of redcap terror begin with two simple things: bloodlust and stolen steel.

70282.Name: Redcap Melee
70282.FlavorText: At first, Syr Fenwick scoffed when he saw his opponents for the final match.

70283.Name: Redcap Raiders
70283.FlavorText:
"I admire their courage as much as I despise their savagery."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

70286.Name: Scorching Dragonfire
70286.FlavorText: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

70287.Name: Searing Barrage
70287.FlavorText: It emerged from the coldest depths of Lochmere only to face the fires of Irencrag.

70288.Name: Seven Dwarves
70288.FlavorText:
"The gleam of rubies and my brothers and sisters by my side . . . what more could I want?"
—Brognold the Third

70289.Name: Skullknocker Ogre
70289.FlavorText: The ogre crashed through the massive door. The winged folios scattered like frightened birds.

70290.Name: Slaying Fire
70290.FlavorText: The purest virtue burns brighter than the sun and hotter than dragonfire.

70292.Name: Syr Carah, the Bold
70292.FlavorText: "Duty and honor are reasons enough, but beating you will also be a pleasure."

70293.Name: Thrill of Possibility
70293.FlavorText:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

70294.Name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
70294.FlavorText: A dwarf's grudge runs deeper than the mountains' roots.

70295.Name: Weaselback Redcap
70295.FlavorText:
"I would rather cast myself into the abyss than let my blood stain the cap of those monsters."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

70297.Name: Curious Pair
70297.FlavorText: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

70298.Name: Edgewall Innkeeper
70298.FlavorText: "Warmth. Safety. A fully-stocked larder. You'll find nothing like Edgewall Keep in the wilds, I promise you that!"

70300.Name: Fell the Pheasant
70300.FlavorText:
"A keen eye and steady hand are essential for defeating most foes, including hunger."
—Syr Grenphire, knight of Garenbrig

70301.Name: Fierce Witchstalker
70301.FlavorText: While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.

70302.Name: Flaxen Intruder
70302.FlavorText: The middle blade was just right.

70303.Name: Garenbrig Carver
70303.FlavorText: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

70305.Name: Garenbrig Squire
70305.FlavorText:
"Find him a weapon as big as his dreams."
—Yorvo, lord of Garenbrig

70306.Name: Giant Opportunity
70306.FlavorText: They look tasty, but best to plant them.

70309.Name: Insatiable Appetite
70309.FlavorText: He ate them out of house and home and shed and barn and flock and herd.

70310.Name: Keeper of Fables
70310.FlavorText:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

70312.Name: Lovestruck Beast
70312.FlavorText: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

70314.Name: Oakhame Adversary
70314.FlavorText: The elves remember every secret path from the days when they ruled the realm.

70320.Name: Return to Nature
70320.FlavorText:
"Long after the magic wore off, the mice still dreamed of glorious galloping."
—Tales of the Fae

70321.Name: Rosethorn Acolyte
70321.FlavorText: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."

70323.Name: Sporecap Spider
70323.FlavorText: After years of taunts and aerial assaults from Rankle's minions, the witches of Maraleaf Forest acquired new familiars.

70324.Name: Syr Faren, the Hengehammer
70324.FlavorText: "Words are pointless. It's what you do with your hammer that counts."

70325.Name: Tall as a Beanstalk
70325.FlavorText: He realized a bit late that he was supposed to plant the magic beans.

70327.Name: Tuinvale Treefolk
70327.FlavorText: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

70330.Name: Wildwood Tracker
70330.FlavorText: "This one was wearing shoes made of glass. She'll be no ordinary prey."

70331.Name: Wolf's Quarry
70331.FlavorText:
"The monster was gaining on them. Twice it had found them. There was only one place left to hide."
—Tales of the Fae

70334.Name: Doom Foretold
70334.FlavorText: In the end, death usually has its way.

70336.Name: Escape to the Wilds
70336.FlavorText: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

70337.Name: Faeburrow Elder
70337.FlavorText: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.

70339.Name: Grumgully, the Generous
70339.FlavorText: "Does it matter what it is? Take it and be grateful!"

70340.Name: Improbable Alliance
70340.FlavorText:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie

70341.Name: Inspiring Veteran
70341.FlavorText: "I fight for my daughter, who may not set foot on a battlefield for many years. Remember who you fight for."

70343.Name: Maraleaf Pixie
70343.FlavorText: Neither hostile nor friendly, pixies flit through the forest seeking the treasures of the wilds.

70347.Name: Savvy Hunter
70347.FlavorText: None of the other villagers dare venture into the wilds, so she feeds the whole hamlet herself.

70349.Name: Steelclaw Lance
70349.FlavorText:
"A traditional lance is fine for the Burning Yard, but in the wilds you need a nastier bite."
—Kenver, Embereth weaponsmith

70350.Name: Stormfist Crusader
70350.FlavorText:
"As she reached the pinnacle, lightning flashed and her eyes blazed with newfound power."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights

70351.Name: Wandermare
70351.FlavorText:
"A good steed will carry you home. A great steed will carry you to glory."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

70355.Name: Deathless Knight
70355.FlavorText:
"Headed to the wilds? Beware the dead riders who serve the Shadow Queen."
—Scalan, Edgewall innkeeper

70356.Name: Elite Headhunter
70356.FlavorText: Nothing remains of his foes but the gripping story of their downfall.

70357.Name: Fireborn Knight
70357.FlavorText: He endured the white-hot blaze of the Circle and the sweltering heat of the Irencrag, and he emerged victorious.

70358.Name: Loch Dragon
70358.FlavorText: Despite its ferocity, its favor can be won with a gift of something it's never seen before.

70360.Name: Rampart Smasher
70360.FlavorText:
"He has strength and courage—just way, way too much of both."
—Syr Faren, the Hengehammer

70361.Name: Resolute Rider
70361.FlavorText: "Respect the wilds? Certainly. Fear them? No."

70362.Name: Thunderous Snapper
70362.FlavorText: While humans hear only a deafening roar, the fae hear music of breathtaking beauty.

70363.Name: Clockwork Servant
70363.FlavorText: Some are annoyed by the constant ticking as they clean the cobbles, but to the castle custodians, there's no sweeter sound.

70364.Name: Crashing Drawbridge
70364.FlavorText:
"The Northern Beacon flared, and even before the drawbridge finished its descent, the knights charged out."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights

70366.Name: Gingerbrute
70366.FlavorText: The unlabeled vial was not vanilla extract after all.

70368.Name: Henge Walker
70368.FlavorText: Everything that inhabits Garenbrig is affected by the wild magic flowing through the Great Henge.

70370.Name: Inquisitive Puppet
70370.FlavorText:
"The strings were gone, but he still felt the pull of invisible forces tugging at his mind."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70371.Name: Jousting Dummy
70371.FlavorText:
"Don't let it fool you. Many of us got our first scars from Syr Nobody."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth

70372.Name: Locthwain Gargoyle
70372.FlavorText:
"As the traitor hurried across the courtyard, its eyes snapped open. It was time to pay the queen a visit."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70373.Name: Lucky Clover
70373.FlavorText: Syr Branigan always remembered to kiss his good luck charm, having lost his foot to wolverines the last time he forgot.

70374.Name: Prophet of the Peak
70374.FlavorText: It frequently predicts imminent death by devouring.

70375.Name: Roving Keep
70375.FlavorText:
"It wandered slowly across the landscape, calling out in its lonely voice, but no other castles answered its cries."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70376.Name: Scalding Cauldron
70376.FlavorText: "It's a witch's trick, this cauldron full of pain. I wouldn't dump it on any but the wicked."

70377.Name: Shambling Suit
70377.FlavorText:
"The young squire gripped her sword as the clanking stranger emerged. It was no knight that had come to challenge her."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70378.Name: Signpost Scarecrow
70378.FlavorText:
"Accursed scarecrow! Sending folk in every direction is the same as sending them nowhere at all."
—Corliss the Wanderer

70379.Name: Sorcerer's Broom
70379.FlavorText:
"Reynald wished for an army to sweep away his enemies. The fae king smiled."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70381.Name: Spinning Wheel
70381.FlavorText:
"Though long forgotten, the wheel continued to turn, spinning fate from a dusty attic."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70382.Name: Stonecoil Serpent
70382.FlavorText: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

70383.Name: Weapon Rack
70383.FlavorText: No weapon stays on the rack for long in the Burning Yard.

70384.Name: Witch's Oven
70384.FlavorText: The wafting smells are both scrumptious and suspicious.

70385.Name: Castle Ardenvale
70385.FlavorText: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

70386.Name: Castle Embereth
70386.FlavorText: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

70387.Name: Castle Garenbrig
70387.FlavorText: Without Garenbrig's strength, the realm would succumb to the wilds.

70388.Name: Castle Locthwain
70388.FlavorText: Without Locthwain's persistence, the realm would stagnate and die.

70389.Name: Castle Vantress
70389.FlavorText: Without Vantress's knowledge, the realm would lose itself in darkness.

70391.Name: Fabled Passage
70391.FlavorText: From here, the path to anywhere may be found.

70395.Name: Tournament Grounds
70395.FlavorText: No one knows when the tournament began. All they know is that it will never end.

70418.Name: Garrison Griffin
70418.FlavorText: The keen-eyed guardians of Ardenvale are ever on alert.

70419.Name: Rowan's Battleguard
70419.FlavorText: "This sword is Sunrise. The other is Dawn. They mark the beginning of my days but the end of yours."

70423.Name: Oko's Accomplices
70423.FlavorText: They function as everything from assassins to jesters in the name of their fae king.

70424.Name: Bramblefort Fink
70424.FlavorText: No matter the cruelty of Oko's jokes, he's always guaranteed the sycophant's laughter.

70425.Name: Oko's Hospitality
70425.FlavorText:
"My advisors recommend I let them eat you."
—Oko

70449.Name: Faerie Formation
70449.FlavorText: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.

70450.Name: Shimmer Dragon
70450.FlavorText: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

70451.Name: Workshop Elders
70451.FlavorText:
"Fear not what's under the bed. The toys are watching."
—Beyond the Great Henge

70453.Name: Taste of Death
70453.FlavorText:
"Hone the knife and mourn the least.
Three chimes to sound the sweet, grim feast."
—Barrow witch incantation

70454.Name: Embereth Skyblazer
70454.FlavorText: "We fight with valor in our hearts and fire in our veins!"

70455.Name: Steelbane Hydra
70455.FlavorText: Many an ancient treasure has been reduced to jagged caltrops by its snapping jaws.

70456.Name: Thorn Mammoth
70456.FlavorText: It will come to the defense of all wild things, from the shivering wren to the towering giant.

70457.Name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
70457.FlavorText: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

70461.Name: Knights' Charge
70461.FlavorText:
"By hoof, wing, or paw. For the realm!"
—Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale

70462.Name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
70462.FlavorText: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

70463.Name: Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
70463.FlavorText: Squires throughout the realm aspire to her mix of panache and martial prowess.

70464.Name: Arcane Signet
70464.FlavorText: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

70466.Name: Command Tower
70466.FlavorText:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

70470.Name: Dizzying Swoop
70470.FlavorText: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.

70471.Name: Gift of the Fae
70471.FlavorText: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

70472.Name: Chop Down
70472.FlavorText: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

70476.Name: On Alert
70476.FlavorText: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

70477.Name: Bring to Life
70477.FlavorText: A true puppet master has no need for strings.

70481.Name: Venture Deeper
70481.FlavorText: Merfolk curiosity usually has dire consequences, but rarely for the merfolk.

70487.Name: Curry Favor
70487.FlavorText: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

70488.Name: Stomp
70488.FlavorText: Not every tale ends in glory.

70489.Name: Battle Display
70489.FlavorText: "Courage is the only shield I need."

70490.Name: Haggle
70490.FlavorText: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

70493.Name: Treats to Share
70493.FlavorText: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

70494.Name: Welcome Home
70494.FlavorText: The middle blade was just right.

70495.Name: Shield's Might
70495.FlavorText: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

70496.Name: Heart's Desire
70496.FlavorText: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

70497.Name: Seasonal Ritual
70497.FlavorText: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."

70498.Name: Oaken Boon
70498.FlavorText: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

70512.Name: Alseid of Life's Bounty
70512.FlavorText:
"Dawn-kissed, he nourishes the golden grain."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

70513.Name: Archon of Falling Stars
70513.FlavorText:
"The archon fell like a star from the sky, meeting the rising sun at the horizon's edge."
—The Cosmogony

70515.Name: Banishing Light
70515.FlavorText:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—The Theriad

70517.Name: Captivating Unicorn
70517.FlavorText:
"Gazing at the unicorn, I felt closer to the majesty of Nyx than I ever had before."
—Oineus, traveling merchant

70518.Name: Commanding Presence
70518.FlavorText: "In every one of you I see a hero's heart."

70519.Name: Dawn Evangel
70519.FlavorText: Is there a greater promise than the glory of the sunrise?

70522.Name: Dreadful Apathy
70522.FlavorText: Those whose lives were uninspired are doomed to the wretched tedium of Phylias in death.

70523.Name: Eidolon of Obstruction
70523.FlavorText: Death turned admirable conviction into pointless intransigence.

70526.Name: Favored of Iroas
70526.FlavorText: "The promise of victory fills my heart. There is no room for fear."

70527.Name: Flicker of Fate
70527.FlavorText: An infinite journey in an infinitesimal time.

70528.Name: Glory Bearers
70528.FlavorText: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

70530.Name: Heliod's Intervention
70530.FlavorText: "I bring a dawn that no night can follow."

70533.Name: Hero of the Pride
70533.FlavorText: Leonin fight for neither god nor polis; their loyalty is to their pride.

70534.Name: Hero of the Winds
70534.FlavorText: To tame a griffin is to ride into legend.

70536.Name: Indomitable Will
70536.FlavorText:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas

70538.Name: Lagonna-Band Storyteller
70538.FlavorText: "Our stories are full of ancient wisdom; they tell us who we are."

70539.Name: Leonin of the Lost Pride
70539.FlavorText: Leonin band together in the Underworld, taking solace in their strength until, at last, both pride and self are forgotten.

70540.Name: Nyxborn Courser
70540.FlavorText:
"Storms drove them westward to Ketaphos;
 wide plains shimmered in starlight.
Centaurs greeted them, offering
 gold-hued apples and grain-cakes."
—The Callapheia

70541.Name: Omen of the Sun
70541.FlavorText: "My time will come, when every soul will bask in my glory and obey my law."

70542.Name: Phalanx Tactics
70542.FlavorText: Every soldier has a place to stand and a role to play.

70543.Name: Pious Wayfarer
70543.FlavorText: Every footstep is a prayer, every road a temple.

70544.Name: Reverent Hoplite
70544.FlavorText: "Zeal is the sharpest blade, and piety the strongest shield."

70545.Name: Revoke Existence
70545.FlavorText:
"The time has come for us to throw off the chains of tyrannical gods and antiquated superstitions."
—Tikaia, disciple of Uremides

70546.Name: Rumbling Sentry
70546.FlavorText:
"To provoke the mountain is to invite the avalanche."
—Perisophia the philosopher

70548.Name: Shatter the Sky
70548.FlavorText: When the gods go to war, mortals pay the highest price.

70549.Name: Sunmane Pegasus
70549.FlavorText: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

70550.Name: Taranika, Akroan Veteran
70550.FlavorText: "I like to think Kytheon keeps watch over all of us."

70551.Name: Transcendent Envoy
70551.FlavorText:
"The first griffins were made by the gods to capture falling stars; they were given the keenest eyes and the swiftest wings, and sent to keep watch above the clouds."
—The Cosmogony

70552.Name: Triumphant Surge
70552.FlavorText: Not even death can quench a hero's inner fire.

70553.Name: Alirios, Enraptured
70553.FlavorText: "Why would I ever want to look away?"

70555.Name: Brine Giant
70555.FlavorText: The oracles of Meletis foresaw neither its rise from the depths nor the destruction it would leave in its wake.

70557.Name: Chain to Memory
70557.FlavorText: Those who do not learn from their mistakes are bound to relive them.

70558.Name: Deny the Divine
70558.FlavorText:
"A great wave crashed, and a mighty wind blew out the stars."
—The Cosmogony

70559.Name: Eidolon of Philosophy
70559.FlavorText: "And what did Erekastos teach us is the nature of the soul?"

70560.Name: Elite Instructor
70560.FlavorText: The greatest minds in Meletis study under the masters at the Dekatia, a renowned school of magic and philosophy.

70561.Name: Glimpse of Freedom
70561.FlavorText:
"Freedom lies in accepting a single path."
—Nyklos, Meletian philosopher

70562.Name: Ichthyomorphosis
70562.FlavorText: Tycthis's military career was a flop.

70565.Name: Memory Drain
70565.FlavorText: Alythos sat and stared blankly out over the glassy oceans of Nerono, trying in vain to remember what he knew he had forgotten.

70567.Name: Naiad of Hidden Coves
70567.FlavorText:
"Wave-borne, he watches over secrets of the shore."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

70568.Name: Nyxborn Seaguard
70568.FlavorText:
"Storm-tossed and broken, Callaphe
 cried out to deep-dwelling Thassa.
Tritons came swiftly to save her,
 bringing her north to the Lindus."
—The Callapheia

70569.Name: Omen of the Sea
70569.FlavorText: "My time will come, when the rising tide will surge above the tallest mountain."

70570.Name: One with the Stars
70570.FlavorText:
"Take your place among the stars."
—Kruphix, god of horizons

70571.Name: Protean Thaumaturge
70571.FlavorText: "Once you see past the veil we call ʻreality,' altering your own shape is elementary."

70572.Name: Riptide Turtle
70572.FlavorText:
"As the storm waves crushed my sailors, I cried out to Thassa. The next time I saw them, hard shells encased them, and they swam away to safety."
—Siona, captain of the Pyleas

70573.Name: Sage of Mysteries
70573.FlavorText: "I see destruction, suffering, and one tormented glimmer of hope."

70574.Name: Sea God's Scorn
70574.FlavorText: Instead of performing their daily devotions, Heliod's acolytes spent the morning picking strands of kelp off the altar.

70575.Name: Shimmerwing Chimera
70575.FlavorText: It swims upon the winds and soars through the waves.

70576.Name: Shoal Kraken
70576.FlavorText: It eats the things that eat the things that are drawn to the light.

70577.Name: Sleep of the Dead
70577.FlavorText: Normally, a cerberus sleeps one head at a time.

70579.Name: Stern Dismissal
70579.FlavorText: Cities offer tribute to Ephara and carve her image into their walls, imploring her to protect them from the dangers of the wild.

70581.Name: Sweet Oblivion
70581.FlavorText: When memory is torment, oblivion is bliss.

70583.Name: Thassa's Intervention
70583.FlavorText: "I bring a flood that nothing can withstand."

70585.Name: Thirst for Meaning
70585.FlavorText: A sip of recollection, an ocean of regrets.

70587.Name: Thryx, the Sudden Storm
70587.FlavorText: Even in their mountain fortresses, the Akroans have learned not to anger Thassa.

70588.Name: Towering-Wave Mystic
70588.FlavorText: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

70589.Name: Triton Waverider
70589.FlavorText: "You can no more stop me than you can halt the tide."

70590.Name: Vexing Gull
70590.FlavorText:
"May the skies be clear of gales and gulls."
—Meletian prayer

70591.Name: Wavebreak Hippocamp
70591.FlavorText: Tritons search for omens in its wake.

70593.Name: Witness of Tomorrows
70593.FlavorText: "As the future slips its way into the present, it ceases to be my concern."

70594.Name: Agonizing Remorse
70594.FlavorText: The sharp memory of Daxos's death stabbed into Elspeth's soul.

70595.Name: Aphemia, the Cacophony
70595.FlavorText:
"Sing, beauty. Sing for death, and for the dead."
—Ashiok

70596.Name: Aspect of Lamprey
70596.FlavorText: "Some aspire to be mighty like the lion or the hydra. I am the parasite that feeds on them all."

70597.Name: Blight-Breath Catoblepas
70597.FlavorText: Wherever it walks, famine follows behind.

70598.Name: Cling to Dust
70598.FlavorText: In bleak Tizerus, all hope crumbles in your grasp.

70600.Name: Drag to the Underworld
70600.FlavorText: The more you struggle against death, the tighter its grip becomes.

70601.Name: Eat to Extinction
70601.FlavorText:
"Kroxa devours what he may—not for sustenance or pleasure, but because it is his nature. He is unending hunger given form."
—Klothys, god of destiny

70603.Name: Enemy of Enlightenment
70603.FlavorText:
"Evil flourishes where ignorance thrives."
—Perisophia the philosopher

70605.Name: Erebos's Intervention
70605.FlavorText: "I bring a death none can escape."

70606.Name: Final Death
70606.FlavorText: The Underworld erodes memory, identity, and eventually the physical form, leaving only crumbling statues called misera—hollow monuments to mortal futility.

70607.Name: Fruit of Tizerus
70607.FlavorText: One spiny tree with bitter fruit grows in the realm of Tizerus, outside the palace of Erebos.

70608.Name: Funeral Rites
70608.FlavorText: Funerary masks help the newly dead resist the erosion of memory and identity in the Underworld.

70611.Name: Grim Physician
70611.FlavorText: The Returned retain no memory of their identities, but sometimes they mindlessly attempt familiar tasks.

70612.Name: Hateful Eidolon
70612.FlavorText: From the echoes of a violent life, a terrible foe is born.

70613.Name: Inevitable End
70613.FlavorText:
"How many more will die before you accept your fate?"
—Erebos, god of the dead

70614.Name: Lampad of Death's Vigil
70614.FlavorText:
"Grief-struck, she weeps for each mortal's final death."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

70615.Name: Minion's Return
70615.FlavorText: As a mortal, Phenax was the first to escape the Underworld. As a god, he brings his pawns along the same dark path.

70616.Name: Mire Triton
70616.FlavorText: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

70617.Name: Mire's Grasp
70617.FlavorText: Those caught attempting to escape the Underworld spend the rest of their existence trapped in the Mire of Punishment.

70618.Name: Mogis's Favor
70618.FlavorText: Rage-crowned Mogis swiftly rewards the virtue of brutality.

70620.Name: Nyxborn Marauder
70620.FlavorText:
"Callaphe guided them into the
 darkness of Hetos, the bleak mire;
Blood-horned minotaurs circled them,
 axes aglimmer in shadow."
—The Callapheia

70621.Name: Omen of the Dead
70621.FlavorText: "My time will come, when life's frantic striving will fade into the boundless quiet of death."

70622.Name: Pharika's Libation
70622.FlavorText: "If you will not pour your drink out for me, I shall pour mine out for you."

70624.Name: Rage-Scarred Berserker
70624.FlavorText: The fury of the slaughter god Mogis burns within him.

70625.Name: Scavenging Harpy
70625.FlavorText: Desecrating the dead is a convenient way for harpies to expand their foul collections.

70626.Name: Soulreaper of Mogis
70626.FlavorText: "We offer to Mogis the blood of the weak, and in return he makes us strong."

70627.Name: Temple Thief
70627.FlavorText: "I don't know if the gods watch over their temples, but I figure it's best to be stealthy just in case."

70628.Name: Treacherous Blessing
70628.FlavorText: Phenax is generous with gifts and unforgiving of debts.

70632.Name: Underworld Dreams
70632.FlavorText: Dreams are just one more form of torment.

70633.Name: Venomous Hierophant
70633.FlavorText: "Many have sought snake-twined Pharika's panacea. Do you wish to share their fate?"

70637.Name: Arena Trickster
70637.FlavorText: "It's not enough to surprise your opponent. You have to delight the crowd as well."

70639.Name: Blood Aspirant
70639.FlavorText: It's a small step from revel to bloodbath.

70640.Name: Careless Celebrant
70640.FlavorText:
"Renata was mesmerized by the satyr's dance of gleeful indifference, of reckless grace and bright disaster."
—Luphea of Setessa, Histories

70641.Name: Dreamshaper Shaman
70641.FlavorText: Magic is the true artist's medium.

70642.Name: Dreamstalker Manticore
70642.FlavorText: Purphoros forged the manticore's tail from bronze, its teeth from silver, and its heart from hate.

70643.Name: Escape Velocity
70643.FlavorText: "Not even death can catch me now!"

70644.Name: Fateful End
70644.FlavorText:
"Everything will be put back in its proper place."
—Klothys, god of destiny

70645.Name: Final Flare
70645.FlavorText: Those who fought without honor in life are taken to Agonas and doomed to fight forever in its arenas.

70646.Name: Flummoxed Cyclops
70646.FlavorText:
"A cyclops thinks slowly but strikes quickly. Try to keep it thinking."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

70647.Name: Furious Rise
70647.FlavorText: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

70648.Name: Hero of the Games
70648.FlavorText: Winners of the Iroan Games are forever remembered as heroes of their people.

70649.Name: Heroes of the Revel
70649.FlavorText: Brashness is close enough to bravery.

70650.Name: Impending Doom
70650.FlavorText: "Feast, for your next meal may be your last!"

70651.Name: Incendiary Oracle
70651.FlavorText: The flamespeakers of Akros live passionately, devoted to Purphoros and the cycle of destructive creation.

70652.Name: Infuriate
70652.FlavorText:
"Renata launched a dozen arrows into the minotaur's thick hide, but the monster didn't slow its charge. The fury of Mogis was upon it."
—Luphea of Setessa, Histories

70653.Name: Iroas's Blessing
70653.FlavorText: The blessing is not the strength itself, but the knowledge of how to use it.

70654.Name: Irreverent Revelers
70654.FlavorText: To some satyrs, only blasphemy is sacred.

70655.Name: Nyxborn Brute
70655.FlavorText:
"One-eyed and frightful, the cyclops
 lifted a boulder and hurled it
seaward from cliff's edge, shattering
 masts and scattering sailors."
—The Callapheia

70656.Name: Omen of the Forge
70656.FlavorText: "My time will come, when all the world will be reforged in the fires of my invention."

70657.Name: Oread of Mountain's Blaze
70657.FlavorText:
"Flame-wrapped, she dances a burning swath amid the clouds."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

70660.Name: Portent of Betrayal
70660.FlavorText: Mogis can fan a small flame of resentment into an inferno of madness.

70662.Name: Purphoros's Intervention
70662.FlavorText: "I bring a fire to recast all the world."

70663.Name: Satyr's Cunning
70663.FlavorText: It's hard to keep a satyr down, even in the Underworld.

70665.Name: Skophos Warleader
70665.FlavorText: The minotaur polis of Skophos boasts grand temples to the god of slaughter.

70666.Name: Stampede Rider
70666.FlavorText: To a satyr, a stampede is just another kind of revelry.

70668.Name: Storm's Wrath
70668.FlavorText: Distant thunder rumbled, a dread forewarning of Keranos's displeasure.

70670.Name: Thrill of Possibility
70670.FlavorText: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."

70673.Name: Underworld Fires
70673.FlavorText: The Underworld is anything but a resting place.

70675.Name: Wrap in Flames
70675.FlavorText: Bright flames quell the darkest nightmares.

70676.Name: Arasta of the Endless Web
70676.FlavorText: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

70680.Name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
70680.FlavorText:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

70682.Name: Gift of Strength
70682.FlavorText: The Nessian Wood is never without defenders.

70684.Name: Hyrax Tower Scout
70684.FlavorText: The scouts of Hyrax Tower keep watch at the edge of Setessan territory, protecting the polis from inhuman monsters and enemy armies.

70685.Name: Ilysian Caryatid
70685.FlavorText: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.

70686.Name: Inspire Awe
70686.FlavorText: Nylea appeared amid the howl of a hundred beasts.

70687.Name: Klothys's Design
70687.FlavorText: The god of destiny grants her followers vision deeper than sight.

70688.Name: Loathsome Chimera
70688.FlavorText:
"I see . . . elk? And lion? And . . . teeth! A lot of teeth!"
—Teraklos of Meletis

70689.Name: Mantle of the Wolf
70689.FlavorText:
"Be fearless, for a furious rebirth awaits you."
—Nylea, god of the hunt

70690.Name: Moss Viper
70690.FlavorText: Nylea watches over all the creatures of the forest except for the snakes. Blessed by Pharika, they can take care of themselves.

70691.Name: Mystic Repeal
70691.FlavorText:
"No power is too great to be undone."
—Karametra, god of harvests

70692.Name: Nessian Boar
70692.FlavorText: Renata led the best hunters in all of Theros on a quest to bring down the terror of the Setessan wilds.

70693.Name: Nessian Hornbeetle
70693.FlavorText:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

70695.Name: Nexus Wardens
70695.FlavorText: The Summer Nexus is a holy grove in Setessa where the starfields of Nyx glitter in the shadows.

70697.Name: Nylea's Forerunner
70697.FlavorText: Where its feet tread, the thunder of many others will follow.

70698.Name: Nylea's Huntmaster
70698.FlavorText: Nature is stillness and savagery in equal measure.

70699.Name: Nylea's Intervention
70699.FlavorText: "I bring a wilderness no law can tame."

70700.Name: Nyx Herald
70700.FlavorText:
"A piercing call, bright as the stars, rang out across the valley, calling the Pheres band to war, to blood and savagery."
—Luphea of Setessa, Histories

70701.Name: Nyxbloom Ancient
70701.FlavorText: Ancient yet ever-young, it is wise and subtle—and cruel and reckless as the spring itself.

70702.Name: Nyxborn Colossus
70702.FlavorText:
"Tree-tall giants confronted her,
 fiercely demanding her tribute;
Fox-cunning Callaphe's slippery
 speaking entangled their senses . . ."
—The Callapheia

70703.Name: Omen of the Hunt
70703.FlavorText: "My time will come, when no road will divide the endless verdure of the trees."

70705.Name: Plummet
70705.FlavorText: An arrow from Nylea's bow never fails to find its mark.

70706.Name: Relentless Pursuit
70706.FlavorText: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

70708.Name: Return to Nature
70708.FlavorText:
"Far-seeing Kruphix glimpsed the end: Heliod's spear cast down and broken."
—The Cosmogony

70709.Name: Setessan Champion
70709.FlavorText: "A blessing is not a gift. It is a duty."

70710.Name: Setessan Petitioner
70710.FlavorText: "Cypress leaves for family, larkspur for protection, amaranth for a bountiful harvest."

70711.Name: Setessan Skirmisher
70711.FlavorText: Bassara, the tower of the fox, houses the elite skirmishers who guard the Nessian Wood against trespassers.

70712.Name: Setessan Training
70712.FlavorText: In the heart of Setessa, the warriors of Leina Tower defend the polis and train its daughters.

70713.Name: Skola Grovedancer
70713.FlavorText: "From the ashes of last night's revel, I bring the dawn of new growth."

70714.Name: Voracious Typhon
70714.FlavorText: A typhon's escape from the Underworld makes armies flee and kingdoms fall.

70717.Name: Acolyte of Affliction
70717.FlavorText: The best healers are intimately familiar with death.

70718.Name: Allure of the Unknown
70718.FlavorText: The light of hope blinded Pantor to the ills of the world.

70723.Name: Dalakos, Crafter of Wonders
70723.FlavorText: His imagination soars from the depths of the sea to the heights of the heavens.

70724.Name: Devourer of Memory
70724.FlavorText: It slips silently through the still waters of the Labyrinth of Memories to feed.

70727.Name: Eutropia the Twice-Favored
70727.FlavorText: Nylea speaks to her in the windblown leaves; Thassa in the rushing tides.

70729.Name: Haktos the Unscarred
70729.FlavorText: "Many have sought my weakness. All have failed."

70733.Name: Kunoros, Hound of Athreos
70733.FlavorText: Three sharp barks announce an attempt to escape the Underworld. Three sharp bites end it.

70734.Name: Mischievous Chimera
70734.FlavorText: Some curiosities are best left alone.

70736.Name: Rise to Glory
70736.FlavorText: A hero dies, and a legend arises.

70738.Name: Slaughter-Priest of Mogis
70738.FlavorText: "Mogis is pleased by this offering. Bring him more!"

70739.Name: Staggering Insight
70739.FlavorText:
"Only cowards flee from the truth."
—Perisophia the philosopher

70741.Name: Warden of the Chained
70741.FlavorText: "Strength, skill, rage—all have their limits, but patience can be infinite."

70743.Name: Bronze Sword
70743.FlavorText: Every strike of the smith's hammer infuses a sword with the determination of its creator.

70744.Name: Entrancing Lyre
70744.FlavorText: Its strings are wayward threads of fate.

70747.Name: Shadowspear
70747.FlavorText: A weapon of darkness for a warrior of light.

70749.Name: Thaumaturge's Familiar
70749.FlavorText: Meletian mages can't claim the title of thaumaturge until they have received a gift or omen from the gods. Ephara likes to give tangible tokens of her favor.

70750.Name: Thundering Chariot
70750.FlavorText: In times of conflict, the philosophers of Meletis trade their podiums for conveyances of war.

70751.Name: Traveler's Amulet
70751.FlavorText: A vision of home, and a glimpse of hope.

70752.Name: Wings of Hubris
70752.FlavorText: Dalakos's invention worked . . . until it didn't.

70754.Name: Labyrinth of Skophos
70754.FlavorText: For centuries, the minotaur polis of Skophos was unknown to humans. It remains unexplored.

70760.Name: Unknown Shores
70760.FlavorText:
"Callaphe gazed on the coastline,
 certain her destiny called her
here, where the mist-shrouded rocks sang,
 promising glories undreamed of."
—The Callapheia

70767.Name: Eidolon of Inspiration
70767.FlavorText:
"Agios was felled by a minotaur's blade, but I swear I have seen him since—in the midst of battle, wherever help is needed most."
—Phrokos, soldier of Akros

70768.Name: Elspeth's Devotee
70768.FlavorText: "For her, I would gladly die again."

70769.Name: Sunlit Hoplite
70769.FlavorText:
"Even in her absence, the light Elspeth
kindled in our hearts never faltered."

70771.Name: Swimmer in Nightmares
70771.FlavorText: Ashiok's minions plumb the depths of the ocean and the psyche.

70772.Name: Mindwrack Harpy
70772.FlavorText: Harpies are among the most detested creatures in all of Theros . . . and they thoroughly deserve it.

70785.Name: Grasping Giant
70785.FlavorText: Mirinthes thought death was seconds away when the giant's fist closed around him. Two days later, he was praying for death's release.

70786.Name: Victory's Envoy
70786.FlavorText: Her paean is the clash of spears, her prayer a battle cry.

70787.Name: Sphinx Mindbreaker
70787.FlavorText: Riddles draw you in, paradoxes hold you fast, and answers shatter your perceptions.

70788.Name: Serpent of Yawning Depths
70788.FlavorText:
"Gleams like moonlight on water drew us through the storm and toward our doom."
—Siona, captain of the Pyleas

70789.Name: Demon of Loathing
70789.FlavorText: Hatred is a potent ally, but an insatiable master.

70790.Name: Underworld Sentinel
70790.FlavorText: Deathless soldiers called phylaskia guard the borders of the Underworld.

70791.Name: Deathbellow War Cry
70791.FlavorText: Deathbellow Canyon echoes with the roars of minotaurs calling each other to battle.

70792.Name: Terror of Mount Velus
70792.FlavorText: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

70793.Name: Ironscale Hydra
70793.FlavorText:
"Put down your bows, you fools! Arrows only make it angry!"
—Callia, Hyrax Tower scout

70794.Name: Treeshaker Chimera
70794.FlavorText: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

70925.Name: Elemental
70925.RawFrameDetail: RG hybrid token, no text box

71068.Name: Adaptive Shimmerer
71068.FlavorText:
"You sure you want to see what emerges? You might not like it. It definitely won't like you."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

71069.Name: Farfinder
71069.FlavorText: "Take us home," she whispered, and the fox's eyes began to glow.

71070.Name: Mysterious Egg
71070.FlavorText:
"A good forage if you can find it, but eat it before you get back to sanctuary. The guards won't let you bring it through the gates."
—Dennae, Savai hunter

71071.Name: Blade Banish
71071.FlavorText: The Wanderer walks many paths. Her blade travels only one.

71072.Name: Checkpoint Officer
71072.FlavorText: After what he viewed as Lukka's shocking betrayal, General Kudro enacted stringent security measures at every entry point into Drannith.

71073.Name: Coordinated Charge
71073.FlavorText:
"Out here we're nothing but our training."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

71075.Name: Daysquad Marshal
71075.FlavorText: "The night emboldens many monsters, but the mightiest will attack in broad daylight."

71076.Name: Divine Arrow
71076.FlavorText: Outside Drannith's walls, where collateral damage is of no concern, the Coppercoats are free to use more potent methods.

71077.Name: Drannith Healer
71077.FlavorText: "The glowstones shine and dinosaurs roar to the south. Business will be brisk tonight."

71078.Name: Drannith Magistrate
71078.FlavorText: "Our sanctuaries must be beacons of reason and calm or else they will fall."

71080.Name: Flourishing Fox
71080.FlavorText:
"Day 1: These fox pups have really taken to me.
"Day 4: Big. So big. Need additional security."
—Jonald, mission naturalist, research notes

71081.Name: Garrison Cat
71081.FlavorText: After much arguing, the soldiers decided to keep it, on the grounds that it killed enough mice to count as an honorary monster slayer.

71082.Name: Helica Glider
71082.FlavorText: It could subsist on seeds but its preferred fare is your face.

71084.Name: Imposing Vantasaur
71084.FlavorText: Raugrin's coastline can be quite beautiful, as long as you avoid the volcanic dinosaurs, the sea dinosaurs, and the roaming beach dinosaurs.

71085.Name: Keensight Mentor
71085.FlavorText: Through the eludha, bonders share the powerful abilities of their chosen companions.

71086.Name: Lavabrink Venturer
71086.FlavorText: "Take one wrong step out here and you're dead. I take only right steps."

71088.Name: Luminous Broodmoth
71088.FlavorText: It soars through currents of moonbeams to give hope to the forsaken.

71090.Name: Maned Serval
71090.FlavorText:
"Don't search the ruins of Orn during the day. Nethroi's many eyes will spot you instantly. Don't go at night either. You'll be dinner for the servals. Maybe just don't go."
—Rasai, Indatha hunter

71092.Name: Pacifism
71092.FlavorText:
"If only they'd all act this docile. I could do something relaxing for a living. I've always wanted to bake biscuits."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

71093.Name: Patagia Tiger
71093.FlavorText: Lukka looked out from the parapet and saw not a monster to be put down, but a fierce kind of beauty.

71094.Name: Perimeter Sergeant
71094.FlavorText: "Get in there, soldier! I want a pelt on my wall before lunch!"

71095.Name: Sanctuary Lockdown
71095.FlavorText:
"Drannith gives no quarter to traitors."
—General Kudro

71096.Name: Savai Sabertooth
71096.FlavorText: The giant tigers of Savai prefer to hunt at daybreak, when the crystals' warning glow is masked by the light of dawn.

71097.Name: Snare Tactician
71097.FlavorText:
"Our volleys don't aim to kill. Impair them and the ground will do the rest."
—Alux, Skysail defender

71100.Name: Spontaneous Flight
71100.FlavorText: "Amazing! And I was only trying to teach her to sit!"

71101.Name: Stormwild Capridor
71101.FlavorText: After a disastrous day of battle, Lavabrink's lightning mages were recalled.

71102.Name: Swallow Whole
71102.FlavorText:
"World's better with one fewer poacher in it."
—Winota, heartbonder

71103.Name: Valiant Rescuer
71103.FlavorText: The floating city of Skysail has two rules: don't leave your crewmates behind, and don't mess with the guardrails.

71105.Name: Will of the All-Hunter
71105.FlavorText:
"It's Snapdax. You'd have a better chance of breaching a wall with a slice of bread."
—Krek, daysquad captain

71106.Name: Aegis Turtle
71106.FlavorText:
"The endurance of the ancient turtles in a land so harsh makes a strong case for patience, tranquility, and composure."
—Gavi, nest warden

71107.Name: Anticipate
71107.FlavorText: Bonder and bonded move in unison, intuiting each other's next move.

71110.Name: Boon of the Wish-Giver
71110.FlavorText:
"There is no law of nature that I have not seen Illuna break. Makes you wonder what is truly possible, does it not?"
—Rielle, the Everwise

71113.Name: Crystacean
71113.FlavorText: It loves blending into its environment, ambushing prey, and long scuttles on the beach.

71115.Name: Escape Protocol
71115.FlavorText: Sanctuaries harnessed the glowstones' natural reaction to monsters to create a warning system.

71116.Name: Essence Scatter
71116.FlavorText:
"I know the nightmares of Indatha seem scary, but when you break them down into their component parts, they're quite beautiful."
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist

71117.Name: Facet Reader
71117.FlavorText: "Every flaw in the crystal represents a moment where our strategy might go wrong."

71118.Name: Frost Lynx
71118.FlavorText: If you feel a strange chill within the temperate Quartzwood, look up.

71119.Name: Frostveil Ambush
71119.FlavorText: Hunters' methods vary from simple and brutal to elaborate and brutal.

71120.Name: Glimmerbell
71120.FlavorText:
"Their paths aren't random, but they don't float with the wind. Could they be following surges in crystalline energy?"
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist

71121.Name: Gust of Wind
71121.FlavorText: Skysail's strength was also its vulnerability.

71122.Name: Hampering Snare
71122.FlavorText:
"I want it to look me in the eyes and know the face of the man who put it down."
—Kelsien, the Plague

71123.Name: Keep Safe
71123.FlavorText: "Coppercoats think they understand duty and loyalty, but they can't begin to fathom the depths of my bond."

71126.Name: Neutralize
71126.FlavorText: On Ikoria, reactive magic can make the difference between barely grazed and really dead.

71127.Name: Of One Mind
71127.FlavorText:
"The eludha is total communication, total understanding. It makes regular human speech feel like garbled grunting."
—Winota, heartbonder

71129.Name: Phase Dolphin
71129.FlavorText:
"You've never had to trust your breath to an inhuman creature who could crush you at its whim, and I truly feel sorry for you."
—Eagan, seabonder

71130.Name: Pollywog Symbiote
71130.FlavorText: It always knew it was destined to be more than a frog.

71132.Name: Reconnaissance Mission
71132.FlavorText:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

71135.Name: Startling Development
71135.FlavorText: Remarkably, dinner continued with no further interruptions.

71136.Name: Thieving Otter
71136.FlavorText:
"You're telling me we spent a year securing the sanctuary against pterosaurs, rambeasts, and nightfangs . . . and we were robbed by what?"
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

71137.Name: Voracious Greatshark
71137.FlavorText: There is no boat big enough.

71138.Name: Wingfold Pteron
71138.FlavorText:
"Its weak spot is easily spotted, but only if it's swooping down on you."
—Jonald, mission naturalist

71139.Name: Wingspan Mentor
71139.FlavorText: Their bond grew over time, as did the height of their jumps.

71140.Name: Bastion of Remembrance
71140.FlavorText: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

71141.Name: Blitz Leech
71141.FlavorText:
"Fools wear armor against it as if the worst it could take is your blood."
—Gavi, nest warden

71143.Name: Boot Nipper
71143.FlavorText:
"I have a number of hyper-specific phobias and this somehow hits all of them."
—Aaru, Zagoth lumberjack

71144.Name: Bushmeat Poacher
71144.FlavorText: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."

71145.Name: Call of the Death-Dweller
71145.FlavorText: The living fear Nethroi's whispers. The dead heed them.

71148.Name: Corpse Churn
71148.FlavorText: "How did we find each other? So there I was, exploring a mound of monster corpses . . ."

71149.Name: Dark Bargain
71149.FlavorText:
"The poacher's trade isn't monster parts. It's myth. People pay to be part of the fantasy."
—Kelsien, the Plague

71150.Name: Dead Weight
71150.FlavorText:
"You're not my quarry, little one. I'm after whatever comes to investigate your cries."
—Kelsien, the Plague

71152.Name: Durable Coilbug
71152.FlavorText:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

71153.Name: Duskfang Mentor
71153.FlavorText: "What she sees, I see. What she tastes, I taste."

71154.Name: Easy Prey
71154.FlavorText: The definition of "bite-sized treat" depends on who you ask.

71155.Name: Extinction Event
71155.FlavorText:
"Nature is more merciless than any hunter I've ever known."
—Zai, nightsquad captain

71156.Name: Gloom Pangolin
71156.FlavorText:
"They say it survives on a purely bioluminescent diet. It's only active during the darkest of Indatha nights, making verification highly challenging."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

71157.Name: Grimdancer
71157.FlavorText: Most monsters are more frightening when they skitter unseen in the dark. Most.

71159.Name: Hunted Nightmare
71159.FlavorText:
"The cruelest monsters inspire the greatest tales. The greatest tales inspire the cruelest hunters."
—Rielle, the Everwise

71161.Name: Lurking Deadeye
71161.FlavorText: "There's no roar so mighty that it can't be silenced."

71162.Name: Memory Leak
71162.FlavorText:
"By halves does youth depart. I remember halves of names, halves of years, halves of myself."
—Ogaro, wandering sage

71163.Name: Mutual Destruction
71163.FlavorText: Hunter and hunted both died thinking they had outwitted the other.

71164.Name: Mythos of Nethroi
71164.FlavorText:
"And then the shadow took living form, and the shadow devoured the man whole—body, mind, and soul."
—Tales of the Ozolith

71165.Name: Nightsquad Commando
71165.FlavorText: "The big fella sounds hungry. Let's send him to bed without his supper."

71166.Name: Serrated Scorpion
71166.FlavorText: Each scorpion's venom is unique, thwarting sanctuary healers' attempts to develop an antidote.

71167.Name: Suffocating Fumes
71167.FlavorText:
"Yesterday it was flying tigers and crumbling bridges. Who knows what today will bring?"
—Dol, Lavabrink quartermaster

71168.Name: Unbreakable Bond
71168.FlavorText:
From now until the crystals stop glowing
—Ketria oath meaning "forever"

71169.Name: Unexpected Fangs
71169.FlavorText:
