"With the frequent mutations, predator-prey relationships seem to change every moment. I already like it here."
—Vivien Reid

71170.Name: Unlikely Aid
71170.FlavorText: "I appreciate you not letting me fall to my death in the acid bogs. Now, can you let me down?"

71172.Name: Whisper Squad
71172.FlavorText: Ears can't hear them. Eyes see too many of them.

71173.Name: Zagoth Mamba
71173.FlavorText:
"It's just a snake. A many-eyed snake with venom that turns your blood to smoke, but still, just a snake."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

71174.Name: Blazing Volley
71174.FlavorText:
"Don't ask me what to do if you miss. They're stingdrakes. Don't miss."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain

71175.Name: Blisterspit Gremlin
71175.FlavorText:
"Ah, we have a critic."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain

71176.Name: Blitz of the Thunder-Raptor
71176.FlavorText: The sound of Vadrok's gigantic wings is ominous. But the true terror is when they fall silent.

71177.Name: Cathartic Reunion
71177.FlavorText: The soldier had given up his wealth, his title, even his home, but he had no room for regret. At last, he had saved his friend.

71178.Name: Clash of Titans
71178.FlavorText:
"Let the brutes fight. If they kill each other, we lose no more soldiers today."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain

71180.Name: Drannith Stinger
71180.FlavorText: The first line of defense, and the last person you want to anger.

71182.Name: Ferocious Tigorilla
71182.FlavorText: From a certain perspective, it's an inspiring story of overcoming obstacles.

71183.Name: Fire Prophecy
71183.FlavorText:
"Water and bone tell many tales, but fire is fickle. It would rather consume than reveal."
—Rielle, the Everwise

71184.Name: Flame Spill
71184.FlavorText: Fragile, floating Skysail suddenly seemed like an appealingly safe place to live.

71186.Name: Forbidden Friendship
71186.FlavorText: The two looked at each other, and neither fled. "I see," the soldier murmured. "We're both just fighting for survival out here, aren't we?"

71187.Name: Frenzied Raptor
71187.FlavorText:
"Though the road through Raugrin is lined with alarm crystals, some monsters seem to be adapting. We've had raptors feigning attacks on provision caravans, while others try to sneak through the lava curtain."
—Dol, Lavabrink quartermaster

71189.Name: Go for Blood
71189.FlavorText: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.

71190.Name: Heightened Reflexes
71190.FlavorText: Some crystals glow in the presence of monsters, forming a convenient warning system. Some monsters have learned to outrun the light.

71191.Name: Lava Serpent
71191.FlavorText: Lavabrink's boiling moat is a deterrent for most, and a relaxing bath for one.

71196.Name: Prickly Marmoset
71196.FlavorText:
"It's either terrified or extremely mad at us, definitely one of the two."
—Jonald, mission naturalist

71197.Name: Pyroceratops
71197.FlavorText: "I always thought wizards were supposed to have cats or one-eyed owls for familiars, but flaming dinosaurs work, too."

71198.Name: Raking Claws
71198.FlavorText:
"How many claws does a monster have? Exactly one more than you've accounted for."
—Alux, Skysail defender

71199.Name: Reptilian Reflection
71199.FlavorText: Danger often lurks in the allure of crystal shards.

71200.Name: Rooting Moloch
71200.FlavorText: Their feeding habits leave them with gizzards full of tumbled gems.

71201.Name: Rumbling Rockslide
71201.FlavorText:
"When monsters walk, the earth knows its place and yields."
—Rielle, the Everwise

71204.Name: Spelleater Wolverine
71204.FlavorText:
"The monster that scares me the most isn't the biggest."
—Taelya, Lavabrink pyromage

71205.Name: Tentative Connection
71205.FlavorText: Lukka was ordered to kill a threat. He chose to make a friend.

71207.Name: Weaponize the Monsters
71207.FlavorText: Revenge is a path inevitably walked alone.

71209.Name: Adventurous Impulse
71209.FlavorText: An adventure without a companion is hardly an adventure at all.

71210.Name: Almighty Brushwagg
71210.FlavorText:
Laughed at the brushwagg
—Hunters' expression meaning
"died unexpectedly"

71212.Name: Barrier Breach
71212.FlavorText:
"They cast wards, thinking it will protect them, but the biggest monsters find a way through."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

71213.Name: Bristling Boar
71213.FlavorText:
"I can bring down anything in Zagoth, but for some quarry the ratio of fight to meat is too high."
—Master Hunter Chevill

71214.Name: Charge of the Forever-Beast
71214.FlavorText: The Zagoth wetlands are fertilized by centuries of Brokkos's former challengers.

71215.Name: Colossification
71215.FlavorText:
"Turns out the case of the flattened outpost and the case of the missing kitten were related."
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

71216.Name: Essence Symbiote
71216.FlavorText: The Ozolith's appearance spawned a new era of wild mutation on Ikoria. Some creatures hunted different prey, lived in new habitats, and thrived on mutation itself.

71217.Name: Excavation Mole
71217.FlavorText: It makes molehills out of mountains.

71218.Name: Exuberant Wolfbear
71218.FlavorText: Sometimes the eludha is a sacred harmony of souls. Sometimes the bonder grabs some fur and holds on tight.

71220.Name: Flycatcher Giraffid
71220.FlavorText: Poachers use the harvested tongues to snare pests, plumb caves, and scale tall buildings.

71221.Name: Fully Grown
71221.FlavorText:
"One day I woke up and knew I had nothing left to teach her. So now I ride on her shoulders and follow where she leads."
—Gustin, wildbonder

71224.Name: Greater Sandwurm
71224.FlavorText: On Ikoria, sandwurms never lie dormant for too long. In some regions, "no activity" is the greatest sign of danger.

71225.Name: Honey Mammoth
71225.FlavorText:
"And I thought I had a big sweet tooth."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

71226.Name: Hornbash Mentor
71226.FlavorText: "We share the same nuanced opinion of hunters and military goons: smash them."

71227.Name: Humble Naturalist
71227.FlavorText: "The key to bonding with monsters, no matter their size, is knowing where they like to be scratched."

71228.Name: Ivy Elemental
71228.FlavorText: For safety reasons, the keeping of houseplants within Ikoria's sanctuaries is heavily discouraged.

71233.Name: Monstrous Step
71233.FlavorText: Life is best taken one step at a time.

71234.Name: Mosscoat Goriak
71234.FlavorText:
"Goriaks are as stubborn and hardy as I'd expect of a large herbivore in a wetland habitat. But I never expected them to have such beautiful voices!"
—Vivien Reid

71235.Name: Mythos of Brokkos
71235.FlavorText:
"The most unexpected weapon that a monster can wield is kindness."
—Tales of the Ozolith

71236.Name: Plummet
71236.FlavorText: Scavengers follow in Skysail's shadow, feasting on the carcasses of monsters that attacked the floating city.

71237.Name: Ram Through
71237.FlavorText:
"Need a medic! And some stonemasons!"
—Wyllon, Drannith merchant

71238.Name: Sudden Spinnerets
71238.FlavorText:
"What's natural on Ikoria continues to delight me."
—Vivien Reid

71239.Name: Survivors' Bond
71239.FlavorText: "And what did we learn? Never taunt a porcuparrot!"

71240.Name: Thwart the Enemy
71240.FlavorText:
"Your prey is in my custody now. Withdraw."
—Vivien Reid

71243.Name: Wilt
71243.FlavorText: Nothing returns from the nightmare nests of Indatha unscathed.

71244.Name: Back for More
71244.FlavorText:
"How can you be sure you pierced its heart? Do you even know where its heart is?"
—Trundan, Indatha poacher

71247.Name: Channeled Force
71247.FlavorText: Few monsters challenged Narset after they sensed her power.

71250.Name: Dire Tactics
71250.FlavorText:
"I will preserve human life at all costs. I will stand alone against behemoths before I let them touch my city. I will hold the wall."
—Oath of the Coppercoats

71251.Name: Eerie Ultimatum
71251.FlavorText:
"The ground under our feet is a record of every slight against the world, to be avenged at a time of its choosing."
—Gavi, nest warden

71253.Name: Frondland Felidar
71253.FlavorText:
"Fear not the behemoth heard from miles away. Fear the stalking felidar, which reveals itself only for the kill."
—Rielle, the Everwise

71256.Name: Genesis Ultimatum
71256.FlavorText: No human eyes have ever witnessed the birth of an apex monster.

71258.Name: Inspired Ultimatum
71258.FlavorText:
"Inner peace is wonderful, and worth striving for. Outer peace is much less important."
—Taelya, Lavabrink pyromage

71265.Name: Offspring's Revenge
71265.FlavorText: All they found in the hunter's camp were tiny paw prints and a lot of blood.

71267.Name: Primal Empathy
71267.FlavorText: "From this day forward, we confront this world together, lifting each other up."

71270.Name: Rielle, the Everwise
71270.FlavorText: "Being all-knowing is a matter of remembering which things it is crucial to forget."

71271.Name: Ruinous Ultimatum
71271.FlavorText:
"Strike those abominations down. Let their names rot with their remains."
—General Kudro

71272.Name: Savai Thundermane
71272.FlavorText: A crackling roar is the last sound many hunters hear.

71273.Name: Skull Prophet
71273.FlavorText: "I study bone because that's where truth dwells. One monster knucklebone is wiser than all that damp meat in your head."

71274.Name: Skycat Sovereign
71274.FlavorText: The bounty on its head is as old as Skysail, but no one has ever tried to collect.

71275.Name: Slitherwisp
71275.FlavorText: Fear is its habitat, sanity its prey.

71277.Name: Song of Creation
71277.FlavorText: She wept, not from perfect understanding, but from serene gratitude.

71278.Name: Sprite Dragon
71278.FlavorText: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

71282.Name: Whirlwind of Thought
71282.FlavorText: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.

71284.Name: Zenith Flare
71284.FlavorText:
"I defy this world to try our defenses now. Send pterons and skycats. Send Vadrok!"
—Janae, Coppercoat architect

71285.Name: Alert Heedbonder
71285.FlavorText: Considering the zealous armies, vile poachers, and titanic monsters, it's always wise to keep one eye on the horizon.

71286.Name: Cunning Nightbonder
71286.FlavorText: "We are each other's shadow, fleeting yet always present."

71290.Name: Jubilant Skybonder
71290.FlavorText: She was born unable to walk. Through the eludha, she was able to fly.

71296.Name: Proud Wildbonder
71296.FlavorText:
"You're little now, yes, but one day your footsteps will make mountains tremble."
—Gustin, wildbonder

71297.Name: Sonorous Howlbonder
71297.FlavorText: The call of the wild is rarely a solo.

71302.Name: Indatha Crystal
71302.FlavorText: Crystals nestle in the roots of Indatha's helica trees as if being nurtured by their embrace.

71303.Name: Ketria Crystal
71303.FlavorText: The dark of night never truly falls on Ketria, where abundant crystals bathe the land in their glow.

71304.Name: The Ozolith
71304.FlavorText: As it twists, so does all life around it.

71305.Name: Raugrin Crystal
71305.FlavorText: The vegetation in Raugrin is dull, but that only makes the towering crystal structures gleam brighter.

71306.Name: Savai Crystal
71306.FlavorText: The same crystals that root deep enough to pierce Savai's catacombs also soar high enough to change its weather.

71307.Name: Sleeper Dart
71307.FlavorText:
"Sleep now, you big brute."
—Kelsien, the Plague

71308.Name: Springjaw Trap
71308.FlavorText:
"Stop trying to pierce the hide. Hit where it's softest: ankle, sole, hamstring."
—Master Hunter Chevill

71309.Name: Zagoth Crystal
71309.FlavorText: From the fertile muck of Zagoth, everything—animal, botanical, and crystalline—grows with rugged beauty.

71312.Name: Bonders' Enclave
71312.FlavorText: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the eludha—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

71314.Name: Evolving Wilds
71314.FlavorText:
"It's not hard to grasp that this land does not belong to us."
—Gavi, nest warden

71315.Name: Indatha Triome
71315.FlavorText:
"These lowlands were formed thousands of years ago by the behemoth Indath—its final footsteps before vanishing into the sea."
—Tales of the Ozolith

71317.Name: Ketria Triome
71317.FlavorText: Nowhere on Ikoria are monsters more integral to the landscape than Ketria, where the river itself will stand up and roar.

71318.Name: Raugrin Triome
71318.FlavorText: Raugrin meets the sea with jaws wide, its coast spiked with teeth of crystal and granite.

71320.Name: Savai Triome
71320.FlavorText: Broad prairies feed the human sanctuary of Drannith and conceal a network of caverns where giant cats make their dens.

71326.Name: Zagoth Triome
71326.FlavorText: Hunters in the primeval wetlands become fluent in reading the ripples to tell when to pursue and when to flee.

71335.Name: Feather
71335.RawFrameDetail: R artifact token, has text box

71345.Name: Battle Screech
71345.FlavorText: All sounds harmonize with the Worldsoul.

71347.Name: Enduring Sliver
71347.FlavorText: Time has ground mountains to sand, but the slivers ever remain.

71350.Name: First Sliver's Chosen
71350.FlavorText: The most tenacious members of the hive instinctually guard the First Sliver.

71353.Name: Gilded Light
71353.FlavorText: Whoever survives the first blow lives to land the second.

71354.Name: Giver of Runes
71354.FlavorText: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

71355.Name: Impostor of the Sixth Pride
71355.FlavorText: The tribe was as strong as his longing, their territory as vast as his isolation. The changeling knew he had found a home, and a form.

71356.Name: Irregular Cohort
71356.FlavorText: Where fickle form meets lasting loyalty.

71357.Name: King of the Pride
71357.FlavorText:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

71359.Name: Lancer Sliver
71359.FlavorText:
"These polearms were supposed to help!"
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

71364.Name: Reprobation
71364.FlavorText: There was a time all craven beasts cowered before Avacyn's divine might.

71366.Name: Segovian Angel
71366.FlavorText: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

71369.Name: Shelter
71369.FlavorText: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

71373.Name: Stirring Address
71373.FlavorText: "For glory! For justice! For our queen!"

71377.Name: Wall of One Thousand Cuts
71377.FlavorText: Families of the fallen donate the swords of their loved ones to bolster the city's defenses.

71380.Name: Zhalfirin Decoy
71380.FlavorText:
"Never let them take their eyes off you."
—Sidar Jabari

71382.Name: Bazaar Trademage
71382.FlavorText: He traded a lamp for a scepter, the scepter for a ruby, and the ruby for a simple rug.

71385.Name: Choking Tethers
71385.FlavorText: A wizard can be outnumbered but never outsmarted.

71390.Name: Eyekite
71390.FlavorText:
"This one will need direction. After all, each of its eyes is larger than its brain."
—Cyla, Lord of the Aerie

71392.Name: Faerie Seer
71392.FlavorText: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."

71395.Name: Iceberg Cancrix
71395.FlavorText: Its shell can withstand anything but a thaw.

71396.Name: Man-o'-War
71396.FlavorText:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

71402.Name: Phantasmal Form
71402.FlavorText: Within each of us lurks the fathomless.

71403.Name: Phantom Ninja
71403.FlavorText:
"Ninjas can run across water, pull ladders from pockets, kill with a kiss, and slip between bricks. Pack of lies, I say."
—Benden, teahouse gossip

71408.Name: Scour All Possibilities
71408.FlavorText: Searching the future for answers often leads to further questions.

71409.Name: Scuttling Sliver
71409.FlavorText: A living fossil active after eons of dormancy.

71418.Name: Windcaller Aven
71418.FlavorText: Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.

71423.Name: Changeling Outcast
71423.FlavorText: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

71424.Name: Cordial Vampire
71424.FlavorText: "Please, come in! Hors d'oeuvres are on the table."

71435.Name: Graveshifter
71435.FlavorText: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

71437.Name: Mind Rake
71437.FlavorText: Spells of madness often require a sacrifice of sanity.

71438.Name: Mob
71438.FlavorText: Not all monsters fight with teeth and claws.

71439.Name: Nether Spirit
71439.FlavorText: Four walls and a roof won't provide safety from that which is buried.

71442.Name: Putrid Goblin
71442.FlavorText: Too stupid to survive, too dumb to die.

71444.Name: Ransack the Lab
71444.FlavorText:
"I think someone is stealing from my laboratory. It had better not be you!"
—Geralf, letter to Gisa

71449.Name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
71449.FlavorText: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.

71451.Name: Throatseeker
71451.FlavorText:
"I just felt a drip. It must be about to rain."
—Stoneway Market vendor, last words

71453.Name: Undead Augur
71453.FlavorText:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—The Red Book of Mezdrithalik

71455.Name: Venomous Changeling
71455.FlavorText: It doesn't contain venom. It is venom.

71456.Name: Warteye Witch
71456.FlavorText: Eyeballs that portend unpleasant futures become slimy snacks instead.

71460.Name: Bladeback Sliver
71460.FlavorText: Slivers can turn a last stand into a stunning victory.

71461.Name: Bogardan Dragonheart
71461.FlavorText: A hunger to soar must be sated.

71462.Name: Cleaving Sliver
71462.FlavorText: When it wriggled closer to a thrum of slivers, their talons hardened and glinted in the sun. One took a playful swipe at a tree trunk, and its new blade cut clean through.

71464.Name: Fists of Flame
71464.FlavorText:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

71466.Name: Geomancer's Gambit
71466.FlavorText: Telepathy changes minds, necromancy changes lives, but geomancy changes the world.

71470.Name: Goblin Matron
71470.FlavorText: A mother only a child could love.

71473.Name: Hollowhead Sliver
71473.FlavorText:
"Brilliant! They evolved away from energy-taxing brains and respond only to spinal reflex arcs from the hive mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal

71478.Name: Ore-Scale Guardian
71478.FlavorText: A dragon's loyalty cannot be earned, but it can be bought.

71479.Name: Pashalik Mons
71479.FlavorText: The thunderhead that leads in the storm.

71488.Name: Spinehorn Minotaur
71488.FlavorText: "If you think twice, I'll cut twice."

71489.Name: Spiteful Sliver
71489.FlavorText: Victories against the hive are tragedies.

71490.Name: Tectonic Reformation
71490.FlavorText: Alone in the charred desolation of her kingdom, she regretted many things—most of all not acting sooner.

71496.Name: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
71496.FlavorText: Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.

71504.Name: Excavating Anurid
71504.FlavorText: Turg's spawn ruled long after he croaked.

71511.Name: Llanowar Tribe
71511.FlavorText: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

71512.Name: Mother Bear
71512.FlavorText: Even without her, the cubs will always know their mother's love.

71513.Name: Murasa Behemoth
71513.FlavorText: The loss of its hunting grounds made it all the more dangerous.

71514.Name: Nantuko Cultivator
71514.FlavorText: "Every seed holds strength and teaches patience."

71519.Name: Savage Swipe
71519.FlavorText: Nine generations of metalworking skill are no match for nine hundred pounds of rage.

71522.Name: Springbloom Druid
71522.FlavorText: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

71524.Name: Tempered Sliver
71524.FlavorText: The question isn't whether slivers will adapt to a world's perils but whether the world's perils will adapt to slivers.

71529.Name: Twin-Silk Spider
71529.FlavorText: A forest-wide network of webs brings a hungry couple to captured prey.

71536.Name: Cloudshredder Sliver
71536.FlavorText: Forked tails rustled. Talons clicked. A lone sliver streaked overhead like jagged lightning, and the hive thundered.

71542.Name: Good-Fortune Unicorn
71542.FlavorText: Catching even a glimpse of one is the start of eight years of good luck.

71548.Name: Lavabelly Sliver
71548.FlavorText: Warm enough to incubate eggs or incinerate those who would eat them.

71550.Name: Munitions Expert
71550.FlavorText: When dealing with goblins, if it isn't nailed down, it's headed your way.

71552.Name: Reap the Past
71552.FlavorText: The ground cracked and unleashed a thousand years of history at once.

71553.Name: Rotwidow Pack
71553.FlavorText: For each one you see, ten see you.

71554.Name: Ruination Rioter
71554.FlavorText: "Those urbanist cobble-roaches won't know what hit them!"

71556.Name: Thundering Djinn
71556.FlavorText: It strikes like a bolt from a brainstorm.

71560.Name: Amorphous Axe
71560.FlavorText: A weapon forged for every hand.

71562.Name: Birthing Boughs
71562.FlavorText: Changelings can't remember where they came from. They just know it wasn't a cradle.

71576.Name: Universal Automaton
71576.FlavorText:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

71579.Name: Fiery Islet
71579.FlavorText: Where water is the canvas and lava the paint.

71584.Name: Nurturing Peatland
71584.FlavorText: New life is born within its shadows.

71587.Name: Silent Clearing
71587.FlavorText: The expedition's end began the marsh's story.

71588.Name: Sunbaked Canyon
71588.FlavorText: Since the river ran dry, travelers wander where fish once swam.

71590.Name: Waterlogged Grove
71590.FlavorText: The trees pull water from deep underground, filling the forest for miles.

71784.Name: Alpine Watchdog
71784.FlavorText:
"On the eighth day, a blizzard hit. Supplies were lost, and morale plummeted. On the ninth day, Dover found us."
—To the Summit: A Tale of Survival

71785.Name: Angelic Ascension
71785.FlavorText: Within her battalion she was known as the Angel of Arkvale. Until now, that was only a metaphor.

71786.Name: Anointed Chorister
71786.FlavorText: "I sing of benevolence and mercy, of golden wings bringing comfort to the meek and downtrodden."

71787.Name: Aven Gagglemaster
71787.FlavorText: An aven's gear is enchanted to avoid weighing them down during aerial maneuvers.

71788.Name: Baneslayer Angel
71788.FlavorText: Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.

71790.Name: Basri's Acolyte
71790.FlavorText: Basri carries on his god's legacy, spreading her teachings throughout the Multiverse.

71792.Name: Basri's Solidarity
71792.FlavorText:
"The will to fight and act as one is not limited to a single world. Oketra's teachings are universal."
—Basri Ket

71793.Name: Celestial Enforcer
71793.FlavorText: "I look to the heavens for hope, but you will kneel."

71794.Name: Concordia Pegasus
71794.FlavorText: In the cloudy skies and dim light of autumn, a flash of white wings is a reminder that better times lie ahead.

71795.Name: Containment Priest
71795.FlavorText: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

71796.Name: Daybreak Charger
71796.FlavorText: It's often mistaken for the coming dawn as it gallops across the horizon.

71797.Name: Defiant Strike
71797.FlavorText: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

71800.Name: Falconer Adept
71800.FlavorText: "My falcons are family, as much as any other member of my clan."

71802.Name: Gale Swooper
71802.FlavorText:
"Be glad the griffin set you back on your feet when it was done with you. My goat wasn't so lucky."
—Arram, goatherd

71803.Name: Glorious Anthem
71803.FlavorText: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

71804.Name: Griffin Aerie
71804.FlavorText: When griffins started nesting atop the northern tower, the castellan worried they'd be a nuisance. Instead, they took the entire castle under their protection.

71806.Name: Legion's Judgment
71806.FlavorText: "My lance was once wielded by Venerable Tarrian. In his name and by his might, I cast you down!"

71807.Name: Light of Promise
71807.FlavorText: The light washed over him, and in the wind he heard the roars of all the pridemates who had come before.

71808.Name: Makeshift Battalion
71808.FlavorText: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.

71811.Name: Pack Leader
71811.FlavorText: He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.

71812.Name: Rambunctious Mutt
71812.FlavorText: Emphatic words with powerful gestures. Clearly this was playtime.

71813.Name: Revitalize
71813.FlavorText:
"A potion is no substitute for a skilled surgeon, but it will hold your bits in."
—Torricks, battlefield medic

71815.Name: Sanctum of Tranquil Light
71815.FlavorText:
An untroubled mind
Dwells in perfect harmony
With a peaceful heart.

71816.Name: Seasoned Hallowblade
71816.FlavorText: "I don't know that I'll win every fight. But I have faith, and that's carried me this far."

71817.Name: Secure the Scene
71817.FlavorText:
"You know it's a great show when the Azorius arrest the props, too!"
—Judith, the Scourge Diva

71818.Name: Selfless Savior
71818.FlavorText: She raised him from an orphaned pup and gave him a life of love. With his last act, he thanked her.

71820.Name: Speaker of the Heavens
71820.FlavorText: "All are welcome in the angels' light."

71821.Name: Staunch Shieldmate
71821.FlavorText: "Gilded with gold from a dragon's trove, it is! And etched with the image of the dragon I slew to take it."

71822.Name: Swift Response
71822.FlavorText:
"There's nothing quite as satisfying as delivering a good kick to the face."
—Adrasteia, Akroan captain

71823.Name: Tempered Veteran
71823.FlavorText: "I've been carrying a sword since before you were born. I wouldn't give up my oath for all the peace and comfort in the world."

71824.Name: Valorous Steed
71824.FlavorText: A unicorn chooses only the most virtuous and noble of knights to be its companion.

71825.Name: Vryn Wingmare
71825.FlavorText: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

71826.Name: Warded Battlements
71826.FlavorText: In dire times, even a place of refuge can become a weapon of war.

71827.Name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
71827.FlavorText: "There is no age at which you stop learning."

71828.Name: Cancel
71828.FlavorText: "I decide what stands in my way."

71831.Name: Enthralling Hold
71831.FlavorText:
"I offered to pay him to do the job, but he refused. So I took matters into my own hands."
—Tahim, the Puppetmaster

71832.Name: Frantic Inventory
71832.FlavorText: "Another village, another angry mob. Why do I even bother unpacking?"

71833.Name: Frost Breath
71833.FlavorText: "I'll make ice chimes of your bones."

71836.Name: Keen Glidemaster
71836.FlavorText: "Fear is a rational response, but waiting won't make it any easier. Just jump!"

71837.Name: Library Larcenist
71837.FlavorText: "I specialize in missing manuscripts, pilfered poetry, and lifted letters."

71838.Name: Lofty Denial
71838.FlavorText: The mage scowled as yet another bolt splashed harmlessly against seemingly empty air.

71839.Name: Miscast
71839.FlavorText:
"Next time, try something more appropriate for your skill level."
—Barrin, Tolarian archmage

71840.Name: Mistral Singer
71840.FlavorText: "I sang of storms, there came a squall. I sang of waves, the seas grew tall. I sang of love, but no voice called."

71841.Name: Opt
71841.FlavorText: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's Planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

71843.Name: Rain of Revelation
71843.FlavorText: "As the sky opened up, we ran for shelter. Halfway there I came to the sudden realization that, already soaked, there might be more to gain from experiencing the rain than running from it."

71844.Name: Read the Tides
71844.FlavorText: Charts and instruments work fine, but the best navigators aren't above a spell or two to nudge the tides in a more favorable direction.

71845.Name: Rewind
71845.FlavorText: "The best denials are simply that: a beginning and end unchanged, a dream with no memory."

71847.Name: Roaming Ghostlight
71847.FlavorText: Some who die senseless deaths return as formless spirits, seeking answers where there are none.

71848.Name: Rookie Mistake
71848.FlavorText: "Stop locking your knees as you strike! Now stand up and try again."

71849.Name: Rousing Read
71849.FlavorText: Great literature can transport the reader.

71850.Name: Sanctum of Calm Waters
71850.FlavorText:
Truth lurks in the depths,
Invisible from the shore.
Knowledge inundates.

71851.Name: See the Truth
71851.FlavorText: "What is this that is neither future nor past?"

71852.Name: Shacklegeist
71852.FlavorText: The Blessed Sleep doesn't come easily to a mind chained by regrets.

71853.Name: Shipwreck Dowser
71853.FlavorText: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

71858.Name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
71858.FlavorText:
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi

71859.Name: Teferi's Protege
71859.FlavorText: Teferi's legacy lives on in Tolaria through the study of time magic and a tradition of irrepressible mischief.

71860.Name: Teferi's Tutelage
71860.FlavorText: "Tarassel's sixth law of temporal recursion is easy to understand as long as you know the first seven."

71861.Name: Tide Skimmer
71861.FlavorText: Fishing boats often follow hunting drakes to find the largest schools of fish.

71862.Name: Tolarian Kraken
71862.FlavorText:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration

71863.Name: Tome Anima
71863.FlavorText: Sometimes knowledge takes on a life of its own.

71864.Name: Unsubstantiate
71864.FlavorText:
"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess

71865.Name: Vodalian Arcanist
71865.FlavorText: The Vodalian Empire tends to be insular. The scholarly Volshe caste are the exception, using education as an antidote to xenophobia.

71866.Name: Waker of Waves
71866.FlavorText: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.

71868.Name: Wishcoin Crab
71868.FlavorText:
"What wishes do they grant? Mostly pinching-related ones."
—Omik, superintendent of waterworks

71871.Name: Bad Deal
71871.FlavorText: There are still places where a smile and a handshake are all you need to seal a deal.

71872.Name: Blood Glutton
71872.FlavorText: "Some savor the hunt. I savor the kill."

71873.Name: Caged Zombie
71873.FlavorText: "Six consecutive life sentences" takes on a new meaning when necromancy is involved.

71875.Name: Crypt Lurker
71875.FlavorText:
"Even the rats refuse to set foot inside. I fear to think what might be waiting in there."
—Gravedigger's journal

71876.Name: Deathbloom Thallid
71876.FlavorText:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

71881.Name: Finishing Blow
71881.FlavorText: "In this world, it's kill or be killed. I'd rather not be the latter."

71882.Name: Gloom Sower
71882.FlavorText:
"First, the darkness fell. Terror came next. After that, only despair remained."
—The Tragedy of Morein

71884.Name: Grasp of Darkness
71884.FlavorText:
"I welcome the use of even the foulest magic if it will rid us of the monstrosities that plague our world."
—Munda, ambush leader

71885.Name: Grim Tutor
71885.FlavorText: As blood touched the empty page, it formed words that seared themselves into the wizard's mind.

71887.Name: Infernal Scarring
71887.FlavorText: One who is marked by a demon in life is sure to be remembered as one in death.

71888.Name: Kaervek, the Spiteful
71888.FlavorText: "Defy me and I will burn the flesh from your bones. Betray me and I will steal the breath from your lungs."

71891.Name: Liliana's Devotee
71891.FlavorText: Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.

71892.Name: Liliana's Standard Bearer
71892.FlavorText: The purple banner of the House of Vess is a symbol of death wherever it's flown.

71893.Name: Liliana's Steward
71893.FlavorText: Servants at Vess Manor are chosen for their strong work ethic and respectful demeanor. Being alive is not required.

71895.Name: Masked Blackguard
71895.FlavorText: Her footsteps are whispers, her passage a last breath.

71897.Name: Mind Rot
71897.FlavorText: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

71899.Name: Peer into the Abyss
71899.FlavorText:
"Oh, don't be so dramatic. When your eyes bleed, and your brain leaks out your ears, then we'll talk about lost sanity."
—Braids, dementia summoner

71900.Name: Pestilent Haze
71900.FlavorText:
"Your crops will rot. The air itself will turn against you. You will suffer as I have suffered."
—Karaz, outcast

71901.Name: Rise Again
71901.FlavorText:
"I love those who are eager to serve."
—Liliana Vess

71902.Name: Sanctum of Stone Fangs
71902.FlavorText:
Renounce all limits,
False chains binding potential.
Power knows no bounds.

71903.Name: Sanguine Indulgence
71903.FlavorText:
"Drink from the vein? How provincial."
—Lord Duchorvin

71904.Name: Silversmote Ghoul
71904.FlavorText: Being trapped between two forms of unlife is a fate worse than mere death.

71905.Name: Skeleton Archer
71905.FlavorText:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

71906.Name: Tavern Swindler
71906.FlavorText: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

71908.Name: Village Rites
71908.FlavorText: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

71909.Name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
71909.FlavorText: "Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."

71910.Name: Walking Corpse
71910.FlavorText:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

71911.Name: Witch's Cauldron
71911.FlavorText: The best recipes start with reliable cookware.

71912.Name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
71912.FlavorText: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

71913.Name: Bolt Hound
71913.FlavorText: Its spark is worse than its bite.

71916.Name: Burn Bright
71916.FlavorText:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

71919.Name: Chandra's Magmutt
71919.FlavorText:
"Is it purebred? No, but it's pure fire."
—Chandra Nalaar

71920.Name: Chandra's Pyreling
71920.FlavorText:
"I think Chandra just wanted something to blame random scorch marks on."
—Jace Beleren

71923.Name: Destructive Tampering
71923.FlavorText:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

71924.Name: Double Vision
71924.FlavorText: "Your eyes aren't playing tricks on you. I am."

71925.Name: Fiery Emancipation
71925.FlavorText:
"One day the mountain's fire will rise up to burn away our chains and end this age of oppression."
—The Molten Prophecy

71926.Name: Furious Rise
71926.FlavorText: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

71927.Name: Furor of the Bitten
71927.FlavorText: Those who only believe themselves infected with lycanthropy can be as dangerous as those who really are.

71929.Name: Goblin Arsonist
71929.FlavorText: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

71930.Name: Goblin Wizardry
71930.FlavorText: "Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.

71931.Name: Havoc Jester
71931.FlavorText: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.

71932.Name: Heartfire Immolator
71932.FlavorText: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."

71933.Name: Hellkite Punisher
71933.FlavorText:
"We'll pay no more tribute to that tyrannical lizard. A new age starts today!"
—Mayor Kadrim, now deceased

71934.Name: Hobblefiend
71934.FlavorText: Bedbugs aren't the only things you need to worry about biting you at night.

71935.Name: Igneous Cur
71935.FlavorText: Some dogs just aren't meant to be indoor pets.

71937.Name: Onakke Ogre
71937.FlavorText: The ogres you know are nothing like the Onakke. Possessing both intellect and industry, they had brute strength without being brutish.

71938.Name: Pitchburn Devils
71938.FlavorText: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

71939.Name: Sanctum of Shattered Heights
71939.FlavorText:
Rage smolders within,
An all-consuming wildfire
Burning fear to ash.

71940.Name: Scorching Dragonfire
71940.FlavorText: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

71941.Name: Shock
71941.FlavorText:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

71942.Name: Soul Sear
71942.FlavorText: There was no witty retort, no confident boast to accompany the attack. There was only pain.

71943.Name: Spellgorger Weird
71943.FlavorText: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

71945.Name: Sure Strike
71945.FlavorText: To survive imminent doom, it sometimes takes a foolhardy soul who acts first and fears later.

71947.Name: Thrill of Possibility
71947.FlavorText: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."

71948.Name: Traitorous Greed
71948.FlavorText:
"Remind me again, what's the going rate for betrayal these days?"
—Captain Rhenmir

71949.Name: Transmogrify
71949.FlavorText: "I'd like to introduce you to the new and improved me."

71950.Name: Turn to Slag
71950.FlavorText:
"If it wasn't a blackened, stinking, melted abomination before, it certainly is now."
—Koth of the Hammer

71951.Name: Turret Ogre
71951.FlavorText: Common Gruul career aspirations: berserker, shaman, catapult.

71952.Name: Unleash Fury
71952.FlavorText: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

71953.Name: Volcanic Geyser
71953.FlavorText:
"The common folk call it the breaking of the crust or the spilling of fire. Geomancers call it target practice."
—Ryda, geomancer

71954.Name: Volcanic Salvo
71954.FlavorText: Seeing it coming a mile away is little comfort if you can't get out of range in time.

71955.Name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
71955.FlavorText: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

71956.Name: Burlfist Oak
71956.FlavorText: If a tree fells you in the forest and no one is around to hear it, "does it make a sound" is the last thing you need to worry about.

71957.Name: Canopy Stalker
71957.FlavorText: The forest's cover offers shade, shelter, and an increased risk of sudden death.

71958.Name: Colossal Dreadmaw
71958.FlavorText: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

71959.Name: Cultivate
71959.FlavorText: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

71960.Name: Drowsing Tyrannodon
71960.FlavorText: What the rangers thought were warning growls turned out to be nothing but monstrous snoring.

71964.Name: Fungal Rebirth
71964.FlavorText:
"We're all food for something in the end."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

71966.Name: Garruk's Gorehorn
71966.FlavorText:
"It certainly takes after its master: big and brutish, and you can smell it from a mile away."
—Liliana Vess

71970.Name: Heroic Intervention
71970.FlavorText:
"Wherever the strong would harm the weak, I will be there."
—Ajani Goldmane

71972.Name: Invigorating Surge
71972.FlavorText: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

71973.Name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
71973.FlavorText: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

71974.Name: Life Goes On
71974.FlavorText:
"If you believe the God-Pharaoh tests you, charge with me to prove yourself. If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!"
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

71975.Name: Llanowar Visionary
71975.FlavorText: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.

71977.Name: Portcullis Vine
71977.FlavorText: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."

71979.Name: Primal Might
71979.FlavorText: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

71980.Name: Quirion Dryad
71980.FlavorText:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

71981.Name: Ranger's Guile
71981.FlavorText:
"You don't survive in the wild by standing in plain sight."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

71982.Name: Return to Nature
71982.FlavorText:
"Yes, nature is stronger. You don't see little buildings sprouting on trees."
—Emmara

71983.Name: Run Afoul
71983.FlavorText:
"What did you catch today, my pet? Ah, it looks like a bit of vampire stuck between your teeth."
—Atla Palani, nest tender

71984.Name: Sabertooth Mauler
71984.FlavorText:
"I hope the idiot who introduced these creatures to the jungle was their first meal."
—Opar, veteran guide

71985.Name: Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest
71985.FlavorText:
Beneath bright blossoms
Verdant with spring's rich bounty,
The soul blooms in song.

71986.Name: Scavenging Ooze
71986.FlavorText: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

71988.Name: Skyway Sniper
71988.FlavorText: "No sight is more beautiful than a clear sky."

71989.Name: Snarespinner
71989.FlavorText:
"Let's lure the drakes to the webs over the Samok Stand. Keep the spiders content."
—Aurelia

71990.Name: Sporeweb Weaver
71990.FlavorText: It spins its web throughout the undercity, strange growths sprouting in its wake.

71991.Name: Thrashing Brontodon
71991.FlavorText: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

71992.Name: Titanic Growth
71992.FlavorText: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

71993.Name: Track Down
71993.FlavorText: Scents fade and footprints wash away, but some trails can never be erased.

71994.Name: Trufflesnout
71994.FlavorText: Its exploits are the stuff of legends among local chefs and fuel for nightmares among the forest thallids.

71995.Name: Warden of the Woods
71995.FlavorText: Weak and strong alike seek shelter beneath its branches.

72000.Name: Experimental Overload
72000.FlavorText: Explosions aren't necessarily failures, just a different kind of success.

72001.Name: Indulging Patrician
72001.FlavorText: "Just a nibble for now. I wouldn't want to ruin my appetite."

72002.Name: Leafkin Avenger
72002.FlavorText: "My roots are ash, my heart a smoldering ember. What I could not protect, I will avenge."

72003.Name: Lorescale Coatl
72003.FlavorText:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

72005.Name: Obsessive Stitcher
72005.FlavorText: No one is as dedicated to perfection as a stitcher working on their latest masterpiece.

72008.Name: Twinblade Assassins
72008.FlavorText: Rumors swirl of a pair of deadly Golgari assassins known only as the Left and Right Hands of the Ochran.

72010.Name: Chromatic Orrery
72010.FlavorText: Visitors marvel at its design, unaware of the other world that inspired it.

72011.Name: Chrome Replicator
72011.FlavorText: Who would you trust to watch your back more than yourself?

72012.Name: Epitaph Golem
72012.FlavorText: Many names and many memories bound together in grim purpose.

72013.Name: Forgotten Sentinel
72013.FlavorText: It was built to withstand the ages, but no one remembers who built it or why it keeps its eternal watch.

72016.Name: Palladium Myr
72016.FlavorText: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

72017.Name: Prismite
72017.FlavorText: Even its shadow is a dazzling rainbow.

72018.Name: Short Sword
72018.FlavorText:
"Sometimes the only difference between a martyr and a hero is a sword."
—Captain Sisay, Memoirs

72019.Name: Silent Dart
72019.FlavorText: "These terms are acceptable to House Dimir. Shall we shake on it?"

72020.Name: Skyscanner
72020.FlavorText: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.

72023.Name: Tormod's Crypt
72023.FlavorText: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

72028.Name: Fabled Passage
72028.FlavorText: From here, the path to anywhere may be found.

72030.Name: Radiant Fountain
72030.FlavorText:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

72043.Name: Adherent of Hope
72043.FlavorText: "Basri has shown me the way forward, and I will follow."

72044.Name: Basri's Aegis
72044.FlavorText:
"As long as we survive, we can rebuild."
—Basri Ket

72047.Name: Historian of Zhalfir
72047.FlavorText: "Come and listen. I'll tell you the story of a nation lost to time, and of the man who caused it."

72048.Name: Mystic Skyfish
72048.FlavorText: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

72052.Name: Liliana's Scrounger
72052.FlavorText: "This arm's got plenty of use left in it. Who'd throw such a nice thing away?"

72053.Name: Spirit of Malevolence
72053.FlavorText: Great evil weighs on the soul.

72056.Name: Keral Keep Disciples
72056.FlavorText: "You're not setting foot in here. Not on our watch!"

72057.Name: Storm Caller
72057.FlavorText: He became elder shaman when his predecessor was mysteriously struck by lightning on a cloudless day.

72060.Name: Predatory Wurm
72060.FlavorText:
"The strong eat. The weak are eaten. That's the way of things."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

72061.Name: Wildwood Patrol
72061.FlavorText: If you're lucky, the centaurs will give a single warning to leave their territory before driving a spear into you. If you're unlucky, the spear is the warning.

72105.Name: Brightmare
72105.FlavorText: A ray of hope in the darkest night.

72107.Name: Release the Dogs
72107.FlavorText: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

72108.Name: Steel-Plume Marshal
72108.FlavorText: The defenders watched in terror as the flying V split apart into a bristling battle formation.

72109.Name: Stone Haven Pilgrim
72109.FlavorText: The persistence to overcome obstacles is the most esteemed of kor virtues.

72110.Name: Supply Runners
72110.FlavorText: Good dogs stay by your side until the end. Great dogs leave to bring back aid.

72111.Name: Trusty Retriever
72111.FlavorText: Wipe away the slobber and it's as good as new, give or take a few bite marks.

72112.Name: Archaeomender
72112.FlavorText: "Just as a broken relic can be mended, a shattered history can be made whole."

72114.Name: Corsair Captain
72114.FlavorText: "Lungs full of sea air and a hold full of loot. Ah, what a life!"

72119.Name: Nocturnal Feeder
72119.FlavorText: A living pulse is an irresistible temptation.

72120.Name: Tinybones, Trinket Thief
72120.FlavorText: Big distractions mean tiny nuisances can slip by unnoticed.

72122.Name: Chained Brute
72122.FlavorText: A momentary lapse is all it needs to break free.

72125.Name: Lightning Visionary
72125.FlavorText: "The gods don't speak to mortals with gentle entreaties. They speak with thunder and fury."

72126.Name: Living Lightning
72126.FlavorText: Not all storms come from the sky.

72129.Name: Spiteful Prankster
72129.FlavorText: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.

72132.Name: Branching Evolution
72132.FlavorText:
"Is it the water? The stars? Whatever it is, something incredible is happening here."
—Eris, zoologist, journal entry

72135.Name: Lightning-Core Excavator
72135.FlavorText:
"That's the third time this month it's exploded on site. Maybe we should switch to something a little less defective."
—Kerrin, archaeologist

72136.Name: Thriving Bluff
72136.FlavorText: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

72137.Name: Thriving Grove
72137.FlavorText: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

72138.Name: Thriving Heath
72138.FlavorText: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

72139.Name: Thriving Isle
72139.FlavorText: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

72140.Name: Thriving Moor
72140.FlavorText: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

72141.Name: Aegis of the Heavens
72141.FlavorText: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.

72142.Name: Aerial Assault
72142.FlavorText:
"Oh, you must be mistaken. Hawks are solitary hunters, you see."
—Bunder Diedreck, ornithologist

72143.Name: Affa Guard Hound
72143.FlavorText: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

72145.Name: Alabaster Mage
72145.FlavorText:
"We hold sacred the powers of light and life. Truth and honor are our greatest weapons."
—Alabaster creed

72146.Name: Angel of Mercy
72146.FlavorText: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

72147.Name: Angel of the Dire Hour
72147.FlavorText: She arrived like a meteorite, and the enemy fell in a shock wave of holy vengeance.

72149.Name: Angelic Edict
72149.FlavorText: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

72150.Name: Angelic Page
72150.FlavorText: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

72151.Name: Archon of Justice
72151.FlavorText: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

72152.Name: Archon of Redemption
72152.FlavorText: Until Emeria is freed, he raises his sword in her name.

72153.Name: Battlefield Promotion
72153.FlavorText: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

72154.Name: Blessed Spirits
72154.FlavorText: Not all heroes die in armor.

72155.Name: Bulwark Giant
72155.FlavorText:
"Where did she come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura

72156.Name: Cathar's Companion
72156.FlavorText:
"Unwavering and loyal, they represent stability in uncertain times."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Angels

72157.Name: Cathars' Crusade
72157.FlavorText: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

72158.Name: Celestial Mantle
72158.FlavorText: Upon such armor, even a mountain would break.

72159.Name: Cloudshift
72159.FlavorText:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit

72160.Name: Cradle of Vitality
72160.FlavorText: Naya's trees grow tall and sturdy. Their foliage intertwines to form dewcups, rainwater pools where the elves gather to celebrate life.

72161.Name: Dauntless Onslaught
72161.FlavorText:
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

72162.Name: Divine Arrow
72162.FlavorText: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

72163.Name: Duelist's Heritage
72163.FlavorText: The best techniques outlive their creators.

72164.Name: Emancipation Angel
72164.FlavorText: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

72165.Name: Face of Divinity
72165.FlavorText: Pure souls shine bright as daybreak.

72166.Name: Forced Worship
72166.FlavorText: Imprisonment teaches revenge. Hobbling teaches resignation.

72167.Name: Fortify
72167.FlavorText:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

72168.Name: Gird for Battle
72168.FlavorText:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia

72169.Name: Healer's Hawk
72169.FlavorText: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

72171.Name: Indomitable Will
72171.FlavorText:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas

72172.Name: Inspired Charge
72172.FlavorText: "We are armed with light and steel. Who can stand against us?"

72173.Name: Inspiring Captain
72173.FlavorText: "Time to show the foe our true mettle."

72174.Name: Inspiring Unicorn
72174.FlavorText: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.

72175.Name: Isamaru, Hound of Konda
72175.FlavorText: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the guard. The kami are coming."

72178.Name: Kor Spiritdancer
72178.FlavorText: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

72179.Name: Lena, Selfless Champion
72179.FlavorText: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."

72180.Name: Lightwalker
72180.FlavorText:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

72181.Name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
72181.FlavorText: Those who seek to disturb the harmony of life will see their instruments taken from them.

72182.Name: Long Road Home
72182.FlavorText: The person who finishes a journey is rarely the same as the one who starts it.

72183.Name: Mentor of the Meek
72183.FlavorText: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

72184.Name: Mesa Unicorn
72184.FlavorText: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

72186.Name: Moment of Heroism
72186.FlavorText: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

72187.Name: Pacifism
72187.FlavorText: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

72190.Name: Patron of the Valiant
72190.FlavorText: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

72191.Name: Raise the Alarm
72191.FlavorText: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

72192.Name: Rhox Faithmender
72192.FlavorText: Rhoxes who live long enough to retire from war lend support with their extensive knowledge of combat injuries.

72193.Name: Ronom Unicorn
72193.FlavorText: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

72194.Name: Serra Angel
72194.FlavorText: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

72195.Name: Sky Tether
72195.FlavorText:
"If you can't control your mount, I will control it for you."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

72196.Name: Take Heart
72196.FlavorText: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.

72197.Name: Tandem Tactics
72197.FlavorText: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

72198.Name: Valorous Stance
72198.FlavorText:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

72199.Name: Voice of the Provinces
72199.FlavorText: Her horn is heard across Innistrad, lifting the hearts of the righteous.

72200.Name: Aegis Turtle
72200.FlavorText:
"The endurance of the ancient turtles in a land so harsh makes a strong case for patience, tranquility, and composure."
—Gavi, nest warden

72201.Name: Battleground Geist
72201.FlavorText: Not content to nudge vases and chill drawing rooms, some geists muster spectral armies to claw at the hearts of the living.

72202.Name: Befuddle
72202.FlavorText: The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still.

72204.Name: Chart a Course
72204.FlavorText: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

72206.Name: Coastal Piracy
72206.FlavorText: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

72208.Name: Cryptic Serpent
72208.FlavorText: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

72209.Name: Curiosity
72209.FlavorText: "Surely you know the joy of the hunt, my furry friend. My kind of hunt just takes a different form than yours."

72212.Name: Erratic Visionary
72212.FlavorText: An Izzet experiment begins with a "what if," gets approved with a "why not," and concludes with a "eureka!"

72213.Name: Essence Flux
72213.FlavorText: A spirit is both fettered and free—bound in some ways to its previous existence, yet able to transcend much of the corporeal.

72215.Name: Exclusion Mage
72215.FlavorText: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

72216.Name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
72216.FlavorText: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.

72217.Name: Kitesail Corsair
72217.FlavorText: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

72218.Name: Leave in the Dust
72218.FlavorText: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

72219.Name: Murmuring Phantasm
72219.FlavorText:
"The most insidious thing in the world is nonsense that sounds just plausible enough to listen to."
—Lazav

72220.Name: Mystic Archaeologist
72220.FlavorText: The delight of discovery drives the pursuit of knowledge.

72221.Name: Narcolepsy
72221.FlavorText:
"It's so cute when it's sleeping, isn't it? Actually, it's still as abhorrent as ever, but at least it's not trying to kill us."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

72223.Name: Octoprophet
72223.FlavorText: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

72224.Name: Oneirophage
72224.FlavorText: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

72225.Name: Peel from Reality
72225.FlavorText: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

72227.Name: Prosperous Pirates
72227.FlavorText: The floating city of High and Dry hasn't yet sunk under the weight of gold, but it's not for want of trying.

72232.Name: Rishadan Airship
72232.FlavorText: The view is truly spectacular—as long as you don't look at Rishada itself.

72233.Name: Sage's Row Savant
72233.FlavorText: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.

72234.Name: Sailor of Means
72234.FlavorText: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

72236.Name: Selhoff Occultist
72236.FlavorText: "The mist whispers to those who know it to be more than a mundane fog."

72237.Name: Serendib Efreet
72237.FlavorText: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

72238.Name: Sharding Sphinx
72238.FlavorText: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

72239.Name: Sigiled Starfish
72239.FlavorText: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

72240.Name: Spectral Sailor
72240.FlavorText:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

72241.Name: Storm Sculptor
72241.FlavorText: In his hands, the wind can become a weapon or a means of escape.

72242.Name: Sweep Away
72242.FlavorText: The Roil takes many forms. It also takes many victims.

72243.Name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
72243.FlavorText: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

72244.Name: Talrand's Invocation
72244.FlavorText: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

72245.Name: Thirst for Knowledge
72245.FlavorText: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

72246.Name: Thought Collapse
72246.FlavorText:
"I can think of no greater punishment than answering your question in full."
—Lazav

72248.Name: Towering-Wave Mystic
72248.FlavorText: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

72249.Name: Vedalken Archmage
72249.FlavorText:
"The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands."
—Janus, speaker of the synod

72250.Name: Vedalken Entrancer
72250.FlavorText: Their denial reaches far into your future.

72251.Name: Voyage's End
72251.FlavorText: Philosophers say those lost at sea ascended to a more perfect realm. Sailors say they drowned.

72252.Name: Wall of Lost Thoughts
72252.FlavorText: Those who intrude upon the Dimir seldom remember that they have done so.

72253.Name: Warden of Evos Isle
72253.FlavorText: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

72255.Name: Whelming Wave
72255.FlavorText:
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa."
—Kiora

72256.Name: Windreader Sphinx
72256.FlavorText: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

72257.Name: Windstorm Drake
72257.FlavorText: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

72258.Name: Winged Words
72258.FlavorText: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

72259.Name: Wishful Merfolk
72259.FlavorText: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.

72260.Name: Wizard's Retort
72260.FlavorText:
"The second mage learned to dissipate blasts of lightning. Threat and response: thus did the study of magic progress."
—Naban, dean of iteration

72261.Name: Agonizing Syphon
72261.FlavorText:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

72262.Name: Assassin's Strike
72262.FlavorText: When Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter, they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

72263.Name: Bake into a Pie
72263.FlavorText: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

72264.Name: Barter in Blood
72264.FlavorText:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

72265.Name: Black Cat
72265.FlavorText: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

72267.Name: Blighted Bat
72267.FlavorText: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.

72268.Name: Blood Artist
72268.FlavorText: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

72269.Name: Blood Divination
72269.FlavorText: Predicting the future is a messy business.

72270.Name: Blood Host
72270.FlavorText: It would be ill-mannered to decline his invitation. It would be ill-advised to accept it.

72271.Name: Bloodbond Vampire
72271.FlavorText:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

72272.Name: Bloodhunter Bat
72272.FlavorText: It returns eager to share the feast of blood and gore with its ghoulish master.

72273.Name: Bogbrew Witch
72273.FlavorText: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

72274.Name: Bone Picker
72274.FlavorText: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

72275.Name: Bone Splinters
72275.FlavorText:
"Which do you deserve, the heft of a femur or the graceful sharpness of a forearm? Decisions, decisions . . ."
—Gisa the Mad

72276.Name: Burglar Rat
72276.FlavorText:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

72277.Name: Cadaver Imp
72277.FlavorText: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

72278.Name: Cauldron Familiar
72278.FlavorText: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

72279.Name: Cemetery Recruitment
72279.FlavorText: "There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."

72280.Name: Child of Night
72280.FlavorText: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.

72281.Name: Corpse Hauler
72281.FlavorText:
"He expects a reward, but the only piece of silver he'll get from me is my blade in his gut."
—Shelac, necromancer

72283.Name: Crow of Dark Tidings
72283.FlavorText:
"Well, this can't be a good sign." 
—Old Rutstein

72284.Name: Death's Approach
72284.FlavorText:
"It's cold in the grave, and the dead crave your warmth. Who are you to deny them?"
—Strava, Dimir mage

72285.Name: Douse in Gloom
72285.FlavorText: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle. He failed to notice the Sultai leader's cruel smile.

72286.Name: Drainpipe Vermin
72286.FlavorText: When times are tough, the poor eat the rats. When times are tougher, the rats eat the poor.

72287.Name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
72287.FlavorText: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

72288.Name: Dutiful Attendant
72288.FlavorText: The dragon who eats the last head in the basket is entitled to the servant's.

72290.Name: Eternal Taskmaster
72290.FlavorText:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren

72293.Name: Exquisite Blood
72293.FlavorText: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.

72294.Name: Falkenrath Noble
72294.FlavorText: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

72296.Name: Festering Newt
72296.FlavorText: Its back bubbles like a witch's cauldron, and it smells just as vile.

72297.Name: Funeral Rites
72297.FlavorText: Funerary masks help the newly dead resist the erosion of memory and identity in the Underworld.

72298.Name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
72298.FlavorText: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

72299.Name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
72299.FlavorText: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

72300.Name: Ghoulraiser
72300.FlavorText:
"Come. Bring your brothers. Tonight, you feast on living flesh."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

72301.Name: Gifted Aetherborn
72301.FlavorText: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

72303.Name: Gravewaker
72303.FlavorText: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

72304.Name: Gristle Grinner
72304.FlavorText:
"There it was, clawing the ice as it chittered and clicked its teeth. We fled in horror before it unearthed its grisly meal."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry

72305.Name: Harvester of Souls
72305.FlavorText:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

72306.Name: Innocent Blood
72306.FlavorText: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

72307.Name: Kalastria Nightwatch
72307.FlavorText:
"Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

72308.Name: Languish
72308.FlavorText: Life is such a fragile thing.

72309.Name: Last Gasp
72309.FlavorText: Takedowns in Valor's Reach are never meant to be lethal, but that doesn't mean they won't be incredibly painful.

72310.Name: Launch Party
72310.FlavorText: Life's too short to not do the things you love.

72311.Name: Lawless Broker
72311.FlavorText: Kaladesh's illicit marketplaces are known as "night markets," but if you know who to ask, you can find what you're looking for at any time of the day.

72312.Name: Liliana's Elite
72312.FlavorText:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

72314.Name: Macabre Waltz
72314.FlavorText: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

72315.Name: Malakir Familiar
72315.FlavorText:
"They are deadly, and they are loyal. We can spare them a little blood."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

72316.Name: Mark of the Vampire
72316.FlavorText:
"My ‘condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

72318.Name: Miasmic Mummy
72318.FlavorText: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.

72319.Name: Mire Triton
72319.FlavorText: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

72320.Name: Nightshade Stinger
72320.FlavorText:
"Most faeries are harmless pranksters. Every now and again, though, you get one that crosses over from mischievous to malicious."
—Gaddock Teeg

72321.Name: Nyxathid
72321.FlavorText: Born of volcanic forces, it thrives on the absolute panic it inspires.

72322.Name: Ogre Slumlord
72322.FlavorText:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

72325.Name: Phyrexian Broodlings
72325.FlavorText: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

72326.Name: Phyrexian Debaser
72326.FlavorText:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes

72327.Name: Phyrexian Gargantua
72327.FlavorText: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

72328.Name: Phyrexian Rager
72328.FlavorText:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

72329.Name: Phyrexian Reclamation
72329.FlavorText: Death is no excuse to stop working.

72330.Name: Plagued Rusalka
72330.FlavorText:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

72331.Name: Ravenous Chupacabra
72331.FlavorText: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

72333.Name: Rise of the Dark Realms
72333.FlavorText:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

72335.Name: Sanitarium Skeleton
72335.FlavorText: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

72337.Name: Sengir Vampire
72337.FlavorText: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

72338.Name: Settle the Score
72338.FlavorText:
"You bound me with a contract only your death could end—and you thought me the fool?"
—Liliana Vess

72339.Name: Shambling Goblin
72339.FlavorText:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

72341.Name: Slate Street Ruffian
72341.FlavorText:
"Merciless to the point of psychosis. Let's give him a job."
—Zelinas, Orzhov recruiter

72342.Name: Soul Salvage
72342.FlavorText: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

72344.Name: Swarm of Bloodflies
72344.FlavorText: In the Gudul delta, bloodfly bites are indistinguishable from spear wounds.

72345.Name: Tempting Witch
72345.FlavorText:
"Murder clad in crimson beauty,
An end to life and love and duty."
—Barrow witch incantation

72346.Name: Tithebearer Giant
72346.FlavorText:
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them."
—Teysa

72347.Name: Vampire Neonate
72347.FlavorText: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.

72348.Name: Wailing Ghoul
72348.FlavorText:
"Don't worry, sweet brother. Help is on the way."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

72349.Name: Wight of Precinct Six
72349.FlavorText: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

72350.Name: Zombie Infestation
72350.FlavorText: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

72351.Name: Act of Treason
72351.FlavorText: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

72352.Name: Ashmouth Hound
72352.FlavorText: Its fiery paws make it easy to track, which is very useful when you want to go in exactly the opposite direction.

72354.Name: Barrage of Expendables
72354.FlavorText: Goblin generals don't distinguish between troops and ammunition.

72355.Name: Bathe in Dragonfire
72355.FlavorText: The scent of cooked flesh lingers in the charred landscape of Tarkir.

72356.Name: Beetleback Chief
72356.FlavorText: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

72357.Name: Blindblast
72357.FlavorText:
"Peril is in the eye of the beholder. At least, if your aim is good."
—Jaya Ballard

72358.Name: Bloodrage Brawler
72358.FlavorText: To Hazoret, those who fight for her are her beloved children.

72359.Name: Bloodrock Cyclops
72359.FlavorText:
"There are only fifty words in the cyclops language, and ten of them mean ‘kill.'"
—Ertai

72360.Name: Bloodshot Trainee
72360.FlavorText: "Just think how strong I'll be if my arms don't tear off!"

72361.Name: Boggart Brute
72361.FlavorText: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

72362.Name: Borderland Marauder
72362.FlavorText: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

72363.Name: Borderland Minotaur
72363.FlavorText:
"You have led us to triumph over the forces of Mogis!" said Brygus the Brave, clapping the Champion on the back.
The Champion wiped the sweat and blood from her brow.
"I count eight graves," she said. "Too many to call this a victory."
—The Theriad

72366.Name: Cinder Elemental
72366.FlavorText:
"The old gods awoke and sent fingers of fire to see what was left of the old ways under the endless city."
—Daiva, Gruul storyteller

72367.Name: Collateral Damage
72367.FlavorText: It is much easier to create fire than to contain it.

72368.Name: Dance with Devils
72368.FlavorText: Devils sow chaos and reap panic.

72369.Name: Doublecast
72369.FlavorText: First the insult, then the encore.

72371.Name: Dragon Fodder
72371.FlavorText: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

72372.Name: Dragon Hatchling
72372.FlavorText:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

72373.Name: Dragonlord's Servant
72373.FlavorText: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

72374.Name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
72374.FlavorText: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

72375.Name: Dualcaster Mage
72375.FlavorText: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

72376.Name: Etali, Primal Storm
72376.FlavorText: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

72377.Name: Fanatical Firebrand
72377.FlavorText:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

72379.Name: Flames of the Firebrand
72379.FlavorText:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

72380.Name: Flames of the Raze-Boar
72380.FlavorText: "Fire will cure a multitude of ills."

72382.Name: Fling
72382.FlavorText: Never flinch. Never falter. Never fear.

72383.Name: Flurry of Horns
72383.FlavorText: A minotaur does not distinguish between human, satyr, and triton. They are all meat.

72384.Name: Forge Devil
72384.FlavorText: A bit of pain never hurts.

72385.Name: Furnace Whelp
72385.FlavorText: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

72387.Name: Goblin Commando
72387.FlavorText: With a commando around, somebody's gonna get hurt.

72391.Name: Goblin Rally
72391.FlavorText: You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.

72392.Name: Goblin Shortcutter
72392.FlavorText: "I'm not running away! I'm figuring out the best routes."

72393.Name: Grim Lavamancer
72393.FlavorText: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

72394.Name: Hamletback Goliath
72394.FlavorText:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

72395.Name: Heartfire
72395.FlavorText: The mage looked within and realized there was still one piece of fuel to burn.

72396.Name: Hellrider
72396.FlavorText:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

72397.Name: Homing Lightning
72397.FlavorText:
"I see countless worlds. What makes them think I can't find them in just one?"
—Ral Zarek

72398.Name: Hungry Flames
72398.FlavorText: In the hold of the Heart of Kiran, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

72400.Name: Kiln Fiend
72400.FlavorText: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

72401.Name: Krenko, Mob Boss
72401.FlavorText:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

72403.Name: Lightning Axe
72403.FlavorText: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

72405.Name: Lightning Diadem
72405.FlavorText: "I fight for Keranos and for mortals. I see no contradiction."

72406.Name: Lightning Elemental
72406.FlavorText:
"Oh, it's easy enough to kill, but I'm not going anywhere near it."
—Norin the Wary

72407.Name: Lightning Shrieker
72407.FlavorText: Dragonslayers learned to keep silent about their deeds after seeing the terrible vengeance wrought by Kolaghan and her brood.

72408.Name: Magma Jet
72408.FlavorText: Some Akroans make the dangerous pilgrimage to the volcanic temples of Purphoros, where oracles known as flamespeakers glean omens from lava.

72409.Name: Magmaquake
72409.FlavorText:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

72410.Name: Makeshift Munitions
72410.FlavorText: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

72411.Name: Minotaur Skullcleaver
72411.FlavorText:
"Their only dreams are of full stomachs."
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

72412.Name: Minotaur Sureshot
72412.FlavorText: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."

72413.Name: Molten Ravager
72413.FlavorText:
"Only the foolhardy would venture into the Akoum Mountains without a lullmage to tame the raging rocks and living fires."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

72414.Name: Mugging
72414.FlavorText: Scream: muffled. Pockets: emptied. Neck function: never the same again.

72415.Name: Ornery Goblin
72415.FlavorText: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."

72416.Name: Outnumber
72416.FlavorText: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

72417.Name: Pillar of Flame
