72417.FlavorText: "May the worthy spend an eternity in Blessed Sleep. May the wicked find the peace of oblivion."

72418.Name: Pyroclastic Elemental
72418.FlavorText:
"Whoever thought of making mobile volcanoes was a genius."
—Chandra Nalaar

72419.Name: Rageblood Shaman
72419.FlavorText:
"I see a spark of pure rage. Soon that spark will spread from the depths of Kragma. Soon its fire will engulf the polis."
—Hira, street oracle

72420.Name: Rapacious Dragon
72420.FlavorText:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

72422.Name: Sarkhan's Rage
72422.FlavorText: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

72424.Name: Seismic Elemental
72424.FlavorText:
"Trying to stop it would be foolish. If you feel it coming—run!"
—Sergeant Ryda

72426.Name: Spitting Earth
72426.FlavorText:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

72427.Name: Thermo-Alchemist
72427.FlavorText: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

72428.Name: Tibalt's Rager
72428.FlavorText:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

72429.Name: Torch Fiend
72429.FlavorText: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

72430.Name: Volcanic Fallout
72430.FlavorText:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

72432.Name: Warfire Javelineer
72432.FlavorText: Minotaurs favor magic that manifests as weapons wrapped in flame.

72433.Name: Weaver of Lightning
72433.FlavorText: "Lightning in a bottle? That's not where I need it."

72434.Name: Young Pyromancer
72434.FlavorText: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

72435.Name: Affectionate Indrik
72435.FlavorText: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

72436.Name: Aggressive Urge
72436.FlavorText: The power of the wild, concentrated in a single charge.

72437.Name: Ambassador Oak
72437.FlavorText: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

72438.Name: Arbor Armament
72438.FlavorText:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

72439.Name: Armorcraft Judge
72439.FlavorText: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

72441.Name: Awakener Druid
72441.FlavorText: The druids of Mazar treat each seedcone with respect for the warrior it will become.

72442.Name: Brindle Shoat
72442.FlavorText: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

72443.Name: Brushstrider
72443.FlavorText: Magistrate Ludy agreed to designate land for the brushstriders only after several broken windows and dozens of missing blini-cakes.

72444.Name: Carven Caryatid
72444.FlavorText: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

72447.Name: Craterhoof Behemoth
72447.FlavorText: Its footsteps of today are the lakes of tomorrow.

72448.Name: Crushing Canopy
72448.FlavorText:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

72449.Name: Dawntreader Elk
72449.FlavorText: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

72450.Name: Drover of the Mighty
72450.FlavorText: "I do not lead. They do not follow. We walk together."

72452.Name: Elemental Uprising
72452.FlavorText:
"My heart and Zendikar's beat as one. Together we will endure."
—Nissa Revane

72453.Name: Elvish Archdruid
72453.FlavorText: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

72454.Name: Enlarge
72454.FlavorText: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

72455.Name: Explore
72455.FlavorText: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

72457.Name: Feral Hydra
72457.FlavorText: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

72458.Name: Feral Invocation
72458.FlavorText: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

72459.Name: Feral Prowler
72459.FlavorText: Once favored companions, many cats were left to fend for themselves.

72461.Name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
72461.FlavorText: The earth walks, strongest of all.

72462.Name: Ghirapur Guide
72462.FlavorText: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

72464.Name: Hunter's Insight
72464.FlavorText:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

72465.Name: Initiate's Companion
72465.FlavorText:
"I'd like to say that it's our pet, but the reverse may be closer to the truth."
—Ixor, initiate of Rhet crop

72466.Name: Inspiring Call
72466.FlavorText: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"

72467.Name: Ironshell Beetle
72467.FlavorText:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

72468.Name: Irresistible Prey
72468.FlavorText: The baloth's instincts boiled, its muscles pulled taut, and its razor-spines bristled, as it turned to face—a runt meepling.

72469.Name: Keeper of Fables
72469.FlavorText:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

72470.Name: Leaf Gilder
72470.FlavorText: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful. Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

72471.Name: Lifecrafter's Gift
72471.FlavorText: The best engineers recognize when a problem has already been solved.

72472.Name: Lurking Predators
72472.FlavorText: All are prey to the eyes of the wild.

72473.Name: Momentous Fall
72473.FlavorText: It wasn't long until the elves had developed a use for every part of the Eldrazi.

72474.Name: Nature's Way
72474.FlavorText: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

72475.Name: Nessian Hornbeetle
72475.FlavorText:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

72478.Name: Orazca Frillback
72478.FlavorText: The frillbacks of Orazca soak up the sun on their tall spinal fins. They look slow and sleepy—until they catch the scent of prey.

72479.Name: Overgrown Battlement
72479.FlavorText:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—The War Diaries

72480.Name: Penumbra Bobcat
72480.FlavorText: This cat has two lives and it's hunting for more.

72481.Name: Pouncing Cheetah
72481.FlavorText: Rhonas's monument is home to a wider variety of creatures than anywhere else in the city of Naktamun—a feature most initiates fail to appreciate.

72482.Name: Presence of Gond
72482.FlavorText: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

72484.Name: Primordial Sage
72484.FlavorText: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

72485.Name: Rampaging Brontodon
72485.FlavorText: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

72486.Name: Ravenous Baloth
72486.FlavorText:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

72487.Name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
72487.FlavorText: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

72488.Name: Rumbling Baloth
72488.FlavorText: In the dim light beneath the vast trees of Deepglade, baloths prowl in search of prey. Their guttural calls are more felt than heard, but their attack scream carries for miles.

72492.Name: Silhana Wayfinder
72492.FlavorText: "Stay close! It's just a little farther."

72493.Name: Somberwald Stag
72493.FlavorText: Despite the reemergence of werewolves and the proliferation of Eldrazi, elk numbers in the Somberwald have remained steady.

72494.Name: Soul of the Harvest
72494.FlavorText: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

72495.Name: Sporemound
72495.FlavorText:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

72496.Name: Sylvan Brushstrider
72496.FlavorText: The mournful lowing of brushstriders warns of changing weather and ill winds.

72497.Name: Sylvan Ranger
72497.FlavorText: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

72499.Name: Thundering Spineback
72499.FlavorText:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

72504.Name: Wall of Blossoms
72504.FlavorText: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

72505.Name: Wall of Vines
72505.FlavorText: Like all jungle plants, the vines must fight and claw for sunlight. Once their place is secured, they grow strong, sharp, and impenetrable.

72506.Name: Wildheart Invoker
72506.FlavorText:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—The Invokers' Tales

72507.Name: Wildsize
72507.FlavorText: Two times the size, four times the smell.

72508.Name: Woodborn Behemoth
72508.FlavorText: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

72510.Name: Zendikar's Roil
72510.FlavorText:
"I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me. It isn't after any of us. It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain."
—Nissa Revane

72511.Name: Auger Spree
72511.FlavorText:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

72512.Name: Dinrova Horror
72512.FlavorText:
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits."
—Sign outside Dinrova Building

72513.Name: Fusion Elemental
72513.FlavorText: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

72514.Name: Ironroot Warlord
72514.FlavorText:
"Alone, it's a fortification. At the head of its troops, it's a battering ram."
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

72516.Name: Maelstrom Archangel
72516.FlavorText: There is no world where angels fear to tread.

72517.Name: Raging Regisaur
72517.FlavorText: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.

72518.Name: Aether Spellbomb
72518.FlavorText:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

72519.Name: Alloy Myr
72519.FlavorText: With or without witnesses, the suns continued their prismatic dance.

72520.Name: Ancestral Statue
72520.FlavorText: The mage awakened the statue in hopes of learning the lost lore of her clan, but the statue was interested only in war.

72521.Name: Arcane Encyclopedia
72521.FlavorText: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.

72524.Name: Chromatic Sphere
72524.FlavorText:
"As expected, this sphere's design reflects the colors of the four moons . . . plus another?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

72525.Name: Dragonloft Idol
72525.FlavorText: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

72526.Name: Dreamstone Hedron
72526.FlavorText: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

72527.Name: Gargoyle Sentinel
72527.FlavorText:
"Do not mistake a quiet rampart for one that is unguarded. Some things stir only when they need to."
—Bonovar, siege commander

72528.Name: Gingerbrute
72528.FlavorText: The unlabeled vial was not vanilla extract after all.

72530.Name: Hedron Archive
72530.FlavorText:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

72532.Name: Jousting Dummy
72532.FlavorText:
"Don't let it fool you. Many of us got our first scars from Syr Nobody."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth

72533.Name: Juggernaut
72533.FlavorText: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

72534.Name: Mana Geode
72534.FlavorText:
"I don't care if it's an all-powerful relic or a street vendor's lucky charm. If it brings you courage, wear it."
—Saheeli Rai

72535.Name: Marauder's Axe
72535.FlavorText: A sharp axe solves most problems.

72536.Name: Meteor Golem
72536.FlavorText: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

72537.Name: Myr Sire
72537.FlavorText: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

72538.Name: Perilous Myr
72538.FlavorText: To Mirrodin, an explosive. To Phyrexia, a missionary.

72540.Name: Prophetic Prism
72540.FlavorText: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

72541.Name: Rogue's Gloves
72541.FlavorText: Thievery requires subtlety, from the beginning of the heist to the end.

72542.Name: Roving Keep
72542.FlavorText:
"It wandered slowly across the landscape, calling out in its lonely voice, but no other castles answered its cries."
—Beyond the Great Henge

72543.Name: Runed Servitor
72543.FlavorText: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

72544.Name: Scarecrone
72544.FlavorText: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.

72545.Name: Scroll of Avacyn
72545.FlavorText: Words to bless the eye that reads them, telling of a future beyond the reach of fear.

72546.Name: Scuttlemutt
72546.FlavorText: With five lenses on its "head," it sees the world in a range of colors beyond ordinary perception.

72547.Name: Signpost Scarecrow
72547.FlavorText:
"Accursed scarecrow! Sending folk in every direction is the same as sending them nowhere at all."
—Corliss the Wanderer

72548.Name: Skittering Surveyor
72548.FlavorText: Like a cross between a spider and a spyglass, but friendlier.

72549.Name: Suspicious Bookcase
72549.FlavorText: All the books were dusty with disuse, save the one titled Camouflage and Its Practical Applications.

72551.Name: Unstable Obelisk
72551.FlavorText: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

72552.Name: Warmonger's Chariot
72552.FlavorText: The best defense is a good offense.

72553.Name: Buried Ruin
72553.FlavorText: History has buried its treasures deep.

72555.Name: Phyrexian Tower
72555.FlavorText:
"Yawgmoth is dead, and his citadels lie empty. But there will always be some who seek power at any price."
—Karn

72598.Name: Terramorphic Expanse
72598.FlavorText:
"The land has its own intentions, beyond the understanding of those who live on it."
—Nissa Revane

73183.Name: Allied Assault
73183.FlavorText: A common foe is the death of old hatreds.

73186.Name: Archon of Emeria
73186.FlavorText:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane

73188.Name: Attended Healer
73188.FlavorText: "My cats have taught me more about the sacred than anything in some old ruin."

73189.Name: Canyon Jerboa
73189.FlavorText:
"Move, you wretched thing! You're scaring the hurdas!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

73190.Name: Cliffhaven Sell-Sword
73190.FlavorText: "I swing a sword. It's a simple life. A lot of adventurers just see me as some cheap muscle, but if my steel lets them return home with their lives and limbs intact, then I've done my job."

73192.Name: Disenchant
73192.FlavorText: "From legend it was forged, and to legend it returns."

73193.Name: Emeria Captain
73193.FlavorText: "The gifts of the past must find their way into deserving hands."

73194.Name: Emeria's Call
73194.FlavorText:
"Iona no longer guards this place. We do."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd
73194.RawFrameDetail: W front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73195.Name: Emeria, Shattered Skyclave
73195.FlavorText:
"You called it the castle of a god. It is less than that, and so much more."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd
73195.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73196.Name: Expedition Healer
73196.FlavorText: In any adventuring party, the cleric is the heart: healing wounds, inspiring courage, and raising morale.

73197.Name: Farsight Adept
73197.FlavorText: "I've walked every one of the Teetering Peaks and never set a foot wrong. I can get you to safety."

73198.Name: Fearless Fledgling
73198.FlavorText: Griffins nest in precarious places, so fledglings often find themselves taking their first flights at surprising moments.

73201.Name: Kabira Outrider
73201.FlavorText: Ondu moas make wildly uncomfortable mounts, but for determined warriors, their speed is enough to make up for it.

73202.Name: Kabira Takedown
73202.FlavorText:
"Down below's where things go to die."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
73202.RawFrameDetail: W front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73203.Name: Kabira Plateau
73203.FlavorText:
"Wise adventurers—and clever beasties—stick to the higher ground."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
73203.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73204.Name: Kitesail Cleric
73204.FlavorText: Too flashy to ignore. Too fast to catch.

73205.Name: Kor Blademaster
73205.FlavorText: Every kor blade is imbued with the skill of a thousand generations.

73206.Name: Kor Celebrant
73206.FlavorText: "The landbind ritual connects us to our sacred sites. More importantly, it binds us with every other kor who has visited here, through countless generations."

73208.Name: Luminarch Aspirant
73208.FlavorText: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"

73209.Name: Makindi Ox
73209.FlavorText:
"May bloodflies empty your veins and turn you into a dried leather sack, cow!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

73210.Name: Makindi Stampede
73210.FlavorText:
"They say the wind carved out these canyon walls. But the floor was hammered flat by hooves."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
73210.RawFrameDetail: W front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73211.Name: Makindi Mesas
73211.FlavorText:
"The ground is rumbling. Better hope it's just the Roil!"
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
73211.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73213.Name: Mesa Lynx
73213.FlavorText: Its ferocity is tempered by patience, knowing it must wait for just the right moment to strike a killing blow.

73214.Name: Nahiri's Binding
73214.FlavorText: "This is my world, Jace, down to its very bones."

73215.Name: Ondu Inversion
73215.FlavorText:
"At first rumble you'd best hold on tight and pray to any gods you still hold dear."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
73215.RawFrameDetail: W front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73216.Name: Ondu Skyruins
73216.FlavorText:
"It always seems so quiet in the aftermath of wrenching violence."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
73216.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73217.Name: Paired Tactician
73217.FlavorText: "If we fight as one, nothing can stand in our way!"

73218.Name: Practiced Tactics
73218.FlavorText: Each individual has their own crucial role to play.

73219.Name: Pressure Point
73219.FlavorText: Poke a drake in the right place and it becomes as docile as a pet. Poke it in the wrong place and goodbye, hand.

73220.Name: Prowling Felidar
73220.FlavorText: On occasion, felidars leave meaty "gifts" outside the tents of explorers they consider worthy.

73221.Name: Resolute Strike
73221.FlavorText:
"If you practice something often enough, it becomes part of you. That's why we train, and that's why we survive."
—Tasha, Graypelt veteran

73222.Name: Sea Gate Banneret
73222.FlavorText: The Sea Gate Expeditionary House was founded after the discovery of the Skyclave over Tazeem. Now its banners fly over every corner of Zendikar.

73223.Name: Sejiri Shelter
73223.FlavorText:
"It blocks the windswept salt and frigid air, but the loneliness of Sejiri remains."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73223.RawFrameDetail: W front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73224.Name: Sejiri Glacier
73224.FlavorText:
"This place offers nothing and takes everything."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73224.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73227.Name: Skyclave Cleric
73227.FlavorText:
"Well, she can jump farther than I can."
—Aelah, expedition cleric
73227.RawFrameDetail: W front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73228.Name: Skyclave Basilica
73228.FlavorText:
"As points of no return go, it is quite epic."
—Aelah, expedition cleric
73228.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73230.Name: Smite the Monstrous
73230.FlavorText:
"Darkness always flees from the light, and I am the breaking dawn."
—Kordain, luminarch of Kabira

73231.Name: Tazeem Raptor
73231.FlavorText:
"It's good to see the eagles circling the Lighthouse once again."
—Tazri

73234.Name: Beyeen Veil
73234.FlavorText:
"All you minnows in the murk, come to my light."
—Jejenar, Silundi lullmage
73234.RawFrameDetail: U front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73235.Name: Beyeen Coast
73235.FlavorText:
"Stay close to my light. You don't want to get lost on the rocks."
—Jejenar, Silundi lullmage
73235.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73237.Name: Cascade Seer
73237.FlavorText: "Perhaps you can't see the path, but that doesn't mean it isn't there."

73238.Name: Charix, the Raging Isle
73238.FlavorText: Zendikar's seas are deeper than anyone can fathom.

73239.Name: Chilling Trap
73239.FlavorText:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder

73240.Name: Cleric of Chill Depths
73240.FlavorText: "Before my people turned to false gods, we built a glittering city beneath the northern sea ice. The magic of ancient Benthidrix lives in me!"

73241.Name: Concerted Defense
73241.FlavorText: "You mess with one of us, you mess with all of us!"

73244.Name: Cunning Geysermage
73244.FlavorText: "Come on, Skitch, we'll lose them in the geyserfield."

73245.Name: Deliberate
73245.FlavorText: "I can't see all that the future holds, but I can keep us one step ahead of death."

73246.Name: Expedition Diviner
73246.FlavorText: Wizards' spells twist the fabric of reality to channel elemental energies, peer into the future, and even calm the Roil.

73247.Name: Field Research
73247.FlavorText: "In the field, speed-reading is a survival skill."

73249.Name: Glasspool Mimic
73249.FlavorText:
"When I touched the Glasspool, I tasted infinite possibility."
—Ashen Wal, Akoum Expeditionary House
73249.RawFrameDetail: U front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73250.Name: Glasspool Shore
73250.FlavorText:
"Past and possibility come together in the vastness of infinite reflection."
—Ashen Wal, Akoum Expeditionary House
73250.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73252.Name: Into the Roil
73252.FlavorText: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

73254.Name: Jwari Disruption
73254.FlavorText:
"You worry too much."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
73254.RawFrameDetail: U front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73255.Name: Jwari Ruins
73255.FlavorText:
"The Ondu Skyclave was a center for rebellion against the capital in Makindi. Of course they built in deadly traps."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
73255.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73256.Name: Living Tempest
73256.FlavorText:
"If you don't like the weather, just wait a few minutes and it'll change . . . probably for the worse."
—Amandi, kitesail expert

73257.Name: Lullmage's Domination
73257.FlavorText: "One spell to quiet the Roil, one to quash the will. The principle is the same."

73258.Name: Maddening Cacophony
73258.FlavorText: Jace traced Nahiri to the Singing City, but the magic of the ancient ruins threatened to overwhelm his mind.

73260.Name: Merfolk Falconer
73260.FlavorText: "For generations, we have bred and trained falcons for expeditions into Emeria. Now more sky ruins open themselves to those with the means to reach the heights!"

73262.Name: Negate
73262.FlavorText: "The ancient kor were a clever bunch with a taste for nasty traps. Spikes, poison, fire pouring forth with no warning . . . I've seen and disabled them all. If you intend to raid a Skyclave, you'd be wise to hire me on."

73264.Name: Risen Riptide
73264.FlavorText:
"Most days the sea is my friend. But only most days."
—Jori En, expedition leader

73266.Name: Ruin Crab
73266.FlavorText: To an explorer, a priceless treasure. To the crab, a rock to call home.

73267.Name: Sea Gate Restoration
73267.FlavorText:
"We have much to remember . . . and much we can never forget."
—Tazri
73267.RawFrameDetail: U front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73268.Name: Sea Gate, Reborn
73268.FlavorText:
"We carry on the legacy of those who defended our world by continuing to unearth its secrets."
—Tazri
73268.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73272.Name: Silundi Vision
73272.FlavorText:
"Feel the current? Rough waters lie ahead."
—Jori En, expedition leader
73272.RawFrameDetail: U front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73273.Name: Silundi Isle
73273.FlavorText:
"From the hedron fields of Agadeem to the Faduun of Jwar Isle, the islands of the Silundi Sea offer one mystery after another."
—Jori En, expedition leader
73273.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73275.Name: Skyclave Squid
73275.FlavorText: An ancient sea monster dragged the Murasa Skyclave under the waves, then smaller sea monsters moved in.

73276.Name: Sure-Footed Infiltrator
73276.FlavorText: "I've yet to discover the ruin that can keep me out."

73279.Name: Umara Wizard
73279.FlavorText:
"You see a waterfall. I see a way up."
—Ko Dari, expedition wizard
73279.RawFrameDetail: U front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73280.Name: Umara Skyfalls
73280.FlavorText:
"The source of the Umara River sits high above Oran-Rief, ever weeping on the jungle below."
—Ko Dari, expedition wizard
73280.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73281.Name: Windrider Wizard
73281.FlavorText: "It's an ideal method for exploring sky ruins. The drakes sniff me briefly but then lose interest."

73284.Name: Agadeem's Awakening
73284.FlavorText:
"Now is the death-hour, just before dawn. Wake, sleepers, and haunt the living!"
—Vivias, Witch Vessel
73284.RawFrameDetail: B front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73285.Name: Agadeem, the Undercrypt
73285.FlavorText:
"Here below the hedron fields, souls and secrets lie entombed."
—Vivias, Witch Vessel
73285.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73286.Name: Blackbloom Rogue
73286.FlavorText:
"If you ever want to get back up, do what I say."
—Exena, expedition rogue
73286.RawFrameDetail: B front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73287.Name: Blackbloom Bog
73287.FlavorText:
"The Raimunza River flows along the branches of jaddi trees for miles before plunging down to feed Blackbloom Lake."
—Exena, expedition rogue
73287.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73290.Name: Bloodchief's Thirst
73290.FlavorText: "We are free. It is our duty to live well."

73292.Name: Deadly Alliance
73292.FlavorText: "He could handle any one of us, but he's no match for all of us!"

73293.Name: Demon's Disciple
73293.FlavorText: Taborax's cultists are the latest in a long history of beings who have desired to see Zendikar torn to pieces.

73296.Name: Dreadwurm
73296.FlavorText: Its silent slithering belies its bulk.

73297.Name: Expedition Skulker
73297.FlavorText: Rogues bring an array of useful skills to the work of an adventuring party: stealth, agility, the ability to locate and disarm traps, and a subtle, deadly fighting style.

73298.Name: Feed the Swarm
73298.FlavorText:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

73300.Name: Guul Draz Mucklord
73300.FlavorText: Death comes in many forms on Guul Draz, most of them slow, subtle, and agonizing. At least a monstrous crocodile offers a swift death.

73302.Name: Hagra Mauling
73302.RawFrameDetail: B front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73303.Name: Hagra Broodpit
73303.FlavorText:
"I think we somehow got turned around."
—Doros, expedition guide
73303.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73304.Name: Highborn Vampire
73304.FlavorText: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

73306.Name: Lithoform Blight
73306.FlavorText: Heedless of Nissa's warnings, Nahiri repeated history.

73308.Name: Malakir Rebirth
73308.FlavorText:
"Those who fail to escape Malakir become part of the city's defense."
—Doros, expedition guide
73308.RawFrameDetail: B front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73309.Name: Malakir Mire
73309.FlavorText:
"Getting into Malakir isn't difficult. It's getting out that's the hard part."
—Doros, expedition guide
73309.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73310.Name: Marauding Blight-Priest
73310.FlavorText: "The vampires never had gods. We followed our bloodchiefs. Now they are gone. What is left? Destruction and death, my friends. That is enough."

73312.Name: Mind Drain
73312.FlavorText: "The meal was exquisite. The conversation, less so."

73313.Name: Nighthawk Scavenger
73313.FlavorText: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

73314.Name: Nimana Skitter-Sneak
73314.FlavorText: "When navigating dangerous terrain, one hundred legs are better than two."

73315.Name: Nimana Skydancer
73315.FlavorText: The Free City of Nimana is a great place to recruit adventurers with shady skill sets.

73317.Name: Oblivion's Hunger
73317.FlavorText:
"Indulge the void. Become the void. Consume all you touch."
—Drana, the last bloodchief

73318.Name: Pelakka Predation
73318.FlavorText:
"I knew we shouldn't have come this way."
—Sneeflebrix, expedition rogue
73318.RawFrameDetail: B front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73319.Name: Pelakka Caverns
73319.FlavorText:
"As a child, I was afraid of the dark. Now, I'm afraid of the things I know are lurking in the dark, waiting to bite my head off."
—Sneeflebrix, expedition rogue
73319.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73320.Name: Scion of the Swarm
73320.FlavorText: Vampires are now masters of their own fates, commanders of their own legions.

73323.Name: Shadows' Verdict
73323.FlavorText: The shadows of death fall over everyone in the end.

73325.Name: Skyclave Shadowcat
73325.FlavorText:
"Perhaps its distant ancestors were radiant felidars, but no hint of their nobility remains."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

73326.Name: Soul Shatter
73326.FlavorText: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.

73327.Name: Subtle Strike
73327.FlavorText: Silence is an underrated hunting strategy.

73330.Name: Vanquish the Weak
73330.FlavorText: Open conflict between expeditionary houses—or even individual adventuring parties—is discouraged, but "accidents" happen.

73331.Name: Zof Consumption
73331.FlavorText:
"Annihilation surrounds us. Our call is to embrace its ceaseless hunger."
—Voshk, oblivion priest
73331.RawFrameDetail: B front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73332.Name: Zof Bloodbog
73332.FlavorText:
"Look at this place. What more evidence do you require that existence is bleak and meaningless?"
—Voshk, oblivion priest
73332.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73333.Name: Akoum Hellhound
73333.FlavorText: Hellhound packs roam the Spikefields, basking in the harsh sunlight and lighting the night with their flames.

73334.Name: Akoum Warrior
73334.FlavorText:
"I'm not cruel, but I have no patience for your mistakes."
—Tyrux, expedition warrior
73334.RawFrameDetail: R front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73335.Name: Akoum Teeth
73335.FlavorText:
"Rock. Lava. Gravity. They're not cruel, but they're not forgiving either."
—Tyrux, expedition warrior
73335.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73337.Name: Cinderclasm
73337.FlavorText: Every inferno begins with a spark.

73338.Name: Cleansing Wildfire
73338.FlavorText: Every rebirth looks like a death.

73339.Name: Expedition Champion
73339.FlavorText: Warriors are combat specialists who bring their deadly skills to bear against the many foes that adventurers face in the course of their journeys.

73340.Name: Fireblade Charger
73340.FlavorText: "Down in flames" isn't a destination, but a journey.

73341.Name: Fissure Wizard
73341.FlavorText: He might call up a burst of lava or a raging hellion from Akoum's volcanic depths. Or he might just fall in.

73342.Name: Goma Fada Vanguard
73342.FlavorText:
"Her weapon's impressive, sure. But you should see her wield it."
—Gred, expedition warrior

73344.Name: Grotag Night-Runner
73344.FlavorText: Naturally inquisitive and adaptable, goblins can turn their small stature to their advantage as rogues.

73345.Name: Inordinate Rage
73345.FlavorText:
"In my years wandering this land I've seen a veritable menagerie of fantastic creatures, but one that has eluded me thus far is the fabled ‘easygoing minotaur.'"
—Ko, expedition wizard

73347.Name: Kazuul's Fury
73347.FlavorText:
"The toll is steep, but the cliffs are steeper."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House
73347.RawFrameDetail: R front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73348.Name: Kazuul's Cliffs
73348.FlavorText:
"The path up the cliffs is nothing but steep switchbacks and rickety lifts, made by elves, maintained by humans, and guarded by ogres. But it's the best way into the heart of Murasa."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House
73348.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73351.Name: Molten Blast
73351.FlavorText: Life among the sudden tremors and violent eruptions of Akoum demands a healthy fear of both.

73353.Name: Nahiri's Lithoforming
73353.FlavorText: "Zendikar has suffered enough. It is time, at last, for my home to know peace."

73354.Name: Pyroclastic Hellion
73354.FlavorText:
"The difference between a hellion and a volcano is that volcanoes don't get hungry."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

73356.Name: Rockslide Sorcerer
73356.FlavorText: "You can cower from the crushing shards or embrace the danger of Akoum. I've made my choice."

73357.Name: Roil Eruption
73357.FlavorText:
"Our feeble villages and tiny encampments stand only at the whim of the Roil."
—The Invokers' Tales

73360.Name: Scorch Rider
73360.FlavorText: "Lava flows where it pleases. I'm just happy to be along for the ride!"

73362.Name: Shatterskull Minotaur
73362.FlavorText:
"We just pay him and point him at problems."
—Aro, Sea Gate adventurer

73363.Name: Shatterskull Smashing
73363.RawFrameDetail: R front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73364.Name: Shatterskull, the Hammer Pass
73364.FlavorText:
"The safest way across the Skyfangs is to fly. Shatterskull Pass is a pretty distant second."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House
73364.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73365.Name: Sizzling Barrage
73365.FlavorText:
"A thousand sparks can burn through your defenses just as quickly as one massive blaze."
—Attikar, Akoum elementalist

73366.Name: Skyclave Geopede
73366.FlavorText: Wrenched from the ground like a dirt-caked rock, the ancient Skyclave wriggled with life.

73368.Name: Song-Mad Treachery
73368.FlavorText:
"I'm not proud of the things I did. But all I could think about at the time was how to make the noise stop."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73368.RawFrameDetail: R front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73369.Name: Song-Mad Ruins
73369.FlavorText:
"They call it the Singing City, but those eerie sounds aren't music. They worm their way into your brain until rational thought is impossible."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73369.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73370.Name: Spikefield Hazard
73370.FlavorText:
"Stop screaming! You'll only bring down more spikes."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
73370.RawFrameDetail: R front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73371.Name: Spikefield Cave
73371.FlavorText:
"Silence until we're through. Even a whisper's echo can dislodge death from above."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
73371.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73372.Name: Spitfire Lagac
73372.FlavorText:
"If you hear a choking sort of cough, it's about to get really hot."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

73374.Name: Teeterpeak Ambusher
73374.FlavorText: Goblins from the Makindi Trenches of Ondu make surprisingly skilled climbing guides due to their habit of scaling the cliffs to drop onto unsuspecting foes.

73375.Name: Thundering Rebuke
73375.FlavorText:
"Fire is too imprecise for my tastes. I'd rather rely on a single, well-placed bolt of lightning."
—Lyrus, Sea Gate wizard

73377.Name: Tormenting Voice
73377.FlavorText: Kargan tribal lands rarely have issues with goblin raids. Coincidentally, they also rarely have issues keeping their dragons fed.

73378.Name: Tuktuk Rubblefort
73378.FlavorText: As with everything else, goblins believe fortifications benefit from as many spiky bits as possible.

73379.Name: Valakut Awakening
73379.FlavorText:
"My ancestors reshaped the world to their vision. I have a few ideas of my own."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic
73379.RawFrameDetail: R front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73380.Name: Valakut Stoneforge
73380.FlavorText:
"I can hear the echo of their hammers, long stilled."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic
73380.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73382.Name: Wayward Guide-Beast
73382.FlavorText: Goblin cavalry tactics consist of pointing a beast in a direction and hanging on for as long as possible.

73383.Name: Adventure Awaits
73383.FlavorText: "Good, we're all here. Let's get started!"

73384.Name: Ancient Greenwarden
73384.FlavorText: When the ruins awakened, so did their defenses.

73386.Name: Bala Ged Recovery
73386.FlavorText:
"Always have a backup plan."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
73386.RawFrameDetail: G front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73387.Name: Bala Ged Sanctuary
73387.FlavorText:
"I know it's around here somewhere."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
73387.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73388.Name: Broken Wings
73388.FlavorText: Getting airborne with a kitesail is easy. It's everything afterward that takes focus, skill, and luck.

73389.Name: Canopy Baloth
73389.FlavorText:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

73391.Name: Dauntless Survivor
73391.FlavorText: "I've got a little surprise for you, beasties! Come and get it!"

73392.Name: Gnarlid Colony
73392.FlavorText: Where mana flows, the gnarlids follow.

73394.Name: Iridescent Hornbeetle
73394.FlavorText: The hatchlings will fill the jungles of Murasa in a glittering tide.

73395.Name: Joraga Visionary
73395.FlavorText: "If you only follow where the paths lead, you merely go where others have gone before you."

73396.Name: Kazandu Mammoth
73396.FlavorText:
"It doesn't obey me. It cooperates with me."
—Triel, Kazandu tuskcaller
73396.RawFrameDetail: G front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73397.Name: Kazandu Valley
73397.FlavorText:
"The elves stick to the trees. Here, where the trees welcome the sky and leave room for grazing herds—this is our land."
—Triel, Kazandu tuskcaller
73397.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73398.Name: Kazandu Nectarpot
73398.FlavorText:
"The scythe-like forelegs are crucial for its survival, because it tastes really good and every inhabitant of Murasa knows it."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

73399.Name: Kazandu Stomper
73399.FlavorText: Elves revere cycles of renewal, but they prefer cycles that don't involve their homes getting smashed.

73400.Name: Khalni Ambush
73400.FlavorText:
"The difference between life and death in Ora Ondar is about three seconds of startled screaming."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
73400.RawFrameDetail: G front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73401.Name: Khalni Territory
73401.FlavorText:
"If you wander into the Khalni Garden without knowing the signs of a scythecat's territory, you're not going to live long enough to learn."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
73401.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73402.Name: Lotus Cobra
73402.FlavorText: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.

73403.Name: Might of Murasa
73403.FlavorText: The continent of Murasa is defined by irrepressible growth, both natural and otherwise.

73404.Name: Murasa Brute
73404.FlavorText: Some adventuring parties are made up of old friends, their common bonds bolstering them in the face of peril. Other parties simply hire the biggest, meanest muscle they can find.

73405.Name: Murasa Sproutling
73405.FlavorText: The seeds of memory grow eternal.

73408.Name: Rabid Bite
73408.FlavorText: A healthy felidar is voracious yet regal. A rabid felidar is nothing more than appetite lashed to frothing jaws.

73410.Name: Roiling Regrowth
73410.FlavorText:
"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane

73412.Name: Scute Swarm
73412.FlavorText:
"Survival rule 782: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

73413.Name: Skyclave Pick-Axe
73413.FlavorText: For use on cliffs and other faces.

73414.Name: Springmantle Cleric
73414.FlavorText: Hope and courage bloom in her wake.

73415.Name: Strength of Solidarity
73415.FlavorText: "This expedition doesn't succeed unless we all succeed!"

73417.Name: Tajuru Blightblade
73417.FlavorText: Ora Ondar, the Khalni Garden, is a lush tangle of growth in the harsh lands of Akoum. Its plant growth is marvelously diverse: a brilliant spectrum of vibrant life . . . and speedy death.

73419.Name: Tajuru Snarecaster
73419.FlavorText: Elves of the Tajuru Nation spend their lives in the ancient jaddi trees' expansive canopy, some living and dying without ever touching the ground.

73420.Name: Tangled Florahedron
73420.FlavorText:
"As Bala Ged regrows, new forms of life blossom with unfettered wonder."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
73420.RawFrameDetail: G front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73421.Name: Tangled Vale
73421.FlavorText:
"We would do well to open our eyes and remember what it is to wonder."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
73421.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73423.Name: Territorial Scythecat
73423.FlavorText: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.

73424.Name: Turntimber Ascetic
73424.FlavorText: "For so long, this land cried out in pain. Now, as the flow returns to its balance point, a new harmony echoes in the trees."

73425.Name: Turntimber Symbiosis
73425.RawFrameDetail: G front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73426.Name: Turntimber, Serpentine Wood
73426.FlavorText:
"The trees here twist around spikes of mana, feeding off the flowing power."
—Jori En, expedition leader
73426.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73427.Name: Vastwood Fortification
73427.FlavorText:
"When you understand nature's ways, you're never unarmed."
—Eyza, Joraga guide
73427.RawFrameDetail: G front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73428.Name: Vastwood Thicket
73428.FlavorText:
"Never underestimate the ferocity of the imperative to thrive."
—Eyza, Joraga guide
73428.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73431.Name: Vine Gecko
73431.FlavorText:
"It's cute now, but those things tend to get a lot bigger when you're not looking."
—Fahar, expedition wizard

73432.Name: Akiri, Fearless Voyager
73432.FlavorText: "No angel bars our ascent. Emeria waits above!"

73436.Name: Kargan Warleader
73436.FlavorText: From rebellion against the Akoum Skyclave to fighting the Eldrazi titans, the dragon-riding Kargan tribes have never missed an opportunity to defy the odds.

73437.Name: Kaza, Roil Chaser
73437.FlavorText: "What sort of life is that, huddling in the familiar and safe? No thanks. Put me right in the center of the action."

73439.Name: Lullmage's Familiar
73439.FlavorText:
"They store energy in special gastric organs . . . but I guess you'd probably rather have me clear the path than ramble about guts."
—Fahar, expedition wizard

73441.Name: Murasa Rootgrazer
73441.FlavorText: Few other creatures so closely embody Murasa's rapid cycles of growth.

73449.Name: Spoils of Adventure
73449.FlavorText: Survival itself is no small reward.

73450.Name: Umara Mystic
73450.FlavorText: "We tolerate the North Hada thieves' den, but cutthroats who wander downriver earn a skymanta ride out to sea."

73452.Name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
73452.FlavorText: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.

73455.Name: Cliffhaven Kitesail
73455.FlavorText: Made from canvas, wood, and hope.

73456.Name: Forsaken Monument
73456.FlavorText:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

73460.Name: Relic Axe
73460.FlavorText: "It's light as a feather, but it hits with the force of a boulder. A very sharp boulder."

73463.Name: Sea Gate Colossus
73463.FlavorText:
"When you are battered and exhausted, look up and be inspired by its resolve."
—Tazri

73464.Name: Skyclave Relic
73464.FlavorText: Skyclaves held the key to reshaping the world.

73466.Name: Spare Supplies
73466.FlavorText:
"It's better to carry a little extra weight than to find yourself halfway down a baloth's throat with no knife."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

73467.Name: Stonework Packbeast
73467.FlavorText: It will happily carry home your treasure or drag you back to civilization, as circumstances demand.

73468.Name: Utility Knife
73468.FlavorText: "Hold on a second, I have just the thing."

73469.Name: Base Camp
73469.FlavorText: A new dawn, a new adventure.

73470.Name: Branchloft Pathway
73470.FlavorText:
"Not for the bumble-footed nor wobble-stomached."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
73470.RawFrameDetail: G land front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73471.Name: Boulderloft Pathway
73471.FlavorText:
"The path is stable. It's the gusts all around it that are a bit ‘whoosh—oops—bye.'"
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
73471.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73472.Name: Brightclimb Pathway
73472.FlavorText:
"Why risk life and limb exploring the wilds? For this."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73472.RawFrameDetail: W land front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73473.Name: Grimclimb Pathway
73473.FlavorText:
"My mother wanted me to take over the family dry goods business, but no. I had to come here."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73473.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73474.Name: Clearwater Pathway
73474.FlavorText:
"Just when the river seems most peaceful, suddenly you round a bend and hurtle down a waterfall."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader
73474.RawFrameDetail: U land front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

73475.Name: Murkwater Pathway
73475.FlavorText:
"Here, at least, the danger is usually in plain sight."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader
73475.RawFrameDetail: B land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73476.Name: Cragcrown Pathway
73476.FlavorText:
"The greatest danger on the path is a failure of nerve."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73476.RawFrameDetail: R land front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

73477.Name: Timbercrown Pathway
73477.FlavorText:
"Walk quickly and ignore any roars from the undergrowth."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
73477.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73479.Name: Needleverge Pathway
73479.FlavorText:
"Once you really trust the rope, you'll learn to sleep standing up."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger
73479.RawFrameDetail: R land front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

73480.Name: Pillarverge Pathway
73480.FlavorText:
"The oxen here take an almost feline delight in pushing things over the edge."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger
73480.RawFrameDetail: W land back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73481.Name: Riverglide Pathway
73481.FlavorText:
"The wind knows the way. Just let it carry you there."
—Amandi, kitesail expert
73481.RawFrameDetail: U land front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

73482.Name: Lavaglide Pathway
73482.FlavorText:
"Don't fear the heat. Just let it lift you up."
—Amandi, kitesail expert
73482.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

73688.Name: Ardenvale Tactician
73688.FlavorText: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.

73689.Name: Dizzying Swoop
73689.FlavorText: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.

73690.Name: Faerie Guidemother
73690.FlavorText: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

73691.Name: Gift of the Fae
73691.FlavorText: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

73692.Name: Giant Killer
73692.FlavorText: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

73693.Name: Chop Down
73693.FlavorText: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

73700.Name: Silverflame Squire
73700.FlavorText: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

73701.Name: On Alert
73701.FlavorText: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

73702.Name: Animating Faerie
73702.FlavorText: A true puppet master has no need for strings.

73703.Name: Bring to Life
73703.FlavorText: A true puppet master has no need for strings.

73710.Name: Merfolk Secretkeeper
73710.FlavorText: Merfolk curiosity usually has dire consequences, but rarely for the merfolk.

73711.Name: Venture Deeper
73711.FlavorText: Merfolk curiosity usually has dire consequences, but rarely for the merfolk.

73722.Name: Smitten Swordmaster
73722.FlavorText: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

73723.Name: Curry Favor
73723.FlavorText: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

73724.Name: Bonecrusher Giant
73724.FlavorText: Not every tale ends in glory.

73725.Name: Stomp
73725.FlavorText: Not every tale ends in glory.

73726.Name: Embereth Shieldbreaker
73726.FlavorText: "Courage is the only shield I need."

73727.Name: Battle Display
73727.FlavorText: "Courage is the only shield I need."

73728.Name: Merchant of the Vale
73728.FlavorText: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

73729.Name: Haggle
73729.FlavorText: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

73734.Name: Curious Pair
73734.FlavorText: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

73735.Name: Treats to Share
73735.FlavorText: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

73736.Name: Flaxen Intruder
73736.FlavorText: The middle blade was just right.

73737.Name: Welcome Home
73737.FlavorText: The middle blade was just right.

73738.Name: Garenbrig Carver
73738.FlavorText: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

73739.Name: Shield's Might
73739.FlavorText: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

73740.Name: Lovestruck Beast
73740.FlavorText: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

73741.Name: Heart's Desire
73741.FlavorText: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

73742.Name: Rosethorn Acolyte
73742.FlavorText: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."

73743.Name: Seasonal Ritual
73743.FlavorText: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."

73744.Name: Tuinvale Treefolk
73744.FlavorText: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

73745.Name: Oaken Boon
73745.FlavorText: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

73769.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
73769.FlavorText: "I've sworn to protect the people from the horrors that would destroy them—even if those horrors are the angels themselves."

73770.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
73770.FlavorText: "I serve the soft light of the moon that holds back the terrors of the night. I serve the bonds between us, driving out the fear that would break us apart."

73771.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
73771.FlavorText: "I would rather be a heretic than betray my conscience."

73772.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
73772.FlavorText: "I am the Guardian of Thraben, and I claim my right to speak before the council."

73774.Name: Anointed Procession
73774.FlavorText:
"The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them."
—Gideon Jura

73777.Name: Aven Mindcensor
73777.FlavorText: "The only question we need to ask is how best to fulfill the will of the God-Pharaoh."

73778.Name: Aven of Enduring Hope
73778.FlavorText: "This storm will calm. We must believe that."

73779.Name: Binding Mummy
73779.FlavorText: What the gods decree, the mummies enforce.

73782.Name: Compulsory Rest
73782.FlavorText: The pain of death is nothing compared to the pain of failure.

73783.Name: Crested Sunmare
73783.FlavorText:
"It is evidence that some pure corner of the world must still exist."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

73784.Name: Dauntless Aven
73784.FlavorText: In the chaos brought by the new gods, swift-winged aven served as pathfinders, leading the last of the people away from the ruins of Naktamun.

73786.Name: Disposal Mummy
73786.FlavorText: Without the viziers to oversee their actions, some anointed went to extreme lengths to fulfill their directives.

73787.Name: Djeru's Resolve
73787.FlavorText: "When I wish to be strong, I train. When I wish to be wise, I study. When I wish to rest, I start again."

73791.Name: Fan Bearer
73791.FlavorText: Rest sometimes requires the right prompting.

73792.Name: Forsake the Worldly
73792.FlavorText: "Why cling to these trappings? They are but tools and affectations. True wealth can be possessed only in the afterlife."

73795.Name: Glory-Bound Initiate
73795.FlavorText:
"Fly as an arrow through the trials, and never waver in your course."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

73797.Name: Hour of Revelation
73797.FlavorText: In the first moments, the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh.

73798.Name: Impeccable Timing
73798.FlavorText: To a trained warrior, there is scarcely a more potent weapon than patience.

73799.Name: In Oketra's Name
73799.FlavorText:
"A single grain of sand is insignificant, but a sandstorm can reduce pyramids to dust. Stand with your crop. Become the storm."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

73800.Name: Mighty Leap
73800.FlavorText: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

73803.Name: Oketra's Avenger
73803.FlavorText: "Oketra's arrow is my spear, and her love my shield."

73805.Name: Protection of the Hekma
73805.FlavorText: Part of the acolytes' training is to walk along the Hekma, staring out at the ravenous horrors kept at bay by the God-Pharaoh's barrier.

73806.Name: Renewed Faith
73806.FlavorText: "To see gods among the people, part of their daily lives . . . It's inspiring."

73809.Name: Solemnity
73809.FlavorText: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh marked a betrayal of both gods and mortals.

73811.Name: Steward of Solidarity
73811.FlavorText: In the midst of disaster, heroic acts became almost ordinary, and ordinary warriors became heroes.

73813.Name: Supply Caravan
73813.FlavorText:
"We each have a weight to carry on the road to the afterlife."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

73815.Name: Those Who Serve
73815.FlavorText:
"The dead perform all the work here—farming, building, teaching, even embalming their fellow mummies. The living need do nothing but train. What system could be more perfect?"
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

73816.Name: Trial of Solidarity
73816.FlavorText: "You will succeed as one or fail as many."

73819.Name: Vizier of Remedies
73819.FlavorText: "You'll need all your strength for the trials to come."

73821.Name: Aerial Guide
73821.FlavorText:
"Kefnet taught us to turn obstacles into advantages."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet

73822.Name: Ancient Crab
73822.FlavorText: The banks of the Luxa River attract all manner of predator but only the most resilient of prey.

73825.Name: Cartouche of Knowledge
73825.FlavorText: Cartouches chronicle the initiates' achievements in the trials.

73826.Name: Censor
73826.FlavorText:
"Why so many questions?"
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

73831.Name: Compelling Argument
73831.FlavorText:
"How can there be doubt in the presence of such blessings?"
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

73832.Name: Countervailing Winds
73832.FlavorText: The Eternals had long since mastered every technique taught during the trials.

73833.Name: Cryptic Serpent
73833.FlavorText: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

73834.Name: Curator of Mysteries
73834.FlavorText: To consult a sphinx is a test in patience. Perhaps that's the point.

73835.Name: Drake Haven
73835.FlavorText:
"If you want to truly test your survival skills, walk the Obelisk Path when the drakes are feeding."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

73836.Name: Essence Scatter
73836.FlavorText: Dependence on luck is anathema to Kefnet's rigorous studies. Those who hope to escape his maze by chance never succeed.

73837.Name: Eternal of Harsh Truths
73837.FlavorText:
"If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?"
—Jace Beleren

73838.Name: Floodwaters
73838.FlavorText:
"It usually appears placid, but don't be fooled. The Luxa River is a snake, and it can swallow you whole."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet

73839.Name: Hekma Sentinels
73839.FlavorText: "The God-Pharaoh created the Hekma to protect us from the horrors beyond and to surround us in his love."

73840.Name: Hieroglyphic Illumination
73840.FlavorText: "The answers are here. This is the way through the trial."

73844.Name: Lay Claim
73844.FlavorText: Initiates need worry only about the trials. Everything else is in the hands of the gods.

73845.Name: Naga Oracle
73845.FlavorText: "All questions will be answered during the Hour of Revelation."

73846.Name: New Perspectives
73846.FlavorText: Understanding is a matter of perspective.

73848.Name: Ominous Sphinx
73848.FlavorText: The sphinxes began to speak only after the Second Sun aligned. They whispered dire warnings, though no one listened.

73850.Name: Pull from Tomorrow
73850.FlavorText:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

73852.Name: Seeker of Insight
73852.FlavorText: The Trial of Knowledge challenges and broadens the minds of initiates.

73853.Name: Seer of the Last Tomorrow
73853.FlavorText: "The truth? It's been here all along. The Hours as we understood them are lies."

73854.Name: Shimmerscale Drake
73854.FlavorText: They are drawn by the brilliant blue glint of the mineral lazotep from the mines below.

73855.Name: Slither Blade
73855.FlavorText: Some naga initiates move as silently as the suns' reflections on the water.

73856.Name: Spellweaver Eternal
73856.FlavorText:
"They were once our brothers and sisters."
—Etha, former Rhet-crop initiate

73857.Name: Strategic Planning
73857.FlavorText:
"Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here. We must approach carefully."
—Jace Beleren

73858.Name: Striped Riverwinder
73858.FlavorText: The denizens of the Luxa River woke angry on the currents of blood.

73865.Name: Vizier of Tumbling Sands
73865.FlavorText: "Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."

73866.Name: Winds of Rebuke
73866.FlavorText: "I have foreseen that you will not pass my trial."

73868.Name: Baleful Ammit
73868.FlavorText:
"Not all in our crop deserve the afterlife. We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop

73869.Name: Blighted Bat
73869.FlavorText: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.

73870.Name: Bone Picker
73870.FlavorText: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

73872.Name: Bontu's Last Reckoning
73872.FlavorText: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

73874.Name: Cruel Reality
73874.FlavorText: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

73877.Name: Doomed Dissenter
73877.FlavorText: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

73878.Name: Doomfall
73878.FlavorText:
"This place has outlived its usefulness."
—Nicol Bolas

73880.Name: Dune Beetle
73880.FlavorText: The scouring sands of Shefet polish its carapace, and the ranks of the cursed fill its belly.

73881.Name: Festering Mummy
73881.FlavorText: As its parched flesh withers away, its malignant hunger grows.

73882.Name: Final Reward
73882.FlavorText: Those who earn a glorious death are given the highest honor. They are carried on funeral barges through the gate to the afterlife.

73883.Name: Gravedigger
73883.FlavorText: In Amonkhet's ever-shifting sands, nothing stays buried for long.

73884.Name: Horror of the Broken Lands
73884.FlavorText: It feeds on dry bones in the sand and desperate pleas in the wind.

73885.Name: Khenra Eternal
73885.FlavorText: For many years, servant mummies toiled in the mines to extract lazotep. The emergence of the Eternals revealed the sacred substance's true purpose.

73886.Name: Lethal Sting
73886.FlavorText: Initiates once believed defeat was the worst fate possible—a sentiment they quickly abandoned.

73888.Name: Liliana's Defeat
73888.FlavorText:
"All the power you have gathered for yourself, Liliana, I can take away."
—Nicol Bolas

73889.Name: Liliana's Mastery
73889.FlavorText: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

73890.Name: Lord of the Accursed
73890.FlavorText: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

73891.Name: Marauding Boneslasher
73891.FlavorText: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

73892.Name: Miasmic Mummy
73892.FlavorText: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.

73893.Name: Nest of Scarabs
73893.FlavorText:
"They are small, but they always want more. Learn from them."
—Bontu, god of ambition

73898.Name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
73898.FlavorText: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

73900.Name: Scarab Feast
73900.FlavorText:
"The face of mediocrity is wrapped in anointed linen. Aspire to a better end."
—Epnokep, vizier of Bontu

73901.Name: Shadow of the Grave
73901.FlavorText:
"Death has seeped into every part of this plane. I can feel it on my skin and taste it like sand in my mouth."
—Nissa Revane

73903.Name: Splendid Agony
73903.FlavorText:
"Wherever you are in the city, you can feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh. Take comfort in that."
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

73904.Name: Supernatural Stamina
73904.FlavorText:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

73907.Name: Trespasser's Curse
73907.FlavorText: Even in the relative safety of the city, there are places best left undisturbed.

73909.Name: Unburden
73909.FlavorText:
"Ambition requires clarity. If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned."
—Bontu, god of ambition

73910.Name: Vile Manifestation
73910.FlavorText: The glyphs writhed and twisted, spewing out dark, vengeful magic.

73911.Name: Wander in Death
73911.FlavorText: Forever restless. Forever growing in number.

73912.Name: Wasp of the Bitter End
73912.FlavorText: As the Second Sun glided into its final position in the sky, a chorus of wings sounded to herald the return of Nicol Bolas.

73913.Name: Wasteland Scorpion
73913.FlavorText: All but the gods fear the scorpion's sting.

73914.Name: Abrade
73914.FlavorText: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

73915.Name: Ahn-Crop Crasher
73915.FlavorText:
"Hesitation breeds dissension. To be worthy of the next life, you must never look back."
—Anep, vizier of Hazoret

73919.Name: Blur of Blades
73919.FlavorText: Samut battled her way through the hordes, shouting the names of those who'd died in her crop and those she hoped yet to save.

73920.Name: Brute Strength
73920.FlavorText: "Oketra had our crop build an obelisk to prove the power of working together. But I am stronger without the weak."

73921.Name: Burning-Fist Minotaur
73921.FlavorText: "There is no afterlife. Not for me, and not for you. So think again before getting in my way."

73922.Name: By Force
73922.FlavorText:
"Dissent? Your gods can't even begin to comprehend the dissent that's about to happen here!"
—Chandra Nalaar

73923.Name: Cartouche of Zeal
73923.FlavorText: The fifth cartouche is the final affirmation of glory, granted only to the worthy dead.

73925.Name: Chandra's Defeat
73925.FlavorText:
"Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?"
—Nicol Bolas

73927.Name: Crash Through
73927.FlavorText:
"We have to get out of the city, Djeru. All of us! Gather as many as you can."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

73929.Name: Desert Cerodon
73929.FlavorText: The endless expanse of desert surrounding Naktamun sometimes yields threats that the gods themselves must answer.

73931.Name: Fervent Paincaster
73931.FlavorText: "Everyone here is a honed fighter. We'll respond the only way we know how."

73932.Name: Firebrand Archer
73932.FlavorText: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.

73933.Name: Gilded Cerodon
73933.FlavorText: The plating of its horns is a token of honor from Hazoret, who favors creatures with great hearts.

73935.Name: Glorybringer
73935.FlavorText: What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.

73938.Name: Hour of Devastation
73938.FlavorText:
"Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch."
—Nicol Bolas

73943.Name: Khenra Scrapper
73943.FlavorText: "There is no tomorrow, so hold nothing back."

73944.Name: Magma Spray
73944.FlavorText:
"Ashes can't be embalmed."
—Neheb, initiate of Ahn crop

73945.Name: Magmaroth
73945.FlavorText: Sand into glass and flesh into ash—such are the markers of its domain.

73946.Name: Nef-Crop Entangler
73946.FlavorText: "If you do not feel the thrill of battle, alive like a flame, you will never triumph."

73947.Name: Neheb, the Eternal
73947.FlavorText:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

73948.Name: Nimble-Blade Khenra
73948.FlavorText:
"In the Hour of Glory, the gods and the untested will prove their worth before the God-Pharaoh."
—The Accounting of Hours

73949.Name: Open Fire
73949.FlavorText: Some khenra archers fashion their arrows with a personal touch.

73950.Name: Pathmaker Initiate
73950.FlavorText: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."

73951.Name: Puncturing Blow
73951.FlavorText:
"Neither the false God-Pharaoh nor his bugs will decide our fate."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

73952.Name: Pursue Glory
73952.FlavorText:
"Combat is a form of worship, the clash of steel a solemn prayer."
—Pytamun, initiate of Nef crop

73953.Name: Sand Strangler
73953.FlavorText: The bombardment of sand disorients, chokes, and ultimately tenderizes its prey.

73956.Name: Sweltering Suns
73956.FlavorText: The Hekma may repel storms and monsters, but nothing holds back the heat of the suns.

73957.Name: Thorned Moloch
73957.FlavorText: Those who fled the destruction of the city stumbled into the territory of their prickly neighbors.

73958.Name: Thresher Lizard
73958.FlavorText: The sound of its plated tail beating on desert rocks is often mistaken for the footfalls of a much larger predator.

73959.Name: Tormenting Voice
73959.FlavorText: "You are undeserving of the afterlife. You will never feel the God-Pharaoh's embrace."

73961.Name: Zealot of the God-Pharaoh
73961.FlavorText: The God-Pharaoh's most devoted took it upon themselves to follow his example.

73962.Name: Beneath the Sands
73962.FlavorText: Though buried and muffled, nature's whisper still called to Nissa.

73963.Name: Bitterbow Sharpshooters
73963.FlavorText:
"Remember, brother, the eyes are always vulnerable."
"I never forgot."

73965.Name: Champion of Rhonas
73965.FlavorText: The only way to finish the Trial of Strength is with a basilisk scale in hand.

73967.Name: Crocodile of the Crossing
73967.FlavorText:
"Everything in the trial has teeth. You will overcome them, or you will feed them."
—Rhonas, god of strength

73969.Name: Dissenter's Deliverance
73969.FlavorText:
"When all doubts have melted away, the worthy will meet the Hour of Eternity and earn a place at the God-Pharaoh's side."
—The Accounting of Hours

73971.Name: Feral Prowler
73971.FlavorText: Once favored companions, many cats were left to fend for themselves.

73972.Name: Greater Sandwurm
73972.FlavorText: A sandwurm can lie in wait beneath the sands for years until the slightest tremor alerts it to the presence of prey.

73973.Name: Haze of Pollen
73973.FlavorText: Few can overcome an assault of such aggressive serenity.

73974.Name: Hooded Brawler
73974.FlavorText: Nagas wielding twin daggers excel at the fighting technique known as the Bite of Rhonas.

73975.Name: Hope Tender
73975.FlavorText: Some refused to leave their shattered homes, vowing to rebuild at any cost.

73977.Name: Hour of Promise
73977.FlavorText: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

73978.Name: Initiate's Companion
73978.FlavorText:
"I'd like to say that it's our pet, but the reverse may be closer to the truth."
—Ixor, initiate of Rhet crop

73979.Name: Life Goes On
73979.FlavorText:
"If you believe the God-Pharaoh tests you, charge with me to prove yourself. If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!"
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

73981.Name: Manglehorn
73981.FlavorText:
"Rely too much on your weapons and watch your dreams shatter in your hands."
—Rhonas, god of strength

73985.Name: Naga Vitalist
73985.FlavorText: "The lands of the God-Pharaoh are suffused with his breath."

73986.Name: Oashra Cultivator
73986.FlavorText: "Like fruits in the field, we will be harvested when the season is right."

73987.Name: Oasis Ritualist
73987.FlavorText: "It's only the end if we allow it."

73988.Name: Ornery Kudu
73988.FlavorText: Debate rages among the viziers whether comparing the kudu's horns to the God-Pharaoh's is blasphemy or reverence.

73989.Name: Pouncing Cheetah
73989.FlavorText: Rhonas's monument is home to a wider variety of creatures than anywhere else in the city of Naktamun—a feature most initiates fail to appreciate.

73991.Name: Prowling Serpopard
73991.FlavorText: The viziers serving Rhonas, the god of strength, maintain the menagerie of animals employed during his trial.

73992.Name: Quarry Hauler
73992.FlavorText: They labor beside the anointed, constructing the vast monuments of Naktamun.

73993.Name: Ramunap Excavator
73993.FlavorText: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

73997.Name: Sandwurm Convergence
73997.FlavorText: Cantankerous and territorial, sandwurms claim even the skies above their dunes.

73998.Name: Shed Weakness
73998.FlavorText: To prepare for the Trial of Strength, nagas shed their old skin—and with it their scars, their doubts, and their fears.

74000.Name: Sidewinder Naga
74000.FlavorText:
"Those who embrace the harsh land rather than fight it find they have a powerful ally."
—Nissa Revane

74001.Name: Sifter Wurm
74001.FlavorText:
"Rhonas's monument belongs to the wurms now. Look elsewhere for refuge."
—Arnun, vizier of the menagerie

74003.Name: Stinging Shot
74003.FlavorText: Initiates must train to resist the natural toxins they use as weapons.

74004.Name: Synchronized Strike
74004.FlavorText: Khenra are almost always born as twins. Their instinctual connection lends itself well to their preferred fighting style.

74007.Name: Watchful Naga
74007.FlavorText: The forked tongue of the naga is sensitive to drifting scent trails from the past, present, and sometimes even the future.

74008.Name: Ahn-Crop Champion
74008.FlavorText: "The Second Sun nears its destination! Let it light the way to ours!"

74028.Name: Enigma Drake
74028.FlavorText: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets known only to Kefnet himself. Many have become meals trying to learn them.

74038.Name: Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons
74038.FlavorText: Her subtle smile is suffused with venom.

74042.Name: Honored Crop-Captain
74042.FlavorText: Her words inspire action. Her actions inspire victory.

74049.Name: Merciless Javelineer
74049.FlavorText: "My mind is the calm in the midst of the storm, and my javelin the lightning."

74072.Name: River Hoopoe
74072.FlavorText:
"It's a cruel thing to give such a sad song to such a colorful creature."
—Sana, former Ahn-crop initiate

74074.Name: Samut, Voice of Dissent
74074.FlavorText: "I'll fight no more just for the honor of dying. The afterlife will have to wait."

74077.Name: Shadowstorm Vizier
74077.FlavorText: She can coil a breeze like a string around her finger—or twist it into a noose.

74089.Name: Wayward Servant
74089.FlavorText: If one of the anointed fails to serve with perfect obedience, the desert is always ready to receive it.

74090.Name: Abandoned Sarcophagus
74090.FlavorText: Although long since dead, the banished dissenters finally took their vengeance.

74091.Name: Bontu's Monument
74091.FlavorText:
"The worthy shall strive for greatness. Supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

74095.Name: Hazoret's Monument
74095.FlavorText:
"The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle."
—Monument inscription

74096.Name: Hollow One
74096.FlavorText: The embodiment of yearning, forever drifting the deserts to find what had once made it whole.

74097.Name: Kefnet's Monument
74097.FlavorText:
"The worthy shall cultivate a nimble mind to perceive the glorious wonders that await them."
—Monument inscription

74098.Name: Mirage Mirror
74098.FlavorText: Most mirrors show your reflection. Others show your potential.

74099.Name: Oketra's Monument
74099.FlavorText:
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united."
—Monument inscription

74101.Name: Rhonas's Monument
74101.FlavorText:
"The worthy shall hone a strong body to endure the boundless energies of the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

74102.Name: Sunset Pyramid
74102.FlavorText: Decades to build. Hours to demolish.

74103.Name: Throne of the God-Pharaoh
74103.FlavorText:
"When the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon, so begins the Hour of Revelation. Then the Hour of Glory, the Hour of Promise, and finally the Hour of Eternity."
—The Accounting of Hours

74105.Name: Watchers of the Dead
74105.FlavorText: They are tasked with protecting the entrance to the embalming chambers.

74108.Name: Crypt of the Eternals
74108.FlavorText: The dead entered as worthy. They exited as Eternals.

74114.Name: Evolving Wilds
74114.FlavorText:
"Don't you ever wonder what lies beyond the Hekma? Beyond the reach of the gods? Beyond the horns on the horizon?"
—Samut, initiate of Tah crop

74150.Name: Scavenger Grounds
74150.FlavorText: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

74153.Name: Sunscorched Desert
74153.FlavorText: The only relief in sight is a mirage.

74623.Name: Thopter
74623.RawFrameDetail: U artifact token, has text box

74646.Name: Containment Priest
74646.FlavorText: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

74647.Name: Grim Tutor
74647.FlavorText: As blood touched the empty page, it formed words that seared themselves into the wizard's mind.

74649.Name: Cultivate
74649.FlavorText: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

74650.Name: Scavenging Ooze
74650.FlavorText: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

74673.Name: Kazandu Mammoth

74674.Name: Kazandu Valley
74674.RawFrameDetail: alt G land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder
