74694.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC FIRE favorite, U reverse-side reminder

74984.Name: Serra's Guardian
74984.FlavorText: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.

74986.Name: Banishing Light
74986.FlavorText:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—The Theriad

74987.Name: Gadwick, the Wizened
74987.FlavorText: His name is spoken only in whispers—but he hears just the same.

74989.Name: Weight of Memory
74989.FlavorText: In lives that have stretched for centuries, there are bound to be a few awkward silences.

74990.Name: Bond of Revival
74990.FlavorText: "Today we throw off the yoke of death. Either this is an affirmation of the eternal cyclical nature of life, or it's just hilarious—depends on which of us you ask."

74991.Name: Audacious Thief
74991.FlavorText: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."

74992.Name: Doomed Necromancer
74992.FlavorText: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

74995.Name: Lightning Strike
74995.FlavorText: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

74996.Name: Lightning Serpent
74996.FlavorText: Ice exploded into steam in its wake, hissing like a thousand serpents hailing their blazing master.

74997.Name: Scorching Dragonfire
74997.FlavorText: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

74998.Name: Goblin Oriflamme
74998.FlavorText:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV

75000.Name: Dryad Greenseeker
75000.FlavorText: "The land already knows its destiny. I simply ask it to share the tale with me."

75002.Name: Prey Upon
75002.FlavorText:
"Light up the dark to find your way, and the dark may seek you out."
—Zalin the Gutter Bard

75035.Name: Regal Caracal
75035.FlavorText: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

75036.Name: Axgard Braggart
75036.FlavorText: "Heavy? Ha! The Trollking of Mossrun was heavy, and I tossed him five miles!"

75037.Name: Battershield Warrior
75037.FlavorText: "I need no axe to best these weaklings."

75038.Name: Battlefield Raptor
75038.FlavorText: It wheeled upward, away from the shrieks and thunder. It reached the point where sky met smoke, and, with but a glance at the horizon, aimed itself and dove.

75039.Name: Beskir Shieldmate
75039.FlavorText: "If we fall today, let us fall with honor, defending our realm from the horrors that would defile it. Forward, shieldmates! To Starnheim!"

75041.Name: Clarion Spirit
75041.FlavorText: To the living, the horn sounds faint and mournful, but to the spirits of Istfell, it is a thunderous call that must be obeyed.

75042.Name: Codespell Cleric
75042.FlavorText: "Today we are not Beskir or Tuskeri. We must fight as one clan, shoulder to shoulder, to defend our rightful home!"

75043.Name: Divine Gambit
75043.FlavorText: There are rules, and then there are gods.

75044.Name: Doomskar
75044.FlavorText: The realms crashed together, with Bretagard at the center of the calamity.

75045.Name: Doomskar Oracle
75045.FlavorText: "Giants and monsters loom on the horizon, and the elves plan to murder our gods!"

75046.Name: Giant Ox
75046.FlavorText:
"How strong is he? Well, I once lost control of the plow, and he carved a furrow right through my house! Didn't even slow down."
—Guldir, Beskir farmer

75048.Name: Gods' Hall Guardian
75048.FlavorText: Not a single rat has been seen in Istfell since the gods moved in.

75049.Name: Goldmaw Champion
75049.FlavorText: "That was nothing. I once took down a frost giant with a spoon!"

75050.Name: Halvar, God of Battle
75050.RawFrameDetail: W legendary front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

75051.Name: Sword of the Realms
75051.FlavorText: It cuts through the Cosmos itself, carving new Omenpaths between the realms.
75051.RawFrameDetail: W artifact legendary back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

75052.Name: Invoke the Divine
75052.FlavorText: "Let's see how brave you really are behind all that oak and steel."

75053.Name: Iron Verdict
75053.FlavorText: "You'll raid nothing but mist in Istfell."

75055.Name: Master Skald
75055.FlavorText: "All my scars have stories to tell."

75056.Name: Rally the Ranks
75056.FlavorText: Halvar united the spirits of all the clans into a single, devastating force.

75057.Name: Reidane, God of the Worthy
75057.RawFrameDetail: W legendary front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

75058.Name: Valkmira, Protector's Shield
75058.RawFrameDetail: W artifact legendary back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

75060.Name: Revitalize
75060.FlavorText: Esika alone knows how to distill the essence of the World Tree into the Cosmos Elixir, a magical substance which grants the Skoti god-family immortality.

75069.Name: Starnheim Courser
75069.FlavorText: Every worthy warrior who arrives in Starnheim is gifted a mount befitting their heroism, a mighty pegasus raised and trained by the valkyries.

75071.Name: Story Seeker
75071.FlavorText: Dwarven skalds are the most renowned storytellers in all of Kaldheim. They travel across the realms, seeking out heroic deeds and chronicling them in epic sagas.

75072.Name: Usher of the Fallen
75072.FlavorText: "I have led ten thousand through these mists and never lost the way."

75074.Name: Valor of the Worthy
75074.FlavorText: "If I am to die, let it be a hero's death!"

75076.Name: Wings of the Cosmos
75076.FlavorText: The wolf's startled yelp changed quickly to a howl of elation as she soared over her envious packmates.

75077.Name: Alrund, God of the Cosmos
75077.RawFrameDetail: U legendary front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

75078.Name: Hakka, Whispering Raven
75078.FlavorText: Alrund's raven soars between realms; no secret is beyond his grasp.
75078.RawFrameDetail: U legendary back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

75080.Name: Annul
75080.FlavorText:
"Many giants have tried to crush me with their hammers. You'll never stop me with that little toy."
—Stigur of the Omenseekers

75082.Name: Augury Raven
75082.FlavorText: Some ravens collect shiny baubles; others hoard omens and secrets.

75084.Name: Behold the Multiverse
75084.FlavorText: Countless worlds unfolded before Niko, every one in need of heroes.

75086.Name: Bind the Monster
75086.FlavorText: Sarulf's snarl of rage shook the World Tree.

75087.Name: Brinebarrow Intruder
75087.FlavorText: Locked in the ice of Karfell, the treasures of ancient nobles await in ruins guarded by the dead.

75088.Name: Cosima, God of the Voyage
75088.RawFrameDetail: U legendary front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

75089.Name: The Omenkeel
75089.RawFrameDetail: U Vehicle legendary back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

75091.Name: Cyclone Summoner
75091.FlavorText: Frost giants study for centuries in isolation, honing their ability to harness elemental mayhem.

75092.Name: Depart the Realm
75092.FlavorText: "My home calls to me. I must go."

75093.Name: Disdainful Stroke
75093.FlavorText:
"The skald boasted that he could outsing the sea. Cosima heard him, and drowned his village with a single wave."
—Longbeard Saga

75094.Name: Draugr Thought-Thief
75094.FlavorText: The worst part is that you won't even remember how much he's taken from you.

75095.Name: Frost Augur
75095.FlavorText: From the barest crack in the ice, she teases forth a swirling, living map of the Cosmos.

75096.Name: Frostpeak Yeti
75096.FlavorText: Some heroes line their coats with yeti fur. More yetis line their bellies with heroes.

75100.Name: Graven Lore
75100.FlavorText: The runes glow beneath the snow, bearing memories of a time when the old gods ruled the realms.

75101.Name: Icebind Pillar
75101.FlavorText:
"Oh, Valki. I'm disappointed in you. How could the god of lies be so gullible?"
—Tibalt

75103.Name: Inga Rune-Eyes
75103.FlavorText: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.

75104.Name: Karfell Harbinger
75104.FlavorText: "This is a realm of the living. King Narfi's legion is coming to change that."

75105.Name: Littjara Kinseekers
75105.FlavorText: Like calls to like, and none are forgotten.

75106.Name: Mists of Littjara
75106.FlavorText: The Skelle raiders boasted that nothing could stop them, certainly not a bit of fog.

75107.Name: Mistwalker
75107.FlavorText:
"To escape Littjara, follow a bird."
—Tuskeri folklore

75110.Name: Pilfering Hawk
75110.FlavorText:
"Well, at least it left us a mouse in exchange. Er . . . ugh . . . make that half a mouse."
—Binhald, Beskir veteran

75112.Name: Reflections of Littjara
75112.FlavorText: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

75113.Name: Run Ashore
75113.FlavorText:
"Which one of you slug-brained milksops forgot to make an offering to Cosima?"
—Jolkur, navigator

75116.Name: Strategic Planning
75116.FlavorText: Alrund sees the future as a whorl of signs and symbols, omens interwoven in an intricate knotwork only he can decipher.

75117.Name: Undersea Invader
75117.FlavorText:
"The currents are strange today, and the fish are fearful. Something's stirring in the depths."
—Rathstaf, Kannah fisherman

75121.Name: Crippling Fear
75121.FlavorText: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

75122.Name: Deathknell Berserker
75122.FlavorText:
"Sven felled the elf with an arrow through the chest, but moments later, the corpse rose with a sneer to fight again."
—Longbeard Saga

75123.Name: Demonic Gifts
75123.FlavorText: It began as a flavor on the tongue, like a bloody morsel of roast boar—but soon the power was a conflagration in her veins.

75124.Name: Dogged Pursuit
75124.FlavorText: Kaya had stalked countless horrific foes, but never one that killed with such callous precision and twisted creativity.

75126.Name: Draugr Recruiter
75126.FlavorText: "You cannot stand against us, but when you fall, you will stand with us!"

75128.Name: Dread Rider
75128.FlavorText:
"What kind of monstrous grave robber leaves the treasures, but takes the bodies?"
—Fjall, Beskir elder

75131.Name: Egon, God of Death
75131.FlavorText: Egon ages backward, his wisdom soured by youthful spite.
75131.RawFrameDetail: B legendary front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

75132.Name: Throne of Death
75132.FlavorText: It offers all the warmth and comfort of the grave.
75132.RawFrameDetail: B artifact legendary back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

75133.Name: Elderfang Disciple
75133.FlavorText: "One day, the great serpent will rejoin us on Skemfar, and those who've wronged us will taste of our venom."

75135.Name: Feed the Serpent
75135.FlavorText: He spent the final moments of his existence tumbling down the length of the serpent's jaws, driven mad by the magnitude of the Cosmos.

75136.Name: Grim Draugr
75136.FlavorText: She was a ragged shadow of her living form, but she had lost none of her deadly prowess.

75137.Name: Hailstorm Valkyrie
75137.FlavorText: When the path to Starnheim was opened, vengeance rained down upon the enemies of Bretagard.

75139.Name: Infernal Pet
75139.FlavorText:
"Here, my pet. Another little light for you to snuff out."
—Kzarakh, Immersturm gamekeeper

75141.Name: Karfell Kennel-Master
75141.FlavorText: Trapped in a realm of dead flesh and scarce hunting, the ravenous wolves of Karfell follow the Dread Marn to warm game.

75142.Name: Koma's Faithful
75142.FlavorText: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."

75143.Name: Poison the Cup
75143.FlavorText: Dark schemes cut down what armies cannot.

75145.Name: Raise the Draugr
75145.FlavorText: "King Narfi calls. We go to war!"

75149.Name: Skemfar Avenger
75149.FlavorText: Stripped of their divinity, the elves of Skemfar channeled their rage and sorrow into bloody brutality.

75152.Name: Tergrid, God of Fright
75152.FlavorText: Fear is her one true companion.
75152.RawFrameDetail: B legendary front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

75153.Name: Tergrid's Lantern
75153.FlavorText: When Tergrid was a child, her shadow tried to kill her. Only her lantern keeps it at bay.
75153.RawFrameDetail: B artifact legendary back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

75154.Name: Tergrid's Shadow
75154.FlavorText: Tergrid, god of fright, never acknowledges her own shadow . . . or its murderous deeds.

75155.Name: Valki, God of Lies
75155.RawFrameDetail: B legendary front side MFC, Z reverse-side reminder

75156.Name: Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor
75156.RawFrameDetail: BR gold planeswalker, 4 abilities, back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

75157.Name: Varragoth, Bloodsky Sire
75157.FlavorText: "I waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard."

75159.Name: Village Rites
75159.FlavorText: The Skelle raise scorn poles in conquered villages—cursed totems of wood and bone that sap survivors of physical strength and the will to fight back.

75160.Name: Weigh Down
75160.FlavorText: The draugr often drown intruders. Years later, their corpses rise from the depths to join the ranks of the Dread Marn.

75161.Name: Withercrown
75161.FlavorText:
"We'll see each other again soon."
—Egon, god of death

75163.Name: Axgard Cavalry
75163.FlavorText:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

75165.Name: Birgi, God of Storytelling
75165.FlavorText: "This is a tale to make all Kaldheim tremble . . ."
75165.RawFrameDetail: R legendary front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

75166.Name: Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
75166.FlavorText: Like her well of stories, Birgi's horn never runs dry.
75166.RawFrameDetail: R artifact legendary back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

75167.Name: Breakneck Berserker
75167.FlavorText: "Go for the knees! The last giant who tried to get past us got rolled back down the mountain in a dozen pieces."

75168.Name: Calamity Bearer
75168.FlavorText: He'd ignite the World Tree itself if he could.

75169.Name: Cinderheart Giant
75169.FlavorText: What fire giants lack in arcane prowess, they make up for with reckless, explosive rage.

75170.Name: Craven Hulk
75170.FlavorText: Abandoned at birth, the giant was raised by goats. Ironically, it grew up to be the most cautious member of the herd.

75178.Name: Fearless Liberator
75178.FlavorText: "No one else had the spine for it, so I ran right between that giant's legs and hauled poor Valdir back to Axgard!"

75180.Name: Frenzied Raider
75180.FlavorText: "Arrogant maggot. You won't be so proud when I rip out your tongue and drink from your skull!"

75181.Name: Frost Bite
75181.FlavorText:
"Don't wander far—it's a bit nippy out there!"
—Leidurr, expedition leader

75184.Name: Immersturm Raider
75184.FlavorText: The demons took no captives and claimed no spoils; they sought only to destroy.

75187.Name: Provoke the Trolls
75187.FlavorText:
"I like burning and pillaging as much as anyone, but sometimes it's just easier to throw a rock and let the trolls do the work."
—Urik, Tuskeri raid leader

75190.Name: Run Amok
75190.FlavorText:
"A Tuskeri never shrinks from battle! Quite the opposite in fact."
—Arni Brokenbrow

75192.Name: Seize the Spoils
75192.FlavorText: "Grab what you want and burn the rest. Leave nothing behind."

75193.Name: Shackles of Treachery
75193.FlavorText: In that instant, Toralf felt only the power of the storm and the need to destroy.

75194.Name: Smashing Success
75194.FlavorText:
"Who said there's no profit in destruction?"
—Magda, brazen outlaw

75195.Name: Squash
75195.FlavorText: The troll had recently crushed a human in much the same way. Sadly, he expired too quickly to appreciate the irony.

75197.Name: Toralf, God of Fury
75197.RawFrameDetail: R legendary front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

75198.Name: Toralf's Hammer
75198.RawFrameDetail: R artifact legendary back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

75200.Name: Tundra Fumarole
75200.FlavorText: The only thing that smells worse than troll is burnt troll.

75201.Name: Tuskeri Firewalker
75201.FlavorText: "Toralf blessed me with fire. I am worthy of Starnheim!"

75202.Name: Vault Robber
75202.FlavorText: The dwarves believe works of art should be passed down the generations, not buried with the dead.

75203.Name: Arachnoform
75203.FlavorText: Deep within endless webs of clinging silk, the weaver waits.

75205.Name: Blessing of Frost
75205.FlavorText: A friend of Jorn is never cold.

75208.Name: Broken Wings
75208.FlavorText:
"Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely. When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true."
—Saga of the Wisdom Seeker

75209.Name: Elderleaf Mentor
75209.FlavorText: "Our ancestors grew complacent in their divinity, allowing their lessers to topple them. Never again."

75212.Name: Esika, God of the Tree
75212.FlavorText: "I know this world, from canopy to roots."
75212.RawFrameDetail: G legendary front side MFC, Z reverse-side reminder

75213.Name: The Prismatic Bridge
75213.RawFrameDetail: Z gold legendary back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

75215.Name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
75215.FlavorText: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

75216.Name: Glittering Frost
75216.FlavorText: At last, the storm's rage subsided, leaving silent, frozen beauty in its wake.

75217.Name: Gnottvold Recluse
75217.FlavorText: Fed up with webs impeding travelers in other realms, Kolvori banished the giant spiders to Gnottvold, where their webs snare only the occasional rampaging troll.

75218.Name: Grizzled Outrider
75218.FlavorText: "Sure, a horse might be faster. But I'd like to see a horse take the head clean off a troll in one swipe!"

75219.Name: Guardian Gladewalker
75219.FlavorText: The raiders' only warning was a whisper floating through the mist: "Trespassers."

75220.Name: Horizon Seeker
75220.FlavorText: "A five-day climb? Ha! I'll do it in two."

75221.Name: Icehide Troll
75221.FlavorText: A troll's greatest weapon is its ability to emerge unexpectedly from the landscape.

75223.Name: Jaspera Sentinel
75223.FlavorText: The arrows of the elvish elite strike as true and deadly as the fangs of the Cosmos Serpent they revere.

75224.Name: Jorn, God of Winter
75224.RawFrameDetail: G snow legendary front side MFC, Z reverse-side reminder

75225.Name: Kaldring, the Rimestaff
75225.FlavorText: As the sagas tell it, Jorn collects a sliver of ice from every realm he visits.
75225.RawFrameDetail: UB gold snow legendary artifact back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

75226.Name: King Harald's Revenge
75226.FlavorText: "We will destroy the pretenders and reclaim the divinity of the Einir."

75227.Name: Kolvori, God of Kinship
75227.RawFrameDetail: G legendary front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

75228.Name: The Ringhart Crest
75228.FlavorText: Kolvori's love for her family knows no bounds.
75228.RawFrameDetail: G legendary back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

75229.Name: Littjara Glade-Warden
75229.FlavorText: In every tree, a restless spirit.

75230.Name: Mammoth Growth
75230.FlavorText: Thus the longhall became a flathall.

75234.Name: Ravenous Lindwurm
75234.FlavorText:
"I'm no coward, but I'd sooner tangle with a rampaging Torga troll than a hungry lindwurm!"
—Yegar, Beskir warrior

75236.Name: Rootless Yew
75236.FlavorText:
"We are bound to wander this forest forever. Sometimes I think it wanders with us."
—Ogni, Kannah scout

75237.Name: Roots of Wisdom
75237.FlavorText: Though imprisoned in Jaspera trees, the elvish gods known as the Einir still whisper through the ages.

75240.Name: Sculptor of Winter
75240.FlavorText: "I and my kin remember the old ways. The frost whispers to me in a language too ancient for the Skoti usurpers to comprehend."

75241.Name: Snakeskin Veil
75241.FlavorText: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

75256.Name: Firja, Judge of Valor
75256.FlavorText: She is both shepherd and reaper, and her judgment is final.

75267.Name: Koll, the Forgemaster
75267.FlavorText: Using tyrite from a fallen Cosmos monster, Koll forged a weapon to awe Halvar himself.

75269.Name: Maja, Bretagard Protector
75269.FlavorText: "Our enemies have breached our realm. To survive, the clans must fight as one!"

75271.Name: Narfi, Betrayer King
75271.FlavorText: To serve the god of death, Narfi forfeited the warmth of life.

75280.Name: Vega, the Watcher
75280.FlavorText: One eye sees the past, one the present, and one the future—and none can be deceived.

75284.Name: Cosmos Elixir
75284.FlavorText: The Skoti owe their immortality to the elixir, and the manner of its creation is their most closely guarded secret.

75285.Name: Funeral Longboat
75285.FlavorText:
"Cast onto the windless water, he drifted until the sea turned to sky."
—Saga of the Lost King

75290.Name: Raven Wings
75290.FlavorText:
"There are some places even our ships cannot travel. I would know their secrets too."
—Inga Rune-Eyes

75293.Name: Scorn Effigy
75293.FlavorText: It remembers every wound it has seen or suffered—and nothing else.

75295.Name: Alpine Meadow
75295.FlavorText:
"Here perished Rognar the Reckless after his hundred-day battle with the Ironmaw Dragon. We raised these stones to mark his resting place."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75296.Name: Arctic Treeline
75296.FlavorText:
"When the Light of Starnheim shines here, every frost-edged needle glitters with the reflected glory of the Cosmos."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75298.Name: Barkchannel Pathway
75298.FlavorText:
"Listen! The trees tell tales of their ancestors in the whisper-song of leaves."
—Inga Rune-Eyes
75298.RawFrameDetail: G land front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

75299.Name: Tidechannel Pathway
75299.FlavorText:
"Trust in the path, and it will bear you to safety."
—Inga Rune-Eyes
75299.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

75300.Name: Blightstep Pathway
75300.FlavorText:
"The waters smell oddly sweet, but do not be enticed. You don't want to meet what lurks below the surface."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior
75300.RawFrameDetail: B land front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

75301.Name: Searstep Pathway
75301.FlavorText:
"Our brave Tuskeri brethren blaze new trails, and we follow, mapping the routes of those who survive."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior
75301.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

75303.Name: Darkbore Pathway
75303.FlavorText:
"Hush, and stay still. No matter how dreary the darkness, a light in the Skelle Mire is never a good sign."
—Haugar, Kannah wayfinder
75303.RawFrameDetail: B land front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

75304.Name: Slitherbore Pathway
75304.FlavorText:
"The Cosmos Serpent carved these tunnels, and his echo remains, a twisting aura of ferocity and boundless growth."
—Haugar, Kannah wayfinder
75304.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

75305.Name: Faceless Haven
75305.FlavorText: It is everywhere and nowhere, a place unbound by logic, just beyond the real.

75307.Name: Glacial Floodplain
75307.FlavorText:
"A cliff once rose from the surf here—until Bjora Dawn-Greeter declared that it was blocking her view and pulled it down bare-handed."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75310.Name: Hengegate Pathway
75310.FlavorText:
"I cannot read these runes, yet somehow they seem like a warning. Have we passed unknowingly into a new realm?"
—Ekken, Omenseeker navigator
75310.RawFrameDetail: W land front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

75311.Name: Mistgate Pathway
75311.FlavorText:
"I've never seen mist so unnaturally thick as this—where does the sea end and the sky begin?"
—Ekken, Omenseeker navigator
75311.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

75312.Name: Highland Forest
75312.FlavorText:
"Tread carefully! The last time I walked this path, half the snowdrifts were, in fact, sleeping trolls. I've never run so fast in my life!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75313.Name: Ice Tunnel
75313.FlavorText:
"The ice cracked underfoot; strange shapes swam beneath the surface. Who else has walked this blighted path?"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75317.Name: Rimewood Falls
75317.FlavorText:
"For a fortnight, our warband lay still beneath the icy waters, breathing through reeds as we waited for the great bear to appear."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75318.Name: Shimmerdrift Vale
75318.FlavorText: Reflections from the wind-sculpted snow gleam with every color of the rainbow.

75320.Name: Snowfield Sinkhole
75320.FlavorText:
"Young Vitima bellowed to the Cosmos, daring the gods to punish her hubris! Well, she got their attention, as you can see."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75321.Name: Sulfurous Mire
75321.FlavorText:
"In my youth, we used to best each other at hopping rabbit-fast between the lava spouts, the burning tar spattering our legs."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75324.Name: Volatile Fjord
75324.FlavorText:
"I watched with my own eyes as Jari Eagle-Caller fell from these cliffs, only to be snatched from the air by a giant bird!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75325.Name: Woodland Chasm
75325.FlavorText:
"Is this the grave of a god? A tunnel carved by the Cosmos Serpent? It matters not. It is no place for us."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

75342.Name: Valkyrie Harbinger
75342.FlavorText: Where she flies, the Light of Starnheim shines.

75344.Name: Cleaving Reaper
75344.FlavorText: "I won't pollute my blade with your blood, demon. You'll die by your own axe!"

75346.Name: Canopy Tactician
75346.FlavorText: "Death and life are two ends of the same spear."

75347.Name: Armed and Armored
75347.FlavorText: The dwarves of Axgard seldom have reason to leave their impregnable underground kingdom—but when they do, they go in force.

75348.Name: Starnheim Aspirant
75348.FlavorText: "I do not fear death. I know my soul will rise to Starnheim, where I will feast forever among valkyries and heroes. Can you say the same?"

75349.Name: Warchanter Skald
75349.FlavorText: "Who will be the hero of my tale?"

75350.Name: Youthful Valkyrie
75350.FlavorText: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

75352.Name: Giant's Grasp
75352.FlavorText: "Behave and you'll be a fine pet. Bite me and you're ammunition."

75353.Name: Elderfang Ritualist
75353.FlavorText: Her fingers stiffened as the shrouded corpse stirred. Her final, ragged breath was one of triumph. "Return, my chosen, and grant our people victory!"

75356.Name: Bearded Axe
75356.FlavorText: Every dwarven artisan spends the first hundred years of their life forging a single weapon and infusing it with runic magic.

75357.Name: Fire Giant's Fury
75357.FlavorText: So ended the feast, the hall, and the clan.

75359.Name: Elven Ambush
75359.FlavorText:
"No elf can match a Tuskeri in combat. Why not charge?"
—Knorjolvin, Tuskeri raider

75361.Name: Rampage of the Valkyries
75361.FlavorText: "This is a foul place. Cleanse it."

75381.Name: Reflections of Littjara
75381.FlavorText: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

75383.Name: Barkchannel Pathway
75383.RawFrameDetail: G land front side MFC FIRE favorite, U reverse-side reminder

75384.Name: Tidechannel Pathway
75384.RawFrameDetail: U land back side MFC FIRE favorite, G reverse-side reminder

75385.Name: Blightstep Pathway
75385.RawFrameDetail: B land front side MFC FIRE favorite, R reverse-side reminder

75386.Name: Searstep Pathway
75386.RawFrameDetail: R land back side MFC FIRE favorite, B reverse-side reminder

75387.Name: Darkbore Pathway
75387.RawFrameDetail: B land front side MFC FIRE favorite, G reverse-side reminder

75388.Name: Slitherbore Pathway
75388.RawFrameDetail: G land back side MFC FIRE favorite, B reverse-side reminder

75445.Name: Bond of Discipline
75445.FlavorText: "We agree that order benefits everyone, but not until you enforce it."

75446.Name: Charmed Stray
75446.FlavorText:
"There's something peculiar about the cats today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker

75448.Name: Fencing Ace
75448.FlavorText: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

75449.Name: Goring Ceratops
75449.FlavorText:
"Follow her footsteps and she will show you the way."
—Itzama the Crested

75451.Name: Impassioned Orator
75451.FlavorText: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.

75453.Name: Knight's Pledge
75453.FlavorText: "As long as my faith persists, so shall I."

75454.Name: Leonin Warleader
75454.FlavorText: When one leonin hunts, many more are surely nearby.

75455.Name: Loxodon Line Breaker
75455.FlavorText: Loxodons are firm in stature and spirit. No matter the odds, they are always first into battle.

75456.Name: Moorland Inquisitor
75456.FlavorText: Inquisitors are taught scripture, philosophy, and the fine art of sharpening an axe.

75457.Name: Pacifism
75457.FlavorText: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

75458.Name: Sanctuary Cat
75458.FlavorText: Cats prowl the corridors of Avacyn's churches in search of devils or signs of their mischief.

75459.Name: Serra Angel
75459.FlavorText: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

75461.Name: Soulmender
75461.FlavorText: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

75464.Name: Air Elemental
75464.FlavorText: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

75465.Name: Armored Whirl Turtle
75465.FlavorText: Not all enormous beasts are quick to anger.

75466.Name: Cloudkin Seer
75466.FlavorText: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

75467.Name: Coral Merfolk
75467.FlavorText: The merfolk know every contour of their coral homes; each reef is a garden in times of peace, and a refuge and fortress in times of war.

75468.Name: Frilled Sea Serpent
75468.FlavorText:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler

75469.Name: Glint
75469.FlavorText: Rakshasa waste no opportunity to display their wealth and power, even in the midst of a sorcerous duel.

75470.Name: Octoprophet
75470.FlavorText: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

75471.Name: Overflowing Insight
75471.FlavorText: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

75472.Name: Riddlemaster Sphinx
75472.FlavorText: "Safe passage requires only a simple answer to a simple question, traveler."

75474.Name: Sleep
75474.FlavorText:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

75475.Name: Soulblade Djinn
75475.FlavorText: He grants endless wishes, as long as you always wish for a blade.

75476.Name: Sworn Guardian
75476.FlavorText: For the River Heralds, the Immortal Sun is an object of terror and devastation. The idea that anyone would retrieve it for their own use is utterly abhorrent.

75477.Name: Unsummon
75477.FlavorText:
"Don't you have somewhere else to be?"
—Sharuum the Hegemon

75478.Name: Wall of Runes
75478.FlavorText:
"It's strangely satisfying seeing an undead killing machine from another world standing befuddled in front of a wall of text."
—Lavinia

75479.Name: Warden of Evos Isle
75479.FlavorText: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

75480.Name: Waterkin Shaman
75480.FlavorText: "They come to drink, to bathe, and—I believe—to play."

75482.Name: Windreader Sphinx
75482.FlavorText: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

75483.Name: Windstorm Drake
75483.FlavorText: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

75484.Name: Winged Words
75484.FlavorText: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

75489.Name: Demon of Loathing
75489.FlavorText: Hatred is a potent ally, but an insatiable master.

75491.Name: Krovikan Scoundrel
75491.FlavorText: The few surviving humans of Krov would have welcomed the return of winter and its sterilizing cold. They often peered northward, hoping that the snow's edge had reached their infested city-tomb.

75492.Name: Malakir Cullblade
75492.FlavorText: Each cut stains his blade with fresh blood that he samples to increase his strength.

75494.Name: Murder
75494.FlavorText: "It's not work if you enjoy it."

75495.Name: Nightmare
75495.FlavorText: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

75497.Name: Raise Dead
75497.FlavorText: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

75498.Name: Sanitarium Skeleton
75498.FlavorText: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

75499.Name: Savage Gorger
75499.FlavorText: "I have no patience for sipping blood from crystal goblets. I want to bite and tear."

75500.Name: Scathe Zombies
75500.FlavorText:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

75501.Name: Sengir Vampire
75501.FlavorText: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

75502.Name: Skeleton Archer
75502.FlavorText:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

75504.Name: Typhoid Rats
75504.FlavorText: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.

75505.Name: Unlikely Aid
75505.FlavorText:
"No one will ever ride me again, Gideon. Expect no further favors."
—Rakdos

75507.Name: Witch's Familiar
75507.FlavorText: Some bog witches practice the strange art of batrachomancy, reading portents in the number, size, and color of warts on a toad's hide.

75508.Name: Bombard
75508.FlavorText:
"Want to sink a ship? Blow a hole in the hull. Want to kill a regisaur? Same answer."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

75509.Name: Burn Bright
75509.FlavorText:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

75510.Name: Fearless Halberdier
75510.FlavorText: "I spent some time in the Legion, but I'm done taking orders all day."

75512.Name: Goblin Gathering
75512.FlavorText: Two's a party. Three's a felony.

75513.Name: Goblin Trashmaster
75513.FlavorText: "Folks 'round here are too in love with their contraptions. Does them some good if we smash one every so often."

75514.Name: Goblin Tunneler
75514.FlavorText: "The best way over the mountain is through."

75515.Name: Hurloon Minotaur
75515.FlavorText: The minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

75516.Name: Immortal Phoenix
75516.FlavorText: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

75517.Name: Inescapable Blaze
75517.FlavorText:
"The Izzet are blamed for every little disaster, which is unfair because we only cause most of them."
—Mizzix of the Izmagnus

75518.Name: Maniacal Rage
75518.FlavorText: Rage is the culmination of an accelerating cycle of anger and violence that feeds itself in battle, spreading like a flame from one warrior to another.

75519.Name: Molten Ravager
75519.FlavorText:
"Only the foolhardy would venture into the Akoum Mountains without a lullmage to tame the raging rocks and living fires."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

75520.Name: Nest Robber
75520.FlavorText:
"These sailors on our shores are like the dinosaurs that plunder eggs from nests. They live on the labors of others."
—Itzama the Crested

75521.Name: Ogre Battledriver
75521.FlavorText: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

75523.Name: Raid Bombardment
75523.FlavorText: Goblins in the first wave of a fire raid always bemoan the aim of everyone else.

75524.Name: Reduce to Ashes
75524.FlavorText:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator

75525.Name: Shock
75525.FlavorText: "I love this thing! It's my best invention since the boulderfist gauntlet!"

75527.Name: Storm Strike
75527.FlavorText: "My shout is thunder and my fist is lightning!"

75529.Name: Volcanic Dragon
75529.FlavorText: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

75530.Name: Affectionate Indrik
75530.FlavorText: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

75532.Name: Charging Badger
75532.FlavorText:
"If the hierarchies of nature were determined by ferocity alone, the badger would be lord of the beasts."
—Anthousa of Setessa

75533.Name: Colossal Majesty
75533.FlavorText:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

75536.Name: Generous Stray
75536.FlavorText: Cats place their gifts with care, so that a bare foot will step on them in the middle of the night.

75537.Name: Gigantosaurus
75537.FlavorText:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid

75538.Name: Greenwood Sentinel
75538.FlavorText: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

75539.Name: Ilysian Caryatid
75539.FlavorText: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.

75540.Name: Jungle Delver
75540.FlavorText: "There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."

75541.Name: Prized Unicorn
75541.FlavorText:
"Friend and foe alike are irresistibly drawn to its beauty—the good, to their lasting reward, and the evil, to their brief and painful regret."
—Vivien Reid

75542.Name: Rabid Bite
75542.FlavorText:
"You should have seen the look on both their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

75543.Name: Rampaging Brontodon
75543.FlavorText: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

75544.Name: Rumbling Baloth
75544.FlavorText: In the dim light beneath the vast trees of Deepglade, baloths prowl in search of prey. Their guttural calls are more felt than heard, but their attack scream carries for miles.

75545.Name: Sentinel Spider
75545.FlavorText:
"Your first reaction may be to stand very still and hope she didn't see you. Trust me, she did."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

75546.Name: Stony Strength
75546.FlavorText: "What you build, we will destroy . . . and bury you in the rubble!"

75547.Name: Titanic Growth
75547.FlavorText: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

75549.Name: Wildwood Patrol
75549.FlavorText: If you're lucky, the centaurs will give a single warning to leave their territory before driving a spear into you. If you're unlucky, the spear is the warning.

75550.Name: Woodland Mystic
75550.FlavorText: "I sing to the branches, and they reach to the sky. I sing to the leaves, and they open to the sun. I sing to the roots, and they dig their fingers deep. I sing the song that creation sung."

75551.Name: World Shaper
75551.FlavorText: "The Great River will not be tamed."

75552.Name: Evolving Wilds
75552.FlavorText: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

75561.Name: Cancel
75561.FlavorText: "I decide what stands in my way."

75562.Name: Coral Merfolk
75562.FlavorText: The merfolk know every contour of their coral homes; each reef is a garden in times of peace, and a refuge and fortress in times of war.

75563.Name: Child of Night
75563.FlavorText: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.

75564.Name: Shambling Goblin
75564.FlavorText:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

75565.Name: Act of Treason
75565.FlavorText: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

75566.Name: Goblin Assailant
75566.FlavorText: What he lacks in patience, intelligence, empathy, lucidity, hygiene, ability to follow orders, self-regard, and discernible skills, he makes up for in sheer chaotic violence.

75567.Name: Infuriate
75567.FlavorText:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign

75568.Name: Spellgorger Weird
75568.FlavorText: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

75569.Name: Ancient Brontodon
75569.FlavorText: It is taller than all but the tallest trees, and older than all but the oldest.

75570.Name: Llanowar Elves
75570.FlavorText: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

75571.Name: Oakenform
75571.FlavorText:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

75572.Name: Primordial Wurm
75572.FlavorText:
"You can hear its tail thrashing from a mile away. Keep in mind that its jaws may already be half a mile closer."
—Jenson Carthalion, Yavimaya exile

75574.Name: Wardscale Crocodile
75574.FlavorText:
"The Eternals had to endure Amonkhet's five trials. Let's see if they can pass the Trial of Ravnica."
—Jace Beleren

75575.Name: Maned Serval
75575.FlavorText:
"Don't search the ruins of Orn during the day. Nethroi's many eyes will spot you instantly. Don't go at night either. You'll be dinner for the servals. Maybe just don't go."
—Rasai, Indatha hunter

75579.Name: Aerial Responder
75579.FlavorText: Dwarves have an instinct for repair, an inherent understanding of how systems work, and a reputation for fearlessness. They're perfect candidates for the Fair's emergency response team.

75580.Name: Aeronaut Admiral
75580.FlavorText: The Consulate recruits its best pilots from the League of Aeronauts. Many go on to command entire fleets.

75584.Name: Alley Evasion
75584.FlavorText: "Sure, you know the law. But I know the streets."

75586.Name: Audacious Infiltrator
75586.FlavorText: "This little critter can turn all of you to scrap in under thirty seconds! Come on, who wants to be the first to go? Try and stop me!"

75587.Name: Authority of the Consuls
75587.FlavorText: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

75588.Name: Aviary Mechanic
75588.FlavorText: Pilots take crippled skyships to the Aviaries, trusting Ghirapur's most talented mechanics to get them back into the air.

75589.Name: Built to Last
75589.FlavorText: Consulate-built automatons have a lifetime warranty.

75591.Name: Conviction
75591.FlavorText: "There is no greater coward than one who believes in nothing."

75592.Name: Countless Gears Renegade
75592.FlavorText: "Go forth and cause trouble, my little one!"

75593.Name: Dawnfeather Eagle
75593.FlavorText:
"It came to rest upon the angel's arm, and then the weight of their gazes fell upon me."
—Aeronaut's journal

75596.Name: Fragmentize
75596.FlavorText:
"Too much friction on your bearings, your countersinking is inconsistent, and there are lines in your casting. Dispose of it, and begin again."
—Dovin Baan

75597.Name: Fumigate
75597.FlavorText:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

75598.Name: Gearshift Ace
75598.FlavorText: Some display their trophies at the Hall of Mechanists. Others display their talent in the streets of Ghirapur.

75600.Name: Herald of the Fair
75600.FlavorText: "Welcome, one and all! Right this way! Open your eyes, your ears, and your imaginations to the wonders of the Inventors' Fair!"

75601.Name: Impeccable Timing
75601.FlavorText: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

75602.Name: Inspired Charge
75602.FlavorText: One dwarf on a build team ensures competence. All dwarves on the team ensures brilliance.

75603.Name: Master Trinketeer
75603.FlavorText: "Let us never forget the joy that lies at the heart of invention."

75604.Name: Propeller Pioneer
75604.FlavorText: "The sky isn't the limit. It's the starting point."

75605.Name: Refurbish
75605.FlavorText:
"There's no reason to buy a new one when I've got the tools to fix the one you've got."
—Ripu, repair specialist

75606.Name: Restoration Specialist
75606.FlavorText: Dwarves' tools are priceless heirlooms handed down through generations.

75607.Name: Revoke Privileges
75607.FlavorText: "By order of Consulate Mandate 482, I am required to detain you, citizen."

75608.Name: Servo Exhibition
75608.FlavorText:
"The judges really put them through their paces, but they prevailed. I think they even impressed Head Judge Tezzeret."
—Ritika, artificer

75609.Name: Skywhaler's Shot
75609.FlavorText: In the moment of truth, it is as though time stands still, and the whale waits, suspended in the sky.

75610.Name: Sram, Senior Edificer
75610.FlavorText: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

75611.Name: Sram's Expertise
75611.FlavorText: "It's important to always have the right tool for the job. This one is for picking my teeth."

75613.Name: Toolcraft Exemplar
75613.FlavorText: "If you wish to produce the finest work, you must start with the finest tools."

75614.Name: Visionary Augmenter
75614.FlavorText: "It's a multifunctional radial extension system with superlateral, force-amplifying rigging. Of course it will win."

75619.Name: Aether Tradewinds
75619.FlavorText: Consulate engineers have developed safe methods of harvesting aether, but renegades aren't always so careful.

75620.Name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
75620.FlavorText: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

75622.Name: Ceremonious Rejection
75622.FlavorText: The judges at the Fair are held in such high esteem that a nod of recognition can inspire an inventor for a lifetime—and a wave of dismissal can end a career.

75623.Name: Confiscation Coup
75623.FlavorText: "Citizens, do not resist. This is for your safety. Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now."

75624.Name: Disallow
75624.FlavorText:
"How easily your flames are quenched."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

75626.Name: Gearseeker Serpent
75626.FlavorText: Its collection is vast, yet each ship has a special place in its heart.

75627.Name: Glimmer of Genius
75627.FlavorText: Creators live for that moment of inspiration: precious, profound, perfect.

75629.Name: Hinterland Drake
75629.FlavorText:
"As a kid, I dreamed of flying on those wild drakes. They inspired me to build wings of my own."
—Nadja Cloudtoucher, aerowright

75630.Name: Ice Over
75630.FlavorText:
"Slow the Consulate with whatever you've got!"
—Jasi Ganin, master siphoner

75631.Name: Illusionist's Stratagem
75631.FlavorText:
"When everything hangs on a single moment, be sure you choose the right moment."
—Jace Beleren

75632.Name: Leave in the Dust
75632.FlavorText: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

75633.Name: Malfunction
75633.FlavorText: "They don't make them like they used to."

75634.Name: Metallic Rebuke
75634.FlavorText:
"Too little, too late. The machine is in motion."
—Tezzeret

75637.Name: Nimble Innovator
75637.FlavorText: "A failure is simply another opportunity for improvement. Just wait until you see what I come up with next."

75639.Name: Paradoxical Outcome
75639.FlavorText: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

75640.Name: Revolutionary Rebuff
75640.FlavorText: By the time a Consulate sanction becomes official, the renegade quicksmiths have already found a way to circumvent it.

75643.Name: Shipwreck Moray
75643.FlavorText: Shipwrecks do wonders for the local fauna, providing both shelter and aether.

75646.Name: Tezzeret's Ambition
75646.FlavorText: "To achieve what none have achieved before, one must dare what none have dared before."

75647.Name: Thriving Turtle
75647.FlavorText: Aether shapes everything on Kaladesh, from the sky to the sea.

75649.Name: Trophy Mage
75649.FlavorText: "The tools of the past will help us forge the future."

75650.Name: Weldfast Wingsmith
75650.FlavorText: "Airships are too confining. If I'm in the sky, I want to feel the wind in my hair and taste the aether."

75652.Name: Wind-Kin Raiders
75652.FlavorText: Small aeronaut societies like the Wind-Kin had little to lose by siding with the renegades, and much to gain.

75654.Name: Aetherborn Marauder
75654.FlavorText: "I don't know what that is or who it belongs to, but it's shiny and I want it."

75655.Name: Alley Strangler
75655.FlavorText: "You never know what day might be your last."

75656.Name: Daring Demolition
75656.FlavorText: Living so close to death gives the aetherborn an unusual perspective on risk.

75657.Name: Defiant Salvager
75657.FlavorText: "I didn't survive that crash just so I could fall to the likes of you."

75659.Name: Die Young
75659.FlavorText: "When the time comes, let go. Nothing lasts forever."

75660.Name: Embraal Bruiser
75660.FlavorText: In Embraal, inventor gangs defend their turf with ingenious devices and blunt objects.

75661.Name: Essence Extraction
75661.FlavorText: The "gifted" among the aetherborn can draw the life essence of other living beings into themselves.

75663.Name: Fen Hauler
75663.FlavorText:
"Success is found where others fear to look."
—Ara, renegade smuggler

75664.Name: Fortuitous Find
75664.FlavorText: An aetherborn wastes neither time nor treasure.

75665.Name: Foundry Hornet
75665.FlavorText: Its buzzing is easily mistaken for the hum of a thopter's wings.

75666.Name: Foundry Screecher
75666.FlavorText:
"My creations still can't match the dive speed of those floppy-winged mammals. Maybe I should enter one of them in the Fair."
—Viprikti, thopterist

75667.Name: Fourth Bridge Prowler
75667.FlavorText: Renegades run the gamut from lofty sages to petty thieves.

75668.Name: Fretwork Colony
75668.FlavorText: The swarm leaves behind a flawless pattern that only occasionally threatens the structural integrity of the wood.

75669.Name: Gifted Aetherborn
75669.FlavorText: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

75673.Name: Live Fast
75673.FlavorText: "When you have the chance, take it. Laugh, sing, dance. Don't allow the night to end."

75674.Name: Lost Legacy
75674.FlavorText:
"That name shall not be spoken."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

75679.Name: Mind Rot
75679.FlavorText: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

75680.Name: Night Market Aeronaut
75680.FlavorText: "Death might come tomorrow, but today—today I am alive."

75681.Name: Night Market Lookout
75681.FlavorText: The Consulate rarely cracks the coded announcement of a night market's location before dawn, and enforcers are taken care of if they wander too close.

75683.Name: Rush of Vitality
75683.FlavorText: Short lives lead to forbidden choices.

75685.Name: Subtle Strike
75685.FlavorText: Renegades do some of their best work right under the Consulate's nose.

75687.Name: Vengeful Rebel
75687.FlavorText: Some aetherborn joined the rebellion for profit, others for the sake of their freedom, still others for revenge.

75688.Name: Weaponcraft Enthusiast
75688.FlavorText:
"No, I don't believe they have the proper permits for those, but I'm not going to be the one to ask."
—Caru, Consulate warden

75689.Name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
75689.FlavorText: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

75690.Name: Yahenni's Expertise
75690.FlavorText: "The Consulate pushed me to my limit, darling, and this is the result."

75693.Name: Built to Smash
75693.FlavorText: Free from Consulate regulations, renegade-built automatons push performance to the limit.

75694.Name: Cathartic Reunion
75694.FlavorText: The chasm of years and worlds collapsed under the power of their embrace.

75696.Name: Chandra's Pyrohelix
75696.FlavorText: "This one's for my mom, and this one's for me."

75697.Name: Chandra's Revolution
75697.FlavorText: Chandra was driven by her anger, directed particularly at the man who had taken her father from her.

75699.Name: Destructive Tampering
75699.FlavorText:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

75700.Name: Enraged Giant
75700.FlavorText: When fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, the aether weapons and swooping airships angered the normally placid creatures.

75701.Name: Fateful Showdown
75701.FlavorText: Tonight at the Grand Exhibition, witness Head Judge Tezzeret face off against the infamous renegade Pia Nalaar.

75702.Name: Freejam Regent
75702.FlavorText: The dragons perching in Freejam's towers symbolize the zone's fierce independence.

75703.Name: Frontline Rebel
75703.FlavorText: "Will you be strong and stand with me?"

75704.Name: Furious Reprisal
75704.FlavorText:
"Now that's the Chandra I've been waiting to see."
—Liliana Vess

75706.Name: Hijack
75706.FlavorText: "Whoa there. Easy. We're just going to take a little detour."

75707.Name: Hungry Flames
75707.FlavorText: In the hold of the Heart of Kiran, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

75709.Name: Inventor's Apprentice
75709.FlavorText:
"Everyone starts off making garbage. If you finally make something halfway decent, it'll be the best day of your life."
—Nehra, inventor

75710.Name: Invigorated Rampage
75710.FlavorText: Gremlins can change from pest to problem to plague in the span of a moment.

75711.Name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
75711.FlavorText: Aboard her ship, the Dragon's Smile, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

75713.Name: Lathnu Sailback
75713.FlavorText: Travelers to Lathnu, high on the Devra Cliffs, need not fear the political strife of Ghirapur . . . but they have other dangers to worry about.

75715.Name: Precise Strike
75715.FlavorText: "Hit where it hurts, and always hit first."

75716.Name: Quicksmith Genius
75716.FlavorText: Quicksmiths are eager to jump from one project to the next, relying on flashes of inspiration rather than careful research.

75717.Name: Quicksmith Rebel
75717.FlavorText: "Let's add just a bit more stopping power."

75718.Name: Ravenous Intruder
75718.FlavorText:
"I've made some fine acquisitions of late, so I'm planning to make commensurate improvements to my security systems. I have a consultant coming tomorrow."
—Kurna Majan, Luminary League

75719.Name: Reckless Fireweaver
75719.FlavorText: Architects find inspiration in the dragon's beauty of form, while artificers are influenced by the function of its fire.

75720.Name: Ruinous Gremlin
75720.FlavorText: City officials once sent twenty gleaming automatons to exterminate a nest of gremlins. They soon saw the error of their ways.

75721.Name: Salivating Gremlins
75721.FlavorText: If an elf can dream it, a dwarf can build it, and a gremlin can eat it.

75723.Name: Siege Modification
75723.FlavorText: Perfect for getting through to the consuls.

75725.Name: Speedway Fanatic
75725.FlavorText: If her vehicle even has a brake, she couldn't tell you which pedal it is.

75726.Name: Spireside Infiltrator
75726.FlavorText: "The Consulate promised that we would all have access to aether. I'm just keeping them honest."

75727.Name: Sweatworks Brawler
75727.FlavorText: The residents of Embraal were never known for finesse, just for getting things done.

75728.Name: Welding Sparks
75728.FlavorText:
"The fires of invention burn in all of us. I fight for the freedom to unleash those flames."
—Pia Nalaar

75729.Name: Appetite for the Unnatural
75729.FlavorText:
"I'd just let the monkey have it if I were you. You can make another, but the same can't be said of your fingers."
—Turni, Greenwheel groundskeeper

75730.Name: Arborback Stomper
75730.FlavorText: The power of aether draws creatures to it like a magnetic force, and those that are touched by it are forever altered.

75731.Name: Armorcraft Judge
75731.FlavorText: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

75732.Name: Attune with Aether
75732.FlavorText: "I've never seen a world where aether weaves through every aspect of nature."

75733.Name: Blossoming Defense
75733.FlavorText: Those who move harmoniously with the flow of aether can channel the power of the natural world.

75735.Name: Commencement of Festivities
75735.FlavorText: Never before have there been so many brilliant minds and wondrous inventions in one place. Denizens from every corner of Kaladesh will flock to the once-in-a-lifetime Inventors' Fair.

75736.Name: Creeping Mold
75736.FlavorText: Sanctions, mandates, regulations . . . These things mean nothing to the natural world.

75737.Name: Druid of the Cowl
75737.FlavorText: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

75738.Name: Greenbelt Rampager
75738.FlavorText: Subtlety is not a necessary part of sabotage.

75739.Name: Heroic Intervention
75739.FlavorText:
"Wherever the strong would harm the weak, I will be there."
—Ajani Goldmane

75741.Name: Highspire Infusion
75741.FlavorText:
"If nothing else, the Inventors' Fair taught us that we're only beginning to discover aether's true potential."
—Kershan Danil, Highspire artisan

75742.Name: Hunt the Weak
75742.FlavorText: Natural evolution is often at odds with industrial progress.

75743.Name: Kujar Seedsculptor
75743.FlavorText: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

75744.Name: Lifecraft Cavalry
75744.FlavorText:
"I do not ask you to be tame. I only ask you to be true."
—Rishkar, Peema renegade

75748.Name: Narnam Renegade
75748.FlavorText: "I do not need to pierce your heart to still its beating."

75749.Name: Nature's Way
75749.FlavorText: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

75751.Name: Ornamental Courage
75751.FlavorText: Inspired by the thorns and brambles of the untamed wilds, elvish armor is both beautiful and formidable.

75752.Name: Oviya Pashiri, Sage Lifecrafter
75752.FlavorText: "Inspiration is reciprocal: we all have a responsibility to each other to create."

75754.Name: Peema Outrider
75754.FlavorText: Connected as artificer and invention, bonded as rider and steed.

75755.Name: Ridgescale Tusker
75755.FlavorText:
"Each creature holds a solution to a problem, a lesson to be learned."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

75757.Name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
75757.FlavorText: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

75758.Name: Rishkar's Expertise
75758.FlavorText: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

75759.Name: Sage of Shaila's Claim
75759.FlavorText: Even now, Shaila's descendants proudly occupy the greenway that she refused to relinquish to the Consulate.

75760.Name: Servant of the Conduit
75760.FlavorText: "Creation without connection to nature is just manufacture."

75761.Name: Thriving Rhino
75761.FlavorText: As unpredictable as aether, and just as hard to contain.

75762.Name: Unbridled Growth
75762.FlavorText:
"If the Consulate has abandoned restraint, so too shall the wilds."
—Surash, keeper of the Cowl

75764.Name: Wild Wanderer
75764.FlavorText: "We all began in nature, and nature is where we belong."

75765.Name: Wildest Dreams
75765.FlavorText:
"I opened my mind to the immensity of the wonders around me. It was only then that I could see the Great Conduit."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

75767.Name: Cloudblazer
75767.FlavorText: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

75768.Name: Contraband Kingpin
75768.FlavorText: "Don't waste my time with trifles. Bring me works of art, and I will make you rich."

75772.Name: Empyreal Voyager
75772.FlavorText: "For years, I studied the aethersphere from afar, but it was not until I touched the aether for myself that I came to know the power contained in the swirling sky."

75774.Name: Hazardous Conditions
75774.FlavorText: "There are many reasons we invent, of which survival is not the least."

75776.Name: Kambal, Consul of Allocation
75776.FlavorText: He has "friends" in places both high and low, and all seem to owe him favors.

75778.Name: Oath of Ajani
75778.FlavorText: "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

75779.Name: Outland Boar
75779.FlavorText: The vibrant forest of Peema is awash with aether. Its animals are stronger, faster, and more aggressive than their counterparts elsewhere.

75782.Name: Renegade Wheelsmith
75782.FlavorText: Many veterans of the Ovalchase racetrack turned their talents to the renegade cause.

75783.Name: Restoration Gearsmith
75783.FlavorText: All she touches turns to well-oiled, delicately calibrated, perfectly balanced gold.

75784.Name: Rogue Refiner
75784.FlavorText: "It's natural, it's all around us, and it's there for the taking. Just try and tell me what I'm doing is wrong."

75786.Name: Spire Patrol
75786.FlavorText: "After I examine your cargo and check your papers, you can be on your way."

75789.Name: Unlicensed Disintegration
75789.FlavorText: "I'd stand back if I were you."

75790.Name: Veteran Motorist
75790.FlavorText: He's set to compete in every race at the Fair, and he plans to win them all.

75792.Name: Weldfast Engineer
75792.FlavorText: "Let's err on the side of glorious mayhem."

75793.Name: Whirler Virtuoso
75793.FlavorText: The first tentative flaps are like a song to his soul.

75795.Name: Aetherflux Reservoir
75795.FlavorText: While most power is used for ordinary, everyday tasks, one shouldn't underestimate its potential for the extraordinary.

75799.Name: Barricade Breaker
75799.FlavorText:
"The Consulate sought to crush us. Let's give them a taste of their own medicine."
—Venkat Dasai, renegade commander

75800.Name: Bastion Mastodon
75800.FlavorText: The Consulate's automaton bank contains only the most impressive specimens.

75803.Name: Chief of the Foundry
75803.FlavorText: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

75806.Name: Consulate Skygate
75806.FlavorText: All skyships entering or leaving the fairgrounds must pass through the security checkpoint.

75807.Name: Consulate Turret
75807.FlavorText:
"Our watchtowers are well positioned. Why don't we arm them?"
—Enforcer-Chief Ranaj

75812.Name: Dukhara Peafowl
75812.FlavorText: Elegant filigree birds perch along the eleven bridges that cross Canal Dukhara.

75813.Name: Dynavolt Tower
75813.FlavorText:
"I like that Tezzeret. He has vision the other judges don't. He sees the potential in what we're making here."
—Faiz, inventor

75814.Name: Eager Construct
75814.FlavorText: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

75817.Name: Filigree Familiar
75817.FlavorText:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

75819.Name: Foundry Inspector
75819.FlavorText: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

75821.Name: Hope of Ghirapur
75821.FlavorText: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

75822.Name: Implement of Examination
75822.FlavorText: A tool to see the unseen.

75826.Name: Key to the City
75826.FlavorText: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

75827.Name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
75827.FlavorText:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

75828.Name: Merchant's Dockhand
75828.FlavorText:
"If you can build it, we can move it."
—Bes Tavani, Bomat merchant

75831.Name: Narnam Cobra
75831.FlavorText: Some say tales of the Narnam greenhouse are told to scare the children, but every tale grows from a seed of truth.

75832.Name: Ornithopter
75832.FlavorText:
"You want to know what we are fighting for? Look at the wonder in that child's eyes."
—Pia Nalaar

75833.Name: Ovalchase Dragster
75833.FlavorText: It'll either crash or win the race. Possibly both.

75834.Name: Pacification Array
75834.FlavorText: The Consulate had access to thousands of innovative devices displayed at the Inventors' Fair. A few small changes transformed some of them from marvels of ingenuity to instruments of oppression.

75835.Name: Panharmonicon
75835.FlavorText: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

75836.Name: Paradox Engine
75836.FlavorText:
"One look at this glorious item convinced me that Kaladesh deserved my full attention. Sure enough, my time here has yielded exquisite fruit."
—Tezzeret

75837.Name: Peacewalker Colossus
75837.FlavorText:
"Peace? Its sole purpose is fear."
—Saheeli Rai

75838.Name: Pendulum of Patterns
75838.FlavorText: Its elaborate designs reveal secrets of aether's flow.

75839.Name: Planar Bridge
75839.FlavorText:
"It is finished. Now the real work can begin."
—Tezzeret

75840.Name: Prakhata Pillar-Bug
75840.FlavorText: Not a mote of dust escapes the dutiful cleaners that keep the exclusive Prakhata Club immaculate.

75842.Name: Renegade Map
75842.FlavorText: "We have safe houses in every zone, but you'll never find one without this."

75843.Name: Reservoir Walker
75843.FlavorText: Renegade supply lines are, by necessity, mobile and difficult to disrupt.

75845.Name: Scrapheap Scrounger
75845.FlavorText: Some machines refuse to accept their own obsolescence.

75847.Name: Servo Schematic
75847.FlavorText: The Consulate prizes innovation when it is dependable and replicable.

75850.Name: Universal Solvent
75850.FlavorText:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

75851.Name: Untethered Express
75851.FlavorText: Rules and rails are made to be broken.

75853.Name: Weldfast Monitor
75853.FlavorText: The avant-garde among Ghirapur's inventors disregard the Consulate's safety standards completely.

75854.Name: Whirlermaker
75854.FlavorText:
"Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves."
—Saheeli Rai

75856.Name: Workshop Assistant
75856.FlavorText: Sometimes the smallest things make the biggest difference.

75857.Name: Aether Hub
75857.FlavorText: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

75858.Name: Blooming Marsh
75858.FlavorText: A retreat to nature can inspire even the most jaded inventor.

75859.Name: Botanical Sanctum
75859.FlavorText: Life inspires technology, which expands life's domain.

75860.Name: Concealed Courtyard
75860.FlavorText: Where high society and dark opportunity intersect.

75864.Name: Inspiring Vantage
75864.FlavorText: Ghirapur is a beacon of inspiration, attracting the most brilliant minds on Kaladesh.

75875.Name: Spire of Industry
75875.FlavorText: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

75876.Name: Spirebluff Canal
75876.FlavorText: There's so much more to Ghirapur than can be accessed by traditional roads.

75880.Name: Ragavan
75880.RawFrameDetail: R token legendary, no text box

75909.Name: Sculpting Steel
75909.FlavorText: Perfected by the kinetic sculptor Shanti Makam, these self-assembling metal strands can be coaxed into any shape imaginable.

75916.Name: Ornithopter
75916.FlavorText:
"Consider all confiscated items hostile until proven otherwise."
—Confiscation directive

75917.Name: Paradox Engine
75917.FlavorText:
"This device was submitted to the Fair anonymously. It is imperative that its maker be found. We must understand it."
—Confiscation directive

75918.Name: Planar Bridge
75918.FlavorText:
"Rashmi's design was just the beginning. We are most eager to see what the High Consul has planned for it."
—Consulate engineer's log

75919.Name: Aether Hub
75919.FlavorText: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

75920.Name: Servo Exhibition
75920.FlavorText: Impressing a judge is one thing. Delighting a child is another.

75953.Name: Abiding Grace
75953.FlavorText:
"Into the smothering dark, Serra spoke a single word: ‘Hope.'"
—Song of All, canto 2

75956.Name: Arcbound Prototype
75956.FlavorText: It flickered to life, saw itself alone, and began to build.

75963.Name: Disciple of the Sun
75963.FlavorText: Heart of a titan, faith as bright as the dawn.

75964.Name: Esper Sentinel
75964.FlavorText: The more Esper changes, the more he refuses to.

75965.Name: Fairgrounds Patrol
75965.FlavorText: "No signs of any suspicious activity. Yet."

75966.Name: Glorious Enforcer
75966.FlavorText: "You are unworthy of life, but take heart. You have earned a clean death."

75968.Name: Healer's Flock
75968.FlavorText: The sight of a flock overhead is bittersweet. It means many are wounded, but it also means help is on the way.

75971.Name: Late to Dinner
75971.FlavorText: "I knew you were set in your ways, friend, but even I didn't expect you to keep our engagement, under the circumstances."

75980.Name: Scour the Desert
75980.FlavorText: Even in the most barren wastelands, every death feeds more life.

75993.Name: Etherium Spinner
75993.FlavorText: "Thopters from a foundry always lack that personal touch."

75994.Name: Filigree Attendant
75994.FlavorText:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dexterous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves." 
—Coruk, Esper artificer

75995.Name: Floodhound
75995.FlavorText: The thief doubled back twice, doused herself with perfume, crossed the ocean, and still woke up with her pursuer close on her heels.

75999.Name: Hard Evidence
75999.FlavorText: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.

76006.Name: Parcel Myr
76006.FlavorText:
"Crack it open. Maybe it knows something we can use."
—Kara Vrist, Mirran resistance

76008.Name: Raving Visionary
76008.FlavorText: "Fear not, child. Open your eyes and witness Keranos's truth!"

76009.Name: Recalibrate
76009.FlavorText:
"Trial 991: Still encountering issues with accidental aetherization. Maybe if we widen the dimensional matrix to 0.7?"
—Izzet research notes

76015.Name: Scuttletide
76015.FlavorText:
"We're going to need more butter."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

76019.Name: Steelfin Whale
76019.FlavorText: It feeds on metal filings suspended in the water, sieving flecks of precious ore through magnetic baleen.

76025.Name: Thought Monitor
76025.FlavorText: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

76032.Name: Cabal Initiate
76032.FlavorText: "Hear our prayers, oh Shadowed One, and bless us in bloody agony."

76037.Name: Discerning Taste
76037.FlavorText: "Everyone loves a dash of crushed pixie . . . except the pixie."

76038.Name: Echoing Return
76038.FlavorText: A single ambition unleashes a legion of horrors.

76041.Name: Gilt-Blade Prowler
76041.FlavorText:
"Let's just say my people are in the business of capital acquisition and intellectual property speculation."
—Er-Miral

76043.Name: Hell Mongrel
76043.FlavorText: It feeds on shadows, fear, and blood.

76044.Name: Kitchen Imp
76044.FlavorText: "Order up! Ooze aspic and jellied anurid eyes!"

76045.Name: Legion Vanguard
76045.FlavorText: It takes guts to be a trailblazer.

76054.Name: Sinister Starfish
76054.FlavorText:
"Throw that one back. I don't like how it's looking at me."
—Netos, Meletian fisherman

76055.Name: Sudden Edict
76055.FlavorText:
"In one future, I see glory. In the other . . . well, that's another story."
—Whisper, blood liturgist

76058.Name: Tourach's Canticle
76058.FlavorText: The same hymns Tourach sang to praise the Ebon Praetor would later be adapted to glorify Tourach himself.

76061.Name: Vermin Gorger
76061.FlavorText:
"Once, vampires ruled this world, commanding the fear and respect that befit our noble blood. Have we truly sunk so low?"
—Sorin Markov

76064.Name: Young Necromancer
76064.FlavorText: "Who needs imaginary friends when you've got dead ones?"

76072.Name: Captain Ripley Vance
76072.FlavorText: The Spitfire Bastion bristles with cannons claimed from every ship she's conquered.

76074.Name: Faithless Salvaging
76074.FlavorText: All that's left are broken beliefs.

76085.Name: Gouged Zealot
76085.FlavorText: He can't fear what he can't see.

76086.Name: Harmonic Prodigy
76086.FlavorText: Each note strikes with deadly precision.

76089.Name: Lightning Spear
76089.FlavorText: When wielded, it begs to be released.

76097.Name: Slag Strider
76097.FlavorText: Imbued with life by a stray bolt of spellcraft, it began to wander about the foundry, to the blacksmiths' alarm.

76098.Name: Spreading Insurrection
76098.FlavorText: Everyone wants to be on the winning side.

76099.Name: Strike It Rich
76099.FlavorText: A few coins soon grow into an obsession.

76101.Name: Unholy Heat
76101.FlavorText: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

76102.Name: Viashino Lashclaw
76102.FlavorText: "Victory is the greatest motivator of all. So sayeth the bey."

76111.Name: Deepwood Denizen
76111.FlavorText: "You didn't come all this way just to bother me, did you? Say your piece and be gone."

76112.Name: Duskshell Crawler
76112.FlavorText: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.

76117.Name: Funnel-Web Recluse
76117.FlavorText: It thrives on a steady diet of hastily disposed-of evidence.

76122.Name: Herd Baloth
76122.FlavorText: Baloth social structure is simple: the biggest one's the leader.

76124.Name: Jewel-Eyed Cobra
76124.FlavorText:
"Sure, they're worth a lot, but I'd rather survive to spend my earnings."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

76128.Name: Sanctum Weaver
76128.FlavorText: The arrival of spring's first flowers is a sacred occasion to Karametra's acolytes, who fill the Setessan woods with song in celebration.

76130.Name: Smell Fear
76130.FlavorText:
"It's fun when they run a little."
—Wasitora, Nekoru queen

76133.Name: Sylvan Anthem
76133.FlavorText:
The harsher the winter, the more glorious the spring.
—Yavimaya saying

76137.Name: Urban Daggertooth
76137.FlavorText: Stop, smell the roses, eat the peoples.

76139.Name: Wren's Run Hydra
76139.FlavorText: The boggart hopped carelessly among the roots . . . until the roots woke up.

76141.Name: Arcus Acolyte
76141.FlavorText: "Archery requires holding an enormous amount of tension and making it look effortless."

76143.Name: Breathless Knight
76143.FlavorText: A deadly charge in eerie silence.

76147.Name: Combine Chrysalis
76147.FlavorText:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

76150.Name: Drey Keeper
76150.FlavorText: He gave the squirrels acorns. They gave him vengeance.

76159.Name: Lazotep Chancellor
76159.FlavorText:
"Cease all psychic attacks pending intel on enemy countermeasures."
—Dimir communiqué

76166.Name: Ravenous Squirrel
76166.FlavorText:
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels."
—Joskun, An-Havva constable

76167.Name: Rakdos Headliner
76167.FlavorText: Caution: Audience in front row may have throats ripped out.

76171.Name: Storm God's Oracle
76171.FlavorText: The lives of Keranos's chosen are brief and brilliant as lightning.

76172.Name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
76172.FlavorText: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

76188.Name: Myr Scrapling
76188.FlavorText:
"They're useful creatures, but quite replaceable. I find it best not to get too attached."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

76192.Name: Sanctuary Raptor
76192.FlavorText: The song of the Worldsoul can take on life in the most unlikely places.

76203.Name: Darkmoss Bridge
76203.FlavorText: The path to power is forged in ruthlessness.

76204.Name: Drossforge Bridge
76204.FlavorText: The path to ruin is forged in pain.

76206.Name: Mistvault Bridge
76206.FlavorText: The path to knowledge is forged in hunger.

76209.Name: Razortide Bridge
76209.FlavorText: The path to unity is forged in understanding.

76210.Name: Rustvale Bridge
76210.FlavorText: The path to strength is forged in stability.

76212.Name: Goldmire Bridge
76212.FlavorText: The path to glory is forged in ambition.

76213.Name: Silverbluff Bridge
76213.FlavorText: The path to genius is forged in creativity.

76214.Name: Slagwoods Bridge
76214.FlavorText: The path to action is forged in confidence.

76215.Name: Tanglepool Bridge
76215.FlavorText: The path to change is forged in insight.

76216.Name: Thornglint Bridge
76216.FlavorText: The path to growth is forged in balance.

76229.Name: Wonder
76229.FlavorText:
"It fell silently from the sky and broke the surface without a ripple. Was it even here at all?"
—Fisherman's journal

76242.Name: Hunting Pack
76242.FlavorText: There is no "I" in "team," but there is definitely "meat."

76244.Name: Squirrel Mob
76244.FlavorText: An army of squirrels is still an army.

76275.Name: Golem
76275.RawFrameDetail: RW artifact token, no text box

76392.Name: Evolving Wilds
76392.FlavorText:
"We don't make mistakes, just happy little accidents."
—Bob Ross

76393.Name: Environmental Sciences
76393.FlavorText: First-years quickly learn how the Vastlands earned its name.

76394.Name: Expanded Anatomy
76394.FlavorText: "Changing the equation from incremental to exponential was a stroke of genius on my part."

76395.Name: Introduction to Annihilation
76395.FlavorText:
"I've never seen a student fail quite so spectacularly. There's potential in that."
—Hostram, professor of arcanochemistry

76396.Name: Introduction to Prophecy
76396.FlavorText: Final grades are posted on the first day of class.

76397.Name: Mascot Exhibition
76397.FlavorText:
"Don't just win the game. Win the crowd."
—Moriana, Mage Tower coach

76398.Name: Wandering Archaic
76398.RawFrameDetail: C creature front side MFC, C reverse-side reminder

76399.Name: Explore the Vastlands
76399.RawFrameDetail: C creature back side MFC, C reverse-side reminder

76401.Name: Ageless Guardian
76401.FlavorText: Ancient ruins dot the world of Arcavios, most older than Strixhaven itself and many still guarded by soldiers from the Blood Age, centuries after their deaths.

76402.Name: Beaming Defiance
76402.FlavorText:
"I've lived too long in my father's shadow. It's time to find my own light."
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student

76403.Name: Clever Lumimancer
76403.FlavorText: "You're too dim to realize it, but you've already lost."

76404.Name: Combat Professor
76404.FlavorText: "Before Yovus was cut down at Pranticle Peak, she performed which maneuver? Anyone? From the reading?"

76405.Name: Defend the Campus
76405.FlavorText: Professors scrambled to push the mage hunters back, leaving the heart of Strixhaven undefended.

76409.Name: Eager First-Year
76409.FlavorText: Today, she learns the basics. She'll knock out advanced theory later this week.

76410.Name: Elite Spellbinder
76410.FlavorText: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, World Champion XXVI

76411.Name: Expel
