76411.FlavorText: Quintorius was a daydreamer, far happier digging through history books than practicing battle tactics. He agreed with the military academy on only one thing: he did not belong in their ranks.

76412.Name: Guiding Voice
76412.FlavorText: When honormancers work together, their compliments are complementary.

76413.Name: Leonin Lightscribe
76413.FlavorText: All who hear his inspiring words are filled with hope and pride.

76416.Name: Pillardrop Rescuer
76416.FlavorText: Gentle hands of stone whisk the careless from the crumbling ruins of Pillardrop.

76417.Name: Professor of Symbology
76417.FlavorText: "A language isn't dead until we stop learning from it."

76418.Name: Reduce to Memory
76418.FlavorText:
"Do not flinch from studying the horrors of the past. History's most important lessons are cloaked in terror and tragedy."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

76419.Name: Secret Rendezvous
76419.FlavorText: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.

76423.Name: Star Pupil
76423.FlavorText: "When I'm done here, they'll name entire buildings after me."

76424.Name: Stonebinder's Familiar
76424.FlavorText:
"Hey, my great-great-grandfather had a dog just like that!"
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student

76425.Name: Stonerise Spirit
76425.FlavorText: The carved cliffs of Pillardrop thrum with the sounds of ancient spirits rising from the past.

76426.Name: Strict Proctor
76426.FlavorText: "You might believe being dead for centuries has made me more lenient. I think you'll find the opposite to be true."

76427.Name: Study Break
76427.FlavorText: "You've been cramming all night. You're taking a nap whether you like it or not."

76429.Name: Arcane Subtraction
76429.FlavorText: The class learned little that day.

76430.Name: Archmage Emeritus
76430.FlavorText: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

76431.Name: Burrog Befuddler
76431.FlavorText: Students who seek river herbs in Doradur quickly find themselves slightly damp and thoroughly surrounded.

76432.Name: Bury in Books
76432.FlavorText: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

76433.Name: Curate
76433.FlavorText: "Kathorran War Chants, Vol. III? That doesn't even belong in this wing!"

76434.Name: Divide by Zero
76434.FlavorText: "Misery. Inadequacy. Failure. The common denominator is you."

76436.Name: Frost Trickster
76436.FlavorText: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.

76438.Name: Kelpie Guide
76438.FlavorText: Kelpies are drawn to paradoxes, making them ideal companions for Quandrix mages.

76439.Name: Mentor's Guidance
76439.FlavorText: Kasmina had encouraged the twins to apply. Strixhaven would test not only their magical potential, but also their character.

76440.Name: Mercurial Transformation
76440.FlavorText: "For sun's sake, I just want a crab!"

76442.Name: Pop Quiz
76442.FlavorText: "Today is hydromancy? I thought it was amplimancy! I studied for amplimancy!"

76443.Name: Reject
76443.FlavorText:
"Grux, for the last time, you have to do more than simply shout ‘Apply!' at the administrators."
—Pavil, admissions officer

76444.Name: Resculpt
76444.FlavorText: Critics were struck first by the elemental's surprising grace, and then by its fists.

76446.Name: Snow Day
76446.FlavorText:
"Advanced Elemental Manifestations is canceled until all students have thawed."
—Prismari dormitory notice

76447.Name: Solve the Equation
76447.FlavorText: Zimone's brilliance drew attention from many, including the sinister mages known as the Oriq.

76448.Name: Soothsayer Adept
76448.FlavorText: One of the first lessons divination students learn is how to recognize the difference between a portent and a simple surface ripple.

76449.Name: Symmetry Sage
76449.FlavorText: "By my calculations, I should be able to achieve true enlightenment before graduation."

76450.Name: Teachings of the Archaics
76450.FlavorText: Mages seek out the ancient beings known as the Archaics for their boundless knowledge of history and magic, dispensed only in cryptic metaphors.

76451.Name: Tempted by the Oriq
76451.FlavorText: To exact his vengeance, Extus needed followers. His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

76453.Name: Vortex Runner
76453.FlavorText: "By using the vortex, I can study for at least fifteen extra minutes between every class. I wasn't being reckless, Dean Imbraham. I was being efficient."

76454.Name: Waterfall Aerialist
76454.FlavorText: Form and function in perfect unity.

76455.Name: Wormhole Serpent
76455.FlavorText: After drownings, devourings, and one highly unpleasant algae infestation, unsupervised portal use on campus was banned.

76456.Name: Arrogant Poet
76456.FlavorText: "I would be kinder to my peers, Professor, but I simply don't have any."

76458.Name: Brackish Trudge
76458.FlavorText: Most trudges are covered with decaying plant matter, making them ideal breeding grounds for fungal spores.

76460.Name: Confront the Past
76460.FlavorText: "Why, Gideon? Of all people, why save me?"

76461.Name: Crushing Disappointment
76461.FlavorText: Most students could barely endure Dean Embrose's scrutiny for a semester or two; Killian lived with it his entire life.

76462.Name: Essence Infusion
76462.FlavorText: "I'd say it's still a fair fight—now my friend is about the size of your ego."

76463.Name: Eyetwitch
76463.FlavorText: Oculomancers see the ideal potion ingredient. The bats don't see it that way.

76464.Name: Flunk
76464.FlavorText:
"I assure you, no one fails my course more than once."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

76465.Name: Go Blank
76465.FlavorText: The only feeling worse than not knowing the answer is the certainty you once did.

76467.Name: Lash of Malice
76467.FlavorText:
"The strongest shadow spells come from disdain for someone else, not frustration with yourself."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

76468.Name: Leech Fanatic
76468.FlavorText: "Everyone thinks that leeches maintain a strictly sanguivorous diet, but in fact, most freshwater leeches are carnivores. Wait, where are you going?"

76469.Name: Mage Hunter
76469.FlavorText: One of the Oriq's most powerful tools is the mage hunter, a vile monstrosity created to seek out and snuff out the arcane.

76470.Name: Mage Hunters' Onslaught
76470.FlavorText: Extus stood before his alma mater for a moment, remembering first his studies, then his vengeance. At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.

76471.Name: Necrotic Fumes
76471.FlavorText: When live specimens aren't readily available, Witherbloom mages make creative use of ragged spirits clinging to long-dead bodies.

76472.Name: Novice Dissector
76472.FlavorText: "The professor said to first extract the venom glands, then the acid sac. Next up, the . . . meeping organ?"

76473.Name: Oriq Loremage
76473.FlavorText: Nothing can quell the Oriq's thirst for the forbidden secrets of the past.

76474.Name: Plumb the Forbidden
76474.FlavorText: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

76477.Name: Professor's Warning
76477.FlavorText: Professor Onyx urged the twins to prepare for the dark mage Extus, sounding very much like someone familiar with the rise of tyrants.

76478.Name: Promising Duskmage
76478.FlavorText: "Your technique is sloppy, but there is talent there. Do it again, and keep your right arm in position this time."

76480.Name: Specter of the Fens
76480.FlavorText: Foul specters hunt down those who try to back out of a deal with a daemogoth.

76481.Name: Tenured Inkcaster
76481.FlavorText: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."

76482.Name: Umbral Juke
76482.FlavorText: The sport of Mage Tower was conceived as a playful testing ground for young spellcasters.

76483.Name: Unwilling Ingredient
76483.FlavorText:
"Don't look at me like that. It was either this or being eaten by a groff."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

76484.Name: Academic Dispute
76484.FlavorText: "I'll show you original research, you hack!"

76485.Name: Ardent Dustspeaker
76485.FlavorText: "The Founder Dragons weren't even hatched when this scroll was written!"

76486.Name: Blood Age General
76486.FlavorText: His troops took the Fortress of Caerdoon centuries ago, yet he fights on.

76488.Name: Crackle with Power
76488.FlavorText: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl. For a moment, she was luminous, transcendent, terrible.

76492.Name: Enthusiastic Study
76492.FlavorText: "If the pen is mightier than the sword, just think what a giant tome could do!"

76493.Name: Explosive Welcome
76493.FlavorText: Rowan and Will were a natural fit in Prismari College, the school of outrageous elemental arts.

76496.Name: Fuming Effigy
76496.FlavorText: Some spirits share ancient wisdom. Others just get mad you touched their stuff.

76497.Name: Grinning Ignus
76497.FlavorText: On rare occasions, a Prismari student will summon an elemental that shows such promise that it's permitted to stay and enroll.

76498.Name: Hall Monitor
76498.FlavorText: "No unauthorized summoning. No writing in the library books. And absolutely no indoor dueling!"

76499.Name: Heated Debate
76499.FlavorText: "While you were wasting time with abstract equations, I mastered ancient Oggyar fire magic. Your move."

76500.Name: Igneous Inspiration
76500.FlavorText: Prismari fosters a burning need to create.

76501.Name: Illuminate History
76501.FlavorText: "Look at the detail in this stonework! Professor, our assumptions about early Kathorran tool use may not be correct."

76502.Name: Illustrious Historian
76502.FlavorText: The most distinguished Lorehold professors are eligible to receive extended tenure, even beyond the limits of their own mortality.

76503.Name: Mascot Interception
76503.FlavorText: Far from the trappings of royalty, Rowan and Will found inspiration from the most popular sport on campus, Mage Tower.

76504.Name: Pigment Storm
76504.FlavorText: When art projects collapse, Prismari students revel in the beauty of destruction. Everyone else runs for cover.

76505.Name: Pillardrop Warden
76505.FlavorText: A giant statue of a dwarf is still a giant statue.

76507.Name: Start from Scratch
76507.FlavorText: "I don't care what they think!" Rootha snapped. "I know I can do better."

76508.Name: Storm-Kiln Artist
76508.FlavorText: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

76509.Name: Sudden Breakthrough
76509.FlavorText: Rootha created constantly, passionately, in hopes of impressing her greatest critic: herself.

76510.Name: Tome Shredder
76510.FlavorText:
"Quintorius, would you care to explain why you didn't complete your homework?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

76511.Name: Twinscroll Shaman
76511.FlavorText: "May your wretched name never grace the annals of history, you ignorant buffoon!"

76512.Name: Accomplished Alchemist
76512.FlavorText: "Tincture of murkroot and lizard feet? Simple. One that doesn't taste like murkroot and lizard feet? I'm working on it."

76513.Name: Basic Conjuration
76513.FlavorText: "I made that! It's mine! Did you see that?"

76514.Name: Bayou Groff
76514.FlavorText:
"Groffs are great for tracking pests through the muck, but securing the pests before the groff devours them is a dicey endeavor."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

76515.Name: Big Play
76515.FlavorText:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

76516.Name: Bookwurm
76516.FlavorText: It takes "devouring a book in one sitting" to a frightening extreme.

76517.Name: Charge Through
76517.FlavorText:
"What a move! Lorehold gets caught flat-footed, and Witherbloom barrels ahead."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

76518.Name: Containment Breach
76518.FlavorText: For pestkeepers, there's no sound more disheartening than breaking glass.

76519.Name: Devouring Tendrils
76519.FlavorText: Witherbloom spells often take on the appearance—and personality—of their components.

76520.Name: Dragonsguard Elite
76520.FlavorText: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."

76523.Name: Exponential Growth
76523.FlavorText: Most Quandrix students fundamentally disagree with the concept of "enough."

76525.Name: Fortifying Draught
76525.FlavorText: "If a seedling can push through solid stone, there's no limit to what I could do."

76527.Name: Honor Troll
76527.FlavorText: First in his clan to attend Strixhaven, and now first in his class.

76528.Name: Karok Wrangler
76528.FlavorText:
"She showed up to class on a what?"
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean

76529.Name: Leyline Invocation
76529.FlavorText:
"Do you still believe my work is nothing but dry, boring equations?"
—Cairu, Quandrix mage-student

76530.Name: Mage Duel
76530.FlavorText: "Remember the rules. No spells to the face!"

76531.Name: Master Symmetrist
76531.FlavorText: Tondo lost his very first duel and has spent his entire life trying to get even.

76533.Name: Professor of Zoomancy
76533.FlavorText: She's brilliant, if a bit overbearing.

76534.Name: Reckless Amplimancer
76534.FlavorText: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"

76535.Name: Scurrid Colony
76535.FlavorText: Scurrid teeth evolved to crack open nuts, but they work just as well for crushing bones if the nest is threatened.

76536.Name: Spined Karok
76536.FlavorText:
"The bogs are deeper than you realize. Most of the space beneath the surface is taken up by these enormous karoks. You might think your feet are touching the bottom. They're probably not."
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef

76537.Name: Springmane Cervin
76537.FlavorText: Cervins feed on the mana-rich plants around the star arches, imbuing their bodies with extraordinary grace and vitality.

76538.Name: Tangletrap
76538.FlavorText:
"It's like that old saying: what goes up . . . feeds the arboretum."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

76540.Name: Augmenter Pugilist
76540.FlavorText: "Hold still. I have a theory about what's going to happen to your face."
76540.RawFrameDetail: G front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder, (Quandrix_G) mark

76541.Name: Echoing Equation
76541.RawFrameDetail: U back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder, (Quandrix_U) mark

76542.Name: Blex, Vexing Pest
76542.FlavorText: Pests are typically harvested before they outgrow their enclosures. Blex is far from typical.
76542.RawFrameDetail: G legendary front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder, (Witherbloom_G) mark

76543.Name: Search for Blex
76543.RawFrameDetail: B back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder, (Witherbloom_B) mark

76544.Name: Extus, Oriq Overlord
76544.FlavorText: "Join me for the dawn of a new age."
76544.RawFrameDetail: WB gold legendary front side MFC, Z reverse-side reminder

76545.Name: Awaken the Blood Avatar
76545.RawFrameDetail: BR gold back side MFC, Z reverse-side reminder

76546.Name: Flamescroll Celebrant
76546.RawFrameDetail: R front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder, (Lorehold_R) mark

76547.Name: Revel in Silence
76547.RawFrameDetail: W back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder, (Lorehold_W) mark

76548.Name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios
76548.RawFrameDetail: U legendary front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder

76549.Name: Journey to the Oracle
76549.FlavorText: To find Jadzi, one need only wander.
76549.RawFrameDetail: G back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

76550.Name: Kianne, Dean of Substance
76550.RawFrameDetail: G legendary front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder, (Quandrix_G) mark

76551.Name: Imbraham, Dean of Theory
76551.RawFrameDetail: U legendary back side MFC, G reverse-side reminder, (Quandrix_U) mark

76552.Name: Mila, Crafty Companion
76552.RawFrameDetail: W legendary front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

76553.Name: Lukka, Wayward Bonder
76553.RawFrameDetail: R planeswalker, 3 abilities, back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

76554.Name: Pestilent Cauldron
76554.RawFrameDetail: B artifact front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder, (Witherbloom_B) mark

76555.Name: Restorative Burst
76555.FlavorText: "Death? Everyone does death. Let me show you something actually impressive."
76555.RawFrameDetail: G back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder, (Witherbloom_G) mark

76556.Name: Plargg, Dean of Chaos
76556.RawFrameDetail: R legendary front side MFC, W reverse-side reminder, (Lorehold_R) mark

76557.Name: Augusta, Dean of Order
76557.RawFrameDetail: W legendary back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder, (Lorehold_W) mark

76558.Name: Rowan, Scholar of Sparks
76558.RawFrameDetail: R planeswalker, 3 abilities, front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

76559.Name: Will, Scholar of Frost
76559.RawFrameDetail: U planeswalker, 4 abilities, back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

76560.Name: Selfless Glyphweaver
76560.FlavorText: He offered his light to make sure no others would be dimmed.
76560.RawFrameDetail: W front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder, (Silverquill_W) mark

76561.Name: Deadly Vanity
76561.FlavorText: She cast a spell to purge all weakness. When the ink cleared, she stood alone.
76561.RawFrameDetail: B back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder, (Silverquill_B) mark

76562.Name: Shaile, Dean of Radiance
76562.FlavorText: "You are so much stronger than you know."
76562.RawFrameDetail: W legendary front side MFC, B reverse-side reminder, (Silverquill_W) mark

76563.Name: Embrose, Dean of Shadow
76563.RawFrameDetail: B legendary back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder, (Silverquill_B) mark

76564.Name: Torrent Sculptor
76564.RawFrameDetail: U front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder, (Prismari_U) mark

76565.Name: Flamethrower Sonata
76565.FlavorText: He channels his heart's passion into every fiery note.
76565.RawFrameDetail: R back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder, (Prismari_R) mark

76566.Name: Uvilda, Dean of Perfection
76566.RawFrameDetail: U legendary front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder, (Prismari_U) mark

76567.Name: Nassari, Dean of Expression
76567.RawFrameDetail: R legendary back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder, (Prismari_R) mark

76568.Name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein
76568.RawFrameDetail: B legendary front side MFC, G reverse-side reminder, (Witherbloom_B) mark

76569.Name: Lisette, Dean of the Root
76569.FlavorText: "Life is as fleeting as it is vibrant. Embrace the brief blessing of a flower before it withers."
76569.RawFrameDetail: G legendary back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder, (Witherbloom_G) mark

76570.Name: Aether Helix
76570.FlavorText: Some Quandrix mages prefer to study at twilight, watching their experimental equations trace glowing trails against the encroaching darkness.

76573.Name: Blade Historian
76573.FlavorText: "So you see, the reckless battle strategy of the Kathorran orcs was effective, but ultimately proved to be a double-edged sword. As did their double-edged swords."

76574.Name: Blood Researcher
76574.FlavorText: "Dean Valentin warns us not to consume the samples for our safety, but I think he's just being greedy."

76575.Name: Blot Out the Sky
76575.FlavorText: A drop of ink is a nuisance. A torrent of inklings is a menace.

76576.Name: Body of Research
76576.FlavorText: Needledeep had promised that his final project would be his biggest one yet.

76578.Name: Cram Session
76578.FlavorText: The only thing more delicious than a top grade is Gyome's signature cake.

76580.Name: Culling Ritual
76580.FlavorText: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."

76581.Name: Culmination of Studies
76581.FlavorText: Will's quick thinking meshed with Rowan's raw power to bring down the Blood Avatar.

76582.Name: Daemogoth Titan
76582.FlavorText:
"Of course it offered you power. Demons always do. But trust me—the sweeter the prize, the more ruinous the price."
—Professor Onyx

76583.Name: Daemogoth Woe-Eater
76583.FlavorText: "Your pain for my wisdom. You'll get no better deal."

76584.Name: Deadly Brew
76584.FlavorText: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.

76587.Name: Double Major
76587.FlavorText: "Now I can dedicate myself fully to zoetimancy and void theory!"

76588.Name: Dramatic Finale
76588.FlavorText: The enraptured audience barely noticed their programs were suddenly blank.

76590.Name: Elemental Masterpiece
76590.FlavorText: Rootha passed with flying, living colors.

76591.Name: Elemental Summoning
76591.FlavorText:
"You've made a splash. Now show me a torrent."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

76592.Name: Eureka Moment
76592.FlavorText: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"

76593.Name: Exhilarating Elocution
76593.FlavorText: His words poured forth on waves of golden light, scouring all fear from his audience's hearts and minds.

76594.Name: Expressive Iteration
76594.FlavorText: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

76595.Name: Fractal Summoning
76595.FlavorText:
"Fractals are just pseudo-dimensional manifestations of asynchronous biosymmetries. It's really quite simple."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

76596.Name: Fracture
76596.FlavorText:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

76598.Name: Golden Ratio
76598.FlavorText:
"When I look around, I see a world defined by patterns that still manages to defy them."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

76599.Name: Harness Infinity
76599.FlavorText:
"As I stepped into the star arch, it all became perfectly clear. Life and death are not opposites, but an endless path, twisting around and back upon itself, never ending and never beginning."
—Zhaer, professor of biophilosophy

76602.Name: Infuse with Vitality
76602.FlavorText: Dina raised her cup to Killian's lips, and for the first time in his life, he knew compassion.

76603.Name: Inkling Summoning
76603.FlavorText:
"Think of an insult so vicious, so vulgar, that you hesitate to speak it aloud. The strongest, most aggressive inklings are born from such scorn."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

76605.Name: Killian, Ink Duelist
76605.FlavorText: "When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option."

76606.Name: Lorehold Apprentice
76606.FlavorText: Ancient footfalls echo in her head, their timeless rhythm guiding the present.

76609.Name: Lorehold Pledgemage
76609.FlavorText: "The weight of history can empower you or it can crush you. It's your choice."

76610.Name: Maelstrom Muse
76610.FlavorText: She's an inspiration to everyone, even herself.

76612.Name: Make Your Mark
76612.FlavorText: Those who do learn from history may still choose to repeat it.

76613.Name: Manifestation Sage
76613.FlavorText: The first thing a Quandrix mage learns is the laws of metaphysics. The second thing is how to break them.

76614.Name: Moldering Karok
76614.FlavorText: Necroluminescence is common among the undead creatures of Sedgemoor, giving the midnight swamp an eerie glow. It's comforting—from a distance.

76616.Name: Needlethorn Drake
76616.FlavorText: As they learn to fly, young drakes have a tendency to accidentally impale trees, cliffs, and unsuspecting students.

76617.Name: Oggyar Battle-Seer
76617.FlavorText: "May Ganathog bless us with bloody visions of glory restored!"

76619.Name: Pest Summoning
76619.FlavorText:
"Step 1: Put the pests in mud.
"Step 2: Wait."
—Gyome's Guide to Pest Breeding

76620.Name: Practical Research
76620.FlavorText: The twins each researched spells to defeat Extus in their own way. Will hit the library. Rowan hit everything else.

76621.Name: Prismari Apprentice
76621.FlavorText: "No one ever created great art by playing it safe!"

76623.Name: Prismari Pledgemage
76623.FlavorText: Many have the talent to create, but few have the courage to share their creations.

76624.Name: Quandrix Apprentice
76624.FlavorText: "The secrets of our world will be mine."

76626.Name: Quandrix Cultivator
76626.FlavorText: In the gardens spread across the Quandrix campus, fern turns to forest before class is even over.

76627.Name: Quandrix Pledgemage
76627.FlavorText: "The first step toward transcending physical limitations is discarding assumptions about what is possible."

76628.Name: Quintorius, Field Historian
76628.FlavorText: "Every life has a story to tell. I won't let them be forgotten."

76631.Name: Relic Sloth
76631.FlavorText: When it comes to transporting priceless, delicate artifacts, safety is more important than speed.

76632.Name: Returned Pastcaller
76632.FlavorText: Lorehold spirit statues are not forbidden from raising statues of their own.

76633.Name: Rip Apart
76633.FlavorText: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

76634.Name: Rise of Extus
76634.FlavorText: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step toward vengeance.

76636.Name: Rushed Rebirth
76636.FlavorText: Witherbloom students learn to see death not as tragedy, but as opportunity.

76637.Name: Shadewing Laureate
76637.FlavorText: "Would you prefer I destroy you using prose or verse?"

76639.Name: Silverquill Apprentice
76639.FlavorText: She had spoken the words a hundred times, but under the spotlight, in front of everyone, something new emerged. And the crowd went wild.

76641.Name: Silverquill Pledgemage
76641.FlavorText: "I avoid violence. It is the last resort of the witless. But if you insist, I'll make an exception for you."

76642.Name: Silverquill Silencer
76642.FlavorText: "I am very much in the mood to start handing out expulsions."

76643.Name: Spectacle Mage
76643.FlavorText: "It would be a crime to withhold my light from the world."

76644.Name: Spirit Summoning
76644.FlavorText:
"Books are fantastic, but if you're really curious about the distant past, why not ask someone who was there?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

76645.Name: Spiteful Squad
76645.FlavorText: "Don't you know first-years pay a toll to walk through here?"

76646.Name: Square Up
76646.FlavorText: Sometimes the most radical thing you can do is think inside the box.

76647.Name: Stonebound Mentor
76647.FlavorText: Quintorius beamed, his mind eager to absorb every historical fact the spirit wanted to divulge.

76649.Name: Teach by Example
76649.FlavorText:
"Learning to imitate a master is the first step in becoming one."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

76650.Name: Tend the Pests
76650.FlavorText: "I've got a special treat for you today."

76651.Name: Thrilling Discovery
76651.FlavorText:
"This must be the lost city of Zantafar, where my people lived before becoming nomads. Think of the history we'll learn here!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student

76652.Name: Vanishing Verse
76652.FlavorText: "Whoever summoned that thing had better confess right this moment, or the whole class will be cleaning the ink receptacles for a month!"

76655.Name: Witherbloom Apprentice
76655.FlavorText: "All we are—every feeling, every action—powered by a single, delicate little organ. Life is so terrifyingly, beautifully fragile."

76657.Name: Witherbloom Pledgemage
76657.FlavorText: "'Death is really just a transfer of energy. Those pests I harvested have the honor of becoming pure magic. What could be more beautiful?"

76658.Name: Zimone, Quandrix Prodigy
76658.FlavorText: "What are they complaining about? It's not like axiomatic leyline paratrigonometrics is hard."

76659.Name: Biblioplex Assistant
76659.FlavorText:
"I appreciate the help, and honestly, it's very entertaining."
—Isabough of the Biblioplex

76660.Name: Campus Guide
76660.FlavorText: "There's nowhere in Strixhaven I can't find. Where do you need to go?"

76662.Name: Cogwork Archivist
76662.FlavorText:
"It's the largest library in the Multiverse. Of course it has the largest librarians."
—Kasmina

76663.Name: Excavated Wall
76663.FlavorText:
"Don't be fooled by the quiet. These old stones are trying to talk to you."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

76664.Name: Letter of Acceptance
76664.FlavorText: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven. Will saw a chance for arcane study. Rowan saw a chance for power.

76665.Name: Reflective Golem
76665.FlavorText: "We don't cut through Sedgemoor anymore. Can't get five steps without a groff trying to fight its own reflection."

76668.Name: Team Pennant
76668.FlavorText: Choosing a college based on Mage Tower results is discouraged, but not unheard of.

76670.Name: Access Tunnel
76670.FlavorText: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.

76673.Name: Frostboil Snarl
76673.FlavorText: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

76674.Name: Furycalm Snarl
76674.FlavorText: A seething locus of reverent rage.

76676.Name: Lorehold Campus
76676.FlavorText: Mage-students obsessed with the secrets of the past choose Lorehold, the college of archaeomancy.

76677.Name: Necroblossom Snarl
76677.FlavorText: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.

76678.Name: Prismari Campus
76678.FlavorText: Mage-students who see spellcraft as the highest form of expression choose Prismari, the college of elemental arts.

76679.Name: Quandrix Campus
76679.FlavorText: Mage-students who see the beauty in patterns and equations choose Quandrix, the college of numeromancy.

76680.Name: Shineshadow Snarl
76680.FlavorText: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

76681.Name: Silverquill Campus
76681.FlavorText: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.

76682.Name: Vineglimmer Snarl
76682.FlavorText: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

76683.Name: Witherbloom Campus
76683.FlavorText: Mage-students fascinated by the energies of life and death choose Witherbloom, the college of essence studies.

76765.Name: Mila, Crafty Companion
76765.RawFrameDetail: W legendary FIRE favorite front side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

76766.Name: Lukka, Wayward Bonder
76766.RawFrameDetail: R planeswalker, 3 abilities, back side MFC, W reverse-side reminder

76767.Name: Rowan, Scholar of Sparks
76767.RawFrameDetail: R planeswalker, 3 abilities, front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

76768.Name: Will, Scholar of Frost
76768.RawFrameDetail: U planeswalker, 4 abilities, back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

76770.Name: Dragonsguard Elite
76770.FlavorText: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."

76860.Name: Ugin, the Spirit Dragon
76860.RawFrameDetail: alt C colorless planeswalker, 3 abilities Ugin

76885.Name: Valki, God of Lies
76885.RawFrameDetail: B legendary fire favorite front side MFC, Z reverse-side reminder

76886.Name: Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor
76886.RawFrameDetail: BR gold planeswalker, 4 abilities, back side MFC, B reverse-side reminder

76898.Name: Marit Lage
76898.RawFrameDetail: B token legendary, has text box

76930.Name: Thraben Watcher
76930.FlavorText:
"Fear not the angels' constant eyes,
E'er on watch from lightless skies;
Eternal vigil will we keep,
Protectors of the Blessed Sleep."

76953.Name: Bone Shards
76953.FlavorText: In the Kathari dumping grounds known as the Boneheaps, it's not hard to improvise an offense.

76969.Name: Nested Shambler
76969.FlavorText: Home is where the heart was.

76996.Name: Galvanic Relay
76996.FlavorText: Abandoned years ago, the experiment continues to iterate upon itself.

77009.Name: Chatterstorm
77009.FlavorText:
"Friends, foragers, fuzzy fighters! Tonight we're after more than just acorns!"
—Larrel, Deep Forest hermit

77012.Name: Glimmer Bairn
77012.FlavorText: "Tricks and treats, souls and sweets! On wooded path, whom shall we meet?"

77021.Name: Squirrel Sovereign
77021.FlavorText: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .

77028.Name: Goblin Anarchomancer
77028.FlavorText: A good Gruul shaman can work a whole clan into a frenzy. A great one will wait until the enemy's nearby.

77034.Name: Terminal Agony
77034.FlavorText: His mouth melted to slag, yet somehow he kept screaming.

77042.Name: Monoskelion
77042.FlavorText: An unfinished body with unfinished business.

77043.Name: Ornithopter of Paradise
77043.FlavorText:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

77106.Name: +2 Mace
77106.FlavorText: The weight of this magic weapon falls heavy on the wicked.

77107.Name: Arborea Pegasus
77107.FlavorText: The noble steeds of the elven gods can sometimes be persuaded to allow mere mortals on their backs.

77108.Name: Blink Dog
77108.FlavorText: Blink dogs protect the wild places of the world, driving away evil influences.

77110.Name: Celestial Unicorn
77110.FlavorText: When all hope fails, its light remains.

77115.Name: Delver's Torch
77115.FlavorText: "Not all of us have darkvision, okay?"

77116.Name: Devoted Paladin
77116.FlavorText: "I swore a sacred oath to protect the weak and punish those who threaten them. As long as I draw breath, I will protect you."

77117.Name: Divine Smite
77117.FlavorText: "When darkness closes in around us, my blade will light our path."

77119.Name: Dwarfhold Champion
77119.FlavorText: Courage is neither a shield nor an axe, but the will to wield both in defense of the innocent.

77120.Name: Flumph
77120.FlavorText: Flumphs siphon thoughts and energy from evil aberrations, and are often eager to share the dark knowledge they obtain with friendly adventurers.

77121.Name: Gloom Stalker
77121.FlavorText: "I'll make sure you never mistake a roper for a stalagmite again."

77124.Name: Half-Elf Monk
77124.FlavorText: "This fight was over the moment you picked up that clumsy cleaver of a sword."

77127.Name: Keen-Eared Sentry
77127.FlavorText: "You're not the first to underestimate me."

77128.Name: Loyal Warhound
77128.FlavorText: A paladin's steed is a celestial spirit in animal form.

77130.Name: Monk of the Open Hand
77130.FlavorText: His mind is a tranquil meadow, his fists a raging storm.

77131.Name: Moon-Blessed Cleric
77131.FlavorText: Selûne guides her devotees with majestic wisdom and grace.

77133.Name: Oswald Fiddlebender
77133.FlavorText: "Can't see this airship crashing in the near future. Sturdy as a rock."

77136.Name: Planar Ally
77136.FlavorText: Her light touches every corner and her wings brush either wall, leaving no place for evil to lurk.

77139.Name: Potion of Healing
77139.FlavorText: Magic can knit the body back together, but the courage to fight on comes only from within.

77140.Name: Priest of Ancient Lore
77140.FlavorText: "We are a product of our ancestors, the apotheosis of countless noble generations. Speak their names with reverence, and they will guide your path."

77141.Name: Rally Maneuver
77141.FlavorText: "Don't give up! You are steel and fire, and victory is yours to seize."

77142.Name: Ranger's Hawk
77142.FlavorText: Swift eyes to scout the way ahead.

77143.Name: Steadfast Paladin
77143.FlavorText: "When I made my oath to Moradin, I left selfishness and cowardice behind. Every battle, I make that commitment anew."

77144.Name: Teleportation Circle
77144.FlavorText:
"Hold on to your lunch!"
—Bartleby, gnome wizard

77145.Name: Veteran Dungeoneer
77145.FlavorText: Her tales of glory light a fire in the souls of the next generation of adventurers.

77146.Name: White Dragon
77146.FlavorText: White dragons are unparalleled hunters, keenly focused on slaughtering their enemies.

77148.Name: You're Ambushed on the Road
77148.FlavorText: "Hand over your loot and no one gets hurt!"

77150.Name: Air-Cult Elemental
77150.FlavorText: Elemental Evil distorts the natural elements, limiting them to aspects of destruction.

77156.Name: Clever Conjurer
77156.FlavorText: "I'm always happy to lend a hand!"

77159.Name: Displacer Beast
77159.FlavorText: The only place you can be sure it's not is wherever it appears to be.

77163.Name: Feywild Trickster
77163.FlavorText: Unlike most warlocks, those who make pacts with archfey are drawn to pranks and whimsy moreso than death and darkness.

77166.Name: Guild Thief
77166.FlavorText: She puts some coin in the Guild's pocket and sends a message at the same time.

77168.Name: Mind Flayer
77168.FlavorText: "Shed your thoughts and let my will flow through you."

77170.Name: Mordenkainen's Polymorph
77170.FlavorText: "Your purpose may change along with your shape, but you will serve regardless."

77171.Name: Pixie Guide
77171.FlavorText: Pixies are well known as pranksters, but some delight in more helpful magic.

77174.Name: Rimeshield Frost Giant
77174.FlavorText: Frost giants carry the trophies of their greatest victories into battle, fashioned into armor of strength and savage beauty.

77176.Name: Secret Door
77176.FlavorText: The way opened before him, and the dust of centuries stirred in the air.

77178.Name: Shortcut Seeker
77178.FlavorText: "Ah, the old ‘trap door under a rug' trick. This is almost too easy."

77179.Name: Silver Raven
77179.FlavorText: Wings take flight on whispered wind.

77180.Name: Soulknife Spy
77180.FlavorText: "My psychic blade cuts the mind and severs thoughts. Even if you survive, you'll never remember I was here."

77182.Name: Sudden Insight
77182.FlavorText: A lucky draw from the Deck of Many Things gave Voltusk an inexplicable flash of understanding that he spent the rest of his life trying to repeat.

77183.Name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
77183.FlavorText: The raging behir reared back, opened its terrible maw . . . and collapsed in a fit of horrifying giggles.

77189.Name: You Find the Villains' Lair
77189.FlavorText: "Give me just a moment! I almost have it."

77195.Name: Black Dragon
77195.FlavorText: Black dragons revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms.

77198.Name: Clattering Skeletons
77198.FlavorText: Those who die in the dungeon become its guardians.

77199.Name: Deadly Dispute
77199.FlavorText: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

77201.Name: Demogorgon's Clutches
77201.FlavorText: The good will be corrupted, the kind will be devoured, and all will be dragged into the bottomless Abyss.

77202.Name: Devour Intellect
77202.FlavorText:
"I'll know what you know soon enough."
—Nihiloor, Xanathar Guild spymaster

77203.Name: Drider
77203.FlavorText: Though their forms embody Lolth's image, driders are those unfortunate drow who have failed the Spider Queen.

77204.Name: Dungeon Crawler
77204.FlavorText:
"I think of it as giving them another chance to achieve their potential."
—Nestus Wrasse, necromancer

77206.Name: Eyes of the Beholder
77206.FlavorText: In the end, there was nothing beautiful to be seen.

77208.Name: Feign Death
77208.FlavorText: A drastic measure for dangerous times.

77211.Name: Grim Bounty
77211.FlavorText: Freed from the need to pay tribute to the dragon, the villagers gladly paid the dragon-slayers instead.

77212.Name: Grim Wanderer
77212.FlavorText: There is a stillness that walks with him, the quiet that follows great tragedy, when even the mourners are too exhausted to weep.

77214.Name: Hired Hexblade
77214.FlavorText: "I'll take care of it. You just be sure to hold up your end of the deal."

77215.Name: Hoard Robber
77215.FlavorText: "And to think, a year ago I was picking pockets in Waterdeep."

77219.Name: Power Word Kill
77219.FlavorText: Aramil issued a long, heroic challenge, then the lich felled him with a single word.

77221.Name: Ray of Enfeeblement
77221.FlavorText: Erigan cried out in pain as a hideous weakness settled into his bones.

77223.Name: Sepulcher Ghoul
77223.FlavorText: Ghouls devour the dead and any living creatures unwary enough to fall into their grasp.

77228.Name: Vampire Spawn
77228.FlavorText: Unsuccessful vampire hunters often wind up as ravenous spawn.

77232.Name: Wight
77232.FlavorText: Wights want the world to resound with echoes of their own cruel hatred.

77233.Name: Yuan-Ti Fang-Blade
77233.FlavorText: "The air is sweet with the taste of your fear."

77234.Name: Zombie Ogre
77234.FlavorText:
"On the plus side, Throg no longer thinks he's clever."
—Xanathar

77235.Name: Armory Veteran
77235.FlavorText: "This one is for goblins, this one is for owlbears, this one is for toast, this one is for . . ."

77238.Name: Boots of Speed
77238.FlavorText: Click your heels and become the wind.

77239.Name: Brazen Dwarf
77239.FlavorText: "My grandmother saved the life of a brass dragon, and in return she was given a glimpse of the fire in its heart—a glimpse she passed down to me."

77240.Name: Burning Hands
77240.FlavorText: A simple fire spell that grows in intensity along with its caster.

77242.Name: Critical Hit
77242.FlavorText: "How do you kill what's already dead? That's how."

77249.Name: Goblin Javelineer
77249.FlavorText: Hate gets you only so far. A pointy stick can close the rest of the distance.

77252.Name: Hobgoblin Bandit Lord
77252.FlavorText: In a hobgoblin's view of the world, the weak owe tribute and fealty to the strong.

77253.Name: Hobgoblin Captain
77253.FlavorText: Hobgoblins do not fear death, for those who fall in battle have gained glory eternal.

77254.Name: Hulking Bugbear
77254.FlavorText: Bugbears move with surprising speed for their size and bulk, a fact that has led to the demise of many unwary adventurers.

77255.Name: Improvised Weaponry
77255.FlavorText: Anything can be a weapon if you swing it hard enough.

77256.Name: Inferno of the Star Mounts
77256.FlavorText: The ancient dragon Imvaernarhro has earned his fiery nickname.

77258.Name: Kick in the Door
77258.FlavorText:
"We tried your way. Now we do it my way!"
—Jym, barbarian of Baldur's Gate

77259.Name: Magic Missile
77259.FlavorText: A tried-and-true favorite of many wizards, whatever their school.

77264.Name: Price of Loyalty
77264.FlavorText: "Most folks got mayhem in their hearts. Just gotta know their price."

77265.Name: Red Dragon
77265.FlavorText: Red dragons consider the world and every creature in it as theirs to command.

77266.Name: Rust Monster
77266.FlavorText:
"They don't seem scary, but then you're suddenly standing there in your underclothes without a weapon. Then everything looks like a threat."
—Jarro, battle master

77270.Name: Valor Singer
77270.FlavorText: "There is only one way forward: into legend."

77271.Name: Wish
77271.FlavorText:
"If you had just one wish, what would it be? Gold, or angel song? Finding a lost love, or finding your way back home? Let me sing a song about one wish that came true . . ."
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

77272.Name: Xorn
77272.FlavorText: Xorns are native to the Elemental Plane of Earth, where gems and rare stones are plentiful. When summoned elsewhere they can be quite destructive in search of food.

77273.Name: You Come to the Gnoll Camp
77273.FlavorText:
"Easy now, everyone. I'll take care of this."
—Nadaar

77275.Name: You See a Pair of Goblins
77275.FlavorText:
"I have the shot. Shall I take it?"
—Varis, Silverymoon ranger

77276.Name: Zalto, Fire Giant Duke
77276.FlavorText: Fire giants love to fight on a large scale, and Duke Zalto is one of the greatest warmongers of his age.

77278.Name: Bulette
77278.FlavorText: Capable of moving swiftly through even tightly-packed earth and leaping surprising distances above ground, bulettes are difficult to escape once they've caught scent of prey.

77279.Name: Bull's Strength
77279.FlavorText: As the iron bars of the portcullis parted like reeds, the defenders of the keep suddenly felt much less secure.

77280.Name: Choose Your Weapon
77280.FlavorText:
"Move it, Varis, or I'll pick one for you!"
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

77281.Name: Circle of Dreams Druid
77281.FlavorText: The realms protected by druids of the Circle of Dreams are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream and reality blur together and the weary can find rest.

77282.Name: Circle of the Moon Druid
77282.FlavorText: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of nature who haunt the deepest parts of the wilderness.

77283.Name: Compelled Duel
77283.FlavorText: "You might be four times my size, but I will not be ignored!"

77284.Name: Dire Wolf Prowler
77284.FlavorText: Large as horses, dire wolves must hunt often to satisfy their ravenous hunger. A mere human does little more than blunt their appetite.

77287.Name: Elturgard Ranger
77287.FlavorText: Since the fall of Elturel, they've walked the Sword Coast from Tethyr to Icewind Dale, eyes always on their prey.

77290.Name: Gnoll Hunter
77290.FlavorText: Yipping and cackling, the hunters tore through the village, leaving nothing but snapped bones and burning homes in their wake.

77291.Name: Green Dragon
77291.FlavorText: Green dragons take special pleasure in corrupting the good-hearted.

77292.Name: Hill Giant Herdgorger
77292.FlavorText: A shepherd's crook is useful for cleaning bits of wool out of the teeth.

77294.Name: Inspiring Bard
77294.FlavorText: "Wake up, my friends! There are deeds to be done and treasures to be won!"

77298.Name: Long Rest
77298.FlavorText: A job well done means a rest well earned.

77299.Name: Lurking Roper
77299.FlavorText: "You see, stalac-tites grow down from the ceiling, while stalag-mites reach—AAHHHHHHHHH—"

77300.Name: Neverwinter Dryad
77300.FlavorText: Its life force entwined with its tree, a dryad is an elusive and solitary being that wishes only to be left alone.

77302.Name: Old Gnawbone
77302.FlavorText: The ancient green dragon Claugiyliamatar is often seen with a mangled corpse dangling from her mouth.

77303.Name: Owlbear
77303.FlavorText: Many people believe a misguided wizard created the first owlbear, but others insist that these creatures have always dwelled in the Feywild.

77304.Name: Plummet
77304.FlavorText: The dragon's noxious breath withered the forest. The whistle of a hundred arrows filled the air. The ground roiled as if shaken by an earthquake. The tyrant fell from the sky.

77306.Name: Purple Worm
77306.FlavorText: Underground civilizations maintain magical barriers around their settlements to deter these monsters.

77308.Name: Ranger's Longbow
77308.FlavorText: With the right weapon, a fearsome beholder is nothing more than a big floating bullseye.

77309.Name: Scaled Herbalist
77309.FlavorText: "I could help you, or I could eat you for lunch. I haven't decided yet."

77310.Name: Spoils of the Hunt
77310.FlavorText: "Every coin helps rebuild the town they destroyed."

77313.Name: Underdark Basilisk
77313.FlavorText:
"See how the statues all have chunks bitten out of them? We're dealing with a basilisk, or I'm a froghemoth."
—Larissa Kyriln, learned warlock

77315.Name: Wandering Troubadour
77315.FlavorText: "There's a new ballad waiting to be born around every corner."

77321.Name: Adult Gold Dragon
77321.FlavorText: Gold dragons are the greatest of the metallic dragons in size, power, and wisdom, and often take it upon themselves to safeguard mortal communities from evils that might threaten them.

77324.Name: Bruenor Battlehammer
77324.FlavorText: "Knew I'd find ye in trouble if I came out an' looked for ye!"

77326.Name: Farideh, Devil's Chosen
77326.FlavorText: "A pact is a tool, not a damnation."

77328.Name: Gretchen Titchwillow
77328.FlavorText: "Plant what you wish to see grow. Listen for the stories you want to hear told."

77329.Name: Hama Pashar, Ruin Seeker
77329.FlavorText: "Someone took the time to carve these inscriptions. The least we can do is care enough to read them."

77341.Name: Trelasarra, Moon Dancer
77341.FlavorText: "Eilistraee teaches us that we are not bound by the circumstances of our birth. We all may find beauty and light, if we have the courage to seek them."

77343.Name: Volo, Guide to Monsters
77343.FlavorText: "The beholder told me I had a good eye for details. Who was I to argue?"

77347.Name: Dungeon Map
77347.FlavorText: "Wait, is that a secret door? I can't tell for sure . . . there's some blood in the way."

77348.Name: Eye of Vecna
77348.FlavorText: "I see all things as they truly are! I see . . . decay in all flesh, and betrayal in every heart."

77350.Name: Greataxe
77350.FlavorText: "If you're so mighty, scaled one, then why are you dead?"

77352.Name: Iron Golem
77352.FlavorText: Once an iron golem is set to a task, it won't turn aside until that task is complete or it has been destroyed.

77361.Name: Evolving Wilds
77361.FlavorText: Parts of Faerûn still churn with the magic of arrogant Netherese archmages long dead.

77366.Name: Treasure Vault
77366.FlavorText: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

77368.Name: Icingdeath, Frost Tongue
77368.RawFrameDetail: W token artifact legendary, has text box

77371.Name: The Atropal
77371.RawFrameDetail: B token legendary, has text box

77374.Name: Vecna
77374.RawFrameDetail: B token legendary, has text box

77376.Name: Boo
77376.RawFrameDetail: R token legendary, has text box

77379.Name: Guenhwyvar
77379.RawFrameDetail: G token legendary, has text box

77460.Name: Plains
77460.FlavorText: You've traced the tensions in Ten-Towns to the dwindling reindeer populations . . . but what has been hunting them?

77461.Name: Plains
77461.FlavorText: Seeking to learn why the ancestors have fallen silent, you've made your way to their ancient cairns.

77462.Name: Plains
77462.FlavorText: Searching for a vanished caravan that was bound for Silverymoon, you've come to a bank of mysterious fog.

77463.Name: Plains
77463.FlavorText: Venturing beneath the desert sands, you've discovered an alien power pulsing with inconceivable energy.

77464.Name: Island
77464.FlavorText: In crystal-studded waters far below the surface, you've discovered an incubating egg of mysterious origin.

77465.Name: Island
77465.FlavorText: After careful study, you've determined that the giant ruins served to track the movement of the planets . . . and they will soon align once more.

77466.Name: Island
77466.FlavorText: As your ship clears the edge of Waterdeep harbor, you notice pirate sails on the horizon. What has made them so bold?

77467.Name: Island
77467.FlavorText: Alarmed by the news you brought, the storm giant king of the Maelstrom has called his kin to council.

77468.Name: Swamp
77468.FlavorText: As a plague ravages the world above, you've made your way into the Underdark in search of a fungal panacea.

77469.Name: Swamp
77469.FlavorText: Your search for a stolen artifact has brought you to the edge of the Mere of Dead Men.

77470.Name: Swamp
77470.FlavorText: As you trudge through the sewers of Baldur's Gate it dawns on you: where are all the rats?

77471.Name: Swamp
77471.FlavorText: You expected to meet hostile drow in this ancient ruin . . . but they fled long ago. What darkness could have driven them out?

77472.Name: Mountain
77472.FlavorText: You meant to simply rest in Hundelstone, but the miners have told you stories of whispers in the dark below.

77473.Name: Mountain
77473.FlavorText: Your path lies across the Spine of the World, where every cave hides some new danger.

77474.Name: Mountain
77474.FlavorText: You've ventured deep into the heart of the mountain to determine what can calm its quaking rage.

77475.Name: Mountain
77475.FlavorText: As you make camp near the ancient ruin, you hear the sound of drums echoing in halls where no dwarf has lived in generations.

77476.Name: Forest
77476.FlavorText: As the sun reaches its zenith on the day of the solstice, a castle shimmers into view on the hilltop, just as the ancient text predicted.

77477.Name: Forest
77477.FlavorText: As you venture deeper under the boughs of Neverwinter Wood, arrows in a tree trunk suggest you might not be welcome.

77478.Name: Forest
77478.FlavorText: As monsters from the Underdark rampage across the world above, you've delved deep underground to determine what has driven them upward.

77479.Name: Forest
77479.FlavorText: Before the elf queen will aid you, you must find a way to cure the strange rot afflicting the roots of the ancient trees.

77481.Name: Day of Judgment
77481.FlavorText:
"This must not become common knowledge. The consequences of such a spell are too great. Lock it away in the restricted archive, and destroy its record in the catalog."
—Director Taiva, to Isabough

77482.Name: Defiant Strike
77482.FlavorText:
"For twelve days and twelve nights, Somat assailed the monster's shell. On the thirteenth morning, it cracked with the dawn."
—Heroics: A Book of Fables

77483.Name: Divine Gambit
77483.FlavorText:
"Evil is to be unshackled, not slain. Unlock your foe and release the miracle within."
—Keevan, docent of Kollema Hall

77485.Name: Gift of Estates
77485.FlavorText:
"We asked for a home and received the world."
—Scroll of Nine Blessings

77487.Name: Mana Tithe
77487.FlavorText:
"The tyrant's bellow of rage trailed off into a whimper as the last of his fortune escaped his grasp."
—The Dethroner's Grimoire

77488.Name: Revitalize
77488.FlavorText:
"Knight Kathryn closed her eyes, bracing herself for the end. When she opened them again, she stood triumphant over her foe."
—Thadus the Healer, Memoirs

77489.Name: Swords to Plowshares
77489.FlavorText:
"The blademaster turned his fury to his new foes: root rot and cabbage slugs."
—Myths and Miracles, Vol. VII

77491.Name: Blue Sun's Zenith
77491.FlavorText:
"Five suns! Can you even imagine how complicated the orbital calculations must be? What I wouldn't give to tackle an equation like that!"
—Zimone, Quandrix mage-student

77492.Name: Brainstorm
77492.FlavorText:
Infinite ideas flow through the Multiverse, waiting for an open mind."
—The Biblioplex: An Introduction

77493.Name: Compulsive Research
77493.FlavorText:
"Every Planeswalker remembers the first time their mind touched the staggering vastness of the Multiverse."
—Kasmina

77494.Name: Counterspell
77494.FlavorText:
"One need not know the specific details of a spell to suppress its effect. Simply rearrange the rules of the reality within which the spell operates."
—Imbraham, Quandrix dean

77495.Name: Memory Lapse
77495.FlavorText:
"Where do our forgotten thoughts go? I knew once, but I can't remember."
—Director Taiva, journal entry

77497.Name: Negate
77497.FlavorText:
"Shatter your opponent's spell with enough force, and you'll shatter their confidence with it."
—Tome of Obstructions, marginalia

77498.Name: Opt
77498.FlavorText:
"The wish most often granted is the wish to choose one's own destiny."
—Aethershrine, inscription

77499.Name: Strategic Planning
77499.FlavorText:
"I can offer only information, young one. What path you choose is up to you."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

77501.Name: Time Warp
77501.FlavorText:
"Chronomancers have a rather different definition of living in the moment."
—The Millennium Tome

77502.Name: Whirlwind Denial
77502.FlavorText:
"If they try to storm your palace, you must become the storm."
—Handbook of Imperial Spellcraft

77503.Name: Agonizing Remorse
77503.FlavorText:
"Guilt is not absolution. Regret is not justice. But it is right that you suffer."
—Extus Narr

77504.Name: Crux of Fate
77504.FlavorText:
"One brother fought for the sake of the Multiverse. The other for himself."
—The Elderspell Parable

77505.Name: Dark Ritual
77505.FlavorText:
"They distrust my methods, but when they want results, whom do you think they seek?"
—Incantations of Lim-Dûl

77506.Name: Demonic Tutor
77506.FlavorText:
"Demons prefer to deal with those who believe themselves too wise to be fooled."
—Scroll case inscription

77507.Name: Doom Blade
77507.FlavorText:
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest."
—Ob Nixilis

77508.Name: Duress
77508.FlavorText:
"Magic brought peace to the Vastlands but was soon corrupted."
—The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells

77509.Name: Eliminate
77509.FlavorText:
"It takes so little energy to erase a person. It's almost like the universe doesn't care that they existed at all."
—Extus Narr

77510.Name: Inquisition of Kozilek
77510.FlavorText:
"To dwell within the Blind Eternities is unthinkable. To encounter those who do could shatter the mind."
—Chronicle of the Titans

77511.Name: Sign in Blood
77511.FlavorText:
"It's always my brightest students who make the worst decisions."
—Shaile, Silverquill dean

77514.Name: Village Rites
77514.FlavorText:
"My colleagues revile the barbarity of the Blood Age, but I believe we have much to learn from the magics of endless war."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

77515.Name: Chaos Warp
77515.FlavorText:
"Be careful when handling old magical trinkets. You never know who they've been."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

77516.Name: Claim the Firstborn
77516.FlavorText:
"Will! They have a copy of Tales of the Fae here! Want me to read you a bedtime story?"
—Rowan Kenrith

77517.Name: Faithless Looting
77517.FlavorText:
"How did you get your hands on that? Wait, never mind. I don't want to know."
—Plargg, Lorehold dean

77520.Name: Infuriate
77520.FlavorText:
"Some mages duel using intricate spellcraft and superior tactics. Others just get really, really mad."
—Secrets of the Feradorn Sorcerers

77521.Name: Lightning Bolt
77521.FlavorText:
"The first mages witnessed the fury of the raging storm and wished to answer back."
—The Stormwright Texts

77523.Name: Shock
77523.FlavorText:
"To this day, I have no idea if the heavens were obeying him or attacking him."
—Ral Zarek, research notes

77524.Name: Stone Rain
77524.FlavorText:
"Thus, Bruk the Skyhammer earned his epithet and won the war, all in one fiery moment."
—Compendium of Warspells

77525.Name: Thrill of Possibility
77525.FlavorText:
"If the prospect of what could be doesn't electrify you to your core, why attend Strixhaven at all?"
—Nassari, Prismari dean

77528.Name: Adventurous Impulse
77528.FlavorText:
"Her quest began as all quests do, with one small step in an unexpected direction."
—The Explorer's Testament

77529.Name: Channel
77529.FlavorText:
"As long as you are breathing, you always have something more to give."
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean

77530.Name: Cultivate
77530.FlavorText:
"You'd be amazed how much a single plant has to teach you."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

77531.Name: Harmonize
77531.FlavorText:
"The bloody din of invasion faded
And silent song rang through the woods again."
—"Song of Freyalise"

77532.Name: Krosan Grip
77532.FlavorText:
"On a world where time was torn asunder, destruction ruled the minds of all."
—Multiversal Metahistories

77533.Name: Natural Order
77533.FlavorText:
"Nature is neither cruel nor kind. It operates on necessity, not sentiment."
—-Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

77535.Name: Regrowth
77535.FlavorText:
"Centuries of war had broken Arcavios, but a single seed began the long process of renewal."
—The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells

77536.Name: Snakeskin Veil
77536.FlavorText:
"Never reject the kindness of a serpent. It will not be offered twice."
—Druidic manuscript fragment

77537.Name: Weather the Storm
77537.FlavorText:
"Neither blade nor tempest can assail the serenity of a tranquil mind."
—The Turrau Carvings

77538.Name: Despark
77538.FlavorText:
"A tale of a tyrant being humiliated and losing all his power? I'm inspired already!"
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student

77539.Name: Electrolyze
77539.FlavorText:
"The hydraulic power grip was a failure, but the gauntlets were a shocking success."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus

77540.Name: Growth Spiral
77540.FlavorText:
"I've gleaned greater insight from the spiraling of a single fern than I have from all the books I've ever read."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

77541.Name: Lightning Helix
77541.FlavorText:
"Mages in the Blood Age would call down actual thunderstorms on their enemies. I bet we can replicate their technique."
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student

77542.Name: Putrefy
77542.FlavorText:
"From monarch to mulch as quick as could be."
—The Dethroner's Grimoire
