77657.Name: Triumphant Reckoning
77657.FlavorText: In a flash of light and a burst of aether, despair turned to hope and defeat turned to victory.

77870.Name: Abomination of Llanowar
77870.FlavorText: "Run!" screamed its living mouths. "Come!" cried its dead ones.

77883.Name: Hamza, Guardian of Arashin
77883.FlavorText: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."

78136.Name: Trash for Treasure
78136.FlavorText: Goblins generally have two possessions: one per hand.

78324.Name: Seasoned Cathar
78324.FlavorText: "The cathars have taught me many things, but I will never forget the hard, honest work that first callused my hands."

78325.Name: Beloved Beggar
78325.FlavorText: Charity is rare on Innistrad, but kindness is always repaid.

78326.Name: Generous Soul
78326.FlavorText: As long as evil threatens his town, the Blessed Sleep can wait.

78327.Name: Bereaved Survivor
78327.FlavorText: "With Avacyn gone, I no longer knew who to pray to. Alone, I wept for a sister who would never return."

78328.Name: Dauntless Avenger
78328.FlavorText: "It was Sigarda who lifted me from despair and gave me the strength to fight on."

78329.Name: Blessed Defiance
78329.FlavorText: "If I'm going, I'm taking you with me!"

78330.Name: Borrowed Time
78330.FlavorText: Teferi stepped calmly into the fray. Suddenly the sun paused in the sky and the werewolves' snarls froze on their faces.

78333.Name: Candlegrove Witch
78333.FlavorText: "Like a thousand candles fighting back the darkness, we are strongest when we stand together."

78335.Name: Cathar Commando
78335.FlavorText: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

78336.Name: Cathar's Call
78336.FlavorText: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking. The rest redoubled their efforts to carry out her work.

78340.Name: Clarion Cathars
78340.FlavorText: The sound of the trumpet is both warning and comfort: it tells of approaching danger but also reminds the village folk that someone is there to stand against it.

78345.Name: Fateful Absence
78345.FlavorText: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

78346.Name: Flare of Faith
78346.FlavorText: "I fell to my knees. I called out to Sigarda. And then I saw my tormentors blaze with blessed sunlight."

78348.Name: Gavony Silversmith
78348.FlavorText: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.

78349.Name: Gavony Trapper
78349.FlavorText: The elite cathars of the Parish-Blades train in all manner of techniques designed to delay and frustrate the beasts that hunt the crossways.

78350.Name: Hedgewitch's Mask
78350.FlavorText: In Kessig, even celebration wears a fearsome face.

78351.Name: Homestead Courage
78351.FlavorText: "C'mon, fiend. I'll carve you up like a Harvesttide ham."

78353.Name: Loyal Gryff
78353.FlavorText: Silverstreak had lost her rider, but not her instinct to help humankind.

78354.Name: Lunarch Veteran
78354.FlavorText: "Even in our darkest times, Avacyn's light still guides us."

78356.Name: Mourning Patrol
78356.FlavorText: "It's creepy out here, isn't it, boy? I always feel like someone's watching us."

78357.Name: Morning Apparition
78357.FlavorText: "You could see the spirits all along, couldn't you? Well, now I can too."

78358.Name: Odric's Outrider
78358.FlavorText: Terms like "safe route" and "cleared district" are a source of dark humor to the cathars who patrol the ruins of Thraben.

78359.Name: Ritual Guardian
78359.FlavorText: "By ancient magics, by angels' grace, we will survive this night."

78361.Name: Search Party Captain
78361.FlavorText: "Werewolves leave messy trails. Easy to follow. Hard to forget."

78363.Name: Sigardian Savior
78363.FlavorText: "Begone, moon-cursed! These folk are no prey of yours."

78364.Name: Soul-Guide Gryff
78364.FlavorText: It conducts the souls of the righteous to their blessed rest and the spirits of the evil to justice.

78365.Name: Sungold Barrage
78365.FlavorText: Heida allowed herself a moment of satisfaction as she watched the beast fall, then turned to seek another foe. It would be a long, long night.

78368.Name: Thraben Exorcism
78368.FlavorText: Chandra, Teferi, and Arlinn sought clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts while Kaya dispatched the spirits obstructing their path.

78369.Name: Unruly Mob
78369.FlavorText: "We survived the Travails! Killer angels! Horrors from beyond the moon! Now some big werewolves think they can scare us? Let 'em try."

78370.Name: Vanquish the Horde
78370.FlavorText: Odric took no joy in violence but neither did he mourn for the twisted things he dispatched. All that mattered were the lives he had saved.

78371.Name: Baithook Angler
78371.FlavorText: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.

78372.Name: Hook-Haunt Drifter
78372.FlavorText: Even in death, he casts his lines, forever fishing for reasons long forgotten.

78373.Name: Component Collector
78373.FlavorText: "Keep master busy with new bits or else maybe she wonders if I'm made of bits too."

78374.Name: Consider
78374.FlavorText: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

78377.Name: Curse of Surveillance
78377.FlavorText: For every eye gouged out, two blinked open.

78379.Name: Insectile Aberration
78379.FlavorText: "Aha! Yes! Now I hear it, the beautiful poetry of the lights in the sky. I must reach the moon and ask what it all means!"

78380.Name: Devious Cover-Up
78380.FlavorText: Widow Weber's new scarecrow seemed to attract more crows than it scared off.

78381.Name: Dissipate
78381.FlavorText:
"Morning light, morning light,
Chase away the fears of night."
—Gavony children's rhyme

78382.Name: Drownyard Amalgam
78382.FlavorText: When human corpses are in short supply, stitchers get creative.

78383.Name: Fading Hope
78383.FlavorText: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

78385.Name: Firmament Sage
78385.FlavorText: The cause remained unclear, but the fact was undeniable: nights were lengthening faster than in any autumn past.

78386.Name: Flip the Switch
78386.FlavorText:
"Works every time! Well, every time they don't explode, anyway."
—Barton, stitcher

78387.Name: Galedrifter
78387.FlavorText:
"If you're lost in a storm, follow a gryff. They always know which way calmer waters lie."
—Geor, Havengul fisher

78388.Name: Waildrifter
78388.FlavorText:
"Wait! That's no gryff—at least not anymore."
—Geor, Havengul fisher

78389.Name: Geistwave
78389.FlavorText: Necro-alchemists gained popular support during the Travails, when geist-fueled weapons helped defend towns against mad cultists and Eldrazi monstrosities.

78391.Name: Larder Zombie
78391.FlavorText: The cathars arrived at the abandoned lab to find many of the unfinished projects gnawing on one another.

78392.Name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
78392.FlavorText: Beneath the waves, lost gods stir in their slumber.

78393.Name: Locked in the Cemetery
78393.FlavorText: "Help! I'm not a zombie! Let me out!"

78395.Name: Benevolent Geist
78395.FlavorText: All his old grudges suddenly seemed laughably petty. So he laughed.

78397.Name: Mysterious Tome
78397.FlavorText: The villagers pored through the old storybook, hoping that one of the tales within might hold some clue to saving the fading sun.

78398.Name: Chilling Chronicle
78398.FlavorText: But every story ended the same way: the countryside was captured in the icy grip of winter and darkened by eternal night.

78400.Name: Ominous Roost
78400.FlavorText:
"One raven is a bad omen. Two are a curse. I don't know what this is, but it can't be good."
—Verna, priest of Sigarda

78401.Name: Organ Hoarder
78401.FlavorText: The stitcher died years ago, but her dutiful assistant still keeps the laboratory well stocked.

78403.Name: Overwhelmed Archivist
78403.FlavorText: "Bah! As if I had time to preserve everything."

78404.Name: Archive Haunt
78404.FlavorText: Cleaning up his life's work was his afterlife's work.

78405.Name: Patrician Geist
78405.FlavorText: He rides in agitated circles, snapping orders at servants who've long since found their peace.

78406.Name: Phantom Carriage
78406.FlavorText: Passage to the abyss is free, but the return trip will cost you.

78408.Name: Poppet Factory
78408.FlavorText: It may have been a mistake to give them minds of their own.

78409.Name: Revenge of the Drowned
78409.FlavorText: A heavy net doesn't always mean a good catch.

78410.Name: Secrets of the Key
78410.FlavorText: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.

78411.Name: Shipwreck Sifters
78411.FlavorText: A loyal crew sticks together, even after death.

78412.Name: Skaab Wrangler
78412.FlavorText: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.

78413.Name: Sludge Monster
78413.FlavorText: Tracking it isn't the hard part.

78416.Name: Stormrider Spirit
78416.FlavorText: The weary travelers mistook the flickering lights for a candleguide pointing the way to Harvesttide. Their relief turned to terror as lightning lit the sky.

78419.Name: Triskaidekaphile
78419.FlavorText: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

78420.Name: Unblinking Observer
78420.FlavorText:
"Day 77: The homunculus within the crystal continues to mimic my every movement. I wonder what they are writing?"
—Laboratory notes of Yzlkpk

78421.Name: Vivisection
78421.FlavorText: Though their work is widely reviled, stitchers see themselves as being on the cutting edge of science.

78422.Name: Arrogant Outlaw
78422.FlavorText: The debased remnants of the Falkenrath bloodline prowl the passes near their ruined castles.

78423.Name: Baneblade Scoundrel
78423.FlavorText: "I was a mere cutpurse until I learned the going rate for fresh corpses."

78425.Name: Bat Whisperer
78425.FlavorText: "My little winged friends tell me which of these townsfolk are worth tasting for myself."

78426.Name: Bladebrand
78426.FlavorText: Skirsdag cultists believe that the right poison "purifies" a tainted soul before it makes its way to Ormendahl.

78427.Name: Blood Pact
78427.FlavorText: Griselbrand's defeat did not mark the end of the Skirsdag cult. They simply turned their worship to the next demon to emerge from the shadows bearing offers of power.

78428.Name: Bloodline Culling
78428.FlavorText: "Forget your human ancestors. You're part of my family now."

78429.Name: Bloodtithe Collector
78429.FlavorText: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

78430.Name: Champion of the Perished
78430.FlavorText: He rose from the graf for every cobbler, tanner, and fool who'd been slaughtered in the parish—and they rose and shambled after him.

78432.Name: Covetous Geist
78432.FlavorText:
"It has no need of wealth in the afterlife. It steals and kills purely for its own spiteful amusement."
—Kaya

78435.Name: Leeching Lurker
78435.FlavorText: First darkness falls. Then it burrows in.

78436.Name: Defenestrate
78436.FlavorText: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.

78438.Name: Dreadhound
78438.FlavorText: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

78439.Name: Duress
78439.FlavorText: The Voldaren torture pits are so expansive that prisoners have a nasty tendency to be forgotten for years.

78440.Name: Eaten Alive
78440.FlavorText:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

78441.Name: Ecstatic Awakener
78441.FlavorText: "Great Ormendahl, I kneel before you, a fragment of your will, a servant of your tyranny. I beg you, release the strength within me!"

78442.Name: Awoken Demon
78442.FlavorText: Bones cracked, flesh split apart, and the screams of euphoric agony gave way to unholy laughter.

78443.Name: Foul Play
78443.FlavorText: The evidence was overwhelming. Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.

78444.Name: Ghoulish Procession
78444.FlavorText: It was a family reunion to die for.

78448.Name: Heirloom Mirror
78448.FlavorText: "Speak my name thrice, and be rewarded."

78449.Name: Inherited Fiend
78449.FlavorText: "Well done, young fool, well done! Now for your reward."

78450.Name: Hobbling Zombie
78450.FlavorText:
"I see someone tried to stop you, my pet. How delightful."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

78451.Name: Infernal Grasp
78451.FlavorText: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

78452.Name: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia
78452.FlavorText: "Rise, my pretty thing. Why rot in the river when you can serve at my bidding?"

78454.Name: Ormendahl, the Corrupter
78454.FlavorText: "Ah, Jerren. You've been such a faithful, useful insect."

78456.Name: Mask of Griselbrand
78456.FlavorText: The legacy of evil lives on.

78458.Name: Morbid Opportunist
78458.FlavorText: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

78459.Name: Morkrut Behemoth
78459.FlavorText:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

78461.Name: No Way Out
78461.FlavorText: In the maze-like passages of the Erdwal, a wrong turn can be fatal.

78462.Name: Novice Occultist
78462.FlavorText: All across Gavony, in shuttered bedrooms and locked barns, young people seek the answers their elders failed to provide.

78463.Name: Olivia's Midnight Ambush
78463.FlavorText: "And you were almost finished with that ritual, weren't you, darling? How very rude of me. To make it up to you, I'll send you an invitation to my wedding."

78464.Name: Rotten Reunion
78464.FlavorText: Aunt and Uncle Greyfeld loved dinner guests.

78465.Name: Shady Traveler
78465.FlavorText: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.

78466.Name: Stalking Predator
78466.FlavorText: Tomorrow a new village, and new victims.

78467.Name: Siege Zombie
78467.FlavorText: A barricade only buys time. So the wealthy buy more barricades.

78468.Name: Slaughter Specialist
78468.FlavorText: From every kill, a gruesome trophy.

78469.Name: Stromkirk Bloodthief
78469.FlavorText: With House Voldaren ascendant, some members of the Stromkirk line took it upon themselves to "borrow" from the blood tithes.

78471.Name: Vampire Interloper
78471.FlavorText: The Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings from the villagers in their territory. Their agents arrive from the sky to collect the ceremonial bowls in eerie silence.

78472.Name: Vengeful Strangler
78472.FlavorText: As the flames consumed the killer, his eyes remained fixed on the executioner's face, his hands twitching like angry spiders.

78473.Name: Strangling Grasp
78473.FlavorText: The next day, the executioner was found with ashen handprints on his throat.

78474.Name: Abandon the Post
78474.FlavorText: You don't have to outrun the werewolf; you only have to outrun your fellow guard.

78475.Name: Ardent Elementalist
78475.FlavorText: While the Dawnhart witches focus their magic on nature and community, other covens consort with devils and twist the elements to their will.

78479.Name: Burn the Accursed
78479.FlavorText: Nothing remained but a few drifting embers and the smell of smoldering hair.

78480.Name: Cathartic Pyre
78480.FlavorText: "Leave behind the sorrow of this body. Be blessed, being of light."

78481.Name: Curse of Shaken Faith
78481.FlavorText: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.

78483.Name: Falkenrath Perforator
78483.FlavorText: "Lady Anje sends her regards. I'll carve the rest of her message into your skin."

78484.Name: Falkenrath Pit Fighter
78484.FlavorText: In the arena, vampires set aside all pretense of honor or civilization and fight like the predators they know themselves to be.

78485.Name: Famished Foragers
78485.FlavorText: Furious to find the workshop empty, the starving vampires flew into a frenzy.

78486.Name: Fangblade Brigand
78486.FlavorText: As long as the sun is up, you'll only lose your purse.

78488.Name: Festival Crasher
78488.FlavorText: So many candles. So many flammables. So little time.

78489.Name: Flame Channeler
78489.FlavorText: At the edge of night, on the cusp of winter, the allure of fire grows ever stronger.

78490.Name: Embodiment of Flame
78490.FlavorText: Never again would she fear the dusk.

78492.Name: Harvesttide Infiltrator
78492.FlavorText: He was one masked stranger among many. Blending in was child's play.

78493.Name: Harvesttide Assailant
78493.FlavorText: When Tovolar's howl sounded from the woods, it was answered from the heart of the festival.

78494.Name: Immolation
78494.FlavorText: Nothing is funnier to a devil than setting someone—anyone—on fire.

78495.Name: Lambholt Harrier
78495.FlavorText:
"This Tovolar is no brainless brute. He sends his howling minions to terrorize a village for months. Sleepless nights and fear take their toll. Only then, when morale is at its worst, does he strike."
—Barnes, village watch

78497.Name: Lunar Frenzy
78497.FlavorText: In the adrenaline-fueled chaos, she hadn't even felt the bite.

78498.Name: Moonrager's Slash
78498.FlavorText: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.

78500.Name: Mounted Dreadknight
78500.FlavorText: Markov vampires cultivate an image of such decadent elegance that it can be easy to forget they can field a deadly fighting force.

78501.Name: Neonate's Rush
78501.FlavorText:
"We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast."
—Anje Falkenrath

78502.Name: Obsessive Astronomer
78502.FlavorText: "Sleep? I can sleep when I'm dead!"

78503.Name: Pack's Betrayal
78503.FlavorText: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.

78504.Name: Play with Fire
78504.FlavorText: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

78506.Name: Raze the Effigy
78506.FlavorText: The folk of Kessig build up their courage by burning effigies of the things they fear.

78511.Name: Ashmouth Dragon
78511.FlavorText: A dragon is born. A province burns.

78514.Name: Stolen Vitality
78514.FlavorText: "There's nothing like a good meal to really lift the spirit."

78516.Name: Tavern Ruffian
78516.FlavorText: She dispatched every challenger with a sickening snap of bone.

78517.Name: Tavern Smasher
78517.FlavorText: With every arm in sight broken, she turned her attention to the furniture.

78518.Name: Thermo-Alchemist
78518.FlavorText: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

78519.Name: Village Watch
78519.FlavorText: "You have my word. You'll see no wolf attacks while we're around!"

78520.Name: Village Reavers
78520.FlavorText: With no guards to be seen, the cobbled streets of Gatstaf echoed with howls.

78522.Name: Voldaren Stinger
78522.FlavorText: A duel to first blood means something very different when a vampire is involved.

78524.Name: Bird Admirer
78524.FlavorText: She won't rest until she's collected specimens of every bird on Innistrad.

78525.Name: Wing Shredder
78525.FlavorText: Her hunger won't be sated until she's tasted every bird on Innistrad.

78526.Name: Bounding Wolf
78526.FlavorText: With their usual prey scared off by werewolves, the wolves of the Ulvenwald adopted inventive new hunting techniques.

78529.Name: Brood Weaver
78529.FlavorText: Travelers in the Somberwald scan the ground for werewolves and other threats, unaware of what lurks above.

78532.Name: Candlelit Cavalry
78532.FlavorText: "On this night, the dark will fear us."

78533.Name: Clear Shot
78533.FlavorText: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

78535.Name: Contortionist Troupe
78535.FlavorText: "Welcome to the greatest show in Kessig!"

78537.Name: Dawnhart Rejuvenator
78537.FlavorText: "Wherever there is life, there is power for one who knows the old ways."

78540.Name: Defend the Celestus
78540.FlavorText: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

78543.Name: Eccentric Farmer
78543.FlavorText: "Careful now. Don't want to get the seeds stuck to your feelers like last time."

78544.Name: Harvesttide Sentry
78544.FlavorText: She patrols the darkness so that others can forget their worries for one bright evening.

78545.Name: Hound Tamer
78545.FlavorText: "You and me, we're not built for captivity."

78548.Name: Might of the Old Ways
78548.FlavorText: Brimming with power from their disrupted ritual, the Dawnhart witches lashed out at the werewolf intruders.

78552.Name: Pestilent Wolf
78552.FlavorText: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

78553.Name: Plummet
78553.FlavorText:
"A creature of stone was never meant to fly. And I see the Ulvenwald agrees with me."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

78555.Name: Return to Nature
78555.FlavorText:
"Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

78558.Name: Shadowbeast Sighting
78558.FlavorText:
"Werewolves leave tracks. Vampires leave wrung-out corpses. This is something else."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

78559.Name: Snarling Wolf
78559.FlavorText:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words

78562.Name: Timberland Guide
78562.FlavorText: Hiring an experienced wilderness guide isn't cheap, but it costs less than a search party. Or a funeral.

78563.Name: Tireless Hauler
78563.FlavorText: The new hire proved more than enough to replace the three farmhands who disappeared the week before.

78564.Name: Dire-Strain Brawler
78564.FlavorText: A few townsfolk had their suspicions, but none dared accuse him openly.

78565.Name: Tovolar's Huntmaster
78565.FlavorText: "Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair."

78568.Name: Unnatural Growth
78568.FlavorText: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

78569.Name: Willow Geist
78569.FlavorText: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.

78571.Name: Angelfire Ignition
78571.FlavorText: "My angel is the flint, and I am her steel."

78573.Name: Arlinn, the Pack's Hope
78573.RawFrameDetail: RG gold planeswalker front side TDFC, 3 abilities

78574.Name: Arlinn, the Moon's Fury
78574.RawFrameDetail: RG gold planeswalker back side TDFC, 3 abilities

78575.Name: Bladestitched Skaab
78575.FlavorText: The surviving militia members reunited with their fallen comrades sooner than they'd hoped.

78576.Name: Can't Stay Away
78576.FlavorText: Death is no impediment to dinner.

78578.Name: Croaking Counterpart
78578.FlavorText: Frog is the sincerest form of flattery.

78579.Name: Dawnhart Wardens
78579.FlavorText: "The balance of day and night is shattered. We must find the Moonsilver Key."

78580.Name: Dennick, Pious Apprentice
78580.RawFrameDetail: WU gold legendary front side TDFC

78581.Name: Dennick, Pious Apparition
78581.RawFrameDetail: WU gold legendary back side TDFC

78586.Name: Faithful Mending
78586.FlavorText: "What has been looted can be restored. The church lives on within us."

78587.Name: Fleshtaker
78587.FlavorText: A soulless husk of endless hunger.

78591.Name: Grizzly Ghoul
78591.FlavorText: The hunters spent the evening celebrating their kill and the rest of the night running from it.

78594.Name: Join the Dance
78594.FlavorText: "We can go into the dark hand-in-hand or alone. I know which I prefer."

78595.Name: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
78595.FlavorText: "The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not."

78596.Name: Kessig Naturalist
78596.FlavorText: "Far from home, little one? I know the feeling."

78599.Name: Ludevic, Necrogenius
78599.RawFrameDetail: UB gold legendary front side TDFC

78600.Name: Olag, Ludevic's Hubris
78600.RawFrameDetail: UB gold legendary back side TDFC

78603.Name: Rite of Harmony
78603.FlavorText: Nature bends to the witches' call.

78604.Name: Rite of Oblivion
78604.FlavorText: Revenge is a circle without end.

78606.Name: Sacred Fire
78606.FlavorText:
"Do not confuse justice with mercy."
—Odric, Order of Saint Traft

78611.Name: Sunrise Cavalier
78611.FlavorText: "Like us, the morning fights for survival."

78613.Name: Tovolar, Dire Overlord
78613.RawFrameDetail: RG gold legendary front side TDFC

78614.Name: Tovolar, the Midnight Scourge
78614.RawFrameDetail: RG gold legendary back side TDFC

78621.Name: Crossroads Candleguide
78621.FlavorText: Do the candleguides' heads turn to follow you as you pass, or is it merely a trick of the flickering light?

78622.Name: Jack-o'-Lantern
78622.FlavorText: By the end of the festival, it was the only thing still grinning.

78623.Name: Moonsilver Key
78623.FlavorText: To restore the day-night balance, the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock must be reunited with its long-lost key.

78624.Name: Mystic Skull
78624.FlavorText: It waited on the barn wall for decades, forgotten, looking for the perfect opportunity.

78625.Name: Mystic Monstrosity
78625.FlavorText: Under the light of an unnatural moon, it walked out on legs of straw with joints of hinges ripped from the barn doors.

78626.Name: Pithing Needle
78626.FlavorText: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.

78627.Name: Silver Bolt
78627.FlavorText:
"When a werewolf charges, you'll only have time for one shot. Best make it count."
—Captain Eberheart

78628.Name: Stuffed Bear
78628.FlavorText: It takes a taxidermist of unusual skill to cleanly stuff and mount a beast without severing its primal, predatory drive.

78629.Name: Deserted Beach
78629.FlavorText: Drownyard floods and unnatural frost made the once peaceful boardwalk deceptively treacherous.

78630.Name: Evolving Wilds
78630.FlavorText:
"Stensia blazes with new heat. Nephalia's tides are chaotic. And everywhere, this unnatural frost. The land is sending a warning."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

78632.Name: Haunted Ridge
78632.FlavorText: Swirling eddies of ash hide crumbling cliffs, treacherous drops, and the slavering maws of unknown evils.

78635.Name: Overgrown Farmland
78635.FlavorText: A few weed-choked gourd patches are all that remain of the proud, thriving farms that once blanketed the province.

78636.Name: Rockfall Vale
78636.FlavorText: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.

78637.Name: Shipwreck Marsh
78637.FlavorText: The bones of doomed ships jut out from the muck while the bones of their sailors molder below.

78771.Name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
78771.FlavorText: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

78772.Name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
78772.FlavorText: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

78774.Name: Urabrask the Hidden
78774.FlavorText: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

78776.Name: Adamant Will
78776.FlavorText: "I refuse to die before I see the sun rise again."

78777.Name: Angelic Quartermaster
78777.FlavorText: "Stand strong. We will reclaim the dawn."

78778.Name: Arm the Cathars
78778.FlavorText: Faith is a cathar's greatest weapon, but a sword of blessed silver is a close second.

78780.Name: By Invitation Only
78780.FlavorText: The red envelopes guarantee safe passage through the Lurenbraum barrier. Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

78783.Name: Dawnhart Geist
78783.FlavorText: "Our bodies may lie slain, but perhaps we can still complete the ritual. I'd rather not spend my afterlife in this wretched eternal night."

78786.Name: Drogskol Infantry
78786.FlavorText: He swore to protect the Moorlands. A little thing like death was no excuse to break his oath.

78787.Name: Drogskol Armaments
78787.FlavorText: When he could no longer carry on, he imparted his strength to the one who took up his duty.

78788.Name: Estwald Shieldbasher
78788.FlavorText: The door to her home survived the fires of the Malignus. Now it's her greatest weapon.

78791.Name: Fierce Retribution
78791.FlavorText: "It won't bring them back, but it will bring me peace."

78793.Name: Gryff Rider
78793.FlavorText:
"Keep your heels down and bend at the hips as your mount takes flight. She'll do the rest."
—Anders, cathar drillmaster

78802.Name: Ancestor's Embrace
78802.FlavorText: "Thank you, Grandmother. I love you too."

78804.Name: Militia Rallier
78804.FlavorText: "We can wait like helpless children for a hero, or we can gather our courage and be the heroes. Who's with me?"

78805.Name: Nebelgast Beguiler
78805.FlavorText: A moment of distraction, an hour off course.

78807.Name: Ollenbock Escort
78807.FlavorText: "Stay in the light. I don't know what lurks in those shadows, and I'd like to keep it that way."

78809.Name: Cackling Culprit
78809.FlavorText: "Ha! They fall for it every time."

78810.Name: Parish-Blade Trainee
78810.FlavorText: The recruits trained in eternal night, fueled by the hope that they might one day see the sun again.

78811.Name: Piercing Light
78811.FlavorText:
"Creatures of the night dissolve like shadows in the light of faith."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

78813.Name: Radiant Restraints
78813.FlavorText:
"Even in times of brutal darkness, never mistake beauty and delicacy for weakness."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

78814.Name: Resistance Squad
78814.FlavorText:
"It's not that I didn't expect some defiance, but I did hope it wouldn't be so heavily armed."
—Olivia Voldaren

78815.Name: Sanctify
78815.FlavorText:
"Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

78818.Name: Sigarda's Summons
78818.FlavorText: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

78820.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
78820.FlavorText: "Thraben belongs to the living. I will not rest until it is cleansed."

78821.Name: Traveling Minister
78821.FlavorText: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.

78822.Name: Twinblade Geist
78822.FlavorText: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.

78823.Name: Twinblade Invocation
78823.FlavorText: Since her passing, many more travelers have made it home alive.

78824.Name: Unholy Officiant
78824.FlavorText:
"Is this twisted ceremony simply a mockery of the human rite, or has Olivia fallen for her own charade?"
—Sorin Markov

78826.Name: Vampire Slayer
78826.FlavorText: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed. When she brought one down herself, she realized she had found her calling.

78829.Name: Wedding Festivity
78829.FlavorText: Vampires from every bloodline mingled together, all swelling with pride to be seen at the event of the century.

78830.Name: Welcoming Vampire
78830.FlavorText: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

78831.Name: Alchemist's Retrieval
78831.FlavorText: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.

78834.Name: Biolume Egg
78834.FlavorText: Serpents leave their eggs in the cold and inky depths . . .

78835.Name: Biolume Serpent
78835.FlavorText: . . . knowing their hatchlings are more fearsome than anything else that might come along.

78837.Name: Chill of the Grave
78837.FlavorText: Frozen is frozen, whether it's with cold, terror, or both.

78838.Name: Cobbled Lancer
78838.FlavorText:
"Don't worry everyone—I hear hoofbeats! The Gavony Riders are coming to save us!"
—Adin, Moorland villager

78839.Name: Consuming Tide
78839.FlavorText: Nephalia's tides obey an unforgiving moon.

78841.Name: Cruel Witness
78841.FlavorText:
"I escaped, so why do I still feel like I'm being watched?"
—Gregel, militia leader

78842.Name: Diver Skaab
78842.FlavorText: It doesn't need to breathe, but the suit does help keep the parts together.

78846.Name: Geistlight Snare
78846.FlavorText: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

78847.Name: Geralf, Visionary Stitcher
78847.FlavorText: "Do you like it, Sister? Its dreadful visage was inspired by your own."

78848.Name: Gutter Skulker
78848.FlavorText: Geists have a knack for showing up wherever they're least expected.

78849.Name: Gutter Shortcut
78849.FlavorText: Some people take that as inspiration.

78851.Name: Inspired Idea
78851.FlavorText: Stitching is an ever-evolving field, with each new advancement reaching a new height of horror.

78852.Name: Jacob Hauken, Inspector
78852.FlavorText: "Our world may be dark, but there's still plenty to see."

78854.Name: Lantern Bearer
78854.FlavorText: Val didn't know what the silent geist was offering . . .

78855.Name: Lanterns' Lift
78855.FlavorText: . . . but she knew it would be rude to refuse.

78859.Name: Mischievous Catgeist
78859.FlavorText:
"I never get any knitting done, but I don't entirely mind."
—Lorn, Lambholt innkeeper

78861.Name: Necroduality
78861.FlavorText:
"Geralf's prowess continues to grow. He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy."
—Ludevic's laboratory notes

78864.Name: Repository Skaab
78864.FlavorText: Created to capture the spark of genius for later use.

78865.Name: Scattered Thoughts
78865.FlavorText: Stitchers delegate the most important tasks to assistants with a good eye for detail.

78867.Name: Selhoff Entomber
78867.FlavorText: It knows one fundamental truth: bodies belong in graves.

78868.Name: Serpentine Ambush
78868.FlavorText: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.

78869.Name: Skywarp Skaab
78869.FlavorText:
"If I wanted all the parts to match, I wouldn't have become a stitcher."
—Barton, stitcher

78871.Name: Cipherbound Spirit
78871.FlavorText: Rather than consort with demons, the Quietus Cult seeks wisdom from the dead.

78872.Name: Steelclad Spirit
78872.FlavorText: Some geists imitate the lives they left behind. Others follow the dreams they never realized.

78874.Name: Stormchaser Drake
78874.FlavorText:
"Blasted drake's interfering with the conductivity again. Garl! Go chase it away."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

78875.Name: Syncopate
78875.FlavorText: "Fool! Can't you see the tide has turned against you?"

78876.Name: Syphon Essence
78876.FlavorText: The third step in creating a skaab requires draining the body of blood and replacing it with viscus vitae, a mixture of angel's blood and lamp oil.

78877.Name: Thirst for Discovery
78877.FlavorText:
"This is your only warning, alchemist. The secrets of the sea are not yours to behold. Lord Krothuss will not be so merciful next time."
—Runo Stromkirk

78878.Name: Wanderlight Spirit
78878.FlavorText: The towers and catwalks of the Voldaren fortress are lit by the lanterns of geists endlessly seeking a way out.

78879.Name: Wash Away
78879.FlavorText:
"May the ocean take it"
—Nephalia expression meaning
"good riddance"

78880.Name: Whispering Wizard
78880.FlavorText: Ivold was aghast when his device revealed the full scope of the geist infestation.

78881.Name: Winged Portent
78881.FlavorText:
"No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder. . . . I think."
—York, Kessig tracker

78883.Name: Wretched Throng
78883.FlavorText:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words

78886.Name: Bleed Dry
78886.FlavorText:
"Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized."
—Anje Falkenrath

78892.Name: Catapult Fodder
78892.FlavorText: These days, ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.

78893.Name: Catapult Captain
78893.FlavorText: And they're more than happy to share the wealth.

78895.Name: Concealing Curtains
78895.FlavorText: Specifics were kept secret, but word quickly spread that the show was a must-see.

78897.Name: Courier Bat
78897.FlavorText: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.

78898.Name: Demonic Bargain
78898.FlavorText:
"Do not try to negotiate with me, human. You want power? This is the price."
—Ormendahl

78899.Name: Desperate Farmer
78899.FlavorText: A tragic moment pushed him to a blasphemous act.

78900.Name: Depraved Harvester
78900.FlavorText: Once he'd tasted that dark power, there was no turning back.

78901.Name: Diregraf Scavenger
78901.FlavorText: It can barely feel the sword anymore.

78902.Name: Doomed Dissenter
78902.FlavorText: The most dangerous place to be in Kessig is alone.

78904.Name: Dreadfeast Demon
78904.FlavorText: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake was more blood than water.

78905.Name: Dying to Serve
78905.FlavorText:
"I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached."
—Olivia Voldaren

78906.Name: Edgar's Awakening
78906.FlavorText: "Here you go. Can't have you sleeping through your own wedding day."

78909.Name: Gift of Fangs
78909.FlavorText:
"You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?"
—Runo Stromkirk

78912.Name: Grisly Ritual
78912.FlavorText:
"You can always tell who's new from the screaming."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist

78914.Name: Headless Rider
78914.FlavorText: He wanders the Moorlands hoping to one day chop off a head worthy of replacing his own.

78916.Name: Henrika, Infernal Seer
78916.FlavorText: "Once you've tasted demon blood, you'll wonder why you ever settled for human."

78917.Name: Hero's Downfall
78917.FlavorText: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

78918.Name: Innocent Traveler
78918.FlavorText: "Aren't you going to invite me in?"

78919.Name: Malicious Invader
78919.FlavorText: "Aren't you going to offer me a drink?"

78920.Name: Mindleech Ghoul
78920.FlavorText:
"This still doesn't make you the brains of the operation."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

78921.Name: Parasitic Grasp
78921.FlavorText: Some wicked souls linger only to consume the warmth of life.

78922.Name: Path of Peril
78922.FlavorText: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.

78923.Name: Persistent Specimen
78923.FlavorText:
"The jaw bone's connected to the skull bone. The skull bone's connected to the . . . uh . . . hook thingy."
—Garl, stitcher's assistant

78924.Name: Pointed Discussion
78924.FlavorText: Small talk is a dying art.

78925.Name: Ragged Recluse
78925.FlavorText: "Forgive my manners. It's been so long since I had a guest for dinner."

78926.Name: Odious Witch
78926.FlavorText: Her cauldron refilled, she settled in to wait for the next unsuspecting traveler to knock at her door.

78929.Name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
78929.FlavorText: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.

78930.Name: Skulking Killer
78930.FlavorText: Olivia set a few villagers loose in the hedge maze as part of the evening's "entertainment."

78934.Name: Undying Malice
78934.FlavorText: Few take kindly to being put in their place, especially if their place is the grave.

78935.Name: Unhallowed Phalanx
78935.FlavorText:
"In case any of you new recruits were wondering, this is why we don't use mass graves anymore."
—Kerren of the Mausoleum Guards

78936.Name: Vampire's Kiss
78936.FlavorText: Young vampires gorge themselves at every meal, but their elders have learned to savor the smallest bite.

78938.Name: Bloodbat Summoner
78938.FlavorText: "Humans throw rice and release doves at their weddings? How quaint."

78939.Name: Wedding Security
78939.FlavorText: In lieu of payment, he was granted permission to devour any unauthorized visitors.

78940.Name: Abrade
78940.FlavorText: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.

78944.Name: Ancestral Anger
78944.FlavorText: "One vampire for every family member I've lost."

78945.Name: Ballista Watcher
78945.FlavorText: "Careful, this thing's dangerous. Wouldn't want anyone getting hurt."

78948.Name: Blood Hypnotist
78948.FlavorText: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

78953.Name: Change of Fortune
78953.FlavorText:
"We cannot escape change, but with faith and fortitude, we can mold it to our liking."
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

78956.Name: Daybreak Combatants
78956.FlavorText: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

78957.Name: Dominating Vampire
78957.FlavorText: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."

78958.Name: End the Festivities
78958.FlavorText: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.

78960.Name: Fearful Villager
78960.FlavorText: When Harold ran from the wolves, the others called him a coward.

78961.Name: Fearsome Werewolf
78961.FlavorText: Come nightfall, they were the ones fleeing in terror.

78962.Name: Flame-Blessed Bolt
78962.FlavorText:
"I noticed you were short on party favors, so I brought my own."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

78963.Name: Frenzied Devils
78963.FlavorText:
"Devils need no reason to stir up chaos. The chaos itself is their reward."
—Rem Karolus, Fiendslayer

78964.Name: Honeymoon Hearse
78964.FlavorText: A carriage crafted from the finest materials. Horses bred from the finest stock. Skulls taken from the finest foes.

78965.Name: Hungry Ridgewolf
78965.FlavorText: Even vampires know to travel faster when they hear howling in the Geier Reach passes.

78968.Name: Into the Night
78968.FlavorText:
"When lost souls wander into the woods, the wilds have a way of showing them who they really are."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

78969.Name: Kessig Flamebreather
78969.FlavorText: "Hunter's fire" was meant for slaying monsters in the Ulvenwald, but that never stopped Ralen from showing it off.

78970.Name: Kessig Wolfrider
78970.FlavorText: "It's a perfect partnership. My village is safe from wolf attacks, and she gets to eat any vampires we catch."

78974.Name: Lightning Wolf
78974.FlavorText: These thick-furred wolves have adapted to Stensia's storms, channeling their energy into bursts of supernatural speed.

78979.Name: Pyre Spawn
78979.FlavorText: Memories of the Harvesttide tragedy festered until they grew into an incarnate rage that set the world ablaze.

78980.Name: Reckless Impulse
78980.FlavorText: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.

78981.Name: Rending Flame
78981.FlavorText:
"It is our duty to bring the Blessed Sleep to the dead, even if they resist that gift."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

78982.Name: Runebound Wolf
78982.FlavorText: The wolf's captor hid his fear, but he knew someday the runes would fail, the collar would break, and the wolf would remember his face.

78984.Name: Stensia Uprising
78984.FlavorText: "Vampires have done nothing but take from us. Tonight, we reclaim what's ours!"

78985.Name: Sure Strike
78985.FlavorText: Before the officiant even had a chance to ask if anyone objected to the Voldaren-Markov union, Arlinn made her opinion known.

78986.Name: Vampires' Vengeance
78986.FlavorText: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.

78989.Name: Voldaren Epicure
78989.FlavorText: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

78990.Name: Voltaic Visionary
78990.FlavorText: She spent many years trying to harness chaos.

78991.Name: Volt-Charged Berserker
78991.FlavorText: She finally realized that chaos was meant to run rampant, as was she.

78992.Name: Weary Prisoner
78992.FlavorText: "Your guard attacked me. He got what was coming to him."

78994.Name: Apprentice Sharpshooter
78994.FlavorText: Innistrad's best archers are trained by the Quiver of Kessig, an order of cathars who specialize in ranged combat.

79000.Name: Cartographer's Survey
79000.FlavorText: She monitors the roads in every province, mapping safe routes through hunting grounds and haunting grounds alike.

79004.Name: Crushing Canopy
79004.FlavorText:
"The forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves."
—Wrenn

79006.Name: Dawnhart Disciple
79006.FlavorText: "Our coven finds strength in nature and purpose in serving our communities."

79007.Name: Dig Up
79007.FlavorText: Things buried on Innistrad rarely seem to stay that way.

79008.Name: Dormant Grove
79008.FlavorText: As the natural cycle of day and night grew twisted, old powers stirred deep in the Ulvenwald.

79009.Name: Gnarled Grovestrider
79009.FlavorText: Far from the bloodsoaked wedding, unseen by human eyes, a long-slumbering force arose to protect its home.

79010.Name: Flourishing Hunter
79010.FlavorText:
"I would welcome her into my pack with honor."
—Arlinn Kord

79014.Name: Hookhand Mariner
79014.FlavorText: The local gossips swore Nesmith lost his hands in a fight with a werewolf.

79019.Name: Infestation Expert
79019.FlavorText: There's only so many times she can take being asked . . .

79021.Name: Laid to Rest
79021.FlavorText:
"We are not here to mourn their loss. We are here to celebrate their lives."
—Vesna, Dawnhart witch

79022.Name: Massive Might
79022.FlavorText:
"Run! It's coming for us! Eventually!"
—Yaster, Havengul shopkeeper

79023.Name: Moldgraf Millipede
79023.FlavorText: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

79024.Name: Mulch
79024.FlavorText:
"Tread carefully. You remember what happened in the last quiet, peaceful clearing."
—Halana, to Alena

79026.Name: Oakshade Stalker
79026.FlavorText: He blends seamlessly into the forest, waiting silently for his prey.

79027.Name: Moonlit Ambusher
79027.FlavorText: Even when he strikes, the only sound is the snap of jaws through bone.

79028.Name: Packsong Pup
79028.FlavorText: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

79029.Name: Reclusive Taxidermist
79029.FlavorText: All druids seek to preserve nature, but some go about it in rather unusual ways.

79030.Name: Retrieve
79030.FlavorText: The roots preserved the armor for a hundred years, safeguarding it for a traveler in need.

79031.Name: Rural Recruit
79031.FlavorText: The Dawnhart survivors welcome recruits of all shapes and sizes.

79033.Name: Sheltering Boughs
79033.FlavorText:
"We're not at odds with the woods. How could we be, when we share so many enemies?"
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

79034.Name: Snarling Wolf
79034.FlavorText:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words

79036.Name: Splendid Reclamation
79036.FlavorText:
"These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again. Now, their patience is rewarded."
—Wrenn

79037.Name: Spore Crawler
79037.FlavorText:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

79038.Name: Sporeback Wolf
79038.FlavorText: The mushrooms growing in the wolves' fur possess curative properties incredible enough to tempt many alchemists into risking their lives to track one down.

79039.Name: Toxic Scorpion
79039.FlavorText:
"You want that venom? Collect it yourself! I'm not losing another pair of dragonhide gloves."
—Old Rutstein

79040.Name: Ulvenwald Oddity
79040.FlavorText:
"Obviously it's dangerous, but I've never seen anything like it. This could be an entirely new species! I say we follow it."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

79041.Name: Ulvenwald Behemoth
79041.FlavorText:
"We've learned enough! I say we run."
—Alena, Kessig trapper

79043.Name: Blossom-Clad Werewolf
79043.FlavorText: . . . does not always mean living in peace.

79044.Name: Witch's Web
79044.FlavorText: Ever since the ritual, Ryla didn't have an appetite at the dinner table, but her long walks in the forest always seemed to satiate her hunger.

79045.Name: Wolf Strike
79045.FlavorText: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.

79046.Name: Wolfkin Outcast
79046.FlavorText: The villagers feared him. The cathars scorned him. Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.

79047.Name: Wedding Crasher
79047.FlavorText: He raged not just against vampires, but against civilization itself.

79048.Name: Ancient Lumberknot
79048.FlavorText: The soft creak of trees in the wind is not always cause for comfort.

79053.Name: Child of the Pack
79053.FlavorText: Her face shines with youthful innocence.

79055.Name: Dorothea, Vengeful Victim
79055.FlavorText: "Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest."
79055.RawFrameDetail: WU gold legendary front side TDFC

79057.Name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
79057.FlavorText: "Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly."
79057.RawFrameDetail: WB gold legendary front side TDFC

79058.Name: Edgar Markov's Coffin
79058.RawFrameDetail: WB gold artifact legendary back side TDFC

79059.Name: Eruth, Tormented Prophet
79059.FlavorText: She is cursed with visions of monsters and suffering . . . and all her visions come true.

79063.Name: Markov Purifier
79063.FlavorText: The ceremonial "incense" was a concoction of Edgar's own design, a precise blend of blood from his favorite human lineages.

79067.Name: Olivia, Crimson Bride
79067.FlavorText: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

79068.Name: Runo Stromkirk
79068.RawFrameDetail: UB gold legendary front side TDFC

79069.Name: Krothuss, Lord of the Deep
79069.RawFrameDetail: UB gold legendary back side TDFC

79075.Name: Blood Servitor
79075.FlavorText:
"Please, my friends, help yourselves to the help."
—Olivia Voldaren

79076.Name: Boarded Window
79076.FlavorText:
"Sturdy nails make for sound sleep."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

79079.Name: Foreboding Statue
79079.FlavorText: As the sand eroded, a faint sound could be heard whirling under the ground.

79080.Name: Forsaken Thresher
79080.FlavorText: Were it not for the cultists' fatal curiosity, the terrible machine might have lain dormant for decades more.

79081.Name: Honored Heirloom
79081.FlavorText: After the Travails, Runechanters set about repairing twisted symbols of Avacyn as the first step in restoring faith in the Church.

79085.Name: Deathcap Glade
79085.FlavorText: Deadly mushrooms litter these woods, each waiting for an errant footstep to release its noxious spores.

79086.Name: Dreamroot Cascade
79086.FlavorText: Soothing whispers invite travelers to step closer, closer, closer . . . until they vanish soundlessly beneath the surface.

79087.Name: Evolving Wilds
79087.FlavorText:
"Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

79088.Name: Shattered Sanctum
79088.FlavorText: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.

79089.Name: Stormcarved Coast
79089.FlavorText: Frequent, violent storms shape the Nephalia coastline, sculpting cliffs and caves where monsters often lurk.

79090.Name: Sundown Pass
79090.FlavorText: Riders chase the fading light recklessly through the mountains, desperate for one last glimpse of day.

79115.Name: Plains

79123.RawFrameDetail: G basic Forest, full art special

79124.RawFrameDetail: G basic Forest, full art special

79131.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
79131.FlavorText: "Our dear Madam Mina is once more our teacher. Her eyes have been where we were blinded. Now we are on the track once again, and this time we may succeed."

79134.Name: Thirst for Discovery
79134.FlavorText: I knew he had left the castle now, and thought to use the opportunity to explore more than I had dared to do as yet.

79137.Name: Henrika, Infernal Seer
79137.FlavorText: Nothing can be more dreadful than those awful women, who were—who are—waiting to suck my blood.

79138.Name: Innocent Traveler
79138.FlavorText: I looked at her throat just now as she lay asleep, and the tiny wounds seem not to have healed.

79139.Name: Malicious Invader
79139.FlavorText: Van Helsing raised his lantern and drew the slide; by the concentrated light that fell on Lucy's face we could see that the lips were crimson with fresh blood.

79142.Name: Bloodbat Summoner
79142.FlavorText: "Do you mean to tell me that Lucy was bitten by such a bat . . . ?"

79143.Name: Vampires' Vengeance
79143.FlavorText: She was ghastly, chalkily pale; the red seemed to have gone even from her lips and gums, and the bones of her face stood out prominently; her breathing was painful to see or hear.

79144.Name: Reclusive Taxidermist
79144.FlavorText: We want no proofs; we ask none to believe us! This boy will some day know what a brave and gallant woman his mother is.

79145.Name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
79145.FlavorText: "It is in the hold, perhaps in one of those boxes. I'll unscrew them one by one and see. You work the helm."
79145.RawFrameDetail: WB gold legendary front side TDFC

79146.Name: Edgar Markov's Coffin
79146.RawFrameDetail: WB gold artifact legendary back side TDFC

79147.Name: Eruth, Tormented Prophet
79147.FlavorText: "The blood is the life! The blood is the life!"

79149.Name: Torens, Fist of the Angels
79149.FlavorText: He seems absolutely imperturbable. I can fancy what a wonderful power he must have over his patients.

79156.Name: Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr
79156.RawFrameDetail: alt W legendary front side TDFC

79157.Name: Katilda's Rising Dawn
79157.RawFrameDetail: alt W legendary back side TDFC

79160.Name: Jacob Hauken, Inspector
79160.RawFrameDetail: alt U legendary front side TDFC

79161.Name: Hauken's Insight
79161.RawFrameDetail: alt U legendary back side TDFC

79163.Name: Dorothea, Vengeful Victim
79163.RawFrameDetail: alt WU gold legendary front side TDFC

79169.RawFrameDetail: alt UB gold legendary front side TDFC
