79170.RawFrameDetail: alt UB gold legendary back side TDFC

79180.Name: Henrika Domnathi
79180.RawFrameDetail: alt B legendary front side TDFC

79181.Name: Henrika, Infernal Seer
79181.RawFrameDetail: alt B legendary back side TDFC

79203.Name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
79203.RawFrameDetail: alt WB gold legendary front side TDFC

79204.Name: Edgar Markov's Coffin
79204.RawFrameDetail: alt WB gold artifact legendary back side TDFC

79209.Name: Runo Stromkirk
79209.RawFrameDetail: alt UB gold legendary front side TDFC

79210.Name: Krothuss, Lord of the Deep
79210.RawFrameDetail: alt UB gold legendary back side TDFC

79235.Name: Abzan Battle Priest
79235.FlavorText: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."

79236.Name: Abzan Falconer
79236.FlavorText: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

79237.Name: Ainok Bond-Kin
79237.FlavorText: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

79238.Name: Angel of the God-Pharaoh
79238.FlavorText: The angels did not deceive. From the start, they were clear their allegiance was to the God-Pharaoh and to him alone.

79240.Name: Anointer of Valor
79240.FlavorText: Light streaked down from the heavens, and a voice whispered in the soldier's ear, "You shall not fall today."

79241.Name: Blade Splicer
79241.FlavorText: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

79242.Name: Bonds of Faith
79242.FlavorText:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

79243.Name: Bonescythe Sliver
79243.FlavorText:
"Their appendages are sharper than our swords and quicker than our bows."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

79244.Name: Boros Elite
79244.FlavorText:
"First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader."
—Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

79245.Name: Devouring Light
79245.FlavorText: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

79246.Name: Djeru's Renunciation
79246.FlavorText:
"I was promised an afterlife, not this. Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

79247.Name: Doomed Traveler
79247.FlavorText: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

79248.Name: Hanweir Militia Captain
79248.FlavorText: Her reputation inspires both loyalty and adoration.

79250.Name: Hive Stirrings
79250.FlavorText: Sliver young are sorted into clutches according to their potential and their future role. Human scholars can only guess how those are determined.

79251.Name: Kor Skyfisher
79251.FlavorText: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."

79255.Name: Roc Egg
79255.FlavorText: A thin shell lies between the roc and a world of bite-sized treats.

79257.Name: Selfless Cathar
79257.FlavorText: "If I fail to offer myself, we will surely be overrun. My fate would be the same."

79258.Name: Sentinel Sliver
79258.FlavorText: Through its watchful gaze, all slivers may see.

79259.Name: Seraph of Dawn
79259.FlavorText: She parts the clouds so sunlight can reach even the darkest lairs and duskiest tombs.

79260.Name: Steelform Sliver
79260.FlavorText:
"Though the slivers may sometimes resemble us, they are not human. Anyone who fights them must remember this."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

79261.Name: Sustainer of the Realm
79261.FlavorText: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

79263.Name: Thraben Standard Bearer
79263.FlavorText: The uncorrupted rallied under Thalia's leadership and Sigarda's banner.

79264.Name: Winged Shepherd
79264.FlavorText:
"When the Hour of Promise arrives, the God-Pharaoh will tear down the Hekma, for its protection will be needed no longer."
—The Accounting of Hours

79265.Name: Yoked Plowbeast
79265.FlavorText:
"It is sacrilege to confine a gargantuan to the grinding of straight lines. I will pray that it remembers who is the master of this land."
—Syeena, elvish godtoucher

79266.Name: Breaching Hippocamp
79266.FlavorText: Don't try to ride this steed unless you've got gills too.

79267.Name: Coralhelm Guide
79267.FlavorText:
"She knows every step of this coastline, both above and below the surface, and she has hideouts all along the way. She will get you there."
—Jori En, expedition leader

79268.Name: Diffusion Sliver
79268.FlavorText:
"The hive shimmered, and its walls seemed a living mirror."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

79269.Name: Dismiss
79269.FlavorText:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

79272.Name: Master of the Pearl Trident
79272.FlavorText: "Let the land dwellers know the coast is no longer the border between our realms. A new age of empire has begun."

79278.Name: Stitchwing Skaab
79278.FlavorText:
"Amazing, isn't it, how scraps can come together to create such a wonder?"
—Stitcher Geralf

79279.Name: Tightening Coils
79279.FlavorText: Having gone to the trouble of stealing a bident from a god on another world, Kiora was eager to test its capabilities.

79281.Name: Asylum Visitor
79281.FlavorText: "The ravings of the mad are laced with eldritch knowledge."

79282.Name: Carrier Thrall
79282.FlavorText:
"Later we will mourn those we have lost. First we must end their suffering."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

79283.Name: Dark Salvation
79283.FlavorText: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.

79284.Name: Death Wind
79284.FlavorText: Leukin stared at the smoldering angel feathers. "Run!" he screamed to his patrol. "We don't stand a chance!"

79286.Name: Eyeblight Assassin
79286.FlavorText: "Boggart blood disgusts me almost as much as the foul creatures themselves."

79287.Name: Facevaulter
79287.FlavorText: Boggarts get so excited when they find something new to smash that they really don't notice who gets underfoot.

79288.Name: Fleshbag Marauder
79288.FlavorText: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

79290.Name: Heir of Falkenrath
79290.FlavorText: Among vampires, there has long been the belief that the urge to feed must be balanced by the poise of nobility.

79291.Name: Heir to the Night
79291.FlavorText: The Falkenrath have relinquished all pretense at nobility, losing themselves completely to their all-consuming thirst.

79292.Name: Indulgent Aristocrat
79292.FlavorText: "If you're not surrounded by decadence, my question to you is—why not?"

79293.Name: Leeching Sliver
79293.FlavorText:
"Seeing one slowly devour one of my party begged the question—do they know what cruelty is?"
—Hastric, Thunian scout

79294.Name: Markov Crusader
79294.FlavorText: The surviving members of the Markov bloodline drove through a crush of horrors to reclaim their ancestral home.

79295.Name: Marrow-Gnawer
79295.FlavorText: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

79296.Name: Nezumi Cutthroat
79296.FlavorText:
"The nezumi will do things for money no other thinking creature would consider. This, of course, makes them useful beyond words."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

79298.Name: Ruin Rat
79298.FlavorText: From every shadow came the dull scratch of teeth on bones.

79302.Name: Battle Squadron
79302.FlavorText: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

79303.Name: Belligerent Sliver
79303.FlavorText:
"The slivers became adept at provoking a fear response in other species."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

79304.Name: Blisterstick Shaman
79304.FlavorText: A productive warren requires a good deal of prodding.

79305.Name: Blur Sliver
79305.FlavorText: They move in a synchronized swarm, turning entire squads into heaps of bloody rags and bones in an instant.

79308.Name: Foundry Street Denizen
79308.FlavorText: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

79309.Name: Furyblade Vampire
79309.FlavorText: "Writhe all you want, filth. It will do you no good."

79311.Name: Hordeling Outburst
79311.FlavorText:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

79313.Name: Insatiable Gorgers
79313.FlavorText:
"Drink deeply, for there is no tomorrow!"
—Anje Falkenrath

79315.Name: Krenko's Command
79315.FlavorText: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

79317.Name: Mad Prophet
79317.FlavorText: "There's no heron in the moon! It's a shrew, a five-legged shrew, with a voice like whispering thunder!"

79319.Name: Ravenous Bloodseeker
79319.FlavorText:
"Nothing will cool the fire in their blood. They are too far gone. We must keep them away from our towns at any cost."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

79320.Name: Reckless Racer
79320.FlavorText: Illegal street races turned out to be perfect practice for avoiding Consulate patrols.

79321.Name: Reckless Wurm
79321.FlavorText: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.

79322.Name: Renegade Tactics
79322.FlavorText: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

79323.Name: Shiv's Embrace
79323.FlavorText: When you see the world as a dragon sees it, everything looks fit to burn.

79324.Name: Striking Sliver
79324.FlavorText: You're too busy recoiling in fear to realize that it's already hit you.

79325.Name: Thunderbreak Regent
79325.FlavorText: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

79328.Name: Awaken the Bear
79328.FlavorText: When Temur warriors enter the battle trance known as "awakening the bear," they lose all sense of enemy or friend, seeing only threats to the wilderness.

79330.Name: Bear Cub
79330.FlavorText:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

79331.Name: Bestial Menace
79331.FlavorText:
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

79334.Name: Grizzly Bears
79334.FlavorText:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

79335.Name: Hardened Scales
79335.FlavorText:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

79336.Name: Harrow
79336.FlavorText: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

79337.Name: Incremental Growth
79337.FlavorText: The bonds of family cross the boundaries of race.

79338.Name: Manaweft Sliver
79338.FlavorText:
"I see in their interconnectedness a strange embodiment of the natural order."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

79339.Name: Parallel Lives
79339.FlavorText:
"There will come a time when the only prey left will be each other."
—Ulrich of Krallenhorde Pack

79340.Name: Predatory Sliver
79340.FlavorText: No matter how much the slivers change, their collective might remains.

79342.Name: Runeclaw Bear
79342.FlavorText: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

79344.Name: Squirrel Wrangler
79344.FlavorText: "Gnawed to death. Bad way to go."

79345.Name: Striped Bears
79345.FlavorText:
"The bear is never cautious—which is why it wasn't born a human."
—Mirri of the Weatherlight

79346.Name: Tajuru Pathwarden
79346.FlavorText: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

79348.Name: Bred for the Hunt
79348.FlavorText: Some see the world as a place of infinite wonder and knowledge. Some see it as an infinite dinner plate.

79350.Name: Nimbus Swimmer
79350.FlavorText: The Simic soon discovered that the sky offered as few constraints on size as the sea.

79352.Name: Bonded Construct
79352.FlavorText: Loyal to a fault, it heeds its master's every command.

79353.Name: Ichor Wellspring
79353.FlavorText:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

79354.Name: Implement of Combustion
79354.FlavorText: A dream of fire lies coiled inside, waiting for its glorious awakening.

79355.Name: Myr Enforcer
79355.FlavorText: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

79416.Name: Arcane Signet
79416.FlavorText: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

79417.Name: Command Tower
79417.FlavorText:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

79422.Name: Imperial Moth
79422.FlavorText:
"The moths of Eiganjo were once no different from any other great beast of Kamigawa's wilds. It took years of patience and dedication to convince them to bear riders."
—History of the Empire

79423.Name: Blade-Blizzard Kitsune
79423.FlavorText: In the time it takes most to master one blade, he mastered two.

79425.Name: Brilliant Restoration
79425.FlavorText:
"We have done our best to heal this land together, but now I must entrust the future to my sister. She will carry our dreams onward into the sunrise."
—Michiko Konda's journal

79427.Name: Dragonfly Suit
79427.FlavorText: Cutting-edge Imperial sentinel mechs patrol the skies over Eiganjo.

79428.Name: Eiganjo Exemplar
79428.FlavorText: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.

79430.Name: Hand of Enlightenment
79430.FlavorText:
"We have endured lifetimes of war and carved our way to peace by blade and conquest. Now, united at last under Kyodai's guidance, we lay down our weapons and open our minds."
—Aoha, general of the First Emperor

79432.Name: Fragment of Konda
79432.FlavorText: For his transgressions against the kami, Lord Konda's immortal body was turned to stone, then shattered into a thousand still-living pieces.

79434.Name: Go-Shintai of Shared Purpose
79434.FlavorText: It seeks those who act with kindness and offers friendship.

79435.Name: Golden-Tail Disciple
79435.FlavorText: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.

79436.Name: Hotshot Mechanic
79436.FlavorText: "If your mech is factory standard, you might as well be walking."

79437.Name: Imperial Oath
79437.FlavorText: Those chosen to guard the Imperial Palace are not only unrivaled warriors but also lionhearted champions of the Imperial cause.

79444.Name: Light the Way
79444.FlavorText: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."

79447.Name: Lucky Offering
79447.FlavorText: The playful kami reserved its greatest blessings for those who brought not wealth or rare delicacies, but particularly amusing trinkets.

79450.Name: Portrait of Michiko
79450.FlavorText: Long ago, as the first mortal to bond with Kyodai, Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.

79451.Name: Mothrider Patrol
79451.FlavorText:
"Be proud, young pup! You've earned your wings. Rise and become the western wind."
—Swift-Arm, Golden-Tail headmaster

79452.Name: Norika Yamazaki, the Poet
79452.FlavorText: "The blades will have their say, but peace is built with words."

79453.Name: Regent's Authority
79453.FlavorText: Before her spark pulled her away again, the Emperor appointed the wise Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.

79454.Name: Repel the Vile
79454.FlavorText:
"You are a guest in this realm, and you've overstayed your welcome."
—Yui, Imperial intercessor

79456.Name: Architect of Restoration
79456.FlavorText:
"A visionary looks at rubble and sees not only what was, but also what could be."
—Onyx-Eye, architect of Eiganjo

79458.Name: Seven-Tail Mentor
79458.FlavorText: "I have taught you all I can. Take this blade and rise as my equal."

79459.Name: Sky-Blessed Samurai
79459.FlavorText: Imperial samurai who show exceptional honor and dexterity are invited to train as mothriders, elite guards charged with protecting the skies of Eiganjo.

79460.Name: Spirited Companion
79460.FlavorText: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

79463.Name: Wanderer's Intervention
79463.FlavorText: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion. One mighty slash was enough to take the praetor out of the fight.

79465.Name: When We Were Young
79465.FlavorText: Since Imperial custom strictly forbade the Emperor to reveal her name—even to Kaito, her closest childhood friend—she had to suffer him calling her "your emperorness" for much of their shared youth.

79466.Name: Acquisition Octopus
79466.FlavorText: You can never have too many arms.

79467.Name: Anchor to Reality
79467.FlavorText: The Wanderer sighed in relief as the Reality Chip tethered her wayward spark to Kamigawa.

79471.Name: Vision of the Unspeakable
79471.FlavorText: Even as her students' minds succumbed to madness, Azami's obsession with the kami of forbidden knowledge only grew.

79474.Name: Disruption Protocol
79474.FlavorText: "Let's just turn that off, shall we?"

79475.Name: Essence Capture
79475.FlavorText: The Futurists regard the tradition of kami-bonding as anachronistic and inefficient, striving constantly to surpass spiritual power with technology.

79476.Name: Futurist Operative
79476.FlavorText: "The Imperials can't arrest you for illegal tech if you never even existed."

79477.Name: Futurist Sentinel
79477.FlavorText:
"I folded a model in paper first to test the relative tensile strength of the plates."
—Katsumasa, the Animator

79478.Name: Go-Shintai of Lost Wisdom
79478.FlavorText: It seeks those driven by curiosity and offers enlightenment.

79481.Name: Living Breakthrough
79481.FlavorText:
"While they squabble below, let us rise above."
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists

79482.Name: Invoke the Winds
79482.FlavorText:
"Are you seriously telling me your heavy combat mech . . . blew away?"
—Risona, leader of the Asari Uprisers

79488.Name: Mnemonic Sphere
79488.FlavorText:
"Let the Imperials search our laboratories. Will they think to look for secrets in a pretty bauble?"
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists

79491.Name: Vector Glider
79491.FlavorText: It drifted from the spirit realm into a neon world full of new possibilities . . . and decided to stay.

79493.Name: Moonfolk Puzzlemaker
79493.FlavorText: "Research is hardly the dry, serious pastime outsiders make it out to be."

79496.Name: Network Disruptor
79496.FlavorText: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."

79497.Name: Planar Incision
79497.FlavorText: Jin-Gitaxias had long coveted the secrets of planeswalking. Spirits that could pass between worlds made for perfect test subjects.

79500.Name: Reality Heist
79500.FlavorText: Kaito grabbed the chip, hoping it held answers.

79501.Name: Replication Specialist
79501.FlavorText: "Step one is innovation. Step two is production. Sometimes step one is optional."

79502.Name: Saiba Trespassers
79502.FlavorText: One to clear the way, another to erase their trail.

79504.Name: Skyswimmer Koi
79504.FlavorText: Once they swam alone among the clouds, but now the people of Kamigawa have built high enough to reach them.

79505.Name: Spell Pierce
79505.FlavorText: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.

79506.Name: Suit Up
79506.FlavorText: With a reckless leap into the pilot's seat, Hirori went from smallest kid on the block to biggest hero in the city.

79510.Name: Thirst for Knowledge
79510.FlavorText: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."

79512.Name: Assassin's Ink
79512.FlavorText: A Reckoner always has another trick up their sleeve—or as their sleeve.

79516.Name: Clawing Torment
79516.FlavorText: A kami's anger never fades, never sleeps, never loosens its grasp.

79517.Name: Debt to the Kami
79517.FlavorText: The masters weren't speaking figuratively when they said guilt could be all-consuming.

79518.Name: Dockside Chef
79518.FlavorText: The squirming is how you know it's fresh.

79519.Name: Dokuchi Shadow-Walker
79519.FlavorText: Don't fear the blade, fear the shadows.

79522.Name: Go-Shintai of Hidden Cruelty
79522.FlavorText: It seeks those with hate in their hearts and offers vengeance.

79523.Name: Gravelighter
79523.FlavorText: It appears only to those whose lives are ending, welcoming them to their fate.

79525.Name: Inkrise Infiltrator
79525.FlavorText: "They can't follow your footprints if you never touch the ground."

79526.Name: Invoke Despair
79526.FlavorText: Although officials said it was a sewer failure, the people whispered that it was a warning of night's reach.

79528.Name: Kaito's Pursuit
79528.FlavorText: Kaito knew every rooftop in the city, and closed in quickly on his quarry—but he knew nothing of the Planar Bridge until it was already too late.

79530.Name: Kami of Terrible Secrets
79530.FlavorText: It feeds on things better left unknown, savoring the bitterness of lies and regrets.

79534.Name: Memory of Toshiro
79534.FlavorText:
"Some called him the hero of the Kami War, others a selfish thief. As ever, the truth is hidden somewhere in between."
—Reki, founder of the Living Historians

79536.Name: Animus of Night's Reach
79536.FlavorText: The dark myojin's gifts were instrumental in ending the Kami War.

79537.Name: Malicious Malfunction
79537.FlavorText:
"That? A minor test, nothing more. Incompleat flesh is weak."
—Jin-Gitaxias

79539.Name: Mukotai Ambusher
79539.FlavorText: The Mukotai Reckoners specialize in stealth and subterfuge.

79542.Name: Nezumi Bladeblesser
79542.FlavorText: "It's not one or the other, kami or technology. Both offer power. I will not limit myself."

79545.Name: Nezumi Road Captain
79545.FlavorText: United by defiant pride in their outsider status, the nezumi of the Okiba Reckoners boast the most advanced cyberbikes and the best riders of all the Reckoner gangs.

79546.Name: Okiba Salvage
79546.FlavorText: "Some fool would rather throw a whole mech away than repair one hydraulic actuator? It must be my lucky day."

79547.Name: Reckoner Shakedown
79547.FlavorText:
"That's a start. What else do you have for us?"
—Takumi, Reckoner enforcer

79548.Name: Reckoner's Bargain
79548.FlavorText: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair—the sacred, neutral meeting ground of all Reckoner gangs.

79549.Name: Return to Action
79549.FlavorText:
"You're hurt? Too bad. You stop fighting when I say, and not a moment sooner."
—Satoru Umezawa

79554.Name: Twisted Embrace
79554.FlavorText: Evil kami are drawn to mortals who share their grim fascinations.

79555.Name: Undercity Scrounger
79555.FlavorText: "That will pay for another arm extension all by itself! Well, as long as it doesn't explode."

79557.Name: Virus Beetle
79557.FlavorText:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

79558.Name: You Are Already Dead
79558.FlavorText: So swift and sharp was his blade that the ogre never even felt the cut.

79560.Name: Akki Ronin
79560.FlavorText:
"Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade."
—Keni-Keni, akki smith

79561.Name: Akki War Paint
79561.FlavorText: Akki paint bright, bold designs on their salvaged Imperial mechs, leaving no doubt as to who they belong to now.

79562.Name: Ambitious Assault
79562.FlavorText: In the clangor and chaos of the akki attack, few even noticed the frogs on their heads.

79565.Name: Crackling Emergence
79565.FlavorText: The transition from spiritual to material is sometimes as shocking as it is beautiful.

79568.Name: Explosive Entry
79568.FlavorText: Kaito and Tamiyo charged headlong into Jin-Gitaxias's secret lab, unaware that the praetor was eagerly awaiting their arrival.

79571.Name: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
79571.FlavorText: Blessed by Keiga, the Tide Star, Kiki-Jiki would one day master the art of duplication.

79572.Name: Flame Discharge
79572.FlavorText: "What? Why would it need a cooling unit?"

79574.Name: Go-Shintai of Ancient Wars
79574.FlavorText: It seeks those consumed with rage and offers burning blades.

79576.Name: Heiko Yamazaki, the General
79576.FlavorText: "I prefer to let my sword do the talking."

79578.Name: Ironhoof Boar
79578.FlavorText:
"I'm glad she can run again, but this might have been a bit much."
—Kenji, Sokenzan artisan

79579.Name: Kami of Industry
79579.FlavorText: It takes many arms to arm an army.

79580.Name: Kami's Flare
79580.FlavorText: "The flames are a gift from my companion. They won't hurt me. You, on the other hand . . ."

79581.Name: Kindled Fury
79581.FlavorText: The only thing better than hitting hard is hitting first.

79583.Name: Etching of Kumano
79583.FlavorText: Many kami came to demand a secret he did not know, and every one of them fell.

79587.Name: Peerless Samurai
79587.FlavorText: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."

79590.Name: Scrap Welder
79590.FlavorText: "This big metal guy will make some amazing wind chimes!"

79591.Name: Scrapyard Steelbreaker
79591.FlavorText: "You've got about three seconds to get out of here before you get a faceful of metal."

79592.Name: Seismic Wave
79592.FlavorText: "Step carefully, Imperial. Even the earth rises against you."

79594.Name: Nameless Conqueror
79594.FlavorText:
"In the wake of the Kami War, Kamigawa descended into a state of constant warfare. Even with Kyodai's wisdom guiding them, it took the first Imperials decades of work and bloodshed to subdue the clans and bring peace to the land."
—History of the Empire

79596.Name: Sokenzan Smelter
79596.FlavorText: Among the artisans of Sokenzan City, reusing every scrap of metal is a point of pride.

79597.Name: Tempered in Solitude
79597.FlavorText: Many master samurai make pilgrimages deep into the Sokenzan Mountains, where they train and meditate in silence, hoping to commune with a lava kami.

79599.Name: Towashi Songshaper
79599.FlavorText: Most Uprisers augment their bodies for speed, strength, or protection, but a few just want to be one with the music.

79600.Name: Twinshot Sniper
79600.FlavorText: "Pierce the heart and pierce the head, even the mightiest fall down dead."

79601.Name: Unstoppable Ogre
79601.FlavorText: Touma never met a door he didn't hate.

79602.Name: Upriser Renegade
79602.FlavorText: "My streets, my rules. You picked the wrong neighborhood for a fight."

79605.Name: Likeness of the Seeker
79605.FlavorText:
"I ask for nothing more than a new journey and a fresh path to greet my feet when I wake each morning."
—Azusa

79606.Name: Bamboo Grove Archer
79606.FlavorText: "Do not mistake tranquility for domestication. This land is wild, and will always remain so."

79607.Name: Bearer of Memory
79607.FlavorText: Members of the Living Historians don't simply chronicle the past; they embody it.

79609.Name: Boon of Boseiju
79609.FlavorText: She closed her eyes and remembered the smell of the leaves of Jukai Forest. When she opened them, the buildings of Towashi had grown small.

79611.Name: Branch of Boseiju
79611.FlavorText: Though they razed the surrounding forest, the builders of Towashi left Boseiju unscathed, shaping the city around the ancient tree.

79614.Name: Commune with Spirits
79614.FlavorText: The kami of Jukai Forest accept only the most respectful petitioners.

79617.Name: Fade into Antiquity
79617.FlavorText:
"Memories fade and wither with time. If we do not nurture the garden of history, we may once more wander blindly through barren lands."
—Reki, founder of the Living Historians

79618.Name: Fang of Shigeki
79618.FlavorText:
"Let me give you a taste of the poison you've poured into our land."
—Shigeki, founder of the Order of Jukai

79619.Name: Favor of Jukai
79619.FlavorText: The land chooses its own champions.

79620.Name: Generous Visitor
79620.FlavorText: It is said that one must modestly refuse a gift three times before accepting it to show humility before the kami.

79621.Name: Geothermal Kami
79621.FlavorText: A mysterious kami will sometimes appear to overworked monks and offer them a warm, relaxing bath.

79622.Name: Go-Shintai of Boundless Vigor
79622.FlavorText: It seeks those with untamed spirits and offers wild strength.

79624.Name: Greater Tanuki
79624.FlavorText: The kami permit few mortals to dwell in Jukai Forest, but the clever, playful tanuki are welcomed as friends and guardians.

79625.Name: Harmonious Emergence
79625.FlavorText: Where the spirit and mortal realms overlap, the laws of reality are rewritten.

79626.Name: Heir of the Ancient Fang
79626.FlavorText: On the last day of a Jukai agent's training, they are bequeathed a powerful relic blessed by the kami.

79628.Name: Invoke the Ancients
79628.FlavorText: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.

79631.Name: Jukai Preserver
79631.FlavorText: "The kami grant you this boon, not I."

79632.Name: Jukai Trainee
79632.FlavorText: "The Order of Jukai accepts only the strongest of body and spirit. I will train until I meet their expectations."

79638.Name: Master's Rebuke
79638.FlavorText: "You have always been a promising student, but your arrogance far outstrips your prowess."

79639.Name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
79639.FlavorText: One day the spirit and mortal realms will be one. Until then, she faithfully guards the sites where they merge.

79641.Name: Season of Renewal
79641.FlavorText: Pavement ripped like paper as the ancient kami awoke from her long slumber beneath the city.

79643.Name: Spinning Wheel Kick
79643.FlavorText: Members of the Order of Jukai commune with kami to enhance their martial prowess.

79647.Name: Seshiro's Living Legacy
79647.FlavorText:
"In times of strife, the foolish make a fist while the wise make a friend."
—First Address of Seshiro the Anointed as Broodmaster of the Orochi Colonies

79648.Name: Tamiyo's Safekeeping
79648.FlavorText: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.

79655.Name: Eiganjo Uprising
79655.FlavorText: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.

79656.Name: Enthusiastic Mechanaut
79656.FlavorText: "Greetings, fellow inventors!" the akki shouted, attempting a friendly smile. To her dismay, the greeting was met only with shrieks and alarms being activated.

79658.Name: Greasefang, Okiba Boss
79658.FlavorText: It's hard to say which is more deadly: her bike or her bite.

79659.Name: Hidetsugu Consumes All
79659.RawFrameDetail: BR gold saga front side TDFC

79660.Name: Vessel of the All-Consuming
79660.RawFrameDetail: BR gold Nyx back side TDFC

79663.Name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
79663.FlavorText: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

79664.Name: Jukai Naturalist
79664.FlavorText: He had heard rumors of the cities—the constant noise, the stagnant air, the tainted water—and he had no wish to learn if they were true.

79666.Name: The Kami War
79666.RawFrameDetail: Z gold saga front side TDFC

79667.Name: O-Kagachi Made Manifest
79667.RawFrameDetail: Z gold Nyx back side TDFC

79669.Name: Naomi, Pillar of Order
79669.FlavorText: "Progress comes only when we rise above our petty quarrels."

79672.Name: Raiyuu, Storm's Edge
79672.FlavorText: "The tempest is the only ally I need."

79679.Name: Automated Artificer
79679.FlavorText:
"I sometimes watch them build more of their kind and wonder: Will there come a day when they no longer need us?"
—Saku, Futurist technician

79680.Name: Bronze Cudgels
79680.FlavorText:
"These were made when Michiko was young. Wield them wisely."
—Chiyoko, Jukai elder

79681.Name: Brute Suit
79681.FlavorText:
"Send them a message they can't ignore."
—Satoru Umezawa

79682.Name: Circuit Mender
79682.FlavorText: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

79683.Name: Containment Construct
79683.FlavorText: Automated units are deployed to stabilize merge sites deemed too dangerous even for trained intercessors.

79684.Name: Dramatist's Puppet
79684.FlavorText:
"Who cares if the story's true as long as people are entertained?"
—Shin, Towashi street performer

79688.Name: Iron Apprentice
79688.FlavorText:
"I needed an extra set of hands, so I built one."
—Kenji, Sokenzan artisan

79691.Name: Network Terminal
79691.FlavorText: Public access terminals around Towashi provide residents with up-to-date information on everything from traffic delays to hostile kami sightings.

79692.Name: Ninja's Kunai
79692.FlavorText: A point to pierce flesh and spirit alike.

79693.Name: Papercraft Decoy
79693.FlavorText:
"And what, precisely, was so important that you left the entrance unguarded?"
—Fumika, Imperial enforcer

79694.Name: Patchwork Automaton
79694.FlavorText: It dwells happily near the ever-burning forges of Sokenzan City, crafting small things of beauty from discarded scraps.

79697.Name: Runaway Trash-Bot
79697.FlavorText: One day it might roll over your foot, the next day your entire house.

79698.Name: Searchlight Companion
79698.FlavorText: The merging of the spirit and material realms has resulted in some unusual friendships.

79699.Name: Shrine Steward
79699.FlavorText: From broken swords, the first Imperials forged a peaceful servant to tend the shrines of Eiganjo.

79701.Name: Thundersteel Colossus
79701.FlavorText:
"This is what I needed all that alloy for."
—Arima, to Emire

79712.Name: Roadside Reliquary
79712.FlavorText: Travelers who leave an offering may pass freely through the forest kami's domain.

79721.Name: Uncharted Haven
79721.FlavorText: Untouched by mortal or kami, unspoiled by their wars.

79748.Name: Construct
79748.RawFrameDetail: R artifact token, has text box

79755.Name: Keimi
79755.RawFrameDetail: BG token legendary, has text box

79756.Name: Mechtitan
79756.RawFrameDetail: Z gold token legendary artifact, has text box

79758.RawFrameDetail: A token legendary, has text box

79836.ArtistCredit: あんべ よしろう/YOSHIRO AMBE

79880.ArtistCredit: 壱子みるく亭/ichiko milk tei

79885.Name: Swords to Plowshares
79885.FlavorText: He stood transfixed, able to do nothing but ponder a life of peace and redemption. It was the worst five minutes of his life.

79886.Name: Opt
79886.FlavorText: The choice isn't whether to eat, but when to stop.

79888.Name: Anger of the Gods
79888.FlavorText: Eating those clerics might have been a bad idea.

79889.Name: Explore
79889.FlavorText: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possible meals.

79892.Name: Craterhoof Behemoth
79892.FlavorText: It loves to eat all things crispy, crunchy, and cheddar-flavored.

79893.Name: Craterhoof Behemoth
79893.FlavorText: It loves to eat all things crispy, crunchy, and cheddar-flavored.

79900.Name: Zilortha, Strength Incarnate
79900.FlavorText:
"Many thought they knew its weakness. They are dead."
—Kelsien, the Plague

79908.Name: Captain Eberhart
79908.FlavorText:
"The Captain's seen it all. Most of it bad."
—Lieutenant Traken

79925.Name: Oglor, Devoted Assistant
79925.FlavorText:
"Carefully, Oglor. I'd prefer not to waste time reviving you again."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

79933.Name: Gutmorn, Pactbound Servant
79933.FlavorText: For the right price, he's willing to serve. Just don't talk to him about tea.

79958.Name: Ishkanah, Broodmother
79958.FlavorText: As werewolves, vampires, and humans contend for power, Ishkanah builds her own army in the shadows.

80145.Name: Snow-Covered Plains
80145.RawFrameDetail: W basic snow Plains, no text box

80146.Name: Snow-Covered Island
80146.RawFrameDetail: U basic snow Island, no text box

80147.Name: Snow-Covered Swamp
80147.RawFrameDetail: B basic snow Swamp, no text box

80148.Name: Snow-Covered Mountain
80148.RawFrameDetail: R basic snow Mountain, no text box

80149.Name: Snow-Covered Forest
80149.RawFrameDetail: G basic snow Forest, no text box

80152.Name: Angelic Observer
80152.FlavorText: Still and solemn as the statues of her kind that decorated the Park Heights rooftops, she gazed in sorrow on the city below.

80153.Name: Backup Agent
80153.FlavorText: "My sources say the Beamtown Bullies were spotted in the Mezzio. Keep your eyes sharp and stay close to me."

80154.Name: Ballroom Brawlers
80154.FlavorText: Don't try to cut in. They'll cut back.

80155.Name: Boon of Safety
80155.FlavorText:
"Saving a stranger's life is an excellent recruitment method. Luckily, peril is so easy to come by."
—Falco Spara

80156.Name: Brokers Initiate
80156.FlavorText: Regarding the relative might of pen and sword, the official position of the Brokers is "Why choose?"

80157.Name: Buy Your Silence
80157.FlavorText: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

80158.Name: Celebrity Fencer
80158.FlavorText: After a brief but memorable incident at her first performance, she was never heckled again.

80160.Name: Dapper Shieldmate
80160.FlavorText: Descended from Old Capenna's paladins, the Brokers are masters of defensive combat.

80161.Name: Depopulate
80161.FlavorText: No screams rang out. No blood stained the streets. In an instant, the bustling metropolis simply fell silent.

80164.Name: Gathering Throng
80164.FlavorText: A plus-one is simply not enough.

80165.Name: Giada, Font of Hope
80165.FlavorText: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

80167.Name: Hold for Ransom
80167.FlavorText:
"Let's find out how much your friends think you're worth."
—Gino, hired kidnapper

80168.Name: Illuminator Virtuoso
80168.FlavorText: The Obscura reserve their keenest blades for traitors in their midst.

80169.Name: Inspiring Overseer
80169.FlavorText:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

80170.Name: Kill Shot
80170.FlavorText:
"In the assassination trade, no one lives to make more than one mistake."
—Anhelo, the Painter

80171.Name: Knockout Blow
80171.FlavorText: "Subsequent efforts to deconstruct this facility will be punished with increasing severity."

80172.Name: Mage's Attendant
80172.FlavorText: Crime sometimes makes unlikely allies into lifelong friends.

80174.Name: Patch Up
80174.FlavorText: "Don't tell me who sent you or who you work for. The less I know, the better."

80177.Name: Raffine's Informant
80177.FlavorText: "I've analyzed the vault schematic. Do you want the fast way, the easy way, or the secret way in?"

80178.Name: Refuse to Yield
80178.FlavorText: Her opponent threw her through the window, so she retaliated by throwing the window through her opponent.

80179.Name: Revelation of Power
80179.FlavorText: As Ob Nixilis closed in, Halo swept through Giada like an electrical current, and inside her, something long dormant unfurled its wings.

80180.Name: Rumor Gatherer
80180.FlavorText: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

80182.Name: Sky Crier
80182.FlavorText: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"

80183.Name: Speakeasy Server
80183.FlavorText: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."

80186.Name: Backstreet Bruiser
80186.FlavorText: "I could show you what's in the case, but it'd be the last thing you ever see."

80187.Name: Brokers Veteran
80187.FlavorText: One last job before he retires.

80188.Name: Case the Joint
80188.FlavorText: Steel doors and iron bars are child's play for an Obscura operative.

80190.Name: Disdainful Stroke
80190.FlavorText:
"I've known for a year that you would cast this exact spell, at this exact spot, at this exact time."
—Raffine

80191.Name: Echo Inspector
80191.FlavorText: The rendezvous took place hours ago, but the Obscura agent read the residue with ease.

80192.Name: Errant, Street Artist
80192.FlavorText: Few know her face, but everyone knows her work.

80193.Name: Even the Score
80193.FlavorText: Those who try to rob the Obscura often leave behind more than they take away.

80194.Name: Expendable Lackey
80194.FlavorText:
"Altonio? No, I'm sorry. No one by that name works here."
—Raffine

80195.Name: Faerie Vandal
80195.FlavorText: "Greedy vault guard, wouldn't share. Now there's Halo in your hair!"

80196.Name: Hypnotic Grifter
80196.FlavorText: "All is calm. All is well. You know me to be a trusted member of your family, and I would like to discuss the contents of our safe."

80199.Name: Majestic Metamorphosis
80199.FlavorText: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

80201.Name: Obscura Initiate
80201.FlavorText: Obscura initiates are required to bring a gift of information. They are judged on both how useful it is and how hard it was to obtain.

80202.Name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
80202.FlavorText: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.

80204.Name: Psionic Snoop
80204.FlavorText: She knows your next move before you do.

80206.Name: Public Enemy
80206.FlavorText: Every Halo smuggler walks a razor's edge between untold riches and sudden disaster.

80209.Name: Run Out of Town
80209.FlavorText: Better to depart in haste than be dearly departed.

80211.Name: Sewer Crocodile
80211.FlavorText:
"Quick, let's hide in the sewer!"
—Ginsi the Thief, now deceased

80218.Name: Angel of Suffering
80218.FlavorText: "If you wish for blessings, mortal, ask your demon masters. We've given enough to your kind."

80221.Name: Corrupt Court Official
80221.FlavorText:
"I wouldn't call what they have here a justice system. More like an auction."
—Elspeth

80222.Name: Crooked Custodian
80222.FlavorText: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."

80223.Name: Cut of the Profits
80223.FlavorText: Everybody is worth their weight in gold.

80224.Name: Cutthroat Contender
80224.FlavorText: The fights may sometimes be rigged, but the front-row spectators know the wounds are real.

80225.Name: Deal Gone Bad
80225.FlavorText:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus

80226.Name: Demon's Due
80226.FlavorText: Ob Nixilis extends his hand not in partnership, but to affirm your subservience.

80232.Name: Graveyard Shift
80232.FlavorText: "Up and at 'em, buddy. We've got more work to do."

80234.Name: Illicit Shipment
80234.FlavorText: Whatever the Maestros had ordered, it wasn't anyone's business, including his.

80235.Name: Incriminate
80235.FlavorText:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator

80237.Name: Maestros Initiate
80237.FlavorText:
"How far are you willing to go for your family, cleanblade?"
—Lord Xander

80238.Name: Midnight Assassin
80238.FlavorText: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.

80239.Name: Murder
80239.FlavorText: Ob Nixilis decided the fastest way to seize control of New Capenna would be to usurp the networks of power already hidden there. Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

80243.Name: Rogues' Gallery
80243.FlavorText: Between the five of them, they'd committed every crime on the books and invented a few new ones.

80245.Name: Shadow of Mortality
80245.FlavorText:
"Build your towers as tall as you want. The shadow always reaches higher."
—Message scrawled on an alley wall

80246.Name: Shakedown Heavy
80246.FlavorText: "Look, we both get what we want. I get your Halo. You get to keep your kneecaps."

80247.Name: Tavern Swindler
80247.FlavorText: "Only a chump stops after one unlucky loss. You're not a chump, are you?"

80249.Name: Vampire Scrivener
80249.FlavorText: No one remains on her list for long.

80251.Name: Antagonize
80251.FlavorText:
"The little guy had guts at least. You can see 'em right there between those cobbles."
—Glunk, freelance crusher

80253.Name: Big Score
80253.FlavorText: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a vivid imagination."

80254.Name: Call In a Professional
80254.FlavorText: For the next week, Park Heights smelled of burnt oil paint and brimstone.

80255.Name: Daring Escape
80255.FlavorText: As the Adversary's forces descended upon the gala, Elspeth whispered to Giada, "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."

80256.Name: Devilish Valet
80256.FlavorText: Nobody thought twice about checking their weapons at the door, until they were informed there was no weapon check at the door.

80258.Name: Glittering Stockpile
80258.FlavorText: The only thing Ziatora desires is "more."

80259.Name: Goldhound
80259.FlavorText: The staccato clatter of its metal claws on pavement is unmistakable.

80269.Name: Pyre-Sledge Arsonist
80269.FlavorText: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.

80270.Name: Ready to Rumble
80270.FlavorText:
"It's too quiet tonight. Go make trouble."
—Ziatora

80271.Name: Riveteers Initiate
80271.FlavorText: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.

80273.Name: Rob the Archives
80273.FlavorText: "Well, I guess stealth's out of the question."

80276.Name: Strangle
80276.FlavorText: They'd warned him greed would be the death of him. He never thought to take it literally.

80277.Name: Structural Assault
80277.FlavorText: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.

80279.Name: Unlucky Witness
80279.FlavorText: The guard took a midnight shift to earn a promotion. Unfortunately, so did the assassin.

80282.Name: Witty Roastmaster
80282.FlavorText: If you're lucky, you'll walk out with just your ego singed.

80283.Name: Wrecking Crew
80283.FlavorText: They built the neighborhood. They know its weak points. They know all the hiding places. When they come for you, they'll find you and bring the roof down on your head.

80285.Name: Bootleggers' Stash
80285.FlavorText: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.

80287.Name: Broken Wings
80287.FlavorText: New Capenna's demonic masters are quick to extinguish any hint of the angels' power reawakening.

80288.Name: Cabaretti Initiate
80288.FlavorText:
"Now there's a fellow who knows how to have a good time!"
—Jetmir

80291.Name: Civic Gardener
80291.FlavorText: "I've told you knuckleheads a hundred times: You can kill 'em here, but bury the bodies somewhere else. If you disturb my prized azaleas again, you'd better dig a second hole for yourself!"

80294.Name: Elegant Entourage
80294.FlavorText: "Terribly sorry, but this is a private party, and your name isn't on the list."

80295.Name: Evolving Door
80295.FlavorText: In with the old, out with the new.

80297.Name: For the Family
80297.FlavorText: The Cabaretti cultivate an image of harmless hedonism, happy for the other families to underestimate their formidable firepower.

80298.Name: Freelance Muscle
80298.FlavorText: He never asks why. Just who, when, and where.

80300.Name: Glittermonger
80300.FlavorText: Street corners in the Mezzio are a tantalizing bazaar of the fantastic, the illicit, and the fake.

80301.Name: High-Rise Sawjack
80301.FlavorText: Slicing girders, rescuing trapped workers, killing gigantic rust flies—one tool does it all!

80302.Name: Jewel Thief
80302.FlavorText: "They can afford the loss. They build it into their prices."

80303.Name: Luxurious Libation
80303.FlavorText:
"Crisp, flavorful, and energizing. Perhaps the most elegant offering of Halo in Park Heights. Five stars."
—Conzuelo, restaurant critic

80304.Name: Most Wanted
80304.FlavorText: Overnight, Elspeth was branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.

80306.Name: Rhox Pummeler
80306.FlavorText: When all you have is a warhammer, every face looks like a nail.

80307.Name: Riveteers Decoy
80307.FlavorText: He keeps the heat off his allies—by drawing it all to himself.

80308.Name: Social Climber
80308.FlavorText: "It's all about who you know, darling. And now you're lucky enough to know me."

80309.Name: Take to the Streets
80309.FlavorText: No institution, however grand, can withstand the collective will of the people.

80315.Name: Warm Welcome
80315.FlavorText: "Welcome to the family. Chef Rocco sends their congratulations."

80318.Name: Black Market Tycoon
80318.FlavorText: "I have exactly what you need. The question is, how badly do you need it?"

80319.Name: Body Dropper
80319.FlavorText: "Kill count? I lost track years ago."

80320.Name: Brazen Upstart
80320.FlavorText: "Trust me, you want to deal with me. My associates are much less pleasant."

80321.Name: Brokers Ascendancy
80321.FlavorText: "This is the beginning of a beautiful friendship. And more importantly, a profitable one. Now sign here."

80323.Name: Cabaretti Ascendancy
80323.FlavorText: "Whatever you're looking for—food, family, Halo—we've got the best in town."

80326.Name: Ceremonial Groundbreaker
80326.FlavorText: Construction in New Capenna is imbued with tradition and ritual.

80327.Name: Civil Servant
80327.FlavorText: "Together we can build a safer, brighter New Capenna!"

80328.Name: Cormela, Glamour Thief
80328.FlavorText: She sees the world as a gift meant for her.

80329.Name: Corpse Appraiser
80329.FlavorText: "Scarcely a mark. A true work of art!"

80330.Name: Corpse Explosion
80330.FlavorText:
"Well, that's one way to scatter her ashes."
—Calvey, funeral director

80331.Name: Crew Captain
80331.FlavorText: The Riveteers are as good at raising buildings as they are at razing them.

80332.Name: Darling of the Masses
80332.FlavorText: The people flocked to the glittering parade, turning their backs on the threats in the shadows.

80333.Name: Disciplined Duelist
80333.FlavorText: Brokers agents defend their charges by all means available, from intricate logic to blunt force trauma.

80334.Name: Endless Detour
80334.FlavorText: After diverting around the eleventh construction barrier, the taxi driver began to suspect she was being herded into a trap.

80336.Name: Exotic Pets
80336.FlavorText: Investigators observed that Altonio's beloved fish were thriving after his disappearance.

80339.Name: Fleetfoot Dancer
80339.FlavorText: The Vanto Beatdown began as an improvised dance-battle at the Rose Room lounge. When word spread of how many were slain at the first event, it became a citywide obsession.

80340.Name: Forge Boss
80340.FlavorText: "Big furnace like this can reduce anything to ash. You got something you need reduced to ash?"

80342.Name: Hostile Takeover
80342.FlavorText: Ob Nixilis smiled. It had been over one thousand years since his last conquest.

80343.Name: Incandescent Aria
80343.FlavorText: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute. When the room fell silent, she was surrounded only by rose petals falling gently to the floor.

80345.Name: Jetmir's Fixer
80345.FlavorText: When you lose Jetmir's trust, his family makes sure you lose everything else.

80346.Name: Jinnie Fay, Jetmir's Second
80346.FlavorText: She watches Jetmir's back while her companions watch hers.

80351.Name: Maestros Diabolist
80351.FlavorText: "Where did I find my horned friend? Now there's a story worth telling. . . ."

80353.Name: Meeting of the Five
80353.FlavorText: For years, the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace, and the city prospered.

80354.Name: Metropolis Angel
80354.FlavorText:
"Angels are living proof that power does not always lead to corruption."
—Elspeth

80355.Name: Mr. Orfeo, the Boulder
80355.FlavorText: Once he was jumped by a dozen Maestros agents. You can still see their imprints in the pavement if you know where to look.

80361.Name: Ognis, the Dragon's Lash
80361.FlavorText: Ziatora's second-in-command has a habit of appearing when and where her enemies least expect her.

80362.Name: Park Heights Pegasus
80362.FlavorText: The burglar turned, bowed, and dropped from the ledge onto her waiting mount.

80363.Name: Queza, Augur of Agonies
80363.FlavorText: Some try to unravel the tangled skeins of fate. She reweaves them to her own deadly design.

80367.Name: Riveteers Ascendancy
80367.FlavorText: "We are this city, down to its bones."

80369.Name: Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer
80369.FlavorText: They wouldn't admit it, but some people join the Cabaretti just for the food.

80371.Name: Security Rhox
80371.FlavorText: Unlucky assassins find out why he's called "Brick Wall" Balzano.

80374.Name: Soul of Emancipation
80374.FlavorText: Light poured from every crack as the sleepers awoke from their long stone slumber.

80377.Name: Syndicate Infiltrator
80377.FlavorText: The mansion's vaulted ceilings provided the perfect cover for an ambush.

80378.Name: Tainted Indulgence
80378.FlavorText: Their toast to good health went immediately, horribly awry.

80381.Name: Void Rend
80381.FlavorText: Bits of the missing agent were discovered in various alleys across all three boroughs.

80384.Name: Arc Spitter
80384.FlavorText: "I'm fresh out of mercy today. Why don't you ask Sparky here for forgiveness?"

80387.Name: Chrome Cat
80387.FlavorText:
"I always say, ‘If it's breathing, it's lying.' Luckily my friend here does neither."
—Lord Xander

80388.Name: Getaway Car
80388.FlavorText: For those who need to make a quick departure without attracting undue attention.

80390.Name: Halo Scarab
80390.FlavorText: It pulses with the colors that best complement the wearer's outfit.

80392.Name: Ominous Parcel
80392.FlavorText: The rest of Anhelo's assistant arrived over the following week.

80393.Name: Paragon of Modernity
80393.FlavorText: No true angels have been created since the founding of New Capenna, but artisans have learned to craft elegant facsimiles.

80395.Name: Scuttling Butler
80395.FlavorText: Porter, cleaner, and bouncer all in one.

80396.Name: Suspicious Bookcase
80396.FlavorText: The great library in the Museum of Old Capenna has a million volumes on display—and miles of passages hidden behind them.

80398.Name: Botanical Plaza
80398.FlavorText: Public parks are a favored meeting spot for those considering a shift in allegiance.

80399.Name: Brokers Hideout
80399.FlavorText: Once the witness was inside, the safe house vanished first from sight, then from memory.

80400.Name: Cabaretti Courtyard
80400.FlavorText: So long as the Halo keeps flowing, the festivities never end.

80401.Name: Jetmir's Garden
80401.FlavorText: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.

80402.Name: Maestros Theater
80402.FlavorText: Only extraordinary performers are invited to grace the grandest stage in New Capenna.

80403.Name: Obscura Storefront
80403.FlavorText: In volatile times, a sense of certainty is in high demand.

80404.Name: Racers' Ring
80404.FlavorText: Purchasing chrome racehorses with cash is a common means of dispersing mysterious income.

80405.Name: Raffine's Tower
80405.FlavorText: The Obscura's Cloud Spire dominates the skyline, its eye a beacon of progress that sees all.

80406.Name: Riveteers Overlook
80406.FlavorText: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.

80407.Name: Skybridge Towers
80407.FlavorText: New Capenna's districts are a series of tiers; wealth and power always rise to the top.

80408.Name: Spara's Headquarters
80408.FlavorText: To most, the Nido Sanctuary is an office complex. To the Brokers, it's a vault of secrets.

80409.Name: Tramway Station
80409.FlavorText: A ten-minute ride can take you to the luxury of Park Heights, or the grit of the Caldaia.

80410.Name: Waterfront District
80410.FlavorText: The bottom of the dark canals is littered with countless corpses and treasures.

80411.Name: Xander's Lounge
80411.FlavorText: Maestros agents can lie low in high style at the opulent Shadow Hostel.

80412.Name: Ziatora's Proving Ground
80412.FlavorText: Restless Riveteers can always find a sparring partner in the sprawling Treza warehouse.

80453.Name: Jaxis, the Troublemaker
80453.RawFrameDetail: R legendary, HI text box (Red_Riveteers) mark

80472.Name: Ob Nixilis, the Adversary
80472.RawFrameDetail: alt BR gold planeswalker, 4 abilities PST_FE

80547.Name: Angelic Gift
80547.FlavorText: "Zendikar will triumph this day, and our armies will fly with angels."

80839.Name: Day of Judgment
80839.FlavorText:
"This must not become common knowledge. The consequences of such a spell are too great. Lock it away in the restricted archive, and destroy its record in the catalog."
—Director Taiva, to Isabough

80840.Name: Counterspell
80840.FlavorText:
"One need not know the specific details of a spell to suppress its effect. Simply rearrange the rules of the reality within which the spell operates."
—Imbraham, Quandrix dean

80841.Name: Time Warp
80841.FlavorText:
"Chronomancers have a rather different definition of living in the moment."
—The Millennium Tome

80842.Name: Demonic Tutor
80842.FlavorText:
"Demons prefer to deal with those who believe themselves too wise to be fooled."
—Scroll case inscription

80843.Name: Doom Blade
80843.FlavorText:
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest."
—Ob Nixilis

80844.Name: Claim the Firstborn
80844.FlavorText:
"Will! They have a copy of Tales of the Fae here! Want me to read you a bedtime story?"
—Rowan Kenrith

80845.Name: Lightning Bolt
80845.FlavorText:
"The first mages witnessed the fury of the raging storm and wished to answer back."
—The Stormwright Texts

80846.Name: Krosan Grip
80846.FlavorText:
"On a world where time was torn asunder, destruction ruled the minds of all."
—Multiversal Metahistories

80847.Name: Regrowth
80847.FlavorText:
"Centuries of war had broken Arcavios, but a single seed began the long process of renewal."
—The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells

80848.Name: Despark
80848.FlavorText:
"A tale of a tyrant being humiliated and losing all his power? I'm inspired already!"
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student

80849.Name: Electrolyze
80849.FlavorText:
"The hydraulic power grip was a failure, but the gauntlets were a shocking success."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus

80850.Name: Growth Spiral
80850.FlavorText:
"I've gleaned greater insight from the spiraling of a single fern than I have from all the books I've ever read."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

80851.Name: Lightning Helix
80851.FlavorText:
"Mages in the Blood Age would call down actual thunderstorms on their enemies. I bet we can replicate their technique."
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student

80852.Name: Putrefy
80852.FlavorText:
"From monarch to mulch as quick as could be."
—The Dethroner's Grimoire

80862.Name: Stormfront Pegasus
80862.FlavorText: Its hooves touch the earth only when a hero must rise.

80863.Name: Swords to Plowshares
80863.FlavorText: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

80865.Name: Kraken Hatchling
80865.FlavorText: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

80866.Name: Ponder
80866.FlavorText: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

80867.Name: Dark Ritual
80867.FlavorText:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

80868.Name: Duress
80868.FlavorText:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

80870.Name: Reassembling Skeleton
80870.FlavorText:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

80871.Name: Assault Strobe
80871.FlavorText: When breaking someone's face once just isn't enough.

80873.Name: Shivan Dragon
80873.FlavorText: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

80874.Name: Fog
80874.FlavorText: It's hard enough to find your way through uncharted wilderness when you can see the tip of your nose.

80876.Name: Regal Force
80876.FlavorText: It rarely moves, standing stock still in its clearing. When it does stir, ravens stop their cawing and crickets their chirping. All of nature watches in awed silence.

80898.Name: Expanded Anatomy
80898.FlavorText: "Changing the equation from incremental to exponential was a stroke of genius on my part."

80899.Name: All That Glitters
80899.FlavorText: A faerie's glee at her trove quickly fades to contentment, then to boredom, then to an urge to steal more.

80900.Name: Angelic Exaltation
80900.FlavorText:
"If we cannot have peace, we will have justice."
—Aurelia

80901.Name: Anointed Procession
80901.FlavorText:
"The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them."
—Gideon Jura

80902.Name: Authority of the Consuls
80902.FlavorText: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

80903.Name: Banishing Light
80903.FlavorText:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—The Theriad

80905.Name: Bounty Agent
80905.FlavorText: "Lately I've seen the biggest bounties of my career—and for the biggest names."

80906.Name: Bring to Trial
80906.FlavorText: "In you go, big guy. Watch your head."

80907.Name: Cathars' Crusade
80907.FlavorText: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

80909.Name: Collar the Culprit
80909.FlavorText:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

80910.Name: Compulsory Rest
80910.FlavorText: The pain of death is nothing compared to the pain of failure.

80911.Name: Divine Visitation
80911.FlavorText: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

80912.Name: Duelist's Heritage
80912.FlavorText: The best techniques outlive their creators.

80913.Name: Expel
80913.FlavorText: Quintorius was a daydreamer, far happier digging through history books than practicing battle tactics. He agreed with the military academy on only one thing: he did not belong in their ranks.

80916.Name: Glass Casket
80916.FlavorText: Fate will decide whether it's a bed or a tomb.

80917.Name: Glorious Anthem
80917.FlavorText: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

80919.Name: Iron Verdict
80919.FlavorText: "You'll raid nothing but mist in Istfell."

80920.Name: Luminous Bonds
80920.FlavorText: "Your part in this fight is done, vampire. Get used to your thirst."

80921.Name: Outflank
80921.FlavorText:
"With the drum of hooves and a flash of blades, the monster's terrifying roar changed to a cry of fear."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights

80922.Name: Raise the Alarm
80922.FlavorText: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

80923.Name: Reprobation
80923.FlavorText: There was a time all craven beasts cowered before Avacyn's divine might.

80924.Name: Seal Away
80924.FlavorText: An ancient nemesis rendered harmless long ago.

80925.Name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
80925.FlavorText: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

80927.Name: Summary Judgment
80927.FlavorText: Any challenge to Azorius authority is met with swift and potent retribution.

80928.Name: Suntail Hawk
80928.FlavorText:
"They are the finest companions in the realm. Swift, clever, and easily trained to hunt intruders."
—Almira, falconer

80929.Name: Teleportation Circle
80929.FlavorText:
"Hold on to your lunch!"
—Bartleby, gnome wizard

80931.Name: Fleet Swallower
80931.FlavorText: "Captain, I think that island is following us."

80932.Name: Moat Piranhas
80932.FlavorText:
"Come on, it's not even that deep!"
—Gorin the Brazen

80933.Name: Mystic Skyfish
80933.FlavorText: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

80935.Name: Patrician Geist
80935.FlavorText: He rides in agitated circles, snapping orders at servants who've long since found their peace.

80937.Name: Riptide Turtle
80937.FlavorText:
"As the storm waves crushed my sailors, I cried out to Thassa. The next time I saw them, hard shells encased them, and they swam away to safety."
—Siona, captain of the Pyleas

80938.Name: Ruin Crab
80938.FlavorText: To an explorer, a priceless treasure. To the crab, a rock to call home.

80940.Name: Serpent of Yawning Depths
80940.FlavorText:
"Gleams like moonlight on water drew us through the storm and toward our doom."
—Siona, captain of the Pyleas

80941.Name: Shipwreck Sifters
80941.FlavorText: A loyal crew sticks together, even after death.

80942.Name: Sigiled Starfish
80942.FlavorText: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

80944.Name: Steelclad Spirit
80944.FlavorText: Some geists imitate the lives they left behind. Others follow the dreams they never realized.

80946.Name: Voracious Greatshark
80946.FlavorText: There is no boat big enough.

80947.Name: Wormhole Serpent
80947.FlavorText: After drownings, devourings, and one highly unpleasant algae infestation, unsupervised portal use on campus was banned.

80949.Name: Black Cat
80949.FlavorText: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

80950.Name: Blood Artist
80950.FlavorText: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

80951.Name: Bloodhunter Bat
80951.FlavorText: It returns eager to share the feast of blood and gore with its ghoulish master.

80952.Name: Cauldron Familiar
80952.FlavorText: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

80953.Name: Champion of the Perished
80953.FlavorText: He rose from the graf for every cobbler, tanner, and fool who'd been slaughtered in the parish—and they rose and shambled after him.

80954.Name: Cruel Reality
80954.FlavorText: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

80956.Name: Drider
80956.FlavorText: Though their forms embody Lolth's image, driders are those unfortunate drow who have failed the Spider Queen.

80957.Name: Headless Rider
80957.FlavorText: He wanders the Moorlands hoping to one day chop off a head worthy of replacing his own.

80958.Name: Leeching Lurker
80958.FlavorText: First darkness falls. Then it burrows in.

80960.Name: Stromkirk Bloodthief
80960.FlavorText: With House Voldaren ascendant, some members of the Stromkirk line took it upon themselves to "borrow" from the blood tithes.

80961.Name: Torment of Scarabs
80961.FlavorText: Like a carpet unrolling for their god, the scarabs poured out from the necropolis.

80962.Name: Trespasser's Curse
80962.FlavorText: Even in the relative safety of the city, there are places best left undisturbed.

80963.Name: Unwilling Ingredient
80963.FlavorText:
"Don't look at me like that. It was either this or being eaten by a groff."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

80964.Name: Witch's Cauldron
80964.FlavorText: The best recipes start with reliable cookware.

80965.Name: Witch's Familiar
80965.FlavorText: Some bog witches practice the strange art of batrachomancy, reading portents in the number, size, and color of warts on a toad's hide.

80966.Name: Witch's Vengeance
80966.FlavorText: The hex swept through the village, its citizens falling one by one.

80967.Name: Boots of Speed
80967.FlavorText: Click your heels and become the wind.

80969.Name: Chained Brute
80969.FlavorText: A momentary lapse is all it needs to break free.

80971.Name: Devil's Play
80971.FlavorText: A devil's hands are never idle.

80972.Name: Dominating Vampire
80972.FlavorText: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."

80974.Name: Falkenrath Pit Fighter
80974.FlavorText: In the arena, vampires set aside all pretense of honor or civilization and fight like the predators they know themselves to be.

80975.Name: Festival Crasher
80975.FlavorText: So many candles. So many flammables. So little time.

80976.Name: Forge Devil
80976.FlavorText: A bit of pain never hurts.

80977.Name: Frenzied Devils
80977.FlavorText:
"Devils need no reason to stir up chaos. The chaos itself is their reward."
—Rem Karolus, Fiendslayer

80978.Name: Havoc Jester
80978.FlavorText: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.

80979.Name: Hellrider
80979.FlavorText:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

80980.Name: Hobblefiend
80980.FlavorText: Bedbugs aren't the only things you need to worry about biting you at night.

80982.Name: Pitchburn Devils
80982.FlavorText: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

80985.Name: Spiteful Prankster
80985.FlavorText: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.

80986.Name: Tibalt's Rager
80986.FlavorText:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

80987.Name: Torch Fiend
80987.FlavorText: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

80989.Name: Almighty Brushwagg
80989.FlavorText:
Laughed at the brushwagg
—Hunters' expression meaning
"died unexpectedly"

80990.Name: Arachnoform
80990.FlavorText: Deep within endless webs of clinging silk, the weaver waits.

80992.Name: Brood Weaver
80992.FlavorText: Travelers in the Somberwald scan the ground for werewolves and other threats, unaware of what lurks above.

80993.Name: Brushstrider
80993.FlavorText: Magistrate Ludy agreed to designate land for the brushstriders only after several broken windows and dozens of missing blini-cakes.

80994.Name: Dawntreader Elk
80994.FlavorText: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

80997.Name: Dire Wolf Prowler
80997.FlavorText: Large as horses, dire wolves must hunt often to satisfy their ravenous hunger. A mere human does little more than blunt their appetite.

80998.Name: Ferocious Pup
80998.FlavorText: The strongest pack has the fiercest pups.

80999.Name: Frilled Sandwalla
80999.FlavorText:
"Even the smallest creatures are fierce in defense of their own territory."
—Vivien Reid

81003.Name: Gnottvold Recluse
81003.FlavorText: Fed up with webs impeding travelers in other realms, Kolvori banished the giant spiders to Gnottvold, where their webs snare only the occasional rampaging troll.

81005.Name: Highland Game
81005.FlavorText:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon Arel's head. She hears the wisdom of our ancestors."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

81006.Name: Hollowhenge Beast
81006.FlavorText: In a world of monsters, it's the stuff of nightmares.

81008.Name: Ironshell Beetle
81008.FlavorText:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

81009.Name: Kazandu Nectarpot
81009.FlavorText:
"The scythe-like forelegs are crucial for its survival, because it tastes really good and every inhabitant of Murasa knows it."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

81010.Name: Lotus Cobra
81010.FlavorText: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.

81011.Name: Mammoth Spider
81011.FlavorText:
"If a careless elf ends up caught in a spider's web, we must expect nature to take its course. Do not blame the spider for being a spider."
—Dellin Berting, Tolarian entomologist

81012.Name: Moldgraf Millipede
81012.FlavorText: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

81013.Name: Moss Viper
81013.FlavorText: Nylea watches over all the creatures of the forest except for the snakes. Blessed by Pharika, they can take care of themselves.

81014.Name: Mosscoat Goriak
81014.FlavorText:
"Goriaks are as stubborn and hardy as I'd expect of a large herbivore in a wetland habitat. But I never expected them to have such beautiful voices!"
—Vivien Reid

81015.Name: Nessian Hornbeetle
81015.FlavorText:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

81016.Name: Netcaster Spider
81016.FlavorText: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

81017.Name: Pestilent Wolf
81017.FlavorText: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

81018.Name: Prey Upon
81018.FlavorText:
"Light up the dark to find your way, and the dark may seek you out."
—Zalin the Gutter Bard

81019.Name: Scurrid Colony
81019.FlavorText: Scurrid teeth evolved to crack open nuts, but they work just as well for crushing bones if the nest is threatened.

81020.Name: Sedge Scorpion
81020.FlavorText:
Thakolides the Mighty
Slayer of minotaurs
Vanquisher of giants
Killed by a scorpion
—Inscription on an Akroan grave

81021.Name: Sentinel Spider
81021.FlavorText:
"Your first reaction may be to stand very still and hope she didn't see you. Trust me, she did."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

81022.Name: Snarespinner
81022.FlavorText:
"Let's lure the drakes to the webs over the Samok Stand. Keep the spiders content."
—Aurelia

81024.Name: Spidery Grasp
81024.FlavorText: There are no safe paths through the Trial of Strength.

81025.Name: Spore Crawler
81025.FlavorText:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

81026.Name: Sporecap Spider
81026.FlavorText: After years of taunts and aerial assaults from Rankle's minions, the witches of Maraleaf Forest acquired new familiars.

81027.Name: Sylvan Brushstrider
81027.FlavorText: The mournful lowing of brushstriders warns of changing weather and ill winds.

81028.Name: Territorial Boar
81028.FlavorText:
"The presence of the strong will make you stronger."
—Yeva, Nature's Herald

81029.Name: Territorial Scythecat
81029.FlavorText: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.

81030.Name: Trufflesnout
81030.FlavorText: Its exploits are the stuff of legends among local chefs and fuel for nightmares among the forest thallids.

81031.Name: Twin-Silk Spider
81031.FlavorText: A forest-wide network of webs brings a hungry couple to captured prey.

81032.Name: Underdark Basilisk
81032.FlavorText:
"See how the statues all have chunks bitten out of them? We're dealing with a basilisk, or I'm a froghemoth."
—Larissa Kyriln, learned warlock

81033.Name: Wary Okapi
81033.FlavorText:
"Be like the grazers of the Saruli. Keep your herd close, and stay alert for encroaching danger."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad

81034.Name: Wedding Crasher
81034.FlavorText: He raged not just against vampires, but against civilization itself.

81036.Name: Wolfkin Outcast
81036.FlavorText: The villagers feared him. The cathars scorned him. Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.

81037.Name: Bladestitched Skaab
81037.FlavorText: The surviving militia members reunited with their fallen comrades sooner than they'd hoped.

81038.Name: Murasa Rootgrazer
81038.FlavorText: Few other creatures so closely embody Murasa's rapid cycles of growth.

81039.Name: Tovolar, Dire Overlord
81039.RawFrameDetail: RG gold legendary front side TDFC

81040.Name: Tovolar, the Midnight Scourge
81040.RawFrameDetail: RG gold legendary back side TDFC

81043.Name: Cliffhaven Kitesail
81043.FlavorText: Made from canvas, wood, and hope.

81045.Name: Colossus Hammer
81045.FlavorText: "There's only one way to be sure it's really dead."

81047.Name: Gingerbrute
81047.FlavorText: The unlabeled vial was not vanilla extract after all.

81052.Name: Millstone
81052.FlavorText: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

81058.Name: Relic Axe
81058.FlavorText: "It's light as a feather, but it hits with the force of a boulder. A very sharp boulder."

81060.Name: Rogue's Gloves
81060.FlavorText: Thievery requires subtlety, from the beginning of the heist to the end.

81061.Name: Shield of the Realm
81061.FlavorText: Benalish glazeplate is stained with salts from the Rift Era and enchanted to deflect blows.

81062.Name: Sorcerer's Broom
81062.FlavorText:
"Reynald wished for an army to sweep away his enemies. The fae king smiled."
—Beyond the Great Henge

81066.Name: Utility Knife
81066.FlavorText: "Hold on a second, I have just the thing."

81067.Name: Weapon Rack
81067.FlavorText: No weapon stays on the rack for long in the Burning Yard.

81068.Name: Whirlermaker
81068.FlavorText:
"Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves."
—Saheeli Rai

81069.Name: Witch's Oven
81069.FlavorText: The wafting smells are both scrumptious and suspicious.

81077.Name: A-Cosmos Elixir
81077.FlavorText: The Skoti owe their immortality to the elixir, and the manner of its creation is their most closely guarded secret.

81078.Name: A-Faceless Haven
81078.FlavorText: It is everywhere and nowhere, a place unbound by logic, just beyond the real.

81079.Name: A-Luminarch Aspirant
81079.FlavorText: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"

81085.Name: Experimental Pilot
81085.FlavorText: "Let's see what this thing can do!"

81096.Name: Consuming Oni
81096.FlavorText: Its hunger will never be sated.

81100.Name: Bellowsbreath Ogre
81100.FlavorText: It must have been something he ate.

81108.Name: Forceful Cultivator
81108.FlavorText: "Your city is a blight. I will cleanse it!"

81109.Name: Imperial Blademaster
81109.FlavorText: "Five against one? I like those odds."

81113.Name: Mechtitan
81113.RawFrameDetail: Z gold token legendary artifact, has text box

81116.Name: Adamant Will
81116.FlavorText: "I refuse to die before I see the sun rise again."

81118.Name: Dragonfly Suit
81118.FlavorText: Cutting-edge Imperial sentinel mechs patrol the skies over Eiganjo.

81119.Name: Eiganjo Exemplar
81119.FlavorText: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.

81121.Name: Norika Yamazaki, the Poet
81121.FlavorText: "The blades will have their say, but peace is built with words."

81124.Name: Futurist Sentinel
81124.FlavorText:
"I folded a model in paper first to test the relative tensile strength of the plates."
—Katsumasa, the Animator

81127.Name: Virus Beetle
81127.FlavorText:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

81128.Name: Akki Ronin
81128.FlavorText:
"Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade."
—Keni-Keni, akki smith

81129.Name: Heiko Yamazaki, the General
81129.FlavorText: "I prefer to let my sword do the talking."

81130.Name: Peerless Samurai
81130.FlavorText: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."

81132.Name: Tempered in Solitude
81132.FlavorText: Many master samurai make pilgrimages deep into the Sokenzan Mountains, where they train and meditate in silence, hoping to commune with a lava kami.

81134.Name: Eiganjo Uprising
81134.FlavorText: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.

81143.Name: Ovalchase Dragster
81143.FlavorText: It'll either crash or win the race. Possibly both.

81146.Name: Thundering Chariot
81146.FlavorText: In times of conflict, the philosophers of Meletis trade their podiums for conveyances of war.

81147.Name: Untethered Express
81147.FlavorText: Rules and rails are made to be broken.

81150.Name: Emergence Zone
81150.FlavorText: The Planar Bridge opened over the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing the symbol of Ravnica's endurance to rubble.

81156.Name: Mobilized District
