81156.FlavorText: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

81157.Name: Radiant Fountain
81157.FlavorText:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

81158.Name: Roadside Reliquary
81158.FlavorText: Travelers who leave an offering may pass freely through the forest kami's domain.

81159.Name: Scavenger Grounds
81159.FlavorText: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

81161.Name: Thriving Grove
81161.FlavorText: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

81162.Name: Treasure Vault
81162.FlavorText: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

81164.Name: Jin-Gitaxias, Progress Tyrant
81164.RawFrameDetail: alt U legendary PhyrexianLanguage, Phyrexian watermark (built into frame)

81179.Name: Plains
81179.RawFrameDetail: W full art Plains, no symbol

81180.Name: Island
81180.RawFrameDetail: U full art Island, no symbol

81181.Name: Swamp
81181.RawFrameDetail: B full art Swamp, no symbol

81182.Name: Mountain
81182.RawFrameDetail: R full art Mountain, no symbol

81183.Name: Forest
81183.RawFrameDetail: G full art Forest, no symbol

81184.Name: A-Divide by Zero
81184.FlavorText: "Misery. Inadequacy. Failure. The common denominator is you."

81201.Name: A-Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
81201.FlavorText: Beneath the waves, lost gods stir in their slumber.

81203.Name: A-Fires of Invention
81203.FlavorText: "Just tell us how many you want and get out of the way."

81204.Name: A-Alrund, God of the Cosmos
81204.RawFrameDetail: U legendary front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

81205.Name: A-Alrund, God of the Cosmos
81205.RawFrameDetail: alt U front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

81206.Name: A-Hakka, Whispering Raven
81206.FlavorText: Alrund's raven soars between realms; no secret is beyond his grasp.
81206.RawFrameDetail: U legendary back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

81207.Name: A-Hakka, Whispering Raven
81207.RawFrameDetail: alt U back side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

81209.Name: A-Narfi, Betrayer King
81209.FlavorText: To serve the god of death, Narfi forfeited the warmth of life.

81211.Name: A-Vega, the Watcher
81211.FlavorText: One eye sees the past, one the present, and one the future—and none can be deceived.

81214.Name: A-Cobbled Lancer
81214.FlavorText:
"Don't worry everyone—I hear hoofbeats! The Gavony Riders are coming to save us!"
—Adin, Moorland villager

81218.Name: A-Hobbling Zombie
81218.FlavorText:
"I see someone tried to stop you, my pet. How delightful."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

81219.Name: A-Sepulcher Ghoul
81219.FlavorText: Ghouls devour the dead and any living creatures unwary enough to fall into their grasp.

81229.Name: A-Blood Artist
81229.FlavorText: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

81230.Name: A-Blood Artist
81230.FlavorText: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

81272.Name: Tiefling Outcasts
81272.FlavorText: They fought with the desperate courage of those who have nothing left to lose.

81284.Name: Liara of the Flaming Fist
81284.FlavorText: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."

81288.Name: Gate of the Black Dragon
81288.FlavorText: An imposing visage that looms over all who would rise above their station.

81289.Name: Gate to Manorborn
81289.FlavorText: A barrier that shields privileged eyes from the city's woes.

81290.Name: Gate to Seatower
81290.FlavorText: An efficient route from a smuggler's ship to a patriar's manor.

81291.Name: Gate to the Citadel
81291.FlavorText: A beacon of order and safety, for those who can afford it.

81292.Name: Gate to Tumbledown
81292.FlavorText: A partition between the hopeless living and the restless dead.

81495.Name: Klement, Novice Acolyte
81495.FlavorText: "Baldurians are free to worship any deities they choose. Where will faith and fate lead me?"

81496.Name: Klement, Life Acolyte
81496.FlavorText: "May Lathander's light guide you to greet tomorrow's sunrise."

81497.Name: Klement, Knowledge Acolyte
81497.FlavorText: "Have you seen the Unrolling Scroll? A truly marvelous shrine dedicated to Oghma's wisdom and teachings."

81498.Name: Klement, Death Acolyte
81498.FlavorText: "The Dead Three—Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul—walk among us. It's time we remake this city to their liking."

81499.Name: Klement, Tempest Acolyte
81499.FlavorText: "The rage of Talos is mine own, and I am become the eye of the storm."

81500.Name: Klement, Nature Acolyte
81500.FlavorText: "Silvanus and Chauntea, like grass in cracked stone, can always find little spaces to flourish."

81503.Name: Lae'zel, Illithid Thrall
81503.FlavorText: "You know what must be done. Do it now!"

81504.Name: Lae'zel, Callous Warrior
81504.FlavorText: "You've a sharp tongue, elf. Would that your mind proved its equal."

81506.Name: Lae'zel, Primal Warrior
81506.FlavorText: "A githyanki crèche must be near; its caretaker has the means to cleanse us."

81507.Name: Lulu, Forgetful Hollyphant
81507.FlavorText: "Most of my memory is gone, and I don't remember why."

81508.Name: Lulu, Helpful Hollyphant
81508.FlavorText: "Maybe, just maybe, there's a little spark of goodness in Zariel still."

81509.Name: Lulu, Curious Hollyphant
81509.FlavorText: "The sword, the sword! I know where it is!"

81510.Name: Lulu, Vengeful Hollyphant
81510.FlavorText: "Through the gate to Avernus we went, tearing through devils like a song through air."

81511.Name: Lulu, Inspiring Hollyphant
81511.FlavorText: "The Zariel I knew is gone, replaced by a devil with a halo of fire and vengeance."

81512.Name: Lulu, Wild Hollyphant
81512.FlavorText: "I wandered Avernus for a time—a harsh, horrible place devoid of growth."

81514.Name: Rasaad, Radiant Monk
81514.FlavorText: "Those who walk the path of evil will never know peace."

81515.Name: Rasaad, Dragon Monk
81515.FlavorText: "I shall endeavor to let wisdom be our torch."

81516.Name: Rasaad, Shadow Monk
81516.FlavorText: "My heart is not so peaceful as it may seem."

81520.Name: Alora, Cheerful Mastermind
81520.FlavorText: "Isn't this great? All of us, doing nice things, being happy."

81521.Name: Alora, Cheerful Thief
81521.FlavorText: "I knew a mage once, but he was pretty stuffy. You're not like that."

81522.Name: Alora, Cheerful Assassin
81522.FlavorText: "I'm so sweet, I've got rotting teeth and gums!"

81523.Name: Alora, Cheerful Swashbuckler
81523.FlavorText: "Hey, I think everyone would be happier if we were a little nicer."

81524.Name: Alora, Cheerful Scout
81524.FlavorText: "What a great forest, huh? I've never seen trees like these before."

81528.Name: Gale, Abyssal Conduit
81528.FlavorText: "No rest for the wicked, I see."

81530.Name: Gale, Primeval Conduit
81530.FlavorText: "Oh, what a tangled Weave we web."

81532.Name: Imoen, Honorable Trickster
81532.FlavorText: "I'll stick with you, no matter what."

81534.Name: Imoen, Occult Trickster
81534.FlavorText: "Just like old times. Well, except for the torture and all."

81535.Name: Imoen, Chaotic Trickster
81535.FlavorText: "My blade will cut ya down to size!"

81536.Name: Imoen, Wise Trickster
81536.FlavorText: "I wish I could spend more time in the forest. I feel so alive."

81538.Name: Vhal, Scholar of Tactics
81538.FlavorText: "The Demiplanar Chambers take a lot longer to clean than you'd think."

81539.Name: Vhal, Scholar of Prophecy
81539.FlavorText: "I find the Endless Chant comforting. How else could I fall asleep?"

81540.Name: Vhal, Scholar of Mortality
81540.FlavorText: "If you've never met Miirym, I'll say nothing else. Let it be a fun surprise."

81541.Name: Vhal, Scholar of Elements
81541.FlavorText: "Whoever's stealing potions and gold from my personal chambers better fess up now!"

81542.Name: Vhal, Scholar of Creation
81542.FlavorText: "An undiscovered prediction of Alaundo! . . . Or just his recipe for Three-Chicken Pie."

81543.Name: Sarevok the Usurper
81543.FlavorText: "We children of Bhaal cannot be stopped."

81544.Name: Sarevok, Divine Usurper
81544.FlavorText: "This is how it was meant to be. Let no one bar our path."

81546.Name: Sarevok, Deadly Usurper
81546.FlavorText: "Death comes for you. Feel its icy breath!"

81547.Name: Sarevok, Ferocious Usurper
81547.FlavorText: "We should kill something soon. My impatience grows."

81548.Name: Sarevok, Mighty Usurper
81548.FlavorText: "In this light, it seems all the insects that prey on the living have retreated to the shadows."

81553.Name: Shadowheart, Cleric of War
81553.FlavorText: "Got to keep focused—can't afford to get attached. To anyone."

81556.Name: Viconia, Disciple of Rebirth
81556.FlavorText: "With the guidance of Shar, we shall prosper."

81557.Name: Viconia, Disciple of Arcana
81557.FlavorText: "I see you have learned much in your short life span."

81558.Name: Viconia, Disciple of Blood
81558.FlavorText: "Trust is for the foolish. And the dead."

81560.Name: Viconia, Disciple of Strength
81560.FlavorText: "Your forests seem very strange . . . and yet somehow familiar."

81561.Name: Ambergris, Citadel Agent
81561.FlavorText: "This better be good if ye're thinking to keep the ale from me lips."

81563.Name: Ambergris, Agent of Progress
81563.FlavorText: "Not a sight ye'd see every day, eh?"

81564.Name: Ambergris, Agent of Tyranny
81564.FlavorText: "If ye have coin and drink, we're bound to be friends."

81566.Name: Ambergris, Agent of Balance
81566.FlavorText: "Cross me, and I'll leave ye held and helpless in the forest."

81567.Name: Gut, Fanatical Priestess
81567.FlavorText: "Us True Souls gotta look out for one another."

81568.Name: Gut, Zealous Fanatic
81568.FlavorText: "All you need to do is open yourself to the Absolute, and I'll do the rest."

81569.Name: Gut, Devious Fanatic
81569.FlavorText: "Got a lot of weird things swimmin' around in that head of yours."

81570.Name: Gut, Brutal Fanatic
81570.FlavorText: "You're gonna be my new pet. A ferocious squiddie, all for myself."

81571.Name: Gut, Furious Fanatic
81571.FlavorText: "The Absolute's voice is a blade—it'd cut your brain to bits."

81572.Name: Gut, Bestial Fanatic
81572.FlavorText: "Yer flesh is marked. The Absolute is upon you!"

81573.Name: Karlach, Raging Tiefling
81573.FlavorText: "Most souls in Avernus are just meat for the grinder. But not me."

81574.Name: Karlach, Tiefling Zealot
81574.FlavorText: "I didn't escape the hells to lose my soul to another evil."

81575.Name: Karlach, Tiefling Spellrager
81575.FlavorText: "Until I've shaken Zariel off my back, I'd only put a target on yours."

81576.Name: Karlach, Tiefling Punisher
81576.FlavorText: "Want me to send them to the Hells? Just say the word."

81577.Name: Karlach, Tiefling Berserker
81577.FlavorText: "I've spat in Baphomet's eye and lived to tell the tale."

81578.Name: Karlach, Tiefling Guardian
81578.FlavorText: "It's a rescue mission then—should be fun. Let's get to work."

81585.Name: Jaheira, Harper Emissary
81585.FlavorText: "The Harpers' movement grows, but it needs sunlight to blossom. We can be that light."

81591.Name: Lukamina, Moon Druid
81591.FlavorText: "Like the moon, I appear in many phases."

81592.Name: Lukamina, Hawk Form
81592.FlavorText: "None as observant or elegant as the hawk."

81593.Name: Lukamina, Crocodile Form
81593.FlavorText: "No creature as tenacious and calculating as the crocodile."

81594.Name: Lukamina, Scorpion Form
81594.FlavorText: "Never an animal as deadly and venomous as the scorpion."

81595.Name: Lukamina, Wolf Form
81595.FlavorText: "Nothing as ferocious or wily as the wolf."

81596.Name: Lukamina, Bear Form
81596.FlavorText: "There's not a beast as mighty or primal as the bear."

81597.Name: Skanos, Dragon Vassal
81597.FlavorText: "Do not place your aggression on one if you cannot handle the wrath of many."

81598.Name: Skanos, White Dragon Vassal
81598.FlavorText: "Surviving the frigid cold means hunting without patience or mercy."

81599.Name: Skanos, Blue Dragon Vassal
81599.FlavorText: "The meek and ugly masses would be wise to not sully my master's lands."

81600.Name: Skanos, Black Dragon Vassal
81600.FlavorText: "Intelligence is a delusion of the weak. Brutality is power's true measure."

81601.Name: Skanos, Red Dragon Vassal
81601.FlavorText: "All will bow and swear fealty to my master. Dragonkind included."

81602.Name: Skanos, Green Dragon Vassal
81602.FlavorText: "Brute strength is a waste of effort when deception will fare more elegantly."

81634.Name: Moat Piranhas
81634.FlavorText:
"Come on, it's not even that deep!"
—Gorin the Brazen

81635.Name: Mystic Skyfish
81635.FlavorText: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

81640.Name: Riptide Turtle
81640.FlavorText:
"As the storm waves crushed my sailors, I cried out to Thassa. The next time I saw them, hard shells encased them, and they swam away to safety."
—Siona, captain of the Pyleas

81641.Name: Ruin Crab
81641.FlavorText: To an explorer, a priceless treasure. To the crab, a rock to call home.

81643.Name: Sigiled Starfish
81643.FlavorText: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

81646.Name: Voracious Greatshark
81646.FlavorText: There is no boat big enough.

81656.Name: Lightning Bolt
81656.FlavorText:
"Hasn't she heard of knocking?!"
—Snerd, Flaming Fist guard

81658.Name: Plummet
81658.FlavorText: The dragon's noxious breath withered the forest. The whistle of a hundred arrows filled the air. The ground roiled as if shaken by an earthquake. The tyrant fell from the sky.

81659.Name: Gate of the Black Dragon
81659.FlavorText: An imposing visage that looms over all who would rise above their station.

81660.Name: Gate to Manorborn
81660.FlavorText: A barrier that shields privileged eyes from the city's woes.

81661.Name: Gate to Seatower
81661.FlavorText: An efficient route from a smuggler's ship to a patriar's manor.

81662.Name: Gate to the Citadel
81662.FlavorText: A beacon of order and safety, for those who can afford it.

81663.Name: Gate to Tumbledown
81663.FlavorText: A partition between the hopeless living and the restless dead.

81666.Name: Ascend from Avernus
81666.FlavorText: Smoke clogged the streets and rubble littered the ground, but sunlight shining on the long-lost towers of Elturel was still a beautiful sight.

81669.Name: Celestial Unicorn
81669.FlavorText: When all hope fails, its light remains.

81671.Name: Devoted Paladin
81671.FlavorText: "I swore a sacred oath to protect the weak and punish those who threaten them. As long as I draw breath, I will protect you."

81672.Name: Flaming Fist Officer
81672.FlavorText: "Get the remaining citizens to safety! These miscreants have an appointment with my spear."

81681.Name: Monk of the Open Hand
81681.FlavorText: His mind is a tranquil meadow, his fists a raging storm.

81685.Name: Priest of Ancient Lore
81685.FlavorText: "We are a product of our ancestors, the apotheosis of countless noble generations. Speak their names with reverence, and they will guide your path."

81686.Name: Rally Maneuver
81686.FlavorText: "Don't give up! You are steel and fire, and victory is yours to seize."

81687.Name: Rescuer Chwinga
81687.FlavorText: Fortunately for lost travelers, chwingas' curiosity often gets the better of their shyness.

81689.Name: Steadfast Paladin
81689.FlavorText: "When I made my oath to Moradin, I left selfishness and cowardice behind. Every battle, I make that commitment anew."

81690.Name: Steadfast Unicorn
81690.FlavorText: Only the good-hearted may set foot in a unicorn's domain.

81691.Name: Stick Together
81691.FlavorText: Every veteran adventurer will tell you to stick with your party, because the ones who split up aren't around to give advice.

81693.Name: You're Ambushed on the Road
81693.FlavorText: "Hand over your loot and no one gets hurt!"

81694.Name: You're Confronted by Robbers
81694.FlavorText: Their only mistake was giving the bard time to speak.

81695.Name: Air-Cult Elemental
81695.FlavorText: Elemental Evil distorts the natural elements, limiting them to aspects of destruction.

81697.Name: Blur
81697.FlavorText: "It's as much a trick of the mind as it is a trick of the eye."

81699.Name: Clever Conjurer
81699.FlavorText: "I'm always happy to lend a hand!"

81701.Name: Displacer Kitten
81701.FlavorText:
"Isn't she the cutest thing you've almost seen?"
—Doen, purveyor of exotic pets

81702.Name: Draconic Lore
81702.FlavorText: The wyrmling studied the ancient carvings and dreamed of a day when her own exploits would be immortalized in stone.

81703.Name: Dragonborn Looter
81703.FlavorText: Erdur never thought of it as stealing. Treasure simply didn't deserve to be stuck underground where no one could admire it.

81704.Name: Dream Fracture
81704.FlavorText: In her dream, Lola gazed into a mirror. Her familiar features warped, her jaw stretching wider and wider until it cracked and her reflection pulled her into its gaping maw.

81707.Name: Guild Thief
81707.FlavorText: She puts some coin in the Guild's pocket and sends a message at the same time.

81708.Name: Illithid Harvester
81708.FlavorText: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

81709.Name: Plant Tadpoles
81709.FlavorText: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

81710.Name: Irenicus's Vile Duplication
81710.FlavorText:
"You will serve me better in this form."
—Jon Irenicus

81712.Name: Kenku Artificer
81712.FlavorText: Though her words may be unoriginal, her creations are anything but.

81713.Name: Kindred Discovery
81713.FlavorText: A family that welcomes birds of all feathers.

81715.Name: Pseudodragon Familiar
81715.FlavorText: Pseudodragons are favored companions of wizards, prized for their cunning and curiosity.

81717.Name: Rimeshield Frost Giant
81717.FlavorText: Frost giants carry the trophies of their greatest victories into battle, fashioned into armor of strength and savage beauty.

81718.Name: Robe of the Archmagi
81718.FlavorText: It offers the power to shape worlds, and the elegance to do so with style.

81720.Name: Soulknife Spy
81720.FlavorText: "My psychic blade cuts the mind and severs thoughts. Even if you survive, you'll never remember I was here."

81723.Name: Tymora's Invoker
81723.FlavorText: "May Lady Luck smile upon you some other day, pal."

81725.Name: You Find the Villains' Lair
81725.FlavorText: "Give me just a moment! I almost have it."

81726.Name: Young Blue Dragon
81726.FlavorText: "I see the far side of tomorrow and the lost memories of queens. What do you wish to learn?"

81727.Name: Sand Augury
81727.FlavorText: "I see the far side of tomorrow and the lost memories of queens. What do you wish to learn?"

81730.Name: Ambition's Cost
81730.FlavorText: "Of course it can be yours. Anything is possible, for the right price. Speaking of which . . ."

81732.Name: Armor of Shadows
81732.FlavorText:
"What's softer than silk, stronger than steel, and quieter than thought?"
—Warlock riddle

81734.Name: Black Dragon
81734.FlavorText: Black dragons revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms.

81736.Name: Blood Money
81736.FlavorText: For the patriar class, wealth is in the blood.

81737.Name: Bonecaller Cleric
81737.FlavorText: The bell's unearthly chime slips into the ears of the dead, waking them rudely from their eternal slumber.

81738.Name: Cast Down
81738.FlavorText:
"We simply cannot tolerate a petty thief among the servants. I'm afraid I'll have to let you go."
—Rog, steward of House Rillyn

81739.Name: Chain Devil
81739.FlavorText: To these fiends, there's no symphony more beautiful than the melodies of rattling chains and ripping flesh.

81740.Name: Deadly Dispute
81740.FlavorText: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

81741.Name: Demogorgon's Clutches
81741.FlavorText: The good will be corrupted, the kind will be devoured, and all will be dragged into the bottomless Abyss.

81742.Name: Drider
81742.FlavorText: Though their forms embody Lolth's image, driders are those unfortunate drow who have failed the Spider Queen.

81743.Name: Eldritch Pact
81743.FlavorText: The Night Serpent tasted the warlock's ambition and savored the dark hunger in her soul.

81744.Name: Eyes of the Beholder
81744.FlavorText: In the end, there was nothing beautiful to be seen.

81749.Name: Grim Bounty
81749.FlavorText: Freed from the need to pay tribute to the dragon, the villagers gladly paid the dragon-slayers instead.

81751.Name: Grim Wanderer
81751.FlavorText: There is a stillness that walks with him, the quiet that follows great tragedy, when even the mourners are too exhausted to weep.

81752.Name: Guildsworn Prowler
81752.FlavorText: "Of course it's part of my plan. Who do you think started the bar fight?"

81753.Name: Hoard Robber
81753.FlavorText: "And to think, a year ago I was picking pockets in Waterdeep."

81756.Name: Nefarious Imp
81756.FlavorText: It listens to all of their plans and plots creative ways to turn them to ruin.

81758.Name: Sepulcher Ghoul
81758.FlavorText: Ghouls devour the dead and any living creatures unwary enough to fall into their grasp.

81762.Name: Summon Undead
81762.FlavorText: The air itself shuddered at the wizard's words, and from the dark beyond, her call was answered.

81764.Name: Vampire Spawn
81764.FlavorText: Unsuccessful vampire hunters often wind up as ravenous spawn.

81768.Name: Breath Weapon
81768.FlavorText: "In the name of Tempus, Lord of Battles, you will die honorably in righteous fire."

81769.Name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
81769.FlavorText: The essence of a red dragon burns within, always ready to rise with wrath.

81776.Name: Improvised Weaponry
81776.FlavorText: Anything can be a weapon if you swing it hard enough.

81779.Name: Reckless Barbarian
81779.FlavorText: The best defense is not even knowing what the word "defense" means.

81780.Name: Red Dragon
81780.FlavorText: Red dragons consider the world and every creature in it as theirs to command.

81781.Name: Storm King's Thunder
81781.FlavorText:
"I alone am worthy to decide where lightning strikes."
—Hekaton, storm giant king

81786.Name: Valor Singer
81786.FlavorText: "There is only one way forward: into legend."

81787.Name: Wrathful Red Dragon
81787.FlavorText: "We'll put it all back! The gems, the gold, the chalice that would've looked great on my mantle; we'll put everythi—"

81788.Name: You Come to the Gnoll Camp
81788.FlavorText:
"Easy now, everyone. I'll take care of this."
—Nadaar

81790.Name: Young Red Dragon
81790.FlavorText: For most, deadly. For a dragon, decadent.

81791.Name: Bathe in Gold
81791.FlavorText: For most, deadly. For a dragon, decadent.

81792.Name: Ambitious Dragonborn
81792.FlavorText: The raging green dragon left destruction—and at least one admirer—in its wake.

81794.Name: Band Together
81794.FlavorText: "Boo, let's see how this miscreant handles a furry missile of justice!"

81796.Name: Choose Your Weapon
81796.FlavorText:
"Move it, Varis, or I'll pick one for you!"
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

81798.Name: Circle of the Moon Druid
81798.FlavorText: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of nature who haunt the deepest parts of the wilderness.

81799.Name: Draconic Muralists
81799.FlavorText: "We must never allow the deeds of our great ancestors to be forgotten."

81800.Name: Dread Linnorm
81800.FlavorText: A serpent's cruelty, a dragon's appetite.

81801.Name: Scale Deflection
81801.FlavorText: A serpent's cruelty, a dragon's appetite.

81803.Name: Druidic Ritual
81803.FlavorText: Bone, root, and seed—the past, present, and future in one handful of earth.

81805.Name: Emerald Dragon
81805.FlavorText: Emerald dragons hate prying eyes, and they have a host of ways to deter them.

81806.Name: Dissonant Wave
81806.FlavorText: Emerald dragons hate prying eyes, and they have a host of ways to deter them.

81807.Name: Ettercap
81807.FlavorText:
"Filthy, sticky, vile, noxious—and I haven't even started describing the webs."
—Erinis, gloom stalker

81808.Name: Web Shot
81808.FlavorText:
"Filthy, sticky, vile, noxious—and I haven't even started describing the webs."
—Erinis, gloom stalker

81809.Name: Gnoll Hunter
81809.FlavorText: Yipping and cackling, the hunters tore through the village, leaving nothing but snapped bones and burning homes in their wake.

81810.Name: Hill Giant Herdgorger
81810.FlavorText: A shepherd's crook is useful for cleaning bits of wool out of the teeth.

81811.Name: Inspiring Bard
81811.FlavorText: "Wake up, my friends! There are deeds to be done and treasures to be won!"

81813.Name: Lurking Roper
81813.FlavorText: "You see, stalac-tites grow down from the ceiling, while stalag-mites reach—AAHHHHHHHHH—"

81814.Name: Monster Manual
81814.FlavorText: The detail really makes the monsters jump off the page.

81815.Name: Zoological Study
81815.FlavorText: The detail really makes the monsters jump off the page.

81816.Name: Owlbear
81816.FlavorText: Many people believe a misguided wizard created the first owlbear, but others insist that these creatures have always dwelled in the Feywild.

81817.Name: Owlbear Shepherd
81817.FlavorText: When your pack is nowhere to be found, you form a new one.

81818.Name: Poison the Blade
81818.FlavorText: "Breath of basilisk, sting of scorpion, or medusa's tears? All may be distilled, for a price."

81820.Name: Scaled Nurturer
81820.FlavorText: "Life always starts small. Only time will tell what heights it may reach."

81821.Name: Split the Spoils
81821.FlavorText: "That half is yours. These halves are mine."

81823.Name: Traverse the Outlands
81823.FlavorText:
"By the time you've seen it all, all have already changed."
—Wandering treant, name unknown

81824.Name: Undercellar Myconid
81824.FlavorText: Water, barley, yeast, darkness—the tavern cellar had everything a growing mold could need.

81825.Name: Underdark Basilisk
81825.FlavorText:
"See how the statues all have chunks bitten out of them? We're dealing with a basilisk, or I'm a froghemoth."
—Larissa Kyriln, learned warlock

81830.Name: Baba Lysaga, Night Witch
81830.FlavorText: Better the cold night than her warm hospitality.

81832.Name: Gorion, Wise Mentor
81832.FlavorText: "You are safest in Candlekeep, Abdel, but I cannot keep you from the world forever."

81836.Name: Korlessa, Scale Singer
81836.FlavorText: "Would you like a song of wing-wind and fire, or one of gentle heartbeats atop a golden hoard?"

81838.Name: Lozhan, Dragons' Legacy
81838.FlavorText: She channels myth and memory into waves of deadly arcane force.

81844.Name: Oji, the Exquisite Blade
81844.FlavorText: They walk the Path of the Kensei with perfect balance.

81848.Name: Thrakkus the Butcher
81848.FlavorText: Somehow, he never seems to run out of fresh meat.

81849.Name: Trelasarra, Moon Dancer
81849.FlavorText: "Eilistraee teaches us that we are not bound by the circumstances of our birth. We all may find beauty and light, if we have the courage to seek them."

81851.Name: Basilisk Collar
81851.FlavorText: Some patriars pay massive sums for exotic pets that can give their posh, predictable lives an edge of danger.

81853.Name: Chardalyn Dragon
81853.FlavorText: First discovered in ancient Netheril, chardalyn stones absorb and hold magical energy, enabling constructs to be infused with fearsome power and unnatural malice.

81854.Name: Cloak of the Bat
81854.FlavorText:
"How about the power of silent flight? Does that suit your needs, cutthroat?"
—Rivalen Blackhand, proprietor of Sorcerous Sundries

81856.Name: Iron Golem
81856.FlavorText: Once an iron golem is set to a task, it won't turn aside until that task is complete or it has been destroyed.

81858.Name: Meteor Golem
81858.FlavorText: The strongest golems are forged from meteoric iron that has been tempered in the heat of an elemental plane.

81859.Name: Mirror of Life Trapping
81859.FlavorText: Quenton barely had a second to admire his exquisite handsomeness before reality collapsed around him.

81860.Name: Navigation Orb
81860.FlavorText: Travel the world without ever leaving the comfort of home.

81861.Name: Pilgrim's Eye
81861.FlavorText: Charting the Spine of the World is best left to the disposable.

81862.Name: Prophetic Prism
81862.FlavorText: To understand Baldur's Gate, one must first understand how wealth and commerce shape every facet of life.

81865.Name: Baldur's Gate
81865.FlavorText:
"Of course I know what ‘eponymous' means! It's a little horse."
—Krizz, gate guard

81876.Name: Boo
81876.RawFrameDetail: R token legendary, has text box

81888.Name: A-Sepulcher Ghoul
81888.FlavorText: Ghouls devour the dead and any living creatures unwary enough to fall into their grasp.

81891.Name: A-Monster Manual
81891.FlavorText: The detail really makes the monsters jump off the page.

81892.Name: A-Baba Lysaga, Night Witch
81892.FlavorText: Better the cold night than her warm hospitality.

81907.Name: A-Goma Fada Vanguard
81907.FlavorText:
"Her weapon's impressive, sure. But you should see her wield it."
—Gred, expedition warrior

81909.Name: A-Kargan Warleader
81909.FlavorText: From rebellion against the Akoum Skyclave to fighting the Eldrazi titans, the dragon-riding Kargan tribes have never missed an opportunity to defy the odds.

81913.Name: A-Base Camp
81913.FlavorText: A new dawn, a new adventure.

81915.Name: A-Skemfar Avenger
81915.FlavorText: Stripped of their divinity, the elves of Skemfar channeled their rage and sorrow into bloody brutality.

81916.Name: A-Elderleaf Mentor
81916.FlavorText: "Our ancestors grew complacent in their divinity, allowing their lessers to topple them. Never again."

81924.Name: A-Canopy Tactician
81924.FlavorText: "Death and life are two ends of the same spear."

81925.Name: A-Elderfang Ritualist
81925.FlavorText: Her fingers stiffened as the shrouded corpse stirred. Her final, ragged breath was one of triumph. "Return, my chosen, and grant our people victory!"

81927.Name: A-Symmetry Sage
81927.FlavorText: "By my calculations, I should be able to achieve true enlightenment before graduation."

81929.Name: A-Dwarfhold Champion
81929.FlavorText: Courage is neither a shield nor an axe, but the will to wield both in defense of the innocent.

81931.Name: A-Armory Veteran
81931.FlavorText: "This one is for goblins, this one is for owlbears, this one is for toast, this one is for . . ."

81932.Name: A-Bruenor Battlehammer
81932.FlavorText: "Knew I'd find ye in trouble if I came out an' looked for ye!"

81941.Name: Agent of Raffine
81941.FlavorText: No backroom deal is ever truly secure.

81953.Name: Arming Gala
81953.FlavorText: For the Cabaretti, everything is a party.

81958.Name: Cabaretti Revels
81958.FlavorText: "What are we celebrating? Join us and find out!"

81979.Name: Emancipation Angel
81979.FlavorText: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

81985.Name: Segovian Angel
81985.FlavorText: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

81986.Name: Serra Angel
81986.FlavorText: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

81987.Name: Sigardian Savior
81987.FlavorText: "Begone, moon-cursed! These folk are no prey of yours."

81989.Name: Valkyrie Harbinger
81989.FlavorText: Where she flies, the Light of Starnheim shines.

81990.Name: Youthful Valkyrie
81990.FlavorText: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

81992.Name: Locked in the Cemetery
81992.FlavorText: "Help! I'm not a zombie! Let me out!"

81993.Name: Naga Oracle
81993.FlavorText: "All questions will be answered during the Hour of Revelation."

81994.Name: Strategic Planning
81994.FlavorText: Alrund sees the future as a whorl of signs and symbols, omens interwoven in an intricate knotwork only he can decipher.

81996.Name: Asylum Visitor
81996.FlavorText: "The ravings of the mad are laced with eldritch knowledge."

81998.Name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
81998.FlavorText: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

81999.Name: Boneclad Necromancer
81999.FlavorText: "Living or dead, everyone responds to the proper motivation."

82000.Name: Corpse Churn
82000.FlavorText: "How did we find each other? So there I was, exploring a mound of monster corpses . . ."

82001.Name: Corpse Hauler
82001.FlavorText:
"He expects a reward, but the only piece of silver he'll get from me is my blade in his gut."
—Shelac, necromancer

82002.Name: Courier Bat
82002.FlavorText: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.

82005.Name: Durable Coilbug
82005.FlavorText:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

82007.Name: Hoard Robber
82007.FlavorText: "And to think, a year ago I was picking pockets in Waterdeep."

82008.Name: Liliana's Elite
82008.FlavorText:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

82010.Name: Malakir Cullblade
82010.FlavorText: Each cut stains his blade with fresh blood that he samples to increase his strength.

82011.Name: Morbid Opportunist
82011.FlavorText: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

82012.Name: Necrotic Wound
82012.FlavorText: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

82013.Name: Reassembling Skeleton
82013.FlavorText:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

82014.Name: Slaughter Specialist
82014.FlavorText: From every kill, a gruesome trophy.

82015.Name: Tavern Swindler
82015.FlavorText: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

82017.Name: Tithebearer Giant
82017.FlavorText:
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them."
—Teysa

82018.Name: Unmarked Grave
82018.FlavorText:
"I'm sure they were once someone important, but I couldn't tell you who they were."
—Doros, expedition guide

82019.Name: Vengeful Warchief
82019.FlavorText: "Try to steal from me and I'll add your skull to my collection."

82020.Name: Yuan-Ti Fang-Blade
82020.FlavorText: "The air is sweet with the taste of your fear."

82021.Name: Bristling Boar
82021.FlavorText:
"I can bring down anything in Zagoth, but for some quarry the ratio of fight to meat is too high."
—Master Hunter Chevill

82022.Name: Enraged Ceratok
82022.FlavorText: "There's no time to calm it down! Run!"

82023.Name: Exuberant Wolfbear
82023.FlavorText: Sometimes the eludha is a sacred harmony of souls. Sometimes the bonder grabs some fur and holds on tight.

82024.Name: Gaea's Protector
82024.FlavorText: Fallen Phyrexians were transmuted into elementals by Gaea long ago, but Yavimaya's other inhabitants still regard them with unease.

82025.Name: Master Symmetrist
82025.FlavorText: Tondo lost his very first duel and has spent his entire life trying to get even.

82027.Name: Overgrown Armasaur
82027.FlavorText: It embodies the riotous growth of the jungle, where creatures crowd upon creatures, where roots sprawl and vines swarm.

82028.Name: Predatory Wurm
82028.FlavorText:
"The strong eat. The weak are eaten. That's the way of things."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

82029.Name: Prized Unicorn
82029.FlavorText:
"Friend and foe alike are irresistibly drawn to its beauty—the good, to their lasting reward, and the evil, to their brief and painful regret."
—Vivien Reid

82030.Name: Sabertooth Mauler
82030.FlavorText:
"I hope the idiot who introduced these creatures to the jungle was their first meal."
—Opar, veteran guide

82031.Name: Spike-Tailed Ceratops
82031.FlavorText: The conquistadors surrounded the dinosaur only to find that it had outflanked them.

82032.Name: Spore Crawler
82032.FlavorText:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

82033.Name: Thrashing Brontodon
82033.FlavorText: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

82034.Name: Wardscale Crocodile
82034.FlavorText:
"The Eternals had to endure Amonkhet's five trials. Let's see if they can pass the Trial of Ravnica."
—Jace Beleren

82035.Name: World Shaper
82035.FlavorText: "The Great River will not be tamed."

82036.Name: Obsessive Stitcher
82036.FlavorText: No one is as dedicated to perfection as a stitcher working on their latest masterpiece.

82037.Name: Arcane Encyclopedia
82037.FlavorText: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.

82040.Name: Filigree Familiar
82040.FlavorText:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

82041.Name: Fountain of Renewal
82041.FlavorText: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.

82042.Name: Gilded Lotus
82042.FlavorText:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

82044.Name: Guild Globe
82044.FlavorText:
"Hopefully Ravnica will prove harder to break."
—Karn

82046.Name: Honored Heirloom
82046.FlavorText: After the Travails, Runechanters set about repairing twisted symbols of Avacyn as the first step in restoring faith in the Church.

82047.Name: Key to the City
82047.FlavorText: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

82048.Name: Prophetic Prism
82048.FlavorText: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

82049.Name: Stuffed Bear
82049.FlavorText: It takes a taxidermist of unusual skill to cleanly stuff and mount a beast without severing its primal, predatory drive.

82051.Name: Treasure Vault
82051.FlavorText: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

82052.Name: Wonder
82052.FlavorText:
"It fell silently from the sky and broke the surface without a ripple. Was it even here at all?"
—Fisherman's journal

82057.Name: Argivian Phalanx
82057.FlavorText: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.

82058.Name: Artillery Blast
82058.FlavorText: To conserve ammunition, Jhoira modified ancient Thran artillery cannons to fire gouts of pure Shivan lava.

82059.Name: Benalish Faithbonder
82059.FlavorText: "A single light can hold back endless darkness."

82060.Name: Benalish Sleeper
82060.FlavorText: Even he didn't know what he was until he felt his skin shifting and splitting, his mind overtaken by a chaos of whispers.

82061.Name: Captain's Call
82061.FlavorText:
"Argivia's walls may run on powerstones, but its real power comes from its people."
—King Darien XLVIII

82062.Name: Charismatic Vanguard
82062.FlavorText: "This battlefield is an anvil, my mace a forging hammer . . . and you, Phyrexian scum, are the scrap metal that's about to be reshaped as I see fit."

82063.Name: Citizen's Arrest
82063.FlavorText: "What lurks behind the faces of those you think you can trust?"

82065.Name: Clockwork Drawbridge
82065.FlavorText: Argivia's clockwork fortifications are the stuff of legend, reminding all on Dominaria that ingenuity has saved them before and can do so again.

82069.Name: Destroy Evil
82069.FlavorText: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

82070.Name: Griffin Protector
82070.FlavorText: Griffin flocks still patrol the skies above the Zhalfirin void, as though they are waiting for their old home to reappear.

82073.Name: Join Forces
82073.FlavorText:
"Okay—you take the sixteen ragers and the hulk on the right. I'll take the ten defilers and the plaguelord on the left. Ready?"
—Danitha, to Radha

82074.Name: Juniper Order Rootweaver
82074.FlavorText: "What Phyrexia takes, the grace of Freyalise shall replenish."

82075.Name: Knight of Dawn's Light
82075.FlavorText: "Phyrexians destroyed my village, but they cannot break my hope."

82077.Name: Love Song of Night and Day

82078.Name: Mesa Cavalier
82078.FlavorText: In the fight to defeat Phyrexia, the courage of Benalish knights is matched only by that of their pegasus steeds.

82080.Name: Prayer of Binding
82080.FlavorText: When a Phyrexian agent cannot be killed, they must be contained.

82081.Name: Resolute Reinforcements
82081.FlavorText: Morale rarely survives the sudden appearance of a squad of Sursi skirmishers at an army's flank.

82083.Name: Samite Herbalist
82083.FlavorText: "Spiritual wholeness is not something you can give to yourself: it is attained only through the divine blessing of healing another."

82085.Name: Shalai's Acolyte
82085.FlavorText: Armed by Multani, she protected the forest from above.

82087.Name: Take Up the Shield
82087.FlavorText: "You are all part of my pride. As long as I live, I will protect you."

82088.Name: Temporary Lockdown
82088.FlavorText: "Any one of us could be compromised," said Karn. "No one leaves until we know who can be trusted."

82090.Name: Valiant Veteran
82090.FlavorText: "Let them come. We will show them that Argivian steel is stronger than any Phyrexian metal."

82092.Name: Academy Loremaster
82092.FlavorText: As a young student, she dusted the shelves of Tolaria's great library. Now, she writes the books that line them.

82093.Name: Academy Wall
82093.FlavorText: Once the Society of Mishra took control, the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam became a haven for dark research.

82097.Name: Coral Colony
82097.FlavorText: The seafloor is strewn with the wreckage of Vodalia's would-be conquerors.

82100.Name: Ertai's Scorn
82100.FlavorText: "You're not so special, Karn. Anything that has been assembled can be disassembled."

82101.Name: Essence Scatter
82101.FlavorText:
"Phyrexians pollute everything they touch, so the solution is simple: don't let them touch anything."
—Teferi

82104.Name: Haughty Djinn
82104.FlavorText: "I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic."

82105.Name: Haunting Figment
82105.FlavorText: Some bad dreams stay with you forever.

82107.Name: Impulse
82107.FlavorText:
"I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser."
—Teferi

82108.Name: Joint Exploration
82108.FlavorText: The Tolarians had the maps, but only the Yavimayans knew how to read them.

82109.Name: Micromancer
82109.FlavorText: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."

82110.Name: Negate
82110.FlavorText:
"It's frustrating, isn't it, to be so weak and ineffectual? Don't worry, you'll be compleat soon enough."
—Rona

82112.Name: Phyrexian Espionage
82112.FlavorText:
"Even if they're hunting for sleeper agents, who looks twice at a bird?"
—Rona

82116.Name: Shore Up
82116.FlavorText: Homarid shells are adapted to the crushing pressure of the deepest depths; on land, their sturdiness seems supernatural.

82117.Name: Silver Scrutiny
82117.FlavorText: Karn's creation allowed him to monitor events across Dominaria—and everything he saw worried him.

82118.Name: Soaring Drake
82118.FlavorText: The already spectacular views from the towers of the College at Lat-Nam are sometimes enhanced by glimpses of drakes diving into the ocean to devour small sharks.

82120.Name: Talas Lookout
82120.FlavorText:
"The Talas pirates are motivated by money, so we paid them twice what they could steal from us to spy for us instead."
—Jhoira

82121.Name: Tidepool Turtle
82121.FlavorText: Prized by wizards as a mobile scrying pool, it bears visions drawn from the depths of the sea.

82122.Name: Timely Interference
82122.FlavorText: Students fled with their research as Tolaria fell to the Phyrexians.

82123.Name: Tolarian Geyser
82123.FlavorText: "If they don't drown, perhaps they'll rust."

82124.Name: Tolarian Terror
82124.FlavorText: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.

82125.Name: Vesuvan Duplimancy
82125.FlavorText:
"There hasn't been an original thought on Vesuva in centuries."
—Emmest, Tolarian chronicler

82127.Name: Vodalian Hexcatcher
82127.FlavorText: "You're just one more pollutant to be removed from the sea."

82129.Name: Volshe Tideturner
82129.FlavorText: Ships suspected of carrying Sheoldred's agents have a tendency to drift far off course as they sail through the Voda Sea.

82130.Name: Aggressive Sabotage
82130.FlavorText: Squee's orders basically came down to "attack the squishy parts."

82132.Name: Battle-Rage Blessing
82132.FlavorText:
"Since when is it cheating to give one side an unfair advantage?"
—Braids

82133.Name: Battlefly Swarm
82133.FlavorText: Having encountered the bitter Phyrexian battleflies before, Squee knew not to bother eating them—or at least to stop after the fifth.

82134.Name: Blight Pile
82134.FlavorText:
"Keep your distance. It may be broken, but it's far from benign."
—Stenn

82135.Name: Bone Splinters
82135.FlavorText:
"Steel may be more durable, but nothing channels the spite of the unjustly dead like bone."
—Braids

82138.Name: Choking Miasma
82138.FlavorText: The Phyrexians were as surprised as anyone to discover they still needed to breathe.

82140.Name: Cult Conscript
82140.FlavorText: His eternal rest turned out to be more of a quick nap.

82141.Name: Cut Down
82141.FlavorText:
"There can be no mercy, no half measures. When facing Phyrexians, it's kill swiftly or die."
—Jodah

82143.Name: Drag to the Bottom
82143.FlavorText: Windgrace's gladehunters hibernate in the quagmires of Urborg until the scent of Phyrexian technology awakens their hunger.

82146.Name: Extinguish the Light
82146.FlavorText: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.

82147.Name: Gibbering Barricade
82147.FlavorText:
"Who needs stone walls when you can hide behind an impenetrable barrier of screaming nightmares?"
—Braids

82151.Name: Phyrexian Rager
82151.FlavorText:
"Resist if you must. It makes no difference. As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia."
—Sheoldred

82152.Name: Phyrexian Vivisector
82152.FlavorText: Before he was the Father of Machines, Yawgmoth was a twisted Thran physician, and his legacy of medical atrocities lives on in New Phyrexia.

82154.Name: Pilfer
82154.FlavorText: To the merchant, it was nothing more than a few missing trinkets. To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.

82156.Name: Sengir Connoisseur
82156.FlavorText: "We cannot afford to let the Phyrexians win. They taste terrible."

82158.Name: Shadow-Rite Priest
82158.FlavorText: Backstabbing is common within demonic cults. So are front- and side-stabbing.

82161.Name: Splatter Goblin
82161.FlavorText:
"For some, perfection is but a single moment when form and purpose converge."
—Rona

82163.Name: Tattered Apparition
82163.FlavorText:
"Ah yes, I remember that one. I turned him inside out and cast his soul into an endless nightmare a few centuries ago."
—Braids

82164.Name: Toxic Abomination
82164.FlavorText: Deep in the forgotten reaches of Urborg, ancient Phyrexian monstrosities shamble endlessly, putrid ichor leaking from their rusted forms.

82167.Name: Writhing Necromass
82167.FlavorText:
"We sent three of our best legions! You're telling me no one came back?"
—Tori D'Avenant

82170.Name: Coalition Warbrute
82170.FlavorText: Anger is his greatest weapon, and he sharpens it daily.

82174.Name: Electrostatic Infantry
82174.FlavorText:
"That's not exactly what I had in mind when I said ‘charge,' but I like your enthusiasm!"
—Balmor, battlemage captain

82175.Name: Fires of Victory
82175.FlavorText: The drums and horns were expected, but the goblin dance was a pleasant surprise.

82176.Name: Flowstone Infusion
82176.FlavorText: The rumor that contact with flowstone would reveal Phyrexian sleeper agents was spread mostly by Phyrexian sleeper agents.

82177.Name: Flowstone Kavu
82177.FlavorText: The kavu adjusted easily to the Rathi overlay, incorporating the invasive flowstone into their own adaptable forms.

82178.Name: Furious Bellow
82178.FlavorText: Minotaurs sometimes pretend to be lost in a battle rage, leading their opponents to underestimate their cleverness.

82180.Name: Goblin Picker
82180.FlavorText: Countless generations of Shivan goblins have worked on the Mana Rig, giving them an unparalleled eye for useful relics.

82182.Name: Hurler Cyclops
82182.FlavorText:
"It's my fault, really. I told him to throw anything he could find at the enemy."
—Throppel, auxiliary commander

82183.Name: Hurloon Battle Hymn
82183.FlavorText: The magical echoes of the Hurloon mountain range greatly increase the potency of spells based on song or speech.

82186.Name: Jaya's Firenado
82186.FlavorText:
"For all their supposed advances, the Phyrexians still aren't fireproof."
—Jaya Ballard

82189.Name: Lightning Strike
82189.FlavorText: Danitha watched in shock as electricity lanced from Jaya's fingertips, obliterating the charging Phyrexians. "What?" said the pyromancer serenely. "I told you I'd learned some new tricks."

82190.Name: Meria's Outrider
82190.FlavorText: Arrows fashioned from the living wood of Yavimaya carry all of the forest's rage in their fire-hardened points.

82191.Name: Molten Monstrosity
82191.FlavorText: The cold snap killed off most of the heat-loving hellions . . . leaving only the strongest alive to breed.

82195.Name: Shivan Devastator
82195.FlavorText: There were many reasons why Shiv was not high on Sheoldred's list of places to conquer: big, fiery reasons.

82200.Name: Thrill of Possibility
82200.FlavorText:
"The most delicious ingredients are often the most dangerous to obtain."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, The Underworld Cookbook

82201.Name: Twinferno
82201.FlavorText:
"More fire?" Jaya asked.
"More fire," Jodah agreed.

82203.Name: Warhost's Frenzy
82203.FlavorText: Keldons may be outnumbered, but they are never outmatched.

82206.Name: Barkweave Crusher
82206.FlavorText:
"Phyrexia may be ancient, but Gaea is eternal."
—Queen Allenal of Ruadach

82207.Name: Bite Down
82207.FlavorText:
"Yavimaya takes care of herself; the kavu are evidence of this. What does your Coalition offer that the forest cannot provide?"
—Jenson Carthalion

82209.Name: Broken Wings
82209.FlavorText:
"Serra guides our shots true. Also, I just tuned the cannons."
—Tiana

82211.Name: Deathbloom Gardener
82211.FlavorText: "I can provide the Coalition with poisons that will break down Phyrexian machinery as easily as they stop the heart."

82213.Name: Elfhame Wurm
82213.FlavorText: The wurms consume everything in their path, so the elves make sure that their path goes through as many Phyrexians as possible.

82214.Name: Elvish Hydromancer
82214.FlavorText: "Water remembers every living thing it has ever been a part of. We need only bring that recollection to the surface."

82216.Name: Gaea's Might
82216.FlavorText:
"Why fight over the lumber in a tree's trunk when its branches have room for all?"
—Multani

82219.Name: Leaf-Crowned Visionary
82219.FlavorText: "The seedling you save today may be the sheltering boughs of generations to come."

82222.Name: Llanowar Loamspeaker
82222.FlavorText: Twigs broken underfoot in Llanowar tend to return the favor.

82223.Name: Llanowar Stalker
82223.FlavorText: If you spot one elf in Llanowar, it's likely there's another with a knife at your back.

82224.Name: Magnigoth Sentry
82224.FlavorText: When one of Yavimaya's enormous magnigoth trees awakens into a treefolk, it is a towering presence of physical strength and ancient wisdom.

82225.Name: Mossbeard Ancient
82225.FlavorText: Older than the mountains, the dragons, and the wars of humans and machines.

82226.Name: Nishoba Brawler
82226.FlavorText: Though native to cold climates, the nishoba have adapted to more temperate environments since the Ice Age ended.

82231.Name: Snarespinner
82231.FlavorText: In the rich jungles of Yavimaya, bright colors are the perfect camouflage.

82232.Name: Strength of the Coalition
82232.FlavorText:
"Root and wing, claw and sword; this will be a memorable stand, indeed."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

82233.Name: Sunbathing Rootwalla
82233.FlavorText: A rootwalla's prey includes anything or anyone that wanders into view.

82235.Name: Tear Asunder
82235.FlavorText: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.

82236.Name: Territorial Maro
82236.FlavorText: The Coalition was more than just treaties and alliances: it was the soul of a world rising up against the invading tide.

82242.Name: Yavimaya Iconoclast
82242.FlavorText: Steel weapons hold a forbidden allure to some of the younger Yavimayans.

82243.Name: Yavimaya Sojourner
82243.FlavorText: To the long-lived treefolk, the Phyrexians invading again after only three centuries was as though they never left.

82245.Name: Aron, Benalia's Ruin
82245.FlavorText:
"He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone."
—Danitha

82247.Name: Baird, Argivian Recruiter
82247.FlavorText: "Fear doesn't make you a coward; giving in to it does. Now take up your sword and fight!"

82248.Name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
82248.FlavorText: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

82250.Name: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim
82250.FlavorText: "All will bow to the Whispering One."

82252.Name: Garna, Bloodfist of Keld
82252.FlavorText: "Let's see who gets more kills, Radha."

82258.Name: Meria, Scholar of Antiquity
82258.FlavorText: "Why fear artifice? Is it not also of this world?"

82263.Name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
82263.FlavorText: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

82264.Name: Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart
82264.FlavorText: "This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."

82268.Name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
82268.FlavorText: "Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of compleation."

82270.Name: Shanna, Purifying Blade
82270.FlavorText: Shanna had heard Sisay's legend all her life. Now it was time to forge her own.

82276.Name: Tura Kennerüd, Skyknight
82276.FlavorText: "The sky is my birthright. I dare you to try and take it from me."

82279.Name: Zar Ojanen, Scion of Efrava
82279.FlavorText: "I carry my home in my heart."

82281.Name: Automatic Librarian
82281.FlavorText: Enforcing absolute quiet with extreme prejudice since 3285 AR.

82283.Name: Hero's Heirloom
82283.FlavorText:
"A blade is just a tool. Its power comes from the hand that wields it."
—Danitha

82285.Name: Jodah's Codex
82285.FlavorText:
"If you remember nothing else of our world's history, remember this: Phyrexians can be defeated."
—Jodah

82287.Name: Meteorite
82287.FlavorText:
"Material at dig site 165-beta confirmed to be of Null Moon origin. Immediate excavation assistance requested."
—Tolarian field dispatch

82288.Name: Relic of Legends
82288.FlavorText:
"If the worst parts of history can repeat themselves, it stands to reason that the best parts can as well."
—Teferi

82289.Name: Salvaged Manaworker
82289.FlavorText:
"When weapons of war are repurposed for peaceful ends, you know society has advanced."
—Jodah

82291.Name: Timeless Lotus
82291.FlavorText: Urza exploited nature to power his war machines; in time, nature exploited his war machines to renew itself.

82292.Name: Vanquisher's Axe
82292.FlavorText: When a Keldon takes a trophy from an enemy, it's usually something they can use to kill more enemies.

82295.Name: Adarkar Wastes
82295.FlavorText: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

82296.Name: Caves of Koilos
82296.FlavorText: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

82297.Name: Contaminated Aquifer
82297.FlavorText: The caves stretch farther than anyone knows, and the terrible legacy of Yawgmoth lurks in every shadow.

82299.Name: Geothermal Bog
82299.FlavorText: There are still a few places where the natural dangers outweigh even those posed by Phyrexian sleeper agents.

82300.Name: Haunted Mire
82300.FlavorText: Some of the nature spirits and wraiths that haunt Urborg take offense at the term "ghost town."

82301.Name: Idyllic Beachfront
82301.FlavorText: In the tradition of the original Tolarian Academy, every Tolarian campus is built near a body of water.

82302.Name: Karplusan Forest
82302.FlavorText: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

82303.Name: Molten Tributary
82303.FlavorText: Though dangerous, Shiv teems with both life and mana, making it a tempting destination for ambitious mages.

82305.Name: Radiant Grove
82305.FlavorText: Yavimaya's inhabitants are dedicated to protecting its unspoiled jungle from the scourge of artifice.

82306.Name: Sacred Peaks
82306.FlavorText: Everyone is welcome in the floating Serran cities, though few but the most faithful attempt the ascent.

82307.Name: Shivan Reef
82307.FlavorText: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

82308.Name: Sulfurous Springs
82308.FlavorText: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

82309.Name: Sunlit Marsh
82309.FlavorText: Even the poisoned land around the Stronghold blossomed with new life in the wake of the Great Mending.

82310.Name: Tangled Islet
82310.FlavorText: Many of Terisiare's islands are merely extensions of the root system of the Yavimaya magnigoth forests.

82312.Name: Wooded Ridgeline
82312.FlavorText: The power of long-forgotten empires still pulses in the earth of Dominaria, giving rise to strange, mana-rich pockets of growth.

82313.Name: Yavimaya Coast
82313.FlavorText: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

82329.Name: Serra Redeemer
82329.FlavorText: "Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds."

82330.Name: Cosmic Epiphany
82330.FlavorText:
"All knowledge, past and future, is etched upon reality. Every answer we seek is out there, hidden only by the limits of our minds."
—Jodah

82332.Name: Ragefire Hellkite
82332.FlavorText:
"Well, the good news is that sound wasn't the volcano erupting . . ."
—George, Coalition scout

82333.Name: Briar Hydra
82333.FlavorText: Flora and fauna alike rose to Yavimaya's defense.

82347.Name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
82347.RawFrameDetail: alt B legendary PhyrexianLanguage, Phyrexian watermark (built into frame)

82348.Name: Ajani, Sleeper Agent
82348.RawFrameDetail: alt GW gold planeswalker PhyrexianLanguage, 4 abilities

82437.Name: Icingdeath, Frost Tongue
82437.RawFrameDetail: W token artifact legendary, has text box

82460.Name: Plains
82460.FlavorText: You've heard rumors of bandits along the Coast Way, but your journey so far has been surprisingly uneventful.
82460.RawFrameDetail: W basic Plains White Mana (White) mark

82461.Name: Plains
82461.FlavorText: Lady Bormul claims an owlbear has been trampling her fields, but there's something unnatural about the tracks it left behind.
82461.RawFrameDetail: W basic Plains White Mana (White) mark

82462.Name: Plains
82462.FlavorText: After spending all day trying to track down a rare tome, you're about to give up when you hear your name whispered from a dark alley.
82462.RawFrameDetail: W basic Plains White Mana (White) mark

82463.Name: Plains
82463.FlavorText: You arrive at Baldur's Gate with instructions to head straight to the heart of the rumor mill: the bakery.
82463.RawFrameDetail: W basic Plains White Mana (White) mark

82464.Name: Island
82464.FlavorText: As you sail past the imposing Seatower of Balduran, you realize that breaking your friend out of that prison will be much harder than you thought.
82464.RawFrameDetail: U basic Island Blue Mana (Blue) mark

82465.Name: Island
82465.FlavorText: As you gaze down upon Wyrm's Crossing, you hear distant cries of alarm, and you notice that all traffic on the bridge has come to a halt.
82465.RawFrameDetail: U basic Island Blue Mana (Blue) mark

82466.Name: Island
82466.FlavorText: You're about to disembark to find the harbormaster when you spot a merfolk darting underneath your ship.
82466.RawFrameDetail: U basic Island Blue Mana (Blue) mark

82467.Name: Island
82467.FlavorText: The ship's captain promised she'd get you safely to the Netherese ruin, but she is the one who just washed overboard.
82467.RawFrameDetail: U basic Island Blue Mana (Blue) mark

82468.Name: Swamp
82468.FlavorText: Now that you've clearly hit the "marsh" part of Lizard Marsh, you begin to worry about the "lizard" part.
82468.RawFrameDetail: B basic Swamp Black Mana (Black) mark

82469.Name: Swamp
82469.FlavorText: The sudden sinkhole was surprising enough, but nothing could have prepared you for the ancient city that was hidden underneath.
82469.RawFrameDetail: B basic Swamp Black Mana (Black) mark

82470.Name: Swamp
82470.FlavorText: The old wizard's experiments destroyed the castle centuries ago. So why does some of the rubble look recent?
82470.RawFrameDetail: B basic Swamp Black Mana (Black) mark

82471.Name: Swamp
82471.FlavorText: At the mouth of the sewer pipe, you realize it's massive enough that even a giant could walk through without stooping. That gives you an idea . . .
82471.RawFrameDetail: B basic Swamp Black Mana (Black) mark

82472.Name: Mountain
82472.FlavorText: As you explore the slums of the Outer City, you keep hearing rumors of a den of werewolves in the caves below Dusthawk Hill.
82472.RawFrameDetail: R basic Mountain Red Mana (Red) mark

82473.Name: Mountain
82473.FlavorText: Lord Jannath sent you to secure the mine from gnoll raiders, but so far you haven't seen any gnolls . . . or, for that matter, any miners.
82473.RawFrameDetail: R basic Mountain Red Mana (Red) mark

82474.Name: Mountain
82474.FlavorText: Rumor holds that powerful artifacts and untold wealth are hidden away in Ramazith's Tower, and today you plan to find out for yourself.
82474.RawFrameDetail: R basic Mountain Red Mana (Red) mark

82475.Name: Mountain
82475.FlavorText: As you pause mid-climb to catch your breath, you'd swear you can hear a heartbeat pulsing deep within the mountain.
82475.RawFrameDetail: R basic Mountain Red Mana (Red) mark

82476.Name: Forest
82476.FlavorText: You know that hiexel bark produces a lot of smoke when burned, but why would Rilsa Rael need so much of it?
82476.RawFrameDetail: G basic Forest Green Mana (Green) mark

82477.Name: Forest
82477.FlavorText: The lights in the cavern glow and fade, glow and fade in a rhythm that must have a deeper meaning, if only you can figure it out.
82477.RawFrameDetail: G basic Forest Green Mana (Green) mark

82478.Name: Forest
82478.FlavorText: You continue to mutter and complain as you trip over yet another gnarled root. From behind the nearest tree trunk, something mutters back.
82478.RawFrameDetail: G basic Forest Green Mana (Green) mark

82479.Name: Forest
82479.FlavorText: You're on your way home when you spot the gates of a strange city . . . one that isn't on the map and wasn't here when you traveled this path four days ago.
82479.RawFrameDetail: G basic Forest Green Mana (Green) mark

82485.Name: Aeronaut Cavalry
82485.FlavorText:
"The ground is where wars are waged, but the air is where they are won."
—Harbin, vanguard aviator

82487.Name: Ambush Paratrooper
82487.FlavorText: "It would be folly to fight a dragon engine head-on. Let's hit it from above."

82488.Name: Calamity's Wake
82488.FlavorText: The sylex's blast had razed the land, leaving behind only snow and sorrow. Urza stood alone in the sudden silence.

82489.Name: Deadly Riposte
82489.FlavorText:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

82490.Name: Disenchant
82490.FlavorText: "One down, several thousand more to go."

82492.Name: In the Trenches
82492.FlavorText: The battlefield became so pockmarked with craters and trenches that casualties were regularly attributed to "fell in a hole."

82494.Name: Kayla's Reconstruction
82494.FlavorText: Anyone can destroy a continent. Few have the vision to rebuild one.

82495.Name: Lay Down Arms
82495.FlavorText: She'll swing a blade all her life, but never again for war.

82496.Name: Loran of the Third Path
82496.FlavorText: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

82497.Name: Loran, Disciple of History
82497.FlavorText: Urza and Mishra may have been Tocasia's most famous students, but Loran was the true heir to her legacy.

82498.Name: Loran's Escape
82498.FlavorText: As Terisia City burned, Feldon pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run. Hope ran with her.

82499.Name: Mass Production
82499.FlavorText:
"I need an army, not a masterpiece. Accelerate output, whatever it takes."
—Urza, notes to his engineers

82500.Name: Meticulous Excavation
82500.FlavorText: "Remember, students, if it's glowing, humming, or whirring, don't touch it!"

82503.Name: Phalanx Vanguard
82503.FlavorText: The cool, sleek automatons beside her mirrored her own iron resolve.

82504.Name: Powerstone Engineer
82504.FlavorText: "Well there's your problem—resonance leak lowering output by thirty percent. I can patch that up."

82505.Name: Prison Sentence
82505.FlavorText: War prisoners were ineffective political pawns, as neither brother cared enough to trade for them.

82506.Name: Recommission
82506.FlavorText: "Put your backs into it! If we don't lay claim to it, the Fallaji will!"

82507.Name: Recruitment Officer
82507.FlavorText: "Every name on this list is already a hero! Will you add your own to it?"

82508.Name: Repair and Recharge
82508.FlavorText:
"Throw the bodies out. They'll just weigh down the frame."
—Rolf, Argivian mechanic

82509.Name: Siege Veteran
82509.FlavorText: "Steady, recruit. We fight in the light of justice. We cast no shadow."

82510.Name: Soul Partition
82510.FlavorText: Teferi's body couldn't travel through time far enough, but with Kaya's help, his spirit could.

82512.Name: Survivor of Korlis
82512.FlavorText: At first, the merchant state of Korlis saw no need to involve itself in the conflict between Yotia and the Fallaji. Mishra's dragon engines changed that.

82513.Name: Thopter Architect
82513.FlavorText: "She'll only fly once. Make it count!"

82514.Name: Tocasia's Welcome
82514.FlavorText: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."

82515.Name: Union of the Third Path
82515.FlavorText: Terisia City at last opened its ivory towers to all who sought respite from the endless war.

82516.Name: Warlord's Elite
82516.FlavorText: "The Warlord thinks we've gone soft, does he? The Fist of Progress will prove him wrong!"

82517.Name: Yotian Medic
82517.FlavorText:
"Go, save as many as you can! The city walls may be rubble, but Kroog will live on in its people."
—Queen Kayla bin-Kroog

82520.Name: Platoon Dispenser
82520.FlavorText:
"Hear that thud-clank, thud-clank? We're saved."
—Ani, Urzan soldier

82527.Name: Air Marshal
82527.FlavorText: "Today our blades remember Kroog! May the seven brass gods be with us!"

82528.Name: Curate
82528.FlavorText: "Aha! This must be one of the ancient keys to . . . No, wait. It's just another puzzle toy."

82530.Name: Desynchronize
82530.FlavorText: Before Kaya could pull Teferi's spirit back, the overloaded temporal anchor failed, and he was set adrift in the currents of time.

82531.Name: Drafna, Founder of Lat-Nam
82531.FlavorText: Alongside his wife, Hurkyl, Drafna built a legacy of scholarship that endured for millennia.

82533.Name: Flow of Knowledge
82533.FlavorText:
"Focus your mind. Do you hold a piece of the ocean or a thousand drops of rain?"
—Hurkyl

82534.Name: Forging the Anchor
82534.FlavorText: The metal turned and blossomed with Saheeli's will, each filigreed twist bringing the temporal anchor closer to completion.

82537.Name: Involuntary Cooldown
82537.FlavorText:
"Back to the ivory towers! This won't hold for long!"
—Vayor, Third Path cryomancer

82538.Name: Keeper of the Cadence
82538.FlavorText: "What you call magic, I call the power of memory."

82540.Name: Lat-Nam Adept
82540.FlavorText: "Every book is a doorway to enlightenment. Curiosity is your key."

82541.Name: Machine Over Matter
82541.FlavorText: The Warlord decreed that only someone who could move the statue was strong enough to marry the princess. So Urza moved it.

82544.Name: Retrieval Agent
82544.FlavorText: The humming tome burned his leather glove, nearly taking his hand along with it. Then a strange power coursed through him.

82545.Name: Scatter Ray
82545.FlavorText: Mishra's army demanded the secrets of the Third Path. Hurkyl's followers graciously showed them.

82546.Name: Skystrike Officer
82546.FlavorText: "Landing zone is clear. Activate and deploy!"

82547.Name: Splitting the Powerstone
82547.FlavorText: As the glowing stone broke apart, so too did the last shred of the brothers' bond.

82548.Name: Stern Lesson
82548.FlavorText:
"The brothers are brilliant, but their quarreling will be the death of me."
—Tocasia, journal entry

82549.Name: Take Flight
82549.FlavorText: Though neither brother cared to admit it, flying the ancient thopter was their last happy moment together.

82551.Name: Third Path Savant
82551.FlavorText: As Mishra's army bore down on Terisia City, Corlo felt his focus, his patience, and his willpower twine together. With a deep breath, he plucked answers from the air.

82552.Name: Thopter Mechanic
82552.FlavorText: "You want me to install a seat belt? Please. You're lucky to get a seat!"

82555.Name: Urza's Rebuff
82555.FlavorText:
"As usual, my brother's maneuvers are brash and impulsive."
—Urza

82557.Name: Wing Commando
82557.FlavorText: "The welds are weaker at the top."

82569.Name: Ashnod's Intervention
82569.FlavorText: "Listen, Duck. Gix is everywhere, playing every side. Mishra won't listen . . . but perhaps Urza will."

82570.Name: Battlefield Butcher
82570.FlavorText: "Any more giant metal monsters want to try their luck? I'm just getting warmed up!"

82571.Name: Carrion Locust
82571.FlavorText: No honor. No glory. No leftovers.

82572.Name: Corrupt
82572.FlavorText: "Most wise, most thoughtful, most powerful qadir," said the Gixian, "we offer whatever help we may give in your illustrious name."

82573.Name: Diabolic Intent
82573.FlavorText: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.

82574.Name: Disciples of Gix
82574.FlavorText: "Machines feel no fear, no sorrow, no hunger—only glorious purpose, true and pure."

82575.Name: Disfigure
82575.FlavorText: With a snap of metal like a strike of lightning, the tide of war shifted in Mishra's favor.

82576.Name: Dreams of Steel and Oil
82576.FlavorText: Mishra's nightmares of Phyrexia rang with screams of agony and groans of twisted metal. The sounds stayed with him long after he awoke.

82577.Name: Emergency Weld
82577.FlavorText: Scurrying repair bots quietly turned the tide of many battles, patching damaged automatons back into fighting form.

82578.Name: Fateful Handoff
82578.FlavorText:
"Get the sylex to Urza at any cost. Tell him to fill it with memories of the land."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

82580.Name: Gix's Caress
82580.FlavorText: "Show me all the delicious misery you've sown."

82582.Name: Gixian Infiltrator
82582.FlavorText: "Terisia City's fall is inevitable. My master's plan runs as sure and steady as the oil in my veins."

82583.Name: Gixian Puppeteer
82583.FlavorText: To some, desecration. To Gix, decoration.

82584.Name: Gixian Skullflayer
82584.FlavorText: "With every culling, we bring this world closer to compleation."

82585.Name: Gnawing Vermin
82585.FlavorText:
"Everyone warns about the sand and the food, but the rats are worse than both put together!"
—Sanwell, letter to his family

82586.Name: Go for the Throat
82586.FlavorText: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down. Mishra made her people pay for the insult.

82587.Name: Gruesome Realization
82587.FlavorText: Mishra was gone—all that remained was a machine wearing his face.

82590.Name: Kill-Zone Acrobat
82590.FlavorText: Her circus training proved surprisingly valuable on the battlefield.

82591.Name: Misery's Shadow
82591.FlavorText: In the ruins of Kroog, only anguish thrived.

82592.Name: Moment of Defiance
82592.FlavorText: "Well? What are you waiting for? Let's not keep the buzzards waiting."

82593.Name: No One Left Behind
82593.FlavorText: Dying for the cause is overrated.

82594.Name: Overwhelming Remorse
82594.FlavorText: Tocasia's face haunted his vision. The explosion still rung in his ears. Mishra kept running and never once looked back.

82595.Name: Painful Quandary
82595.FlavorText: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

82596.Name: Powerstone Fracture
82596.FlavorText:
"Move! When the powerstone blows, that behemoth will be nothing but a hole in the ground."
—Ashnod, to Hajar

82598.Name: Thran Vigil
82598.FlavorText: Glacian built his automatons to last, and last they did, beyond even the Thran themselves.

82599.Name: Thraxodemon
82599.FlavorText: Urza and Mishra weren't the only denizens of Terisiare to covet the powerstones' energy.

82600.Name: Trench Stalker
82600.FlavorText: It can hear a panicked heartbeat from a thousand paces away.

82602.Name: Clay Revenant
82602.FlavorText: Tawnos built his clay statues for durability, not knowing they'd keep fighting long after the war.

82604.Name: Goring Warplow
82604.FlavorText: Built to crush walls and wills in equal measure.

82608.Name: Transmogrant Altar
82608.FlavorText:
"The human body—like any other machine—can be stripped for parts."
—Ashnod

82609.Name: Transmogrant's Crown
82609.FlavorText: Fallaji soldiers hated seeing loved ones' faces among the transmogrants. Ashnod devised a solution.

82610.Name: Arms Race
82610.FlavorText: "You want it good, fast, or cheap? You can't have all three."

82611.Name: Bitter Reunion
82611.FlavorText: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

82612.Name: Brotherhood's End
82612.FlavorText: The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.

82613.Name: Conscripted Infantry
82613.FlavorText: "Funny," remarked Laga to his squad. "Mishra's lackeys wear luxurious silks in their gilded palaces, while we toil in the trenches eating stale bread."

82616.Name: Excavation Explosion
82616.FlavorText: Urza's engineers could take weeks to dig out a powerstone. The goblins weren't so painstaking.

82617.Name: The Fall of Kroog
82617.FlavorText: As retaliation for the Warlord's ambush at the peace summit, Mishra leveled Yotia's capital city.

82618.Name: Fallaji Chaindancer
82618.FlavorText: She was eager to show the invading Yotians how she earned her nickname, "The Sandstorm of Tomakul."

82620.Name: Giant Cindermaw
82620.FlavorText:
"Don't excavate too far into those canyons. I promised your parents I'd return you in one piece."
—Tocasia

82621.Name: Goblin Blast-Runner
82621.FlavorText: Most goblins can light a fuse and run, but only the cleverest remember to drop the bomb.

82623.Name: Mechanized Warfare
82623.FlavorText: First the automatons reinforced depleted squads. Then they replaced them entirely.

82624.Name: Mishra, Excavation Prodigy
82624.FlavorText: While Urza read books, Mishra learned to read the desert itself.

82626.Name: Mishra's Domination
82626.FlavorText: Power radiated from the Weakstone, binding the dragon engine to Mishra's command.

82627.Name: Mishra's Onslaught
82627.FlavorText:
"Hah. Urza has underestimated my strength yet again."
—Mishra

82628.Name: Monastery Swiftspear
82628.FlavorText: She focused her mind on the volcano's fury, and hers erupted in kind.

82629.Name: Obliterating Bolt
82629.FlavorText: In desperation, Pero called on his memory of a lightning storm that nearly killed his family. When he opened his eyes, only smoke and dust remained.

82631.Name: Penregon Strongbull
82631.FlavorText: His child-lifting act was second only to his cauldron-punting routine.

82632.Name: Pyrrhic Blast
82632.FlavorText: Only the quartermaster wept for their loss.

82633.Name: Raze to the Ground
82633.FlavorText: First one, then a second, then a third of the ivory towers fell to the invaders, who moved in a circle around the city like an apocalyptic clock.

82634.Name: Roc Hunter
82634.FlavorText: "Never track the roc itself with your eyes, for it will swoop with the sun at its back and blind you. Instead, track its shadow and, when it's almost upon you, heave your javelin upward with all your might."

82635.Name: Sardian Cliffstomper
82635.FlavorText: When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves, they called upon the might of their neighbors for aid.

82638.Name: Tyrant of Kher Ridges
82638.FlavorText: In war, dragons don't see sides, just side dishes.

82639.Name: Unleash Shell
82639.FlavorText: The new cannon's destructive power more than made up for its unpredictable blast radius.

82641.Name: Whirling Strike
82641.FlavorText:
"I will trust desert steel in Fallaji hands over a soulless machine any day."
—Hajar, Mishra's bodyguard

82642.Name: Blitz Automaton
82642.FlavorText: While Urza's machines favored defense, Mishra built his to end the war quickly.

82648.Name: Mishra, Lost to Phyrexia
82648.RawFrameDetail: BR gold legendary artifact oversized back side

82651.Name: Alloy Animist
82651.FlavorText: "This metal belonged to Argoth before it was ripped from the ground. Now it belongs to Argoth again."

82653.Name: Argothian Sprite
82653.FlavorText:
"Make the exhaust vents smaller next time!"
—Urza, notes to his engineers

82655.Name: Awaken the Woods
82655.FlavorText:
"We expected the Argothians to stand their ground. We didn't expect the ground itself to stand."
—Myrel, Shield of Argive

82656.Name: Blanchwood Armor
82656.FlavorText: Some armor is forged, some is forested.

82658.Name: Burrowing Razormaw
82658.FlavorText:
"That's odd. I don't remember seeing plans to dig a trench near here."
—Lognell, Argivian scout

82660.Name: Citanul Stalwart
82660.FlavorText: The endless grind of the Brothers' War had fouled Terisiare's land and blackened its skies. Argoth's defenders were determined to protect their isle from the same fate.

82661.Name: Epic Confrontation
82661.FlavorText:
"You've let yourself grow old, and your light is dimming. Shall we talk one last time, or must I slay you now?"
—Mishra, to Urza

82662.Name: Fade from History
82662.FlavorText: After a long hibernation, Argoth began slowly recovering from the ravages of war.

82663.Name: Fallaji Excavation
82663.FlavorText: Few relics excited Fallaji archaeologists more than Thran powerstones, which they called "eyes of the Old Ones."

82664.Name: Fauna Shaman
82664.FlavorText: "I call on both predators and protectors, for now is a season of war."

82665.Name: Fog of War
82665.FlavorText: So thick was the fog on Argoth's shores that the brothers' forces passed within shouting distance of each other without realizing it.

82666.Name: Gaea's Courser
82666.FlavorText: "Even the leaves oppose your being here. What hope have you against nature's might?"

82667.Name: Gaea's Gift
