82667.FlavorText: When it came to fighting an army of trees, even Mishra's best generals were stumped.

82668.Name: Giant Growth
82668.FlavorText:
"Imagine being scared of pixies. Just smoosh them under your boot!"
—Kerish, Urzan mechanist

82669.Name: Gnarlroot Pallbearer
82669.FlavorText: The flames of war consumed most of Argoth's treefolk. Vengeance consumed the rest.

82671.Name: Hoarding Recluse
82671.FlavorText: To the spiders of Argoth, thopters were just bigger, crunchier flies.

82673.Name: Perimeter Patrol
82673.FlavorText: The Fallaji quickly learned that the Kher Ridges held too many caves and valleys to be surveyed from the air alone.

82674.Name: Sarinth Steelseeker
82674.FlavorText: "This metal junk is ugly, but it's got its uses."

82675.Name: Shoot Down
82675.FlavorText: Gwenna stayed her hand only once, to save young Harbin's life—a mistake she would never repeat.

82676.Name: Tawnos's Tinkering
82676.FlavorText: While his master tried to surpass nature, Tawnos aimed to capture its beauty.

82680.Name: Tomakul Honor Guard
82680.FlavorText: In the Great Desert, one law is enforced over all others: water belongs to all.

82681.Name: Wasteful Harvest
82681.FlavorText: Once the brothers discovered the pristine island of Argoth, the war came down to who could plunder it faster.

82682.Name: Boulderbranch Golem
82682.FlavorText:
"Artifice is not the only form of creation."
—Titania

82683.Name: Cradle Clearcutter
82683.FlavorText: A thousand years of growth, harvested in minutes.

82684.Name: Haywire Mite
82684.FlavorText:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

82689.Name: Rust Goliath
82689.FlavorText:
"You know those seedpods cluttering the eastern approach? I've got an idea . . . ."
—Calle, Urzan sergeant

82693.Name: Deathbloom Ritualist
82693.FlavorText: Each fallen friend was a seed of regret, eager to blossom again in Gaea's name.

82694.Name: Evangel of Synthesis
82694.FlavorText: "Forge the future in metal and oil!"

82695.Name: Fallaji Vanguard
82695.FlavorText: "The Burnished Banner will show the Warlord that the Suwwardi Marches belong to the Fallaji!"

82696.Name: Hajar, Loyal Bodyguard
82696.FlavorText: "I've stood by Mishra's side from the beginning. I will not abandon him now."

82697.Name: Harbin, Vanguard Aviator
82697.FlavorText: "Yotia is my birthright, father. Let me fight for it."

82698.Name: Hero of the Dunes
82698.FlavorText: History forgot her name but not her victories.

82700.Name: Legions to Ashes
82700.FlavorText:
"For the love of the seven brass gods, it's a city of academics! How are they doing this?"
—Sharaman, Urzan lieutenant

82701.Name: Mishra, Claimed by Gix
82701.RawFrameDetail: BR gold legendary front side TDFC

82705.Name: Sarinth Greatwurm
82705.FlavorText: It felt the rumblings of war and uncoiled itself from the depths of the world.

82707.Name: Tawnos, the Toymaker
82707.FlavorText: "Don't thank me. Thank nature for its wondrous designs!"

82708.Name: Third Path Iconoclast
82708.FlavorText: "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. I merely propose expanding our toolbox."

82710.Name: Urza, Lord Protector
82710.RawFrameDetail: WU gold legendary front side TDFC

82711.Name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
82711.FlavorText: The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.

82712.Name: Yotian Dissident
82712.FlavorText: "I joined this war to protect my homeland, not to destroy someone else's."

82713.Name: Yotian Tactician
82713.FlavorText: "Time for the Iron Alliance to remind the qadir's army how inhospitable the Sword Marches can be."

82716.Name: Aeronaut's Wings
82716.FlavorText: Volunteers rarely questioned why the airborne battalion always seemed to be recruiting.

82717.Name: Argivian Avenger
82717.FlavorText: Unable to settle on just one versatile being, Urza decided to create myriad adaptable machines.

82720.Name: Goblin Firebomb
82720.FlavorText:
"And if this works, Tawnos is gonna let us build the full-sized version!"
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

82724.Name: Urza, Planeswalker
82724.RawFrameDetail: WU planeswalker oversized back side, six ability

82725.Name: Mine Worker
82725.FlavorText: Following his hunger for knowledge and power from the past, Urza starved Dominaria's future.

82726.Name: Portal to Phyrexia
82726.FlavorText: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.

82727.Name: Power Plant Worker
82727.FlavorText: Mechanical workers toiled away, tirelessly fueling the impossible.

82728.Name: Reconstructed Thopter
82728.FlavorText: From above, the brothers noticed strange glyphs etched into the desert sand.

82731.Name: The Stasis Coffin
82731.FlavorText: Tawnos built it to be absolutely impermeable to any force inside. Luckily it worked for any force outside as well.

82732.Name: Steel Exemplar
82732.FlavorText: Reports differed on whether the figure was an automaton or a mage, mostly because few who saw it survived.

82734.Name: Stone Retrieval Unit
82734.FlavorText: Automatons could be rebuilt. Powerstones could not.

82736.Name: Supply Drop
82736.FlavorText: New armaments, fresh provisions, and best of all, dry socks.

82737.Name: Swiftgear Drake
82737.FlavorText: Inspired by fishing raptors, Tawnos designed the drake's talons to seize prey with overwhelming speed and precision.

82738.Name: Symmetry Matrix
82738.FlavorText:
"Achieving perfection is simple. Watch, I'll do it twice."
—Mishra

82741.Name: Tower Worker
82741.FlavorText: Even Urza's most mundane creations shared his obsession with perfection.

82744.Name: Battlefield Forge
82744.FlavorText:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—The Antiquities War

82746.Name: Brushland
82746.FlavorText:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—The Antiquities War

82748.Name: Evolving Wilds
82748.FlavorText:
"There's a certain beauty in destruction. Some will consider this war a masterpiece."
—Ashnod

82750.Name: Hall of Tagsin
82750.FlavorText: The Thran's machines were not dead after all, merely dormant . . . and waiting.

82751.Name: Llanowar Wastes
82751.FlavorText:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—The Antiquities War

82753.Name: Tocasia's Dig Site
82753.FlavorText: Sent by their noble parents to toughen up and learn something of the world's past, Urza and Mishra instead uncovered Terisiare's future.

82754.Name: Underground River
82754.FlavorText:
"The war polluted the land, turning what had once been fruitful fields into fetid morasses of mud and rusted corpses."
—The Antiquities War

82755.Name: Rescue Retriever
82755.FlavorText: It brings the two things weary soldiers need most: medicine and morale.

82794.Name: Mishra, Tamer of Mak Fawa
82794.FlavorText:
"With the Brotherhood of Gix whispering in his ear, Mishra's drive to prove himself was slowly twisted into an insatiable hunger for power."
—The Antiquities War

82795.Name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
82795.FlavorText:
"At heart, Urza was an inventor, not a warlord. Over time, the burdens of leadership left him as cold and calculating as his mechanical creations."
—The Antiquities War

82801.Name: Aetherflux Reservoir
82801.FlavorText: While most power is used for ordinary, everyday tasks, one shouldn't underestimate its potential for the extraordinary.

82802.Name: Altar of Dementia
82802.FlavorText:
"It is not that you will go mad. It is that you will beg for madness."
—Volrath

82803.Name: Ashnod's Altar
82803.FlavorText:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

82805.Name: Blackblade Reforged
82805.FlavorText: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

82806.Name: Bone Saw
82806.FlavorText: In a world where death is always violent, cruel weapons are as common as rocks.

82807.Name: Burnished Hart
82807.FlavorText: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

82809.Name: Chromatic Lantern
82809.FlavorText: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

82811.Name: Cloud Key
82811.FlavorText: The musical sound of its turning triggers the tumblers of revelation.

82812.Name: Defense Grid
82812.FlavorText: It lights up the sky, beckoning enemies only to repel them.

82813.Name: Door to Nothingness
82813.FlavorText: Only a monster could create such a door. Only a fool would open it.

82814.Name: Elsewhere Flask
82814.FlavorText: One night Oona bottled the sky. The next night she aligned the stars and released it.

82815.Name: Foundry Inspector
82815.FlavorText: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

82816.Name: Gilded Lotus
82816.FlavorText:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

82819.Name: Howling Mine
82819.FlavorText: The mine's riches never end, nor do the moans of the spirits doomed to haunt them.

82820.Name: Ichor Wellspring
82820.FlavorText:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

82821.Name: Inspiring Statuary
82821.FlavorText: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

82822.Name: Ivory Tower
82822.FlavorText: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

82823.Name: Jalum Tome
82823.FlavorText: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

82824.Name: Journeyer's Kite
82824.FlavorText:
"From the clouds, you can see as far as the distant horizon. It's a reminder of the infinite possibilities of everyday life."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

82825.Name: Keening Stone
82825.FlavorText: As it spins, dead voices shriek in an ever-increasing cacophony, rending the mind asunder.

82826.Name: Key to the City
82826.FlavorText: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

82827.Name: Liquimetal Coating
82827.FlavorText:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

82828.Name: Lodestone Golem
82828.FlavorText:
"Somehow it warps the aether. It brings a strange weight, a blockade in the flow of spellcraft."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

82830.Name: Mesmeric Orb
82830.FlavorText: A step in one direction is two steps away from another.

82831.Name: Millstone
82831.FlavorText: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

82832.Name: Mind's Eye
82832.FlavorText: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

82833.Name: Mishra's Bauble
82833.FlavorText:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

82834.Name: Mox Amber
82834.FlavorText: A moment in time made tangible, it has the power to realize epic visions.

82836.Name: Ornithopter
82836.FlavorText: Once a year, the skies over Paliano fill with the flying machines of those who hope to be taken on as pupils by the artificer Muzzio.

82837.Name: Perilous Vault
82837.FlavorText: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy. To disrupt one is to unleash devastation and chaos.

82839.Name: Phyrexian Revoker
82839.FlavorText:
"To be in the presence of a revoker is to be truly alone."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

82840.Name: Platinum Angel
82840.FlavorText: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.

82842.Name: Pristine Talisman
82842.FlavorText:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

82843.Name: Psychosis Crawler
82843.FlavorText:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

82844.Name: Quicksilver Amulet
82844.FlavorText: Those who examine the amulet too closely have been known to become part of its ornate carvings.

82847.Name: Runechanter's Pike
82847.FlavorText: As sharp as its bearer's words of faith.

82849.Name: Sculpting Steel
82849.FlavorText: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

82850.Name: Self-Assembler
82850.FlavorText: It sees itself in all of its creations.

82852.Name: Sigil of Valor
82852.FlavorText: With each honor he earns, Gideon paves the path to his redemption.

82854.Name: Springleaf Drum
82854.FlavorText: "The music is in the drum. I simply coax it out to be heard."

82856.Name: Sundering Titan
82856.FlavorText:
"Even if we defeat it, what remains to be saved?"
—Glissa Sunseeker

82857.Name: Swiftfoot Boots
82857.FlavorText:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

82859.Name: Thorn of Amethyst
82859.FlavorText: Mined from a cave in the Dark Meanders, it shines brightest when no one is looking.

82860.Name: Unwinding Clock
82860.FlavorText:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal

82861.Name: Well of Lost Dreams
82861.FlavorText: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

82864.Name: Aetherflux Reservoir
82864.FlavorText:
"These estimates are conservative. Its true capacity may be far, far greater."
—Research notes, signature illegible

82865.Name: Altar of Dementia
82865.FlavorText:
"My dreams have brought more visions from our master: an altar, exquisite and perfect. We must build it at once."
—Writings of Artonac, priest of Gix

82866.Name: Ashnod's Altar
82866.FlavorText:
"Blood fluting needs to be deeper. Additional hooks needed for nerve rigging. Surface stippling could be coarser."
—Ashnod, design notes

82868.Name: Blackblade Reforged
82868.FlavorText:
"Tempered in the blood of ten thousand sacrifices? Superstitious drivel."
—Mishra, note to his researchers

82869.Name: Bone Saw
82869.FlavorText:
"When metal instruments are scarce, a saw constructed from the subject's femur will suffice for a craniectomy."
—Ashnod, research notes

82870.Name: Burnished Hart
82870.FlavorText:
"The natural world has already solved our problems. Our challenge is to replicate the elegance of its solutions."
—Tawnos

82872.Name: Chromatic Lantern
82872.FlavorText:
"Feldon's latest discovery appears to draw upon the same ‘memories of the land' my wife studied. How I wish she could see it."
—Writings of Drafna

82874.Name: Cloud Key
82874.FlavorText:
"A key only unlocks a door. Its wielder must choose whether to cross the threshold."
—Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II

82875.Name: Defense Grid
82875.FlavorText:
"Properly installed, each powerstone emits a targeted electromagnetic field that halts momentum as sure as stone."
—Tome of Obstructions

82876.Name: Door to Nothingness
82876.FlavorText:
"I have re-created a Thran portal at last! Before I inform Lord Urza, I'll test it myself."
—Oryan, Urzan artificer, final research note

82877.Name: Elsewhere Flask
82877.FlavorText:
"My husband is clever enough to bottle the sky, and foolish enough to ignore its beauty."
—Queen Kayla bin-Kroog

82878.Name: Foundry Inspector
82878.FlavorText:
"Delicate resonance detectors could scan the assembly lines for metallic impurities, loose bolts, and freak occurrences of sentience."
—Tawnos, proposal for overseer prototype

82879.Name: Gilded Lotus
82879.FlavorText:
"The lotus is a potent but ephemeral source of power. To preserve its potency, lacquer carefully with a conductive coating."
—Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II

82882.Name: Howling Mine
82882.FlavorText:
"The Sardian dwarves have let superstition override common sense. There's plenty of ore left in the mountain, and we mustn't let it go to waste."
—Last dispatch of Bolgon, Argivian surveyor

82883.Name: Ichor Wellspring
82883.FlavorText:
"Should a single drop take hold, the oil begins to consume organic tissue and will multiply until it overwhelms the host."
—Yawgmoth, collected writings

82884.Name: Inspiring Statuary
82884.FlavorText:
"In the early days, Urza's wondrous automatons were seen as symbols of hope and courage."
—The Antiquities War

82885.Name: Ivory Tower
82885.FlavorText:
"Ringed by white stone, Terisia was a city of scholarship and knowledge, where magic promised a brighter future to a world devoured by artifice."
—The Antiquities War

82886.Name: Jalum Tome
82886.FlavorText:
"These glyphs describe a Thran device capable of controlling a machine army, but the dimensions make no sense. It's nearly the size of the Null Moon."
—Urza, diary

82887.Name: Journeyer's Kite
82887.FlavorText:
"Measure the angles carefully. Note the gauge of the paper. By your sixth birthday, I expect a flying prototype."
—Tawnos, letter to Harbin

82888.Name: Keening Stone
82888.FlavorText:
"The new prototype utilizing a rotational axis is marvelously effective: it makes me want to tear my own ears off."
—Ashnod, to her assistants

82889.Name: Key to the City
82889.FlavorText:
"Presented to the Chief Artificer in recognition of his unparalleled service to Yotia."
—Rusted plaque

82890.Name: Liquimetal Coating
82890.FlavorText:
"We've had a breakthrough on the fifth iteration. The subject's skin was entirely replaced within an hour, and he survived a full day after that!"
—Ashnod, to Mishra

82891.Name: Lodestone Golem
82891.FlavorText:
"Progress update: the problem of the slagheap blocking the entrance seems to have solved itself."
—Mine supervisor's report

82893.Name: Mesmeric Orb
82893.FlavorText:
"I now believe the strange orb was some kind of Thran security device. Supporting this theory, I can no longer recall where I found it."
—Tocasia, journal entry

82894.Name: Millstone
82894.FlavorText:
"In the lean months, communities lived off a bitterwheat berry so tough that its flour contained more millstone than grain."
—On the Early History of Keld

82895.Name: Mind's Eye
82895.FlavorText:
"I sit and I think of Lat-Nam, of the azure waves white with froth, suspended over the shore. I see the energy there and I call it here."
—Hurkyl, meditation notes

82896.Name: Mishra's Bauble
82896.FlavorText:
"The secrets of my great-uncle's heirloom lie in the world where it was forged: the grease-stained wastes of Phyrexia."
—Jarsyl, diary

82897.Name: Mox Amber
82897.FlavorText:
"A crystallized moment in time from the Mending Era, first discovered during the Ice Age. A temporal conundrum, even to the great scholar himself."
—The Discoveries of Feldon

82899.Name: Ornithopter
82899.FlavorText:
"Without Urza's ingenuity, the wings would never have borne weight. Without Mishra's courage, we would never have known the machine's true potential. I hope this persuades them to work together more."
—Tocasia, journal entry

82900.Name: Perilous Vault
82900.FlavorText:
"As the years passed, Urza turned his focus from the Thran to worlds beyond his own, seeking any spell or technology that might break the Phyrexian scourge."
—Urza: From Prodigy to Planeswalker

82902.Name: Phyrexian Revoker
82902.FlavorText:
"These skittering creatures were created to hunt the one true threat to Phyrexia: dissent."
—Venser, journal

82903.Name: Platinum Angel
82903.FlavorText:
"Serra built angels from the spirits of fallen warriors, but I believe a more mundane power source might suffice."
—Karn

82905.Name: Pristine Talisman
82905.FlavorText:
"A rakalite core paired with a powerstone matrix has significantly increased the healing effects of my original amulet design."
—Urza, research notes

82906.Name: Psychosis Crawler
82906.FlavorText:
"Perhaps drawing the impossible monster will lessen the burden my memory must bear."
—Jarsyl, diary

82907.Name: Quicksilver Amulet
82907.FlavorText:
"If powerstones are energy stored in material form, could we store matter as energy in the same way?"
—Rayne, research notes

82910.Name: Runechanter's Pike
82910.FlavorText:
"Harmonic resonance infusions amplify the natural abilities of the song mages of Sumifa."
—Drafna, research notes

82912.Name: Sculpting Steel
82912.FlavorText:
"Based on his early work with primal clay, Tawnos refined the rare metals in the earth into self-assembling strands."
—After the War

82913.Name: Self-Assembler
82913.FlavorText:
"Test 37: Sentience module is still too strong. It's adding ears again."
—Development log of Willa, Yotian artificer

82914.Name: Semblance Anvil
82914.FlavorText:
"The forges consumed all and still screamed for more."
—The Antiquities War

82915.Name: Sigil of Valor
82915.FlavorText:
"This war will be over quickly, so we can afford to make the medals out of gold."
—Dispatch from the Merchant Council of Korlis

82917.Name: Springleaf Drum
82917.FlavorText:
"It is neither the species of leaf nor the thickness of branch that creates music. Gaea's song is already in the drum."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

82919.Name: Sundering Titan
82919.FlavorText:
"Give the schematic to the younger brother. Tell him that it will surely keep Argoth's resources out of Urza's hands."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

82920.Name: Swiftfoot Boots
82920.FlavorText:
"Test 12: Boots now protect wearer from all hazards except blisters. Need to source better insoles."
—Development log of Willa, Yotian artificer

82922.Name: Thorn of Amethyst
82922.FlavorText:
"The geode must be mined in moonlight and broken open by a silver hammer."
—Tome of Obstructions

82923.Name: Unwinding Clock
82923.FlavorText:
"Heat from the rotating mechanism is captured and converted into energy, allowing it to operate in perpetuity."
—Rusko's Compendium of Clockwork

82924.Name: Well of Lost Dreams
82924.FlavorText:
"A wish can be controlled. Dreams are far more chaotic, and ungoverned by rationale."
—Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II

82943.Name: A-Zoological Study
82943.FlavorText: The detail really makes the monsters jump off the page.

83047.Name: Monologue Tax
83047.FlavorText:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology

83143.Name: Ophiomancer
83143.FlavorText: Her writhing, boneless movements are unsettling to humans, but hypnotic to her serpent brood.

83338.Name: Magmaw
83338.FlavorText:
"The purpose of existence is simple: everything is fuel for the magmaw."
—Jaji, magmaw worshipper

83387.Name: Tarmogoyf
83387.FlavorText: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

83473.Name: A-Cauldron Familiar
83473.FlavorText: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

83475.Name: A-Cauldron Familiar
83475.FlavorText: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

83478.Name: A-Skyclave Shadowcat
83478.FlavorText:
"Perhaps its distant ancestors were radiant felidars, but no hint of their nobility remains."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

83479.Name: A-Rockslide Sorcerer
83479.FlavorText: "You can cower from the crushing shards or embrace the danger of Akoum. I've made my choice."

83480.Name: A-Gnarlid Colony
83480.FlavorText: Where mana flows, the gnarlids follow.

83481.Name: A-Iridescent Hornbeetle
83481.FlavorText: The hatchlings will fill the jungles of Murasa in a glittering tide.

83484.Name: A-Umara Mystic
83484.FlavorText: "We tolerate the North Hada thieves' den, but cutthroats who wander downriver earn a skymanta ride out to sea."

83488.Name: A-Mentor's Guidance
83488.FlavorText: Kasmina had encouraged the twins to apply. Strixhaven would test not only their magical potential, but also their character.

83489.Name: A-Tenured Inkcaster
83489.FlavorText: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."

83490.Name: A-Ardent Dustspeaker
83490.FlavorText: "The Founder Dragons weren't even hatched when this scroll was written!"

83491.Name: A-Tome Shredder
83491.FlavorText:
"Quintorius, would you care to explain why you didn't complete your homework?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

83492.Name: A-Rowan, Scholar of Sparks
83492.RawFrameDetail: R planeswalker, 3 abilities, front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

83493.Name: A-Rowan, Scholar of Sparks
83493.RawFrameDetail: R planeswalker, 3 abilities, front side MFC, U reverse-side reminder

83494.Name: A-Will, Scholar of Frost
83494.RawFrameDetail: U planeswalker, 4 abilities, back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

83495.Name: A-Will, Scholar of Frost
83495.RawFrameDetail: U planeswalker, 4 abilities, back side MFC, R reverse-side reminder

83496.Name: A-Maelstrom Muse
83496.FlavorText: She's an inspiration to everyone, even herself.

83500.Name: A-Unholy Heat
83500.FlavorText: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

83505.Name: A-Cauldron Familiar
83505.FlavorText: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

83529.Name: Marwyn's Kindred
83529.FlavorText: "We are one family, connected by the sacred roots of Llanowar."

83532.Name: Wandering Treefolk
83532.FlavorText: "It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, Ichabod."

83539.Name: Slimefoot, Thallid Transplant
83539.FlavorText: At last, some room to grow.

83556.Name: Benalish Marshal
83556.FlavorText:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—History of Benalia

83560.Name: Seraph of Dawn
83560.FlavorText: She parts the clouds so sunlight can reach even the darkest lairs and duskiest tombs.

83561.Name: Serra Angel
83561.FlavorText: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

83563.Name: Star-Crowned Stag
83563.FlavorText: White as starlight on snow, it appears only on the eve of the winter solstice.

83564.Name: Steel-Plume Marshal
83564.FlavorText: The defenders watched in terror as the flying V split apart into a bristling battle formation.

83568.Name: Choking Tethers
83568.FlavorText: A wizard can be outnumbered but never outsmarted.

83569.Name: Contentious Plan
83569.FlavorText: Niv-Mizzet had perfected a plan, but he had no control over the mortal minds who had to agree to implement it.

83570.Name: Flood of Recollection
83570.FlavorText: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.

83572.Name: Hampering Snare
83572.FlavorText:
"I want it to look me in the eyes and know the face of the man who put it down."
—Kelsien, the Plague

83573.Name: Hard Evidence
83573.FlavorText: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.

83574.Name: Keep Safe
83574.FlavorText: "Coppercoats think they understand duty and loyalty, but they can't begin to fathom the depths of my bond."

83575.Name: Majestic Metamorphosis
83575.FlavorText: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

83576.Name: See the Truth
83576.FlavorText: "What is this that is neither future nor past?"

83578.Name: Stifle
83578.FlavorText:
"Superior force meets woefully inadequate object. What paradox were you expecting?"
—Azguri, archmage of Evos Isle

83579.Name: Suit Up
83579.FlavorText: With a reckless leap into the pilot's seat, Hirori went from smallest kid on the block to biggest hero in the city.

83580.Name: Teferi's Time Twist
83580.FlavorText: "The safest place for you is not now."

83583.Name: Black Dragon
83583.FlavorText: Black dragons revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms.

83584.Name: Bone Dragon
83584.FlavorText: Its roar is the clatter of a thousand bones.

83585.Name: Deathbloom Thallid
83585.FlavorText:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

83586.Name: Thallid Omnivore
83586.FlavorText: Thelon of Havenwood created thallids as a food source in times of darkness. Thallids did the same with saprolings.

83587.Name: Thallid Soothsayer
83587.FlavorText: Some of the thallids that escaped into the fens of Urborg began emulating the Cabal's bloodsoaked rituals in their own peculiar way.

83589.Name: Beetleback Chief
83589.FlavorText: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

83591.Name: Captivating Crew
83591.FlavorText: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

83592.Name: Demanding Dragon
83592.FlavorText: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

83593.Name: Ember Hauler
83593.FlavorText: Not every job in the goblin army is glamorous. Actually, no job in the goblin army is glamorous.

83594.Name: Fanatical Firebrand
83594.FlavorText:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

83596.Name: Goblin Chieftain
83596.FlavorText: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."

83598.Name: Goblin Trashmaster
83598.FlavorText: "Folks 'round here are too in love with their contraptions. Does them some good if we smash one every so often."

83599.Name: Goblin Warchief
83599.FlavorText: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

83604.Name: Ogre Battledriver
83604.FlavorText: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

83606.Name: Red Dragon
83606.FlavorText: Red dragons consider the world and every creature in it as theirs to command.

83608.Name: Shivan Dragon
83608.FlavorText: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

83610.Name: Skirk Prospector
83610.FlavorText:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

83613.Name: Thunderbreak Regent
83613.FlavorText: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

83614.Name: Wily Goblin
83614.FlavorText: Goblins climb and swing with ease, whether through a pirate ship's rigging or a tree's branches.

83617.Name: Fungal Plots
83617.FlavorText: Thallids nurture saprolings, entertain them, and eat them.

83618.Name: Llanowar Elves
83618.FlavorText: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

83619.Name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
83619.FlavorText: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

83620.Name: Saproling Migration
83620.FlavorText: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

83621.Name: Spore Crawler
83621.FlavorText:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

83622.Name: Spore Swarm
83622.FlavorText: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

83623.Name: Sporecrown Thallid
83623.FlavorText:
"The identifying ornamental growths of alpha thallids may be hereditary, or catalyzed by some chemical signal."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. III

83624.Name: Sporemound
83624.FlavorText:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

83627.Name: Verdant Force
83627.FlavorText: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

83628.Name: Yavimaya Sapherd
83628.FlavorText:
"When their community grows cluttered, thallids begin a traditional bobbing dance, then trek out in all directions."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. III

83629.Name: Blade Historian
83629.FlavorText: "So you see, the reckless battle strategy of the Kathorran orcs was effective, but ultimately proved to be a double-edged sword. As did their double-edged swords."

83631.Name: Rhizome Lurcher
83631.FlavorText:
"The dead gain new purpose here. What is strange in the eyes of other guilds is harmonious in ours."
—Devesh, Golgari shaman

83633.Name: Juggernaut
83633.FlavorText:
"Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves."
—Rona, disciple of Gix

83642.Name: A-Eyes of the Beholder
83642.FlavorText: In the end, there was nothing beautiful to be seen.

83647.Name: A-Steadfast Unicorn
83647.FlavorText: Only the good-hearted may set foot in a unicorn's domain.

83648.Name: A-Dragonborn Looter
83648.FlavorText: Erdur never thought of it as stealing. Treasure simply didn't deserve to be stuck underground where no one could admire it.

83654.Name: A-Eyes of the Beholder
83654.FlavorText: In the end, there was nothing beautiful to be seen.

83656.Name: A-Kenku Artificer
83656.FlavorText: Though her words may be unoriginal, her creations are anything but.

83657.Name: A-Pseudodragon Familiar
83657.FlavorText: Pseudodragons are favored companions of wizards, prized for their cunning and curiosity.

83658.Name: A-Guildsworn Prowler
83658.FlavorText: "Of course it's part of my plan. Who do you think started the bar fight?"

83659.Name: A-Young Blue Dragon
83659.FlavorText: "I see the far side of tomorrow and the lost memories of queens. What do you wish to learn?"

83660.Name: A-Sand Augury
83660.FlavorText: "I see the far side of tomorrow and the lost memories of queens. What do you wish to learn?"

83662.Name: A-Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
83662.FlavorText: The essence of a red dragon burns within, always ready to rise with wrath.

83663.Name: A-Young Red Dragon
83663.FlavorText: For most, deadly. For a dragon, decadent.

83664.Name: A-Bathe in Gold
83664.FlavorText: For most, deadly. For a dragon, decadent.

83666.Name: A-Druidic Ritual
83666.FlavorText: Bone, root, and seed—the past, present, and future in one handful of earth.

83667.Name: A-Emerald Dragon
83667.FlavorText: Emerald dragons hate prying eyes, and they have a host of ways to deter them.

83668.Name: A-Dissonant Wave
83668.FlavorText: Emerald dragons hate prying eyes, and they have a host of ways to deter them.

83670.Name: A-Split the Spoils
83670.FlavorText: "That half is yours. These halves are mine."

83672.Name: A-Navigation Orb
83672.FlavorText: Travel the world without ever leaving the comfort of home.

83677.Name: Plains
83677.RawFrameDetail: W full art Plains, atomic symbol

83678.Name: Island
83678.RawFrameDetail: U full art Island, atomic symbol

83679.Name: Swamp
83679.RawFrameDetail: B full art Swamp, atomic symbol

83680.Name: Mountain
83680.RawFrameDetail: R full art Mountain, atomic symbol

83681.Name: Forest
83681.RawFrameDetail: G full art Forest, atomic symbol

83689.Name: Goring Warplow
83689.FlavorText: Built to crush walls and wills in equal measure.

83691.Name: Blitz Automaton
83691.FlavorText: While Urza's machines favored defense, Mishra built his to end the war quickly.

83694.Name: Boulderbranch Golem
83694.FlavorText:
"Artifice is not the only form of creation."
—Titania

83695.Name: Cradle Clearcutter
83695.FlavorText: A thousand years of growth, harvested in minutes.

83698.Name: Rust Goliath
83698.FlavorText:
"You know those seedpods cluttering the eastern approach? I've got an idea . . . ."
—Calle, Urzan sergeant

83702.Name: Annex Sentry
83702.FlavorText: There's never a need to change the watch, for the servants of Norn are sleepless.

83703.Name: Apostle of Invasion
83703.FlavorText: "Be not afraid of the holy chorus. Join in rapturous harmony."

83705.Name: Bladed Ambassador
83705.FlavorText: "Let those thanebound dissenters prattle about their dead god. I serve the Mother of Machines, and in her name I carve out their heresy."

83707.Name: Compleat Devotion
83707.FlavorText: "Elspeth, my friend, the Multiverse has answered my prayers to bring you here so that I may gather you into my pride and forever protect you."

83708.Name: Crawling Chorus
83708.FlavorText: "We need not be swift. We are inexorable."

83709.Name: Duelist of Deep Faith
83709.FlavorText: "There is no hate behind our blades. We kill out of love, and the desire to share Norn's blessings with all."

83713.Name: Goldwarden's Helm
83713.FlavorText: "My mother wore this into battle against the first Phyrexians. Now I wear it in her honor."

83715.Name: Incisor Glider
83715.FlavorText:
"You think it's creepy now? You should see how it eats."
—Melira

83718.Name: Jawbone Duelist
83718.FlavorText: "I have room for a few more teeth in my collection. Who's next?"

83720.Name: Leonin Lightbringer
83720.FlavorText: "It's hard to fight for the future if you can't see the way forward."

83721.Name: Mandible Justiciar
83721.FlavorText: While one mouth feeds, the other chatters mindless paeans of Elesh Norn's glory.

83725.Name: Orthodoxy Enforcer
83725.FlavorText: The mites sniff out any potential interlopers. He handles the rest.

83726.Name: Ossification
83726.FlavorText: Only Elesh Norn's most loyal servants are granted the honor of becoming part of her throne.

83728.Name: Planar Disruption
83728.FlavorText: New Phyrexia's planar defenses scattered the Planeswalker strike team on arrival. Elesh Norn knew they were coming.

83729.Name: Plated Onslaught
83729.FlavorText:
"Witness the glory of true, unwavering unity."
—Ajani

83730.Name: Porcelain Zealot
83730.FlavorText: "There is a single, glorious truth, etched in the hearts of the faithful. Join in unity, or be washed away."

83731.Name: Resistance Reunited
83731.FlavorText: "Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes!" said Koth. "I was about to say the same, my friend," Elspeth replied.

83732.Name: Sinew Dancer
83732.FlavorText: He spreads word of the Argent Etchings to a captive audience.

83735.Name: Swooping Lookout
83735.FlavorText:
"It's hard to tell with this glare, but those must be the skyhunter reinforcements! They have arrived at last!"
—Prahan, Mirran rebel

83736.Name: Vanish into Eternity
83736.FlavorText: Faced with a blast that would level not only New Phyrexia, but also a dozen innocent worlds, Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.

83737.Name: Veil of Assimilation
83737.FlavorText:
"Hear only harmony. See only glory. Speak only truth."
—Atraxa

83740.Name: Aspirant's Ascent
83740.FlavorText: For the aspirants of the Progress Engine, being launched into the sphere's upper reaches is a great honor. Some are even granted wings beforehand.

83741.Name: Atmosphere Surgeon
83741.FlavorText: It is Jin-Gitaxias's deepest exasperation that any part of his domain still requires maintenance.

83743.Name: Blue Sun's Twilight
83743.FlavorText:
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned."
—Monument inscription

83744.Name: Bring the Ending
83744.FlavorText: Kaya watched in horror as the illusion vanished from her hands. Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.

83745.Name: Chrome Prowler
83745.FlavorText: It can catch a rat and perform a spinal tap with one graceful swipe of its paw.

83746.Name: Distorted Curiosity
83746.FlavorText: "Free will was an illusion so perfect it fooled even me. I know better now."

83747.Name: Encroaching Mycosynth
83747.FlavorText:
"Careful—however they might look, they're not human. A step too close and they'll drag you in."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

83748.Name: Escaped Experiment
83748.FlavorText: One morning, the test subject decided to perform trials on the scientists.

83751.Name: Font of Progress
83751.FlavorText:
"Drink deeply of the truth, and become compleat."
—Tamiyo

83752.Name: Gitaxian Anatomist
83752.FlavorText: An inconsistency in a routine vivisection sparked a revelation about the inner workings of the Orthodoxy's centurions.

83753.Name: Gitaxian Raptor
83753.FlavorText: Bored with the ruins of Lumengrid, it migrated to the ruins of the Mephidross.

83754.Name: Glistener Seer
83754.FlavorText: "The oil is all-knowing. The trick is to ask the right questions."

83755.Name: Ichor Synthesizer
83755.FlavorText: "I've isolated the chirality of the glistening oil, so there will be no wasted precursors."

83758.Name: Malcator's Watcher
83758.FlavorText: Each of the Gitaxian sectives watches the others, looking for any hint of imperfection.

83759.Name: Meldweb Curator
83759.FlavorText:
"Imagine a giant room, like a library . . . except instead of books, it's filled with body parts."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

83764.Name: Minor Misstep
83764.FlavorText: No matter how many times he saw it, Sarnvax always relished the look of dawning horror as his foes realized their mistake.

83765.Name: Prologue to Phyresis
83765.FlavorText: "Please, for science, tell me how it feels. Leave nothing out."

83766.Name: Quicksilver Fisher
83766.FlavorText: It no longer needs to eat, but old instincts are put to use ridding the Surgical Bay of spies.

83767.Name: Reject Imperfection
83767.FlavorText:
"Your theory holds merit. You do not."
—Sarnvax, Gitaxian sective

83768.Name: Serum Snare
83768.FlavorText: "I bring a message from the Autonomous Furn—argh!"

83769.Name: Tamiyo's Immobilizer
83769.FlavorText: Visitors to the Surgical Bay often become permanent residents.

83770.Name: Tamiyo's Logbook
83770.FlavorText:
"We are opening a new chapter in the one true story of Phyrexia. Someone must record it for posterity."
—Tamiyo

83777.Name: Vivisurgeon's Insight
83777.FlavorText: "Experimental Log 290: Leaving the subject's pain receptors active appears to yield an unprecedented combination of incoherence and hyperawareness."

83778.Name: Watchful Blisterzoa
83778.FlavorText: After a series of ambushes, Uulbrek demanded a sentry with no blind spots.

83779.Name: Ambulatory Edifice
83779.FlavorText: The Mirran forces thought they'd vanquished their foes . . . until a nearby monument got up and started stalking toward them.

83780.Name: Annihilating Glare
83780.FlavorText: By gaze, sting, and claw, Vraska will see the will of Phyrexia done.

83781.Name: Anoint with Affliction
83781.FlavorText: Many vatkeepers use necrogen etchings to judge the value of their aspirants. If the wounds rot and fester, the recipient is not worth further effort.

83783.Name: Bilious Skulldweller
83783.FlavorText:
"Watch your footing around here. Anything you might step on probably has teeth."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

83784.Name: Black Sun's Twilight
83784.FlavorText:
"Where once there was complacence, Sheoldred brought ambition, and soon the will of Yawgmoth reigned."
—Monument inscription

83786.Name: Bonepicker Skirge
83786.FlavorText:
"Get away from there! I must rebuild that one for the next bout. Shoo, shoo!"
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor

83787.Name: Chittering Skitterling
83787.FlavorText: What cannot be remade will be unmade, one scrap at a time.

83788.Name: Cruel Grimnarch
83788.FlavorText: The gospel of lies sounds sweetest when whispered by many mouths.

83789.Name: Cutthroat Centurion
83789.FlavorText: "We both serve the Demon Thane. Your parts would better serve with me."

83791.Name: Drown in Ichor
83791.FlavorText: Sinking into the Dross is neither a gentle death nor a quiet one. But once the necrogen takes hold, it is inevitable.

83792.Name: Duress
83792.FlavorText:
"Give of yourself, for compleation awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred

83793.Name: Feed the Infection
83793.FlavorText: They wished to become vital parts of the Dross Pits. Azax-Azog granted their request.

83794.Name: Fleshless Gladiator
83794.FlavorText: What she lacks in skin she makes up in swagger.

83795.Name: Geth, Thane of Contracts
83795.FlavorText: "It seems someone forgot to read the fine print."

83796.Name: Gulping Scraptrap
83796.FlavorText:
"Does anyone else hear that horrible crunching sound?"
—Jace

83797.Name: Infectious Inquiry
83797.FlavorText: "I give you pain, you give me information. A simple trade, is it not?"

83802.Name: Offer Immortality
83802.FlavorText: "Give all you are to Phyrexia, and you will receive more than you could have ever desired."

83803.Name: Pestilent Syphoner
83803.FlavorText: The praetors of the other Spheres privately wonder how Sheoldred always has a surplus of glistening oil at her disposal.

83804.Name: Phyrexian Arena
83804.FlavorText: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.

83805.Name: Phyrexian Obliterator
83805.FlavorText:
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain."
—Sheoldred

83806.Name: Ravenous Necrotitan
83806.FlavorText: Some of Sheoldred's goliaths spread the glory of Phyrexia. Others just eat.

83807.Name: Scheming Aspirant
83807.FlavorText: "I have raised many of my own contenders for the Coliseum. This one will be fearsome one day, mark my words."

83809.Name: Sheoldred's Headcleaver
83809.FlavorText: The punishment for sedition, like every other crime in the Dross Pits, is execution.

83810.Name: Stinging Hivemaster
83810.FlavorText: From within its form, a single word echoed forth: "Devour."

83811.Name: Testament Bearer
83811.FlavorText: She proudly carries the weight of Phyrexia's creed, both figuratively and literally.

83812.Name: Vat Emergence
83812.FlavorText: The first rebirth is a reward. The fifty-first is a punishment.

83814.Name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
83814.FlavorText: "Soon enough each praetor will have hired me to kill the others, and I will stand alone as the true Father of Machines."

83816.Name: Vraska's Fall
83816.FlavorText: The dull, creeping pain of phyresis curdled in Vraska's blood. She knew as soon as it took her, she would betray everything—even Jace.

83817.Name: Whisper of the Dross
83817.FlavorText: "Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now."

83818.Name: All Will Be One
83818.FlavorText: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.

83819.Name: Awaken the Sleeper
83819.FlavorText:
"Without faith in each other, we truly would have nothing left. Isn't that right, Malach? . . . Malach?"
—Darven, Mirran rebel, last words

83820.Name: Axiom Engraver
83820.FlavorText: "I will not rest until the truth of Phyrexia is inscribed across the Multiverse."

83821.Name: Barbed Batterfist
83821.FlavorText: "Finally, a safe way to punch the rotters in the face."

83822.Name: Bladegraft Aspirant
83822.FlavorText: "To dance to the music of Juex, leap like the flickering flame and hit like the hammer."

83823.Name: Blazing Crescendo
83823.FlavorText:
"They call themselves the Quiet Furnace? Ironic."
—Tyvar

83826.Name: Chimney Rabble
83826.FlavorText:
"They're violent, headstrong, and wildly unpredictable. It should be amusing to see how Norn's vaunted tactics try to cope with them."
—Urabrask

83831.Name: Free from Flesh
83831.FlavorText: He finally understood that phyresis was not an ending, but a new, perfect beginning.

83832.Name: Furnace Punisher
83832.FlavorText: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.

83833.Name: Furnace Strider
83833.FlavorText: With the Quiet Furnace closed to all other factions, Urabrask's smiths were free to build anything their creativity demanded.

83834.Name: Gleeful Demolition
83834.FlavorText: Urabrask encourages creativity in all its forms, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.

83835.Name: Hazardous Blast
83835.FlavorText: The Machine Orthodoxy finds strength in numbers. The Quiet Furnace finds that amusing.

83837.Name: Hexgold Slash
83837.FlavorText:
"No matter how tough they are, even Phyrexians prefer to keep their guts on the inside."
—Jor Kadeen

83839.Name: Kuldotha Cackler
83839.FlavorText: You would laugh too if you just burned through a tyrranax's stomach.

83841.Name: Molten Rebuke
83841.FlavorText: "Perhaps this will show the Orthodoxy what we think of their attempts at indoctrination."

83842.Name: Nahiri's Sacrifice
83842.FlavorText: Nahiri's last free breath became a defiant roar as she tore apart Sheoldred's Coliseum.

83843.Name: Oxidda Finisher
83843.FlavorText: Popular wisdom says that Phyrexians don't feel fear. But popular wisdom has never tried to hold a bridge against an angry ogre.

83844.Name: Rebel Salvo
83844.FlavorText: "That Great Work of yours is looking pretty fragile, Urabrask!"

83845.Name: Red Sun's Twilight
83845.FlavorText:
"Where once there was apathy, Urabrask brought passion, and the Great Work truly began."
—Monument inscription

83846.Name: Resistance Skywarden
83846.FlavorText: When the Vulshok taught him the word for "home," he knew it was what he had been fighting for.

83847.Name: Sawblade Scamp
83847.FlavorText: Sometimes the Great Work requires destruction to allow for more efficient reconstruction.

83848.Name: Shrapnel Slinger
83848.FlavorText:
"They may have unlimited mites, but that just means we have unlimited ammunition."
—Urabrask

83849.Name: Slobad, Iron Goblin
83849.FlavorText: Once he fought to save Mirrodin. Now he fights to remake it.

83851.Name: Thrill of Possibility
83851.FlavorText: As the infection spread, Nahiri's thoughts grew tangled. She needed to protect what she loved from Phyrexia . . . or maybe only Phyrexia could protect what she loved.

83852.Name: Urabrask's Anointer
83852.FlavorText: "You were so eager to spy on my work, I assume you'll appreciate a hands-on demonstration."

83854.Name: Vindictive Flamestoker
83854.FlavorText: Her faith burns hot enough to sear away the flesh of the heretic.

83855.Name: Volt Charge
83855.FlavorText:
"There's a war brewing between Norn and Urabrask. Exploit the chaos, and we can take them both down for good."
—Koth

83856.Name: Vulshok Splitter
83856.FlavorText:
"Not my style, but it'll get the job done."
—Nahiri

83860.Name: Branchblight Stalker
83860.FlavorText: Some Vicious Swarm aspirants hang motionless in the canopy for weeks, allowing poisonous flowers to root in their flesh and weave tendrils through their hair.

83865.Name: Copper Longlegs
83865.FlavorText: Its webs are not true silk, but woven from thousands of delicate mycosynth strands.

83870.Name: Ichorspit Basilisk
83870.FlavorText: Warm forges and tasty goblins lured it from the Hunter Maze to the Quiet Furnace.

83871.Name: Incubation Sac
83871.FlavorText:
"This one needs a bit longer to ripen."
—Glissa Sunslayer

83872.Name: Infectious Bite
83872.FlavorText:
"Let me tell you why you must never close your eyes when on watch. Not even for a second."
—Jor Kadeen

83876.Name: Noxious Assault
83876.FlavorText: Even as they brought the beast down, they could feel its poison working into their blood, altering their bodies, and filling their minds with the thrill of the eternal hunt.

83877.Name: Oil-Gorger Troll
83877.FlavorText: Metal or flesh, it didn't matter—seasoned with ichor, it all tasted so good.

83878.Name: Paladin of Predation
83878.FlavorText: The strategies and politics of the Vicious Swarm are as subtle as Vorinclex himself.

83880.Name: Predation Steward
83880.FlavorText:
"Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time."
—Melira

83881.Name: Rustvine Cultivator
83881.FlavorText:
"All elves aspire to be part of nature. Only Phyrexia can truly grant that wish."
—Glissa Sunslayer

83882.Name: Ruthless Predation
83882.FlavorText: In the Hunter Maze, today's apex predator is tomorrow's prey.

83883.Name: Skyscythe Engulfer
83883.FlavorText:
"I bet even Skithiryx would take the long way around this one."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

83887.Name: Titanic Growth
83887.FlavorText:
"It is as the Mirrans say: True strength comes from within."
—Ich-Tekik, Salvage Splicer

83888.Name: Tyrranax Atrocity
83888.FlavorText: While some predators specialize in speed, size, or deadly venom, the adaptive tyrranax see no need to limit themselves.

83890.Name: Tyvar's Stand
83890.FlavorText: "When they write songs about this battle, I will make sure your name is forgotten, devil."

83891.Name: Unnatural Restoration
83891.FlavorText: "If you don't reassemble me immediately, the Mother of Machines will notice my absence, and this entire layer will face her wrath!"

83892.Name: Venerated Rotpriest
83892.FlavorText:
"This was once a peaceful spring, but I wouldn't advise taking a sip."
—Melira

83898.Name: Cephalopod Sentry
83898.FlavorText: Silent observers swim through the air of Norn's Seedcore, watching the nascent Invasion Tree for any signs of interference.

83901.Name: Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres
83901.FlavorText: "Ah, my old friends. Have you decided at last to stop clinging to the past and join me in the grand pursuit of perfection?"

83916.Name: Slaughter Singer
83916.FlavorText: After giving in to the thrill of the hunt, he could never again return to the quiet of the Basilica.

83920.Name: Vivisection Evangelist
83920.FlavorText: "May you rejoice in the magnificence of Norn. May your flesh serve perfection."

83924.Name: Basilica Skullbomb
83924.FlavorText: It shines with the conviction of a zealous acolyte.

83925.Name: Dross Skullbomb
83925.FlavorText: It seethes with the ambition of a ruthless gladiator.

83926.Name: Dune Mover
83926.FlavorText: The shifting, unpredictable sands were deemed a disobedient affront to the Flesh Singularity.

83928.Name: Furnace Skullbomb
83928.FlavorText: It burns with the passion of an unbound creator.

83931.Name: Maze Skullbomb
83931.FlavorText: It pulses with the might of an apex predator.

83932.Name: Mirran Safehouse
83932.FlavorText:
"Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold. We should be safe inside."
—Koth

83934.Name: Myr Convert
83934.FlavorText: Humble, obedient, and tireless, myr require little modification to excel as servants of Phyrexia.

83935.Name: Myr Custodian
83935.FlavorText:
"Myr will go where the work is. We always have. We always will."
—Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch

83936.Name: Myr Kinsmith
83936.FlavorText:
"Our resistance is like the myr: small and easily overlooked, but loyal and resilient beyond measure."
—Melira

83937.Name: Phyrexian Atlas
83937.FlavorText: Since conquering Mirrodin, Phyrexian engineers have worked tirelessly to transform the plane's original two layers into a more fitting array of nine.

83938.Name: Prophetic Prism
83938.FlavorText:
"The five suns may have dimmed, but their light still guides us."
—Thrun

83939.Name: Prosthetic Injector
83939.FlavorText: Why carry a subject to a surgical lab when you can bring the surgical lab to them?

83941.Name: Soulless Jailer
83941.FlavorText:
"Lock the door and eat the key."
—Vraan, Executioner Thane

83943.Name: Surgical Skullbomb
83943.FlavorText: It crackles with the intellect of a twisted genius.

83946.Name: Zenith Chronicler
83946.FlavorText: It watches through the never-ending day, motionless save for the unsettling, twitching dance it performs as each sun reaches its apex.

83947.Name: The Autonomous Furnace
83947.FlavorText: In Urabrask's domain, mighty forges echo day and night with the clangor of the Great Work.

83948.Name: Blackcleave Cliffs
83948.FlavorText: Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.

83949.Name: Copperline Gorge
83949.FlavorText: Where fire meets ferocity, a greater evolution begins.

83950.Name: Darkslick Shores
83950.FlavorText: Where curiosity meets cruelty, hideous innovations arise.

83951.Name: The Dross Pits
83951.FlavorText: In Sheoldred's domain, the Steel Thanes wage a never-ending war in her long shadow.

83952.Name: The Fair Basilica
83952.FlavorText: In Elesh Norn's domain, the gospel of unity is the highest law.

83953.Name: The Hunter Maze
83953.FlavorText: In Vorinclex's domain, only the mightiest survive, and all are prey in his endless hunt.

83956.Name: The Mycosynth Gardens
83956.FlavorText: As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.

83957.Name: Razorverge Thicket
83957.FlavorText: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.

83958.Name: Seachrome Coast
83958.FlavorText: Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.

83960.Name: The Surgical Bay
83960.FlavorText: In Jin-Gitaxias's domain, strange and terrible experiments iterate toward perfection, unbound by ethics.

83961.Name: Terramorphic Expanse
83961.FlavorText:
"The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule."
—Koth

83963.Name: Serum Sovereign
83963.FlavorText: A thousand riddles, each with a single answer: "The glory of Phyrexia."

83965.Name: Rhuk, Hexgold Nabber
83965.FlavorText: Never get between a goblin and the closest shiny object.

83995.Name: The Hollow Sentinel
83995.RawFrameDetail: A token legendary, no text box

84033.Name: Bladed Ambassador
84033.FlavorText: Obedience is the armor that turns any blade.

84034.Name: Sinew Dancer
84034.FlavorText: To resist the embrace of the Flesh Singularity is to reject unconditional acceptance.

84035.Name: Quicksilver Fisher
84035.FlavorText: Phyrexia will stretch from sea to sky, across worlds and realities, inescapable and perfect.

84038.Name: Bonepicker Skirge
84038.FlavorText: Even the most insignificant creature can be perfected.

84039.Name: Furnace Punisher
84039.FlavorText: Etch your victories in iron, that the world may celebrate them forever.

84040.Name: Sawblade Scamp
84040.FlavorText: Be the blade that severs hierarchy.

84041.Name: Urabrask's Anointer
84041.FlavorText: Will you be the flame which burns the world, or merely be consumed as fuel?

84043.Name: Rustvine Cultivator
84043.FlavorText: Feel the joy of losing yourself to feed the land.

84045.Name: Myr Convert
84045.FlavorText: In the embrace of the Mother of Machines, hard work never goes unrewarded.

84048.Name: Phyrexian Vindicator
84048.FlavorText: Submit and know the Mother‘s glory. Resist and and know her wrath.

84056.Name: Phyrexian Obliterator
84056.FlavorText: Take everything from them. Lives. Flesh. The very ground they walk on. Only then will your victory be compleat.

84057.Name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
84057.FlavorText: Do not fear death. Fear failure.

84059.Name: Slobad, Iron Goblin
84059.FlavorText: The Forge embraces all who contribute to the Great Work.

84065.Name: Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres
84065.FlavorText: Who is an enemy but a friend who has yet to accept perfection?

84092.Name: Lukka, Bound to Ruin
84092.RawFrameDetail: alt RG gold planeswalker, 4 abilities PhyrexianLanguage

84093.Name: Nahiri, the Unforgiving
84093.RawFrameDetail: alt RW gold planeswalker, 4 abilities PhyrexianLanguage

84095.Name: A-Buy Your Silence
84095.FlavorText: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

84096.Name: A-Celebrity Fencer
84096.FlavorText: After a brief but memorable incident at her first performance, she was never heckled again.

84097.Name: A-Speakeasy Server
84097.FlavorText: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."

84098.Name: A-Case the Joint
84098.FlavorText: Steel doors and iron bars are child's play for an Obscura operative.

84099.Name: A-Psionic Snoop
84099.FlavorText: She knows your next move before you do.

84100.Name: A-Public Enemy
84100.FlavorText: Every Halo smuggler walks a razor's edge between untold riches and sudden disaster.

84101.Name: A-Sewer Crocodile
84101.FlavorText:
"Quick, let's hide in the sewer!"
—Ginsi the Thief, now deceased

84102.Name: A-Deal Gone Bad
84102.FlavorText:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus

84103.Name: A-Demon's Due
84103.FlavorText: Ob Nixilis extends his hand not in partnership, but to affirm your subservience.

84104.Name: A-Graveyard Shift
84104.FlavorText: "Up and at 'em, buddy. We've got more work to do."

84105.Name: A-Incriminate
84105.FlavorText:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator

84106.Name: A-Midnight Assassin
84106.FlavorText: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.

84108.Name: A-Vampire Scrivener
84108.FlavorText: No one remains on her list for long.

84111.Name: A-Pyre-Sledge Arsonist
84111.FlavorText: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.

84112.Name: A-Ready to Rumble
84112.FlavorText:
"It's too quiet tonight. Go make trouble."
—Ziatora

84113.Name: A-Riveteers Initiate
84113.FlavorText: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.

84116.Name: A-Glittermonger
84116.FlavorText: Street corners in the Mezzio are a tantalizing bazaar of the fantastic, the illicit, and the fake.

84117.Name: A-High-Rise Sawjack
84117.FlavorText: Slicing girders, rescuing trapped workers, killing gigantic rust flies—one tool does it all!

84118.Name: A-Most Wanted
84118.FlavorText: Overnight, Elspeth was branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.

84119.Name: A-Social Climber
84119.FlavorText: "It's all about who you know, darling. And now you're lucky enough to know me."

84120.Name: A-Warm Welcome
84120.FlavorText: "Welcome to the family. Chef Rocco sends their congratulations."

84124.Name: A-Civil Servant
84124.FlavorText: "Together we can build a safer, brighter New Capenna!"

84125.Name: A-Forge Boss
84125.FlavorText: "Big furnace like this can reduce anything to ash. You got something you need reduced to ash?"

84130.Name: A-Metropolis Angel
84130.FlavorText:
"Angels are living proof that power does not always lead to corruption."
—Elspeth

84131.Name: A-Mr. Orfeo, the Boulder
84131.FlavorText: Once he was jumped by a dozen Maestros agents. You can still see their imprints in the pavement if you know where to look.

84133.Name: A-Queza, Augur of Agonies
84133.FlavorText: Some try to unravel the tangled skeins of fate. She reweaves them to her own deadly design.

84137.Name: A-Security Rhox
84137.FlavorText: Unlucky assassins find out why he's called "Brick Wall" Balzano.

84143.Name: A-Syndicate Infiltrator
84143.FlavorText: The mansion's vaulted ceilings provided the perfect cover for an ambush.

84144.Name: A-Ominous Parcel
84144.FlavorText: The rest of Anhelo's assistant arrived over the following week.

84145.Name: A-Paragon of Modernity
84145.FlavorText: No true angels have been created since the founding of New Capenna, but artisans have learned to craft elegant facsimiles.

84152.Name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
84152.FlavorText: If you saw her, you'd go, "AAAHHHH!"

84153.Name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
84153.FlavorText: If you saw her, you'd go, "AAAHHHH!"

84173.Name: Lonely End
84173.FlavorText: "Father, I'm sorry," he said as he fell. But his last words were lost in the deafening grind of machines.

84174.Name: Penregon Besieged
84174.FlavorText: "Save our arrows," Kayla said. "We will need them tomorrow."

84176.Name: Kayla's Kindling
84176.FlavorText: Magic had cracked out into the world when Urza killed it. But at the nadir of her despair, Kayla channeled fire.

84177.Name: Melt Through
84177.FlavorText: "Sir, I believe we've taken out their . . . everything." —Dajin, Suwwardi sniper-captain

84180.Name: Foundry Groundbreaker
84180.FlavorText: On Argoth, Mishra forced the land to serve him.

84182.Name: Sylvan Smite
84182.FlavorText: "What can I say? Victory just comes naturally to me."

84183.Name: Argivian Welcome
84183.FlavorText: A local greeting with a universal message.

84188.Name: Perilous Iteration
84188.FlavorText: Artificers must always cope with the tension between exploration and explosion.

84189.Name: Raddic, Tal Zealot
84189.FlavorText: "The age of machine magic is dead. You may die with it, or live with us."

84208.Name: Benalish Marshal
84208.FlavorText:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—History of Benalia

84211.Name: Dauntless Bodyguard
84211.FlavorText: The Benalish aristocracy is hereditary, but the loyalty of its subjects is earned.

84214.Name: Valiant Knight
84214.FlavorText: "Defeat is no reason for retreat. It is a sign we must redouble our efforts to win this fight."

84216.Name: Blacklance Paragon
84216.FlavorText: The Blacklances travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years at a time, in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.

84219.Name: Midnight Reaper
84219.FlavorText: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

84224.Name: Smitten Swordmaster
84224.FlavorText: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

84225.Name: Curry Favor
84225.FlavorText: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

84226.Name: Abrade
84226.FlavorText: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

84227.Name: Banefire
84227.FlavorText: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

84228.Name: Cleansing Wildfire
84228.FlavorText: Every rebirth looks like a death.

84229.Name: Crackle with Power
84229.FlavorText: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl. For a moment, she was luminous, transcendent, terrible.

84230.Name: Dualcaster Mage
84230.FlavorText: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

84231.Name: Electrodominance
84231.FlavorText: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."

84233.Name: Guttersnipe
84233.FlavorText: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

84239.Name: Volcanic Fallout
84239.FlavorText:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

84240.Name: Young Pyromancer
84240.FlavorText: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

84243.Name: Urza's Mine
84243.FlavorText: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

84244.Name: Urza's Power Plant
84244.FlavorText: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

84245.Name: Urza's Tower
84245.FlavorText: Urza studied the creations of the Thran not simply to learn from them, but to surpass them.

84251.Name: Alabaster Host Sanctifier
84251.FlavorText: "Heliod shines his light on all things, excising the shadows of doubt. Rejoice, for beneath his purifying eyes, Theros is united as one!"

84252.Name: Angelic Intervention
84252.FlavorText: Elspeth shone like a sixth sun, inspiring hope in the Mirrans and terror in New Phyrexia.

84254.Name: Attentive Skywarden
84254.FlavorText: The same sturdy kitesail that once carried her safely through the Roil now allows her to monitor the pods' progress from above.

84256.Name: Boon-Bringer Valkyrie
84256.FlavorText: Her blades were twin beacons, calling the worthy to glory and the wretched to despair.

84257.Name: Cut Short
84257.FlavorText: With one swift, merciful stroke, Tamiyo's story came to an end.

84258.Name: Dusk Legion Duelist
84258.FlavorText: "We sailed to Ixalan guided by a promise—the Age of Everflowing Blood. No machine will take that from us."

84261.Name: Elspeth's Smite
84261.FlavorText: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.

84263.Name: Golden-Scale Aeronaut
84263.FlavorText: Johar had never heard of a pterodon. He just knew Saheeli's new invention let him fly circles around the invading monsters.

84264.Name: Guardian of Ghirapur
84264.FlavorText: She was hope incarnate, an incandescent bulwark against the tide of machines.

84265.Name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn
84265.FlavorText:
"Compleat the faith, compleat the god."
—Ajani Goldmane
84265.RawFrameDetail: W legendary Nyx front side TDFC

84266.Name: Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
84266.FlavorText:
"Compleat the god, compleat the plane."
—Ajani Goldmane
84266.RawFrameDetail: WU gold legendary Nyx back side TDFC

84267.Name: Infected Defector
84267.FlavorText: The diamond storms of Gobakhan hampered Phyrexia's progress until they recruited some of the local shieldmages.

84268.Name: Inspired Charge
84268.FlavorText:
"Let's show these soulless fiends what a real army looks like! Forward!"
—Shella, knight of Zhalfir

84270.Name: Belenon War Anthem
84270.FlavorText: "Just as a flute turns breath into music, we are the vessel through which the Sacred Winds produce glorious justice."

84272.Name: Serra Faithkeeper
84272.FlavorText: "I was there when Phyrexia doomed Serra's realm with a single touch. I was there when Yawgmoth tried and failed to conquer Dominaria. And I will still be here when Elesh Norn lies dead."

84274.Name: Lightshield Array
84274.FlavorText: The weight of Phyrexia crashed down upon Gobakhan, but the will of its people endured.

84276.Name: Ephara, Ever-Sheltering
84276.FlavorText: When the sun falters and the seas disperse, when the wilds wither and the forges go cold, when death itself succumbs, she endures.
84276.RawFrameDetail: WU gold legendary Nyx back side TDFC

84277.Name: Kithkin Billyrider
84277.FlavorText: "Brother, guide my right hand. Sister, my left. Rest well, my kin, but Lorwyn still needs me. I will not be joining you quite yet."

84278.Name: Knight of the New Coalition
84278.FlavorText: Raised in a long tradition of heroes, every Benalish knight knows the day might come when they will be called to face Phyrexia.

84280.Name: Kor Halberd
84280.FlavorText: An ancient weapon for a modern war.

84284.Name: Phyrexian Censor
84284.FlavorText: Quintorius muffled a sob as he watched the thing that was once Professor Pitnik "confiscate" yet another priceless historical tome.

84286.Name: Realmbreaker's Grasp
84286.FlavorText: The Invasion Tree wasn't merely a conduit through which to breach planes. It was a living, writhing extension of Phyrexia's will.

84287.Name: Scrollshift
84287.FlavorText: Bim lashed out with the only weapon she'd never run out of: lecture notes.

84289.Name: Seraph of New Capenna
84289.FlavorText: The angels had vowed to protect New Capenna. She was determined to uphold that vow, no matter the cost.

84290.Name: Seraph of New Phyrexia
84290.FlavorText: With her Halo reserves exhausted, she began to change, and she made a new promise to bless New Capenna with glistening perfection.

84291.Name: Sigiled Sentinel
84291.FlavorText: "Alara has been broken before. I will not let it break again."

84292.Name: Sun-Blessed Guardian
84292.FlavorText: Light glinted off the raised weapons of the Sun Empire, filling her with an unbreakable hope . . .

84293.Name: Furnace-Blessed Conqueror
84293.FlavorText: . . . but even the unbreakable can be reshaped.

84295.Name: Sunfall
84295.FlavorText:
"Let the light scour away your imperfect flesh."
—Heliod

84296.Name: Surge of Salvation
84296.FlavorText: No Meletian had ever laid eyes on an angel, but when protective Halo flooded the Multiverse, they knew a divine blessing was at hand.

84297.Name: Swordsworn Cavalier
84297.FlavorText: The Royal Knights of Belenon are equally practiced in courtesy and combat.

84298.Name: Tarkir Duneshaper
84298.FlavorText:
"Obey the teachings of the dragonlords, for they provide all. They grant us magic and safety, and in return we offer respect."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage

84299.Name: Burnished Dunestomper
84299.FlavorText:
"Your precious dragonlords repressed your instincts, cur. You were born a hunter. Evolve, and hunt again."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

84301.Name: Zhalfirin Lancer
84301.FlavorText: The Phyrexians armored themselves against blades, fire, and every conjuration they could think of. She brought a war rhino.

84302.Name: Artistic Refusal
84302.FlavorText: Errant wouldn't allow anything to stop her from decorating the streets of New Capenna.

84303.Name: Assimilate Essence
84303.FlavorText: "You have no viable escape vector. Cease your resistance and accept perfection."

84305.Name: Captive Weird
84305.FlavorText: Izzet researchers agreed to keep the unusual weird contained until they understood the extent of its powers.

84306.Name: Compleated Conjurer
84306.FlavorText: The Furnace Host saw no need for such caution.

84307.Name: Change the Equation
84307.FlavorText: "It's not your fault. Strixhaven taught you an imperfect premise. Okay, the imperfect execution was your fault."

84313.Name: Expedition Lookout
84313.FlavorText: Skills honed on perilous treasure hunts helped Zendikar's adventurers stay a crucial step ahead of their Phyrexian foes.

84314.Name: Eyes of Gitaxias
84314.FlavorText: No longer bound by the myopic limitations of flesh, Ekken would truly see the realms.

84316.Name: Furtive Analyst
84316.FlavorText: Where had she first seen that symbol? She usually took such detailed notes, but her memory of it was like a fading nightmare.

84317.Name: Halo-Charged Skaab
84317.FlavorText: Innistrad's stitchers were practiced at incorporating magical substances into undead creations.

84319.Name: Invocation of the Founders
84319.FlavorText: No professors, no grades, no room for mistakes.

84321.Name: Rooftop Saboteurs
84321.FlavorText: The pace of Kamigawa's development meant that Jin-Gitaxias's intel was already outdated when the invaders arrived.

84325.Name: Overloaded Mage-Ring
84325.FlavorText:
"On my signal, disable the safeguards. Let's blow these metal freaks right back to their own world!"
—Gav Beleren, mage-ring engineer

84328.Name: Meeting of Minds
84328.FlavorText:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria

84329.Name: Moment of Truth
84329.FlavorText: On the precipice of eternity, Elspeth made a choice. The fight would not end without her.

84330.Name: Negate
84330.FlavorText: Teferi gave them time. Karn gave them a chance. But it was Melira who paid the ultimate price to free Ajani from Phyrexia's grasp.

84331.Name: Oculus Whelp
84331.FlavorText: Even before Phyrexia's forces arrived on Tarkir, Silumgar's draconic brood had a discerning eye for valuables.

84332.Name: Omen Hawker
84332.FlavorText: After years of fabricating visions for naive customers of the Obscura, Stafano was flummoxed by the nightmarish scenes that played out unbidden in his mind's eye.

84334.Name: Order of the Mirror
84334.FlavorText: The Magic Mirror of Vantress showed Catrina a twisted vision of black oil and bloody machines.

84335.Name: Order of the Alabaster Host
84335.FlavorText: Soon she understood that it was not the vision that had been twisted, but her own mind.

84336.Name: Preening Champion
84336.FlavorText: On Kylem, the omens of impending invasion went largely unnoticed, drowned out by the everyday fanfare of Valor's Reach.

84337.Name: Protocol Knight
84337.FlavorText: "Ingress without proper writ of extraplanar intent? Unacceptable!"

84339.Name: Rona, Tolarian Obliterator
84339.RawFrameDetail: UB gold legendary back side TDFC

84340.Name: Saiba Cryptomancer
84340.FlavorText: "Good luck getting through a class-seven proxy ward, creep."

84342.Name: Skyclave Aerialist
84342.FlavorText: Together with her beloved falcon, she had explored every waterway on Zendikar, from the Tazeem highlands to the inland sea.

84343.Name: Skyclave Invader
84343.FlavorText: With her guidance, the oil coursed freely across the world.

84344.Name: Stasis Field
84344.FlavorText: Old glitches in mage-ring function became critical tools in Vryn's defense.

84346.Name: Thunderhead Squadron
84346.FlavorText: Just as all seemed lost, the griffin riders of Zhalfir arrived with the force of a gathered storm.

84348.Name: Transcendent Message
84348.FlavorText: Wrenn reached out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, and an impossible connection flared across the vast emptiness.

84350.Name: Xerex Strobe-Knight
84350.FlavorText: Phyrexia broke the laws of reality to invade the planes. On Xerex, reality merely bent around the invaders.

84352.Name: Zhalfirin Shapecraft
84352.FlavorText: Patient and observant, the people of Zhalfir lurked beyond the veil of time until their moment came to finally strike at Phyrexia.

84353.Name: Aetherblade Agent
84353.FlavorText: The Consulate of Kaladesh had always valued his particular talent for extracting information . . .

84354.Name: Gitaxian Mindstinger
84354.FlavorText: . . . but the Chrome Host's methods were far more efficient.

84357.Name: Ayara, Furnace Queen
84357.FlavorText: Ayara cherished her new machine servitors just as much as she once did her many suitors: not at all.
84357.RawFrameDetail: BR gold legendary back side TDFC

84359.Name: Blightreaper Thallid
84359.FlavorText: Mudcreep loved the taste of the funny oil that leaked from the wrecked machines in Urborg.

84360.Name: Blightsower Thallid
84360.FlavorText: Then one day, Mudcreep started to feel funny itself.

84363.Name: Collective Nightmare
84363.FlavorText: Night fell all at once. Specifically, on the Phyrexian.

84364.Name: Compleated Huntmaster
84364.FlavorText: The elves of Lorwyn sought perfection. The Etched Host supplied it.

84365.Name: Consuming Aetherborn
84365.FlavorText: Doji found the Phyrexian's essence foul, but every drop added an hour to their life.

84366.Name: Corrupted Conviction
84366.FlavorText:
"For the good of all, those who stand against the harmony of Phyrexia must be cut down."
—Ajani Goldmane

84367.Name: Deadly Derision
84367.FlavorText: Daretti looked down disdainfully. "You call yourself machines? Where's the elegance? Nothing but ugly piles of scrap."

84368.Name: Dreg Recycler
84368.FlavorText: Bodies too damaged to survive phyresis are collected and broken down into useful raw materials.

84372.Name: Final Flourish
84372.FlavorText: Strixhaven braced for another Oriq assault, but something far worse arrived.

84375.Name: Glistening Deluge
84375.FlavorText: As oil began to pour from Ikoria's crystals, some monsters developed strange mechanical mutations. Others were simply pulled under.

84380.Name: Ichor Shade
84380.FlavorText: As oil seeped into their funeral shrouds, Tolvada's dead rose to join the invaders' ranks.

84382.Name: Prickle Faeries
84382.FlavorText: When the courts fell, Eldraine's fae turned from their usual pranks to deadlier tricks.

84386.Name: Deluge of the Dead
84386.FlavorText: The eerie magic animating Innistrad's zombies rendered them immune to phyresis, making them crucial to the plane's defense.

84389.Name: Merciless Repurposing
84389.FlavorText: As the harvesters bore away the last of his limbs, what remained of Urabrask heard Elesh Norn say, "Leave the traitor be."

84390.Name: Mirrodin Avenged
84390.FlavorText: "You were my mistake. I will forever bear the weight of your horrors, and of your end."

84392.Name: Hideous Fleshwheeler
84392.FlavorText: Freedom became a distasteful memory, a thing to fear and destroy.

84393.Name: Nezumi Informant
84393.FlavorText: "Tell Boss Umezawa there's a new gang moving in on our territory. I'm forwarding their insignia. Watch for it elsewhere."

84394.Name: Phyrexian Gargantua
84394.FlavorText:
"Of course I'd rather it hadn't skinned six of my best wizards, but as nightmare fuel goes, it's a truly inspired design."
—Braids

84396.Name: Render Inert
84396.FlavorText: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source. The compleated invaders ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.

84397.Name: Scorn-Blade Berserker
84397.FlavorText: "Before I fall, I will taste the blood of Sarulf himself!"

84401.Name: Traumatic Revelation
84401.FlavorText: "My new form must be hard to understand."

84402.Name: Unseal the Necropolis
84402.FlavorText: On Amonkhet, Phyrexia found a ready-made army of horrors waiting for a new master.

84403.Name: Vanquish the Weak
84403.FlavorText: When Atraxa first arrived, the people of New Capenna rejoiced at the sight of such a grand angel. Then the slaughter began.

84404.Name: Akki Scrapchomper
84404.FlavorText: The Furnace Host found great value in the chaotic ingenuity of Kamigawa's akki and allowed willing converts to "experiment" however they saw fit.

84407.Name: Burning Sun's Fury
