84407.FlavorText: Ixalan greeted Phyrexia with a defiant roar.

84410.Name: Coming In Hot
84410.FlavorText: "I have a reckless idea," Koth offered. Chandra grinned and cracked her knuckles.

84412.Name: Etali, Primal Sickness
84412.FlavorText: The contagion spreads and the Multiverse quakes.
84412.RawFrameDetail: RG gold legendary back side TDFC

84413.Name: Fearless Skald
84413.FlavorText: "Hold nothing back, my friends. Tonight we feast in Starnheim!"

84415.Name: Furnace Host Charger
84415.FlavorText: With barely a moment's warning, a one-giant avalanche crashed into Kaldheim's defenders.

84418.Name: Harried Artisan
84418.FlavorText: As strange portals roared open across Theros, Lydus gathered his prototype and fled. He was so close to perfecting his design.

84419.Name: Phyrexian Skyflayer
84419.FlavorText: Soaring in Realmbreaker's embrace, he finally understood what perfection was.

84420.Name: Into the Fire
84420.FlavorText: The rest of the Gatewatch retreated. Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.

84422.Name: Pyre of the World Tree
84422.FlavorText: The warriors of Kaldheim burned the soul of their world to keep it out of Phyrexia's hands.

84424.Name: Refraction Elemental
84424.FlavorText: The crystal landslide stirred over the shattered forms of the Machine Legion vanguard, and then it rose and rearranged itself into an avenging colossus.

84426.Name: Kyren Flamewright
84426.FlavorText: Inspired by tales of the legendary hero Squee, many young Kyren goblins strove to emulate his magical skill and courage in the face of danger.

84430.Name: Defiant Thundermaw
84430.FlavorText:
"The Phyrexians are fools if they believe they can weather such a storm."
—Sarkhan Vol

84431.Name: Karsus Depthguard
84431.FlavorText: He stood his ground in the Mirrored Depths, his roar of defiance echoed by a thousand crystalline reflections.

84433.Name: Gitaxian Spellstalker
84433.FlavorText:
"Bolas's methods were crude and inefficient, taking generations to refine the population into a reliable source of combat units. Still, it offers us something of a head start."
—Jin-Gitaxias

84434.Name: Lithomantic Barrage
84434.FlavorText: Nahiri's rage shattered hedrons into deadly, burning ruin.

84437.Name: Nahiri's Warcrafting
84437.FlavorText: "Zendikar must be broken before it can be saved."

84438.Name: Onakke Javelineer
84438.FlavorText: With the ways between worlds thrown open, the Chain Veil's foul magic seeped from a vault deep within Ravnica all the way to Shandalar's dormant masters.

84439.Name: Pyretic Prankster
84439.FlavorText: It'd played the same prank a hundred times, never noticing the flame's slowly evolving pattern.

84440.Name: Glistening Goremonger
84440.FlavorText: When it realized the symbol's true, glorious meaning, it began marking every surface on Innistrad with oil-soaked claws.

84441.Name: Ral's Reinforcements
84441.FlavorText: "Good thing maintenance never got around to decatalyzing the bithermic plasma displacement conduits!"

84444.Name: Redcap Heelslasher
84444.FlavorText: Boffle was delighted to have an excuse to use the nice cutlery he'd liberated from Edgewall.

84445.Name: Scrappy Bruiser
84445.FlavorText:
"My flesh is an affront to existence? Come say that to my fist, you bloated rust bucket."
—Koko, Riveteers welder

84446.Name: Searing Barb
84446.FlavorText: "You always were such a sharp student. Shame it took you so long to get the point."

84448.Name: Shivan Branch-Burner
84448.FlavorText: The New Coalition gave Shiv time to prepare a warm welcome for the invaders.

84449.Name: Stoke the Flames
84449.FlavorText: The Atarka shamans roused the fire into a scorching rebuke of the invaders and a beacon of hope for the survivors.

84450.Name: Thrashing Frontliner
84450.FlavorText: With Urabrask in hiding, the masterless Furnace Host was unleashed on the Multiverse to spread mayhem and destruction.

84451.Name: Trailblazing Historian
84451.FlavorText: Spells once used to traverse Lorehold excavation sites were swiftly repurposed to keep the students one step ahead of the Invasion Tree's grasp.

84454.Name: Volcanic Spite
84454.FlavorText: None may approach the Ashen Idol without an offering—an edict fortuitously absent from Phyrexian intelligence concerning the world of Azgol.

84455.Name: Voldaren Thrillseeker
84455.FlavorText: "The end is always nigh. Let's have some fun!"

84456.Name: War-Trained Slasher
84456.FlavorText:
"That's my girl. Just don't eat it—wouldn't want you getting an upset stomach again."
—Jalina, Ikorian bonder

84457.Name: Wrenn's Resolve
84457.FlavorText: Even as she burned, Wrenn bent Realmbreaker to her will.

84459.Name: Arachnoid Adaptation
84459.FlavorText:
"Deploy the blightwidows. Rankle's pests should make for a delicious meal."
—Ayara, Furnace Queen

84462.Name: Bonded Herdbeast
84462.FlavorText: Though both had lost their families, the eludha—the spiritual connection between the monsters of Ikoria and their human bonders—gave them something greater.

84463.Name: Plated Kilnbeast
84463.FlavorText: Now, united by the Great Work, they knew what it meant to be truly bonded.

84465.Name: Converter Beast
84465.FlavorText: Slowly, the distinct screams of the trapped faded into muffled gurgles of glistening oil.

84466.Name: Copper Host Crusher
84466.FlavorText: Walls built to withstand assaults even from Ikoria's apex monsters were quickly deemed tactically irrelevant by Vorinclex's forces.

84467.Name: Cosmic Hunger
84467.FlavorText: The Copper Host sought only the strongest converts. In Koma, it found perfection.

84469.Name: Deeproot Wayfinder
84469.FlavorText: Her warning raced through the roots and rivers of Ixalan: prepare for war.

84471.Name: Fertilid's Favor
84471.FlavorText: The denizens of Lorwyn were accustomed to resisting darkness.

84472.Name: Glistening Dawn
84472.FlavorText: Unleashed on new worlds, the Phyrexians were driven by a simple imperative: spread and conquer.

84473.Name: Gnottvold Hermit
84473.FlavorText: The Hagi trolls stood little chance against Phyrexia, having killed everyone who came to Gnottvold to warn them.

84474.Name: Chrome Host Hulk
84474.FlavorText: Now they saw the truth. Divisions between Hagi and Torga were meaningless. There was only Phyrexia.

84475.Name: Herbology Instructor
84475.FlavorText: "As you see, these flowers . . . can have either restorative or poisonous . . . what is that?"

84476.Name: Malady Invoker
84476.FlavorText: "How dare you leave before my lesson is done!"

84478.Name: Zilortha, Apex of Ikoria
84478.FlavorText: Phyrexia's largest goliaths stormed Ikoria, ready to challenge the world's great monsters. Zilortha was unimpressed.

84480.Name: Belligerent Regisaur
84480.FlavorText:
"Careful. Its vision is based on fear, and it can smell movement . . . or something like that."
—Gregor, amateur zoologist

84482.Name: Primordial Plasm
84482.FlavorText: Before the tree of life branched into predators and prey, there was only shapeless hunger.

84484.Name: Leyline Surge
84484.FlavorText: Shandalar's wild magic stripped away the unnatural Phyrexian carapaces, reclaiming the true forms hidden underneath.

84486.Name: Awakened Skyclave
84486.FlavorText: Nahiri tried to bend Zendikar to Phyrexia's will. In response, the world rose against her.

84487.Name: Iridescent Blademaster
84487.FlavorText: Her arm and spirit were weary, but as the Halo flowed across her blade, it became weightless, and new strength flooded through her. She would fight on.

84488.Name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
84488.FlavorText: Nashi knelt reverently before the kami and envisioned his family reunited.

84489.Name: Overgrown Pest
84489.FlavorText: If only the biofluctuations students could have seen what became of their prize specimen after its escape.

84491.Name: Placid Rottentail
84491.FlavorText: It had always loved munching on daisies and crystalweed, but lately its favorite snacks were the strange, round roots popping up everywhere.

84492.Name: Polukranos Reborn
84492.FlavorText: Freed from the Underworld, the World Eater resumed his endless feast with reckless enthusiasm.

84493.Name: Polukranos, Engine of Ruin
84493.RawFrameDetail: GW gold legendary back side TDFC

84494.Name: Portent Tracker
84494.FlavorText: In the days before the invasion, the symbol of its perpetrator appeared in strange places all across the Multiverse.

84495.Name: Ravenous Sailback
84495.FlavorText: Converter beasts were sent to ensnare as many of Ixalan's dinosaurs as possible. Many of them were converted themselves—into snacks.

84497.Name: Seed of Hope
84497.FlavorText: Wrenn had given everything and asked for nothing. She deserved a monument, but rest in a quiet meadow is all she would've wanted.

84498.Name: Serpent-Blade Assailant
84498.FlavorText: "Kaldheim's cosmos was never yours to corrupt."

84499.Name: Storm the Seedcore
84499.FlavorText: In that moment, the fate of countless worlds rested with one dryad and a handful of the bravest Mirrodin had to offer.

84500.Name: Streetwise Negotiator
84500.FlavorText: Like the laws, the rules of engagement always seem to bend in the Brokers' favor.

84501.Name: Tandem Takedown
84501.FlavorText:
"I take no pleasure in this, but Vadrok might."
—Vivien Reid, to Lukka

84503.Name: Timberland Ancient
84503.FlavorText: Only the trees were old enough to remember what happened when Moag ignored warnings of Phyrexia millennia ago. They were determined not to repeat the mistake.

84504.Name: Tribute to the World Tree
84504.FlavorText:
"The Tree was the heart of our world. It made me what I am and pulled me back from the brink of death. I won't allow it to be forgotten."
—Esika, god of the Tree

84505.Name: Vengeant Earth
84505.FlavorText: When Zendikar's defenders faltered, the Roil rose up to shake the invaders from its back.

84508.Name: War Historian
84508.FlavorText: All children on Kamigawa learn of the Kami War. Hostilities with beings from another reality were understood, and no time was wasted in disbelief.

84509.Name: Wary Thespian
84509.FlavorText: The Cabaretti performance had veered off-script . . . so how were the acrobats still moving in perfect unison?

84510.Name: Wildwood Escort
84510.FlavorText: With Eldraine's human knights called away to defend the courts, lost travelers were surprised to find themselves whisked to safety by the secretive folk of the wilds.

84524.Name: Invasion of Alara
84524.RawFrameDetail: Z gold battle front side TDFC

84526.Name: Invasion of Amonkhet
84526.RawFrameDetail: UB gold battle front side TDFC

84527.Name: Lazotep Convert
84527.FlavorText: As the lazotep covered his body, he heard Norn's voice fade from a deafening clarion to a distant whisper.

84528.Name: Invasion of Azgol
84528.RawFrameDetail: BR gold battle front side TDFC

84530.Name: Invasion of Ergamon
84530.RawFrameDetail: RG gold battle front side TDFC

84531.Name: Truga Cliffcharger
84531.FlavorText: Throughout Ergamon's wild Truga Jungle, predator-prey relationships stopped until every last invader was crushed to dust.

84532.Name: Invasion of Kaladesh
84532.RawFrameDetail: UR gold battle front side TDFC

84533.Name: Aetherwing, Golden-Scale Flagship
84533.FlavorText: Inspired by the grace of Ixalan's pterodons, Saheeli built one of her own.
84533.RawFrameDetail: UR gold Vehicle back side TDFC

84534.Name: Invasion of Kylem
84534.RawFrameDetail: RW gold battle front side TDFC

84535.Name: Valor's Reach Tag Team
84535.FlavorText: "Let's give these creeps the old one-two!"

84536.Name: Invasion of Lorwyn
84536.RawFrameDetail: BG gold battle front side TDFC

84537.Name: Winnowing Forces
84537.FlavorText: The Phyrexian appearance was so offensive that perfects and eyeblights worked together in unprecedented kinship to destroy them.

84538.Name: Invasion of Moag
84538.RawFrameDetail: GW gold battle front side TDFC

84539.Name: Bloomwielder Dryads
84539.FlavorText: Against the implacable will of Phyrexia, the dryads of Moag raised a shield of living summer.

84540.Name: Invasion of New Capenna
84540.RawFrameDetail: WB gold battle front side TDFC

84541.Name: Holy Frazzle-Cannon
84541.FlavorText:
"They're using my Halo stockpile for what?"
—Jetmir
84541.RawFrameDetail: WB gold artifact back side TDFC

84542.Name: Invasion of New Phyrexia
84542.RawFrameDetail: WU gold battle front side TDFC

84543.Name: Teferi Akosa of Zhalfir
84543.RawFrameDetail: WU gold planeswalker, 3 abilities, back side TDFC

84544.Name: Invasion of Pyrulea
84544.RawFrameDetail: GU gold battle front side TDFC

84545.Name: Gargantuan Slabhorn
84545.FlavorText: To the slabhorn, the branches of the Invasion Tree were as brittle as the stems of a Pyrulean fern.

84546.Name: Invasion of Tolvada
84546.RawFrameDetail: WB gold battle front side TDFC

84547.Name: The Broken Sky
84547.FlavorText: Angry ghosts poured through and pummeled the Invasion Tree, filling the heavens with the rhythms of war.

84548.Name: Invasion of Xerex
84548.RawFrameDetail: WU gold battle front side TDFC

84549.Name: Vertex Paladin
84549.FlavorText: The literal-minded Phyrexians made the greatest mistake possible on Xerex: they tried to understand what they were seeing.

84552.Name: Kroxa and Kunoros
84552.FlavorText: When the Invasion Tree reached the Underworld, it found only teeth and fury.

84553.Name: Marshal of Zhalfir
84553.FlavorText: "How kind of our foes to move in such perfect, predictable unison. Split into squadrons and execute the Lion's Claw!"

84554.Name: Mirror-Shield Hoplite
84554.FlavorText: In the shield's gleaming surface, the Phyrexian saw a reflection of what it once had been, and paused.

84555.Name: Mutagen Connoisseur
84555.FlavorText: Much to the Phyrexians' delight, sheer curiosity drove many to willingly surrender to compleation.

84558.Name: Rampaging Geoderm
84558.FlavorText: The Phyrexian juggernaut found itself crushed between a rock and a hard place.

84561.Name: Stormclaw Rager
84561.FlavorText: No amount of spilled oil and crushed metal could slake her bloodlust.

84563.Name: Yargle and Multani
84563.FlavorText:
"I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled. "There was a time when I'd balk at your aid, phantom, but she has shown me the merit in Urborg's strange ways."
"Gnshhagghkkapphribbit," replied Yargle.

84567.Name: Halo Hopper
84567.FlavorText: Folded by an imaginative child, animated by a mischievous kami, and blessed by an otherworldly angel.

84568.Name: Kitesail
84568.FlavorText: "Just like dodging stampedes in the Makindi Trenches back home!"

84569.Name: Phyrexian Archivist
84569.FlavorText: Silence quickly went from an annoying library rule to an imperative for survival.

84571.Name: Skittering Surveyor
84571.FlavorText: Though no bigger than a hand, the surveyors were as vital to the resistance as the largest war constructs.

84573.Name: Urn of Godfire
84573.FlavorText: Ephara blessed the defenders of Theros with godfire, a Nyx-infused incendiary substance that burned without fuel.

84574.Name: Bloodfell Caves
84574.FlavorText: Having learned of New Capenna's Halo supply, Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa herself to bring the world to heel.

84575.Name: Blossoming Sands
84575.FlavorText: The Copper Host brought a hideous mockery of new life to Amonkhet's death-cursed desert.

84576.Name: Dismal Backwater
84576.FlavorText: The Invasion Tree's branches snaked through the streets of Otawara, turning Kamigawa's soaring city into a clouded nightmare.

84577.Name: Jungle Hollow
84577.FlavorText: On the surface of Ixalan's vast tar pits, Phyrexian oil glistened, and old bones began to stir.

84578.Name: Rugged Highlands
84578.FlavorText: The Roil, Zendikar's planewide immune system, rose in full force against the threat of Phyrexian infection.

84579.Name: Scoured Barrens
84579.FlavorText: As oil seeped from Ikoria's crystals, strange metallic mutations emerged in monsters all across the plane.

84580.Name: Swiftwater Cliffs
84580.FlavorText: Kaladesh's wondrous inventions and glowing aether were of utmost interest to Jin-Gitaxias and his Chrome Host.

84581.Name: Thornwood Falls
84581.FlavorText: Deep in Eldraine's wilds, strange eyelike appendages twined among the vines and faerie lights.

84582.Name: Tranquil Cove
84582.FlavorText: The sky darkened and the seas turned to oil as the gods of Theros themselves fell to New Phyrexia.

84583.Name: Wind-Scarred Crag
84583.FlavorText: Serra was a symbol of hope to Dominaria, so Norn defiled her temples with monuments to Phyrexia.

84600.Name: Phyrexian Myr
84600.RawFrameDetail: U artifact token, no text box

84606.Name: First Mate Ragavan
84606.RawFrameDetail: R token legendary, no text box

84616.Name: Incubator
84616.RawFrameDetail: A token front side TDFC, has text box

84617.Name: Phyrexian
84617.RawFrameDetail: A token back side TDFC, no text box

84618.Name: Incubator
84618.RawFrameDetail: A token front side TDFC, has text box

84619.Name: Phyrexian
84619.RawFrameDetail: A token back side TDFC, no text box

84620.Name: Incubator
84620.RawFrameDetail: A token front side TDFC, has text box

84621.Name: Phyrexian
84621.RawFrameDetail: A token back side TDFC, no text box

84693.Name: Banish from Edoras
84693.FlavorText: Wormtongue bared his teeth; and then with a hissing breath he spat before the king's feet.

84694.Name: The Battle of Bywater
84694.FlavorText: The Tooks marched in with Pippin at their head. Merry now had enough sturdy Hobbitry to deal with the ruffians.

84696.Name: Boromir, Warden of the Tower
84696.FlavorText: "Farewell, Aragorn! Go to Minas Tirith and save my people!"

84698.Name: Dúnedain Blade
84698.FlavorText: The sword glinted in the westering sun.

84701.Name: East-Mark Cavalier
84701.FlavorText:
"The Rohirrim have long been the friends of the people of Gondor, though they are not akin to them."
—Aragorn

84703.Name: Errand-Rider of Gondor
84703.FlavorText: "Gondor is in great need. Lord Denethor asks for all your strength and all your speed, lest Gondor fall at last."

84704.Name: Escape from Orthanc
84704.FlavorText:
"How far can you bear me?" asked Gandalf.
"Many leagues," said Gwaihir, "but not to the ends of the earth. I was sent to bear tidings, not burdens."

84705.Name: Esquire of the King
84705.FlavorText:
"Where now the horse and the rider?
Where is the horn that was blowing?
Where is the helm and the hauberk,
and the bright hair flowing?"
—Lament for the Rohirrim

84706.Name: Faramir, Field Commander
84706.FlavorText: "A chance for Faramir, Captain of Gondor, to show his quality."

84707.Name: Flowering of the White Tree
84707.FlavorText: Aragorn planted the new tree in the court by the fountain, and swiftly and gladly it began to grow.

84708.Name: Fog on the Barrow-Downs
84708.FlavorText:
"Cold be hand and heart and bone,
and cold be sleep under stone:
never more to wake on stony bed,
never, till the Sun fails and the Moon is dead."

84712.Name: Hobbit's Sting
84712.FlavorText: "One for the Shire!" cried Aragorn. "The Hobbit's bite is deep! You have a good blade, Frodo son of Drogo!"

84713.Name: Landroval, Horizon Witness
84713.FlavorText: He passed over Udûn and Gorgoroth and saw all the land in ruin and tumult beneath him, and before him Mount Doom blazing, pouring out its fire.

84714.Name: Lost to Legend
84714.FlavorText:
"In the days of Isildur, the Ruling Ring passed out of all knowledge."
—Elrond

84715.Name: Nimble Hobbit
84715.FlavorText: The ruffian knew too little of Hobbits to understand his peril. Foolishly, he decided to fight.

84716.Name: Now for Wrath, Now for Ruin!
84716.FlavorText: The Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate and the might of Mordor.

84717.Name: Protector of Gondor
84717.FlavorText: Orcs were digging deep trenches in a huge ring, just out of bowshot of the walls, while the Men of Minas Tirith looked on, unable to hinder them.

84718.Name: Reprieve
84718.FlavorText: As Faramir and Éowyn stood so, their hands met and clasped, though they did not know it.

84720.Name: Samwise the Stouthearted
84720.FlavorText: "You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay for it."

84721.Name: Second Breakfast
84721.FlavorText: The Hobbits of the Shire were fond of six meals a day—when they could get them.

84722.Name: Shire Shirriff
84722.FlavorText: "You're arrested for Gate-breaking, and Tearing up of Rules, and Trespassing, and Bribing Guards with Food."

84723.Name: Slip On the Ring
84723.FlavorText: How had it come to be on his finger? He wondered if the Ring itself had not played him a trick.

84724.Name: Soldier of the Grey Host
84724.FlavorText:
"The Dead awaken; for the hour is come for the oathbreakers."
—Malbeth the Seer

84725.Name: Stalwarts of Osgiliath
84725.FlavorText:
"The Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River."
—Denethor

84727.Name: Took Reaper
84727.FlavorText: The Tooks came, a hundred strong, from Tuckborough and the Green Hills.

84729.Name: Westfold Rider
84729.FlavorText:
"The Orcs were greater in number than we counted on. Great Orcs, who also bore the White Hand of Isengard."
—Éomer

84730.Name: You Cannot Pass!
84730.FlavorText: It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked. Fire came from its nostrils. But Gandalf stood firm.

84731.Name: Arwen's Gift
84731.FlavorText: "Wear this now in memory of Elfstone and Evenstar with whom your life has been woven!"

84735.Name: Birthday Escape
84735.FlavorText: As Bilbo finished his speech, he slipped the ring on his finger, and he was never seen by any Hobbit in Hobbiton again.

84736.Name: Borne Upon a Wind
84736.FlavorText:
"I looked on Aragorn and thought how great and terrible a Lord he might have become, had he taken the Ring for himself. Not for naught does Mordor fear him."
—Legolas

84737.Name: Captain of Umbar
84737.FlavorText:
"There is a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin, manned by the Corsairs of Umbar in the South. They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor."
—Beregond

84738.Name: Council's Deliberation
84738.FlavorText:
"I will take the Ring to Mordor, though I do not know the way."
—Frodo

84739.Name: Deceive the Messenger
84739.FlavorText:
"Tell Gandalf that he must seek my aid at once."
—Saruman

84740.Name: Dreadful as the Storm
84740.FlavorText: "I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night! All shall love me and despair!"

84741.Name: Elrond, Lord of Rivendell
84741.FlavorText: "This is the hour of the Shire-folk, when they arise from their quiet fields to shake the towers and counsels of the Great. Who of all the Wise could have foreseen it?"

84742.Name: Gandalf, Friend of the Shire
84742.FlavorText: "After a hundred years, Hobbits can still surprise you at a pinch."

84743.Name: Glorious Gale
84743.FlavorText: The Elves of Lórien took Dol Guldur. Galadriel threw down its walls and laid bare its pits, and the forest was cleansed.

84744.Name: Goldberry, River-Daughter
84744.FlavorText: "Fear nothing! For tonight you are under the roof of Tom Bombadil."

84745.Name: Grey Havens Navigator
84745.FlavorText: It was an old tradition that beyond the Shire stood the Grey Havens, from which at times elven-ships set sail, never to return.

84746.Name: Hithlain Knots
84746.FlavorText:
"If you will try to run away you must be tied; but we don't wish to hurt you."
—Sam

84747.Name: Horses of the Bruinen
84747.FlavorText: The black horses were filled with madness, and leaping forward in terror they bore their riders into the rushing flood.

84748.Name: Ioreth of the Healing House
84748.FlavorText: "I have been too busy with this and that to heed all the crying and shouting. All I hope is that those murdering devils do not come to this House and trouble the sick."

84749.Name: Isolation at Orthanc
84749.FlavorText:
"They took me and set me on the pinnacle of Orthanc. I stood alone on an island in the clouds; I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter and cold."
—Gandalf

84750.Name: Ithilien Kingfisher
84750.FlavorText: After their reunion, the Hobbits spent many days in Ithilien. The stream that flowed from the falls of Henneth Annûn could be heard in the night as it rushed down through its rocky gate.

84751.Name: Knights of Dol Amroth
84751.FlavorText: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate.

84752.Name: Lórien Revealed
84752.FlavorText:
"Look on us now with friendly eyes! Behold the trees of the Naith of Lórien and be glad!"
—Haldir

84754.Name: Meneldor, Swift Savior
84754.FlavorText:
"Then come! We have need of speed greater than any wind, outmatching the wings of the Nazgûl."
—Gandalf

84755.Name: Nimrodel Watcher
84755.FlavorText:
"But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies."
—Haldir

84756.Name: Pelargir Survivor
84756.FlavorText: "The Corsairs are upon us! Back to the walls! Back to the City before all are overwhelmed!"

84757.Name: Press the Enemy
84757.FlavorText: "I showed the blade reforged to him. He is not so mighty yet that he is above fear."

84758.Name: Rangers of Ithilien
84758.FlavorText: "We have a new errand on this journey: to ambush the Men of Harad."

84759.Name: Saruman the White
84759.FlavorText: "Sauron's victory is at hand; and there will be rich reward for those who aided it."

84760.Name: Saruman's Trickery
84760.FlavorText:
"I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly."
—Saruman

84762.Name: Soothing of Sméagol
84762.FlavorText: Frodo's heart sank. This was too much like trickery, and certainly what he did would seem a treachery to the poor treacherous creature.

84763.Name: Stern Scolding
84763.FlavorText: "Fool of a Took! This is a serious journey, not a Hobbit walking-party. Throw yourself in next time, and then you will be no further nuisance. Now be quiet!"

84764.Name: Storm of Saruman
84764.FlavorText: Isengard had once been filled with fruitful trees, but no green thing grew there in the latter days of Saruman.

84768.Name: Willow-Wind
84768.FlavorText: The branches of the willow began to sway violently. Frodo called for help, but he could hardly hear his own voice: it was blown away from him by the willow-wind and drowned in a clamor of leaves.

84769.Name: Bitter Downfall
84769.FlavorText:
"I tried to take the Ring from Frodo. I am sorry. I have paid."
—Boromir

84770.Name: The Black Breath
84770.FlavorText:
"When the black breath blows, death's shadow grows."
—A rhyme of old days

84772.Name: Cirith Ungol Patrol
84772.FlavorText:
"Spies feared on Stairs. Double vigilance. Patrol to head of Stairs."
—Shagrat's orders

84773.Name: Claim the Precious
84773.FlavorText:
"I think it is a sad story, and it might have happened to others, even to some Hobbits that I have known."
—Gandalf

84774.Name: Dunland Crebain
84774.FlavorText:
"What's that, Strider? It don't look like a cloud."
—Sam

84775.Name: Easterling Vanguard
84775.FlavorText: An army of Easterlings charged forth, while from the hills poured Orcs innumerable.

84776.Name: Gollum, Patient Plotter
84776.FlavorText: "They'll take it, steal my Precious. Thieves. We hates them."

84777.Name: Gollum's Bite
84777.FlavorText:
"It was Pity that stayed Bilbo's hand. Do not be too eager to deal out death in judgment; Gollum has some part to play yet, before the end."
—Gandalf, to Frodo

84780.Name: Gríma Wormtongue
84780.FlavorText: "Do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength. Let others deal with these irksome guests."

84782.Name: Haunt of the Dead Marshes
84782.FlavorText:
"You should not look in when the candles are lit."
—Gollum

84783.Name: Isildur's Fateful Strike
84783.FlavorText: Isildur cut the Ring from Sauron's hand with the hilt-shard of his father's sword, and Sauron himself was overthrown.

84784.Name: Lash of the Balrog
84784.FlavorText: Even as the Balrog fell, it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about Gandalf's knees, dragging him to the brink of the abyss. "Fly, you fools!" he cried, and was gone.

84786.Name: March from the Black Gate
84786.FlavorText: Like a storm, they broke upon the line of the Men of Gondor.

84787.Name: Mirkwood Bats
84787.FlavorText:
"The enemy has many spies and many ways of hearing."
—Gandalf

84788.Name: Mordor Muster
84788.FlavorText:
"Orcs, thousands of Orcses. Nice Hobbits mustn't go to those places."
—Gollum

84790.Name: Morgul-Knife Wound
84790.FlavorText: Frodo felt a pain like a dart of poisoned ice pierce his left shoulder.

84791.Name: Nasty End
84791.FlavorText:
"And that's the end of that. A nasty end for Saruman, and I wish I needn't have seen it; but it's a good riddance."
—Sam

84794.Name: One Ring to Rule Them All

84797.Name: Sam's Desperate Rescue
84797.FlavorText: "By all the signs, there's a large warrior loose, with an Elf-sword, and an axe as well maybe." Gorbag spat. Sam smiled grimly at this description of himself.

84799.Name: Shadow of the Enemy
84799.FlavorText: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly. His wrath blazed in consuming flame, but his fear rose like black smoke.

84800.Name: Shelob's Ambush
84800.FlavorText: As Frodo ran forward, eager, rejoicing to be free, Shelob with hideous speed came behind and stung him in the neck.

84801.Name: Snarling Warg
84801.FlavorText: A shuddering howl broke from him, as if he were a captain summoning his pack to the assault.

84802.Name: The Torment of Gollum
84802.FlavorText: In Mordor, all that he knew was forced from him.

84803.Name: Troll of Khazad-dûm
84803.FlavorText:
"A great cave-troll, I think. There is no hope of escape that way."
—Gandalf

84804.Name: Uruk-hai Berserker
84804.FlavorText: "What of the dawn? We are the Uruk-hai; we do not stop the fight for night or day, for fair weather or for storm. We come to kill, by sun or moon. What of the dawn?"

84807.Name: Battle-Scarred Goblin
84807.FlavorText:
"An Orc shot Balin from behind a stone. We slew the Orc, but many more came."
—Book of Mazarbul

84809.Name: Breaking of the Fellowship
84809.FlavorText: "It might have been mine. It should be mine. Give it to me!"

84810.Name: Cast into the Fire
84810.FlavorText:
"But for Gollum, I could not have destroyed the Ring. So let us forgive him! For the Quest is achieved, and now all is over."
—Frodo

84811.Name: Display of Power
84811.FlavorText:
"The Nazgûl closed round at night, and I was besieged. Such light and flame cannot have been seen on Weathertop since the war-beacons of old."
—Gandalf

84812.Name: Éomer, Marshal of Rohan
84812.FlavorText: "Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never."

84813.Name: Éomer of the Riddermark
84813.FlavorText: But northward the white crest of Éomer led the great front of the Rohirrim which he had again gathered and marshaled.

84814.Name: Erebor Flamesmith
84814.FlavorText:
"We make good armor and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that our fathers made before the dragon came."
—Glóin

84815.Name: Erkenbrand, Lord of Westfold
84815.FlavorText: Down from the hills leaped Erkenbrand, lord of Westfold, and the hosts of Isengard roared in fear.

84818.Name: Fiery Inscription
84818.FlavorText: Ash nazg durbatulûk, ash nazg gimbatul, ash nazg thrakatulûk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul.

84819.Name: Fire of Orthanc
84819.FlavorText: The barricade was scattered as if by a thunderbolt.

84821.Name: Gimli, Counter of Kills
84821.FlavorText: "Twenty-one!" cried Gimli. He hewed a two-handed stroke and laid the last Orc before his feet. "Now my count passes Master Legolas."

84825.Name: Goblin Fireleaper
84825.FlavorText:
"Let us hope that fire now lies between us and pursuit. Come! There is no time to lose."
—Gandalf

84827.Name: Haradrim Spearmaster
84827.FlavorText:
"In the South the Haradrim are moving, and fear has fallen on all our coastlands."
—Hirgon, errand-rider of Gondor

84829.Name: Improvised Club
84829.FlavorText:
"‘For a couple o' pins,' says Troll, and grins,
‘I'll eat thee too and gnaw thy shins.'"
—Sam

84830.Name: Moria Marauder
84830.FlavorText: There was a rush of hoarse laughter, like the fall of sliding stones into a pit; amid the clamor a deep voice was raised in command.

84832.Name: Olog-hai Crusher
84832.FlavorText: Trolls were abroad, no longer dull-witted, but cunning and armed with dreadful weapons.

84833.Name: Quarrel's End
84833.FlavorText:
"It is a joy to us to see you return into your own."
—Éomer

84834.Name: Rally at the Hornburg
84834.FlavorText: With a cry and a great noise they charged. Down from the gates they roared, over the causeway they swept, and they drove through the hosts of Isengard as a wind among grass.

84835.Name: Ranger's Firebrand
84835.FlavorText:
"Keep close to the fire, with your faces outward! Get some of the longer sticks ready in your hands!"
—Strider

84836.Name: Relentless Rohirrim
84836.FlavorText:
"The Orcs are in the Deep! Helm! Helm! Forth Helmingas!"
—Gamling the Old

84837.Name: Rising of the Day
84837.FlavorText: Over the low hills the horns were sounding. Hastening down the long slopes were a thousand men on foot; their swords were in their hands.

84838.Name: Rohirrim Lancer
84838.FlavorText:
"Dire deeds awake, dark is it eastward.
Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!"
—Théoden

84839.Name: Rush the Room
84839.FlavorText: There was a horn-blast and a rush of feet, and Orcs one after another leaped into the chamber.

84844.Name: Warbeast of Gorgoroth
84844.FlavorText: Drums rolled, fires leaped, and great engines drawn by beasts crawled across the field.

84845.Name: Bag End Porter
84845.FlavorText:
"Dwarves' tongues run on when speaking of their handiwork, they say."
—Glóin

84846.Name: Bombadil's Song
84846.FlavorText:
"Hey dol! merry dol! ring a dong dillo!
Ring a dong! hop along! fal lal the willow!
Tom Bom, jolly Tom, Tom Bombadillo!"

84847.Name: Brandywine Farmer
84847.FlavorText:
"Your land must be a realm of peace and content, and there must gardeners be in high honor."
—Faramir

84848.Name: Celeborn the Wise
84848.FlavorText: His eyes were keen as lances in starlight, and yet profound, the wells of deep memory.

84849.Name: Chance-Met Elves
84849.FlavorText:
"It is said, ‘Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes.'"
—Frodo

84850.Name: Delighted Halfling
84850.FlavorText: There were toys the Hobbit-children had never seen before, all beautiful, and some obviously magical.

84851.Name: Dúnedain Rangers
84851.FlavorText: "Aragorn has need of his kindred. Let the Dúnedain go to him in Rohan!"

84852.Name: Elven Chorus
84852.FlavorText: "A Elbereth Gilthoniel, silivren penna míriel o menel aglar elenath!"

84853.Name: Elven Farsight
84853.FlavorText:
"Few can foresee whither their road will lead them, till they come to its end."
—Legolas

84854.Name: Enraged Huorn
84854.FlavorText:
"They stand watching endlessly over the trees. It is difficult to see them moving, but they can move very quickly if they are angry."
—Merry

84856.Name: Ent's Fury
84856.FlavorText:
"I came and called the trees by their long names, but they did not hear or answer—they lay dead."
—Quickbeam

84858.Name: Fangorn, Tree Shepherd
84858.FlavorText: "I am an Ent. Fangorn is my name according to some, Treebeard others make it."

84860.Name: Galadhrim Guide
84860.FlavorText: "I shall lead you well, and the paths are smooth and straight."

84862.Name: Gift of Strands
84862.FlavorText:
"None have ever made to me a request so bold and yet so courteous."
—Galadriel

84863.Name: Glorfindel, Dauntless Rescuer
84863.FlavorText: On the Elf-lord's brow sat wisdom, and in his hand was strength.

84864.Name: Last March of the Ents
84864.FlavorText:
"To Isengard with doom we come!
With doom we come, with doom we come!"

84867.Name: Lothlórien Lookout
84867.FlavorText:
"That was the custom of the Elves of Lórien, to dwell in the trees. Therefore they were called Galadhrim, the Tree-people."
—Legolas

84868.Name: Many Partings
84868.FlavorText:
"For you in all the lands of the West there will ever be a welcome, dearest friend."
—Aragorn

84869.Name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
84869.FlavorText: "My dear old Hobbit, you don't allow for the inquisitiveness of friends. I have known about the existence of the Ring for years."

84870.Name: Mirkwood Spider
84870.FlavorText: Far and wide Shelob's lesser broods spread from glen to glen, to Dol Guldur and the fastnesses of Mirkwood.

84871.Name: Mirrormere Guardian
84871.FlavorText:
"But still the sunken stars appear
In dark and windless Mirrormere;
There lies his crown in water deep,
Till Durin wakes again from sleep."
—Gimli's song

84872.Name: Mushroom Watchdogs
84872.FlavorText:
"They won't harm you—not unless I tell 'em to. Here, Grip! Fang! Heel!"
—Farmer Maggot

84873.Name: Peregrin Took
84873.FlavorText: "Sam! Get breakfast ready for half-past nine!"

84874.Name: Pippin's Bravery
84874.FlavorText: Pippin stabbed upwards, and the written blade of Westernesse pierced through the hide and went deep into the vitals of the troll.

84875.Name: Quickbeam, Upstart Ent
84875.FlavorText: "It is only a nickname, of course. They have called me that ever since I said yes to an elder Ent before he had finished his question."

84877.Name: Revive the Shire
84877.FlavorText: In the Party Field, a beautiful young sapling leaped up: it was indeed a mallorn, and it was the wonder of the neighborhood.

84880.Name: Shower of Arrows
84880.FlavorText:
"I wish there were more of your kin among us, Gimli. But even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them."
—Legolas

84881.Name: Stew the Coneys
84881.FlavorText: "Stew the rabbits?" squealed Gollum in dismay. "Spoil beautiful meat Sméagol saved for you, poor hungry Sméagol! What for?"

84882.Name: Wose Pathfinder
84882.FlavorText: "Road is forgotten, but not by Wild Folk. Over hill and behind hill it lies still under grass and tree. Wild Folk will show you that road."

84886.Name: Arwen Undómiel
84886.FlavorText: She was called Undómiel, for she was the Evenstar of her people.

84888.Name: Bilbo, Retired Burglar
84888.FlavorText: "I don't know half of you half as well as I should like; and I like less than half of you half as well as you deserve."

84889.Name: Butterbur, Bree Innkeeper
84889.FlavorText: "I hope you'll be comfortable. You'll be wanting supper, I don't doubt. As soon as may be. This way now!"

84893.Name: Éowyn, Fearless Knight
84893.FlavorText: "Am I not of the House of Eorl? I have waited on faltering feet long enough."

84894.Name: Faramir, Prince of Ithilien
84894.FlavorText: The City was made more fair than it had ever been, even in the days of its first glory.

84895.Name: Flame of Anor
84895.FlavorText: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire, and the Balrog fell back.

84897.Name: Frodo Baggins
84897.FlavorText:
"Few have ever come hither through greater peril or on an errand more urgent."
—Elrond

84898.Name: Galadriel of Lothlórien
84898.FlavorText: "I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel."

84900.Name: Gandalf's Sanction
84900.FlavorText: There was a crack, and the staff split asunder in Saruman's hand, and the head of it fell down at Gandalf's feet.

84902.Name: Gwaihir the Windlord
84902.FlavorText: There came Gwaihir the Windlord, greatest of all the Eagles of the North, mightiest of the descendants of old Thorondor.

84904.Name: Legolas, Counter of Kills
84904.FlavorText: "Two?" said Legolas. "I make my tale twenty at the least."

84905.Name: Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff
84905.FlavorText:
"Whatever is wrong in the Shire, Lotho will be at the bottom of it: you can be sure of that."
—Pippin

84906.Name: Mauhúr, Uruk-hai Captain
84906.FlavorText: "We are the servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand: the Hand that gives us Man's-flesh to eat."

84907.Name: Merry, Esquire of Rohan
84907.FlavorText: Then suddenly Merry felt it at last, beyond doubt: a change. Wind was in his face!

84910.Name: Pippin, Guard of the Citadel
84910.FlavorText: "Here I do swear fealty to Gondor, until my lord release me, or death take me."

84911.Name: Prince Imrahil the Fair
84911.FlavorText: "The Lord Aragorn I hold to be my liege lord, whether he claim it or no. His wish is to me a command."

84912.Name: Ringsight
84912.FlavorText: Frodo was able to see beneath their black wrappings. In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes.

84913.Name: Rise of the Witch-king
84913.FlavorText: In rode the Lord of the Nazgûl, under the archway that no enemy ever yet had passed, and all fled before his face.

84917.Name: Sauron's Ransom
84917.FlavorText: "He was dear to you, I see. And now he shall endure the slow torment of years."

84918.Name: Shadow Summoning
84918.FlavorText:
"Whose shall the horn be? Who shall call them
from the grey twilight, the forgotten people?
The heir of him to whom the oath they swore."
—Malbeth the Seer

84924.Name: Strider, Ranger of the North
84924.FlavorText: The greatest traveler and huntsman of this age of the world.

84925.Name: Théoden, King of Rohan
84925.FlavorText: "Dark have been my dreams of late, but I feel new-awakened. I only fear that already you have come too late, Gandalf."

84927.Name: Uglúk of the White Hand
84927.FlavorText: "I am Uglúk. I command. I return to Isengard by the shortest road."

84930.Name: Ent-Draught Basin
84930.FlavorText: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigor as it coursed upward, right to the tips of the hair.

84933.Name: Horn of the Mark
84933.FlavorText:
"He that blows this horn shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends."
—Éowyn

84934.Name: Inherited Envelope
84934.FlavorText:
"Keep it secret, and keep it safe!"
—Gandalf

84935.Name: Lembas
84935.FlavorText: They could eat of it and find new strength even as they ran.

84936.Name: Mirror of Galadriel
84936.FlavorText: "Your Quest stands upon the edge of a knife. Stray but a little and it will fail, to the ruin of all. Yet hope remains while all the Company is true."

84940.Name: Phial of Galadriel
84940.FlavorText: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out."

84943.Name: Stone of Erech
84943.FlavorText:
"At the Stone of Erech they shall stand again
and hear there a horn in the hills ringing."
—Malbeth the Seer

84945.Name: Barad-dûr
84945.FlavorText:
"Those who pass the gates of Barad-dûr do not return."
—Gandalf

84946.Name: Great Hall of the Citadel
84946.FlavorText:
"Renewed shall be blade that was broken:
The crownless again shall be king."
—Bilbo

84947.Name: The Grey Havens
84947.FlavorText: There dwelt Círdan the Shipwright, and some say he dwells there still, until the Last Ship sets sail into the West.

84948.Name: Minas Tirith
84948.FlavorText:
"I would see the White Tree in flower again in the courts of the kings, and Minas Tirith in peace."
—Faramir

84949.Name: Mines of Moria
84949.FlavorText:
"Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!"
—Glóin

84951.Name: Rivendell
84951.FlavorText:
"Were I to go where my heart dwells, I would now be wandering in the fair valley of Rivendell."
—Aragorn

84952.Name: The Shire
84952.FlavorText:
"You must start somewhere and have some roots, and the soil of the Shire is deep."
—Merry

84953.Name: Shire Terrace
84953.FlavorText: Everything looked fresh, and the new green of Spring was shimmering in the fields.

84954.Name: Human Soldier
84954.RawFrameDetail: W token, no text box, beyond

84955.Name: Human Soldier
84955.RawFrameDetail: W token, no text box, beyond

84956.Name: Spirit
84956.RawFrameDetail: W token, has text box, beyond

84960.RawFrameDetail: R legendary token, has text box, beyond

84964.RawFrameDetail: A token, has text box, beyond

84965.Name: Treasure
84965.RawFrameDetail: A token, has text box, beyond

84969.Name: Trailblazer's Boots
84969.FlavorText:
"Not idly do the leaves of Lórien fall."
—Aragorn

84970.Name: Eagle of Deliverance
84970.FlavorText: Even as he came swooping down, Gwaihir saw the two figures fall, worn out, hiding their eyes from death.

84974.Name: Mirkwood Channeler
84974.FlavorText: The dark things that were driven out of Mirkwood have returned in greater numbers, and it is again an evil place, save where the Elvish realm is maintained.

84976.Name: Elvish Mariner
84976.FlavorText: In the days of the Kings, most of the High Elves dwelt with Círdan or in the seaward lands of Lindon.

84979.Name: Elanor Gardner
84979.FlavorText: Her father Samwise gave her the Red Book for safekeeping before he sailed into the West.

84980.Name: Frodo, Determined Hero
84980.FlavorText: Frodo's heart flamed within him. He drew his sword and advanced.

84981.Name: Gandalf, White Rider
84981.FlavorText: He has passed through the fire and the abyss, and the enemy shall fear him.

84982.Name: Knight of the Keep
84982.FlavorText: Now the cries of clear strong voices came ringing over the fields. They rode in: a long line of mail-clad Men, swift, shining, fell and fair to look upon. Suddenly they swept up with a noise like thunder, and the foremost horseman swerved.

84986.Name: Goblin Assailant
84986.FlavorText: The fighting waxed furious on the fields of the Pelennor; and the din of arms rose upon high, with the crying of Men and the neighing of horses. But the hosts of Mordor were enheartened, and filled with a new fury they came yelling to the onset.

84988.Name: The Balrog, Flame of Udûn
84988.FlavorText: An evil of the Ancient World, both a shadow and a flame.

84990.Name: Aragorn and Arwen, Wed
84990.FlavorText: Aragorn the King Elessar wedded Arwen Undómiel, and the tale of their long waiting and labors came to fulfillment.

84991.Name: Sauron, the Lidless Eye
84991.FlavorText: There is an Eye in the Dark Tower that does not sleep.

84992.Name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
84992.FlavorText: The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be compleated.

84994.Name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
84994.FlavorText: "Rejoice, blessed evangels! The glorious light of compleation is nigh. Soon, we shall awaken the Multiverse from its slumber."

84996.Name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
84996.FlavorText:
"His blades were the ultimate agents of transformation. All Phyrexians who met them were transformed into pieces."
—Heroes of the Second Invasion

84997.Name: Sram, Senior Edificer
84997.FlavorText:
"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face."
—Monument inscription

84998.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
84998.FlavorText: No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.

84999.Name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
84999.FlavorText: In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.

85001.Name: Inga Rune-Eyes
85001.FlavorText: Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.

85002.Name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
85002.FlavorText: His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.

85003.Name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
85003.FlavorText:
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—Heroes of the Second Invasion

85005.Name: Horobi, Death's Wail
85005.FlavorText:
"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike."
—Records of the Living Historians

85006.Name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
85006.FlavorText:
"In its hatred for the mortal realms, it fought on the side of the invaders, heedless of its own eventual fate."
—Records of the Living Historians

85010.Name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
85010.FlavorText: Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

85013.Name: Squee, the Immortal
85013.FlavorText:
"Squee had never wanted to be a king or a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians. Naturally, he found himself as both."
—Heroes of the Second Invasion

85014.Name: Urabrask the Hidden
85014.FlavorText: While the other praetors eagerly prepared for invasion, Urabrask retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands.

85016.Name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
85016.FlavorText: To her delight, she was able to fully realize the explosive magical potential of hedrons.

85017.Name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
85017.FlavorText: "I always said I had a score to settle with that serpent. I'm a man of my word."

85021.Name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
85021.FlavorText: She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.

85022.Name: Aegar, the Freezing Flame
85022.FlavorText: Though Phyrexian machines could adapt to extremes of heat or cold, they never figured out how to adapt to both at once.

85024.Name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
85024.FlavorText:
"Teach these people the price of their insolence."
—Elesh Norn

85026.Name: Aurelia, the Warleader
85026.FlavorText: Leading from behind had never been her style.

85028.Name: Dina, Soul Steeper
85028.FlavorText: Her concoctions corroded metal and fortified organic tissue. They would be studied for generations.

85031.Name: Firja, Judge of Valor
85031.FlavorText: Invader after invader fell before her, and to each she spoke a single word: "Unworthy."

85036.Name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
85036.FlavorText: She protected Ravnica with the same things that thrilled her fans: courage, charisma, and a grand assortment of spiked chains.

85037.Name: Juri, Master of the Revue
85037.FlavorText: "Sure, the invasion was violent, but where was the beauty? As an artist, I had to intervene."

85046.Name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
85046.FlavorText:
"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons."
—Grand Warlord Radha

85048.Name: Reyav, Master Smith
85048.FlavorText: His impromptu demonstration of the portable energy shield attachment both saved lives and increased demand for aether-powered multi-tool gauntlets tenfold.

85049.Name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
85049.FlavorText: While many fought valiantly to preserve humanity, Rona wished only to strip hers away.

85050.Name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
85050.FlavorText:
"The Weatherlight gave so much. It deserved justice as much as any of us."
—Shanna

85052.Name: Teysa Karlov
85052.FlavorText: Her uncanny predictions of Phyrexian movements saved countless lives, though she never revealed the source of her information.

85054.Name: Yarok, the Desecrated
85054.FlavorText:
"Its blighted heart, its spinous hands
To break the hosts that foul its lands."
—Triumph of Bala Ged, stanza 6

85057.Name: Coppercoat Vanguard
85057.FlavorText: It was a time for rebuilding, but first Ikoria's wrecked cities had to be cleared of monsters.

85059.Name: Harnessed Snubhorn
85059.FlavorText: Survivors put the strength of former war mounts to good use clearing the rubble of Orazca.

85060.Name: Metropolis Reformer
85060.FlavorText: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.

85061.Name: Spark Rupture
85061.FlavorText: Phyrexia was defeated, but the repercussions of the invasion rippled through the Blind Eternities.

85063.Name: Filter Out
85063.FlavorText: The glistening oil had been rendered inert, but planes wouldn't begin to truly heal until every last drop was purged.

85065.Name: Training Grounds
85065.FlavorText: For those who survived, being prepared for the next crisis became one of the greatest virtues.

85068.Name: Blot Out
85068.FlavorText: After the invasion, many wanted to leave a life of violence. But once you're a Reckoner, you die a Reckoner.

85073.Name: Kolaghan Warmonger
85073.FlavorText: Conflict is a constant. Only the enemies change.

85075.Name: Reckless Handling
85075.FlavorText: The relic shattered, and something in Nahiri broke as well.

85076.Name: Animist's Might
85076.FlavorText: The creature was unlike any Nissa had seen, but she dealt with it as she would any threat.

85077.Name: Leyline Immersion
85077.FlavorText: When Nissa tapped into Zhalfir's leylines, she was shocked to feel not a piece of Dominaria, but a plane all its own.

85081.Name: Undercity Upheaval
85081.FlavorText: Light shone on parts of the undercity for the first time in centuries.

85083.Name: Campus Renovation
85083.FlavorText: Reconstructing the past is Lorehold's specialty.

85084.Name: Cosmic Rebirth
85084.FlavorText:
"When all the stories find their ends, a new one shall begin."
—The Endsaga

85085.Name: Danitha, New Benalia's Light
85085.FlavorText: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen, but she mourned that the opportunity had come so soon.

85086.Name: Feast of the Victorious Dead
85086.FlavorText: To hear them tell it, they charged bare-handed into New Phyrexia and beat up Elesh Norn all by themselves.

85087.Name: Gold-Forged Thopteryx
85087.FlavorText: Worlds apart, Huatli built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.

85088.Name: Jirina, Dauntless General
85088.FlavorText: "Our strength lies not in our walls, but in our people."

85094.Name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
85094.FlavorText: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

85097.Name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
85097.FlavorText: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, he faced five families out for blood.

85099.Name: Rebuild the City
85099.FlavorText: The Phyrexian design had to go, but the materials could be put to good use.

85101.Name: Samut, Vizier of Naktamun
85101.FlavorText: "Try to keep up, Djeru. We have lots of work to do."

85106.Name: Drannith Ruins
85106.FlavorText: Like Orn before it, Drannith was reduced to a playground for Ikoria's monsters.

85108.Name: Phyrexian Pegasus
85108.FlavorText:
"It is glory, exalted and compleat."
—Cymede, regent of the Alabaster Host

85109.Name: Seedpod Caretaker
85109.FlavorText: His body clicked and hummed—a lullaby meant only for machines.

85112.Name: Zephyr Winder
85112.FlavorText: It twines through the roiling cloudscape feeding on the energies of nascent storms.

85115.Name: Terror of Towashi
85115.FlavorText: Takumi knew where all the bodies were buried. After all, he'd buried most of them.

85116.Name: Axgard Artisan
85116.FlavorText: Skodreg knew the Phyrexians wouldn't appreciate his craftsmanship, but they'd get an up-close look just the same.

85119.Name: Fairgrounds Trumpeter
85119.FlavorText:
"What is that horrible flesh-noise?! We must silence it before it grows even louder!"
—Thxmir, Machine Legion scout

85120.Name: Ruins Recluse
85120.FlavorText: Desert horrors were its favorite treat, but it happily expanded its diet to include extraplanar horrors.

85121.Name: Surrak and Goreclaw
85121.FlavorText: Two titans of Tarkir carved a swath through Phyrexia's elite.

85515.Name: Yargle and Multani
85515.FlavorText:
"I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled. "There was a time when I'd balk at your aid, phantom, but she has shown me the merit in Urborg's strange ways."
"Gnshhagghkkapphribbit," replied Yargle.

85519.Name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
85519.FlavorText: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

85521.Name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
85521.FlavorText: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

85523.Name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
85523.FlavorText: Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.

85524.Name: Sram, Senior Edificer
85524.FlavorText: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

85525.Name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
85525.FlavorText: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

85526.Name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
85526.FlavorText: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

85528.Name: Inga Rune-Eyes
85528.FlavorText: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.

85529.Name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
85529.FlavorText: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

85530.Name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
85530.FlavorText: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, ‘Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

85531.Name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
85531.FlavorText: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

85532.Name: Horobi, Death's Wail
85532.FlavorText:
"From the ashes of Reito rose a new kami. And thereafter at every battle came Horobi, Death's Wail."
—The History of Kamigawa

85533.Name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
85533.FlavorText:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

85537.Name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
85537.FlavorText: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

85540.Name: Squee, the Immortal
85540.FlavorText: "You gotta be pretty smart to live long as me, but not being able to die helps."

85541.Name: Urabrask the Hidden
85541.FlavorText: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

85542.Name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
85542.FlavorText: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

85543.Name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
85543.FlavorText: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

85544.Name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
85544.FlavorText: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

85545.Name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
85545.FlavorText: You don't want to know how she got that name.

85548.Name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
85548.FlavorText: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

85553.Name: Aurelia, the Warleader
85553.FlavorText: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

85557.Name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
85557.FlavorText: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.

85558.Name: Firja, Judge of Valor
85558.FlavorText: She is both shepherd and reaper, and her judgment is final.

85563.Name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
85563.FlavorText: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

85564.Name: Juri, Master of the Revue
85564.FlavorText: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

85568.Name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
85568.FlavorText: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

85573.Name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
85573.FlavorText: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

85574.Name: Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart
85574.FlavorText: "This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."

85576.Name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
85576.FlavorText: "Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of compleation."

85577.Name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
85577.FlavorText: "I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."

85579.Name: Teysa Karlov
85579.FlavorText: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

85581.Name: Yarok, the Desecrated
85581.FlavorText:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 1

85620.Name: A-Shipwreck Sifters
85620.FlavorText: A loyal crew sticks together, even after death.

85621.Name: A-Patrician Geist
85621.FlavorText: He rides in agitated circles, snapping orders at servants who've long since found their peace.

85625.Name: A-Shipwreck Sifters
85625.FlavorText: A loyal crew sticks together, even after death.

85626.Name: A-Phantom Carriage
85626.FlavorText: Passage to the abyss is free, but the return trip will cost you.

85627.Name: A-Patrician Geist
85627.FlavorText: He rides in agitated circles, snapping orders at servants who've long since found their peace.

85628.Name: A-Akki Ronin
85628.FlavorText:
"Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade."
—Keni-Keni, akki smith

85630.Name: A-Eiganjo Exemplar
85630.FlavorText: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.

85632.Name: A-Peerless Samurai
85632.FlavorText: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."

85637.Name: A-Raiyuu, Storm's Edge
85637.FlavorText: "The tempest is the only ally I need."

85638.Name: A-Raiyuu, Storm's Edge
85638.ArtistCredit: 壱子みるく亭/ichiko milk tei

85644.Name: A-Lantern Bearer
85644.FlavorText: Val didn't know what the silent geist was offering . . .

85645.Name: A-Dorothea, Vengeful Victim
85645.FlavorText: "Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest."
85645.RawFrameDetail: WU gold legendary front side TDFC

85646.Name: A-Dorothea, Vengeful Victim
85646.RawFrameDetail: alt WU gold legendary front side TDFC

85647.Name: A-Gutter Skulker
85647.FlavorText: Geists have a knack for showing up wherever they're least expected.

85648.Name: A-Mischievous Catgeist
85648.FlavorText:
"I never get any knitting done, but I don't entirely mind."
—Lorn, Lambholt innkeeper

85651.Name: A-Lanterns' Lift
85651.FlavorText: . . . but she knew it would be rude to refuse.

85653.Name: A-Dorothea's Retribution
85653.RawFrameDetail: alt WU gold back side TDFC

85654.Name: A-Gutter Shortcut
85654.FlavorText: Some people take that as inspiration.

85656.Name: A-Akki Ronin
85656.FlavorText:
"Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade."
—Keni-Keni, akki smith

85657.Name: A-Eiganjo Exemplar
85657.FlavorText: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.

85658.Name: A-Peerless Samurai
85658.FlavorText: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."

86059.Name: Descend upon the Sinful
86059.FlavorText: Above the cries, a phrase rang out: "You will all be saved."

86060.Name: Devilthorn Fox
86060.FlavorText: On expeditions through Ashmouth, the hunters of Devilthorn Lodge rely on the cleverness of foxes to counteract the mischief of devils.

86061.Name: Drogskol Shieldmate
86061.FlavorText: "I will join you so that you will not yet join me."

86063.Name: Faithbearer Paladin
86063.FlavorText:
"I've seen cathars riding to battle without a hint of fear. Perhaps that is its own sort of madness."
—Esler, Havengul mercenary

86064.Name: Fiend Binder
86064.FlavorText: She had not believed any shred of humanity remained in these writhing monsters until the twisted form of her partner appeared before her.

86065.Name: Gisela, the Broken Blade
86065.FlavorText: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

86067.Name: Guardian of Pilgrims
86067.FlavorText: Immune to the physical warping caused by Emrakul, geists proved to be some of humanity's most important allies.

86068.Name: Hope Against Hope
86068.FlavorText: "I have given my life to the church, my soul to Avacyn, and my heart to the people."

86069.Name: Humble the Brute
86069.FlavorText: "The element of surprise only works when it's backed up by a bolt between the eyes."

86070.Name: Ironclad Slayer
86070.FlavorText: The best weapon is the one at hand.

86071.Name: Lone Rider
86071.FlavorText:
"Horse and rider are often of one mind."
—Ulda, Gavony Rider

86072.Name: It That Rides as One
86072.FlavorText:
". . . but until this morning, I'd never seen them be of one body."
—Ulda, Gavony Rider

86073.Name: Lunarch Mantle
86073.FlavorText:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

86076.Name: Puncturing Light
86076.FlavorText: "If you refuse to see the light, then you will feel it."

86079.Name: Sigarda's Aid
86079.FlavorText: The Order of Saint Traft found new strength with Sigarda's support.

86080.Name: Sigardian Priest
86080.FlavorText: Many whose faith was destroyed by Avacyn turned to the only angel who remained true to humanity.

86081.Name: Spectral Shepherd
86081.FlavorText: The restless geists of common folk often continue their lifelong labors.

86082.Name: Steadfast Cathar
86082.FlavorText:
"The most resolute soldiers will press forward in the face of overwhelming odds."
—Gideon Jura

86083.Name: Strength of Arms
86083.FlavorText:
"We fight not for Avacyn, but for her ideals; not for the church, but for its people."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

86084.Name: Subjugator Angel
86084.FlavorText: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

86085.Name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
86085.FlavorText: "Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary."

86086.Name: Thalia's Lancers
86086.FlavorText: "Let the points of our lances lead the way."

86087.Name: Thraben Inspector
86087.FlavorText: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

86090.Name: Incited Rabble
86090.FlavorText: Rumors are sparks: gather enough of them and something's going to catch fire.

86091.Name: Advanced Stitchwing
86091.FlavorText:
"Improvement is a consequence of practice."
—Stitcher Geralf

86094.Name: Convolute
86094.FlavorText:
"There's no sense arguing with insanity."
—Levana, Midnight Duelist

86096.Name: Voracious Reader
86096.FlavorText: Good books make you savor each word.

86097.Name: Daring Sleuth
86097.FlavorText: "No matter the cost, I must discover the source of these strange happenings."

86099.Name: Deny Existence
86099.FlavorText: When all logical solutions fail, try an illogical one.

86100.Name: Docent of Perfection
86100.FlavorText: The time had come for him to share his findings.

86102.Name: Drag Under
86102.FlavorText: Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.

86103.Name: Drownyard Explorers
86103.FlavorText: "Angels and inquisitors terrorize villages, but no one seems to notice the stirring out at sea."

86104.Name: Drunau Corpse Trawler
86104.FlavorText: Seagrafs yield an abundance of resources for stitchers and ghoulcallers alike.

86105.Name: Epiphany at the Drownyard
86105.FlavorText:
"Is this what you found, Tamiyo?"
—Jace Beleren

86106.Name: Erdwal Illuminator
86106.FlavorText:
"When all else fails, follow the geist's lantern."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector

86107.Name: Essence Flux
86107.FlavorText: A spirit is both fettered and free—bound in some ways to its previous existence, yet able to transcend much of the corporeal.

86108.Name: Exultant Cultist
86108.FlavorText: Amid the gibbering chorus that rose from the drownyard temple, Jace recognized a single word: "Emrakul."

86112.Name: Geist of the Archives
86112.FlavorText: After reading the final words, it turns back to the first page and begins again.

86114.Name: Imprisoned in the Moon
86114.FlavorText: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

86115.Name: Ingenious Skaab
86115.FlavorText: Heads and shoulders above the rest.

86118.Name: Jace's Scrutiny
86118.FlavorText: "Just a collage of images: cryptoliths, the sea, a tangle of shipwrecks."

86119.Name: Laboratory Brute
86119.FlavorText: It keeps intruders out and experiments in.

86122.Name: Mind's Dilation
86122.FlavorText: Infinite wisdom cannot be contained within a single mind.

86125.Name: Pieces of the Puzzle
86125.FlavorText: "The clues have begun to reveal a truth I hesitate to accept."

86126.Name: Pore Over the Pages
86126.FlavorText: "‘I'm certain that the fate of Markov Manor is connected to these cryptoliths . . .' This Tamiyo was on to something."

86128.Name: Rise from the Tides
86128.FlavorText:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

86132.Name: Stormrider Spirit
86132.FlavorText: Thunder isn't all that follows lightning.

86134.Name: Take Inventory
86134.FlavorText: A place for everything, and everything in its place.

86135.Name: Tattered Haunter
86135.FlavorText: When the Nebelgast recedes, there are often stragglers.

86137.Name: Awoken Horror
86137.FlavorText:
"It serves as evidence of the ancient power of the deep, a reminder that the sea is the only thing worthy of reverence."
—Runo Stromkirk

86142.Name: Biting Rain
86142.FlavorText: On Innistrad, it is seldom wrong to stay indoors.

86144.Name: Call the Bloodline
86144.FlavorText: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

86145.Name: Certain Death
86145.FlavorText: Some spirits cling to one person, feasting on the growing fear until a final moment of all-consuming terror.

86148.Name: Dark Salvation
86148.FlavorText: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.

86149.Name: Dead Weight
86149.FlavorText:
"Dungeons and cages offer far too little sport."
—Relio Voldaren

86150.Name: Kindly Stranger
86150.FlavorText: "I'm not afraid out here, for I know that a higher power protects me."

86151.Name: Demon-Possessed Witch
86151.FlavorText: "It looks like you could use some protection of your own."

86153.Name: Dusk Feaster
86153.FlavorText: The Voldaren lands remained well protected when Olivia's army marched from Lurenbraum Fortress.

86155.Name: Gavony Unhallowed
86155.FlavorText:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

86156.Name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
86156.FlavorText: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

86163.Name: Indulgent Aristocrat
86163.FlavorText: "If you're not surrounded by decadence, my question to you is—why not?"

86165.Name: Liliana's Elite
86165.FlavorText:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

86166.Name: Macabre Waltz
86166.FlavorText: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

86167.Name: Merciless Resolve
86167.FlavorText: "You sought to anger me, Nahiri. Soon you will see how well you have succeeded."

86170.Name: Morkrut Necropod
86170.FlavorText:
"There's not enough salt in all of Nephalia to wither that thing."
—Ghoulcaller Enslow

86172.Name: Olivia's Bloodsworn
86172.FlavorText: "As we muster for war, I have little patience for lethargy or recalcitrance."

86173.Name: Olivia's Dragoon
86173.FlavorText: Displays of Voldaren bloodlust are not restricted to glamorous banquets and lavish parties.

86176.Name: Rise from the Grave
86176.FlavorText:
"Don't get too comfortable in there."
—Liliana Vess

86177.Name: Ruthless Disposal
86177.FlavorText:
"Do try to pull your weight, Geralf. I feel like I'm doing everything."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

86178.Name: Sanitarium Skeleton
86178.FlavorText: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

86179.Name: Stromkirk Condemned
86179.FlavorText:
"Blood from the vein is the finest vintage to accompany a feast of the mind."
—Runo Stromkirk

86180.Name: Thraben Foulbloods
86180.FlavorText: The famed hunting hounds of House Cecani continue to prove the quality of their pedigree.

86184.Name: Abolisher of Bloodlines
86184.FlavorText: Even if the rain turned to blood, her thirst would not be slaked.

86185.Name: Weirded Vampire
86185.FlavorText:
"Emrakul makes apparent those whom she has favored."
—Runo Stromkirk

86187.Name: Assembled Alphas
86187.FlavorText: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

86190.Name: Blood Mist
86190.FlavorText: "Some claim that rage is a cloud that obscures thought and vision. But I can assure you—I've never seen with greater clarity."

86195.Name: Conduit of Storms
86195.FlavorText: It strikes with the fury of a tempest.

86197.Name: Deranged Whelp
86197.FlavorText:
"When you confront a wolf scorned by its pack, extra caution is the order of the day."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

86198.Name: Devils' Playground
86198.FlavorText:
"The city is overrun. I would say burn it to the ground, but that won't be necessary."
—Inquisitor Delmund

86199.Name: Ember-Eye Wolf
86199.FlavorText: No howl. No snarl. Just the roar of flames.

86202.Name: Flameblade Angel
86202.FlavorText: "You must pay for your sin in blood."

86203.Name: Furyblade Vampire
86203.FlavorText: "Writhe all you want, filth. It will do you no good."

86204.Name: Galvanic Bombardment
86204.FlavorText: Geist-powered devices have no shortage of fuel.

86205.Name: Gatstaf Arsonists
86205.FlavorText: The glow in their eyes reveals more than anger or madness.

86207.Name: Geier Reach Bandit
86207.FlavorText: The cathars realized they had not tracked her—she had led them here.

86212.Name: Howlpack Wolf
86212.FlavorText: Wolves and werewolves join together for the common cause of the hunt.

86213.Name: Incendiary Flow
86213.FlavorText:
"What's your plan?" Gideon asked.
"Are you serious?" Chandra replied.

86214.Name: Insatiable Gorgers
86214.FlavorText:
"Drink deeply, for there is no tomorrow!"
—Anje Falkenrath

86216.Name: Lightning Axe
86216.FlavorText: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

86217.Name: Mad Prophet
86217.FlavorText: "I have seen it. Seen the end, seen the beginning, the beginning of the end. Not death, no, no. Transcendence!"

86218.Name: Magmatic Chasm
86218.FlavorText: The Needle's Eye, a seldom-used passage that winds through Stensia's mountains, carries travelers close to Ashmouth—too close, some would argue.

86219.Name: Make Mischief
86219.FlavorText: A tidy desk is as good as an invitation.

86222.Name: Pyre Hound
86222.FlavorText: Its growl is the crackling and popping of a wildfire untamed.

86223.Name: Ravenous Bloodseeker
86223.FlavorText:
"Nothing will cool the fire in their blood. They are too far gone. We must keep them away from our towns at any cost."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

86224.Name: Rush of Adrenaline
86224.FlavorText: Scarecrows only go so far in sending the message to stay away.

86226.Name: Shreds of Sanity
86226.FlavorText: A few gnawing thoughts can eat at the mind until nothing else remains.

86230.Name: Thermo-Alchemist
86230.FlavorText: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

86231.Name: Tormenting Voice
86231.FlavorText:
"The voice has grown louder, its accusations angrier and more insistent. By morning, it will likely drown out all else. I fear what I will do."
—Letter discovered in an abandoned estate

86232.Name: Ulrich's Kindred
86232.FlavorText:
"I am not its master. We are of the same pack."
—Ulrich, Krallenhorde alpha

86233.Name: Uncaged Fury
86233.FlavorText:
"It's right to fear those that you keep locked away."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

86236.Name: Aim High
86236.FlavorText:
"A slayer gets by on wits and reflexes."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

86237.Name: Bloodbriar
86237.FlavorText:
"There is a sourness here that I don't understand. When the land reaches out to me, I hesitate to reach back."
—Nissa Revane

86239.Name: Byway Courier
86239.FlavorText: A good courier travels fast and asks no questions.

86240.Name: Clear Shot
86240.FlavorText:
"What worked to bring down angels will do the same for these horrors."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi

86241.Name: Confront the Unknown
86241.FlavorText:
"Never flinch from the truth."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

86243.Name: Cryptolith Rite
86243.FlavorText: The chant was incomprehensible, but its power was unmistakable.

86244.Name: Deathcap Cultivator
86244.FlavorText: The old hermit would never say what he fed his mushrooms, and people learned not to ask.

86248.Name: Gnarlwood Dryad
86248.FlavorText: As Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad, evacuation from Kessig's remote villages became increasingly difficult.

86249.Name: Graf Mole
86249.FlavorText:
"Their keen sense of smell draws them to the unnatural. To find one is a boon."
—Veka, hinterland inspector

86250.Name: Grapple with the Past
86250.FlavorText: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

86251.Name: Groundskeeper
86251.FlavorText: "While the church thinks in terms of legacies, others think in terms of eternities."

86252.Name: Hamlet Captain
86252.FlavorText: "Bloodsuckers, howlers, monsters from the beyond . . . it doesn't much matter. I won't have to face them alone."

86253.Name: Hinterland Logger
86253.FlavorText:
"There's a forester lives up in the highlands. Tried to sell her one of my finest axes at a bargain, but she wasn't interested."
—Old Rutstein

86254.Name: Timber Shredder
86254.FlavorText:
"She even had the audacity to criticize my wares as inferior."
—Old Rutstein

86255.Name: Howlpack Resurgence
86255.FlavorText: The renewed howling of werewolves announced the end of the Cursemute—and the beginning of Avacyn's madness.

86256.Name: Intrepid Provisioner
86256.FlavorText: "How do I know where aid is needed? Look around you."

86258.Name: Moonlight Hunt
86258.FlavorText: Courage alone won't keep you alive.

86259.Name: Noose Constrictor
86259.FlavorText:
"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor

86262.Name: Permeating Mass
86262.FlavorText: Woodland geists concluded that Emrakul would be unable to warp the denizens of the forest if the geists got there first.

86263.Name: Rabid Bite
86263.FlavorText:
"You should have seen the look on both their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

86266.Name: Seasons Past
86266.FlavorText: The seeds of new life take root in the soil of old.

86267.Name: Second Harvest
86267.FlavorText:
"The cornfields promise a good yield this season."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

86268.Name: Shrill Howler
86268.FlavorText:
"A werewolf's howl is terrifying, to be sure. But this . . . this was a chilling sound I somehow felt. I fear what will reply to it."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

86270.Name: Spirit of the Hunt
86270.FlavorText: The bonds of the pack transcend time and death.

86271.Name: Splendid Reclamation
86271.FlavorText:
"No matter how much a plane has suffered, there is a way to restore it."
—Nissa Revane

86272.Name: Swift Spinner
86272.FlavorText: Its web is woven so tightly that not even geists can avoid capture.

86273.Name: Thornhide Wolves
86273.FlavorText:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

86276.Name: Ulvenwald Captive
86276.FlavorText:
"Even on a plane as dark as this one, nature will organize a defense against the unnatural."
—Nissa Revane

86277.Name: Ulvenwald Abomination
86277.FlavorText:
"The Eldrazi are all too practiced at twisting natural into unnatural."
—Nissa Revane

86281.Name: Veteran Cathar
86281.FlavorText: "Prayers can be powerful, but I prefer to put faith in my own two hands."

86285.Name: Anguished Unmaking
86285.FlavorText: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

86286.Name: Arlinn Kord
86286.RawFrameDetail: RG gold planeswalker front side 2 abilities

86289.Name: Fevered Visions
86289.FlavorText: The mind can only expand so far before it flies apart.

86290.Name: Gisa and Geralf
86290.FlavorText:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

86292.Name: Heron's Grace Champion
86292.FlavorText: Sigarda was the last uncorrupted archangel, but she would not have to fight alone.

86293.Name: Mercurial Geists
86293.FlavorText:
