"Procedural misstep: provocation of geists for the purpose of yielding more energy can compromise containment units. Next action: clean up mess."
—Laboratory notes

86297.Name: Prized Amalgam
86297.FlavorText:
"Ludevic's laboratory is a veritable wonderland. I have never felt so inspired."
—Stitcher Geralf

86298.Name: Ride Down
86298.FlavorText: The Order of Saint Traft cleared the roads of cultists and horrors, opening the way for the villagers to flee Thraben.

86307.Name: Aurora of Emrakul
86307.FlavorText:
"I felt compelled to take the twisted stone, and I abandoned my horse's burden to accommodate its weight. Now, its continued glow illuminates my home and warms my mind."
—Garner Kroft, Moorland farmer

86308.Name: Epitaph Golem
86308.FlavorText: Many names and many memories bound together in grim purpose.

86309.Name: Explosive Apparatus
86309.FlavorText:
"Souls are volatile things. When compressed and loaded into a handheld device, their destructive potential is quite impressive."
—Dierk, geistmage

86310.Name: Field Creeper
86310.FlavorText: As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

86313.Name: Lupine Prototype
86313.FlavorText:
"Ludevic saw it in a dream and set to work immediately, every detail already known. Can such genius be taught?"
—Stitcher Geralf

86314.Name: Magnifying Glass
86314.FlavorText: Knight-Inquisitors of Saint Raban delve deep into mysteries best left unexplored.

86315.Name: Murderer's Axe
86315.FlavorText: Though the first who raised it in a fit of passion is long dead, the axe still carries memories of bitter scorn.

86316.Name: Neglected Heirloom
86316.FlavorText:
"There is a rich history in a blade like this."
—Old Rutstein

86317.Name: Ashmouth Blade
86317.FlavorText:
"Its previous owners had some stories to share, I'm certain."
—Old Rutstein

86321.Name: Tamiyo's Journal
86321.FlavorText: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

86326.Name: Foreboding Ruins
86326.FlavorText: Sent to find Sorin, Jace ventured to the vampire's ancestral home, only to find evidence of a deeper mystery.

86327.Name: Forsaken Sanctuary
86327.FlavorText:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

86329.Name: Foul Orchard
86329.FlavorText:
"Such a beautiful place for a stroll."
—Liliana Vess

86333.Name: Highland Lake
86333.FlavorText: With the fate of Innistrad uncertain, some seek solace in remote areas.

86334.Name: Port Town
86334.FlavorText: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

86335.Name: Stone Quarry
86335.FlavorText: In Gavony, headstones come only from quarries that have been blessed by chaplains.

86337.Name: Ormendahl, Profane Prince
86337.FlavorText: With Griselbrand gone, the Skirsdag eagerly awaited another demon to claim their devotion. Ormendahl did not make them wait long.

86338.Name: Woodland Stream
86338.FlavorText: Two creaking waterwheels herald the approach to Briarbridge through the Ulvenwald.

86369.Name: Clue
86369.FlavorText:
"Their chanting grows louder as the tide rises."
—Tamiyo's journal
86369.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

86370.Name: Angel of Flight Alabaster
86370.FlavorText: She endures without Avacyn but secretly asks each soul she guides if it has seen her.

86371.Name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
86371.FlavorText: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

86372.Name: Bonds of Faith
86372.FlavorText:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

86374.Name: Doomed Traveler
86374.FlavorText: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

86375.Name: Elder Cathar
86375.FlavorText: "My greatest hope is that you will surpass me in every way, consigning my name to some forgotten corner of history."

86376.Name: Feeling of Dread
86376.FlavorText: People only say "I'm sure it was nothing" when they're sure it was something.

86378.Name: Lingering Souls
86378.FlavorText: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

86379.Name: Rally the Peasants
86379.FlavorText:
"If you must go out at night, bring a mob."
—Master of the Elgaud Cathars

86380.Name: Requiem Angel
86380.FlavorText: When angels despair, what hope can remain for mortals?

86382.Name: Battleground Geist
86382.FlavorText: Not content to nudge vases and chill drawing rooms, some geists muster spectral armies to claw at the hearts of the living.

86431.Name: Young Wolf
86431.FlavorText: The Ulvenwald makes no allowances for youth. Today's newborn is either tomorrow's hunter or tomorrow's lunch.

86432.Name: Diregraf Captain
86432.FlavorText: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.

86433.Name: Drogskol Captain
86433.FlavorText: Dead or alive, true leaders can inspire an entire army.

86434.Name: Falkenrath Aristocrat
86434.FlavorText: "Your blood is quite pleasing. A pity there's not enough for both of us."

86436.Name: Havengul Lich
86436.FlavorText: Fusing intelligence with the power of undeath requires inspiration of the darkest kind.

86441.Name: Stromkirk Captain
86441.FlavorText:
"No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass."
—Runo Stromkirk

86444.Name: Butcher's Cleaver
86444.FlavorText: Outside the safety of Thraben, there is little distinction between tool and weapon.

86445.Name: Demonmail Hauberk
86445.FlavorText: It comes off as easily as your own skin.

86447.Name: Traveler's Amulet
86447.FlavorText: The rider set off into the eerie mist, swaddled in armor and laden with amulets.

86449.Name: Evolving Wilds
86449.FlavorText:
"Our world is vast, but Thraben is its heart. The cathedral must stand even if the hinterlands are lost."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

86460.Name: Ghalma the Shaper
86460.FlavorText: If you can't find allies, forge them.

86465.Name: Surgical Metamorph
86465.FlavorText:
"Never begin an experiment assuming you know what the end result will be."
—Unctus, Grand Metatect

86466.Name: Tezzeret's Reckoning
86466.FlavorText: He had his darksteel body. His service was finally complete. Why was he not elated? Tezzeret looked at the Phyrexian empire he'd helped create and felt—for the span of half a breath—something almost like regret.

86468.Name: March Toward Perfection
86468.FlavorText:
"There will come a day when blessed perfection is no longer a mere concept, but tangible, for all to behold."
—Phyrexian Scriptures

86470.Name: Hexgold Sledge
86470.FlavorText: Krol decided to personally put the nail in every Phyrexian coffin.

86471.Name: Magmatic Scorchwing
86471.FlavorText: As Chiss-Goria took wing beneath the arc of the Red Sun, other dragons who slumbered deep in secret lairs began to rise—and fight.

86473.Name: Rothga, Bonded Engulfer
86473.FlavorText: Lukka smiled as the bond took hold, then hesitated. For a moment, he could have sworn some strange, malignant presence was trying to worm its way into his mind.

86474.Name: Phyresis Roach
86474.FlavorText:
"Remember, recruits: A Phyrexian's size is not a reliable indicator of its threat level."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

86475.Name: Spawning Pod
86475.FlavorText:
"If you can't grow, then hunt. If you can't hunt, then you will feed evolution."
—Glissa Sunslayer

86476.Name: Arek, False Goldwarden
86476.FlavorText: "The moment I laid eyes on Sheoldred's coliseum, I knew nothing Mirran could ever compare to that grandeur, that power. My entire being was seized with the desire to serve my Thane."

86477.Name: Bladehold Cleaver
86477.FlavorText:
"If there can be no victory, then we will fight forever!"
—Mirran battle cry

86481.Name: Gyox, Brutal Carnivora
86481.FlavorText: Having slaughtered enough of Vorinclex's champions to earn his respect, she stalks the Hunter Maze in search of worthy fodder for Sheoldred's coliseum.

86483.Name: Innovative Metatect
86483.FlavorText: There is nothing so finely engineered that the sectives of the Surgical Bay cannot improve it.

86484.Name: Mephidross Slime
86484.FlavorText: The ground in the Hunter Maze was already dangerous enough before it seeped in.

86488.Name: Vexyr, Ich-Tekik's Heir
86488.FlavorText: With Vorinclex's attention elsewhere, Ich-Tekik turned from crafting mindless predators to building a living legacy.

86496.Name: Accorder Paladin
86496.FlavorText: "I fight for the suns, the surface, and everything in between."

86497.Name: Ardent Recruit
86497.FlavorText: "We lost our homes and our kin. We won't let those rotters take our future as well."

86498.Name: Auriok Sunchaser
86498.FlavorText:
"Grant me loft. Grant me light. Grant me the accuracy I need to kill all who threaten Bladehold."
—Prayer to the Whitesun

86500.Name: Mirran Crusader
86500.FlavorText: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

86501.Name: Sunspear Shikari
86501.FlavorText: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

86502.Name: Tempered Steel
86502.FlavorText:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper

86503.Name: Contentious Plan
86503.FlavorText: Niv-Mizzet had perfected a plan, but he had no control over the mortal minds who had to agree to implement it.

86504.Name: Flux Channeler
86504.FlavorText: "Inform our allies in the Tenth and throw the circuit. It's about to get weird."

86505.Name: Inexorable Tide
86505.FlavorText:
"See how gratefully this world accepts our blessings."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

86509.Name: Bilious Skulldweller
86509.FlavorText:
"Watch your footing around here. Anything you might step on probably has teeth."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

86514.Name: Phyrexian Gargantua
86514.FlavorText: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

86515.Name: Phyrexian Obliterator
86515.FlavorText:
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain."
—Sheoldred

86516.Name: Phyrexian Rager
86516.FlavorText:
"Resist if you must. It makes no difference. As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia."
—Sheoldred

86518.Name: Toxic Abomination
86518.FlavorText: Deep in the forgotten reaches of Urborg, ancient Phyrexian monstrosities shamble endlessly, putrid ichor leaking from their rusted forms.

86519.Name: Vault Skirge
86519.FlavorText: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

86520.Name: Barbed Batterfist
86520.FlavorText: "Finally, a safe way to punch the rotters in the face."

86523.Name: Goblin Gaveleer
86523.FlavorText:
"When everything looks like a nail, you really need to get yourself a hammer."
—Krol, goblin furnace-priest

86525.Name: Oxidda Finisher
86525.FlavorText: Popular wisdom says that Phyrexians don't feel fear. But popular wisdom has never tried to hold a bridge against an angry ogre.

86526.Name: Oxidda Scrapmelter
86526.FlavorText: It subsists on a diet rich in screaming metal and molten blood.

86527.Name: Bloom Hulk
86527.FlavorText:
"Tread upon these flower beds at your own peril."
—Emmara

86529.Name: Evolution Sage
86529.FlavorText: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

86531.Name: Smell Fear
86531.FlavorText:
"It's fun when they run a little."
—Wasitora, Nekoru queen

86533.Name: Mephidross Slime
86533.FlavorText: The ground in the Hunter Maze was already dangerous enough before it seeped in.

86534.Name: Jor Kadeen, the Prevailer
86534.FlavorText: "As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."

86539.Name: Darksteel Ingot
86539.FlavorText:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

86540.Name: Darksteel Plate
86540.FlavorText:
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever."
—Koth of the Hammer

86541.Name: Mox Opal
86541.FlavorText: The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.

86542.Name: Myr Convert
86542.FlavorText: Humble, obedient, and tireless, myr require little modification to excel as servants of Phyrexia.

86544.Name: Phyrexian Revoker
86544.FlavorText:
"To be in the presence of a revoker is to be truly alone."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

86546.Name: Soulless Jailer
86546.FlavorText:
"Lock the door and eat the key."
—Vraan, Executioner Thane

86548.Name: Zenith Chronicler
86548.FlavorText: It watches through the never-ending day, motionless save for the unsettling, twitching dance it performs as each sun reaches its apex.

86606.Name: Emrakul, the Promised End
86606.FlavorText: An enigma as vexing as life itself.

86607.Name: Eternal Scourge
86607.FlavorText:
"It has latched onto this place like an infestation. All efforts at eradication have proved futile."
—Yeter, Trostad villager

86610.Name: Always Watching
86610.FlavorText:
"We pray to Avacyn on high.
On snow-white wings fearless you fly.
Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives.
May angels watch us from the skies."
—Children's prayer

86612.Name: Apothecary Geist
86612.FlavorText: For some customers, the old apothecary shop still opens its doors.

86614.Name: Avacyn, the Purifier
86614.FlavorText:
"Wings that once bore hope are now stained with blood. She is our guardian no longer."
—Grete, cathar apostate

86618.Name: Bruna, the Fading Light
86618.FlavorText: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

86619.Name: Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
86619.FlavorText: Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.

86622.Name: Courageous Outrider
86622.FlavorText: One silvery blast signaled that she wouldn't be arriving at Thraben alone.

86623.Name: Dauntless Cathar
86623.FlavorText: "The harder they try to extinguish my faith, the brighter it burns in the darkness."

86624.Name: Dawn Gryff
86624.FlavorText: After facing so many horrors, the survivors of Videns parish couldn't comprehend the hope that the gryff represented.

86625.Name: Declaration in Stone
86625.FlavorText: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

86629.Name: Invisible Stalker
86629.FlavorText: "All that concerns me is the vampires' sense of smell and those freezing Nephalian nights."

86630.Name: Mist Raven
86630.FlavorText:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

86631.Name: Murder of Crows
86631.FlavorText: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

86633.Name: Selhoff Occultist
86633.FlavorText: "The mist whispers to those who know it to be more than a mundane fog."

86634.Name: Silent Departure
86634.FlavorText: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

86636.Name: Stitcher's Apprentice
86636.FlavorText: "Oglor create life, Oglor take it away. Oglor god! . . . until Master return."

86637.Name: Barter in Blood
86637.FlavorText:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

86638.Name: Bloodflow Connoisseur
86638.FlavorText:
"Death not for survival but for vanity and pleasure? This is the decadence I sought to curb."
—Sorin Markov

86641.Name: Bump in the Night
86641.FlavorText: It's not just the wind. It's not all in your head. And it's definitely something to worry about.

86642.Name: Falkenrath Noble
86642.FlavorText: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

86643.Name: Ghoulraiser
86643.FlavorText:
"Come. Bring your brothers. Tonight, you feast on living flesh."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

86644.Name: Griselbrand
86644.FlavorText:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

86647.Name: Skirsdag High Priest
86647.FlavorText: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

86648.Name: Tragic Slip
86648.FlavorText: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

86649.Name: Unburial Rites
86649.FlavorText: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

86650.Name: Balefire Dragon
86650.FlavorText: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

86652.Name: Devil's Play
86652.FlavorText: A devil's hands are never idle.

86653.Name: Faithless Looting
86653.FlavorText: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

86654.Name: Forge Devil
86654.FlavorText: Devils infiltrated the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, making cracks in load-bearing pillars and setting fire to precious archives.

86655.Name: Kruin Outlaw
86655.FlavorText: "Hold tight. I've got a surprise for them."

86658.Name: Skirsdag Cultist
86658.FlavorText: "Within blood is life. Within life is fire. Within fire is the path to our masters' glory!"

86659.Name: Traitorous Blood
86659.FlavorText:
"I can make you dance to my tune like a puppet, your very blood eager to obey."
—Olivia Voldaren

86660.Name: Vampiric Fury
86660.FlavorText: Many peasants secretly admire vampires' glamour and elegance—until they witness a moment of pure bloodlust.

86662.Name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
86662.FlavorText: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

86664.Name: Hollowhenge Scavenger
86664.FlavorText: After werewolves slaughtered the citizenry of Hollowhenge, other creatures moved in.

86665.Name: Mayor of Avabruck
86665.FlavorText: He can deny his true nature for only so long.

86668.Name: Somberwald Sage
86668.FlavorText: "You can face any danger when all of nature is on your side."

86670.Name: Travel Preparations
86670.FlavorText: Visiting a shrine at the start of a journey makes the traveler more likely to finish it.

86683.Name: Archon of the Wild Rose
86683.FlavorText: The curse of Redtooth Keep could only be broken by a mystical rose that blooms in moonlight.

86684.Name: Archon's Glory
86684.FlavorText: A winged dawn dispels the terrors of night.

86685.Name: Armory Mice
86685.FlavorText: They help ensure that the forges of the dwarves are always squeaky clean.

86686.Name: Besotted Knight
86686.FlavorText: "You are no monster to me, my love."

86687.Name: Betroth the Beast
86687.FlavorText: "You are no monster to me, my love."

86688.Name: Break the Spell
86688.FlavorText: As Hylda watched Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious form through the cold, Hylda felt something she hadn't felt in a long time: compassion.

86690.Name: Cheeky House-Mouse
86690.FlavorText: "Get back here, vile rodent! I was almost done cursing that ring!"

86691.Name: Squeak By
86691.FlavorText: "Get back here, vile rodent! I was almost done cursing that ring!"

86692.Name: Cooped Up
86692.FlavorText:
"Cold iron's all you need to hold a faerie. The charms are mostly decorative."
—Eulyn, Edgewall peddler

86693.Name: Cursed Courtier
86693.FlavorText: It was the first and last time anyone attempted to levy a tax on the witches of Dunbarrow.

86695.Name: Dutiful Griffin
86695.FlavorText: She stayed by her master's side, leaving only to hunt. She would guard him until he woke, however long it took.

86696.Name: Eerie Interference
86696.FlavorText: Ranks of sleeping Ardenvale knights filled Eriette's throne room, ready to defend their witch-queen with unthinking devotion.

86697.Name: Expel the Interlopers
86697.FlavorText: When a redcap raid threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh, Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.

86698.Name: Frostbridge Guard
86698.FlavorText: The sentry watched impassively, its spear unmoving. One by one, the would-be adventurers stumbled and fell, frostbitten, to the ground.

86699.Name: Gallant Pie-Wielder
86699.FlavorText: "Time for your just desserts, redcap scum!"

86700.Name: Glass Casket
86700.FlavorText: While Neva's mind wandered the realm of dreams, her body lay protected as mages worked frantically to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber.

86702.Name: Kellan's Lightblades
86702.FlavorText: Kellan struck out on pure instinct, and his conjured blades cleaved through the icy guardians as though they were nothing but air.

86703.Name: Knight of Doves
86703.FlavorText: So many birds, yet the air was still and empty of song. Part of Syr Damon knew something wasn't right, but it was a far-off worry, unimportant and soon forgotten.

86704.Name: Moment of Valor
86704.FlavorText: Hardened by the Phyrexian invasion, Will's knights starved the nightmares of the thing they craved most: fear.

86705.Name: Moonshaker Cavalry
86705.FlavorText: High King Kenrith's armies followed him into the afterlife, ready to charge at his command.

86706.Name: Plunge into Winter
86706.FlavorText: When Hylda froze Loch Larent to create her palace, some merfolk dove deep enough underwater to escape the chill. Others weren't so lucky.

86709.Name: Regal Bunnicorn
86709.FlavorText:
"It's entirely peaceful, as long as you don't try to pet it, pen it, take its food, take its hide, sit on its grass, or dress it up in colorful garb for human holidays."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

86711.Name: Rimefur Reindeer
86711.FlavorText: Attracted by the quiet of Hylda's realm, reindeer herds moved in and made themselves at home near the palace of ice.

86712.Name: Savior of the Sleeping
86712.FlavorText: Even lost in slumber, the citizens of Ardenvale dream of a tireless protector standing guard over their homes.

86713.Name: Slumbering Keepguard
86713.FlavorText: Dreams of a realm united gave him strength even in sleep.

86717.Name: Stroke of Midnight
86717.FlavorText: The assembled partygoers fell silent and stared. As the helmet came to a clattering stop, the only sound was Ash's distant footsteps.

86718.Name: A Tale for the Ages
86718.FlavorText: With every retelling of Agatha's demise, Kellan got taller and Ruby got stronger. But the core story stayed the same, and people remembered what happens to those who prey on the weak.

86720.Name: Tuinvale Guide
86720.FlavorText: "Weary traveler, follow me. The night is a cage, and my light is the key."

86721.Name: Unassuming Sage
86721.FlavorText: "The archmage Valya? Why yes, I do believe I've heard of her."

86727.Name: Archive Dragon
86727.FlavorText: "Fascinating. It says here that dragons cannot read."

86729.Name: Beluna's Gatekeeper
86729.FlavorText: "And what makes you think Lady Grandsquall wants to see you, little one?"

86730.Name: Entry Denied
86730.FlavorText: "And what makes you think Lady Grandsquall wants to see you, little one?"

86732.Name: Chancellor of Tales
86732.FlavorText: ". . . so the knight stabbed the troll, the troll threw the knight off the bridge, and they both forgot about the sword."

86734.Name: Disdainful Stroke
86734.FlavorText: In retrospect, using storm magic against a storm giant was not the wisest strategy.

86737.Name: Freeze in Place
86737.FlavorText:
"I'm getting the sense we shouldn't expect a warm welcome."
—Kellan

86743.Name: Ice Out
86743.FlavorText: Hylda built an ice statuary from all those who couldn't understand "go away."

86746.Name: Into the Fae Court
86746.FlavorText: Kellan stepped from his village into a strange world where trees bore jeweled fruit. A regal, inhuman voice rang in his ears: "Tell me, brave hero, are you true of heart?"

86747.Name: Johann's Stopgap
86747.FlavorText: "Just . . . stay in there . . . for one . . . second!"

86749.Name: Merfolk Coralsmith
86749.FlavorText: "Wooden swords rot. Steel axes rust. But coral only grows."

86750.Name: Misleading Motes
86750.FlavorText: Yarvis was almost certain he'd seen the same tree an hour ago, but then again, didn't all trees look alike? He shelved his doubts and followed the friendly, twinkling motes deeper into the forest.

86751.Name: Mocking Sprite
86751.FlavorText: "Look at me, everyone! I'm a High Fae! Watch me do important High Fae things!"

86752.Name: Obyra's Attendants
86752.FlavorText: Obyra's devoted servants shrieked as their sleeping mistress slashed at them, unseeing.

86753.Name: Desperate Parry
86753.FlavorText: Obyra's devoted servants shrieked as their sleeping mistress slashed at them, unseeing.

86756.Name: Quick Study
86756.FlavorText: At first, Johann was annoyed that the library had decided to reorganize itself. But he had to admit that storing the cookbooks in the cauldron made a certain kind of sense.

86758.Name: Sleight of Hand
86758.FlavorText: The farmer was amazed to see the penny vanish into thin air, but the goose knew he'd just slipped it to the faerie.

86760.Name: Spell Stutter
86760.FlavorText: "You are but learning to walk in a world where I fly, mortal."

86762.Name: Stormkeld Prowler
86762.FlavorText: To the giants, it was one little gem among thousands. But to Kylene, it was a haul that would feed her family for years.

86763.Name: Succumb to the Cold
86763.FlavorText:
"I've never known cold like it. It burned like fire and bit like an adder's fangs. Call me a coward if you wish, but I won't go back there."
—Syr Lydel, knight of Vantress

86764.Name: Talion's Messenger
86764.FlavorText: "The Kindly Lord does not issue invitations to their court lightly. I suggest you accept."

86765.Name: Tenacious Tomeseeker
86765.FlavorText: "An intact volume of Tales of the Fae? The king will be pleased."

86766.Name: Vantress Transmuter
86766.FlavorText: "My orders were to capture you alive. They didn't specify in what form."

86767.Name: Croaking Curse
86767.FlavorText: "My orders were to capture you alive. They didn't specify in what form."

86770.Name: Water Wings
86770.FlavorText: Luckily for the plummeting Johann, the hydroloft spell was one he had actually mastered.

86772.Name: Ashiok's Reaper
86772.FlavorText: Neva's dreams were haunted by memories of the invasion—oil-black tendrils grasping at her through the mist. Or . . . was this something new?

86774.Name: Barrow Naughty
86774.FlavorText: "The difference between mischief and malice? Numbers."

86776.Name: Candy Grapple
86776.FlavorText: "Don't you mean ‘poisonous'? There's no such thing as a venomous—AGGHHH!"

86779.Name: Dream Spoilers
86779.FlavorText: The Wicked Slumber saved Eldraine from Phyrexia's grasp, but instead of fading when the invasion ended, it continued to spread.

86780.Name: Ego Drain
86780.FlavorText: "You've wasted your life. Let's see if I can do any better with it."

86784.Name: Faerie Fencing
86784.FlavorText: Even in the grip of the Wicked Slumber, the High Fae princess Obyra is a blademaster of unrivaled skill.

86785.Name: Feed the Cauldron
86785.FlavorText: Kellan heard Agatha howl when he slammed into her, heard her scream as she fell into the cauldron, but couldn't afford to think about the implications just yet.

86792.Name: Lich-Knights' Conquest
86792.FlavorText: In their rotting minds, they still quest for virtue and glory.

86796.Name: Mintstrosity
86796.FlavorText: If the sugary abominations of Sweettooth Village were ever under someone's control, that time is long past.

86798.Name: Rankle's Prank
86798.FlavorText: The louder they scream, the harder he laughs.

86801.Name: Scream Puff
86801.FlavorText: Too much sugar is bad for your health.

86804.Name: Spiteful Hexmage
86804.FlavorText: "Who'll never amount to anything now, Father?"

86806.Name: Sugar Rush
86806.FlavorText:
"I smell frosting. Ready your weapons!"
—Greta, Scourge of Sweettooth

86807.Name: Sweettooth Witch
86807.FlavorText: "Try some pie! Your brother helped make it, and he really poured his heart into it."

86808.Name: Taken by Nightmares
86808.FlavorText: Dying in your sleep is never peaceful when Ashiok is involved.

86809.Name: Tangled Colony
86809.FlavorText: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.

86813.Name: Voracious Vermin
86813.FlavorText: Lord Skitter promised the starving rats of Edgewall that they would never go hungry again.

86814.Name: Warehouse Tabby
86814.FlavorText: For every rat she kills, ten more take its place.

86815.Name: Wicked Visitor
86815.FlavorText: Amalgamations of many childhood nightmares stalked the realm of dreams, feeding on the collective terror of all those trapped in the Wicked Slumber.

86818.Name: Bellowing Bruiser
86818.FlavorText: You can't give an ogre the runaround.

86819.Name: Beat a Path
86819.FlavorText: You can't give an ogre the runaround.

86821.Name: Boundary Lands Ranger
86821.FlavorText: "You only find out who was hunting who when one of you is dead."

86824.Name: Edgewall Pack
86824.FlavorText: The mayor sent hounds to root out Lord Skitter, but their loyalty was easily bought with a handful of bones.

86826.Name: Flick a Coin
86826.FlavorText: "From here, hit the antique gong, ricochet off the suit of armor, and get Gunrudd on the nose? Is that all?"

86827.Name: Food Fight
86827.FlavorText: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

86828.Name: Frantic Firebolt
86828.FlavorText: Johann's conjecture about draconic fire dispelling rainwater elementals proved to be correct. Now he just needed a way to dispel draconic fire.

86829.Name: Gnawing Crescendo
86829.FlavorText: Totentanz's song had no lyrics, but the rats understood it nonetheless. "You own this land," it said. "You deserve to feast."

86833.Name: Grand Ball Guest
86833.FlavorText: It takes a lot to pull a master blacksmith from their work, but Maurice couldn't pass up an invitation to a lavish Delverhaugh feast.

86834.Name: Harried Spearguard
86834.FlavorText: "Why're you vermin so daft? This is a warehouse full of bricks. BRICKS! You can't eat bricks."

86837.Name: Imodane, the Pyrohammer
86837.FlavorText: "The realm needs a ruler, not a boy playing king."

86838.Name: Kindled Heroism
86838.FlavorText: Even in the grip of Hylda's unnatural cold, something in Kellan felt bright as spring, something that poured into the empty hilts he'd been given by Talion and formed thorn-sharp blades of light.

86841.Name: Minecart Daredevil
86841.FlavorText: Mines that once rang with the strikes of pickaxes now echo with shouts of reckless glee.

86842.Name: Ride the Rails
86842.FlavorText: Mines that once rang with the strikes of pickaxes now echo with shouts of reckless glee.

86843.Name: Monstrous Rage
86843.FlavorText:
"My, what big paws y—"
—Thomas the woodsman, last words

86849.Name: Redcap Thief
86849.FlavorText: "Shiny is best. Then sharp. Sharp is good. Anything else is basically trash."

86851.Name: Skewer Slinger
86851.FlavorText: One way or another, dwarven meals end up in someone's stomach.

86852.Name: Song of Totentanz
86852.FlavorText: Townsfolk tapped their feet and hummed along, unwittingly amplifying the tune that would summon their doom.

86854.Name: Tattered Ratter
86854.FlavorText: "What's that, Snappers? Yes, you're right! It was very rude of the innkeeper to throw us out!"

86859.Name: Unruly Catapult
86859.FlavorText: An autonomous, self-loading catapult had seemed like such a good idea.

86863.Name: Witchstalker Frenzy
86863.FlavorText: The witchstalkers circled the armored figure, drawn to the corrupting stink of dark magic. Kellan and Ruby fled to the sound of savage howls and snapping jaws.

86865.Name: Beanstalk Wurm
86865.FlavorText: When Beluna's pets escape Stormkeld, villages fall and new Everstalks rise.

86866.Name: Plant Beans
86866.FlavorText: When Beluna's pets escape Stormkeld, villages fall and new Everstalks rise.

86867.Name: Bestial Bloodline
86867.FlavorText: "There is a fierce joy in losing yourself to savagery, and a bitter pain in regaining your senses afterward. You could never understand."

86872.Name: Commune with Nature
86872.FlavorText: Agatha befriended the beasts of the wilds, and under her influence they grew bolder . . . and more savage. Some herbivores developed a taste for flesh.

86876.Name: Ferocious Werefox
86876.FlavorText: Each night, the elves of Redtooth Keep transform into feral, monstrous beasts.

86877.Name: Guard Change
86877.FlavorText: Each night, the elves of Redtooth Keep transform into feral, monstrous beasts.

86878.Name: Graceful Takedown
86878.FlavorText: The fauns of the Tanglespan are adept at using the precarious environment against larger opponents.

86883.Name: Howling Galefang
86883.FlavorText:
"I have to hand it to you, Yorvo. Since your pet showed up, not a single smallfolk has even made it to the door of my vault."
—Beluna Grandsquall

86885.Name: Leaping Ambush
86885.FlavorText: Witchstalkers have extremely powerful legs—all the better to reach you with.

86887.Name: Redtooth Genealogist
86887.FlavorText: Some family trees are thornier than others.

86888.Name: Redtooth Vanguard
86888.FlavorText: "I'm just as deadly during the day."

86890.Name: Rootrider Faun
86890.FlavorText: "Human feet aren't inferior to hooves for climbing. It's their plodding, mistrustful personalities that hold them back."

86893.Name: Skybeast Tracker
86893.FlavorText: Cloud eaters, heaven tillers, beanstalk wurms—he favors prey worthy of a giant's appetite.

86894.Name: Spider Food
86894.FlavorText: To the giant spiders of Dunbarrow, there's little difference between fly and faerie.

86895.Name: Stormkeld Vanguard
86895.FlavorText: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

86896.Name: Bear Down
86896.FlavorText: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

86897.Name: Tanglespan Lookout
86897.FlavorText: "The trolls have your scent, traveler. Hurry on, and let me take care of them."

86900.Name: Titanic Growth
86900.FlavorText: "Looks like you need a bigger net, mister fae-catcher."

86901.Name: Toadstool Admirer
86901.FlavorText: Where an ouphe makes its home, the land blooms with color and joy.

86903.Name: Troublemaker Ouphe
86903.FlavorText: Heavy is the head that wears the vase.

86904.Name: Up the Beanstalk
86904.FlavorText:
"It's not so bad. All you have to do is keep from looking down."
—Troyan, to Kellan and Ruby

86905.Name: Verdant Outrider
86905.FlavorText: Some knights who survived the invasion have forsaken what remains of their courts. The newly formed Verdant Order has sworn to defend the last untouched parts of the wilds.

86911.Name: Ash, Party Crasher
86911.FlavorText: "Get up and dance! Let your feet thunder like forgehammers!"

86912.Name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
86912.FlavorText: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

86917.Name: Johann, Apprentice Sorcerer
86917.FlavorText: "Okay. First I'll calm the elementals. Then I'll put out the fire. Then I'll unflood the basement. Then I'll do the chores myself."

86920.Name: Obyra, Dreaming Duelist
86920.FlavorText: Obyra sleepwalks through the wilds, hunting for worthy opponents.

86921.Name: Rowan, Scion of War
86921.FlavorText: "No more days withering at a negotiating table with my brother. I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power."

86922.Name: Ruby, Daring Tracker
86922.FlavorText: Neither the sharpest thorns nor the foulest beasts would stop her from finding her brother.

86926.Name: Totentanz, Swarm Piper
86926.FlavorText: Among the rats, he found the acceptance the human world never gave him.

86927.Name: Troyan, Gutsy Explorer
86927.FlavorText: "The streets of Ravnica were stifling. Eldraine is an endless adventure paved in gold."

86928.Name: Will, Scion of Peace
86928.FlavorText: "It's easy to cry ‘For glory!' and charge those who disagree with you. But it takes finesse to turn enemies into allies rather than corpses."

86929.Name: Yenna, Redtooth Regent
86929.FlavorText: "My people are both bloom and thorn."

86946.Name: Heartflame Duelist
86946.FlavorText: "The fire of Embereth will never be doused!"

86947.Name: Heartflame Slash
86947.FlavorText: "The fire of Embereth will never be doused!"

86956.Name: Pollen-Shield Hare
86956.FlavorText: She can drive off any threat, from owl to hunter to Phyrexian monster.

86957.Name: Hare Raising
86957.FlavorText: She can drive off any threat, from owl to hunter to Phyrexian monster.

86968.Name: Threadbind Clique
86968.FlavorText: Giggles of delight may be the last thing you hear.

86969.Name: Rip the Seams
86969.FlavorText: Giggles of delight may be the last thing you hear.

86970.Name: Twining Twins
86970.FlavorText: "We spin and spin to keep us busy, but somehow you're the one who's dizzy."

86971.Name: Swift Spiral
86971.FlavorText: "We spin and spin to keep us busy, but somehow you're the one who's dizzy."

86972.Name: Woodland Acolyte
86972.FlavorText: He left knighthood behind to heal the scars of the invasion.

86973.Name: Mend the Wilds
86973.FlavorText: He left knighthood behind to heal the scars of the invasion.

86975.Name: Candy Trail
86975.FlavorText:
"Look! Another one! Who cares what Mother said? We'll be home before she gets back."
—Daniela, Edgewall youth

86976.Name: Collector's Vault
86976.FlavorText: Beluna makes a habit of "liberating" valuables from the world below, from priceless artifacts to historic buildings.

86978.Name: Gingerbrute
86978.FlavorText: Sometimes, "as fast as you can" isn't quite fast enough.

86979.Name: Hylda's Crown of Winter
86979.FlavorText: With each day she wore the crown, her icy kingdom spread, and her heart grew ever colder.

86981.Name: Prophetic Prism
86981.FlavorText:
"Most dreams reveal but fragments of what you could be. Only nightmares can show you who you truly are."
—Ashiok

86982.Name: Scarecrow Guide
86982.FlavorText:
"You're doing a splendid job, my noble stitched friend. Not a single bird has attacked us!"
—Troyan

86986.Name: Crystal Grotto
86986.FlavorText: What little light filters down through frost and fathoms is refracted into a million rainbow shards.

86988.Name: Evolving Wilds
86988.FlavorText:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is you."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

86998.Name: Rowdy Research
86998.FlavorText:
"Stolen treasures can be reclaimed, but stolen knowledge is yours forever."
—Alela

86999.Name: Storyteller Pixie
86999.FlavorText: After the royal nanny had finished his dull, droning recital of the prince and princess's bedtime story, their secret friend emerged and the real story began.

87001.Name: Malevolent Witchkite
87001.FlavorText:
"Was there a fearsome witch around here? Or was it a cruel dragon? The tales were confu—oh no."
—Osval, adventurer

87004.Name: Charging Hooligan
87004.FlavorText: "Soon the rats are gonna run this town, so I'm gonna run with them!"

87009.Name: Wildwood Mentor
87009.FlavorText: "Not bad. If only you had branches."

87039.Name: Blind Obedience
87039.FlavorText:
"Oaths are naught but empty air. Take what measures you must to ensure absolute loyalty."
—The Witch's Way

87040.Name: Dawn of Hope
87040.FlavorText:
"She was the rising sun, her courage banishing the terrors of the night."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights

87041.Name: Grasp of Fate
87041.FlavorText:
"The witch wrapped her heart in briar vines, hid it away in the ancient keep in the depths of the forest. If none could find it, the prophecy could never come to pass."
—Beyond the Great Henge

87042.Name: Greater Auramancy
87042.FlavorText:
"The hunter drew her dagger and found she grasped a flower. She reached for an arrow, but her quiver held only leaves."
—Tales of the Fae

87043.Name: Griffin Aerie
87043.FlavorText:
"Davin's heart swelled with a heady mix of excitement and fear. If the young griffin accepted him, he would begin his path to knighthood."
—Skies of Ardenvale

87044.Name: Intangible Virtue
87044.FlavorText:
"Find glory not in blood, nor dragons felled,
But in kindness given, oaths upheld."
—"The Scholar & the Knight"

87045.Name: Karmic Justice
87045.FlavorText:
"I have wronged your family on a fool's errand. All I can offer is myself, that you might take your revenge."
—The Folly of Syr Perrin

87047.Name: Land Tax
87047.FlavorText:
"‘That town is rudely blocking my view!' said the witch. The giant bowed and smiled."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales

87048.Name: Leyline of Sanctity
87048.FlavorText:
"An enchanted glade revealed itself, offering safety in its warm embrace. Still she walked on."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer

87049.Name: Phyrexian Unlife
87049.FlavorText:
"While the realm's great minds quarreled over the strange eclipse, Locthwain fell to the invaders."
—Last Stand of the Realm

87050.Name: Rest in Peace
87050.FlavorText:
"The king ordered those lost in sleep be placed in glass caskets, protected and watched in case they might one day wake."
—The Wicked Slumber

87051.Name: Smothering Tithe
87051.FlavorText:
"They laughed with glee as the pixie spun gold from straw. They smiled and shrugged when their curtains and clothes were next on the wheel. Then he grabbed their hair."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales

87053.Name: Compulsion
87053.FlavorText:
"O my love, would that you could understand!
Adventure beckons; I must take its hand."
—"The Scholar & the Knight"

87054.Name: Copy Enchantment
87054.FlavorText:
"‘I don't need anyone else,' muttered Hylda. ‘You don't need anyone else,' her reflection agreed."
—Witch of Winter

87055.Name: Curiosity
87055.FlavorText:
"Valtry gasped. The strange new coral was not coral at all, but a fallen drywalker! But how did it get to the bottom of Loch Larent?"
—The Merfolk Who Walked

87056.Name: Forced Fruition
87056.FlavorText:
"‘My kingdom for a feast!' quoth the king. A faerie appeared before him, and spoke through a wicked grin: ‘As you wish.'"
—Tales of the Fae

87057.Name: Fraying Sanity
87057.FlavorText:
"I saw my mind stretch like cloth on a loom,
Warping, twisting toward a deathless doom."
—A Traveler's Trials

87058.Name: Hatching Plans
87058.FlavorText:
"The thief fled with her ill-gotten prize, her mind awhirl with visions of wealth and glory. In her pack, unnoticed, the egg began to stir and crack."
—Tales of the Fae

87059.Name: Intruder Alarm
87059.FlavorText:
"The dark forest lit up with a thousand eyes, and for the first time, Jurald considered that the High Fae might be more than myth."
—Beyond the Great Henge

87060.Name: Kindred Discovery
87060.FlavorText:
"The towers were like a song on the night breeze, faint and lovely, calling her home."
—A Quickling's Journey

87061.Name: Leyline of Anticipation
87061.FlavorText:
"A glowing spring appeared before her, promising untold wisdom. Still she walked on."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer

87062.Name: Omniscience
87062.FlavorText:
"They are led by Talion, the Kindly Lord, First and Greatest of the High Fae, Sovereign of the Court, the Liege of Laughter, Finder of the First Yew, and the One True Lord of Eldraine."
—On the High Fae

87063.Name: Rhystic Study
87063.FlavorText:
"Despite her father's warnings, Valtry's fascination with the surface only grew. She collected things that fell to the bottom, daydreaming of life on land."
—The Merfolk Who Walked

87064.Name: Spreading Seas
87064.FlavorText:
"Hasty efforts to defend Castle Vantress left it more moat than castle."
—Last Stand of the Realm

87065.Name: Bitterblossom
87065.FlavorText:
"Tarry not in Tuinvale,
Ignore the flowers' heady scents.
Take no thing, stay to the trail,
Lest the fae seek recompense."
—To Walk the Wilds

87066.Name: Dark Tutelage
87066.FlavorText:
"Ours is a path of the outcast, of pain given and pain received. But for the strong, it is a path that leads to power untethered from fae riddles."
—The Witch's Way

87067.Name: Grave Pact
87067.FlavorText:
"‘Fools,' sneered the witch. ‘I never intended to leave here alive. And thanks to your dogged insistence on following me, neither will you.'"
—Hexes of Dunbarrow

87068.Name: Leyline of the Void
87068.FlavorText:
"Malevolent lights pulsed around her, whispering of riches in the dark. Still she walked on."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer

87070.Name: Oppression
87070.FlavorText:
"‘The human world will fall,' whispered the monstrous rat. ‘You have but one choice to make: Will you fall with it?'"
—Song of the Vermin

87071.Name: Oversold Cemetery
87071.FlavorText:
"‘Get out! Get out!' the dead screamed. ‘We've not room for one more! Get out!'"
—Hexes of Dunbarrow

87072.Name: Polluted Bonds
87072.FlavorText:
"'Twas the cruelest of ironies: the realm, in desperate need of rest, gripped by endless sleep that offered no comfort."
—The Wicked Slumber

87073.Name: Sanguine Bond
87073.FlavorText:
"The witch smiled, savoring every stolen year. Every love the knight would never court, every meal he'd never taste, every honor he'd never win, was sweet as honey on her tongue."
—Hexes of Dunbarrow

87074.Name: Stab Wound
87074.FlavorText:
"What first seemed like a ridiculous and vaguely demeaning task quickly turned into a vicious struggle for survival."
—Welcome to Sweettooth

87075.Name: Vampiric Rites
87075.FlavorText:
"Should prying eyes observe the ritual, seize them for the cauldron, and soak the altar with the blood of the witness."
—The Witch's Way

87077.Name: Aggravated Assault
87077.FlavorText:
"The knights of Embereth fought with the fire of the Irencrag in their hearts. Though many fell, not a single one retreated."
—Last Stand of the Realm

87078.Name: Blood Moon
87078.FlavorText:
"The wyrm's dread eye upon the land was turned,
And all its people bent the knee—or burned."
—"The Night of Dragonfire"

87079.Name: Dragon Mantle
87079.FlavorText:
"With reckless courage, Cade embraced the flame.
He vowed they wouldn't dare forget his name."
—"The Night of Dragonfire"

87080.Name: Fiery Emancipation
87080.FlavorText:
"Mighty Torbran struck the invading phalanx like a bolt from the heavens. When the light faded, only ash remained around him."
—Last Stand of the Realm

87081.Name: Goblin Bombardment
87081.FlavorText:
"What redcaps lack in strategic acumen they more than make up for with brazen audacity."
—The Kenriths' Royal Bestiary

87082.Name: Impact Tremors
87082.FlavorText:
"With tears in his smoke-scorched eyes, he watched the living flames consume the only home he'd ever known."
—The Apprentice's Folly

87084.Name: Mana Flare
87084.FlavorText:
"I give my heart to the mountain, my memories to the wind. Let my last moment be burned into history."
—Daughters of Flame

87085.Name: Raid Bombardment
87085.FlavorText:
"For slaying dozens of redcaps using only fruit and cakes, the dwarven survivors were dubbed the Gluttoneers."
—Assault on Delverhaugh

87086.Name: Repercussion
87086.FlavorText:
"Tugrunn threw blow after blow, howling with pain as his fist met solid rock. The creature merely stared quizzically at him, unsure when the fight would start."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales

87087.Name: Shared Animosity
87087.FlavorText:
"The feud between dwarves and redcaps had raged for so long that no one could quite recall how it started. Few would believe it was sparked by a long-ago dispute over a spoon."
—Assault on Delverhaugh

87088.Name: Sneak Attack
87088.FlavorText:
"Korlag carefully prepared to try the new ‘am bush' strategy he'd heard about."
—The Ogre's Revenge

87089.Name: Defense of the Heart
87089.FlavorText:
"And as the rose began to bloom, the curse of Redtooth Keep began, at last, to wither."
—Curse of the Werefox

87092.Name: Ground Seal
87092.FlavorText:
"They laid her to rest in the wilds, in a sacred place beyond the reach of nightmares or machines."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer

87093.Name: Hardened Scales
87093.FlavorText:
"Before me writhed the guardian of my prize,
A serpent with stone skin and cunning eyes!"
—A Traveler's Trials

87095.Name: Nature's Will
87095.FlavorText:
"The troll took the fauns' hesitation as fear and roared in triumph. In truth, they'd seen the ledge begin to crack beneath his weight."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales

87096.Name: Parallel Lives
87096.FlavorText:
"Brave Syr Armont mused: Was the elves' true nature that of day's civility or night's savagery? Could such bestial rage be bestowed by curse alone?"
—Curse of the Werefox

87098.Name: Prismatic Omen
87098.FlavorText:
"There would be time later to mourn the lost, to weep for their fallen homes and lost treasures. But for now, they breathed in the untainted air and allowed themselves to hope again."
—Last Stand of the Realm

87100.Name: Unnatural Growth
87100.FlavorText:
"Should you hear witchstalkers howl,
Best to hide or run away.
They hunt witches vile and foul.
Fear both predator and prey."
—To Walk the Wilds

87122.Name: A-Circuit Mender
87122.FlavorText: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

87125.Name: A-Futurist Operative
87125.FlavorText: "The Imperials can't arrest you for illegal tech if you never even existed."

87127.Name: A-Knockout Blow
87127.FlavorText: "Subsequent efforts to deconstruct this facility will be punished with increasing severity."

87130.Name: A-Haywire Mite
87130.FlavorText:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

87131.Name: Abuelo's Awakening
87131.FlavorText: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

87132.Name: Acrobatic Leap
87132.FlavorText: As the cliff began to crumble, Wayta danced fearlessly across the tumbling stones, knowing Ajij would never let her fall.

87133.Name: Adaptive Gemguard
87133.FlavorText: Left to their own devices, gnomes reengineer their own devices.

87134.Name: Attentive Sunscribe
87134.FlavorText: Few humans are steady-handed enough to match a gnome's precision. Even the slightest change to a single line can wildly alter a glyph's meaning.

87137.Name: Cosmium Kiln
87137.FlavorText:
"I love the smell of freshly baked gnomes!"
—Yelha, Oltec artisan

87138.Name: Cosmium Blast
87138.FlavorText: Cosmium is the tangible essence of Chimil's power. The Oltec's cosmium-laced tattoos ensure that power can be called upon when needed.

87139.Name: Dauntless Dismantler
87139.FlavorText: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

87140.Name: Deconstruction Hammer
87140.FlavorText:
"All that is made can be unmade. Chimil's light is the only constant."
—Oltec artificers' creed

87142.Name: Envoy of Okinec Ahau
87142.FlavorText: Though wary of each other at first, the Malamet and the Oltec found a common enemy in the mycoids. They began to share glyph knowledge and other crafting secrets.

87144.Name: Family Reunion
87144.FlavorText: Huatli smiled up at Akal. "Our peoples have too long been parted, and yet we are cousins still."

87146.Name: Glorifier of Suffering
87146.FlavorText: "Everyone wants to be remembered. Few are willing to do what it takes."

87147.Name: Guardian of the Great Door
87147.FlavorText: The Core was sealed long ago by the Deep Gods, who set the angels to the eternal task of defending its golden gates.

87148.Name: Helping Hand
87148.FlavorText: Itzmin walked away from the collapse with a new friend—and an enduring fear of heights.

87149.Name: Ironpaw Aspirant
87149.FlavorText:
"Train your mind and your muscles with equal ferocity, cub. Without wisdom, even a mighty warrior is nothing but a bully."
—Sovereign Okinec Ahau

87152.Name: Malamet War Scribe
87152.FlavorText: The glyph is mightier than the sword.

87153.Name: Market Gnome
87153.FlavorText: "Maize, sweet and fresh! Tamal, hot and filling! Water, still or sparkling!"

87154.Name: Might of the Ancestors
87154.FlavorText: Malamet histories speak of a time when they were not yet confined to mortal bodies and existed as ferocity unrestrained.

87156.Name: Mischievous Pup
87156.FlavorText:
"Either he made a gnome very angry when he took that, or he'll make one very happy when he brings it back."
—Ihio, Oteclan market vendor

87158.Name: Temple of Civilization
87158.FlavorText: Chimil gave the Oltec life. Ojer Taq taught them how to live together.

87160.Name: Oltec Cloud Guard
87160.FlavorText: Many Oltec youth dream of one day joining the elite bat-riding cavalry of the Thousand Moons military force.

87162.Name: Oteclan Levitator
87162.FlavorText: Dusk Legion invaders sought lone Oltec travelers to prey upon. The Core's guidestones did not approve.

87163.Name: Petrify
87163.FlavorText: Those who break the laws of the Malamet become cold, silent warnings to others who might try.

87164.Name: Quicksand Whirlpool
87164.FlavorText:
"Those who would steal the blood and breath of the living will drink their fill of the sand."
—Sovereign Okinec Ahau

87166.Name: Ruin-Lurker Bat
87166.FlavorText:
"Look! Aclazotz sends his children to watch over our pilgrimage."
—Clavileño, First of the Blessed

87171.Name: Thousand Moons Crackshot
87171.FlavorText: The Thousand Moons practice every maneuver thousands of times, allowing them to strike flawlessly without hesitation in the heat of battle.

87172.Name: Thousand Moons Infantry
87172.FlavorText: The Thousand Moons train and fight in tight-knit squads of ten. Every tenth Moon functions as an officer, every hundredth as a captain, and the thousandth, Anim Pakal, as supreme commander.

87173.Name: Thousand Moons Smithy
87173.RawFrameDetail: W artifact legendary front side TDFC

87175.Name: Tinker's Tote
87175.FlavorText: Never leave home without a gnome.

87178.Name: Vanguard of the Rose
87178.FlavorText: "No one soul is worth more than Torrezon's salvation. Press on."

87180.Name: Akal Pakal, First Among Equals
87180.FlavorText: "These lost children of Aclazotz are misguided, but perhaps there can be reconciliation of our ideals without war."

87181.Name: Ancestral Reminiscence
87181.FlavorText: A typical conversation with Echoes is three parts wisdom and one part gossip.

87182.Name: Brackish Blunder
87182.FlavorText: When the Malamet told him to avoid the river, he thought they meant it wasn't safe to drink.

87184.Name: Braided Quipu
87184.FlavorText: The Oltec repurpose objects out of reverence rather than scarcity, believing them strengthened by the memory of each past function.

87185.Name: Chart a Course
87185.FlavorText: As the River Heralds began to decipher the ancient map, they were staggered by the vastness of the world-within-the-world that it revealed.

87186.Name: Cogwork Wrestler
87186.FlavorText: Years of adventure and adversity on the open seas did not prepare Brog for the humiliation of losing a sparring match to a cogwork doll less than half his size.

87187.Name: Confounding Riddle
87187.FlavorText: Explorers learned not to tamper with sites of ancient power without learning their purpose.

87188.Name: Council of Echoes
87188.FlavorText: The Komon Winaq, ancestors of the Oltec, linger on as the eldest of the Echoes.

87190.Name: Didact Echo
87190.FlavorText: The folk of the Sun Empire respect their ancestors. The Oltec go further, communing with spirits of esteemed elders after death.

87191.Name: Eaten by Piranhas
87191.FlavorText: It is ill-advised to swim where even the River Heralds do not.

87192.Name: The Enigma Jewel
87192.RawFrameDetail: U artifact legendary front side TDFC

87193.Name: Locus of Enlightenment
87193.RawFrameDetail: U artifact legendary back side TDFC

87194.Name: The Everflowing Well
87194.RawFrameDetail: U artifact legendary front side TDFC

87195.Name: The Myriad Pools
87195.RawFrameDetail: U map legendary back side TDFC

87196.Name: Frilled Cave-Wurm
87196.FlavorText:
"Remember that weird salamander thing we found in the jungle stream? I think we just met its god."
—Carella, quartermaster of the Windshark

87197.Name: Hermitic Nautilus
87197.FlavorText: It devoured the shell's original owner long ago, but it's just about ready to start looking for a new home—and a meal to go with it.

87200.Name: Iceberg Titan
87200.FlavorText: The force of a blizzard. The rage of a monstrosaur.

87205.Name: Marauding Brinefang
87205.FlavorText: Ancient glyphs are a lot harder to decipher when attached to an apex predator.

87206.Name: Merfolk Cave-Diver
87206.FlavorText:
"Learn all you can of this underground sea. I suspect more secrets of our ancestors lie waiting in its depths."
—Tishana

87207.Name: Oaken Siren
87207.FlavorText: The ship's carpenter adorned the figurehead with a small cosmium gem, never expecting the figurehead to take flight.

87209.Name: Temple of Cyclical Time
87209.FlavorText: Chimil gave the Oltec time. Ojer Pakpatiq gave them the tools to learn its lessons.

87210.Name: Orazca Puzzle-Door
87210.FlavorText: Between Quintorius's archaeological expertise and Huatli's knowledge of ancient glyphs, the "impossible" lock finally yielded, and the door to the underground world rumbled open.

87211.Name: Out of Air
87211.FlavorText:
"The Core is not a simple trove to be plundered by intruders from the surface. It will reject those who do not accord it respect."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

87212.Name: Pirate Hat
87212.FlavorText: "Landlubbers just don't understand the value of a proper hat."

87213.Name: Relic's Roar
87213.FlavorText:
"Well, that's one less share to divide up."
—Dranach, Dire Fleet boatswain

87214.Name: River Herald Scout
87214.FlavorText: "Don't worry, little swimmers. I'm here for the ruins, not you."

87216.Name: Self-Reflection
87216.FlavorText: Some Echoes remember every moment of their past lives and spend their existence contemplating past choices.

87221.Name: Staunch Crewmate
87221.FlavorText: "Leave you? Not a chance. You still owe me money."

87224.Name: Unlucky Drop
87224.FlavorText:
"First rule down here is the same as it is on the water: always double-check your knots."
—Captain Lannery Storm

87228.Name: Waylaying Pirates
87228.FlavorText: "The only drink in your future is seawater."

87230.Name: Abyssal Gorestalker
87230.FlavorText: Its kin once overran entire civilizations, but they tore each other to pieces in their unending hunger. Now only it remains.

87232.Name: Temple of the Dead
87232.FlavorText: Chimil gave the Oltec peace in death. Aclazotz ripped it away.

87234.Name: Another Chance
87234.FlavorText: The pull of duty was so strong that they barely paused to notice they'd died.

87235.Name: Bitter Triumph
87235.FlavorText: Though he wept at Inti's death, Caparocti's eyes were keen, and his spear pierced cleanly through Clavileño's tainted heart.

87237.Name: Bloodthorn Flail
87237.FlavorText:
"This weapon embodies both the strength and the weakness of the Legion of Dusk. They will endure any pain to achieve their ends, but they suffer pointlessly just to prove their dedication."
—Huatli

87239.Name: Broodrage Mycoid
87239.FlavorText: As the massive mycoids known as rage titans charge into battle, lesser ones swarm in their wake, gobbling up any survivors.

87241.Name: Chupacabra Echo
87241.FlavorText: It needs no food, yet still it hungers.

87243.Name: Dead Weight
87243.FlavorText: The hired goblins were not, as advertised, worth their weight in gold.

87244.Name: Deathcap Marionette
87244.FlavorText: Mycoids have no concept of life or death. All things exist, and all things can be made useful.

87246.Name: Deep-Cavern Bat
87246.FlavorText: The first shriek locates the prey. The second immobilizes it.

87248.Name: Echo of Dusk
87248.FlavorText:
"It's a mournful fate, to remember so well the taste of blood yet be forever unable to drink."
—Bartolomé del Presidio, director of the Queen's Bay Company

87249.Name: Fanatical Offering
87249.FlavorText: The gateway could be opened only by the spilling of innocent blood. Vito did not hesitate.

87251.Name: Gargantuan Leech
87251.FlavorText:
"Does everything down here want to suck my blood?"
—Derilene, expedition porter

87253.Name: Shadows' Lair
87253.FlavorText: The shadows make no mark upon the flesh. It is the mind they claw and strangle.

87254.Name: Greedy Freebooter
87254.FlavorText: Neither Nurgam nor the mycoid who laid the trap could quite believe their luck.

87255.Name: Join the Dead
87255.FlavorText: The more creatures that plunge to their deaths in the abyss, the more angry Echoes that arise to drag others down.

87256.Name: Malicious Eclipse
87256.FlavorText: Aclazotz laughed as the dark shards closed around Chimil, plunging the Core into unnatural darkness. At long last, his bloody reign would begin.

87257.Name: Mephitic Draught
87257.FlavorText:
"Don't look at me. I'm not drinking it."
—Dranach, Dire Fleet boatswain

87259.Name: Primordial Gnawer
87259.FlavorText: Cave crawlers devour anything from plant matter to solid rock, but they prefer fresh meat.

87262.Name: Ray of Ruin
87262.FlavorText:
"We know Chimil's light as a warming, healing presence, but make no mistake: to those who would desecrate her lands, it is a terrible force of scouring fury."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

87263.Name: Screaming Phantom
87263.FlavorText: After a slow death in darkness, she flies into a rage at the slightest glimpse of light.

87264.Name: Skullcap Snail
87264.FlavorText:
"Oh, come on! Aren't regular snails gross enough?"
—Derilene, expedition porter

87265.Name: Soulcoil Viper
87265.FlavorText:
"As the snake sheds its skin to be born anew, we cast off death to rise as servants of Aclazotz."
—Vito, Church of Dusk heretic

87269.Name: Stinging Cave Crawler
87269.FlavorText: Caverns uninhabited by mycoids are often infested with worse.

87270.Name: Synapse Necromage
87270.FlavorText:
"It's no good killing them? Then what do we do? Distract them with a tea party?"
—Mervin, Brazen Coalition prospector

87271.Name: Tarrian's Journal
87271.FlavorText: Though officially deemed a heretic for his reverent writings on Aclazotz, Tarrian is viewed as a holy martyr by the most radical sects of the Church of Dusk.
87271.RawFrameDetail: B artifact legendary front side TDFC

87273.Name: Terror Tide
87273.FlavorText: Those who go under rise again as cruel mockeries of their former selves, spewing foul water and keening with sorrow.

87275.Name: Consuming Sepulcher
87275.FlavorText:
"Slake my thirst so that we both may be free."
—Faded inscription

87277.Name: Dread Osseosaur
87277.FlavorText:
"It's not my fault! The glyphs for ‘blessed' and ‘cursed' look very similar!"
—Diego, Brazen Coalition translator

87278.Name: Vito's Inquisitor
87278.FlavorText: "We usher in the Age of Everflowing Blood, when those who are fed upon will be fed, and those who feed will be satiated."

87279.Name: Abrade
87279.FlavorText:
"What do you mean a walking clock destroyed all our cannons?!"
—Captain Lannery Storm

87280.Name: Ancestors' Aid
87280.FlavorText:
"You surface-dwellers may have forgotten your history, but it has not forgotten you."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

87281.Name: Belligerent Yearling
87281.FlavorText: One day it will be as terrifying as it thinks it is.

87283.Name: Brass's Tunnel-Grinder
87283.RawFrameDetail: R artifact legendary front side TDFC

87285.Name: Brazen Blademaster
87285.FlavorText: "The secret is footwork. Plus an extra sword."

87287.Name: Burning Sun Cavalry
87287.FlavorText: "By fire and lightning, tooth and claw, we will send these invaders fleeing back to Torrezon!"

87288.Name: Calamitous Cave-In
87288.FlavorText:
"For ‘immortal conquerors,' these vampires seem very susceptible to being crushed by boulders."
—Chara Rebal, bat rider

87289.Name: Child of the Volcano
87289.FlavorText: It is a living eruption, unquenchable fury given form.

87290.Name: Curator of Sun's Creation
87290.FlavorText: "Put your hammers away and bring me some blankets! Such a gift from Tilonalli must be handled with the utmost care."

87295.Name: Dire Blunderbuss
87295.FlavorText: "Thought you were out of my skull-bashin' range, didn't you?"

87296.Name: Dowsing Device
87296.FlavorText:
"A little innovation can lead to a big score."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

87298.Name: Dreadmaw's Ire
87298.FlavorText:
"That's the fifth ship lost in three days! Can't we build them out of something stronger?"
—Malcolm Lee

87299.Name: Enterprising Scallywag
87299.FlavorText: "He would've wanted me to have it!"

87302.Name: Goblin Tomb Raider
87302.FlavorText: Enterprising goblins can extract their body weight in loot. Ambitious ones have a big meal first.

87303.Name: Goldfury Strider
87303.FlavorText:
"Let's send our vampiric visitors a welcoming party, shall we?"
—Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon

87305.Name: Hotfoot Gnome
87305.FlavorText: As the surface-dwellers became bolder in their intrusions, Oltec artificers began to repurpose courier gnomes for intelligence gathering and distraction.

87311.Name: Temple of Power
87311.FlavorText: Chimil gave the Oltec passion. Ojer Axonil challenged them to harness it.

87312.Name: Panicked Altisaur
87312.FlavorText: Early Sun Empire expeditions learned the hard way that some surface dinosaurs were particularly ill-suited to the caverns' enclosed environments.

87313.Name: Plundering Pirate
87313.FlavorText: "Whatever it is, it set off a trap. It must be valuable!"

87315.Name: Rampaging Ceratops
87315.FlavorText: Anticipating tight spaces and trivial fauna, the first Dusk Legion expeditions were small, mobile, and lightly armored. Hundreds of casualties later, they started sending plate-clad platoons.

87316.Name: Rumbling Rockslide
87316.FlavorText: Sometimes an expedition reaches a natural conclusion. Sometimes it all just comes crashing down.

87318.Name: Mastercraft Raptor
87318.FlavorText: While Huatli ventured underground, Saheeli used her unique expertise to bolster the Sun Empire's defenses.

87319.Name: Scytheclaw Raptor
87319.FlavorText:
"She's a smart one. Noticed all on her own that the bloodsuckers wave their hands around to do their filthy magic, so she rips off their hands first."
—Citamitzin, Sun Empire warrior

87321.Name: Sunfire Torch
87321.FlavorText: "Let Tilonalli's light burn a path through this darkness."

87322.Name: Sunshot Militia
87322.FlavorText: As the Legion of Dusk closed in, Oltec citizens rallied to support the Thousand Moons and drive off the invaders.

87323.Name: Tectonic Hazard
87323.FlavorText:
"The ground is on fire, the ceiling's made of spears, and I think a mushroom tried to curse me. Don't tell me not to panic!"
—Jino Grag, Brazen Coalition scout

87324.Name: Triumphant Chomp
87324.FlavorText: With crunchy outer shells and juicy innards, cave crawlers quickly became a favorite snack of the Sun Empire's dinosaur companions.

87326.Name: Volatile Wanderglyph
87326.FlavorText: Touched eons ago by Ojer Axonil's flaming macuahuitl, it still burns with his boundless fury.

87328.Name: Armored Kincaller
87328.FlavorText:
"She's devoted to protecting her herd. We're just lucky she considers us part of it."
—Huatli

87329.Name: Basking Capybara
87329.FlavorText:
"Even our most learned philosophers can only hope to approach the inner serenity of the humble capybara."
—Nelli, Oltec didact

87330.Name: Bedrock Tortoise
87330.FlavorText: Many temples have strong foundations. Few are also wise.

87332.Name: Cenote Scout
87332.FlavorText: "If you're afraid to dive into the unknown, how will you ever find anything new?"

87333.Name: Coati Scavenger
87333.FlavorText: The difference between trash and treasure is a matter of perspective.

87334.Name: Colossadactyl
87334.FlavorText: Accustomed to hunting nimble flying prey, the dinosaur was delighted to have its meal delivered neatly in a box.

87336.Name: Disturbed Slumber
87336.FlavorText: "I'm telling you, the wall just blinked!"

87337.Name: Earthshaker Dreadmaw
87337.FlavorText:
"I suggest we leave this cavern for someone else to conquer."
—Amalia, master cartographer

87339.Name: Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant
87339.FlavorText: A thundering roar calls forth a primeval army.

87340.Name: Glimpse the Core
87340.FlavorText:
"Wow. It's a good thing we brought a poet."
—Wayta

87343.Name: Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
87343.FlavorText: Though the Sun Empire and the River Heralds once came together to plant the sacred forest, its roots have been tended by the mycoids ever since.

87345.Name: Roar of the Fifth People
87345.RawFrameDetail: Z gold Saga back side TDFC

87346.Name: Huatli's Final Strike
87346.FlavorText:
"Inti's name will grace our poems and histories for generations. Yours will collect dust, forgotten, in this cave."
—Huatli, to Vito

87347.Name: Hulking Raptor
87347.FlavorText:
"I watched him rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half once. A few vampires will barely slow him down."
—Huatli

87348.Name: In the Presence of Ages
87348.FlavorText:
"Finally, those glowing purple bone-monsters are gone and we can get back to the real excitement: archaeology!"
—Quintorius Kand

87350.Name: Ixalli's Lorekeeper
87350.FlavorText: "Did we follow the dinosaurs out of the caverns, or did they follow us? These glyphs could change our entire understanding of our history."

87352.Name: Jadeheart Attendant
87352.FlavorText: When the merfolk fled underground, they brought the life force of the jungle with them.

87353.Name: Jadelight Spelunker
87353.FlavorText: The River Heralds found clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.

87355.Name: Kaslem's Strider
87355.FlavorText: The Oltec long ago abandoned the caverns to the mycoids, but the Deep Gods still keep watch over the spore-strewn darkness.

87356.Name: Malamet Battle Glyph
87356.FlavorText:
"Let's not give the surface-dwellers time to learn what tactics work best here."
—Daram, Malamet marshal

87357.Name: Malamet Brawler
87357.FlavorText: "I bear the marking of the Deep King, and in his name I will rend you to nothing but spores on the wind!"

87359.Name: Malamet Veteran
87359.FlavorText: The mightiest Malamet warriors train as titan-killers, elite champions capable of facing down the caverns' most fearsome beasts.

87360.Name: Mineshaft Spider
87360.FlavorText: Anything that falls into the pit—relics, rubble, even corpses—ends up snared in its magic-infused web.

87363.Name: Temple of Cultivation
87363.FlavorText: Chimil gave the Oltec sacred lands. Ojer Kaslem brought them to life.

87365.Name: Pathfinding Axejaw
87365.FlavorText: When you don't know what dangers you'll face, bring the biggest danger with you.

87366.Name: Poison Dart Frog
87366.FlavorText:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli

87367.Name: Pugnacious Hammerskull
87367.FlavorText:
"I don't know whether it hates the mycoids or just loves breaking things. I say we leave it be."
—Samin, Oltec scout

87369.Name: Seeker of Sunlight
87369.FlavorText: "We weren't fleeing a broken world. We were running toward paradise!"

87370.Name: Sentinel of the Nameless City
87370.FlavorText: "Halt, traveler. Whatever you seek, you will not find it here."

87373.Name: Staggering Size
87373.FlavorText:
"Ah well . . . the temple was due for a new roof anyhow."
—Kusi, Oltec gardener

87374.Name: Tendril of the Mycotyrant
87374.FlavorText: Every mycoid carries within itself the makings of an entire colony.

87375.Name: Thrashing Brontodon
87375.FlavorText:
"I suppose we'll just hope those ancient monoliths lost to our people for centuries weren't particularly important."
—Toxayac, Sun Empire historian

87379.Name: Abuelo, Ancestral Echo
87379.FlavorText: "Come, friends. Let us see if this world remembers us."

87383.Name: Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
87383.FlavorText: "If we are to protect this world, we can no longer hide within it!"

87384.Name: Bartolomé del Presidio
87384.FlavorText: "Bless this sinner, who sacrificed his blood so that I may live."

87387.Name: Captain Storm, Cosmium Raider
87387.FlavorText: "To the mother lode, and death take the wary!"

87390.Name: Itzquinth, Firstborn of Gishath
87390.FlavorText:
"Dinosaurs have no concept of royalty, but they recognize the scent of the mightiest among them."
—Atla Palani, nest tender

87393.Name: Kutzil, Malamet Exemplar
87393.FlavorText: "Invaders in the West Chasm? Give me an hour and they'll be fungus food."

87395.Name: Master's Manufactory
87395.FlavorText:
"The Fomori are a foul and distant memory, but their war machines taught us much about large-scale armorcraft."
—Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon

87398.Name: Nicanzil, Current Conductor
87398.FlavorText: "This water can guide you anywhere, if you know how to ask."

87401.Name: Saheeli, the Sun's Brilliance
87401.FlavorText: What began as a single gift for Huatli became a battalion of automatons unlike anything ever seen on Ixalan.

87402.Name: Sovereign Okinec Ahau
87402.FlavorText: As surface empires send their explorers down, his hungry eyes look upward.

87403.Name: Squirming Emergence
87403.FlavorText: Due to archaic Brazen Coalition guidelines regarding hats, a few mycoids are now technically pirate captains.

87410.Name: Cartographer's Companion
87410.FlavorText: Ever since the Fomori's attempt long ago to extinguish Chimil's light, the Oltec have taken extensive measures to never get lost in the Core.

87412.Name: Compass Gnome
87412.FlavorText:
"I'm certain it's some kind of sophisticated navigational tool. If only I had any idea what it was telling me!"
—Colbo, Brazen Coalition surveyor

87415.Name: Disruptor Wanderglyph
87415.FlavorText: Wherever the spores begin to take hold, it crushes the ground to rubble.

87416.Name: Hoverstone Pilgrim
87416.FlavorText: They scour for secrets in places too distant or dangerous for humans to tread.

87417.Name: Hunter's Blowgun
87417.FlavorText:
"Ow! I think a wasp just stung me, cap'n."
—Nirk Doobin, last words

87419.Name: The Core
87419.FlavorText: Centuries ago, under siege from the Mycotyrant, the Oltec sealed the Core off from the world . . . until Huatli's party arrived.
87419.RawFrameDetail: Z gold map back side TDFC

87423.Name: Scampering Surveyor
87423.FlavorText: It knows the length, pitch, and orientation of every tunnel it has ever traversed.

87428.Name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
87428.FlavorText: Tarrian's holy weapon still holds a fragment of his dark power . . . and his hunger.

87436.Name: Cavernous Maw
87436.FlavorText: Many footprints lead into the cave. None lead out.

87437.Name: Echoing Deeps
87437.FlavorText: The still, silent waters reflect what was, not what is.

87438.Name: Forgotten Monument
87438.FlavorText: The Komon Winaq left behind few written records, but their handiwork stands strong all throughout the Core.

87445.Name: Promising Vein
87445.FlavorText: United under the banner of the Brazen Coalition, pirates put aside their feuds to plunder the underground bounty.

87486.Name: Deeproot Pilgrimage
87486.FlavorText: "These glyphs are more than trail markings! They tell a story as they go. But does it end in celebration or tragedy?"

87488.Name: Acolyte of Aclazotz
87488.FlavorText: "Great Aclazotz, receive this offering. Wrought with skill. Captured with strength. Anointed with the blood of your enemies."

87489.Name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
87489.FlavorText: Its very presence rips old wounds open to bleed anew.

87495.Name: Runaway Boulder
87495.FlavorText: "Run, hearties, run! Or we'll end our days as pirate paste!"

87497.Name: Halfling
87497.RawFrameDetail: W token, no text box, Beyond

87642.Name: A-Etching of Kumano
87642.FlavorText: Many kami came to demand a secret he did not know, and every one of them fell.

87681.Name: Mentor of the Meek
87681.FlavorText: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

87760.Name: Unearth
87760.FlavorText: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

88511.Name: Wayfarer's Bauble
88511.FlavorText: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

88682.Name: Repeal
88682.FlavorText:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

88881.Name: Elemental
88881.RawFrameDetail: GW token, has text box, g/w guildmark

88924.Name: Assemble the Players
88924.FlavorText:
"All will soon be made clear, but I can give you this: our killer is here with us, in this very room."
—Alquist Proft

88926.Name: Auspicious Arrival
88926.FlavorText: Proft brushed past the guards and introduced himself as "the great Detective Proft" without a hint of irony, then identified the culprit within minutes.

88927.Name: Call a Surprise Witness
88927.FlavorText: "Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate? I'm going to be here for a long, long time."

88932.Name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
88932.FlavorText: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."

88933.Name: Doorkeeper Thrull
88933.FlavorText: Parties at Karlov Manor are strictly invitation only.

88935.Name: Essence of Antiquity
88935.FlavorText: In a city as old as Ravnica, history takes on a life of its own—even when you least expect it.

88937.Name: Griffnaut Tracker
88937.FlavorText:
"The desperate will tread unexpected paths. Be prepared to follow."
—Tam Sennic, Ezrim's second-in-command

88938.Name: Haazda Vigilante
88938.FlavorText: "Call the Boros if you want. While they figure out if they have enough people to send a patrol, I'll be out clobbering the lowlifes who robbed you."

88940.Name: Karlov Watchdog
88940.FlavorText: Teysa trusts only those for whom money has no meaning.

88942.Name: Make Your Move
88942.FlavorText:
"If you're thinking only one step ahead, you're already falling behind."
—Teysa

88943.Name: Makeshift Binding
88943.FlavorText: Kaya clung to the cords of the barrier ward with all her might, trapping the thrashing dryad like a fly in a spider's web.

88944.Name: Marketwatch Phantom
88944.FlavorText: "It's amazing how efficient a detective you can be when you're not slowed down by things like self-preservation or walls."

88945.Name: Museum Nightwatch
88945.FlavorText: "You there, halt! The gallery is closed. Wait—what are you doing?"

88946.Name: Neighborhood Guardian
88946.FlavorText: A rare and beloved exception to the Agency's "no one is above suspicion" rule.

88947.Name: No Witnesses
88947.FlavorText: When cunning fails, there's always violence.

88948.Name: Not on My Watch
88948.FlavorText: "You know, Proft, I've done a lot of questionable things in my life, but helping a pompous detective save lives is a new low, even for me."

88949.Name: Novice Inspector
88949.FlavorText:
"If the perfect evidence appears at your feet, your first task is to rule out misdirection."
—The Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations handbook

88950.Name: On the Job
88950.FlavorText: For all their differences, Kaya, Kellan, and Agrus Kos agreed on one thing: none of them would rest until Teysa's murderer was brought to justice.

88951.Name: Perimeter Enforcer
88951.FlavorText: He makes sure no one sets foot in a fresh crime scene—not even himself.

88953.Name: Seasoned Consultant
88953.FlavorText:
"I appreciate working with associates whose greatest loyalty is to the job at hand."
—Skurad of the Foundway Associates

88959.Name: Benthic Criminologists
88959.FlavorText: Scientists from the Simic Combine are regularly seconded to various detective agencies in hopes that sharing their expertise will improve the guild's tarnished reputation.

88960.Name: Bubble Smuggler
88960.FlavorText: By the time they noticed the missing vials, Glovax was three fathoms away.

88961.Name: Burden of Proof
88961.FlavorText: "You must have known all those lies would catch up to you eventually."

88965.Name: Cold Case Cracker
88965.FlavorText: "It's a rare privilege to investigate one's own death."

88966.Name: Conspiracy Unraveler
88966.FlavorText: "There can be many motives and opportunities, but there is always only one truth."

88970.Name: Curious Inquiry
88970.FlavorText: Each time he replayed the attack in his mind, new details emerged.

88971.Name: Deduce
88971.FlavorText: Proft lit up like a man who had just been handed a glorious and unexpected gift. "I know who's responsible for this," he said. "And I can prove it."

88973.Name: Eliminate the Impossible
