88973.FlavorText: "Half the city had motive. Time to narrow down who also had the means and opportunity."

88978.Name: Furtive Courier
88978.FlavorText:
"Glad to see you made it in one piece. Next time, try not looking so obviously nervous."
—Linghu of the Foundway Associates

88979.Name: Hotshot Investigators
88979.FlavorText: They always think they're better than the local investigators. They're usually right.

88981.Name: Jaded Analyst
88981.FlavorText: "Oh, good, another case with too many victims and not enough clues."

88985.Name: Out Cold
88985.FlavorText:
"We'll get their statements after they defrost."
—Dvika of the Foundway Associates

88987.Name: Projektor Inspector
88987.FlavorText: "Bring up the particulars from yesterday's altercation, and enhance."

88988.Name: Reasonable Doubt
88988.FlavorText: "Merle had the motive, but Blovinac was the one caught with the murder weapon. And who was the seven-foot-tall hooded figure? This case is a mess!"

88989.Name: Reenact the Crime
88989.FlavorText: At Proft's command, an ethereal model of the ransacked workshop sprang into being, every detail perfectly recreated. He'd missed something—he knew it—but what?

88991.Name: Unauthorized Exit
88991.FlavorText: Proft had never been a by-the-book investigator, but even he never expected to find himself breaking a notorious assassin out of a maximum-security Azorius holding cell.

88992.Name: Agency Coroner
88992.FlavorText: "Well, cause of death seems pretty straightforward, but what else can you tell me, friend?"

88997.Name: Cerebral Confiscation
88997.FlavorText:
"Never rely on secondhand description. Always review the memory yourself."
—Lazav

89000.Name: Festerleech
89000.FlavorText:
"Four Dead in Zombie Leech Attack, Dozens Nauseated"
—Tenth District Times headline

89001.Name: Homicide Investigator
89001.FlavorText: In her line of work, the dead are often better sources than the living.

89004.Name: It Doesn't Add Up
89004.FlavorText: Etrata had committed dozens of murders, all of which she recalled in perfect, loving detail. But no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't remember killing Zegana.

89006.Name: Leering Onlooker
89006.FlavorText: "Ooh, this one does look nasty. Maybe they'll send Proft!"

89007.Name: Long Goodbye
89007.FlavorText: As the days grew longer, so did the list of missing persons.

89008.Name: Macabre Reconstruction
89008.FlavorText:
"Eyewitness testimony, coming right up! Just let me finish regenerating their eyes."
—Nelo, Agency coroner

89009.Name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
89009.FlavorText: "‘Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

89010.Name: Murder
89010.FlavorText: Laughter and conversation trailed off as the revelers gathered around Zegana's body. Three things quickly became clear: it was a murder, the killer was likely among them, and Teysa's party was definitely over.

89012.Name: Outrageous Robbery
89012.FlavorText:
"When you can't erase your own trail, leave as many false ones as possible."
—Etrata

89015.Name: Presumed Dead
89015.FlavorText: "Corpses are pulled from the undercity canals every day. They'll assume one's mine."

89016.Name: Repeat Offender
89016.FlavorText: "Blasted sketch artist did too good a job. Looks like it's time for me to lie low for a little while."

89017.Name: Rot Farm Mortipede
89017.FlavorText: Every week, the necropsy lab's unclaimed bodies are transferred to the Golgari for "recycling."

89018.Name: Slice from the Shadows
89018.FlavorText:
"Proft has been poking his nose where it doesn't belong. I want him out of the way."
—Judith, to Massacre Girl

89019.Name: Slimy Dualleech
89019.FlavorText:
"Isn't it gorgeous? It's my most efficient corpse eliminator! One head bites while the other chews."
—Glogus, Golgari leechbreeder

89020.Name: Snarling Gorehound
89020.FlavorText:
"I'd offer your dog a treat, but I'm afraid I don't have any appendages to spare."
—Alquist Proft, to Judith

89021.Name: Soul Enervation
89021.FlavorText: Judith's plan was close to fruition. She couldn't have Agrus get in the way.

89022.Name: Toxin Analysis
89022.FlavorText: "Poison this deadly is only used by the Ochran. Either the Golgari are behind this, or someone wants us to think they are."

89023.Name: Undercity Eliminator
89023.FlavorText: With their guild shunned for opening the doors to Phyrexia, some among the Golgari embraced their status as pariahs and took out their bitterness on all who crossed their paths.

89024.Name: Unscrupulous Agent
89024.FlavorText: Obtaining evidence through the "proper" channels can take weeks of paperwork. Sometimes justice just can't wait.

89025.Name: Vein Ripper
89025.FlavorText: "I'm afraid your investigation has reached a dead end."

89027.Name: Bolrac-Clan Basher
89027.FlavorText: Determining the culprit was not difficult. Getting him to stop committing the crime long enough to be arrested, however, was a massive challenge.

89030.Name: Caught Red-Handed
89030.FlavorText: "Wait, stop! I've been framed! Extremely convincingly!"

89031.Name: The Chase Is On
89031.FlavorText: Etrata evaded the Boros arresters and Azorius lawmages, but not even a master assassin could give Kaya the slip.

89033.Name: Connecting the Dots
89033.FlavorText: "How could I have missed it? The answer was right in front of me all along!"

89035.Name: Cornered Crook
89035.FlavorText: Monax knew attacking the detective was a reckless move, but he was at the end of his rope.

89036.Name: Crime Novelist
89036.FlavorText: "But then he peeled off the mask, revealing a sight that made Groja's blood run cold—Brulu was actually Vogos in disguise!"

89037.Name: Demand Answers
89037.FlavorText: After the attempt on Aurelia's life, she gave the Agency an ultimatum: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.

89040.Name: Felonious Rage
89040.FlavorText: It's hard to keep the peace if you can't even control your temper.

89043.Name: Galvanize
89043.FlavorText: "Why doesn't Kylox put an off switch on these things?!"

89044.Name: Gearbane Orangutan
89044.FlavorText:
"In her defense, thopters are very fun to smash."
—Udol of the Foundway Associates

89045.Name: Goblin Maskmaker
89045.FlavorText: "When you can't show your own face, try one of mine!"

89046.Name: Harried Dronesmith
89046.FlavorText: After the eleventh consecutive thopter failed to return from Gruul territory, she developed a disposable model.

89048.Name: Innocent Bystander
89048.FlavorText: "Whoops, this isn't my street! Don't mind me! I'll just be on my way while you enjoy your . . . very sharp knives."

89052.Name: Lamplight Phoenix
89052.FlavorText: The only warning was the faint smell of burning plasma.

89053.Name: Offender at Large
89053.FlavorText:
"In a city this big, anyone can blend in."
—Imel of the Foundway Associates

89054.Name: Person of Interest
89054.FlavorText: "Maybe they're following someone else," Alvis thought to himself, despite mounting evidence to the contrary.

89056.Name: Reckless Detective
89056.FlavorText: He's gonna crack this thing wide open.

89057.Name: Red Herring
89057.FlavorText:
"Thopters are but one option in our suite of autonomous surveillance solutions."
—Kylox

89058.Name: Rubblebelt Braggart
89058.FlavorText: "I did it! Double—no, triple homicide! In a building I set on fire. Yep, all me."

89059.Name: Shock
89059.FlavorText: She realized that she could not, in fact, handle the truth.

89060.Name: Suspicious Detonation
89060.FlavorText:
"Clearly someone wanted us to find this."
—Runubi of the Foundway Associates

89061.Name: Vengeful Tracker
89061.FlavorText: "I won't waste my time hunting down petty thieves while my brother's killer still walks free."

89062.Name: Aftermath Analyst
89062.FlavorText: "Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like . . . a lot more?"

89066.Name: Audience with Trostani
89066.FlavorText: Trostani was as regal and vibrant as ever, but Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off, some discordant note lurking deep within the chorus.

89071.Name: Chalk Outline
89071.FlavorText:
"In your search for a suspect, never forget that the most important person is the victim."
—Ezrim, Agency chief

89072.Name: Culvert Ambusher
89072.FlavorText: The bite at the end of the tunnel.

89073.Name: Fanatical Strength
89073.FlavorText: "What is this? An ambush or a staring contest?" Kaya taunted. As if in answer, the robed figure lunged forward.

89075.Name: Get a Leg Up
89075.FlavorText: "Apologies for using you like a stepladder. On the other hand, thank you, you're a wonderful stepladder!"

89076.Name: Glint Weaver
89076.FlavorText: The spider just loved how the gems twinkled, and the high-class prey they attracted.

89078.Name: Hard-Hitting Question
89078.FlavorText:
"Keen eyes and an analytical mind are some of a detective's most important tools. As is a mean left hook."
—Senior Inspector Holjo

89080.Name: Hide in Plain Sight
89080.FlavorText: The trees look beautiful . . . until they look back.

89084.Name: Pick Your Poison
89084.FlavorText: A reliable, general-purpose toxin is a handy way to save on belt space.

89089.Name: Sample Collector
89089.FlavorText: "Whatever broke out of here is at least half bear . . . and I'd say some lizard as well."

89092.Name: They Went This Way
89092.FlavorText:
"Running doesn't prove guilt, but innocent people don't typically flee into the North Ridge Forest."
—Alst of the Foundway Associates

89093.Name: Topiary Panther
89093.FlavorText: The gardens around Karlov Manor are oddly bereft of birdsong.

89094.Name: Tunnel Tipster
89094.FlavorText: "When your perp goes underground, I know where to find 'em."

89095.Name: Undergrowth Recon
89095.FlavorText:
"I want eyes on the scene of the crime, day and night. I have a feeling our killer won't be able to resist coming back."
—Thare of the Foundway Associates

89096.Name: Vengeful Creeper
89096.FlavorText: Seeking intact evidence in the Rubblebelt is a fool's errand.

89098.Name: Agrus Kos, Spirit of Justice
89098.FlavorText: "Eventually I'll give retirement another shot. But not today."

89100.Name: Anzrag, the Quake-Mole
89100.FlavorText: His claws tear at the foundations of civilization.

89101.Name: Assassin's Trophy
89101.FlavorText:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates

89105.Name: Coerced to Kill
89105.FlavorText:
"People are being brainwashed into these attacks. We must find the puppet master."
—Alquist Proft

89107.Name: Curious Cadaver
89107.FlavorText:
"When you said I could learn a lot from a corpse, I have to admit I wasn't expecting it to lecture me on forensic procedure."
—Kellan, to Ezrim

89108.Name: Deadly Complication
89108.FlavorText: Teysa's security was unrivaled. Etrata was locked up. Kaya was left with nothing but multiplying questions . . . and a dead friend.

89109.Name: Detective's Satchel
89109.FlavorText: It's a crime lab in a bag.

89111.Name: Doppelgang
89111.FlavorText:
"Suspect spotted at the Tin Street Market, Yescu Street entrance. And the Oak Street entrance. And somehow also in Lobar Alley!"
—Avult of the Foundway Associates

89112.Name: Drag the Canal
89112.FlavorText: "Let's gather what we can before the Golgari tidy up the scene."

89120.Name: Ill-Timed Explosion
89120.FlavorText: Only too late did the Agency custodians realize the device had not been inactive—it was just waiting for the right trigger.

89121.Name: Insidious Roots
89121.FlavorText: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi allowed Trostani to reach every crack and crevice in the city.

89123.Name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
89123.FlavorText: "I don't make my living hiding the truth, detective. I shout it from the stage."

89131.Name: Lightning Helix
89131.FlavorText: After heavy casualties in the Phyrexian invasion, the Boros mage-priests trained as many rank-and-file soldiers as possible to wield the Legion's legendary battle magic.

89132.Name: Meddling Youths
89132.FlavorText: "Well, if it isn't mean old Mr. Larchbottom, who's always been so eager to have the only dumpling stall in Oxblood Alley."

89134.Name: No More Lies
89134.FlavorText:
"Lies fester and flourish in shadow. Our job is to bathe them in light."
—Ezrim, Agency chief

89135.Name: Officious Interrogation
89135.FlavorText: No guest was permitted to leave before being questioned in an Azorius verity circle.

89137.Name: Rakdos, Patron of Chaos
89137.FlavorText: "Finally, a performance worthy of my applause!"

89139.Name: Relive the Past
89139.FlavorText:
"Many have tried to subjugate Ravnica. All have failed. All will fail."
—Museum of Ravnican History

89140.Name: Repulsive Mutation
89140.FlavorText:
"Remind me to send the biomancer team a gift basket."
—Olana, Simic field researcher

89141.Name: Riftburst Hellion
89141.FlavorText: Like any Ravnican denizen, it decided to visit Plaza West for lunch.

89142.Name: Rune-Brand Juggler
89142.FlavorText: Notice: Guests of Hellbender may be exposed to occasional bursts of flame.

89144.Name: Shady Informant
89144.FlavorText: Rakdos snitches rarely survive to get stitches.

89145.Name: Soul Search
89145.FlavorText: Taking a secret to your grave still doesn't make it safe from the Orzhov.

89146.Name: Sumala Sentry
89146.FlavorText: The great meditation garden of Sumala was no place for Ravnica's rising crime wave, and he would keep it that way.

89148.Name: Tin Street Gossip
89148.FlavorText: "The lawmages are trying to hush it up, but I'm telling you—the guard didn't fall off that balcony. He was pushed!"

89150.Name: Treacherous Greed
89150.FlavorText: Loot's easy to divide by one.

89151.Name: Trostani, Three Whispers
89151.FlavorText: Tangled in the heart of Vitu-Ghazi, they guard their secrets from eager ears.

89152.Name: Urgent Necropsy
89152.FlavorText:
"The Golgari can read the dead like a newspaper."
—Taboro of the Foundway Associates

89154.Name: Warleader's Call
89154.FlavorText: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock, desperate to stave off a war the guilds might not survive.

89156.Name: Worldsoul's Rage
89156.FlavorText: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"

89157.Name: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

89174.Name: Gravestone Strider
89174.FlavorText: The empty graves grew tired of waiting for bodies to fill them and set out to make some.

89176.Name: Magnetic Snuffler
89176.FlavorText: It recovers precious jewelry, murder weapons, and discarded food tins with equal excitement.

89177.Name: Magnifying Glass
89177.FlavorText:
"These footprints mean only one thing: the streetcleaner is running late!"
—Argyle, Agency junior detective

89178.Name: Sanitation Automaton
89178.FlavorText: "I am once again bursting with discarded theories. Disposal imminent."

89179.Name: Thinking Cap
89179.FlavorText:
"I find that my greatest insights rarely arrive when my ears are cold."
—Senior Inspector Holjo

89183.Name: Escape Tunnel
89183.FlavorText: No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.

89195.Name: Wojek Investigator
89195.FlavorText: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know . . ."

89196.Name: Sudden Setback
89196.FlavorText: "Look, buddy, you're not in trouble. I just wanna ask you a questio—"

89197.Name: Surveillance Monitor
89197.FlavorText: Thopters don't take breaks, and neither does he.

89200.Name: Torch the Witness
89200.FlavorText:
"He was scheduled to meet me tomorrow with something important to share. This was no coincidence."
—Algrom of the Foundway Associates

89202.Name: Kraul Whipcracker
89202.FlavorText:
"Er, sir, we could try to cite him for mishandling evidence, but I'm not sure he technically has hands."
—Argyle, Agency junior detective

89235.Name: Clue
89235.FlavorText:
"Four prints plus one murder weapon equals a case even Juri won't be able to wriggle out of."
—Agency memo
89235.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

89236.Name: Clue
89236.FlavorText:
With the Gnat Alley mugging case solved, maybe we can finally figure out who's been leaving shoes all over the Sixth Precinct."
—Agency memo
89236.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

89237.Name: Clue
89237.FlavorText:
"As we suspected, someone appears to be targeting Tolsimir specifically."
—Agency memo
89237.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

89238.Name: Clue
89238.FlavorText:
"Whatever it is, the smell alone could stun a loxodon. Simic involvement?"
—Agency memo
89238.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

89239.Name: Clue
89239.FlavorText:
"Confiscated from the twin heirs of the Lusaht family. Will not be easy to unlock."
—Agency memo
89239.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

90115.Name: Cerise, Slayer of Fear
90115.FlavorText: "Too bad for this Wicked Slumber-—I've always been an insomniac!"

90117.Name: The Conundrum of Bowls
90117.FlavorText: The smallest bowl was temptingly cute; from the middle bowl wafted a soothing aroma; but the big bowl held a generous portion, and she was hungry . . .

90119.Name: Talion's Throneguard
90119.FlavorText: "You spent your life toiling to learn a few simple tricks, and you call yourself an archmage? Truly, the arrogance of mortals knows no bounds."

90120.Name: Tome of Gadwick
90120.FlavorText: Filled with illustrations by Gadwick himself, the prized tome is coveted by every apprentice, witch, and librarian on Eldraine.

90121.Name: Dunbarrow Revivalist
90121.FlavorText: "The Wicked Slumber was just the beginning."

90125.Name: Overcooked
90125.FlavorText: "You'll eat it and you'll like it! Anyone care to argue?"

90126.Name: Victory of the Pyrohammer
90126.FlavorText: Tales of Will and Imodane's duel spread through the kingdom like wildfire, though the specifics varied greatly based on which side the teller supported.

90127.Name: A Golden Opportunity
90127.FlavorText: The gilded goose journeyed aimlessly across the land, laying eggs as she pleased and unwittingly granting lucky peasants the fortune of a lifetime.

90128.Name: Hex, Kellan's Companion
90128.FlavorText: Growing up with Kellan gave him an uncanny knack for sniffing out traces of fae magic.

90129.Name: Swine Rebellion
90129.FlavorText:
"And the pigs called to the wolf, ‘WE'LL RIP YOUR CAVE DOWN STONE BY STONE . . .'"
—Gylwain, "The Pigs' Revenge"

90132.Name: Drover of the Swine
90132.FlavorText: "Back, fiend! It's a vegetarian life for you from this day forward!"

90134.Name: Grow Old Together
90134.FlavorText:
"True love can make the mundane magical and the unbearable bearable."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

90135.Name: High Fae Prankster
90135.FlavorText: A life-or-death struggle for a human is but a moment's entertainment for the fae.

90136.Name: Jewel Mine Overseer
90136.FlavorText: "Hey, I don't hear any whistling! Get back to work!"

90137.Name: Outfitted Jouster
90137.FlavorText: She brings the crowd to their feet and her opponents to their knees.

90143.Name: Stormkeld Curator
90143.FlavorText: He scours the furthest reaches of Eldraine for novelties to add to Beluna's vault.

90144.Name: Giant Secrets
90144.FlavorText: He scours the furthest reaches of Eldraine for novelties to add to Beluna's vault.

90145.Name: Syr Joshua and Syr Saxon
90145.FlavorText: They were inseparable in waking life, and they fought in perfect coordination even as puppets of the Wicked Slumber.

90147.Name: Captivating Crossroads
90147.FlavorText:
"All roads lead to where you are meant to go."
—Talion

90148.Name: Loch Larent
90148.FlavorText:
"The Ice Witch thinks this place silent and still. But beneath the surface, my people thrive."
—Sharae

90153.Name: Ethereal Armor
90153.FlavorText: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

90155.Name: On Serra's Wings
90155.FlavorText:
"The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance."
—Song of All, canto 524

90156.Name: Face of Divinity
90156.FlavorText: Pure souls shine bright as daybreak.

90157.Name: All That Glitters
90157.FlavorText: A faerie's glee at her trove quickly fades to contentment, then to boredom, then to an urge to steal more.

90158.Name: Celestial Mantle
90158.FlavorText: Upon such armor, even a mountain would break.

90159.Name: Brainstorm
90159.FlavorText: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

90160.Name: Ponder
90160.FlavorText: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

90162.Name: Consider
90162.FlavorText: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

90163.Name: Sleight of Hand
90163.FlavorText: The farmer was amazed to see the penny vanish into thin air, but the goose knew he'd just slipped it to the faerie.

90165.Name: Opt
90165.FlavorText:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

90166.Name: Rousing Read
90166.FlavorText: Great literature can transport the reader.

90167.Name: Peek
90167.FlavorText: Sometimes you have to read between the minds.

90168.Name: Thought Scour
90168.FlavorText:
"As you inject the viscus vitae into the brain stem, don't let the spastic moaning bother you. It will soon become music to your ears."
—Stitcher Geralf

90170.Name: Curiosity
90170.FlavorText: "Surely you know the joy of the hunt, my furry friend. My kind of hunt just takes a different form than yours."

90171.Name: Serum Visions
90171.FlavorText: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.

90173.Name: Aether Tunnel
90173.FlavorText: If you can't find a doorway, make one.

90174.Name: Take Flight
90174.FlavorText: Though neither brother cared to admit it, flying the ancient thopter was their last happy moment together.

90176.Name: Quicken
90176.FlavorText: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

90177.Name: Seven Dwarves
90177.FlavorText:
"The gleam of rubies and my brothers and sisters by my side . . . what more could I want?"
—Brognold the Third

90178.Name: Food Fight
90178.FlavorText: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

90180.Name: Staggering Insight
90180.FlavorText:
"Only cowards flee from the truth."
—Perisophia the philosopher

90183.Name: Steelclaw Lance
90183.FlavorText:
"A traditional lance is fine for the Burning Yard, but in the wilds you need a nastier bite."
—Kenver, Embereth weaponsmith

90248.RawFrameDetail: W basic snow Plains, no text box

90251.Name: Snow-Covered Mountain
90251.RawFrameDetail: R basic snow Mountain, no text box

90252.Name: Snow-Covered Forest
90252.RawFrameDetail: G basic snow Forest, no text box

90259.Name: Shadowspear
90259.FlavorText:
"Few now have the skill in healing to match such evil weapons."
—Strider

90262.Name: Thorn of Amethyst
90262.FlavorText:
"Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it has not yet been forged again."
—Elrond

90264.Name: Bojuka Bog
90264.FlavorText: There loomed against the westward stars a dark black shape: a great barrow stood there.

90267.Name: Castle Ardenvale
90267.FlavorText: The hall was long and wide and filled with shadows. Mighty pillars upheld its lofty roof.

90284.Name: Cogwork Progenitor
90284.FlavorText: There's a gnome built for just about every job in Oteclan, including building gnomes.

90286.Name: Radiant Smite
90286.FlavorText: Pure faith enkindled can sear even those blessed by the sun.

90287.Name: Valiant Batrider
90287.FlavorText: The Thousand Moons chose to ride giant bats as a message to Aclazotz: Anything you twist can be undone.

90288.Name: Herald's Reveille
90288.FlavorText:
"Dawn! The morning tide! Arise! Arise!"
—River Herald chant

90289.Name: Hymn to the Ages
90289.FlavorText:
"As there was one age, there shall be another."
—Hymn to the Ages, chorus

90290.Name: Landlore Navigator
90290.FlavorText: "Let's see: if that bit is the tunnel, and the blue scribble is the waterfall . . . yep, we're going the wrong way."

90293.Name: Dusk's Landing
90293.FlavorText: In the darkness of Ixalan's underworld, the Legion found new lands to claim.

90299.Name: Pirate's Landing
90299.FlavorText: To the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, gold and distant horizons are both reason enough to set sail.

90301.Name: Colossal Chorus
90301.FlavorText: A harmonious crescendo that ends in a loud bellow.

90304.Name: Scalespeaker Shepherd
90304.FlavorText: "Rough-Tail, old friend! You're far from the herd today. Is something stirring in the jungle?"

90308.Name: Merfolk Tunnel-Guide
90308.FlavorText: The farther she swam from one world, the closer she came to the next.

90309.Name: Mycoid Resurrection
90309.FlavorText: The mycelium pulsed slowly, as if counting the beats of an enormous heart. The bones around them shuddered, then stood again.

90311.Name: Scalesoul Gnome
90311.FlavorText: The Oltec learned from their Imperial cousins, and applied new magic to old artifice in defense of the Core.

90312.Name: Stalwart Speartail
90312.FlavorText:
"Give her space! She'll adapt to the Cosmium in her, or kill us trying."
—Yeyetzi, Sun Empire sergeant

90313.Name: Tan Jolom, the Worldwalker
90313.FlavorText:
"I, who have seen all the world, now go on to what comes next."
—Tan Jolom, last words

90317.Name: Corsair Captain
90317.FlavorText: "Lungs full of sea air and a hold full of loot. Ah, what a life!"

90319.Name: Staunch Crewmate
90319.FlavorText: "Leave you? Not a chance. You still owe me money."

90320.Name: Thieving Magpie
90320.FlavorText: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies collect jewels for theirs.

90321.Name: Arguel's Blood Fast
90321.FlavorText: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

90322.Name: Burning Sun's Avatar
90322.FlavorText:
"Tilonalli's searing rays carry the spark of life's eventual destruction as all light fades."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

90323.Name: Charging Monstrosaur
90323.FlavorText: "I knew I should have stayed with the boat. Always stay with the boat!"

90325.Name: Volcanic Geyser
90325.FlavorText:
"The common folk call it the breaking of the crust or the spilling of fire. Geomancers call it target practice."
—Ryda, geomancer

90327.Name: Carnage Tyrant
90327.FlavorText: Sun Empire commanders are well versed in advanced martial strategy. Still, the correct maneuver is usually to deploy the giant, implacable death lizard.

90328.Name: Colossal Dreadmaw
90328.FlavorText: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

90329.Name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
90329.FlavorText: The earth walks, strongest of all.

90330.Name: Naturalize
90330.FlavorText:
"Better to let the sword go than to lose the arm with it."
—Captain Lannery Storm

90332.Name: Ripjaw Raptor
90332.FlavorText: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

90335.Name: Territorial Allosaurus
90335.FlavorText: A living remnant of the Ice Age.

90337.Name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
90337.FlavorText:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

90338.Name: Admiral Beckett Brass
90338.FlavorText: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

90339.Name: Etali, Primal Sickness
90339.FlavorText: The contagion spreads and the Multiverse quakes.

90342.Name: Regisaur Alpha
90342.FlavorText:
"Seeing a pack of these monsters hunt together, I'm at a loss to imagine the size of their prey."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

90344.Name: Temple of Aclazotz
90344.FlavorText: . . . to the lost temple of a bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun.
90344.RawFrameDetail: B land back side side TDFC

90347.Name: Another Round
90347.FlavorText: Weary travelers trade stories of the Eversaloon, an extraplanar respite that appears at the moment it is most needed.

90349.Name: Armored Armadillo
90349.FlavorText:
"I always wanted to ride a slow cannonball with legs!"
—Kellan

90352.Name: Bovine Intervention
90352.FlavorText: No one could prove the ox did it, but no one tried to harness it again either.

90356.Name: Eriette's Lullaby
90356.FlavorText: When Kellan questioned her, Eriette reminded him that she'd been asked only to put the guard to sleep—the request said nothing about waking up.

90360.Name: Getaway Glamer
90360.FlavorText: As the vault collapsed around them, Kellan made sure Akul couldn't follow them out.

90361.Name: High Noon
90361.FlavorText: They both knew only one of them would walk away.

90362.Name: Holy Cow
90362.FlavorText: After it passed by, the rancher swore she saw hope shining in the pigs' eyes.

90363.Name: Inventive Wingsmith
90363.FlavorText: "We must forge for ourselves the gifts that nature neglected to give us."

90365.Name: Mystical Tether
90365.FlavorText: Kellan had no plan. He simply poured his focus into the train and willed it to stop.

90366.Name: Nurturing Pixie
90366.FlavorText: "Count yourself lucky I came upon you. This is not a world of second chances."

90367.Name: Omenport Vigilante
90367.FlavorText: Freestriders took to patrolling near the Omenpaths, protecting new arrivals from the robbers and charlatans prowling for easy marks.

90369.Name: Outlaw Medic
90369.FlavorText: "What are you gonna do, walk a hundred miles for a second opinion?"

90372.Name: Requisition Raid
90372.FlavorText: The Freestriders believe in liberation, in all its many forms.

90374.Name: Shepherd of the Clouds
90374.FlavorText: It catches those who are not ready to fall.

90377.Name: Steer Clear
90377.FlavorText:
"Just because you can saddle a critter, doesn't mean it'll let you ride."
—Annie Flash

90378.Name: Sterling Keykeeper
90378.FlavorText: "If you don't want to tell me where the stash is, you'd best start getting comfy in there. You just let me know when you've changed your mind."

90379.Name: Sterling Supplier
90379.FlavorText: The Sterling Company can always rely on him to bring the thunder.

90380.Name: Take Up the Shield
90380.FlavorText: The frontier was an anvil on which many an unlikely hero would be forged.

90383.Name: Vengeful Townsfolk
90383.FlavorText: "The Sterling Company says they protect us, but where are they when the Hellspurs burn half the town? Counting their vaults!"

90384.Name: Wanted Griffin
90384.FlavorText: Many a would-be captor has gotten close enough to count its feathers, only to be left behind with nothing but regret and a dangling rope.

90386.Name: Canyon Crab
90386.FlavorText: They cluster near shallow river crossings, blending into the rocks, waiting for unsuspecting travelers to step within range of their claws.

90387.Name: Daring Thunder-Thief
90387.FlavorText: It's amazing how many sticky situations you can get out of simply by being ten times faster than anyone expects.

90388.Name: Deepmuck Desperado
90388.FlavorText: "Heard you've been horning in on my turf. How about I introduce you to some surf?"

90389.Name: Djinn of Fool's Fall
90389.FlavorText: No one knew if the waterfall was a natural wonder the djinn guarded or if he'd conjured it to hide something even greater.

90390.Name: Double Down
90390.FlavorText: The best alibi is being in multiple places at the same time.

90393.Name: Failed Fording
90393.FlavorText:
"We should have taken the blasted ferry!"
—Hope Hagan, prospector

90395.Name: Fleeting Reflection
90395.FlavorText:
"You're not mad I pulled a little prank. You're just mad you fell for it."
—Oko, to Annie Flash

90397.Name: Geyser Drake
90397.FlavorText: As mating season approaches, drakes dive through scalding geysers, revealing the brightly colored scales hidden beneath layers of dust.

90398.Name: Harrier Strix
90398.FlavorText: It can see in both darkness and daylight, but it hunts best when thunder growls in the sky.

90399.Name: Jailbreak Scheme
90399.FlavorText: Satoru insisted he was just about to free himself.

90402.Name: Marauding Sphinx
90402.FlavorText: She poses a riddle to each mark, allowing them a chance to keep their goods. Thus far, none have succeeded.

90403.Name: Metamorphic Blast
90403.FlavorText: Rundo's craving for revenge was replaced by a craving for vegetables.

90404.Name: Nimble Brigand
90404.FlavorText: The hard part wasn't sneaking aboard. It was safely exiting with Slickshot flair.

90406.Name: Peerless Ropemaster
90406.FlavorText: "Murder someone and you'll have a gaggle of folks lining up for revenge. Humiliate them, and they won't dare bother you again."

90407.Name: Phantom Interference
90407.FlavorText: To his enemies' chagrin, Winston was every bit as meddlesome dead as he had been alive.

90410.Name: Seize the Secrets
90410.FlavorText: Nolan refused to give up the vault's location. The strange figure simply smiled and reached into his mind.

90411.Name: Shackle Slinger
90411.FlavorText: Even when he missed the wrists, a pair of thundercuffs to the head got the job done.

90414.Name: Slickshot Vault-Buster
90414.FlavorText: "Sure it's risky, but that's what makes it fun! That and the money. And the bankers' faces."

90415.Name: Spring Splasher
90415.FlavorText: It once escaped a cook's pot. Now it fears neither heat nor human.

90417.Name: Stoic Sphinx
90417.FlavorText: Lucky travelers reported a mighty winged creature among the geysers. Unlucky ones didn't make it back.

90419.Name: Take the Fall
90419.FlavorText: Dewey had been briefed on every aspect of the plan . . . except the bit where he was left holding the bag.

90420.Name: This Town Ain't Big Enough
90420.FlavorText: "All that fancy footwork, and you can't even dodge one silly little rope? Cryin' shame, that is."

90421.Name: Three Steps Ahead
90421.FlavorText: She'd planned for every eventuality, with the obvious exception of failure.

90423.Name: Ambush Gigapede
90423.FlavorText:
"First rule of crossing Blacksnag Bog: if you can't see the bottom, don't."
—Chance Mulligan, wilderness guide

90424.Name: Binding Negotiation
90424.FlavorText: "The tighter I bind them, the looser their tongues become."

90427.Name: Boneyard Desecrator
90427.FlavorText: It's never too late to start an afterlife of crime.

90429.Name: Consuming Ashes
90429.FlavorText: The enforcer only got halfway through the arrest warrant before it—and he—went up in smoke.

90430.Name: Corrupted Conviction
90430.FlavorText: Every moving carriage is an accident waiting to happen, and the Hellspurs hate waiting.

90431.Name: Desert's Due
90431.FlavorText: He was glad when the mirages appeared. At least he wouldn't die alone.

90432.Name: Desperate Bloodseeker
90432.FlavorText: With no mammals around, some vampires tried to feed on cactusfolk, with horrible results for everyone involved.

90433.Name: Fake Your Own Death
90433.FlavorText:
"Oh, he's done bothering us. Trust me."
—Dwayne, Hellspur guard

90437.Name: Insatiable Avarice
90437.FlavorText: Akul didn't know what lay inside Tarnation's great vault, but the mystery fueled his obsession.

90439.Name: Lively Dirge
90439.FlavorText: "Now rip your partner from the grave, and form an undead killing wave!"

90440.Name: Mourner's Surprise
90440.FlavorText: "Y'all should've known better than to buy me a coffin!"

90441.Name: Neutralize the Guards
90441.FlavorText: "Don't bother getting up. I'll see myself in."

90442.Name: Nezumi Linkbreaker
90442.FlavorText: "If they want to get to Prosperity so badly, they can walk there."

90443.Name: Overzealous Muscle
90443.FlavorText: Not everyone can be a pickpocket.

90444.Name: Pitiless Carnage
90444.FlavorText: Akul saw his Hellspur followers as little more than ammunition to be expended.

90446.Name: Rattleback Apothecary
90446.FlavorText: "Looking for a little liquid courage? I also stock liquid murder, if that's what you're after."

90447.Name: Raven of Fell Omens
90447.FlavorText: A raven sighted at midnight often means there's unkindness on the way.

90452.Name: Shoot the Sheriff
90452.FlavorText:
"Now, where is that deputy?"
—Jana, Hellspur thunderslinger

90453.Name: Skulduggery
90453.FlavorText: "Why you yellow-bellied, loot-stealing, good-for-nothing, bottom-feeding, dog-faced, lily-livered . . ."

90454.Name: Tinybones Joins Up
90454.FlavorText: It was going to be the greatest heist of his unlife.

90456.Name: Treasure Dredger
90456.FlavorText: The old miners' trail across Blacksnag Bog is littered with lost fortunes and the bones of those who searched for them.

90457.Name: Unfortunate Accident
90457.FlavorText:
"Looks like you've got a train to catch."
—Laughing Jasper Flint

90460.Name: Vault Plunderer
90460.FlavorText: "Kind of them to put all their valuables in the same place."

90465.Name: Deadeye Duelist
90465.FlavorText: Slickshots are always eager to demonstrate their skills to whomever questions them.

90467.Name: Discerning Peddler
90467.FlavorText: "Can I interest you in some herbs from Naktamun? Fresh from the Omenpath! Or a set of Fioran cookware? Finest in the Multiverse!"

90472.Name: Hell to Pay
90472.FlavorText: For years afterward, lucky explorers who found the cave could chip gold fragments off the rocky walls.

90473.Name: Hellspur Brute
90473.FlavorText: The last fool who called him "cowboy" earned a free ride to the bottom of Blacksnag Bog.

90475.Name: Highway Robbery
90475.FlavorText: The fires weren't even out before the backstabbing began.

90477.Name: Iron-Fist Pulverizer
90477.FlavorText:
"The 3:10 to Omenport will be delayed."
—Prosperity Station announcement

90480.Name: Magebane Lizard
90480.FlavorText:
"I didn't miss. Blasted thing snatched my bolt out of the air and ate it!"
—Lilah, Slickshot boss

90482.Name: Outlaws' Fury
90482.FlavorText: The only witness to their rampage was the stoic visage of the moon.

90483.Name: Prickly Pair
90483.FlavorText: They grew together, awoke together, and took up arms together. If they were going to fall, they'd do that together too.

90484.Name: Quick Draw
90484.FlavorText: The opening of the Omenpaths awoke the wild magic of Thunder Junction. Settlers dubbed it "thunder" and put it to use in everything from farming tools to deadly weapons.

90486.Name: Reckless Lackey
90486.FlavorText: "First to the fray, first to the pay!"

90487.Name: Resilient Roadrunner
90487.FlavorText:
"Chasing the roadrunner"
—Omenport slang for wasting energy on impossible pursuits

90488.Name: Return the Favor
90488.FlavorText: "Don't you know it's rude not to share?"

90489.Name: Rodeo Pyromancers
90489.FlavorText:
"My citizens throw good money at them, and for what? Cheap tricks and collateral damage. Damnable Slickshot charlatans."
—Baron Bertram Graywater

90490.Name: Scalestorm Summoner
90490.FlavorText: The herd followed him through an Omenpath and found their curiosity rewarded with an untamed world rich with unsuspecting prey.

90491.Name: Scorching Shot
90491.FlavorText: Most outlaws prefer to strike when there are no witnesses. Slickshots prefer as many as possible.

90496.Name: Thunder Salvo
90496.FlavorText: "You said one weapon in the duel. Ain't my fault you forgot to specify size."

90497.Name: Trick Shot
90497.FlavorText:
"Cowerin' behind your buddy ain't gonna help, ya yellow-bellied lowlife."
—Tyron, Slickshot duelist

90499.Name: Ankle Biter
90499.FlavorText:
"Little tip, newcomer. Give your boots a shake in the morning before you put them on."
—Annie Flash, to Kellan

90501.Name: Betrayal at the Vault
90501.FlavorText: The vault cracked open, and the unlikely alliance met the likeliest of ends, as greed, rage, and self-interest won out over any shred of loyalty.

90502.Name: Bristlepack Sentry
90502.FlavorText: As she defends them in their youth, they shall someday defend her in her old age.

90503.Name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
90503.FlavorText: "Wake up, little ones. There's a new day ahead."

90510.Name: Full Steam Ahead
90510.FlavorText: The runaway train tore through the manicured streets of Prosperity, its new conductors reveling in the sheer destruction.

90512.Name: Gold Rush
90512.FlavorText: "Don't believe anyone who tells you to bite it. If it's the real thing, you'll know."

90513.Name: Goldvein Hydra
90513.FlavorText: The key is to slay it before it sprouts so many heads that your fear outpaces your greed.

90514.Name: Hardbristle Bandit
90514.FlavorText: Visitors to the town of Hardbristle found the locals to be quite prickly.

90515.Name: Intrepid Stablemaster
90515.FlavorText: "Never get too cocky. Remember you stay upright only by your mount's good graces."

90516.Name: Map the Frontier
90516.FlavorText: Pioneers with a distaste for crowds and cities are welcomed by the Outcasters, who celebrate solitude and find endless wonder in the natural world.

90518.Name: Outcaster Greenblade
90518.FlavorText: In the shade of his sword, the desert blooms.

90520.Name: Patient Naturalist
90520.FlavorText: The Atiin delight in delving into the unique wonders of each world they visit.

90523.Name: Raucous Entertainer
90523.FlavorText: It's not hard to know the right song for the occasion when most occasions are saloon brawls.

90527.Name: Snakeskin Veil
90527.FlavorText: Most travelers panic when they stumble upon the skin of a giant rattlewurm. Landry saw it as a gift.

90531.Name: Throw from the Saddle
90531.FlavorText:
"A little kindness would've carried you a lot farther than those spurs."
—Miriam, herd whisperer

90533.Name: Tumbleweed Rising
90533.FlavorText: When weeds tumble against the wind, run.

90534.Name: Voracious Varmint
90534.FlavorText:
"A varmint's diet consists of anything it can fit into its mouth and a surprising number of things it can't."
—Doc Aurlock

90535.Name: Akul the Unrepentant
90535.FlavorText: Crackling with rage and stolen thunder, he drives the Hellspurs to ever-greater heights of violence.

90537.Name: Annie Joins Up
90537.FlavorText: One last job, then she could retire in peace.

90540.Name: Badlands Revival
90540.FlavorText: The cactusfolk were a young culture, but they already knew the pains of death and joys of birth.

90541.Name: Baron Bertram Graywater
90541.FlavorText: "Of course the law's on my side. I wrote it."

90544.Name: Bruse Tarl, Roving Rancher
90544.FlavorText: "I find a world where the herds finally listen to me, but now the plants have an attitude?"

90547.Name: Doc Aurlock, Grizzled Genius
90547.FlavorText: "Learning stops only when you close your mind off to wonder."

90548.Name: Eriette, the Beguiler
90548.FlavorText: "Your dreams and mine will soon align."

90550.Name: Form a Posse
90550.FlavorText: The terms were simple: half in advance, half when the entire town belonged to their employer.

90551.Name: Ghired, Mirror of the Wilds
90551.FlavorText: "The Conclave was soft. The Clans were trapped beasts. Here in this untamed wilderness, nature can truly roam free."

90555.Name: Jem Lightfoote, Sky Explorer
90555.FlavorText: The nomadic Atiin rarely settle anywhere for more than a few seasons, but Jem never lets that stop her from seeing every last corner.

90556.Name: Jolene, Plundering Pugilist
90556.FlavorText: "So, are we doing this the easy way or the fun way?"

90559.Name: Kellan, the Kid
90559.FlavorText: "I found out who I was. Now it's time to discover who I am."

90560.Name: Kraum, Violent Cacophony
90560.FlavorText: Concerned for his apprentice's welfare, Ludevic sent his greatest creation to make sure Geralf got into the right kind of trouble.

90564.Name: Make Your Own Luck
90564.FlavorText:
"Aim alone won't win you a duel if you can't keep your nerve."
—Annie Flash

90565.Name: Malcolm, the Eyes
90565.FlavorText: "It's funny how rarely folks here think to look up."

90566.Name: Marchesa, Dealer of Death
90566.FlavorText: "You should have folded when you had the chance."

90567.Name: Miriam, Herd Whisperer
90567.FlavorText: "Anything willing to bear your weight and save your feet a trip across the hot sands deserves respect. Show some."

90575.Name: Ruthless Lawbringer
90575.FlavorText: There's only one law that truly matters to the Sterling Company: never stand in the way of profit.

90576.Name: Satoru, the Infiltrator
90576.FlavorText: "This backwater doesn't have a single wall, ward, or guard that could keep me out."

90579.Name: Slick Sequence
90579.FlavorText: "Shooting first don't mean much if you ain't got proper follow-through."

90580.Name: Taii Wakeen, Perfect Shot
90580.FlavorText: "You'd best keep yourself out of my sights."

90581.Name: Vial Smasher, Gleeful Grenadier
90581.FlavorText: It wasn't quite home, but the fire still burned bright and the bombs still went boom.

90582.Name: Vraska Joins Up
90582.FlavorText: Letting Oko believe he held all the cards provided the perfect cover for her own scheme to unfold.

90585.Name: Wylie Duke, Atiin Hero
90585.FlavorText: "I've seen a fair few worlds in my travels, and there's always some lowlife looking to prey on the innocent. That's where I come in."

90587.Name: Boom Box
90587.FlavorText: The cruel irony of explosives is they're most interesting exactly when you should be running away as fast as you can.

90589.Name: Lavaspur Boots
90589.FlavorText: These boots were made for far more than walking.

90592.Name: Oasis Gardener
90592.FlavorText:
"I think the blasted thing's actually attracting more birds, but all the same, the garden's never looked better."
—Jay Marigold, homesteader

90593.Name: Redrock Sentinel
90593.FlavorText: The miners thought it would be genius to increase their productivity with explosives. The land thought otherwise.

90594.Name: Silver Deputy
90594.FlavorText: It couldn't comprehend the spirit of the law, so the Sterling Company settled for the letter.

90596.Name: Tomb Trawler
90596.FlavorText:
"Dying is common on Thunder Junction. Resting in peace is a much rarer commodity."
—Baron Bertram Graywater

90597.Name: Abraded Bluffs
90597.FlavorText:
"The wind passing through the grooves makes a strange sort of music here."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90599.Name: Bristling Backwoods
90599.FlavorText:
"The cacti have it right. Always carry water."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90600.Name: Conduit Pylons
90600.FlavorText: The newly constructed relays harness the desert sun, bringing power to settlers across the plane.

90601.Name: Creosote Heath
90601.FlavorText:
"The sunsets in Spinegully sure make the soul question why we bother with cities."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90602.Name: Eroded Canyon
90602.FlavorText:
"The water looks like liquid gold. Wonder how many died trying to bottle it."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90603.Name: Festering Gulch
90603.FlavorText:
"Lost a boot in the muck. Get the feeling I'm lucky I got to keep the leg."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90604.Name: Forlorn Flats
90604.FlavorText:
"Should have known that shine on the horizon wasn't water."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90605.Name: Jagged Barrens
90605.FlavorText:
"Tense day of travel. Couldn't shake the feeling those peaks were about to topple."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90606.Name: Lonely Arroyo
90606.FlavorText:
"Barely dodged a stampede yesterday. Took all night for the dust to settle."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90607.Name: Lush Oasis
90607.FlavorText:
"Finally, a stroke of luck! Had to taste the water myself to believe it wasn't a mirage."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90608.Name: Mirage Mesa
90608.FlavorText:
"Out there, death and salvation may lie on either side of the same ridge of sand."
—Ertha Jo, frontier mentor

90609.Name: Sandstorm Verge
90609.FlavorText:
"Ever been caught out in a storm like that? Think of it like drowning, but all the water is knives."
—Annie Flash

90610.Name: Soured Springs
90610.FlavorText:
"Groundwater's tainted here. Best push on before our canteens run out."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

90654.Name: Desertion
90654.FlavorText:
"It is one thing to run away. It is quite another to escape your fate."
—Oko

90655.Name: Morbid Opportunist
90655.FlavorText: "It's downright selfish to die with full pockets."

90656.Name: Port Razer
90656.FlavorText: "We're taking back what's ours. And a little bit of what's yours."

90657.Name: Scapeshift
90657.FlavorText:
"These people come from their cities and think to tame the wilderness. They forget that here, the wilderness has a head start."
—Selvala

90658.Name: Mystic Snake
90658.FlavorText: Travelers who have reached the headwaters of Fool's Fall say that strange serpents dwell in the waters there, though none can recall any more than that.

90659.Name: Notion Thief
90659.FlavorText: "All these childhood memories are getting in the way of the vault codes."

90660.Name: Desert
90660.FlavorText:
"Only a fool goes out there unprepared. If the heat doesn't get you, the time alone with your thoughts likely will."
—Ertha Jo, frontier mentor

90661.Name: Prismatic Vista
90661.FlavorText: When Kellan let his eyes wander to the horizon, he saw a land whose destiny was as uncertain as his own.

90663.Name: Grand Abolisher
90663.FlavorText: "You think because you've mapped the land, you own the land. You own an idea, nothing more."

90673.Name: Legion Extruder
90673.FlavorText: When the vault door opened, ancient war machines rumbled to life.

90675.Name: Molten Duplication
90675.FlavorText: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

90677.Name: Ancient Cornucopia
90677.FlavorText:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!" 
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

90680.Name: Sandstorm Salvager
90680.FlavorText: Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.

90682.Name: Loot, the Key to Everything
90682.FlavorText: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

90683.Name: Pest Control
90683.FlavorText:
"How dare these varmints befoul the shining streets of Prosperity?"
—Baron Bertram Graywater

90688.Name: Torpor Orb
90688.FlavorText:
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you."
—Fomori inscription

90699.Name: Fell the Mighty
90699.FlavorText: Tumblewaggs Migrating on Southern Trail—Stampedes Expected

90700.Name: Fierce Retribution
90700.FlavorText: Ambush Justified? Holes in Story, Sheriff Unresolved

90701.Name: Journey to Nowhere
90701.FlavorText: Barkeep Reports Theft of Bottle—Customers Report Theft of Barkeep

90705.Name: Archive Trap
90705.FlavorText: Heist Shocker! Supposedly Invincible Vault Vinced!

90707.Name: Commandeer
90707.FlavorText: Off the Rails? Serial Train Robber Strikes Again!

90708.Name: Essence Capture
90708.FlavorText: Might or Magic? Recent Clash Fuels Debate

90709.Name: Mana Drain
90709.FlavorText: Fighting Fire with Fire Ineffective, Reports Flammable Wizard

90712.Name: Heartless Pillage
90712.FlavorText: Homesteader Robbed for Third Time This Week

90714.Name: Murder
90714.FlavorText: Champion of Justice Just Iced—Killer on the Loose!

90715.Name: Overwhelming Forces
90715.FlavorText: Town Takeover! Sterling Company Expands Territory Again

90716.Name: Reanimate
90716.FlavorText: Local Man Defies Death, Morticians Mortified!

90718.Name: Thoughtseize
90718.FlavorText: Billy, please don't forget to add the headline before sending for publication again. —Clara

90720.Name: Crackle with Power
90720.FlavorText: "Quint-Blaster" Inventor Promises Five Times the Fun

90721.Name: Electrodominance
90721.FlavorText: Where There's Thunder, There's Lightning—Blaster Disaster Vaporizes Safety Inspector!

90722.Name: Fling
90722.FlavorText: Notorious Hellspur Comes Out Ahead in Violent Conflict

90724.Name: Skewer the Critics
90724.FlavorText: Maligned Thespian Stares, Hurls Daggers at Disparaging Audience

90725.Name: Skullcrack
90725.FlavorText: Sterling Enforcer Can't Stand Heat, or at All

90726.Name: Clear Shot
90726.FlavorText: Crack Shot Snipes First Prize in Omenport's "Thunder Trial"

90727.Name: Force of Vigor
90727.FlavorText: General Store Faces Thorny Problems, Spiking Prices

90728.Name: Pest Infestation
90728.FlavorText: Pest Problem Plagues Eatery—"Never Thought I'd Miss the Rats," Owner Laments

90732.Name: Abrupt Decay
90732.FlavorText: Local Purveyor Honest Rutstein Clarifies, Strengthens "No Refunds" Policy

90733.Name: Anguished Unmaking
90733.FlavorText: Somber Day in Omenport as Another Hero Laid to Rest

90735.Name: Bedevil
90735.FlavorText: Hellspurs Unleash Newest Members on Unsuspecting Town!

90740.Name: Cruel Ultimatum
90740.FlavorText: Rage on the Omenport Express! Cramped Dragon Takes Matter into Own Claws

90741.Name: Decimate
90741.FlavorText: Tragedy Strikes! And Again! And Again! And Again!

90742.Name: Decisive Denial
90742.FlavorText: Bear Dismayed to Discover Food Chain Keeps Going

90745.Name: Fractured Identity
90745.FlavorText: Reality Breach Engulfs Town—All Four Mayors Urge Caution

90746.Name: Hindering Light
90746.FlavorText: Hats Off! Quick-Thinking Sterling Merc Puts a Cap on Surprise Attack

90747.Name: Humiliate
90747.FlavorText: Onlookers Delighted as Sterling Agent Brought Low

90748.Name: Hypothesizzle
90748.FlavorText: Science Outbreak Spreads—Officials Recommend Avoiding Books

90749.Name: Ionize
90749.FlavorText: Backfire Bummer! Sizzling Slinger Singes Slickshot

90753.Name: Savage Smash
90753.FlavorText: Rolling Thunder! Angry Armadillo Assaults Architecture

90755.Name: Terminal Agony
90755.FlavorText: Akul Disposes of Would-Be Usurper—Sheriff Tries to Put Pieces Together

90757.Name: Vanishing Verse
90757.FlavorText: Killer New Act Haunts Local Haunt

90758.Name: Villainous Wealth
90758.FlavorText: Some Robber Barons Get Just Desserts, Others Just Deserted

90759.Name: Void Rend
90759.FlavorText: Stagecoach Encounters One More Magical Vortex than Expected

90760.Name: Voidslime
90760.FlavorText: Slimy Service at Saloon Sends Scamp Scrambling

90762.Name: Grindstone
90762.FlavorText: Tarnation Weaponsmith Enters Third Month of Sharpening: "It's Almost Ready"

90763.Name: Mindslaver
90763.FlavorText: Invention Heralded as Revolutionary—Reviewer Gives Million-Star Rating

90765.Name: Dust Bowl
90765.FlavorText: Dust Has No Time to Settle as New Dust Arrives

90799.Name: Flusterstorm
90799.FlavorText: "You said you'd hit me with everything you have. Was that all?"

90800.Name: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah
90800.FlavorText: His pride denied him; his brother did not.

90802.Name: Razorgrass Ambush
90802.FlavorText: When disturbed, razorgrass skewers unwary intruders in violent, jingling bursts.

90803.Name: Razorgrass Field
90803.FlavorText: Leonin hide their dwellings within the Razor Fields, making approach deadly without knowledge of their secret paths.

90804.Name: Witch Enchanter
90804.FlavorText: Shilgengar's famine once starved Stensia into embracing vampirism. The Dawnhart Coven would not let the same happen to Kessig.

90805.Name: Witch-Blessed Meadow
90805.FlavorText:
"Ghrin-Danu will not let her people go hungry."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

90806.Name: Hydroelectric Specimen
90806.FlavorText: Whenever the research team stepped out, the specimen emerged to conduct experiments of its own.

90807.Name: Hydroelectric Laboratory
90807.FlavorText: As long as the scientists were present, the specimen floated patiently or swam quietly about, biding its time, watching.

90808.Name: Sink into Stupor
90808.FlavorText: The kami help travelers find profound relief, by freeing them from their mortal concerns.

90809.Name: Soporific Springs
90809.FlavorText: Desperate travelers journey from across Kamigawa, drawn by rumors of relief from all their troubles.

90812.Name: Boggart Trawler
90812.FlavorText: "Look what I found, and it's only been dead for a week!"

90813.Name: Boggart Bog
90813.FlavorText: A boggart warren is usually located in a place rich with sensations . . . good and bad.

90814.Name: Fell the Profane
90814.FlavorText:
"I can think of no fate more fitting for one so foul as you."
—Aryel, knight of Windgrace

90815.Name: Fell Mire
90815.FlavorText:
"The Nethermire is all the salvation you deserve."
—Aryel, knight of Windgrace

90818.Name: Pinnacle Monk
90818.FlavorText: Narset brought the Jeskai djinn ancient wisdom and the promise to challenge the status quo.

90819.Name: Mystic Peak
90819.FlavorText:
"Fear not the fall. Fear never reaching the pinnacle."
—Narset

90822.Name: Sundering Eruption
90822.FlavorText:
"Idea: Climbing boots also balanced for running."
—Expedition journal entry, very scorched

90823.Name: Volcanic Fissure
90823.FlavorText: Even the most seasoned adventurers think twice before testing their fortunes on the volcanic teeth of Akoum.

90824.Name: Bridgeworks Battle
90824.FlavorText:
"I thought trolls were supposed to be under bridges!"
—Nelvin, Vantress squire

90825.Name: Tanglespan Bridgeworks
90825.FlavorText: The chasm formed during the Phyrexian Invasion quickly filled with new life.

90826.Name: Disciple of Freyalise
90826.FlavorText: "Freyalise is gone, but her song lives on."

90827.Name: Garden of Freyalise
90827.FlavorText: The Juniper Order safeguards secret places that still thrum with traces of Freyalise's life-giving magic.

90831.Name: Sanguine Morass
90831.FlavorText: All who enter the bog despair, for the first thing it steals is hope.

90832.Name: Drowner of Truth
90832.FlavorText:
"Mangeni's children take their places among us."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

90833.Name: Drowned Jungle
90833.FlavorText:
"Eldrazi scour the world of impurity so that we, the faithful, will inherit paradise."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

90834.Name: Glasswing Grace
90834.FlavorText: Serra may be long gone, but Benalia's faithful still draw strength from her blessings.

90835.Name: Age-Graced Chapel
90835.FlavorText:
"Empires fall, cities crumble, righteousness remains."
—Chapel inscription

90836.Name: Legion Leadership
90836.FlavorText:
"The firemane angels are mighty, but their greatest value lies in the fervor their presence kindles in the heart of a soldier."
—Agrus Kos

90837.Name: Legion Stronghold
90837.FlavorText: Boros fortresses bristle with high towers so that, even at rest, Legion soldiers can remain in the light of the sun.

90838.Name: Revitalizing Repast
90838.FlavorText:
"Today, we feast! Tomorrow, we fight! Then, we feast again!"
—Harald, king of Skemfar

90839.Name: Old-Growth Grove
90839.FlavorText: The most potent elvish tonics and potions are brewed from the trees containing their imprisoned gods, the Einir.

90840.Name: Rush of Inspiration
90840.FlavorText:
"Insight is like a waterfall—near-limitless power, but only if properly harnessed."
—Saheeli Rai

90841.Name: Crackling Falls
90841.FlavorText: In the wilds beyond Ghirapur, raw magical energy permeates the landscape.

90842.Name: Strength of the Harvest
90842.FlavorText: The Kelema Veil flows through Setessa, allowing Karametra's faithful followers direct access to her wisdom and power.

90843.Name: Haven of the Harvest
90843.FlavorText:
"For us, a temple is a part of nature, not something we impose upon it."
—Sythis, Harvest's Hand

90844.Name: Stump Stomp
90844.FlavorText:
"Don't be a superstitious coward. What's a tree going to do, slowly fall on us?"
—Sebastian the Logger

90845.Name: Burnwillow Clearing
90845.FlavorText: The loggers never questioned why the last crew had abandoned camp.

90846.Name: Suppression Ray
90846.FlavorText: The Consulate's aether spotlights have a setting to incapacitate trespassers on contact.

90847.Name: Orderly Plaza
90847.FlavorText:
"Chaos fuels the flames of violence. Only through order can peace be assured."
—Dovin Baan

90848.Name: Waterlogged Teachings
90848.FlavorText: The long-dead librarians are still on hand to recommend selected titles.

90849.Name: Inundated Archive
90849.FlavorText: Moldering tomes line rotting shelves. Generations of priceless knowledge fade from memory beneath the waves.

90850.Name: Breaker of Creation
90850.FlavorText: The shackles of reality were stifling. It would unmake all that had bound it.

90852.Name: Drownyard Lurker
90852.FlavorText: When Emrakul arrived on Innistrad, even fossils answered her twisted call.

90858.Name: It That Heralds the End
90858.FlavorText:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander

90861.Name: Null Elemental Blast
90861.FlavorText:
"Despite my years, I am still but a student of the Multiverse. How arrogant to think yourself its master."
—Ugin, to Nicol Bolas

90865.Name: Warped Tusker
90865.FlavorText: Once, foraging for truffles, the very average boar fell asleep beneath the moon . . . .

90867.Name: Aerie Auxiliary
90867.FlavorText: The hordechief's ground tactics were unsurpassed. If only he'd thought to watch the skies.

90873.Name: Essence Reliquary
90873.FlavorText:
"It safeguards the greatest treasure of all: our memories of those most precious to us."
—Elspeth

90875.Name: Flare of Fortitude
90875.FlavorText: "I call upon a power greater than myself."

90883.Name: Mandibular Kite
90883.FlavorText: The Machine Orthodoxy finds skin impure, and will not sully their creations with impure material.

90884.Name: Metastatic Evangel
90884.FlavorText: "I am no sleeper agent. I am a liberator. It is you who are asleep."

90892.Name: Solstice Zealot
90892.FlavorText: "Embrace the light, or succumb to the shadows."

90896.Name: White Orchid Phantom
90896.FlavorText: His oath required no service beyond death, but his honor demanded it.

90897.Name: Wing It
90897.FlavorText: After a moment's confusion, the otter splashed through clouds and gamboled in the wind, delighting in its newfound freedom.

90898.Name: Wrath of the Skies
90898.FlavorText: Even the weather of Dominaria shifts to assail would-be invaders.

90899.Name: Aether Spike
90899.FlavorText:
"The shield doesn't block the fire physically. It tells the fire to stop."
—Genku, future shaper

90902.Name: Brainsurge
90902.FlavorText: In the Cosmos, secrets swirl and spark like windborne embers, and only Alrund can capture them.

90903.Name: Consign to Memory
90903.FlavorText: He wept not for what was, but what could never be.

90904.Name: Copycrook
90904.FlavorText: The best hiding places are other people.

90905.Name: Corrupted Shapeshifter
90905.FlavorText: Within its body, three lineages warred for supremacy.

90906.Name: Deem Inferior
90906.FlavorText: Forced to behold such a pitiful demonstration of scholarship, Archmage Jeven could hold his tongue no longer.

90910.Name: Emrakul's Messenger
90910.FlavorText: "Obey her will! Don't be a fool! Submit your mind to Emrakul!"

90911.Name: Flare of Denial
90911.FlavorText: "I see where you're going with that, and I don't like it."

90912.Name: Harbinger of the Seas
90912.FlavorText: The rising moon calls mercilessly to the waves, commanding the sea to rise high enough to devour mountains.

90916.Name: Roil Cartographer
90916.FlavorText: "The world shifts constantly, but that doesn't mean it can't be mapped. Our maps must shift as well."

90917.Name: Sage of the Unknowable
90917.FlavorText: "Someday, we will walk the Blind Eternities and see the truths that lie beyond the stifling veil of reality."

90918.Name: Serum Visionary
90918.FlavorText: "Pre-criminal notions detected in the Sixth Precinct. The suspect will confess when arrested in two hours."

90919.Name: Shadow of the Second Sun
90919.FlavorText: Live fully, then return to the beginning.

90920.Name: Strix Serenade
90920.FlavorText: Some birds sing to nature's beauty and the freedom of the skies. Others simply ask questions.

90922.Name: Tempest Harvester
90922.FlavorText: "The Golden City was a trinket compared to the power that lies beneath the waves."

90924.Name: Tune the Narrative
90924.FlavorText: "The kami whisper of other worlds, brimming with stories untold. It would take a lifetime to learn them. A lifetime well spent."

90926.Name: Unfathomable Truths
90926.FlavorText:
"Maybe we are all just figments of Kozilek's imagination."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

90927.Name: Utter Insignificance
90927.FlavorText: "I used to think my life was meaningless. Now I know for certain."

90929.Name: Accursed Marauder
90929.FlavorText: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.

90931.Name: Breathe Your Last
90931.FlavorText:
"Bodies are so much more cooperative with the soul out of the way."
—Liliana

90933.Name: Consuming Corruption
90933.FlavorText: While crossing the mire, Lort the Sneaky found the perfect shortcut to the end of his life.

90937.Name: Dreamdrinker Vampire
90937.FlavorText: The dream she tastes will be your last.

90940.Name: Etched Slith
90940.FlavorText: The inherently adaptive bodies of the slith made them coveted subjects for compleation.

90942.Name: Eviscerator's Insight
90942.FlavorText: "We're all just the sum of our parts."

90943.Name: Fetid Gargantua
90943.FlavorText:
When the night comes knocking
—Kessig expression meaning "in dire times"

90944.Name: Flare of Malice
90944.FlavorText: "Suffer as I have suffered. Lose as I have lost."

90947.Name: Kami of Jealous Thirst
90947.FlavorText: The bustle of life in Towashi opened up new avenues for less benevolent kami.

90949.Name: Marionette Apprentice
90949.FlavorText: "Ah! Yes! I got its leg to twitch!"

90954.Name: Refurbished Familiar
90954.FlavorText: When her beloved pet died, the artificer turned to necromancy.

90955.Name: Retrofitted Transmogrant
90955.FlavorText:
"Repair it again! I need reinforcements by tomorrow."
—Ashnod

90956.Name: Ripples of Undeath
90956.FlavorText: As the monster lay dying, it stared into the eyes of the human who slew it. Decades later, it has yet to break its gaze.

90957.Name: Scurrilous Sentry
90957.FlavorText: Queen Marchesa's agents always manage to find the exact evidence they're looking for.

90959.Name: Warren Soultrader
90959.FlavorText: "The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."

90960.Name: Wither and Bloom
90960.FlavorText:
"Death itself is nothing to cry about. The real tragedy is letting a death go to waste."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

90961.Name: Wurmcoil Larva
90961.FlavorText: Even a scrap of Phyrexian machinery can be lethal.

90967.Name: Fanged Flames
90967.FlavorText: With Dorble's natural immunity to venom, he'd always taken certain comfort in the knowledge that he wouldn't die of snakebite.

90968.Name: Flare of Duplication
90968.FlavorText: "Decent. But let me show you what mastery looks like."

90969.Name: Frogmyr Enforcer
90969.FlavorText: Laws of nature on Mirrodin are always malleable.

90970.Name: Frogmyr Enforcer
90970.FlavorText: Laws of nature on Mirrodin are always malleable.

90971.Name: Furnace Hellkite
90971.FlavorText: Some mornings it wakes up determined to consume the red sun itself.

90972.Name: Galvanic Discharge
90972.FlavorText:
"Remember, if you find a rock making crackly noises, just put it back. Carefully."
—Bo, Great Desert prospector

90973.Name: Ghostfire Slice
90973.FlavorText: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it won't hurt.

90974.Name: Glimpse the Impossible
90974.FlavorText: Gisela beheld true divinity, and was humbled.

90975.Name: Infernal Captor
90975.FlavorText: Possession is nine-tenths of the law. His fist is the other tenth.

90977.Name: Mogg Mob
90977.FlavorText: There was absolutely nothing suspicious about three moggs carrying barrels of explosives—or so they told everyone who would listen.

90980.Name: Phyrexian Ironworks
90980.FlavorText:
"We have made a friend today."
—Slobad, Iron Goblin

90981.Name: Powerbalance
90981.FlavorText: For every action, a reaction. For every force, a firestorm.

90984.Name: Reiterating Bolt
90984.FlavorText: "Eureka! Now to show those fools at the Academy how easily I can replicate these results!"

90985.Name: Sarpadian Simulacrum
90985.FlavorText: Built to be super soldiers, the goblins preferred just being super destructive.

90987.Name: Skittering Precursor
90987.FlavorText: It pushes ahead, eliminating lookouts and tactically sowing spawn.

90991.Name: Thriving Skyclaw
90991.FlavorText: As wild as unbound aether, and just as dangerous.

90994.Name: Wheel of Potential
90994.FlavorText: The wheel only has one sure output: chaos.

90998.Name: Colossal Dreadmask
90998.FlavorText: No legs to quake, no lungs to bellow, but if you see its teeth, it's still too late.

91000.Name: Eldrazi Repurposer
91000.FlavorText:
"I almost admire their ability to avoid waste. Almost."
—General Tazri, allied commander

91001.Name: Evolution Witness
91001.FlavorText: She remembers every breakthrough, from the gene's mutation to the new life's propagation.

91005.Name: Fowl Strike
91005.FlavorText: With a resounding wallop, the ancient battle between buzzard and druid was finally finished.

91006.Name: Gift of the Viper
91006.FlavorText: Ohran mages willingly endure the bites of vipers, believing the snakes bestow great power on those who survive their venom.

91007.Name: Horrific Assault
91007.FlavorText: With shifting forms and no angel to pray to, Innistrad's werewolves were especially susceptible to Emrakul's influence.

91011.Name: Malevolent Rumble
91011.FlavorText: What emerged from Turntimber was even more twisted than the forest itself.

91013.Name: Nightshade Dryad
91013.FlavorText: "Death is a natural part of life. Without the mulch to feed new sprouts, everything withers."

91016.Name: Primal Prayers
91016.FlavorText: When Gaea speaks, all of nature falls silent.

91018.Name: Signature Slam
91018.FlavorText: A lone dinosaur in gorilla territory doesn't stand a chance.

91022.Name: Temperamental Oozewagg
91022.FlavorText: Its position on the food chain causes great confusion in everyone from hunters to other monsters.

91025.Name: Trickster's Elk
91025.FlavorText:
"Wait. Is that one Dad?"
—Rowan Kenrith, to Will

91026.Name: Wumpus Aberration
91026.FlavorText: All who behold its twisted form are consumed by a single-minded obsession: destroy it.

91027.Name: Abstruse Appropriation
91027.FlavorText:
"Kozilek experiences reality on his own terms."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

91029.Name: Conduit Goblin
91029.FlavorText: Warned against wearing metal in a lightning storm, Smurt took it as a challenge.

91030.Name: Cranial Ram
91030.FlavorText: To ensure proper fit, the mandibles can be inserted directly into the ears.

91034.Name: Expanding Ooze
91034.FlavorText:
"It eats the royal garbage. Of course it's growing!"
—Prince Bolbuss

91035.Name: Faithful Watchdog
91035.FlavorText: Though its official designation was Third Battalion Patrol Hound 7, the soldiers dubbed their new companion Lord Fancy-Paws.

91038.Name: Horrid Shadowspinner
91038.FlavorText:
"The daylight's done, the nightmare's spun.
It crawls off the loom, and into your room."
—Kithkin children's rhyme

91040.Name: Invert Polarity
91040.FlavorText:
"Skreeg! I thought I told you to stop messing with . . . Oh, that worked. Good job, Skreeg."
—Ral Zarek

91041.Name: Izzet Generatorium
91041.FlavorText: Hard hats are required. Shock-resistant coveralls aren't, but are highly recommended.

91042.Name: Kudo, King Among Bears
91042.FlavorText: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.

91049.Name: Planar Genesis
91049.FlavorText: Out of nothing, something was born.

91050.Name: Psychic Frog
91050.FlavorText: Some frogs poison the body. Some frogs poison the mind.

91051.Name: Pyretic Rebirth
91051.FlavorText: Death has never kept Darigaaz down for long.

91054.Name: Scurry of Gremlins
91054.FlavorText: A whiff of aether brings the horde out of hiding.

91055.Name: Snapping Voidcraw
91055.FlavorText: Once considered a delicacy, turtle soup is no longer served in Nephalia's inns.

91056.Name: Sneaky Snacker
91056.FlavorText: Though the High Fae gave explicit instructions not to tarry, she stayed in Sweettooth Village for seconds, thirds, and then dessert.

91057.Name: Titans' Vanguard
91057.FlavorText: With a shriek, it directed the spawn toward the temple where the refugees sheltered.

91058.Name: Wight of the Reliquary
91058.FlavorText: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.

91063.Name: Vexing Bauble
91063.FlavorText: No one knew who invented it. No one knew its purpose. All anyone knew was they didn't like being anywhere near it.

91064.Name: Winter Moon
91064.FlavorText:
"The sun and moon have decided to make a competition of our misery."
—Naromin, veteran explorer

91067.Name: Bloodstained Mire
91067.FlavorText: A graveyard for conquerors and conquered alike.

91071.Name: Flooded Strand
91071.FlavorText: Once a prosperous Vantress town, now swept clean and reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.

91075.Name: Polluted Delta
91075.FlavorText: A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.

91085.Name: Urza's Cave
91085.FlavorText: No matter how deep Urza delved, he couldn't escape his regrets.

91086.Name: Windswept Heath
91086.FlavorText: An underground paradise, bright and thriving beneath the surface of Ixalan.

91087.Name: Wooded Foothills
91087.FlavorText: Home and hunting ground for Kaldheim's fearsome trolls.

91092.Name: Recruiter of the Guard
91092.FlavorText: "The kingdom is in peril! Who among you is brave enough to defend it?"

91094.Name: Deep Analysis
91094.FlavorText: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"

91095.Name: Estrid's Invocation
91095.FlavorText: Enchanters add layer upon layer of complexity to the world around them.

91098.Name: Shrieking Drake
91098.FlavorText:
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi

91099.Name: Buried Alive
91099.FlavorText: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

91101.Name: Nadier's Nightblade
91101.FlavorText: Checking around every corner doesn't help if you forget to look up.

91102.Name: Ophiomancer
91102.FlavorText:
"There are dark, ancient arts that fascinate even me."
—Sorin Markov

91103.Name: Toxic Deluge
91103.FlavorText:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

91104.Name: Victimize
91104.FlavorText:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

91108.Name: Meltdown
91108.FlavorText: Catastrophes happened so often at the mana rig that the viashino language had a special word to describe them.

91111.Name: Branching Evolution
91111.FlavorText: As Aclazotz's undead forces approached the temple of Ojer Kaslem, they met a roaring wall of vibrant, flourishing life.

91112.Name: Priest of Titania
91112.FlavorText: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

91113.Name: Sylvan Safekeeper
91113.FlavorText:
"He has been to the heart of the wood. Did you truly expect to wield power over him?"
—Oakhide druid

91116.Name: Kaalia of the Vast
91116.FlavorText: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.

91117.Name: Emerald Medallion
91117.FlavorText: It is a sun-dappled glade in the morning, the aroma of spring's first blossoms, and the melody of birds chirping in a joyful chorus. It is life.

91118.Name: Jet Medallion
91118.FlavorText: It is the imposing heft of a ruler's scepter, the stench of death after a victory in battle, and the mournful wail of an enemy kneeling in supplication. It is power.

91120.Name: Pearl Medallion
91120.FlavorText: It is a helping hand reaching out to the downtrodden, the acrid-sweet tang of burning incense during prayer, and the harmony of voices uplifted in unison. It is faith.

91121.Name: Ruby Medallion
91121.FlavorText: It is the warm glow of the setting sun at journey's end, the scent of the evening meal crackling over a fire, and the cacophony of a raucous song shared over tankards of mead. It is freedom.

91122.Name: Sapphire Medallion
91122.FlavorText: It is the glimpse of a new horizon beyond the hills, the briny taste of salt spray off a ship's hull, and the whisper of pages turning in a new book. It is discovery.

91123.Name: Urza's Incubator
91123.FlavorText:
"Our recruitment drives are bringing in fewer fresh troops every day. We need a new strategy."
—Urza, to Tawnos

91124.Name: Worn Powerstone
91124.FlavorText: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

91127.Name: Deserted Temple
91127.FlavorText: A monument to long-forgotten gods, it stands as a tribute to the fleeting nature of human ways.

91128.Name: Nesting Grounds
91128.FlavorText: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

91129.Name: Phyrexian Tower
91129.FlavorText:
"A cursed silhouette to look upon. Even if the halls stand empty, its vile shadows blight the land. I shudder to think of the evils that it held."
—Koth

91159.Name: Clue
91159.RawFrameDetail: A noncreature token, has text box

91169.Name: Thought-Knot Seer
91169.FlavorText: Its gaze gifts you with knowledge no mortal mind should possess.

91170.Name: Prismatic Ending
91170.FlavorText: Sagas sing of realms long forgotten, shattered by doomskars and cleaved violently from the World Tree.

91171.Name: Dismember
91171.FlavorText:
"No one has heard Drivnod speak. But we have seen him do unspeakable things. As he drifts over Ish Sah, a deathly whisper rides the wind. I can never watch for long—I turn away and hide."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

91172.Name: Persist
91172.FlavorText:
"I paid a price to one I will not name to escape the abyss. A bit of my soul for a second chance. And I'd do it again, and again—until I had no soul left to trade."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist

91173.Name: Expressive Iteration
91173.FlavorText: "Art exposes truth. Each step of my dance brings me closer to the secrets of the universe."

91187.Name: Wojek Investigator
91187.FlavorText: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know . . ."

91189.Name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
91189.FlavorText: Charismatic and well connected. Knows their worth and charges accordingly.

91190.Name: Doorkeeper Thrull
91190.FlavorText: No help. Answered questions with a mix of hissing and drool.

91191.Name: Neighborhood Guardian
91191.FlavorText: Currently defines its neighborhood as all of Districts Eight and Nine, extending lately into parts of the Tenth.

91192.Name: Wojek Investigator
91192.FlavorText: A great boon to have an angel on hand, but highly suspect she reports information to Aurelia before us.

91193.Name: Conspiracy Unraveler
91193.FlavorText: Invariably reaches the correct conclusion. Cannot be rushed.

91195.Name: Homicide Investigator
91195.FlavorText: Investigative skills: impeccable. People skills: lacking.

91198.Name: Vein Ripper
91198.FlavorText: Identity unknown. Body count unknown but potentially in the dozens.

91203.Name: Culvert Ambusher
91203.FlavorText: Just let the Golgari deal with it.

91210.Name: Curious Cadaver
91210.FlavorText: Patient and surprisingly clever, though he does need to be reminded not to eat the corpses.

91215.Name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
91215.FlavorText: Owner and star of Hellbender. A trendsetter in both fashion and violence.

91216.Name: Kraul Whipcracker
91216.FlavorText: Do not approach. Stay a safe distance away, and then take five more steps back.

91219.Name: Meddling Youths
91219.FlavorText: Chaotic, but surprisingly fearless. Often seen in the company of a strangely intelligent hound.

91221.Name: Rakdos, Patron of Chaos
91221.FlavorText: An actual signatory of the original Guildpact. Over 10,000 years old, but doesn't look a day over 2,500.
