91227.Name: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

91228.Name: Magnetic Snuffler
91228.FlavorText: Kylox's most advanced detector yet. Don't let it near your keys.

91250.Name: Assemble the Players
91250.FlavorText:
"One of these people is the mastermind. I wonder, do they still believe they won't be caught?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91251.Name: Auspicious Arrival
91251.FlavorText:
"The Azorius are too obsessed with facts to see the truth that knits them together. They'll never solve this case unless I step in."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91252.Name: Call a Surprise Witness
91252.FlavorText:
"Honestly, the real surprise would be if a powerful member of the Orzhov didn't hang around after their demise."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91253.Name: Makeshift Binding
91253.FlavorText:
"With the treacherous Oba separated from her sisters, I'm hopeful that Trostani will, in some form, eventually recover."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91254.Name: Not on My Watch
91254.FlavorText:
"It's not so bad working with Etrata. She's taciturn, and she has saved my life twice today."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91255.Name: On the Job
91255.FlavorText:
"The Agency's detectives will eliminate the false leads. I will find the truth."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91256.Name: Deduce
91256.FlavorText:
"Of course! It was all so obvious. I should have made the connection days ago."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91260.Name: Reenact the Crime
91260.FlavorText:
"As I suspected, Kylox had prepared a secret exit. But the question remains: Did he escape his assailants or was he taken against his will?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91261.Name: Unauthorized Exit
91261.FlavorText:
"The Azorius will be annoyed with me for breaking out their star suspect, but what else is new."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91262.Name: It Doesn't Add Up
91262.FlavorText:
"Etrata claims she has no memory of committing the murder. Somehow, I believe she's telling the truth."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91263.Name: Murder
91263.FlavorText:
"The manner of death, the way the body was displayed, the carefully arranged guild emblems . . . someone is trying to send a message."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91264.Name: Slice from the Shadows
91264.FlavorText:
"Something about Massacre Girl's brazen attack doesn't make sense. Why would the Cult of Rakdos be involved at all?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91267.Name: The Chase Is On
91267.FlavorText:
"If she's innocent, as she so vehemently claims, why did she run?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91269.Name: Demand Answers
91269.FlavorText:
"I suppose, from Aurelia's perspective, she was being generous by giving us one entire day to solve the most complex case in Ravnican history."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91272.Name: Audience with Trostani
91272.FlavorText:
"More bizarre metaphors about rot and renewal. Wildly unhelpful."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91273.Name: Fanatical Strength
91273.FlavorText:
"Kaya and Kellan were attacked today! This is excellent news. Clearly we are on the trail of the true killer."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91274.Name: Coerced to Kill
91274.FlavorText:
"Mind control—anyone could be a threat!"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91275.Name: Deadly Complication
91275.FlavorText:
"Etrata was in custody long before Teysa was killed. It's impossible that she could be the culprit."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91277.Name: Officious Interrogation
91277.FlavorText:
"Oh gods, here come the verity circles. Do the Azorius ever tire of them?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91278.Name: Warleader's Call
91278.FlavorText:
"I fear a war between the guilds is exactly what our killer wants. Who could stand to benefit from such destruction?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91279.Name: Worldsoul's Rage
91279.FlavorText:
"Oba fought Realmbreaker's corruption alone, hiding her pain even from her sisters. Even after everything she's done, I can't hate her. I pity her."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

91314.Name: Human
91314.RawFrameDetail: W token, no text box, Beyond

91336.Name: A-Llanowar Loamspeaker
91336.FlavorText: Twigs broken underfoot in Llanowar tend to return the favor.

91338.Name: A-Sunbathing Rootwalla
91338.FlavorText: A rootwalla's prey includes anything or anyone that wanders into view.

91340.Name: A-Zar Ojanen, Scion of Efrava
91340.FlavorText: "I carry my home in my heart."

91343.Name: A-Meria's Outrider
91343.FlavorText: Arrows fashioned from the living wood of Yavimaya carry all of the forest's rage in their fire-hardened points.

91352.Name: A-Radha, Coalition Warlord
91352.FlavorText: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

91356.Name: A-Briar Hydra
91356.FlavorText: Flora and fauna alike rose to Yavimaya's defense.

91359.Name: A-Excavation Explosion
91359.FlavorText: Urza's engineers could take weeks to dig out a powerstone. The goblins weren't so painstaking.

91360.Name: A-Splitting the Powerstone
91360.FlavorText: As the glowing stone broke apart, so too did the last shred of the brothers' bond.

91361.Name: A-Hall of Tagsin
91361.FlavorText: The Thran's machines were not dead after all, merely dormant . . . and waiting.

91367.Name: A-Mishra, Excavation Prodigy
91367.FlavorText: While Urza read books, Mishra learned to read the desert itself.

91371.Name: A-Radha, Coalition Warlord
91371.FlavorText:
"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons."
—Grand Warlord Radha

91372.Name: A-Radha, Coalition Warlord
91372.FlavorText: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

91377.Name: Scrutiny of the Guildpact
91377.FlavorText: The Chamber of the Guildpact could be rebuilt, but faith in the guilds would not be restored so easily.

91380.Name: Construction Arsonist
91380.FlavorText: What started as an attempt to burn incriminating evidence soon became a passion project.

91383.Name: Guildpact Greenwalker
91383.FlavorText: It guards the incomplete halls of the new Chamber of the Guildpact.

91384.Name: Thought-String Analyst
91384.FlavorText: "What a confusing tangle of paradigms and perceptions! Our perpetrator may be acting under duress."

91385.Name: Shove Aside
91385.FlavorText: "Out of the way! I'm not letting the other detectives snatch up all the good clues!"

91386.Name: Relics of the Rubblebelt
91386.FlavorText: The Gruul agreed to let the archaeologists examine the ruins if they agreed to put all the destruction right back where they found it.

91387.Name: Emmara, Voice of the Conclave
91387.FlavorText: "While Trostani heals, someone must guide the way."

91388.Name: Izzet Polarizer
91388.FlavorText:
"The experiment went off without a hitch—only one casualty!"
—Zibens, Izzet record-keeper

91389.Name: Tajic, Legion's Valor
91389.FlavorText: "To arms! The unyielding resolve of the Legion will win this day!"

91390.Name: Roalesk, Prime Specimen
91390.FlavorText: His body is the laboratory where his greatest innovations come to life.

91391.Name: Spotlight Falcon
91391.FlavorText:
"It's the newest model—10 percent lighter and 20 percent more expensive!"
—Kylox

91393.Name: Sleuth Instructor
91393.FlavorText: "A bit more vivid than the textbooks, eh?"

91395.Name: Emporium Thopterist
91395.FlavorText: "All my machines come with a lifetime warranty! With exceptions, of course, for intentional crash, user error, and ghosts."

91396.Name: Excogitator Sphinx
91396.FlavorText: She weaves overlooked strands of detail into a tapestry of truth.

91398.Name: Perforator Crocodile
91398.FlavorText: The tag on its toe read "deceased." It vehemently disagreed.

91399.Name: Cackling Observer
91399.FlavorText: Aspiring Hellbender performers often seek inspiration for their acts from particularly grisly crime scenes.

91400.Name: Concert Kaboomist
91400.FlavorText: On special occasions, the Hellbender orchestra will cap off their performance with a virtuoso bomb solo.

91401.Name: Sproutwatch Dryad
91401.FlavorText: "The Conclave is much like a root system—branching, yet unified. See the connections, and you can tap into their power."

91403.Name: Rampaging Ursaguana
91403.FlavorText: At this point, mutant rampages are proactively factored into every Simic research project's timeline.

91404.Name: Veko, Death's Doorkeeper
91404.FlavorText: "Though you may have expired, your use to me has not."

91406.Name: Furgul, Quag Nurturer
91406.FlavorText:
Golgari leechbreeders have cultivated over a
hundred different species of leeches, even though they were repeatedly asked not to.

91411.Name: Ornithopter
91411.FlavorText: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

91414.Name: Simic Signet
91414.FlavorText: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

91415.Name: Golgari Signet
91415.FlavorText: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

91416.Name: Orzhov Signet
91416.FlavorText: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

91417.Name: Selesnya Signet
91417.FlavorText: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

91418.Name: Gruul Signet
91418.FlavorText: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

91419.Name: Izzet Signet
91419.FlavorText: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

91420.Name: Rakdos Signet
91420.FlavorText: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

91421.Name: Dimir Signet
91421.FlavorText: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

91422.Name: Boros Signet
91422.FlavorText:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

91423.Name: Azorius Signet
91423.FlavorText: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

91424.Name: Overwhelm
91424.FlavorText: "Let the song of Selesnya be heard above the rhythm of our thundering hordes!"

91429.Name: March of the Multitudes
91429.FlavorText: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."

91432.Name: Ionize
91432.FlavorText: "Countermagic is a simple process of breaking matter into its elementary particles."

91433.Name: Electrolyze
91433.FlavorText: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

91435.Name: Spark Trooper
91435.FlavorText: Izzet-designed conductors atop Sunhome charge empty sets of armor that give form to the fluctuating elementals.

91436.Name: Skyknight Legionnaire
91436.FlavorText:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia

91439.Name: Slimy Dualleech
91439.FlavorText:
"Isn't it gorgeous? It's my most efficient corpse eliminator! One head bites while the other chews."
—Glogus, Golgari leechbreeder

91440.Name: Spotlight Falcon
91440.FlavorText:
"It's the newest model—10 percent lighter and 20 percent more expensive!"
—Kylox

91451.Name: Grand Abolisher
91451.FlavorText: "You think because you've mapped the land, you own the land. You own an idea, nothing more."

91461.Name: Legion Extruder
91461.FlavorText: When the vault door opened, ancient war machines rumbled to life.

91463.Name: Molten Duplication
91463.FlavorText: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

91465.Name: Ancient Cornucopia
91465.FlavorText:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!" 
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

91468.Name: Sandstorm Salvager
91468.FlavorText: Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.

91470.Name: Loot, the Key to Everything
91470.FlavorText: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

91471.Name: Pest Control
91471.FlavorText:
"How dare these varmints befoul the shining streets of Prosperity?"
—Baron Bertram Graywater

91476.Name: Torpor Orb
91476.FlavorText:
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you."
—Fomori inscription

91492.Name: Jessie Zane, Fangbringer
91492.FlavorText: She brings the Bite of Rhonas to lands that have never known his name.

91493.Name: Wagon Wrecker
91493.FlavorText: "Let's see how far you get without any wheels!"

91495.Name: Prairie Survivalist
91495.FlavorText: As interplanar nomads, the Atiin are experts in packing for every possible situation.

91496.Name: Runecarved Obelisk
91496.FlavorText: By all accounts, Thunder Junction was uninhabited before the Omenpaths opened, but no one could explain the centuries-old obelisks.

91499.Name: Intruder's Inquisition
91499.FlavorText: Somewhere in Alquist Proft's mind were the answers Jace needed.

91500.Name: Solitary Defiance
91500.FlavorText: Jace constructed a mental vault deep in his consciousness as Phyresis closed in.

91501.Name: Cathartic Operation
91501.FlavorText: It was a quiet moment, and a heavy one. It was full of all they had lost, and the hope they had despite it all.

91508.Name: Vona de Iedo, the Antifex
91508.FlavorText: Vona promised a new beginning, but first demanded an ultimate end.

91515.Name: Stalwart Realmwarden
91515.FlavorText: "This is a place of new beginnings. I will not allow the land to be carved up by those who seek only to profit from it."

91516.Name: Silent Extraction
91516.FlavorText: With a dying man's determination, Jace pulls Vraska from the rubble and into the Blind Eternities.

91528.Name: Invoke the Divine
91528.FlavorText: "Let's see how brave you really are behind all that oak and steel."

91529.Name: Ritual of Rejuvenation
91529.FlavorText: "Nothing is more sacred than the gift of blood. Blessed are the vein that empties and the heart that is renewed."

91530.Name: Inspiring Cleric
91530.FlavorText: "The Immortal Sun will bring us true eternal life to replace the everlasting shadow of undeath."

91531.Name: Ambush Viper
91531.FlavorText:
"Living creatures seldom impress me. But I like this one."
—Uta Falkenrath

91537.Name: Banishing Light
91537.FlavorText:
"If you cannot find light in the darkness, create it."
—Aural, high cleric

91539.Name: Brave-Kin Duo
91539.FlavorText: "Did you bring everything you need for the journey?" the rabbit asked. "Of course I did! I brought you, my dear pine cone," the mouse replied.

91540.Name: Brightblade Stoat
91540.FlavorText: Brightblades are trained to constantly mind the sun's position, adjusting the angle of their dagger to maximize glare.

91543.Name: Carrot Cake
91543.FlavorText:
"Secret ingredient? What do you think?"
—Ms. Bumbleflower

91547.Name: Driftgloom Coyote
91547.FlavorText: "The fog is descending like a starving beast. I believe our expedition ends here."

91549.Name: Feather of Flight
91549.FlavorText: As he grasped the glowing feather, the lizard's heart soared, and the rest of him quickly followed.

91551.Name: Harvestrite Host
91551.FlavorText: "Many paws grew this feast, and many paws should share it!"

91552.Name: Hop to It
91552.FlavorText:
"Finding a hidden patch of glowberries is almost as joyful as eating them. Almost."
—Ms. Bumbleflower

91553.Name: Intrepid Rabbit
91553.FlavorText: "I'll light the way, but we must walk it together."

91555.Name: Jolly Gerbils
91555.FlavorText: "With all the chaos going around, we thought it might be the perfect time to take a break and have a nice picnic. Would you like to join us?"

91556.Name: Lifecreed Duo
91556.FlavorText: "Why are you eating upside down?" asked the bird. "Why are you eating upside up?" replied the bat.

91557.Name: Mabel's Mettle
91557.FlavorText: "You stole a child from its nest," Mabel accused. "The only calamity I see here is you."

91558.Name: Mouse Trapper
91558.FlavorText: "I'm not here to hurt you, but I will stop you from hurting others."

91561.Name: Pileated Provisioner
91561.FlavorText: Aerial supporters train for years to make sure the weapons they drop land in the hands of mice and not on their heads.

91562.Name: Rabbit Response
91562.FlavorText: You never fight just one rabbitfolk. They bring the strength of their burrow to battle with them.

91563.Name: Repel Calamity
91563.FlavorText: The living seasons come to grow, to burn, to wither, and to freeze. As natural as it is for the Calamity Beasts to live, it is just as natural for them to die.

91566.Name: Seasoned Warrenguard
91566.FlavorText: Never underestimate what a rabbit can do with a root vegetable and some moxie.

91567.Name: Shrike Force
91567.FlavorText:
"I've trained every one of them in aerial maneuvers, talon strikes, and dive precision. They are the top of my class, and they may surpass me one day."
—Quickwing, master flyer

91568.Name: Sonar Strike
91568.FlavorText: Valley's midnight clerics channel the life force of other animals into blinding strikes and searing shrieks.

91570.Name: Starfall Invocation
91570.FlavorText: Nothing lurks in the purity of the moon's light.

91571.Name: Thistledown Players
91571.FlavorText:
"In hand, a sword to slay the frightful beast; in heart, these words to soothe our frightened kin."
—Lily and the Ember Seed

91572.Name: Valley Questcaller
91572.FlavorText: No battle is fought, or won, alone.

91573.Name: Warren Elder
91573.FlavorText: "There is strength in numbers, yes. More importantly, there is joy."

91575.Name: Wax-Wane Witness
91575.FlavorText: Batfolk clerics consider the cycle of light and darkness as a sacred allegory of life and death.

91578.Name: Bellowing Crier
91578.FlavorText: Glarb's court can always be found repeating his disastrous visions, even when they're unwelcome.

91579.Name: Calamitous Tide
91579.FlavorText: Zoraline turned her attention to the shore. Helga and Ral's conversation quickly faded from her mind as she watched the gigantic wave approach.

91581.Name: Dazzling Denial
91581.FlavorText: Maintaining brilliant plumage isn't just a statement. It's a tactic.

91582.Name: Dire Downdraft
91582.FlavorText: Quickwing's elite flyers were more than capable of navigating ordinary storms, but Dragonhawk's storms were anything but ordinary.

91583.Name: Dour Port-Mage
91583.FlavorText: "Find your mooring and stop clogging the shipping lanes!"

91591.Name: Knightfisher
91591.FlavorText: His keen eyes can see the glint of scales far below the river's surface.

91592.Name: Lightshell Duo
91592.FlavorText: "Lightning and snail as one!" cried the rat. "It's so beautiful!" the otter gasped in awe.

91597.Name: Mockingbird
91597.FlavorText: "Laughing at you? No, no, I'm laughing as you!"

91598.Name: Nightwhorl Hermit
91598.FlavorText: He etches his secrets onto the shimmering shells of mussels, saving them to share with the Great Snail.

91600.Name: Pearl of Wisdom
91600.FlavorText: Otterfolk divers compete to bring up the biggest, purest pearls they can find. Storing elemental magic in them is a bonus.

91601.Name: Plumecreed Escort
91601.FlavorText: "I defend Valley and its beauty. What better weapon to wield than beauty itself?"

91603.Name: Run Away Together
91603.FlavorText: Nobody bothered to look for Libo and Pulla, because everyone knew they didn't want to be found.

91605.Name: Shore Up
91605.FlavorText: "Is that all you've got? Put some mussel into it!"

91606.Name: Shoreline Looter
91606.FlavorText: A water skimmer's ability to sense danger in the slightest ripple makes them a prized companion for Long River trawlers.

91607.Name: Skyskipper Duo
91607.FlavorText: "I don't know how to swim!" said the bird. "That's okay! I don't know how to fly!" laughed the frog.

91610.Name: Splash Portal
91610.FlavorText:
"Don't ask me how it works. If I stopped long enough to question it, I'd lose my legs."
—Lorb, frogfolk wizard

91612.Name: Sugar Coat
91612.FlavorText: Some jokes have the punchline baked in.

91613.Name: Thought Shucker
91613.FlavorText: Many rats have found their minds while lost in the mud-slicked gyre of a snail shell.

91616.Name: Waterspout Warden
91616.FlavorText: The escape route of many a birdfolk thief has been less surefire than they'd thought.

91618.Name: Agate-Blade Assassin
91618.FlavorText: Some lizardfolk wield the precious agate and yearn for fire. Others wield it and thirst for blood.

91620.Name: Bonebind Orator
91620.FlavorText: A great actor can breathe new life into old material.

91625.Name: Daggerfang Duo
91625.FlavorText: "Should we act now or later?" the rat asked. "Both," whispered the squirrel.

91627.Name: Diresight
91627.FlavorText: There is a fine line between predicting the future and causing it.

91629.Name: Early Winter
91629.FlavorText: The climate changed and the world suffered.

91630.Name: Feed the Cycle
91630.FlavorText:
Sleeping beneath the sumac
—Squirrelfolk expression meaning "death"

91631.Name: Fell
91631.FlavorText: When Glarb ordered the egg stolen, the Great Maha communicated its anger in a universal language.

91632.Name: Glidedive Duo
91632.FlavorText: "Catch the thermal!" called the bat. "What's a thermal?!" cried the lizard.

91633.Name: Hazel's Nocturne
91633.FlavorText: On stormy autumn days, the leaves in the trees chitter and whisper.

91636.Name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
91636.FlavorText: Its wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.

91637.Name: Moonstone Harbinger
91637.FlavorText: Moonstone weapons drink in the last light of dusk to give their wielders an edge in combat.

91642.Name: Ravine Raider
91642.FlavorText: The path to the Cliff of Heroes is rife with bandits, expertly camouflaged in the dense flora of Valley.

91644.Name: Ruthless Negotiation
91644.FlavorText: "Next time you come this way, do us both a favor and have something worth stealing, yeah?"

91645.Name: Savor
91645.FlavorText: Edibility is in the eye of the beholder.

91649.Name: Sinister Monolith
91649.FlavorText: Blood and brine make a strong mortar.

91650.Name: Stargaze
91650.FlavorText:
"Some batfolk dedicate their lives to seeing the world beyond them."
—Warion, scholar of the Cosmos

91651.Name: Starlit Soothsayer
91651.FlavorText: "The Lunar Paean is upon us. Let us turn to our ancestors for guidance, and look to our children for hope."

91655.Name: Valley Rotcaller
91655.FlavorText:
We all share one life and one death.
—Rotcaller saying

91657.Name: Wick's Patrol
91657.FlavorText:
"What a hideous creature! And the worm's no looker either."
—Grumble, rival marshstalker

91658.Name: Agate Assault
91658.FlavorText: "Only an amateur crushes their enemies with a cold rock."

91659.Name: Alania's Pathmaker
91659.FlavorText: "The frogfolk should worry less that the sky is falling and worry more about where it's landing."

91663.Name: Brambleguard Captain
91663.FlavorText: "We sought adventure and found calamity. Forward, so we may meet both with courage!"

91664.Name: Brazen Collector
91664.FlavorText: Risks taken to retrieve a prize only increase its value.

91665.Name: Byway Barterer
91665.FlavorText: "This trinket has saved my hide more times than I can count. I couldn't possibly let it go for less than say . . . four acorns."

91667.Name: Conduct Electricity
91667.FlavorText: "Give me a lightning rod, something I can use as a channel!" Ral called above the mayhem. Nodding, Finneas drew a copperleaf arrow from his emptying quiver and shot.

91670.Name: Flamecache Gecko
91670.FlavorText: Wood holds a flame for only so long before it crumbles into ash. But stone can burn forever.

91672.Name: Frilled Sparkshooter
91672.FlavorText: Its frills keep it steady, making its aim impeccable.

91673.Name: Harnesser of Storms
91673.FlavorText: She feeds and powers her entire village.

91678.Name: Kindlespark Duo
91678.FlavorText: "We burn like fire!" cackled the lizard. "And strike like lightning!" the otter thundered.

91680.Name: Might of the Meek
91680.FlavorText:
"Fear is unavoidable. You can run from it with your tail between your legs, or charge it head on with sword in hand. I prefer the latter."
—Rho, veteran hero

91681.Name: Playful Shove
91681.FlavorText: The boisterous pat on the back was painful, but not nearly as painful as the joke that inspired it.

91682.Name: Quaketusk Boar
91682.FlavorText:
"Calamity Beasts are running through Valley, leaving death and destruction in their wake. I have a plan to stop them."
—Glarb, ruler of Fountainport

91683.Name: Rabid Gnaw
91683.FlavorText: Unbeknownst to the hosts, the foraged seeds they served at dinner had been touched by a Calamity Beast. The results were . . . disturbing.

91684.Name: Raccoon Rallier
91684.FlavorText: "I used to play for family only until I realized I could inspire an entire party with a single note."

91686.Name: Roughshod Duo
91686.FlavorText: "En garde, you inadequate excuse for a foe!" challenged the mouse. "Raaahrgh grrrr raaaargh!" agreed the raccoon.

91690.Name: Stormsplitter
91690.FlavorText: "We'll cover more ground if I split up."

91693.Name: Teapot Slinger
91693.FlavorText: "For the last time it's porcelain, not stoneware, you ignorant fool!"

91694.Name: Valley Flamecaller
91694.FlavorText:
"Well, that's another night of research spoiled."
—Claire, batfolk astrologer

91695.Name: War Squeak
91695.FlavorText: Dangers sharper than thorns can hide among flowers.

91696.Name: Whiskerquill Scribe
91696.FlavorText:
"Unneeded words are like dandelion seeds—cast adrift at the slightest whiff of scrutiny, only to find purchase and thrive where you least expect."
—Myrtle, Valley scribe

91698.Name: Bakersbane Duo
91698.FlavorText: "I'll take the crust!" chittered the squirrel. "And I'll take the filling!" drooled the raccoon.

91700.Name: Bark-Knuckle Boxer
91700.FlavorText:
May your bark be worse than your bite.
—Raccoonfolk war blessing

91701.Name: Brambleguard Veteran
91701.FlavorText: "Why should the birdfolk get the best view?"

91705.Name: Curious Forager
91705.FlavorText: The bones of Calamity Beasts are sometimes buried in caches where their power can grow quietly.

91706.Name: Druid of the Spade
91706.FlavorText: The druid brought the best out of the soil and, in turn, the best out of the fluffle.

91708.Name: For the Common Good
91708.FlavorText: Despite their differences, every creature and culture of Valley stood in unison against the threat.

91709.Name: Galewind Moose
91709.FlavorText:
"Something has stirred the Calamity Beasts, and they are wreaking havoc. Anyone who wishes to help, come forth! Whether it's with your swords in the fight or your shovels in the field, join me!"
—Mabel, heir to Cragflame

91710.Name: Hazardroot Herbalist
91710.FlavorText: Just because it's natural doesn't mean it's healthy.

91711.Name: Heaped Harvest
91711.FlavorText: One can travel all of Valley and never eat the same meal twice.

91712.Name: High Stride
91712.FlavorText:
"It takes a moment to find your stride, but once you do, you'll feel like a giant!"
—Brisco, river guide

91717.Name: Keen-Eyed Curator
91717.FlavorText: "Now this one's a real collector's item. They say Lily Emberseed herself drank from this mug when she was still Lily of Valley."

91729.Name: Stickytongue Sentinel
91729.FlavorText: Victory doesn't have to be close for him to taste it.

91730.Name: Stocking the Pantry
91730.FlavorText:
Sorting the seeds from the nuts
—Squirrelfolk expression meaning "dwelling on unnecessary details"

91731.Name: Sunshower Druid
91731.FlavorText: Apprentice augurs begin their studies by predicting where the rain will fall. Even those who don't succeed derive great joy from the process.

91734.Name: Three Tree Rootweaver
91734.FlavorText: "It's easy to find your way around the Root Maze if you know what to look, listen, smell, feel, and taste for."

91735.Name: Three Tree Scribe
91735.FlavorText: "The tree wants to give me a warning. I just need to help it communicate."

91736.Name: Treeguard Duo
91736.FlavorText: "You shall not pass me," croaked the frog. "Nor me," growled the rabbit.

91737.Name: Treetop Sentries
91737.FlavorText: They don't waste arrows on warning shots.

91738.Name: Valley Mightcaller
91738.FlavorText: "There is no path to the Root Maze's center. Bard, sing a song while I create one."

91739.Name: Wear Down
91739.FlavorText: The birdfolk guards flitted angrily. "Seriously, Timbles? Again?!"

91740.Name: Alania, Divergent Storm
91740.FlavorText: "Why would I chase the storm? Does a cloud chase the rain? Does the sun chase the light?"

91742.Name: Burrowguard Mentor
91742.FlavorText: "On your paws! I've been fighting in these fields for more seasons than you've had hot dinners!"

91744.Name: Cindering Cutthroat
91744.FlavorText: "We don't ‘play' with fire. It is strictly business."

91746.Name: Corpseberry Cultivator
91746.FlavorText: A rare fruit grows from the corpses of Calamity Beasts, with nectar the flavor of strength and skin as fragile as life.

91747.Name: Dreamdew Entrancer
91747.FlavorText: "Your dreams are too precious to leave to chance."

91749.Name: Fireglass Mentor
91749.FlavorText: "Nothing focuses the mind quite like a flame."

91752.Name: Head of the Homestead
91752.FlavorText:
"Interrupting a rabbitfolk dinner is a most grievous offense. If you must do so, bring gifts for the little ones, or bring a shield."
—Giddy's Guide to Valley

91754.Name: Hugs, Grisly Guardian
91754.FlavorText: Most of his scars tell tales. A few tell jokes.

91756.Name: Junkblade Bruiser
91756.FlavorText: Each scrap shed from her battle-axe is more likely to end up stored permanently in an enemy's skull.

91758.Name: Lilysplash Mentor
91758.FlavorText: "Splashy entrances are my specialty. And they can be yours too. Try again!"

91761.Name: Mind Drill Assailant
91761.FlavorText: "If only you kept your secrets somewhere more secure than your delicate little skull."

91762.Name: Moonrise Cleric
91762.FlavorText: "The sunrisers have entrusted me with their life force. I intend to repay them bountifully."

91764.Name: Plumecreed Mentor
91764.FlavorText: "Any fledgling can flap their wings. But a true windscout must soar!"

91765.Name: Pond Prophet
91765.FlavorText: "The rainfall brings us news of the world around us. I've learned a lot, but most of all I've learned that it's very exciting out there!"

91767.Name: Seedglaive Mentor
91767.FlavorText: "Your riposte is good, yes. But how's your footwork?"

91768.Name: Seedpod Squire
91768.FlavorText:
"If you think he's loud now, wait until he starts the battle song."
—Clement, pessimistic adventurer

91769.Name: Starseer Mentor
91769.FlavorText: "Each star is given a name befitting its grandeur. This one is called Aurax, the Night-Eater. That one is called Blinky."

91770.Name: Stormcatch Mentor
91770.FlavorText: "Only novice mages burn their whiskers. So pay attention!"

91771.Name: Tempest Angler
91771.FlavorText: "Castin' lines or castin' spells, ain't no one better than me."

91772.Name: Tidecaller Mentor
91772.FlavorText: "The same tides that bring us knowledge can sweep us away."

91774.Name: Vinereap Mentor
91774.FlavorText: "In youth, we reap. In death, we sow."

91776.Name: Wandertale Mentor
91776.FlavorText: "You've all grown so much since I passed through this burrow last! Let's see, where to begin this story?"

91779.Name: Barkform Harvester
91779.FlavorText: The farmers hide when it runs out of potatoes to harvest.

91781.Name: Fountainport Bell
91781.FlavorText: Fountainport's town crier once saved the townsfolk from predation by a rottenmouth viper with only their bell.

91782.Name: Heirloom Epic
91782.FlavorText: "The beasts feared fire, and little else. Lily of Valley raised Cragflame and . . ."

91783.Name: Patchwork Banner
91783.FlavorText: With thistle, quill, twig, and beak, the finest artisans of each animalfolk society stitched unique quilts, patched together as a symbol of harmony.

91784.Name: Short Bow
91784.FlavorText: Take heart. Take aim. Take them down.

91787.Name: Three Tree Mascot
91787.FlavorText:
"Every paw and claw should be at the celebrations in Three Tree City! Even the float is smiling!"
—Valley Gazetteer, four-acorn review

91797.Name: Uncharted Haven
91797.FlavorText:
"There are lands beyond Valley. Wild, calamity-scarred, and beautiful."
—Farfeather, birdfolk scout

91799.Name: Byrke, Long Ear of the Law

91800.Name: Serra Redeemer
91800.FlavorText: "Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds."

91802.Name: Mind Spring
91802.FlavorText: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

91803.Name: Thieving Otter
91803.FlavorText:
"You're telling me we spent a year securing the sanctuary against pterosaurs, rambeasts, and nightfangs . . . and we were robbed by what?"
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

91805.Name: Colossification
91805.FlavorText:
"Turns out the case of the flattened outpost and the case of the missing kitten were related."
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

91806.Name: Giant Growth
91806.FlavorText:
"Sometimes Mowu is content to gnaw on a bone. Sometimes he wants the whole skeleton."
—Jiang Yanggu

91807.Name: Rabid Bite
91807.FlavorText: A healthy felidar is voracious yet regal. A rabid felidar is nothing more than appetite lashed to frothing jaws.

91808.Name: Sword of Vengeance
91808.FlavorText: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

91870.Name: Swords to Plowshares
91870.FlavorText: "I'm not as quick as I used to be, but the wheat doesn't mind."

91871.Name: Ledger Shredder
91871.FlavorText: "Pah! You call this a comprehensive? I call this nest-stuffing!"

91872.Name: Rat Colony
91872.FlavorText: For every five you see, there are fifty you don't.

91873.Name: Relentless Rats
91873.FlavorText: Each of them is a bad influence on the rest.

91874.Name: Kindred Charge
91874.FlavorText:
"Anyone can live next door, but when you fight to defend your neighbors, you become a village."
—Rho, veteran hero

91875.Name: Sylvan Tutor
91875.FlavorText: The magic of the land is a thread that weaves all of Valley into a tapestry, connecting even the most distant of friends.

91877.Name: Frogmite
91877.FlavorText:
"It started as a prototype for a frog diving suit, but the internal mechanisms didn't leave room for the frog."
—Fitzwhisker, otterfolk inventor

91886.Name: Marrow-Gnawer
91886.FlavorText: They don't follow orders. They follow him.

91887.Name: Ant Queen
91887.FlavorText:
"She only makes the trek through Valley when she's hungry. I fear it's not just our crops she enjoys."
—Lop, rabbitfolk farmer

91888.Name: Birds of Paradise
91888.FlavorText:
"How lovely! An ambassador from outside Valley arrived today in Three Tree City. Animalfolk from all over have come to welcome them."
—Ms. Bumbleflower

91893.Name: Baleful Strix
91893.FlavorText: It came from beyond Valley. Not a calamity like the Great Maha, and not animalfolk. It was something new.

91897.Name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
91897.FlavorText: "Invite your friends! Invite your family! Invite some strangers! Tonight we feast!"

91898.Name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
91898.FlavorText: He calls forth his flock from dancing zephyrs and swirling clouds.

91962.Name: Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor
91962.FlavorText: "For all his crimes, Lord Konda's greatest legacy is his daughter. I will guide her as I can."

91974.Name: Kaalia of the Vast
91974.FlavorText: "They laughed because I couldn't walk. Now they tremble as I take flight."

91975.Name: Kudo, King Among Bears
91975.FlavorText: Ayula's consort is the hearth to her fire, the honey to her sting, and the mirror to her splendor.

91981.Name: It That Heralds the End
91981.FlavorText:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander

91983.Name: Null Elemental Blast
91983.FlavorText:
"Despite my years, I am still but a student of the Multiverse. How arrogant to think yourself its master."
—Ugin, to Nicol Bolas

91987.Name: Flare of Fortitude
91987.FlavorText: "I call upon a power greater than myself."

91989.Name: Metastatic Evangel
91989.FlavorText: "I am no sleeper agent. I am a liberator. It is you who are asleep."

91991.Name: Recruiter of the Guard
91991.FlavorText: "The kingdom is in peril! Who among you is brave enough to defend it?"

91992.Name: White Orchid Phantom
91992.FlavorText: His oath required no service beyond death, but his honor demanded it.

91993.Name: Wrath of the Skies
91993.FlavorText: Even the weather of Dominaria shifts to assail would-be invaders.

91994.Name: Aether Spike
91994.FlavorText:
"The shield doesn't block the fire physically. It tells the fire to stop."
—Genku, future shaper

91995.Name: Brainsurge
91995.FlavorText: In the Cosmos, secrets swirl and spark like windborne embers, and only Alrund can capture them.

91996.Name: Flare of Denial
91996.FlavorText: "I see where you're going with that, and I don't like it."

91998.Name: Shadow of the Second Sun
91998.FlavorText: Live fully, then return to the beginning.

91999.Name: Tune the Narrative
91999.FlavorText: "The kami whisper of other worlds, brimming with stories untold. It would take a lifetime to learn them. A lifetime well spent."

92001.Name: Accursed Marauder
92001.FlavorText: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.

92003.Name: Consuming Corruption
92003.FlavorText: While crossing the mire, Lort the Sneaky found the perfect shortcut to the end of his life.

92004.Name: Flare of Malice
92004.FlavorText: "Suffer as I have suffered. Lose as I have lost."

92006.Name: Marionette Apprentice
92006.FlavorText: "Ah! Yes! I got its leg to twitch!"

92008.Name: Toxic Deluge
92008.FlavorText:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

92009.Name: Victimize
92009.FlavorText:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

92010.Name: Warren Soultrader
92010.FlavorText: "The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."

92012.Name: Flare of Duplication
92012.FlavorText: "Decent. But let me show you what mastery looks like."

92013.Name: Galvanic Discharge
92013.FlavorText:
"Remember, if you find a rock making crackly noises, just put it back. Carefully."
—Bo, Great Desert prospector

92014.Name: Meltdown
92014.FlavorText: Catastrophes happened so often at the mana rig that the viashino language had a special word to describe them.

92018.Name: Wheel of Potential
92018.FlavorText: The wheel only has one sure output: chaos.

92020.Name: Evolution Witness
92020.FlavorText: She remembers every breakthrough, from the gene's mutation to the new life's propagation.

92024.Name: Priest of Titania
92024.FlavorText: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

92025.Name: Primal Prayers
92025.FlavorText: When Gaea speaks, all of nature falls silent.

92028.Name: Kudo, King Among Bears
92028.FlavorText: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.

92031.Name: Bloodstained Mire
92031.FlavorText: A graveyard for conquerors and conquered alike.

92032.Name: Flooded Strand
92032.FlavorText: Once a prosperous Vantress town, now swept clean and reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.

92033.Name: Nesting Grounds
92033.FlavorText: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

92034.Name: Polluted Delta
92034.FlavorText: A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.

92036.Name: Windswept Heath
92036.FlavorText: An underground paradise, bright and thriving beneath the surface of Ixalan.

92037.Name: Wooded Foothills
92037.FlavorText: Home and hunting ground for Kaldheim's fearsome trolls.

92039.Name: Esper Sentinel
92039.FlavorText: The more Esper changes, the more he refuses to.

92041.Name: Hard Evidence
92041.FlavorText: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.

92044.Name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
92044.FlavorText: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.

92048.Name: Strike It Rich
92048.FlavorText: A few coins soon grow into an obsession.

92049.Name: Unholy Heat
92049.FlavorText: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

92052.Name: Munitions Expert
92052.FlavorText: When dealing with goblins, if it isn't nailed down, it's headed your way.

92054.Name: A-Unholy Heat
92054.FlavorText: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

92055.Name: Acrobatic Cheerleader
92055.FlavorText: "I used to cheat death every day in practice. This is nothing."

92056.Name: Cult Healer
92056.FlavorText: "Oh, we don't need to operate. I've just always wanted to try it."

92063.Name: Emerge from the Cocoon
92063.FlavorText: Within the silken shroud, all doubts are cleansed, and all desires are united with Valgavoth.

92065.Name: Ethereal Armor
92065.FlavorText: Clad in the light of conviction and hope, Linette strode forth to face Duskmourn's terrors without fear.

92066.Name: Exorcise
92066.FlavorText:
"Strictly speaking, you can't kill what's already dead, but trapping and disintegrating it is pretty close."
—Garden, survivor technologist

92068.Name: Fear of Immobility
92068.FlavorText: As it slunk toward her, Nina told her legs to run, but they stayed rooted and rigid. She screamed—but no sound left her lips.

92069.Name: Fear of Surveillance
92069.FlavorText: Its unblinking gaze sees every flaw, every shame, every humiliating moment you wish you could forget.

92070.Name: Friendly Ghost
92070.FlavorText: In life, Marcus had been a devoted guide of new arrivals. Death simply made it easier to get around.

92072.Name: Glimmer Seeker
92072.FlavorText: "Well, hello there. Want to come exploring?"

92076.Name: Hardened Escort
92076.FlavorText: "It's not magic. I read the writing on the House's walls. I listen to its sighs. I smell the changes in its air. It tells me where danger lies."

92079.Name: Lionheart Glimmer
92079.FlavorText: The survivors would no longer be picked off one by one. It was their turn to hunt.

92081.Name: Optimistic Scavenger
92081.FlavorText: "A void rod? Perfect! Now I'll be able to get the glitch reader working again."

92082.Name: Orphans of the Wheat
92082.FlavorText: Their only family is each other, and their only toys are those who wander too far into the fields.

92084.Name: Patched Plaything
92084.FlavorText: When it ripped, its owner attempted to fix it. Something went . . . wrong.

92085.Name: Possessed Goat
92085.FlavorText: When their would-be sacrifice wandered back to their encampment, the survivors breathed a sigh of relief, assuming the demon had departed.

92087.Name: Savior of the Small
92087.FlavorText: "You're safe, kiddo! For at least the next ten minutes. That's about all I can promise."

92088.Name: Seized from Slumber
92088.FlavorText: Tyson tried to scream for help, but his lungs simply unraveled.

92089.Name: Shardmage's Rescue
92089.FlavorText: With a flick of their wrist, Niko shattered the wickerfolk and whisked Nashi to safety.

92091.Name: Shepherding Spirits
92091.FlavorText: "This way, Melinda. A hundred years haven't improved your sense of direction."

92092.Name: Split Up
92092.FlavorText:
"Don't be a wimp. We'll cover more ground this way."
—Rian, former survivor

92093.Name: Splitskin Doll
92093.FlavorText: Those who mock its ragged surface and seeping eyes have a curious tendency to go missing.

92097.Name: Toby, Beastie Befriender
92097.FlavorText: "Sure, I'm pretty small, but Gribble isn't, so I don't get scared."

92098.Name: Trapped in the Screen
92098.FlavorText: Maggie had always wanted to be on television.

92111.Name: Clammy Prowler
92111.FlavorText: Sometimes, survivors in the Floodpits hear their own drowning voices crying out for help. Only the ones who flee immediately live to speak of it.

92112.Name: Creeping Peeper
92112.FlavorText:
"Be on your guard. Valgavoth has eyes everywhere. And I don't mean that figuratively."
—Winter

92114.Name: Daggermaw Megalodon
92114.FlavorText: Valgavoth's evil aura turned the shark from an apex predator into an inescapable terror of the deeps.

92115.Name: Don't Make a Sound
92115.FlavorText: Jace kept his mouth shut, but he couldn't shake the feeling that the strange creatures could hear the screaming in his mind.

92116.Name: Duskmourn's Domination
92116.FlavorText: All who enter the House hear Valgavoth's whispers, worming through their consciousness until they can no longer resist his influence.

92118.Name: Enter the Enigma
92118.FlavorText: Though she was used to stepping into the unknown, something about this strange doorway made the Wanderer shiver as she crossed the threshold.

92119.Name: Entity Tracker
92119.FlavorText: "The readings are off the charts! Whatever it is, it's close."

92120.Name: Erratic Apparition
92120.FlavorText:
"What's got you all bent out of shape?"
—Joseph, comedian, last words

92121.Name: Fear of Failed Tests
92121.FlavorText:
"W-wait! What do you mean this quiz determines half our grade?"
—Zimone, muttering in her sleep

92122.Name: Fear of Falling
92122.FlavorText: It had been months since Jakob had started falling but only a few weeks since he'd run out of breath to scream.

92124.Name: Fear of Isolation
92124.FlavorText: On the second day after he'd been separated from his friends, Tino worried they'd be panicking at his absence. By the fourth, he was certain they'd never cared for him at all.

92126.Name: Get Out
92126.FlavorText: Kaito's blade brought the light of another plane into Duskmourn, and with it, a brief chance to escape.

92127.Name: Ghostly Keybearer
92127.FlavorText: Once charged with watching over every room in the original Vendrell house, it doggedly surveys the endless, ever-expanding labyrinth.

92128.Name: Glimmerburst
92128.FlavorText: At first Sasha felt silly fending off the cellarspawn hordes with the essence of her childhood pet hamster. But it sure beat dying alone in the dark.

92134.Name: The Mindskinner
92134.FlavorText: It slices away the most precious memories first, then the mundane, until all that remains is blank, formless fear.

92139.Name: Paranormal Analyst
92139.FlavorText: "If I've done this right, it should immobilize all spirits in the area. If I've done this wrong . . . you know what, let's just hope I did it right."

92140.Name: Piranha Fly
92140.FlavorText: They thirst for blood like mosquitoes do. They just have a less dainty way of accessing it.

92141.Name: Scrabbling Skullcrab
92141.FlavorText: With sandy beaches in short supply, Duskmourn's crabs have adapted to burrow into everything from carpet to flesh.

92143.Name: Stalked Researcher
92143.FlavorText: "Just a shadow. It's only a shadow. Please let it be a shadow."

92146.Name: Tunnel Surveyor
92146.FlavorText: Though he needed to know what lay beyond the intersection, Harp couldn't suppress a shiver of disquiet as his glimmer disappeared into the darkness ahead.

92154.Name: Vanish from Sight
92154.FlavorText: The Wanderer flung out her hand, but too late—Kaito had vanished into the House's maw.

92155.Name: Appendage Amalgam
92155.FlavorText: It moves with the speed of a spider but none of its skittering grace, scuttling to the sound of mucus-covered fingers.

92156.Name: Balemurk Leech
92156.FlavorText: Adapted to feed on dead flesh, it's not averse to making its own when no corpses are available.

92157.Name: Cackling Slasher
92157.FlavorText: Every death was funnier than the last, until his howling laughter drowned out his victims' screams.

92158.Name: Come Back Wrong
92158.FlavorText:
"See?! That's why you always burn the bodies."
—Rip, spawn hunter

92159.Name: Commune with Evil
92159.FlavorText: Elsa swelled with euphoria and power as she stepped over her friends' corpses. She should have bargained with a demon a lot sooner.

92160.Name: Cracked Skull
92160.FlavorText: Ears ringing and head throbbing, all Tarvin could do was wait to see what would finish the job.

92161.Name: Cynical Loner
92161.FlavorText: "Thanks, but no thanks. I'm done with hope."

92162.Name: Dashing Bloodsucker
92162.FlavorText: "There are worse things here than vampires."

92166.Name: Demonic Counsel
92166.FlavorText: Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.

92170.Name: Doomsday Excruciator
92170.FlavorText: "All stars grow dark. All worlds come to an end."

92172.Name: Fanatic of the Harrowing
92172.FlavorText: "Valgavoth wants our pain, our terror! We cannot join him unless we suffer!"

92173.Name: Fear of Lost Teeth
92173.FlavorText: As it drew closer, Sam felt her own teeth wriggle in their sockets, as if they wanted to leap out and join the thing.

92174.Name: Fear of the Dark
92174.FlavorText: The first thing it kills is the light.

92175.Name: Final Vengeance
92175.FlavorText: The cries of survivor and cellarspawn mingled in a single, terrible roar as they plunged into the fathomless depths.

92179.Name: Give In to Violence
92179.FlavorText:
"Come. Strip yourself of flesh and fear. Hunt for me. Entertain me."
—The Lord of Pain

92180.Name: Grievous Wound
92180.FlavorText: Vicky was so tired. The pain began to fade. "You were so brave," said her grandmother's voice from somewhere far away. "But it's time to rest now."

92184.Name: Leyline of the Void
92184.FlavorText: Cracks in the facade of the House lead not to escape but to oblivion.

92185.Name: Live or Die
92185.FlavorText:
"I grant them the illusion of hope so that their despair grows ever sweeter."
—Valgavoth

92187.Name: Miasma Demon
92187.FlavorText: "Hush, little ants. I can rid you of your troubles with a breath. All I ask in return is a drop of blood . . . and a promise."

92192.Name: Popular Egotist
92192.FlavorText: "I know you'd want me to live, bestie!"

92201.Name: Valgavoth's Faithful
92201.FlavorText:
"That's the one good thing about these cultists: sometimes they do your work for you."
—Winter

92203.Name: Winter's Intervention
92203.FlavorText: "Can we trust him?" Niko whispered as they eyed the stranger. "I don't know," the Wanderer replied, "but he's a lot friendlier than the creature that was chasing us."

92204.Name: Withering Torment
92204.FlavorText: Each spindrell is the lingering consciousness of a survivor consumed by cellarspawn—a ragged, drifting remnant pulsing with constant psychic agony.

92205.Name: Bedhead Beastie
92205.FlavorText: It had heard monsters were supposed to hide under beds, and it did its best.

92206.Name: Betrayer's Bargain
92206.FlavorText:
"This is my way out. You'll have to find your own."
—Winter, to Niko

92212.Name: Clockwork Percussionist
92212.FlavorText: Dance to its beat, or it will dance on your grave.

92216.Name: Fear of Being Hunted
92216.FlavorText: It makes no effort to hide itself, savoring its prey's rising panic as the sound of its clacking skull grows closer and closer.

92222.Name: Grab the Prize
92222.FlavorText: Unfortunately, the keyhole turned out to be located in an even larger, scarier clown mouth.

92223.Name: Hand That Feeds
92223.FlavorText: In the darkness, Lana reached for Shay's hand and squeezed it for comfort. Then she heard Shay call to her from the next room.

92224.Name: Impossible Inferno
92224.FlavorText: No living being, survivor or monster, is exempt from Valgavoth's wrath.

92228.Name: Most Valuable Slayer
92228.FlavorText: Torain had never lost a match in his life, and he didn't plan to start now.

92229.Name: Norin, Swift Survivalist
92229.FlavorText: "I don't know what it was! Why would I stick around to find out?"

92234.Name: Piggy Bank
92234.FlavorText: "Remember when you smashed me for a little pocket money?"

92235.Name: Pyroclasm
92235.FlavorText:
"In my younger days, I would meticulously catalog all the terrors I encountered. These days, I mostly just kill them with fire."
—Rip, spawn hunter

92236.Name: Ragged Playmate
92236.FlavorText: "You tried to throw me away, Henry. I don't like that at all."

92237.Name: Rampaging Soulrager
92237.FlavorText: The souls of those who perished before Valgavoth's Ascension exist now only as fractured echoes of who they once were.

92238.Name: Razorkin Hordecaller
92238.FlavorText: "Know your place, pets! First blood is mine!"

92239.Name: Razorkin Needlehead
92239.FlavorText: "Stitch your eyes, stitch your skin, stitch your mouth into a grin."

92240.Name: Ripchain Razorkin
92240.FlavorText: "Listen to that tasty squelch. Good hit, good hit! Come here now, little meatbag!"

92242.Name: Scorching Dragonfire
92242.FlavorText: Kaito ran. Illusion or no, the fire felt hot enough to kill.

92243.Name: Screaming Nemesis
92243.FlavorText: She sees the faces of those who wronged her in everyone she encounters.

92247.Name: Trial of Agony
92247.FlavorText: All it took to shatter their lifelong bond was a scrap of hope.

92249.Name: Untimely Malfunction
92249.FlavorText: "No! This worked perfectly in the lab!"

92250.Name: Vengeful Possession
92250.FlavorText: As the ghost clawed its way into her skin, Sarissa forgot that the rage tearing through her heart wasn't her own.

92251.Name: Vicious Clown
92251.FlavorText: "Surprise! Aaahahahahah! You should see the look on your face. Here, let's peel it off so you can!"

92252.Name: Violent Urge
92252.FlavorText: Rage can be a potent antidote to fear.

92253.Name: Waltz of Rage
92253.FlavorText: The melody was all in her head, but she'd always preferred to dance alone.

92255.Name: Anthropede
92255.FlavorText: The touch of its many hands is almost gentle, at first. But then the grip tightens, and the mandibles dig in.

92257.Name: Bashful Beastie
92257.FlavorText: No one knows what hides beneath the beasties' masks.

92259.Name: Cathartic Parting
92259.FlavorText: "We got more than most people do. We got the chance to say goodbye."

92260.Name: Cautious Survivor
92260.FlavorText: She came back alone, with her recorder broken and its footage scrambled. Whatever she had experienced, she never spoke of again.

92261.Name: Coordinated Clobbering
92261.FlavorText: Zimone's theory was that the fractalization of atmospheric aether would increase kinetic energy. Tyvar's theory was that if you hit cultists in the face really hard, they would fall down. They were both right.

92262.Name: Cryptid Inspector
92262.FlavorText: "Please be dead, please be dead, please be dead."

92263.Name: Defiant Survivor
92263.FlavorText: "The dark should be scared of me!"

92265.Name: Fear of Exposure
92265.FlavorText: A mouth like that can never keep secrets.

92266.Name: Flesh Burrower
92266.FlavorText: Symptoms of a burrower bite include fevers, chills, gangrene, subcutaneous writhing, a growing urge to eat the flesh of the living, and if you're lucky, death.

92267.Name: Frantic Strength
92267.FlavorText: With his friends dead and his weapons broken, Taros seized the only thing he could to defend himself.

92268.Name: Grasping Longneck
92268.FlavorText:
"We ran, but it was all around us—like a writhing, flailing forest of rubbery limbs and stabbing talons."
—Survivor's journal

92274.Name: Horrid Vigor
92274.FlavorText:
"We set it on fire. It lived. We cut off its head. It lived. We fell to it, one by one. It lives."
—Sunrise, survivor sentry

92276.Name: Insidious Fungus
92276.FlavorText: Wherever it grows, wood rots, walls turn gray, and flesh becomes fertilizer.

92277.Name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
92277.FlavorText: She's got a heart of gold, a nose for danger, and jaws that can pulverize a cellarspawn with a single snap.

92278.Name: Leyline of Mutation
92278.FlavorText: Life thrives in the Hauntwoods, but it follows its own laws, unbound from the natural order.

92279.Name: Manifest Dread
92279.FlavorText:
"That's why I never travel without a flamethrower."
—Rip, spawn hunter

92285.Name: Overgrown Zealot
92285.FlavorText: Even as the roots twisted painfully into his flesh, he sang out in joy, for he could feel himself becoming one with the woods.

92287.Name: Patchwork Beastie
92287.FlavorText: It doesn't know it isn't real.

92290.Name: Slavering Branchsnapper
92290.FlavorText:
"Hey, look! It made us a nice big path through the hedge maze!"
—Zimone

92294.Name: Tyvar, the Pummeler
92294.FlavorText: "They just keep coming and coming—perfect for my morning workout!"

92296.Name: Valgavoth's Onslaught
92296.FlavorText: Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

92300.Name: Wary Watchdog
92300.FlavorText: Valgavoth harbors a special loathing for dogs, whose mere presence provides a powerful antidote to the fear he craves.

92302.Name: Arabella, Abandoned Doll
92302.FlavorText: Every night, Cori threw the unsettling doll away. Every morning, it was back on the shelf, its eyes following her every move.

92307.Name: Drag to the Roots
92307.FlavorText:
"Valgavoth commands us to feed the trees. Let our blood be their mulch, our flesh their soil."
—Victor, Valgavoth's seneschal

92308.Name: Fear of Infinity
92308.FlavorText: There are some nightmares so terrible, you're never truly rid of them.

92309.Name: Gremlin Tamer
92309.FlavorText: "Do they cause trouble? Sure. But if you're nice to them, the trouble happens to other folks."

92311.Name: Inquisitive Glimmer
92311.FlavorText: Glimmers are physical manifestations of survivors' hope and courage. Their presence is one of the few things that can protect from Valgavoth's malevolent influence.

92312.Name: Intruding Soulrager
92312.FlavorText: The souls of those who perished outside the House persist as fractured echoes, driven to share their misery with the living.

92316.Name: Midnight Mayhem
92316.FlavorText:
"They might look funny, but when all those teeth sink into your flesh, you won't be laughing."
—Winter

92319.Name: Oblivious Bookworm
92319.FlavorText: "Huh, the detector won't stop beeping. Must be on the fritz again."

92320.Name: Peer Past the Veil
92320.FlavorText: Those who glimpse the House's true nature firsthand are cursed to never again look away.

92331.Name: Shroudstomper
92331.FlavorText:
"At least the razorkin are happy when they kill you. The walkers don't even notice."
—Angus, survivor scout

92337.Name: Undead Sprinter
92337.FlavorText: Farley had always been the fastest on the track team. But no one was cheering anymore.

92339.Name: Wildfire Wickerfolk
92339.FlavorText:
"Isn't fire supposed to kill those things?"
—Tyvar

92343.Name: Bear Trap
92343.FlavorText: Every time its teeth tasted blood, its hunger grew, until one day it was no longer a trap but a hunter.

92347.Name: Friendly Teddy
92347.FlavorText: Best friends are great to share secrets with—like where the matches are, or how to find a human heart.

92349.Name: Glimmerlight
92349.FlavorText: Hope and reliable lighting are in short supply in the House. Glimmers provide both.

92351.Name: Keys to the House
92351.FlavorText: If you find them, they wanted to be found.

92352.Name: Malevolent Chandelier
92352.FlavorText:
"If you see a light moving toward you in the darkness, don't assume it's coming to help."
—Winter

92353.Name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
92353.FlavorText: In a moment of bloodthirsty whimsy, a razorkin once picked up a ventriloquist's puppet and used it to terrorize a survivor. Now it hunts on its own, with no one pulling its strings.

92355.Name: Abandoned Campground
92355.FlavorText: They say every inhabitant vanished in a single night, leaving their belongings untouched but curiously covered in moths.

92356.Name: Blazemire Verge
92356.FlavorText: Here, the Balemurk spits and boils, the oppressive darkness pierced by scorching spears of fire.

92357.Name: Bleeding Woods
92357.FlavorText: They say if someone lies down to sleep beneath the trees, in the morning nothing will remain but a few scattered bones and a bed of blood-red lilies.

92358.Name: Etched Cornfield
92358.FlavorText: They say those who lose their way in the fields gradually wither and grow brittle, until at last they put down roots and anchor into the soil as a whispering stalk.

92359.Name: Floodfarm Verge
92359.FlavorText: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

92360.Name: Gloomlake Verge
92360.FlavorText: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

92361.Name: Hushwood Verge
92361.FlavorText: Here, the Hauntwoods churn like a viper's nest, as monstrous creatures prowl hungrily toward the ghostly light.

92362.Name: Lakeside Shack
92362.FlavorText: They say that if you stay in the cabin until the mists reach it, something will slither from the water and knock at the door.

92363.Name: Murky Sewer
92363.FlavorText: They say dripping, hungry things writhe beyond the edge of the light, waiting to drag the unwary into the darkness.

92364.Name: Neglected Manor
92364.FlavorText: They say every family who resided there met a grisly end, and once in a while you'll hear their screams echoing through the moldering halls.

92365.Name: Peculiar Lighthouse
92365.FlavorText: They say its beckoning beacon leads not to safe harbor but into the arms of the drowned.

92366.Name: Raucous Carnival
92366.FlavorText: They say that those who enter the amusement park never come back, and their disembodied laughter joins the others on the wind.

92367.Name: Razortrap Gorge
92367.FlavorText: They say the blades wait to bite through your skin until you've climbed too far to turn back, leaving you to cling with blood-slick hands until gravity takes you.

92368.Name: Strangled Cemetery
92368.FlavorText: They say that with each new moon, the buried dead rise and dance from dusk to dawn, and witnesses to the revelry must join them for eternity.

92369.Name: Terramorphic Expanse
92369.FlavorText: The House's geography constantly warps and twists, fields melting into floorboards and walls opening into hungry maws.

92370.Name: Thornspire Verge
92370.FlavorText: Here, the Boilerbilges twitch like a trapped animal, peaks straining against the grasping roots and vines.

92371.Name: Valgavoth's Lair
92371.FlavorText: It is the one chamber whose location never changes, the rotten, rancorous heart of Duskmourn itself.

92404.Name: Soul Warden
92404.FlavorText: The group called the Benefactors offers what aid and protection it can to other survivors, marking precious safe zones with the sign of the flame.

92405.Name: Expropriate
92405.FlavorText: Even those who think they have nothing have something left to lose.

92407.Name: Damnation
92407.FlavorText: Bound to a single house, Valgavoth simply expanded its boundaries until it consumed the plane, turning a vibrant world into his playground of terror.

92408.Name: Sacrifice
92408.FlavorText: Cultists eagerly undergo the Rite of the Threshold, allowing Valgavoth to feed on their fear and bind them to the essence of the House.

92410.Name: Unholy Heat
92410.FlavorText: He turns every room into a crematorium.

92411.Name: Collected Company
92411.FlavorText: Survivors who stay together, slay together.

92412.Name: Noxious Revival
92412.FlavorText:
"Nothing I beat down stays down. I love this place!"
—Tyvar

92413.Name: A-Unholy Heat
92413.FlavorText: He turns every room into a crematorium.

92450.Name: Swords to Plowshares
92450.FlavorText: At the Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center, Mr. Handy robots were repurposed for farming—and turning intruders into fertilizer.

92473.Name: Cultivate
92473.FlavorText: Like him, his tiny flower friend continued to grow larger each day.

92479.Name: Heroic Intervention
92479.FlavorText:
"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine

92505.Name: Arcane Signet
92505.FlavorText: Something to love, honor, and cherish—and a reminder of someone who once did that for you.

92516.Name: Mind Stone
92516.FlavorText:
"When facing a crisis, don't forget to squeeze your official Vault-Tec stress ball!"
—Overseer's Manual

92523.Name: Swiftfoot Boots
92523.FlavorText: "I don't need brakes. I usually find that if something stops me, it's interesting enough to stop for."

92539.Name: Clifftop Retreat
92539.FlavorText:
"From up here, you could almost imagine how it was before."
—Wasteland survivor

92540.Name: Command Tower
92540.FlavorText:
"New Vegas is more than a city—it's the remedy to mankind's derailment."
—Mr. House

92542.Name: Dragonskull Summit
92542.FlavorText: The Poseidon offshore oil rig became one of the Enclave's mightiest fortresses, and eventually, the site of their greatest defeat.

92543.Name: Drowned Catacomb
92543.FlavorText:
"Make no mistake, the rats run these tunnels. We just live here."
—Fiends gang member

92544.Name: Evolving Wilds
92544.FlavorText:
"One day, maybe, kids will play here again."
—Preston Garvey

92547.Name: Glacial Fortress
92547.FlavorText: Considered the greatest battle in history, Operation: Anchorage showcased the effectiveness of the winterized T-51b power armor.

92548.Name: Hinterland Harbor
92548.FlavorText: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.

92550.Name: Isolated Chapel
92550.FlavorText: The pride of Calverton was now the town's only marker.

92565.Name: Rootbound Crag
92565.FlavorText: Mutant strangler vines carried the town of Tanagra up into the treetops, where it remains to this day.

92575.Name: Sulfur Falls
92575.FlavorText: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.

92578.Name: Sunpetal Grove
92578.FlavorText:
"Must have been something to see a movie on a screen that big."
—Preston Garvey

92597.Name: Woodland Cemetery
92597.FlavorText: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.

92663.Name: Dawn's Truce
92663.FlavorText: "I have a child I want to return to as well," whispered Mabel.

92664.Name: Jackdaw Savior
92664.FlavorText:
Be the calm in the storm.
—Birdfolk saying

92666.Name: Starfall Invocation
92666.FlavorText: The boundaries of Valley are heavily defended. Especially at night.

92667.Name: Valley Questcaller
92667.FlavorText:
"Heroes grew as steadily as crops, and nourished our spirits."
—Wake of the Beasts

92671.Name: Dour Port-Mage
92671.FlavorText:
"Rations were tightly controlled."
—Wake of the Beasts

92673.Name: Mockingbird
92673.FlavorText: "Don't worry, your secrets are safe with me!" the birdfolk called back in the ratfolk's own voice.

92681.Name: Valley Rotcaller
92681.FlavorText: "Fighting the snake is to fight starvation itself. Strikes synchronize with hunger pangs."

92686.Name: Manifold Mouse
92686.FlavorText: "Oh? Do I need to repeat myself?"

92687.Name: Stormsplitter
92687.FlavorText:
"There was a bold young otterfolk / Who sailed for parts unknown, / Ignored the words her elders spoke, / And crewed the ship alone."
—Songs from Upstream

92688.Name: Valley Flamecaller
92688.FlavorText:
"The same heat with which we forge weapons may also forge friendships."
—Emberheart Forge inscription

92689.Name: For the Common Good
92689.FlavorText:
"Here's to good food, good friends, and a good life, together in our Valley."
—Lily Emberseed

92690.Name: Keen-Eyed Curator
92690.FlavorText:
"Raccoonfolk scoured the wreckage, hoping to reunite heirlooms with their owners."
—Tales from Downstream

92691.Name: Mistbreath Elder
92691.FlavorText:
Where you are is temporary. What you do is forever.
—Frogfolk saying

92692.Name: Scrapshooter
92692.FlavorText: When the woodlands are your armory, you can afford to travel light.

92693.Name: Tender Wildguide
92693.FlavorText:
"The community banded together to revitalize the scorched earth."
—Wake of the Beasts

92694.Name: Valley Mightcaller
92694.FlavorText:
"Creatures of all kinds united to patrol the outskirts."
—Wake of the Beasts

92695.Name: Alania, Divergent Storm
92695.FlavorText: While the storm raged, the sage took the lightning and wove a thunderous tapestry.

92705.Name: Flubs, the Fool
92705.FlavorText: He knows exactly where he's going and exactly how he isn't getting there.

92734.Name: Faithless Looting
92734.FlavorText: "If they didn't want me to steal this, they should've used more than seven layers of shatterproof antimagus glass."

92740.Name: Elvish Mystic
92740.FlavorText: "Just as new shoots rise from winter's slumber, so too will my people rise to greatness once again."

92745.Name: Arcane Signet
92745.FlavorText: Matic had only taken the ring to appease his grandmother when she'd pressed it insistently into his palm. As the rats scurried away from its light, he understood her urgency.

92751.Name: Command Tower
92751.FlavorText:
"I'm not sure who's in charge around here, but I'm pretty sure I know where to go to find out."
—Corliss the Wanderer

92765.Name: Balefire Dragon
92765.FlavorText: An unwelcome light on a dark and foggy night.

92777.Name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
92777.FlavorText: "I am the bridge between sea and sky. Wind and waves alike rise at my whim."

92783.Name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
92783.FlavorText: "If you travel only to reach a destination, you will miss the point of the journey."

92787.Name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
92787.FlavorText: "A life is meaningless until put to use."

92857.Name: Dawnwing Marshal
92857.FlavorText: "Horizon to horizon, mountain to sea. Everything within is ours to protect."

92859.Name: Faithful Pikemaster
92859.FlavorText: "I seek no fight with you, but neither will I stand aside."

92860.Name: Generous Pup
92860.FlavorText: They communicate via the universal language of treats.

92861.Name: Hinterland Sanctifier
92861.FlavorText: "You can learn a lot about a place just by asking the land how it's doing."

92862.Name: Delightful Discovery
92862.FlavorText: "What do you think? New class pet?"

92863.Name: Gilded Scuttler
92863.FlavorText: "ATTENTION BEACHGOERS: This is a litter-free zone. Violators will be pinched."

92864.Name: Phantasmal Shieldback
92864.FlavorText: It materialized in the mist, and the invading horde broke like waves against solid rock.

92866.Name: Revoke Demise
92866.FlavorText: "Arise, sister. Our journey has only just begun."

92867.Name: Scourge of the Undercity
92867.FlavorText: Her hunger for blood is matched only by her hunger for vengeance.

92868.Name: Wriggling Grub
92868.FlavorText: The professor of essence studies always relished the looks on the first-years' faces as their vivisections descended into chaos.

92869.Name: Dropkick Bomber
92869.FlavorText: "I've always enjoyed kicking stuff, so this was an ideal career opportunity."

92870.Name: Firespitter Whelp
92870.FlavorText: In subsequent terms, first-year students were prohibited from enrolling in Introduction to Dragonkeeping.

92873.Name: Hearts on Fire
92873.FlavorText:
"With you by my side, I am unstoppable."
—Halana, to Alena

92875.Name: Scholar of Combustion
92875.FlavorText: "If the fire is silent, I‘m technically not breaking the library rules!"

92876.Name: Go Forth
92876.FlavorText: Spark or no, Nissa would always be an explorer.

92877.Name: Hungry Megasloth
92877.FlavorText: It supplements its leafy diet with delicacies snatched from low-flying airships.

92878.Name: Razorgrass Invoker
92878.FlavorText: "Let the beauty of our land lull them so that they may stumble upon its hidden thorns."

92881.Name: Slimy Piper
92881.FlavorText: All throughout the glade, sprouts squelched happily along to the tune.

92882.Name: Spined Tyrranax
92882.FlavorText:
"Drive the beasts into the enemy ranks, then stay back and let them do the work."
—Koth

92883.Name: Woodland Liege
92883.FlavorText: "Your human laws mean nothing here. Plead your case before the tribunal of the wilds."

92884.Name: Shardless Outlander
92884.FlavorText: The Conflux proved that Alara's strength came from unity, not division.

92885.Name: Starnheim Memento
92885.FlavorText: Made from a feather from Firja's wing, it marks a worthy hero with the blessing of the valkyries.

92886.Name: Banishing Light
92886.FlavorText:
"The kami have declared that courtyard a no-fly zone."
—Light-Paws

92887.Name: Celestial Unicorn
92887.FlavorText:
"The true champion of the sun shall arrive on swift hooves, bearing a light to pierce the bleakest darkness."
—Korinna, Meletian oracle

92888.Name: Dauntless Onslaught
92888.FlavorText: Energized by a hearty lunch and a long nap in the afternoon sun, they were more than ready to take down any prey.

92889.Name: Mentor of the Meek
92889.FlavorText: "Considering your statures, let's start with the upward slash."

92891.Name: Raise the Alarm
92891.FlavorText: The city of Drannith danced to the music of the siege. Four bells meant a breach of the north wall. A horn blast meant all hands to arms. Additional gongs and tones indicated fire, poison, air raids, and more.

92893.Name: Steadfast Unicorn
92893.FlavorText: As the majestic creature pranced through the market, furious haggling calmed and arguments trailed off.

92894.Name: Tenacity
92894.FlavorText:
"Deep in the ugliness of war, she appeared to remind us of the love for which we fight."
—Syr Agata of Ardenvale

92895.Name: Drag Under
92895.FlavorText: One moment Dorica was meditating in her study, searching her mind for Thassa‘s guidance. Then, with a splash, she was underwater, face to face with a god.

92896.Name: Faerie Seer
92896.FlavorText: "Such dull wishes these humans make! To grant them as wished would be a dismal affair. Perhaps with a twist . . ."

92897.Name: Murmuring Mystic
92897.FlavorText: "Go on now, get up there and take a gander at what's beyond those hills for me."

92899.Name: Run Ashore
92899.FlavorText: Sand to the eyes was against the rules. Unfortunately, there was no referee.

92900.Name: Sudden Insight
92900.FlavorText: He sought to peer beneath the surface of the moon. Instead, he peeled back the skin of reality itself.

92901.Name: Uncomfortable Chill
92901.FlavorText:
"Tormented screams are like snowflakes: no two are quite the same."
—Pedor, ice witch

92902.Name: Bonecaller Cleric
92902.FlavorText: "My blood was never my own. I carried it gladly for the Hungering One, and at last she arises to reclaim it."

92903.Name: Dark Bargain
92903.FlavorText: Under Ormendahl's demonic influence, Bishop Jerren became the perfect agent of bloody blasphemy.

92904.Name: Dark Confidant
92904.FlavorText: "Newly conjured demons arrive confused, angry, and unsure how to direct their cruelty. I offer a few fun suggestions."

92905.Name: Deadly Dispute
92905.FlavorText: Fortune may favor the bold, but it also flattens the foolhardy.

92906.Name: Eaten Alive
92906.FlavorText: Flesh untouched by plague was a rare delicacy for the hungry creatures in Guul Draz.

92907.Name: Eternal Taskmaster
92907.FlavorText: Sometimes she considered how much easier it would have been to stay dead.

92908.Name: Grim Bounty
92908.FlavorText: The Dusk Legion demanded a share of the gold. The pirates happily obliged.

92909.Name: Howling Banshee
92909.FlavorText:
"No such thing as ‘too quiet.' Quiet is good. Quiet means we don't end up dead in the mud, bleeding from our ears."
—Rem Karolus

92910.Name: Killing Glare
92910.FlavorText: "Now really, was that the expression you wanted preserved on your face forever?"

92911.Name: Priest of Gix
92911.FlavorText: "Take my mind, so it may serve the will of Phyrexia. Take my flesh, so I may become compleat."

92912.Name: Sangromancer
92912.FlavorText: "Capenna needs some new blood. Preferably spilled by us."

92913.Name: Serpent Assassin
92913.FlavorText:
"Patrol didn't find a single footprint, Captain. We should be safe to rest here."
—Lowell, army scout

92915.Name: Skymarch Bloodletter
92915.FlavorText: "Looks like my Blood Fast is about to end early."

92918.Name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
92918.FlavorText: The staff flared and rattled erratically, every twirl driving the wolf to greater heights of rage.

92919.Name: Beetleback Chief
92919.FlavorText: Great goblin warlords lead vast hordes into battle from atop mighty siege-beasts. Lesser chiefs get a couple of squires and a big bug.

92920.Name: Blood Feud
92920.FlavorText: No wedding between rival vampire dynasties is complete without a few attempted murders at the reception.

92921.Name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
92921.FlavorText: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

92923.Name: Destructive Digger
92923.FlavorText: "Depending what's behind that boulder, we're either about to be very rich or very disintegrated."

92925.Name: Fathom Fleet Firebrand
92925.FlavorText: As her pulse quickened, the snakes on her arms flared and writhed, eager to sink their fangs into the coming fray.

92926.Name: Goblin Fireslinger
92926.FlavorText: The explorers didn't understand the lone sentry's jabbering, but they offered gold for passage. The counteroffer was a face full of molten rock.

92927.Name: Goblin Smuggler
92927.FlavorText: "No one here but us empty barrels!"

92928.Name: Guttersnipe
92928.FlavorText: "Your steel fails you, surface-dweller. Perhaps I will reforge the fragments into something less embarrassing."

92929.Name: Kiln Fiend
92929.FlavorText: Born of fire yet not immune to it, the fiend lashes out in mindless rage, spurred by constant agony.

92931.Name: Seize the Spoils
92931.FlavorText: Slibbo was tired of following Korvold's draconian library rules.

92932.Name: Volley Veteran
92932.FlavorText: They didn't fire in unison, nor in the same direction. Most didn't even use arrows. Somehow it worked perfectly.

92933.Name: Zealous Conscripts
92933.FlavorText: Only those who strike without a moment's hesitation may earn Hazoret's favor.

92934.Name: Biogenic Upgrade
92934.FlavorText:
"Our state-of-the-art laboratories have been stripped of bothersome safety measures."
—Radula, Simic biomancer

92935.Name: Elvish Visionary
92935.FlavorText: "If you cling to the safety of the roots, you'll never climb high enough to see through the canopy."

92936.Name: Explore
92936.FlavorText: As he crested the final peak, Nidd gasped at the beauty laid out before him. Finally, he had found a place to rest his weary legs. A place to call home.

92937.Name: Forgotten Ancient
92937.FlavorText: Once revered, then hunted, and now beyond memory.

92938.Name: Gift of the Gargantuan
92938.FlavorText: To Alara's Wild Nacatl, the greatest blessing is to be spared by the behemoths.

92939.Name: Llanowar Elves
92939.FlavorText: "This forest is your birthright. From now until your final breath, you and Llanowar are bound. Keep each other safe."

92940.Name: Undercellar Myconid
92940.FlavorText:
"Granted, we were trying to make perfume, but I'd still say the experiment was a success!"
—George, underground alchemist

92941.Name: Chromatic Lantern
92941.FlavorText: The beacon shone over the city, its lights a message to every traveler: whoever you are, you belong here.

92942.Name: Leonin Scimitar
92942.FlavorText: "Our enemies may be more metal than flesh. Good reason to wield a blade that will cut either."

92943.Name: Ornithopter of Paradise
92943.FlavorText: Every evening a rainbow of industry illuminates the skies above Eiganjo.

92944.Name: Ash Barrens
92944.FlavorText:
"You should have granted us an audience. Instead, you now reign over a kingdom of ruins."
—Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker

92946.Name: Terramorphic Expanse
92946.FlavorText: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.

92947.Name: Agonizing Syphon
92947.FlavorText:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

92950.Name: Army of the Damned
