92950.FlavorText: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

92951.Name: Arrogant Outlaw
92951.FlavorText: The debased remnants of the Falkenrath bloodline prowl the passes near their ruined castles.

92952.Name: Audacious Thief
92952.FlavorText: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."

92954.Name: Bastion of Remembrance
92954.FlavorText: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

92955.Name: Bleed Dry
92955.FlavorText:
"Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized."
—Anje Falkenrath

92957.Name: Blood Burglar
92957.FlavorText:
"You've heard that a vampire can't enter a home without an invitation? A lie meant to help you sleep at night."
—Kerin, watch sergeant

92959.Name: Bloodgift Demon
92959.FlavorText: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

92960.Name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
92960.FlavorText: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

92961.Name: Bloodtithe Collector
92961.FlavorText: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

92962.Name: Boneclad Necromancer
92962.FlavorText: "Living or dead, everyone responds to the proper motivation."

92963.Name: Coat with Venom
92963.FlavorText:
"Every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of our dragonlord."
—Xathi the Infallible

92964.Name: Contract Killing
92964.FlavorText: For a price, the floating city of High and Dry offers all the amenities a pirate could want: rest, recreation, and revenge.

92966.Name: Creeping Bloodsucker
92966.FlavorText:
"If a vampire were feeding on you every night, wouldn't you have bite marks? Stop wasting my time."
—Donya, village healer

92967.Name: Crooked Custodian
92967.FlavorText: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."

92969.Name: Dark Supplicant
92969.FlavorText: Cabal clerics serve two masters: their patriarch and their god.

92970.Name: Deal Gone Bad
92970.FlavorText:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus

92971.Name: Defenestrate
92971.FlavorText: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.

92972.Name: Devouring Swarm
92972.FlavorText: Their arrival is heralded by the deafening hum of ten thousand wings. Their departure is marked by the silence of the dead.

92973.Name: Dire Fleet Hoarder
92973.FlavorText: Among the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, the only thing more dangerous than failure is success.

92974.Name: Diregraf Scavenger
92974.FlavorText: It can barely feel the sword anymore.

92975.Name: Disfigure
92975.FlavorText: With a snap of metal like a strike of lightning, the tide of war shifted in Mishra's favor.

92976.Name: Doomed Dissenter
92976.FlavorText: The most dangerous place to be in Kessig is alone.

92977.Name: Doomed Necromancer
92977.FlavorText: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

92978.Name: Dreadhound
92978.FlavorText: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

92979.Name: Dross Hopper
92979.FlavorText: Bred in the vicious Mephidross, dross hoppers learned to eat quickly and escape faster.

92980.Name: Durable Coilbug
92980.FlavorText:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

92983.Name: Elderfang Disciple
92983.FlavorText: "One day, the great serpent will rejoin us on Skemfar, and those who've wronged us will taste of our venom."

92984.Name: Endless Cockroaches
92984.FlavorText: There is nothing more repulsive than a cockroach—except a cockroach and all its friends.

92986.Name: Epicure of Blood
92986.FlavorText: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

92987.Name: Expedition Skulker
92987.FlavorText: Rogues bring an array of useful skills to the work of an adventuring party: stealth, agility, the ability to locate and disarm traps, and a subtle, deadly fighting style.

92988.Name: Exsanguinate
92988.FlavorText: Vampires don't consider patience a virtue nor gluttony a sin.

92989.Name: Extinguish the Light
92989.FlavorText: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.

92990.Name: Eye Collector
92990.FlavorText: "Lord Rankle will see you now—all he asks is a small token of tribute."

92992.Name: Falkenrath Noble
92992.FlavorText: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

92993.Name: Foul Play
92993.FlavorText: The evidence was overwhelming. Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.

92994.Name: Fretwork Colony
92994.FlavorText: The swarm leaves behind a flawless pattern that only occasionally threatens the structural integrity of the wood.

92995.Name: Gift of Fangs
92995.FlavorText:
"You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?"
—Runo Stromkirk

92997.Name: Gnawing Zombie
92997.FlavorText: On still nights you can hear its rotted teeth grinding tirelessly on scavenged bones.

92998.Name: Go for the Throat
92998.FlavorText: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down. Mishra made her people pay for the insult.

93001.Name: Grave Strength
93001.FlavorText: So long as death follows life, the supply lines of the Sultai will never be cut.

93003.Name: Gravedigger
93003.FlavorText: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

93004.Name: Harvester of Souls
93004.FlavorText:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

93007.Name: Infernal Grasp
93007.FlavorText: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

93008.Name: Koma's Faithful
93008.FlavorText: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."

93010.Name: Masked Blackguard
93010.FlavorText: Her footsteps are whispers, her passage a last breath.

93011.Name: Midnight Assassin
93011.FlavorText: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.

93012.Name: Moan of the Unhallowed
93012.FlavorText: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

93013.Name: Moment of Craving
93013.FlavorText: "The time of condemnation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and I consign you to eternal darkness!"

93015.Name: Morbid Opportunist
93015.FlavorText: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

93016.Name: Morkrut Behemoth
93016.FlavorText:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

93017.Name: Morkrut Necropod
93017.FlavorText:
"There's not enough salt in all of Nephalia to wither that thing."
—Ghoulcaller Enslow

93018.Name: Murder
93018.FlavorText:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

93019.Name: Nantuko Husk
93019.FlavorText:
"The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace."
—Nantuko teaching

93020.Name: Necropolis Regent
93020.FlavorText: "Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot."

93021.Name: Necrotic Wound
93021.FlavorText: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

93022.Name: Night's Whisper
93022.FlavorText:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

93024.Name: Persistent Specimen
93024.FlavorText:
"The jaw bone's connected to the skull bone. The skull bone's connected to the . . . uh . . . hook thingy."
—Garl, stitcher's assistant

93025.Name: Pharika's Chosen
93025.FlavorText: The serpents' dens built into statues of Pharika serve not only to consecrate her temples, but as a hidden line of defense.

93027.Name: Pitiless Plunderer
93027.FlavorText: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

93028.Name: Powerstone Fracture
93028.FlavorText:
"Move! When the powerstone blows, that behemoth will be nothing but a hole in the ground."
—Ashnod, to Hajar

93029.Name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
93029.FlavorText: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

93030.Name: Read the Bones
93030.FlavorText: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

93031.Name: Reaper from the Abyss
93031.FlavorText: "Avacyn has deserted you. I welcome your devotion in her stead."

93032.Name: Reassembling Skeleton
93032.FlavorText:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

93034.Name: Ruthless Knave
93034.FlavorText: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."

93036.Name: Sanctum Seeker
93036.FlavorText: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

93038.Name: Scion of the Swarm
93038.FlavorText: Vampires are now masters of their own fates, commanders of their own legions.

93039.Name: Severed Strands
93039.FlavorText: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

93042.Name: Subtle Strike
93042.FlavorText: Silence is an underrated hunting strategy.

93043.Name: Swarm of Bloodflies
93043.FlavorText: Despite the name, they'll happily devour the flesh too.

93045.Name: Thirsting Bloodlord
93045.FlavorText: "A whole life, full of memories and experience, love and sorrow, drained drop by drop into this bottle. Could any feast be more glorious?"

93046.Name: Torment of Scarabs
93046.FlavorText: Like a carpet unrolling for their god, the scarabs poured out from the necropolis.

93047.Name: Tragic Slip
93047.FlavorText: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

93048.Name: Typhoid Rats
93048.FlavorText: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.

93049.Name: Ukud Cobra
93049.FlavorText:
"The Silumgar hide behind the deadly wildlife of their swamps. They'd rather scheme in their jungle palaces than face us."
—Khibat, Kolaghan warrior

93050.Name: Ulcerate
93050.FlavorText:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

93052.Name: Undercity Scrounger
93052.FlavorText: "That will pay for another arm extension all by itself! Well, as long as it doesn't explode."

93054.Name: Vampire Nighthawk
93054.FlavorText: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

93055.Name: Vampire of the Dire Moon
93055.FlavorText: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."

93056.Name: Vampire Scrivener
93056.FlavorText: No one remains on her list for long.

93057.Name: Venomous Hierophant
93057.FlavorText: "Many have sought snake-twined Pharika's panacea. Do you wish to share their fate?"

93058.Name: Vicious Conquistador
93058.FlavorText:
"He is ambitious. Tireless. And utterly ruthless. Ideal for the frontier."
—Viceroy Elia Sotonores, report to the queen

93059.Name: Village Rites
93059.FlavorText: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

93060.Name: Virus Beetle
93060.FlavorText:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

93061.Name: Vraska's Finisher
93061.FlavorText: "You might have pleaded your case with my queen earlier. Now I am here, and it is far too late."

93062.Name: Wailing Ghoul
93062.FlavorText:
"Don't worry, sweet brother. Help is on the way."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

93063.Name: Wakedancer
93063.FlavorText: Havengul wakes are widely regarded as great entertainment. If you're lucky, the guest of honor climbs out of the casket and joins in the festivities.

93064.Name: Academy Journeymage
93064.FlavorText: "We don't choose who comes here. We choose how long they stay."

93065.Name: Aerial Guide
93065.FlavorText:
"Kefnet taught us to turn obstacles into advantages."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet

93067.Name: Air Elemental
93067.FlavorText: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

93068.Name: Archaeomancer
93068.FlavorText: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

93069.Name: Augur of Bolas
93069.FlavorText: "There is no future save the one my master wills."

93070.Name: Aven Reedstalker
93070.FlavorText: "Our best chance against the Eternals will be tactics they've never seen and styles they've never trained in."

93071.Name: Azure Drake
93071.FlavorText: More so than "storm" or "pirate," "drake" is the word a sailor least wants to hear.

93073.Name: Breaching Hippocamp
93073.FlavorText: Don't try to ride this steed unless you've got gills too.

93074.Name: Brineborn Cutthroat
93074.FlavorText: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

93075.Name: Bury in Books
93075.FlavorText: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

93078.Name: Cartouche of Knowledge
93078.FlavorText: Cartouches chronicle the initiates' achievements in the trials.

93080.Name: Chilling Trap
93080.FlavorText:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder

93081.Name: Choking Tethers
93081.FlavorText: A wizard can be outnumbered but never outsmarted.

93082.Name: Chrome Prowler
93082.FlavorText: It can catch a rat and perform a spinal tap with one graceful swipe of its paw.

93083.Name: Cloudkin Seer
93083.FlavorText: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

93084.Name: Concentrate
93084.FlavorText: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

93085.Name: Cruel Witness
93085.FlavorText:
"I escaped, so why do I still feel like I'm being watched?"
—Gregel, militia leader

93086.Name: Crystacean
93086.FlavorText: It loves blending into its environment, ambushing prey, and long scuttles on the beach.

93088.Name: Draugr Thought-Thief
93088.FlavorText: The worst part is that you won't even remember how much he's taken from you.

93089.Name: Exclusion Mage
93089.FlavorText: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

93090.Name: Expedition Diviner
93090.FlavorText: Wizards' spells twist the fabric of reality to channel elemental energies, peer into the future, and even calm the Roil.

93091.Name: Expendable Lackey
93091.FlavorText:
"Altonio? No, I'm sorry. No one by that name works here."
—Raffine

93092.Name: Experimental Aviator
93092.FlavorText: "The little thopters seemed lonely up here, so I thought I'd join them."

93093.Name: Fading Hope
93093.FlavorText: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

93094.Name: Faerie Vandal
93094.FlavorText: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.

93095.Name: Filigree Attendant
93095.FlavorText:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dexterous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

93096.Name: Frost Trickster
93096.FlavorText: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.

93097.Name: Gearseeker Serpent
93097.FlavorText: Its collection is vast, yet each ship has a special place in its heart.

93098.Name: Glimmerbell
93098.FlavorText:
"Their paths aren't random, but they don't float with the wind. Could they be following surges in crystalline energy?"
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist

93099.Name: Gust of Wind
93099.FlavorText: Skysail's strength was also its vulnerability.

93100.Name: Haunting Figment
93100.FlavorText: Some bad dreams stay with you forever.

93101.Name: Kapsho Kitefins
93101.FlavorText:
"It's a truly disconcerting sight to see their shadows cast upon the deck."
—Captain Triff

93102.Name: Krovikan Mist
93102.FlavorText: Plague-induced dreams became real as they swirled above Krov, mingling with the magical residue of the World Spell.

93103.Name: Lat-Nam Adept
93103.FlavorText: "Every book is a doorway to enlightenment. Curiosity is your key."

93104.Name: Locked in the Cemetery
93104.FlavorText: "Help! I'm not a zombie! Let me out!"

93105.Name: Lord of the Unreal
93105.FlavorText: "The dream does not end until I say so."

93106.Name: Majestic Metamorphosis
93106.FlavorText: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

93107.Name: Malcator's Watcher
93107.FlavorText: Each of the Gitaxian sectives watches the others, looking for any hint of imperfection.

93108.Name: Malfunction
93108.FlavorText: "They don't make them like they used to."

93109.Name: Merfolk Pupil
93109.FlavorText: Maintaining a personal bubble is even more important when you have gills.

93113.Name: Muse Drake
93113.FlavorText: A composer wrote a symphony based on the drakes screeching outside her window. Reviews were mixed—except among the drakes.

93114.Name: Mystic Skyfish
93114.FlavorText: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

93116.Name: Naiad of Hidden Coves
93116.FlavorText:
"Wave-borne, he watches over secrets of the shore."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

93117.Name: Network Disruptor
93117.FlavorText: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."

93118.Name: Nightveil Sprite
93118.FlavorText:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

93120.Name: Oneirophage
93120.FlavorText: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

93121.Name: Opportunity
93121.FlavorText: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

93122.Name: Opt
93122.FlavorText: "It's easy to anticipate Captain Storm's orders: take the more dangerous route."

93123.Name: Organ Hoarder
93123.FlavorText: The stitcher died years ago, but her dutiful assistant still keeps the laboratory well stocked.

93124.Name: Overflowing Insight
93124.FlavorText: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

93126.Name: Pestermite
93126.FlavorText: The fae know when they're not wanted. That's precisely why they show up.

93127.Name: Phantasmal Form
93127.FlavorText: Within each of us lurks the fathomless.

93128.Name: Phantom Ninja
93128.FlavorText:
"Ninjas can run across water, pull ladders from pockets, kill with a kiss, and slip between bricks. Pack of lies, I say."
—Benden, teahouse gossip

93130.Name: Purple-Crystal Crab
93130.FlavorText: A precious shell without, a delicious taste within.

93132.Name: Remand
93132.FlavorText: "Well, at least all of that arm-waving and arcane babbling you did was impressive."

93134.Name: Serpentine Ambush
93134.FlavorText: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.

93136.Name: Shipwreck Dowser
93136.FlavorText: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

93137.Name: Shore Keeper
93137.FlavorText: Over their long life spans, the larger trilobites accumulate vast treasure troves in their guts.

93138.Name: Shorecomber Crab
93138.FlavorText: Though Captain Riptide's corpse was mostly recovered from the shipwreck, no one ever managed to find his favorite hat.

93139.Name: Sigiled Starfish
93139.FlavorText: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

93140.Name: Silent Departure
93140.FlavorText: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

93141.Name: Sky-Eel School
93141.FlavorText: They swim on tides few can see, away from a threat few yet understand.

93142.Name: Slimebind
93142.FlavorText:
"Relax. It's quite harmless. And it will dissolve completely in a month or two."
—Navona, Simic field tester

93144.Name: Soul Read
93144.FlavorText: It's easy to be two steps ahead when you can see their every thought.

93145.Name: Spectral Sailor
93145.FlavorText:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

93146.Name: Sphinx of Enlightenment
93146.FlavorText: "I would be a fool if I taught you everything I know."

93147.Name: Sprite Noble
93147.FlavorText: "By thorn and by stone, we will fight to see the day when beauty returns to this world."

93150.Name: Stitched Drake
93150.FlavorText:
"The best skaab are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

93151.Name: Stolen by the Fae
93151.FlavorText: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

93153.Name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
93153.FlavorText:
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi

93154.Name: Thopter Mechanic
93154.FlavorText: "You want me to install a seat belt? Please. You're lucky to get a seat!"

93155.Name: Thought Monitor
93155.FlavorText: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

93156.Name: Thoughtcast
93156.FlavorText: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

93157.Name: Tide Skimmer
93157.FlavorText: Fishing boats often follow hunting drakes to find the largest schools of fish.

93158.Name: Tidepool Turtle
93158.FlavorText: Prized by wizards as a mobile scrying pool, it bears visions drawn from the depths of the sea.

93159.Name: Tolarian Kraken
93159.FlavorText:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration

93160.Name: Towering-Wave Mystic
93160.FlavorText: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

93162.Name: Undersea Invader
93162.FlavorText:
"The currents are strange today, and the fish are fearful. Something's stirring in the depths."
—Rathstaf, Kannah fisherman

93163.Name: Vexing Gull
93163.FlavorText:
"May the skies be clear of gales and gulls."
—Meletian prayer

93164.Name: Voracious Greatshark
93164.FlavorText: There is no boat big enough.

93165.Name: Waker of Waves
93165.FlavorText: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.

93166.Name: Wall of Lost Thoughts
93166.FlavorText: Those who intrude upon the Dimir seldom remember that they have done so.

93167.Name: Warden of Evos Isle
93167.FlavorText: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

93168.Name: Waterkin Shaman
93168.FlavorText: "They come to drink, to bathe, and—I believe—to play."

93169.Name: Wavebreak Hippocamp
93169.FlavorText: Tritons search for omens in its wake.

93171.Name: Wind Strider
93171.FlavorText: "Currents are currents, whether in sea or sky."

93172.Name: Windcaller Aven
93172.FlavorText: Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.

93173.Name: Windreader Sphinx
93173.FlavorText: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

93174.Name: Windstorm Drake
93174.FlavorText: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

93175.Name: Winged Words
93175.FlavorText: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

93176.Name: Witching Well
93176.FlavorText: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

93177.Name: Yarok's Wavecrasher
93177.FlavorText:
"Yarok's waters rush and rage
Where armies bled into the sand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 2

93178.Name: Adventure Awaits
93178.FlavorText: "Good, we're all here. Let's get started!"

93179.Name: Adventurous Impulse
93179.FlavorText: Every odyssey begins with a single step.

93180.Name: Advocate of the Beast
93180.FlavorText: "I am neither their drover nor their leader. To these majestic beasts, I am simply their herdmate and nothing more."

93181.Name: Aggressive Instinct
93181.FlavorText:
"Mowu was wary that day, as though he sensed the danger ahead."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

93182.Name: Ainok Artillerist
93182.FlavorText:
"In the Tarkir I once knew, the Abzan revered their ancestor trees. Now, as Dromoka, they cut their finest groves to make weapons."
—Sarkhan Vol

93184.Name: Ambassador Oak
93184.FlavorText: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

93186.Name: Arbor Armament
93186.FlavorText:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

93187.Name: Armorcraft Judge
93187.FlavorText: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

93188.Name: Armored Kincaller
93188.FlavorText:
"She's devoted to protecting her herd. We're just lucky she considers us part of it."
—Huatli

93190.Name: Baloth Gorger
93190.FlavorText: A baloth only cares about the many things it eats and the few things that eat it.

93191.Name: Baloth Woodcrasher
93191.FlavorText: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

93192.Name: Band Together
93192.FlavorText: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

93193.Name: Big Play
93193.FlavorText:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

93194.Name: Bite Down
93194.FlavorText:
"Yavimaya takes care of herself; the kavu are evidence of this. What does your Coalition offer that the forest cannot provide?"
—Jenson Carthalion

93195.Name: Bond of Flourishing
93195.FlavorText: "We agree that life should flourish. We disagree on the optimal number of limbs."

93196.Name: Bounty of Skemfar
93196.FlavorText: Even war cannot dull Skemfar's beauty.

93198.Name: Brushstrider
93198.FlavorText: Magistrate Ludy agreed to designate land for the brushstriders only after several broken windows and dozens of missing blini-cakes.

93200.Name: Byway Courier
93200.FlavorText: A good courier travels fast and asks no questions.

93201.Name: Canopy Baloth
93201.FlavorText:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

93202.Name: Cherished Hatchling
93202.FlavorText: Despite its appearance, it's anything but defenseless.

93203.Name: Clear Shot
93203.FlavorText: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

93204.Name: Colossal Dreadmaw
93204.FlavorText: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

93206.Name: Deepwood Denizen
93206.FlavorText: "You didn't come all this way just to bother me, did you? Say your piece and be gone."

93207.Name: Defend the Celestus
93207.FlavorText: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

93208.Name: Drover of the Mighty
93208.FlavorText: "I do not lead. They do not follow. We walk together."

93209.Name: Drowsing Tyrannodon
93209.FlavorText: What the rangers thought were warning growls turned out to be nothing but monstrous snoring.

93210.Name: Druid of the Anima
93210.FlavorText: Although the Anima herself remains at the Sacellum, her druids roam Naya, collecting mana bonds with every location in the world.

93211.Name: Duskshell Crawler
93211.FlavorText: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.

93212.Name: Dwynen's Elite
93212.FlavorText:
"Come, my beautiful brothers and sisters. Let us hunt."
—Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf daen

93213.Name: Elvish Archdruid
93213.FlavorText: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

93214.Name: Fierce Witchstalker
93214.FlavorText: While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.

93215.Name: For the Family
93215.FlavorText: The Cabaretti cultivate an image of harmless hedonism, happy for the other families to underestimate their formidable firepower.

93216.Name: Fungal Plots
93216.FlavorText: Thallids nurture saprolings, entertain them, and eat them.

93218.Name: Garruk's Packleader
93218.FlavorText:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

93219.Name: Ghirapur Guide
93219.FlavorText: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

93220.Name: Giant Growth
93220.FlavorText:
"Only the most effective tactics stand the test of time."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

93221.Name: Giant Opportunity
93221.FlavorText: They look tasty, but best to plant them.

93223.Name: Grazing Gladehart
93223.FlavorText:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

93224.Name: Greenwood Sentinel
93224.FlavorText: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

93226.Name: Harrow
93226.FlavorText: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

93227.Name: Heir of the Ancient Fang
93227.FlavorText: On the last day of a Jukai agent's training, they are bequeathed a powerful relic blessed by the kami.

93228.Name: High-Rise Sawjack
93228.FlavorText: Slicing girders, rescuing trapped workers, killing gigantic rust flies—one tool does it all!

93230.Name: Insatiable Appetite
93230.FlavorText: He ate them out of house and home and shed and barn and flock and herd.

93231.Name: Invigorating Surge
93231.FlavorText: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

93232.Name: Ivy Lane Denizen
93232.FlavorText: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

93236.Name: Jungle Delver
93236.FlavorText: "There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."

93237.Name: Kazandu Nectarpot
93237.FlavorText:
"The scythe-like forelegs are crucial for its survival, because it tastes really good and every inhabitant of Murasa knows it."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

93238.Name: Kazandu Stomper
93238.FlavorText: Elves revere cycles of renewal, but they prefer cycles that don't involve their homes getting smashed.

93240.Name: Kujar Seedsculptor
93240.FlavorText: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

93241.Name: Leaf-Crowned Visionary
93241.FlavorText: "The seedling you save today may be the sheltering boughs of generations to come."

93242.Name: Llanowar Visionary
93242.FlavorText: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.

93243.Name: Lotus Cobra
93243.FlavorText: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.

93245.Name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
93245.FlavorText: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

93247.Name: Might of the Masses
93247.FlavorText:
"There is nothing stronger than many hearts united for a single cause."
—Emmara

93248.Name: Moldgraf Millipede
93248.FlavorText: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

93249.Name: Murasa Ranger
93249.FlavorText: "If you're not prepared to fight, you'd best be prepared to die."

93253.Name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
93253.FlavorText: One day the spirit and mortal realms will be one. Until then, she faithfully guards the sites where they merge.

93254.Name: Overcome
93254.FlavorText:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

93255.Name: Overwhelm
93255.FlavorText: The Conclave acts with a single will, expressed by countless warriors.

93256.Name: Paradise Druid
93256.FlavorText: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

93257.Name: Predator's Strike
93257.FlavorText: If you hear it coming, you're not its prey.

93262.Name: Rampant Growth
93262.FlavorText: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

93264.Name: Reckless Amplimancer
93264.FlavorText: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"

93266.Name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
93266.FlavorText: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

93267.Name: Saproling Migration
93267.FlavorText: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

93270.Name: Skyclave Pick-Axe
93270.FlavorText: For use on cliffs and other faces.

93271.Name: Snakeskin Veil
93271.FlavorText: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

93272.Name: Snapping Gnarlid
93272.FlavorText: All of Zendikar's beings sense the upheaval that accompanies the Eldrazi.

93274.Name: Spore Crawler
93274.FlavorText:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

93275.Name: Spore Swarm
93275.FlavorText: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

93276.Name: Sporecrown Thallid
93276.FlavorText:
"The identifying ornamental growths of alpha thallids may be hereditary, or catalyzed by some chemical signal."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. III

93277.Name: Sporemound
93277.FlavorText:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

93278.Name: Stony Strength
93278.FlavorText: "What you build, we will destroy . . . and bury you in the rubble!"

93280.Name: Tajuru Pathwarden
93280.FlavorText: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

93281.Name: Territorial Scythecat
93281.FlavorText: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.

93282.Name: Thornweald Archer
93282.FlavorText: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

93283.Name: Thrashing Brontodon
93283.FlavorText:
"I suppose we'll just hope those ancient monoliths lost to our people for centuries weren't particularly important."
—Toxayac, Sun Empire historian

93284.Name: Thundering Spineback
93284.FlavorText:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

93291.Name: Tukatongue Thallid
93291.FlavorText: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

93296.Name: Voice of the Woods
93296.FlavorText: "Ancient ones, I call on you, your wisdom and your power, your will to claim again all that is rightfully yours."

93299.Name: Woodland Champion
93299.FlavorText: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

93302.Name: Enlisted Wurm
93302.FlavorText: A match for any army—even its own.

93303.Name: Fusion Elemental
93303.FlavorText: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

93305.Name: Chief of the Foundry
93305.FlavorText: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

93306.Name: Cliffhaven Kitesail
93306.FlavorText: Made from canvas, wood, and hope.

93307.Name: Eager Construct
93307.FlavorText: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

93309.Name: Gingerbrute
93309.FlavorText: Sometimes, "as fast as you can" isn't quite fast enough.

93312.Name: Maelstrom Colossus
93312.FlavorText:
"Nothing of the Maelstrom is quiet or easy."
—Ajani Goldmane

93314.Name: Myr Enforcer
93314.FlavorText: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

93315.Name: Patchwork Automaton
93315.FlavorText: It dwells happily near the ever-burning forges of Sokenzan City, crafting small things of beauty from discarded scraps.

93316.Name: Prophetic Prism
93316.FlavorText: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

93317.Name: Relic Axe
93317.FlavorText: "It's light as a feather, but it hits with the force of a boulder. A very sharp boulder."

93319.Name: Universal Solvent
93319.FlavorText:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

93320.Name: Whirlermaker
93320.FlavorText:
"Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves."
—Saheeli Rai

93323.Name: Evolving Wilds
93323.FlavorText: The Eldrazi may be ruthless, but Zendikar is relentless.

93331.Name: Seat of the Synod
93331.FlavorText: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

93333.Name: Thriving Bluff
93333.FlavorText: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

93334.Name: Thriving Grove
93334.FlavorText: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

93335.Name: Thriving Heath
93335.FlavorText: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

93336.Name: Thriving Isle
93336.FlavorText: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

93337.Name: Thriving Moor
93337.FlavorText: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

93338.Name: Vault of Whispers
93338.FlavorText: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

93341.Name: Akroan Crusader
93341.FlavorText: An Akroan soldier's worth is measured by the number of swords raised by his battle cry.

93344.Name: Arena Athlete
93344.FlavorText: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.

93345.Name: Bathe in Dragonfire
93345.FlavorText: The scent of cooked flesh lingers in the charred landscape of Tarkir.

93348.Name: Blood Hypnotist
93348.FlavorText: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

93350.Name: Bloodfire Expert
93350.FlavorText: Some efreet abandon their homes in the volcanic Fire Rim to embrace the Jeskai Way and discipline their innate flames.

93352.Name: Boggart Brute
93352.FlavorText: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

93354.Name: Brute Strength
93354.FlavorText: "Oketra had our crop build an obelisk to prove the power of working together. But I am stronger without the weak."

93355.Name: Cartouche of Zeal
93355.FlavorText: The fifth cartouche is the final affirmation of glory, granted only to the worthy dead.

93356.Name: Chandra's Spitfire
93356.FlavorText: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

93358.Name: Coordinated Assault
93358.FlavorText: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.

93359.Name: Crimson Wisps
93359.FlavorText: The whispers are incomprehensible, yet cinders always hear a message of urgency.

93361.Name: Daybreak Combatants
93361.FlavorText: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

93362.Name: Dragon Hatchling
93362.FlavorText:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

93364.Name: Dragonlord's Servant
93364.FlavorText: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

93366.Name: Emberhorn Minotaur
93366.FlavorText: "My stride will break only against the twin points of Hazoret's spear."

93367.Name: Expedition Champion
93367.FlavorText: Warriors are combat specialists who bring their deadly skills to bear against the many foes that adventurers face in the course of their journeys.

93370.Name: Fanatical Firebrand
93370.FlavorText:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

93371.Name: Fiendish Duo
93371.FlavorText: Half the size, double the mayhem.

93373.Name: Fire Prophecy
93373.FlavorText:
"Water and bone tell many tales, but fire is fickle. It would rather consume than reveal."
—Rielle, the Everwise

93374.Name: Firebrand Archer
93374.FlavorText: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.

93375.Name: Fissure Wizard
93375.FlavorText: He might call up a burst of lava or a raging hellion from Akoum's volcanic depths. Or he might just fall in.

93376.Name: Fists of Flame
93376.FlavorText:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

93377.Name: Flame-Blessed Bolt
93377.FlavorText:
"I noticed you were short on party favors, so I brought my own."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

93378.Name: Flames of the Firebrand
93378.FlavorText:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

93379.Name: Fling
93379.FlavorText: Never flinch. Never falter. Never fear.

93380.Name: Furious Reprisal
93380.FlavorText:
"Now that's the Chandra I've been waiting to see."
—Liliana Vess

93381.Name: Goblin Arsonist
93381.FlavorText: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

93385.Name: Goblin Researcher
93385.FlavorText: Slonk was struck by lightning twenty-seven times before he got the idea. Another forty-three hits and he'd perfected it.

93386.Name: Goblin Trailblazer
93386.FlavorText:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, Diremore first mate

93387.Name: Goma Fada Vanguard
93387.FlavorText:
"Her weapon's impressive, sure. But you should see her wield it."
—Gred, expedition warrior

93388.Name: Hellkite Whelp
93388.FlavorText:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler

93389.Name: Hero of the Games
93389.FlavorText: Winners of the Iroan Games are forever remembered as heroes of their people.

93391.Name: Infuriate
93391.FlavorText:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign

93393.Name: Invigorated Rampage
93393.FlavorText: Gremlins can change from pest to problem to plague in the span of a moment.

93394.Name: Jaya's Firenado
93394.FlavorText:
"For all their supposed advances, the Phyrexians still aren't fireproof."
—Jaya Ballard

93396.Name: Keldon Raider
93396.FlavorText: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

93397.Name: Kindled Fury
93397.FlavorText: The minotaur stared at the Eternal bearing down on him—the embodiment of deadly skill he had aspired to become.

93399.Name: Kruin Striker
93399.FlavorText: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

93400.Name: Markov Blademaster
93400.FlavorText: "Mortals practice swordplay for a few decades at best. How can they ever attain the exquisite mastery that eternity has to offer?"

93403.Name: Markov Warlord
93403.FlavorText: "What use is a stake or holy symbol in the hands of a coward?"

93404.Name: Minotaur Sureshot
93404.FlavorText: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."

93406.Name: Mogg Flunkies
93406.FlavorText: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

93408.Name: Neonate's Rush
93408.FlavorText:
"We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast."
—Anje Falkenrath

93409.Name: Open Fire
93409.FlavorText: Some khenra archers fashion their arrows with a personal touch.

93410.Name: Pathmaker Initiate
93410.FlavorText: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."

93411.Name: Pigment Storm
93411.FlavorText: When art projects collapse, Prismari students revel in the beauty of destruction. Everyone else runs for cover.

93412.Name: Play with Fire
93412.FlavorText: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

93413.Name: Pyrophobia
93413.FlavorText:
"I hate this! I hate fire! I hate you for taking me on this route!"
—Norin the Wary

93414.Name: Rapacious Dragon
93414.FlavorText:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

93415.Name: Reckless Impulse
93415.FlavorText: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.

93416.Name: Renegade Tactics
93416.FlavorText: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

93417.Name: Resistance Skywarden
93417.FlavorText: When the Vulshok taught him the word for "home," he knew it was what he had been fighting for.

93418.Name: Roil Eruption
93418.FlavorText:
"Our feeble villages and tiny encampments stand only at the whim of the Roil."
—The Invokers' Tales

93420.Name: Sarkhan's Rage
93420.FlavorText: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

93421.Name: Satyr Hoplite
93421.FlavorText: "Xenagos has become what he once despised: a tyrant and an oppressor."

93424.Name: Shock
93424.FlavorText:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

93425.Name: Soul Sear
93425.FlavorText: There was no witty retort, no confident boast to accompany the attack. There was only pain.

93426.Name: Sparktongue Dragon
93426.FlavorText: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

93427.Name: Spellgorger Weird
93427.FlavorText: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

93431.Name: Trueheart Twins
93431.FlavorText: Shoulder to shoulder until blade must turn against blade.

93433.Name: Uncaged Fury
93433.FlavorText: The cage is a crucible for the rage that builds inside, refining it into something pure and terrible.

93434.Name: Unleash Fury
93434.FlavorText: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

93435.Name: Unstoppable Ogre
93435.FlavorText: Touma never met a door he didn't hate.

93436.Name: Vampiric Fury
93436.FlavorText: Many peasants secretly admire vampires' glamour and elegance—until they witness a moment of pure bloodlust.

93438.Name: Voldaren Duelist
93438.FlavorText: "I have yet to find my equal."

93439.Name: Voldaren Epicure
93439.FlavorText: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

93440.Name: Weaselback Redcap
93440.FlavorText:
"I would rather cast myself into the abyss than let my blood stain the cap of those monsters."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

93441.Name: Weaver of Lightning
93441.FlavorText: "Lightning in a bottle? That's not where I need it."

93442.Name: Wildfire Elemental
93442.FlavorText:
"Fire is always dancing, leaping and whirling, seeking more fuel. It never rests, so why should I?"
—Chandra Nalaar

93444.Name: Young Pyromancer
93444.FlavorText: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

93445.Name: Zealot of the God-Pharaoh
93445.FlavorText: The God-Pharaoh's most devoted took it upon themselves to follow his example.

93447.Name: Ajani's Pridemate
93447.FlavorText:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

93448.Name: Akroan Skyguard
93448.FlavorText: "Trust me. When you have earned a god's favor, you'll know."

93450.Name: Angel of Mercy
93450.FlavorText: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

93453.Name: Angelic Edict
93453.FlavorText: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

93454.Name: Angelic Gift
93454.FlavorText: "Zendikar will triumph this day, and our armies will fly with angels."

93455.Name: Archon of Falling Stars
93455.FlavorText:
"The archon fell like a star from the sky, meeting the rising sun at the horizon's edge."
—The Cosmogony

93457.Name: Argivian Phalanx
93457.FlavorText: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.

93459.Name: Basri's Acolyte
93459.FlavorText: Basri carries on his god's legacy, spreading her teachings throughout the Multiverse.

93461.Name: Basri's Solidarity
93461.FlavorText:
"The will to fight and act as one is not limited to a single world. Oketra's teachings are universal."
—Basri Ket

93462.Name: Battlefield Promotion
93462.FlavorText: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

93463.Name: Bishop's Soldier
93463.FlavorText: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

93464.Name: Brightmare
93464.FlavorText: A ray of hope in the darkest night.

93466.Name: Captivating Unicorn
93466.FlavorText:
"Gazing at the unicorn, I felt closer to the majesty of Nyx than I ever had before."
—Oineus, traveling merchant

93468.Name: Celestial Enforcer
93468.FlavorText: "I look to the heavens for hope, but you will kneel."

93470.Name: Chosen by Heliod
93470.FlavorText:
"Training and studies aid a soldier in meager amounts. The gods do the rest."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

93473.Name: Daybreak Chaplain
93473.FlavorText: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."

93474.Name: Deadly Riposte
93474.FlavorText:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

93475.Name: Defend the Campus
93475.FlavorText: Professors scrambled to push the mage hunters back, leaving the heart of Strixhaven undefended.

93476.Name: Defiant Strike
93476.FlavorText: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

93477.Name: Desperate Lunge
93477.FlavorText: Ravnica held its breath as the hero of the resistance—their last hope—flew through the sky, his dark sword ready to strike a god.

93478.Name: Destroy Evil
93478.FlavorText: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

93479.Name: Divine Arrow
93479.FlavorText: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

93480.Name: Divine Favor
93480.FlavorText: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

93481.Name: Dreadful Apathy
93481.FlavorText: Those whose lives were uninspired are doomed to the wretched tedium of Phylias in death.

93482.Name: Elite Skirmisher
93482.FlavorText: Some adopted the tactics of the leonin to combat the ferocity of the minotaurs.

93486.Name: Favored of Iroas
93486.FlavorText: "The promise of victory fills my heart. There is no room for fear."

93488.Name: Fencing Ace
93488.FlavorText: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

93489.Name: Flutterfox
93489.FlavorText:
"The fox grinned. ‘How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—Tales of the Fae

93490.Name: Gavony Silversmith
93490.FlavorText: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.

93491.Name: Gird for Battle
93491.FlavorText:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia

93492.Name: Glory Bearers
93492.FlavorText: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

93494.Name: Golden-Tail Disciple
93494.FlavorText: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.

93495.Name: Herald of the Sun
93495.FlavorText: "Fear neither clouds nor darkness. The light shall overcome them all."

93498.Name: Impeccable Timing
93498.FlavorText: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

93499.Name: Indomitable Will
93499.FlavorText:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas

93500.Name: Ingenious Leonin
93500.FlavorText: Leonin claws were already deadly weapons of natural evolution before he improved upon them.

93501.Name: Inspiring Overseer
93501.FlavorText:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

93502.Name: Jubilant Mascot
93502.FlavorText: The competition is but one aspect of the spectacle.

93503.Name: King of the Pride
93503.FlavorText:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

93504.Name: Leonin of the Lost Pride
93504.FlavorText: Leonin band together in the Underworld, taking solace in their strength until, at last, both pride and self are forgotten.

93505.Name: Leonin Vanguard
93505.FlavorText: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

93508.Name: Light the Way
93508.FlavorText: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."

93509.Name: Lightwalker
93509.FlavorText:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

93511.Name: Make a Stand
93511.FlavorText: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

93513.Name: Mesa Unicorn
93513.FlavorText: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

93515.Name: Militant Inquisitor
93515.FlavorText: "I am an instrument of the church wielded against Avacyn's enemies."

93517.Name: Moment of Heroism
93517.FlavorText: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

93518.Name: Moment of Triumph
93518.FlavorText: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

93519.Name: Nykthos Paragon
93519.FlavorText: Though Heliod turned against humanity in his hunger for power, the ideals he once championed still stand strong.

93520.Name: Nyx-Fleece Ram
93520.FlavorText: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.

93522.Name: Outflank
93522.FlavorText:
"With the drum of hooves and a flash of blades, the monster's terrifying roar changed to a cry of fear."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights

93523.Name: Pacifism
93523.FlavorText: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

93524.Name: Paladin of the Bloodstained
93524.FlavorText: Closely linked to the Church of Dusk, the paladins of the Bloodstained order are devout to the point of fanaticism.

93525.Name: Parhelion Patrol
93525.FlavorText: "Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."

93526.Name: Patron of the Valiant
93526.FlavorText: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

93527.Name: Rally of Wings
93527.FlavorText: Even the clouds became a field of battle. Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.

93528.Name: Recruitment Officer
93528.FlavorText: "Every name on this list is already a hero! Will you add your own to it?"

93529.Name: Recumbent Bliss
93529.FlavorText: Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.

93530.Name: Relief Captain
93530.FlavorText: Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.

93531.Name: Repel the Darkness
93531.FlavorText: A boon to those who cannot see in the dark. A bane to those who live in it.

93532.Name: Resistance Reunited
93532.FlavorText: "Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes!" said Koth. "I was about to say the same, my friend," Elspeth replied.

93533.Name: Revitalize
93533.FlavorText: Esika alone knows how to distill the essence of the World Tree into the Cosmos Elixir, a magical substance which grants the Skoti god-family immortality.

93534.Name: Rhox Faithmender
93534.FlavorText: Rhoxes who live long enough to retire from war lend support with their extensive knowledge of combat injuries.

93536.Name: Ronom Unicorn
93536.FlavorText: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

93538.Name: Savannah Lions
93538.FlavorText:
One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable.
—Benalish proverb

93539.Name: Search Party Captain
93539.FlavorText: "Werewolves leave messy trails. Easy to follow. Hard to forget."

93540.Name: Serra Angel
93540.FlavorText: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

93541.Name: Serra's Embrace
93541.FlavorText: The touch of Serra's angels bears hopes aloft and empowers noble causes.

93542.Name: Shield Mare
93542.FlavorText: When it passes, order defeats chaos.

93543.Name: Shoulder to Shoulder
93543.FlavorText:
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."
—Gideon Jura

93544.Name: Speakeasy Server
93544.FlavorText: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."

93545.Name: Spirited Companion
93545.FlavorText: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

93546.Name: Squad Captain
93546.FlavorText: The strength of the one is the strength of the many.

93548.Name: Star Pupil
93548.FlavorText: "When I'm done here, they'll name entire buildings after me."

93549.Name: Starfield Mystic
93549.FlavorText: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

93550.Name: Starnheim Courser
93550.FlavorText: Every worthy warrior who arrives in Starnheim is gifted a mount befitting their heroism, a mighty pegasus raised and trained by the valkyries.

93551.Name: Steadfast Sentry
93551.FlavorText: "Get up, slugabeds! We've got company, and they're not dressed for a party!"

93552.Name: Stone Haven Outfitter
93552.FlavorText: The makers and menders are the first called to battle and the last to leave.

93554.Name: Sungrace Pegasus
93554.FlavorText: The sacred feathers of the pegasus are said to have healing powers.

93555.Name: Sunhome Stalwart
93555.FlavorText: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"

93556.Name: Sunmane Pegasus
93556.FlavorText: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

93557.Name: Sunspear Shikari
93557.FlavorText: Raksha's sudden departure split the leonin into two prides. The fight for survival reunited them.

93558.Name: Swift Response
93558.FlavorText:
"There's nothing quite as satisfying as delivering a good kick to the face."
—Adrasteia, Akroan captain

93559.Name: Take Up the Shield
93559.FlavorText: "You are all part of my pride. As long as I live, I will protect you."

93560.Name: Tethmos High Priest
93560.FlavorText: "Death is tyranny. Like all tyranny, it must be opposed."

93561.Name: Thopter Architect
93561.FlavorText: "She'll only fly once. Make it count!"

93563.Name: Trusty Retriever
93563.FlavorText: Wipe away the slobber and it's as good as new, give or take a few bite marks.

93568.Name: Wingsteed Rider
93568.FlavorText: Trust is the only bridle a pegasus will accept.

93569.Name: Youthful Valkyrie
93569.FlavorText: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

93572.Name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
93572.FlavorText: "I've beaten far better than you, in far greater numbers. So go ahead, draw your swords."

93574.Name: Naban, Dean of Iteration
93574.FlavorText: "Good work, but I know you can do better. Try again."

93576.Name: Sai, Master Thopterist
93576.FlavorText: "Do not mistake complexity for brilliance. It takes a master to perfect a simple design."

93577.Name: Syr Elenora, the Discerning
93577.FlavorText: She rode forth from Vantress an emissary, a marshal, and a paragon of style.

93578.Name: Thryx, the Sudden Storm
93578.FlavorText: "I see no heroes upon this field. Only tinder awaiting my spark."

93583.Name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
93583.FlavorText: "Sign or don't, it makes little difference to me. It is your fate that hangs in the balance."

93584.Name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
93584.FlavorText: "Oppose us and die a heretic. Join us and be blessed with immortality."

93587.Name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
93587.FlavorText: If she commands it, her subjects will burn the world to ash.
93587.ArtistCredit: マツモト ミツアキ/M.Matsumoto

93589.Name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
93589.FlavorText: She pulverizes each hedron and consumes the dust, absorbing the power within.

93590.Name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
93590.FlavorText: Various cultures of Ixalan tell stories of the monsters of legend that ended up as gristle between Ghalta's teeth.

93592.Name: Mowu, Loyal Companion
93592.FlavorText: In his sleep, he twitched and snarled, dreaming of glorious battle against the undead hordes.

93593.Name: Averna, the Chaos Bloom
93593.FlavorText: "Soil and stone, hear my call! Branch and bone, yield your all!"

93599.Name: Cynette, Jelly Drover
93599.FlavorText: "Once you build up an immunity to their deadly venom, they're really quite cuddly!"

93601.Name: Plagon, Lord of the Beach
93601.FlavorText: "No more lurking in the shallows. We ride!"

93602.Name: Pol Jamaar, Illusionist
93602.FlavorText: "‘Real' is a more flexible concept than you might think."

93609.Name: Rev, Tithe Extractor
93609.ArtistCredit: マツモト ミツアキ/M.Matsumoto

93611.Name: Cleon, Merry Champion
93611.FlavorText: "Let us dance 'round the funeral pyres of our foes!"

93612.Name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
93612.FlavorText: To cross swords with her is a shockingly bad idea.

93615.Name: Braulios of Pheres Band
93615.FlavorText: "Your claim to this land is as tenuous as my tolerance of your presence on it."

93616.Name: Dionus, Elvish Archdruid
93616.FlavorText: "My people are like the great magnigoth trees. We've seen ice, flood, invasions, and wars, yet our roots remain strong."

93618.Name: Shroofus Sproutsire
93618.FlavorText: His laughter—and everything else about him—was infectious.

93624.Name: A-Speakeasy Server
93624.FlavorText: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."

93625.Name: A-Steadfast Unicorn
93625.FlavorText: As the majestic creature pranced through the market, furious haggling calmed and arguments trailed off.

93626.Name: A-Deal Gone Bad
93626.FlavorText:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus

93627.Name: A-Midnight Assassin
93627.FlavorText: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.

93628.Name: A-Vampire Scrivener
93628.FlavorText: No one remains on her list for long.

93629.Name: A-Goma Fada Vanguard
93629.FlavorText:
"Her weapon's impressive, sure. But you should see her wield it."
—Gred, expedition warrior

93631.Name: A-High-Rise Sawjack
93631.FlavorText: Slicing girders, rescuing trapped workers, killing gigantic rust flies—one tool does it all!

93632.Name: A-Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
93632.FlavorText: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

93636.Name: Hinterland Sanctifier
93636.FlavorText: "You can learn a lot about a place just by asking the land how it's doing."

93637.Name: Adamant Will
93637.FlavorText: "I refuse to die before I see the sun rise again."

93638.Name: Ancestor Dragon
93638.FlavorText: From emperors to paupers, every citizen of Shenmeng pays reverence to the mighty ancestor dragons.

93639.Name: Angelic Edict
93639.FlavorText: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

93640.Name: Bishop's Soldier
93640.FlavorText: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

93641.Name: Deadly Riposte
93641.FlavorText:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

93642.Name: Elspeth's Smite
93642.FlavorText: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.

93643.Name: Herald of Faith
93643.FlavorText: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.

93644.Name: Ingenious Leonin
93644.FlavorText: Leonin claws were already deadly weapons of natural evolution before he improved upon them.

93645.Name: Inspiring Overseer
93645.FlavorText: The angels were determined to show a city run by demons that there was a better path.

93647.Name: Leonin Skyhunter
93647.FlavorText: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

93648.Name: Leonin Vanguard
93648.FlavorText: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

93649.Name: Moment of Triumph
93649.FlavorText: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

93650.Name: Pacifism
93650.FlavorText:
"If only they'd all act this docile. I could do something relaxing for a living. I've always wanted to bake biscuits."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

93651.Name: Prayer of Binding
93651.FlavorText:
"We do not make martyrs of villains. We leave them and their vile ideologies to be forgotten."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

93653.Name: Burrog Befuddler
93653.FlavorText: Students who seek river herbs in Doradur quickly find themselves slightly damp and thoroughly surrounded.

93654.Name: Cancel
93654.FlavorText: "I decide what stands in my way."

93655.Name: Corsair Captain
93655.FlavorText: "Lungs full of sea air and a hold full of loot. Ah, what a life!"

93657.Name: Exclusion Mage
93657.FlavorText: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

93658.Name: Into the Roil
93658.FlavorText: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

93659.Name: Kitesail Corsair
93659.FlavorText: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

93660.Name: Mystic Archaeologist
93660.FlavorText: The delight of discovery drives the pursuit of knowledge.

93661.Name: Opt
93661.FlavorText: Teferi had once wielded the power—and hubris—of a god. To fix his mistakes, he would risk everything.

93662.Name: Quick Study
93662.FlavorText: At first, Johann was annoyed that the library had decided to reorganize itself. But he had to admit that storing the cookbooks in the cauldron made a certain kind of sense.

93664.Name: Storm Fleet Spy
93664.FlavorText: "They're searching in the same direction we are. And for the same thing, I'll wager."

93665.Name: Bloodtithe Collector
93665.FlavorText: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

93666.Name: Cemetery Recruitment
93666.FlavorText: To a necromancer as powerful as Liliana Vess, a graveyard is as good as a garrison of soldiers awaiting her command.

93669.Name: Deadly Plot
93669.FlavorText:
"Open grave available, only one previous tenant."
—Sign on cemetery gate

93670.Name: Death Baron
93670.FlavorText: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

93671.Name: Highborn Vampire
93671.FlavorText: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

93672.Name: Maalfeld Twins
93672.FlavorText:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

93673.Name: Moment of Craving
93673.FlavorText: The vampires of the Dusk Legion undertake Blood Fasts to strengthen their wills, but not all can control their hunger.

93674.Name: Offer Immortality
93674.FlavorText: "Give all you are to Phyrexia, and you will receive more than you could have ever desired."

93675.Name: Skeleton Archer
93675.FlavorText:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

93676.Name: Suspicious Shambler
93676.FlavorText: It was the perfect disguise—at least until its stomach started moaning.

93677.Name: Undying Malice
93677.FlavorText: Lazlo was going to find the jerks who stabbed him in the back and stab them in their fronts.

93678.Name: Untamed Hunger
93678.FlavorText:
"Mindlessness is not weakness. When we are lost to hunger we are unstoppable."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

93679.Name: Vampire Interloper
93679.FlavorText: He hovers silently above the city, scouting for when the ripest necks pass through the darkest alleys.

93680.Name: Vampire Neonate
93680.FlavorText: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.

93681.Name: Vampire Spawn
93681.FlavorText: Unsuccessful vampire hunters often wind up as ravenous spawn.

93682.Name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
93682.FlavorText: A few moments of her rattle's infuriating clattering is enough to provoke even lifelong pacifists into a howling, violent rage.

93683.Name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
93683.FlavorText: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

93684.Name: Dragon Fodder
93684.FlavorText: Gnorl and Vurg knew all too well how much dragons liked to eat goblins, but they had a dream that could not be dampened: they were going to be the first goblins to eat a dragon.

93685.Name: Dragonlord's Servant
93685.FlavorText: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

93686.Name: Dropkick Bomber
93686.FlavorText: "I've always enjoyed kicking stuff, so this was an ideal career opportunity."

93687.Name: Fire Elemental
93687.FlavorText:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

93688.Name: Goblin Oriflamme
93688.FlavorText:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV

93689.Name: Goblin Smuggler
93689.FlavorText: "No one here but us empty barrels!"

93690.Name: Kargan Dragonrider
93690.FlavorText: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

93691.Name: Kindled Fury
93691.FlavorText: "Fiends! Cowards! Your days of slaughtering innocents are done. It's time to face a real warrior!"

93692.Name: Raging Redcap
93692.FlavorText: Many tales of redcap terror begin with two simple things: bloodlust and stolen steel.

93693.Name: Rapacious Dragon
93693.FlavorText:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

93694.Name: Scorching Dragonfire
93694.FlavorText: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

93695.Name: Seize the Spoils
93695.FlavorText: Slibbo was tired of following Korvold's draconian library rules.

93696.Name: Skyraker Giant
93696.FlavorText: She will not be content until hers is the highest head in the sky.

93697.Name: Swab Goblin
93697.FlavorText: Though small, goblins can hold their own in a fight. Foolhardy confidence goes a long way.

93698.Name: Terror of Mount Velus
93698.FlavorText: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

93699.Name: Volley Veteran
93699.FlavorText: They didn't fire in unison, nor in the same direction. Most didn't even use arrows. Somehow it worked perfectly.

93700.Name: Aggressive Mammoth
93700.FlavorText:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

93701.Name: Bear Cub
93701.FlavorText:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

93702.Name: Biogenic Upgrade
93702.FlavorText:
"Our state-of-the-art laboratories have been stripped of bothersome safety measures."
—Radula, Simic biomancer

93703.Name: Druid of the Cowl
93703.FlavorText: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

93704.Name: Joraga Invocation
93704.FlavorText:
"A single tree does not a forest make. We are stronger when we stand together."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

93705.Name: Magnigoth Sentry
93705.FlavorText: When one of Yavimaya's enormous magnigoth trees awakens into a treefolk, it is a towering presence of physical strength and ancient wisdom.

93707.Name: Tajuru Pathwarden
93707.FlavorText: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

93708.Name: Thornweald Archer
93708.FlavorText: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

93709.Name: Thrashing Brontodon
93709.FlavorText: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

93710.Name: Wildheart Invoker
93710.FlavorText:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—The Invokers' Tales

93711.Name: Goblin Firebomb
93711.FlavorText:
"And if this works, Tawnos is gonna let us build the full-sized version!"
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

93713.Name: Uncharted Haven
93713.FlavorText:
"There are lands beyond Valley. Wild, calamity-scarred, and beautiful."
—Farfeather, birdfolk scout

93714.Name: Sire of Seven Deaths
93714.FlavorText: Born of the infinite void between realities, the Eldrazi have one goal: to consume.

93715.Name: Arahbo, the First Fang
93715.FlavorText: It's said all cats in the Multiverse trace their lineage back to him, from the meekest kitten to the mightiest lion.

93716.Name: Armasaur Guide
93716.FlavorText: The armasaur was skittish about the lanterns, until it noticed the captivating dance of its shadow along the walls.

93717.Name: Cat Collector
93717.FlavorText: "Why so many? Because they need a home, just like I once did."

93719.Name: Claws Out
93719.FlavorText:
"I'm sure we can spare a little of today's catch for a hungry friend. Or two. Or five. Or . . . seven . . ."
—Lars, fisherman

93721.Name: Dauntless Veteran
93721.FlavorText: "Courage is not the absence of fear. Courage is choosing to face your fear, spit in its face, and refuse to let it hold you back."

93722.Name: Dazzling Angel
93722.FlavorText: Her wings ripple with impossible colors—a sign that a miracle is on the way.

93724.Name: Exemplar of Light
93724.FlavorText: "I will not rest until you know peace."

93725.Name: Felidar Savior
93725.FlavorText: Cut and bruised from his climb to the summit, Zahr wept with relief when he saw the felidar's horns appear.

93726.Name: Fleeting Flight
93726.FlavorText: On that fateful day, Sir Brilbury's fear of heights was outmatched by his sense of duty.

93727.Name: Guarded Heir
93727.FlavorText: The fate of the kingdom is tied to her own. Until she's old enough to rule, her vassals will not leave her side.

93728.Name: Hare Apparent
93728.FlavorText: Most families have trees. His has an entire forest.

93729.Name: Helpful Hunter
93729.FlavorText:
"Ah, the conquering hero returns! What trials did you face, little one?"
—Basri Ket

93730.Name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
93730.FlavorText: "I am the light that breaks the darkness."

93731.Name: Inspiring Paladin
93731.FlavorText: As the line faltered, the thunder of hoofbeats heralded desperately needed aid.

93733.Name: Luminous Rebuke
93733.FlavorText: The monstrous bird swooped in for the kill, only to be met by a concentrated blast of pure, searing moonlight.

93734.Name: Prideful Parent
93734.FlavorText: One day, the future king will protect a pride of his own. For now, he defends his family from the terror of the swishy tail.

93735.Name: Raise the Past
93735.FlavorText: At Strixhaven University, learning about the past means talking to those who were there.

93736.Name: Skyknight Squire
93736.FlavorText: Before Pashin could become the greatest skyknight in the kingdom, he'd have to survive his first flight.

93737.Name: Squad Rallier
93737.FlavorText: Between the call of the bugler and the shrill squawk of her mount, not a soul slept through morning muster.

93741.Name: Vanguard Seraph
93741.FlavorText: She guides expedition parties through the perilous floating ruins of Zendikar's ancient empires.

93742.Name: Arcane Epiphany
93742.FlavorText: For years, the tome pulsed with forgotten spells and secrets, hungry for a mind strong enough to read it.

93743.Name: Archmage of Runes
93743.FlavorText: He's so intent on his study that others think him frozen in place.

93744.Name: Bigfin Bouncer
93744.FlavorText: "You know how to swim, don't ya, chum?"

93746.Name: Clinquant Skymage
93746.FlavorText: Despite their advanced intellect, some aven never quite shake their instinctive need to collect shiny baubles.

93749.Name: Elementalist Adept
93749.FlavorText: "Mana is all around us, ready to take shape. We need only reach out and guide it."

93750.Name: Erudite Wizard
93750.FlavorText: "Pretty baubles and gilded palaces may appeal to the egotist, but true wealth comes only through knowledge."

93751.Name: Faebloom Trick
93751.FlavorText:
"A face full of pollen? That's probably the nicest thing a faerie will ever give you!"
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

93752.Name: Grappling Kraken
93752.FlavorText:
"Oh, settle down. She just wants a hug."
—Kiora

93753.Name: High Fae Trickster
93753.FlavorText: To the High Fae, spells that take a human years to master come as easily as breathing.

93754.Name: Homunculus Horde
93754.FlavorText:
"That is why you triple-check all decimals when commissioning a new batch of homunculi!"
—Trigori, Azorius senator

93755.Name: Icewind Elemental
93755.FlavorText: It surveys its domain on wings of ice, bringing misfortune to all who dare trespass.

93756.Name: Inspiration from Beyond
93756.FlavorText: When seeking spiritual enlightenment, best to go directly to the source.

93759.Name: Lunar Insight
93759.FlavorText: "The night sky is generous with its secrets. We need only learn its language."

93760.Name: Mischievous Mystic
93760.FlavorText: "Don't worry about where they're taking me. The more pressing question is, why aren't they taking you?"

93762.Name: Rune-Sealed Wall
93762.FlavorText:
"If the giant, repelling wards aren't enough to keep out nosy visitors, the huge wall should help."
—Kastigan, reclusive runecaster

93763.Name: Skyship Buccaneer
93763.FlavorText:
"It's a pirate's nature to be free of law. Gravity is no exception."
—Kari Zev, skyship captain

93766.Name: Uncharted Voyage
93766.FlavorText: As his ship passed the waterlogged wrecks, Markos realized he wasn't the first person to try sailing out of the Underworld.

93767.Name: Abyssal Harvester
93767.FlavorText:
"Till the soil, spare no soul. / Neath the darkness, nightmares grow."
—Children's nursery rhyme

93770.Name: Blasphemous Edict
93770.FlavorText:
"A demonic pact is all fun and games until the bill comes due."
—Liliana Vess

93771.Name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
93771.FlavorText: "This town swims with such exquisite blood. I will take every drop for my own."

93774.Name: High-Society Hunter
93774.FlavorText: "You've been a marvelous servant. Consider this your final assignment."

93775.Name: Hungry Ghoul
93775.FlavorText: All at once, the warden realized the string of mysterious escapes was an entirely different problem.

93776.Name: Infernal Vessel
93776.FlavorText: "Rise, my liege! Rise, and blanket the world in eternal night!"

93777.Name: Infestation Sage
93777.FlavorText: "I control the swarm. If you strike me down, there will be nothing left to hold back their hunger."
