93779.Name: Nine-Lives Familiar
93779.FlavorText: Her master gathered the bones to resurrect her, only to find her purring on the altar.

93780.Name: Revenge of the Rats
93780.FlavorText:
"The cats are behaving oddly today. Almost like they're all scared of something."
—Entry in a heavily chewed journal

93781.Name: Sanguine Syphoner
93781.FlavorText: As life returned to the bogs of Bala Ged, the vampires returned to feed upon it.

93782.Name: Seeker's Folly
93782.FlavorText: While searching the foreboding woods for his favorite helmet, Syr Verlor lost his second-favorite helmet.

93783.Name: Soul-Shackled Zombie
93783.FlavorText: The ritual successfully rebound her soul to her body, but not quite in the way she'd planned.

93784.Name: Stab
93784.FlavorText: Elgin's final mistake was assuming an intruder would come through the door, and not up the sheer, smooth, six-story wall.

93786.Name: Tragic Banshee
93786.FlavorText: She attended her own burial service, eager for company.

93787.Name: Vampire Gourmand
93787.FlavorText: "He asked me if I wanted to come in for a bite to eat. Who am I to turn down a stranger's kindness?"

93788.Name: Vampire Soulcaller
93788.FlavorText: "Don't worry, little friends. We will not be hungry much longer."

93789.Name: Vengeful Bloodwitch
93789.FlavorText: "You thought I was unarmed? Poor fool—your veins are my arsenal."

93791.Name: Battlesong Berserker
93791.FlavorText: The thud of her axe striking armor and flesh gives rhythm to her song of bloody victory.

93792.Name: Boltwave
93792.FlavorText:
"Taming a storm is like taming a wild beast; once you understand its wants and needs, you can direct it any way you like."
—Ral Zarek

93793.Name: Bulk Up
93793.FlavorText: Norf would win the arm-wrestling contest this year, at any cost.

93796.Name: Crackling Cyclops
93796.FlavorText: What he lacks in depth perception, he makes up for in charged potential.

93797.Name: Dragon Trainer
93797.FlavorText: "I was hardly a month old when he hatched. We grew up together. Even shared a crib!"

93798.Name: Electroduplicate
93798.FlavorText: The dragon roared and the storm thundered back.

93799.Name: Fiery Annihilation
93799.FlavorText:
"Fireproof or your money back!"
—Jornald's Arms and Armor (out of business)

93800.Name: Goblin Boarders
93800.FlavorText:
"SPLIT THE SKULLS AND SPLIT THE SPOILS!"
—Breeches, munitions master

93801.Name: Goblin Negotiation
93801.FlavorText: Either you pay for Krenko's "protection" or you pay to replace your stall. Either way, you pay.

93802.Name: Gorehorn Raider
93802.FlavorText: Anyone fast enough to dodge her horns and parry her cutlass just gets kicked overboard.

93803.Name: Incinerating Blast
93803.FlavorText: Most pyromancers could never summon the sheer heat necessary to melt solid rock, but most pyromancers aren't Chandra Nalaar.

93805.Name: Rite of the Dragoncaller
93805.FlavorText: All at once, a quiet world was seized by wings, claws, fangs, and fire.

93806.Name: Searslicer Goblin
93806.FlavorText: Ikko hadn't intended to start a riot, but now that it was under way, he was having a lot of fun.

93807.Name: Slumbering Cerberus
93807.FlavorText: The plan seemed to be going perfectly, until Mino realized the third head was no longer snoring.

93808.Name: Sower of Chaos
93808.FlavorText: After a few minutes in the cathar's attire, Vizrik started getting all kinds of new ideas.

93810.Name: Twinflame Tyrant
93810.FlavorText:
"Job only paid enough for one head. I'm out."
—Peren, veteran mercenary

93811.Name: Ambush Wolf
93811.FlavorText: It lies perfectly still and silent for hours, concealed in the undergrowth, until its prey draws close enough to strike.

93812.Name: Apothecary Stomper
93812.FlavorText: A walking clinic with a trumpet to sound its arrival.

93813.Name: Beast-Kin Ranger
93813.FlavorText: "We smelled you coming from a mile away, outsider."

93816.Name: Elfsworn Giant
93816.FlavorText: He upheld his vow to the elves by watching their woods and blazing their trails.

93817.Name: Elvish Regrower
93817.FlavorText: "There you are, little friends! You've been sleeping for a long time, but it's time to wake up now."

93821.Name: Needletooth Pack
93821.FlavorText:
"Nature's greatest predators sometimes come in small packages. A lot of small packages."
—Vivien Reid

93822.Name: Preposterous Proportions
93822.FlavorText: Their acorn hunt was unsuccessful, but they did find the wizard's experimental potion cache.

93823.Name: Quakestrider Ceratops
93823.FlavorText:
"For the first time in all my travels, I've encountered a creature I can only describe as an apex herbivore."
—Vivien Reid

93827.Name: Treetop Snarespinner
93827.FlavorText: The griffins think they rule the sky, but the spiders know better.

93829.Name: Anthem of Champions
93829.FlavorText: Setessa is protected by four warrior factions, each named for an animal. United, they can repel any threat to their polis.

93830.Name: Ashroot Animist
93830.FlavorText: "We will burn down the old growth of civilization and nurture what sprouts from the ashes."

93831.Name: Dreadwing Scavenger
93831.FlavorText: It scours battlefields for corpses, consuming flesh and souls alike.

93832.Name: Elenda, Saint of Dusk
93832.FlavorText: "You have learned nothing in my absence."

93834.Name: Koma, World-Eater
93834.FlavorText: The gods imprisoned Koma, fearing he would eventually devour the Cosmos itself.

93836.Name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
93836.FlavorText: Ravnica's sharpest mind and its biggest ego.

93837.Name: Perforating Artist
93837.FlavorText: The first three rows of the audience are marketed as the "slash zone."

93838.Name: Wardens of the Cycle
93838.FlavorText: "The wheel turns, and what meets its end begins again."

93839.Name: Zimone, Paradox Sculptor
93839.FlavorText: "Extraplanar geometry isn't so hard once you get used to thinking in twelve dimensions."

93843.Name: Quick-Draw Katana
93843.FlavorText:
"Draw swiftly, strike cleanly, and sheathe before the ground tastes blood."
—Munetsugu Takeno, Way of the Samurai

93844.Name: Ravenous Amulet
93844.FlavorText: Each of its owners' final moments is remembered within the roiling stone.

93845.Name: Scrawling Crawler
93845.FlavorText: It spreads the machine gospel of New Phyrexia, its task incomplete until all surrender to perfection.

93846.Name: Soulstone Sanctuary
93846.FlavorText: By tradition, travelers touched the pillar for good luck. One day, it decided to travel as well.

93848.Name: Ajani's Pridemate
93848.FlavorText: Once rejected by his pride, Ajani is now revered by countless leonin as a healer and, more importantly, a friend.

93849.Name: Angel of Finality
93849.FlavorText: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

93850.Name: Authority of the Consuls
93850.FlavorText: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

93851.Name: Banishing Light
93851.FlavorText:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—The Theriad

93852.Name: Cathar Commando
93852.FlavorText: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

93853.Name: Day of Judgment
93853.FlavorText: Clerics on both sides prayed for divine intervention to end the war. The gods didn't play favorites.

93854.Name: Giada, Font of Hope
93854.FlavorText: Now she is New Capenna's greatest hope.

93855.Name: Healer's Hawk
93855.FlavorText: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

93856.Name: Make Your Move
93856.FlavorText:
"If you're thinking only one step ahead, you're already falling behind."
—Teysa

93857.Name: Mischievous Pup
93857.FlavorText: As far as the dog was concerned, anything that fit in its mouth was a toy.

93858.Name: Resolute Reinforcements
93858.FlavorText: Morale rarely survives the sudden appearance of a squad of Sursi skirmishers at an army's flank.

93859.Name: Savannah Lions
93859.FlavorText:
One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable.
—Benalish proverb

93860.Name: Serra Angel
93860.FlavorText: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

93861.Name: Stroke of Midnight
93861.FlavorText:
"Who was that knight, so graceful and strong? Why did she flee before the food was gone?"
—Tale of the Masked Maiden

93862.Name: Youthful Valkyrie
93862.FlavorText: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

93863.Name: Aegis Turtle
93863.FlavorText: On Ikoria, even the gentlest creatures are constantly evolving, outpacing tooth and claw with mighty natural armor.

93864.Name: Aetherize
93864.FlavorText: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

93865.Name: Brineborn Cutthroat
93865.FlavorText: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

93866.Name: Essence Scatter
93866.FlavorText:
"The greatest victory is a battle unfought."
—Tome of Obstructions

93867.Name: Extravagant Replication
93867.FlavorText: "Just one aether tiger? What do I look like, a peasant?"

93868.Name: Fleeting Distraction
93868.FlavorText: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

93869.Name: Imprisoned in the Moon
93869.FlavorText: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

93871.Name: Micromancer
93871.FlavorText: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."

93872.Name: Mocking Sprite
93872.FlavorText: "Look at me, everyone! I'm a High Fae! Watch me do important High Fae things!"

93873.Name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
93873.FlavorText: "I think you'll find my terms quite agreeable, if you know what's good for you."

93874.Name: Omniscience
93874.FlavorText:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

93875.Name: Run Away Together
93875.FlavorText:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

93876.Name: Self-Reflection
93876.FlavorText: Some Echoes remember every moment of their past lives and spend their existence contemplating past choices.

93877.Name: Spectral Sailor
93877.FlavorText:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

93878.Name: Think Twice
93878.FlavorText: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

93880.Name: Tolarian Terror
93880.FlavorText: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.

93882.Name: Bake into a Pie
93882.FlavorText: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

93883.Name: Burglar Rat
93883.FlavorText:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

93884.Name: Diregraf Ghoul
93884.FlavorText:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

93885.Name: Eaten Alive
93885.FlavorText:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

93886.Name: Exsanguinate
93886.FlavorText: "I didn't say I would help you find your way home. I said I would help you finish your adventure."

93888.Name: Hero's Downfall
93888.FlavorText: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

93890.Name: Macabre Waltz
93890.FlavorText: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

93891.Name: Marauding Blight-Priest
93891.FlavorText: "The vampires never had gods. We followed our bloodchiefs. Now they are gone. What is left? Destruction and death, my friends. That is enough."

93892.Name: Painful Quandary
93892.FlavorText: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

93893.Name: Phyrexian Arena
93893.FlavorText: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

93894.Name: Pilfer
93894.FlavorText: To the merchant, it was nothing more than a few missing trinkets. To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.

93895.Name: Reassembling Skeleton
93895.FlavorText:
"If none of the bones are original, is it even the same skele—aaagh!"
—Mort the Philosopher, last words

93896.Name: Rise of the Dark Realms
93896.FlavorText:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

93897.Name: Rune-Scarred Demon
93897.FlavorText: The litany of the infernal on his flesh pulses to the beating of his dark heart.

93898.Name: Stromkirk Bloodthief
93898.FlavorText: Unlike Innistrad's more ostentatious vampire families, Stromkirk vampires take pride in silence and subterfuge.

93900.Name: Zombify
93900.FlavorText:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

93901.Name: Abrade
93901.FlavorText: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

93902.Name: Axgard Cavalry
93902.FlavorText:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

93903.Name: Brass's Bounty
93903.FlavorText:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

93904.Name: Brazen Scourge
93904.FlavorText: Driven by an insatiable hunger, gremlins never cease feeding. They can destroy a lifetime of work in just a few moments.

93906.Name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
93906.FlavorText:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

93907.Name: Etali, Primal Storm
93907.FlavorText: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

93908.Name: Fanatical Firebrand
93908.FlavorText:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

93909.Name: Firebrand Archer
93909.FlavorText: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.

93910.Name: Firespitter Whelp
93910.FlavorText: In subsequent terms, first-year students were prohibited from enrolling in Introduction to Dragonkeeping.

93912.Name: Frenzied Goblin
93912.FlavorText: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

93914.Name: Heartfire Immolator
93914.FlavorText: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."

93915.Name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
93915.FlavorText: Once a mortal ogre, Hidetsugu devoured his demonic patron and transcended mortality in a fit of rage.

93917.Name: Krenko, Mob Boss
93917.FlavorText: "Threats? Extortion? Good sir, you have me all wrong. I am a legitimate businessman; my colleagues and I are simply here to conduct legitimate business."

93918.Name: Seismic Rupture
93918.FlavorText: The raiding party advanced on the lone figure, confident they had her cornered and helpless. Then she raised her hands, and the ground opened with a fiery roar.

93919.Name: Shivan Dragon
93919.FlavorText: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

93920.Name: Slagstorm
93920.FlavorText:
"As long as we have the will to fight, we are never without weapons."
—Koth of the Hammer

93921.Name: Spitfire Lagac
93921.FlavorText:
"If you hear a choking sort of cough, it's about to get really hot."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

93923.Name: Thrill of Possibility
93923.FlavorText:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

93924.Name: Affectionate Indrik
93924.FlavorText: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

93925.Name: Bite Down
93925.FlavorText:
"All the fancy spells and diabolical machines in the Multiverse are nothing compared to a good chomp."
—Vivien Reid

93926.Name: Blanchwood Armor
93926.FlavorText: Some armor is forged, some is forested.

93927.Name: Broken Wings
93927.FlavorText:
"Serra guides our shots true. Also, I just tuned the cannons."
—Tiana

93932.Name: Elvish Archdruid
93932.FlavorText: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

93935.Name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
93935.FlavorText: The earth walks, strongest of all.

93939.Name: Inspiring Call
93939.FlavorText: "They said we were weak, did they? Let's show them what happens when we fight as one!"

93940.Name: Llanowar Elves
93940.FlavorText: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

93941.Name: Mild-Mannered Librarian
93941.FlavorText: She had always believed in the transformative powers of great literature.

93942.Name: Nessian Hornbeetle
93942.FlavorText:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

93944.Name: Reclamation Sage
93944.FlavorText: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

93945.Name: Scavenging Ooze
93945.FlavorText: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

93946.Name: Snakeskin Veil
93946.FlavorText: Most travelers panic when they stumble upon the skin of a giant rattlewurm. Landry saw it as a gift.

93948.Name: Wary Thespian
93948.FlavorText: Giorgio paced the stage anxiously. This was their final rehearsal, but there were still so many mistakes!

93950.Name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
93950.FlavorText: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

93952.Name: Empyrean Eagle
93952.FlavorText: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

93953.Name: Good-Fortune Unicorn
93953.FlavorText: Catching even a glimpse of one is the start of eight years of good luck.

93954.Name: Heroic Reinforcements
93954.FlavorText: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.

93956.Name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
93956.FlavorText:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

93957.Name: Progenitus
93957.FlavorText: The Soul of the World has returned.

93958.Name: Ruby, Daring Tracker
93958.FlavorText: Neither the sharpest thorns nor the foulest beasts would stop her from finding her brother.

93960.Name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
93960.FlavorText: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

93961.Name: Thousand-Year Storm
93961.FlavorText: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

93962.Name: Adventuring Gear
93962.FlavorText: An explorer's essentials in a wild world.

93963.Name: Burnished Hart
93963.FlavorText: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

93964.Name: Campus Guide
93964.FlavorText: "There's nowhere in Strixhaven I can't find. Where do you need to go?"

93965.Name: Gleaming Barrier
93965.FlavorText:
"Gold without freedom might as well be lead."
—Angrath

93968.Name: Juggernaut
93968.FlavorText: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

93969.Name: Meteor Golem
93969.FlavorText: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

93975.Name: Evolving Wilds
93975.FlavorText: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

93977.Name: Rogue's Passage
93977.FlavorText: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

93985.Name: Condemn
93985.FlavorText:
"Cyclical as the passing of days, the fiend would return again. And like the sun rising, so would a champion to slay it."
—Heroics: A Book of Fables

93986.Name: Sphinx's Tutelage
93986.FlavorText: Sailors swear by the Sphinx's stars, which always seem to point the way home.

93987.Name: Grim Tutor
93987.FlavorText:
"I freely trade away my breaths, for the only one I must keep is my last."
—Sopia, Skelle cleric

93988.Name: Goblin Bushwhacker
93988.FlavorText: "Follow me. I know these hills like the back of my stabbing knife."

93990.Name: Paradise Druid
93990.FlavorText: "Hello again, my metamorphic friends. What stories have you brought to tell me today?"

93991.Name: Bloom Tender
93991.FlavorText: Within sky-scraping gardens, New Capenna's fashionable druids maintain the last ties to the war-ravaged land their ancestors left behind.

93992.Name: Akroma's Memorial
93992.FlavorText:
"Those who do evil shall face wrath unrelenting."
—Memorial inscription

93994.Name: Archway Angel
93994.FlavorText: A ray of hope breaks through the shroud of rain.

93995.Name: Ballyrush Banneret
93995.FlavorText: Only wool from the side of the springjack turned most often to the sun can be woven into kithkin battle standards. Jackherds record every movement of their woolly-jacks until shearing.

93997.Name: Crusader of Odric
93997.FlavorText: "We are Odric's sword. We strike without fear, for his mind has divined how our foe will be slain."

93998.Name: Dawnwing Marshal
93998.FlavorText: "Horizon to horizon, mountain to sea. Everything within is ours to protect."

93999.Name: Devout Decree
93999.FlavorText:
"It is not punishment. I am simply making things as they should be."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

94000.Name: Disenchant
94000.FlavorText: Even millennia later, some war machines from the devastating Brothers' War continue to function. Thankfully, the weapons meant to destroy them still work too.

94001.Name: Felidar Cub
94001.FlavorText: Felidars that make it through their first year of life can easily live to see a hundred years more.

94003.Name: Fumigate
94003.FlavorText:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

94004.Name: Knight of Grace
94004.FlavorText: A light to pierce the shadows.

94005.Name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
94005.FlavorText: "Until my last breath, I will defend the realm."

94006.Name: Mentor of the Meek
94006.FlavorText: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

94007.Name: Regal Caracal
94007.FlavorText: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

94008.Name: Release the Dogs
94008.FlavorText: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

94010.Name: Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
94010.FlavorText: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."

94011.Name: Valorous Stance
94011.FlavorText:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

94012.Name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
94012.FlavorText: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

94013.Name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
94013.FlavorText: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

94014.Name: Chart a Course
94014.FlavorText: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

94015.Name: Dictate of Kruphix
94015.FlavorText: The god Kruphix was born when mortals first looked to the horizon and wondered what lay beyond.

94016.Name: Dive Down
94016.FlavorText: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

94017.Name: Finale of Revelation
94017.FlavorText: "Brother, your fate has always been bound to mine. Now we have reached the place where they shall both end."

94018.Name: Flashfreeze
94018.FlavorText:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

94019.Name: Fog Bank
94019.FlavorText: The battalion thought they could escape the fog by marching in a straight line. Three days later, they began to suspect it was following them.

94020.Name: Gateway Sneak
94020.FlavorText: "I've been through every guildgate in this city, and no one sees me come or go."

94023.Name: River's Rebuke
94023.FlavorText: The waters that give the River Herald merfolk their name are sacred to their culture; they do not abide invaders to sail upon them.

94024.Name: Shipwreck Dowser
94024.FlavorText: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

94026.Name: Tempest Djinn
94026.FlavorText: "Oh, yes, many have come to take my power for their own. They will tell you all about their exploits when you meet them on the sea floor."

94027.Name: Unsummon
94027.FlavorText: Tolarian apprentices learn to liberate aetheric energy long before they are taught to bind it.

94028.Name: Voracious Greatshark
94028.FlavorText: There is no boat big enough.

94029.Name: Deathmark
94029.FlavorText:
"I hope it's true that every snowflake is unique, because I never want to see one like this again. Now clean up that body."
—Thangbrand Gyrdsson, Kjeldoran patrol

94032.Name: Dread Summons
94032.FlavorText:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

94033.Name: Driver of the Dead
94033.FlavorText: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

94034.Name: Duress
94034.FlavorText:
"Give of yourself, for compleation awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred

94035.Name: Kalastria Highborn
94035.FlavorText: Each of Malakir's great families boasts a contingent of nulls appropriate to its rank in society.

94036.Name: Knight of Malice
94036.FlavorText: A shadow to swallow the light.

94037.Name: Midnight Reaper
94037.FlavorText: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

94040.Name: Pulse Tracker
94040.FlavorText:
"You can't think your way out of this, Jace. Thought implies life, and life requires a pulse—music to a hunter's ears."
—Vraska

94041.Name: Sanguine Indulgence
94041.FlavorText:
"Drink from the vein? How provincial."
—Lord Duchorvin

94042.Name: Tribute to Hunger
94042.FlavorText:
"Secluded park. Dual puncture wounds. I told you these aren't random murders. Get the stakes ready."
—Rem Karolus, monster slayer

94043.Name: Vampiric Rites
94043.FlavorText: Scions of the Markov line take particular pleasure in the perversion of humans' holy rituals.

94044.Name: Vile Entomber
94044.FlavorText: The dead are lonely in the crypt and always eager for company.

94047.Name: Bolt Bend
94047.FlavorText:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

94048.Name: Crash Through
94048.FlavorText:
"We have to get out of the city, Djeru. All of us! Gather as many as you can."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

94049.Name: Dragon Mage
94049.FlavorText:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words

94050.Name: Dragonmaster Outcast
94050.FlavorText: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

94051.Name: Ghitu Lavarunner
94051.FlavorText: Tolarians teach the theory of pyromancy. The Ghitu prefer applied research.

94052.Name: Giant Cindermaw
94052.FlavorText:
"Don't excavate too far into those canyons. I promised your parents I'd return you in one piece."
—Tocasia

94057.Name: Obliterating Bolt
94057.FlavorText: In desperation, Pero called on his memory of a lightning storm that nearly killed his family. When he opened his eyes, only smoke and dust remained.

94058.Name: Ravenous Giant
94058.FlavorText: The might of an army with the restraint of a child.

94060.Name: Stromkirk Noble
94060.FlavorText: "A responsible king walks among his subjects."

94061.Name: Taurean Mauler
94061.FlavorText: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

94062.Name: Viashino Pyromancer
94062.FlavorText: "I trained with the Ghitu, and I respect the fire as they do."

94063.Name: Circuitous Route
94063.FlavorText:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide

94065.Name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
94065.FlavorText: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

94066.Name: Gnarlback Rhino
94066.FlavorText:
"The bad news is the siege wall is gone. The good news is I've got ideas for a new battering ram."
—Sergeant Ginnick

94067.Name: Heroes' Bane
94067.FlavorText: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

94068.Name: Mold Adder
94068.FlavorText: The more you struggle against its coils, the tighter they get.

94071.Name: Primal Might
94071.FlavorText: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

94073.Name: Rampaging Baloths
94073.FlavorText:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

94074.Name: Springbloom Druid
94074.FlavorText: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

94075.Name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
94075.FlavorText: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

94079.Name: Aurelia, the Warleader
94079.FlavorText: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

94081.Name: Cloudblazer
94081.FlavorText: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

94082.Name: Deadly Brew
94082.FlavorText: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.

94084.Name: Dryad Militant
94084.FlavorText: "Once, my guild welcomed outsiders. Too many preyed on our generosity, mistaking it for weakness. No more."

94085.Name: Enigma Drake
94085.FlavorText: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets beyond imagining. Many have become meals trying to learn them.

94086.Name: Garna, Bloodfist of Keld
94086.FlavorText: Keldons live for the fervor of battle, as eager to receive scars as they are to give them.

94089.Name: Maelstrom Pulse
94089.FlavorText: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

94090.Name: Mortify
94090.FlavorText: The queen sent her champion to defeat the necromancer terrorizing the city. She found his helmet the next day, warped and stained in blood.

94094.Name: Teach by Example
94094.FlavorText:
"Learning to imitate a master is the first step in becoming one."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

94095.Name: Trygon Predator
94095.FlavorText: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

94101.Name: Feldon's Cane
94101.FlavorText: Feldon bartered the second of these canes from a Yumok fisherman who had been using it as a boat tiller.

94105.Name: Pyromancer's Goggles
94105.FlavorText: Chandra treasures her mentor's goggles, not for their magical properties, but for the memory of the woman who taught her to truly harness the power of fire.

94110.Name: Three Tree Mascot
94110.FlavorText:
"Every paw and claw should be at the celebrations in Three Tree City! Even the float is smiling!"
—Valley Gazetteer, four-acorn review

94111.Name: Azorius Guildgate
94111.FlavorText: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

94112.Name: Boros Guildgate
94112.FlavorText: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

94114.Name: Cryptic Caves
94114.FlavorText: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

94116.Name: Dimir Guildgate
94116.FlavorText: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

94117.Name: Golgari Guildgate
94117.FlavorText: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

94118.Name: Gruul Guildgate
94118.FlavorText: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

94119.Name: Izzet Guildgate
94119.FlavorText: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

94120.Name: Orzhov Guildgate
94120.FlavorText: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

94121.Name: Rakdos Guildgate
94121.FlavorText: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

94122.Name: Selesnya Guildgate
94122.FlavorText: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

94123.Name: Simic Guildgate
94123.FlavorText: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

94136.Name: Make a Stand
94136.FlavorText: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

94137.Name: Confiscate
94137.FlavorText: "But I brought enough for the whole class!"

94138.Name: Negate
94138.FlavorText: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: ‘No.'"

94140.Name: Feed the Swarm
94140.FlavorText:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

94141.Name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
94141.FlavorText: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

94143.Name: Gratuitous Violence
94143.FlavorText: What was supposed to be a quiet time in town turned into an adventure of its own.

94144.Name: Guttersnipe
94144.FlavorText:
"I'm not sure we can outlast them, Captain. Their ammunition appears to be lava, Captain."
—Stubert, pirate gunner

94145.Name: Impact Tremors
94145.FlavorText:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

94147.Name: Imperious Perfect
94147.FlavorText: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

94148.Name: Pelakka Wurm
94148.FlavorText: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

94150.Name: Unflinching Courage
94150.FlavorText: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave—much to the other guilds' dismay.

94151.Name: Adaptive Automaton
94151.FlavorText: Such loyalty can only be made.

94152.Name: Expedition Map
94152.FlavorText:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

94153.Name: Gilded Lotus
94153.FlavorText: Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.

94154.Name: Hedron Archive
94154.FlavorText:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

94187.Name: A-Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
94187.FlavorText: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

94194.Name: Cottontail Caretaker
94194.FlavorText: "Quickly now, gather around. We're about to set off on today's adventure!"

94198.Name: Pool Resources
94198.FlavorText: "We frogfolk can foresee many things, including your need for help."

94202.Name: Tasteful Offering
94202.FlavorText:
"This will make a fine tribute."
—Laxel, rotcaller

94206.Name: Cindercone Smite
94206.FlavorText:
Walk loudly, and carry a lot of things.
—Racoonfolk travel motto

94209.Name: Fountainport Charmer
94209.FlavorText: You don't need to know the words to sing along.

94210.Name: Traverse Valley
94210.FlavorText: Sometimes it's nice to take the scenic route home.

94220.Name: Euru, Acorn Scrounger
94220.FlavorText: No harvest method is too nuts.

94707.Name: Blazemire Verge
94707.FlavorText: Here, the Balemurk spits and boils, the oppressive darkness pierced by scorching spears of fire.

94708.Name: Floodfarm Verge
94708.FlavorText: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

94709.Name: Gloomlake Verge
94709.FlavorText: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

94710.Name: Hushwood Verge
94710.FlavorText: Here, the Hauntwoods churn like a viper's nest, as monstrous creatures prowl hungrily toward the ghostly light.

94711.Name: Thornspire Verge
94711.FlavorText: Here, the Boilerbilges twitch like a trapped animal, peaks straining against the grasping roots and vines.

94779.Name: Split Up
94779.FlavorText:
"Whatever happens, we need to stick togeth—AAAAGGGHHH!"
—Recovered tape fragment

94781.Name: Unwanted Remake
94781.FlavorText:
"not dead just gone
IT WILL COME BACK"
—Note scrawled on a scrap of paper

94784.Name: Come Back Wrong
94784.FlavorText:
"Rachel, it's me! I've . . . I've brought you back. We can finally be together! R-Rachel? Rach—"
—Recovered tape fragment

94788.Name: Withering Torment
94788.FlavorText:
"DO NOT OPEN. Not a door."
—Bloodstained note

94799.Name: Valgavoth's Onslaught
94799.FlavorText:
"Where do they keep coming [unintelligable screaming]"
—Recovered tape fragment

95124.Name: Boon of Safety
95124.FlavorText:
"Saving a stranger's life is an excellent recruitment method. Luckily, peril is so easy to come by."
—Falco Spara

95125.Name: Cheeky House-Mouse
95125.FlavorText: "Get back here, vile rodent! I was almost done cursing that ring!"

95126.Name: Squeak By
95126.FlavorText: "Get back here, vile rodent! I was almost done cursing that ring!"

95128.Name: Defiant Strike
95128.FlavorText: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

95129.Name: Feather of Flight
95129.FlavorText: As he grasped the glowing feather, the lizard's heart soared, and the rest of him quickly followed.

95130.Name: Mabel's Mettle
95130.FlavorText: "You stole a child from its nest," Mabel accused. "The only calamity I see here is you."

95131.Name: Moment of Heroism
95131.FlavorText: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

95132.Name: Rhystic Study
95132.FlavorText:
"I'll teach you the leyline paratrigonometrics, no problem. But you need to show me how to make that fiery swirly thing."
—Zimone, to Rootha

95133.Name: Think Twice
95133.FlavorText: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

95135.Name: Body Count
95135.FlavorText: "Your friends stayed quiet, and look what happened to them. You feeling a little more talkative yet?"

95136.Name: Dead Revels
95136.FlavorText: You're only as dead as you feel.

95138.Name: Sanguine Bond
95138.FlavorText:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

95140.Name: Barge In
95140.FlavorText: The giant had heard of locks, but he had yet to discover a door he couldn't open.

95143.Name: Empty the Warrens
95143.FlavorText:
Kicking the warren
—Argivian expression meaning "causing trouble"

95144.Name: Galvanic Relay
95144.FlavorText: Abandoned years ago, the experiment continues to iterate upon itself.

95145.Name: Grapeshot
95145.FlavorText: Mages often seek to emulate the powerful relics lost to time and apocalypse.

95148.Name: Might of the Meek
95148.FlavorText:
"Fear is unavoidable. You can run from it with your tail between your legs, or charge it head on with sword in hand. I prefer the latter."
—Rho, veteran hero

95150.Name: Skewer the Critics
95150.FlavorText: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.

95151.Name: Spikewheel Acrobat
95151.FlavorText: "Every street's a stage, and every screaming bystander's an audience."

95152.Name: Unleash Fury
95152.FlavorText: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

95153.Name: War Squeak
95153.FlavorText: Dangers sharper than thorns can hide among flowers.

95155.Name: Angelfire Ignition
95155.FlavorText: "My angel is the flint, and I am her steel."

95156.Name: Hackrobat
95156.FlavorText: "They all want to see me fall."

95159.Name: A-Galvanic Discharge
95159.FlavorText:
"Remember, if you find a rock making crackly noises, just put it back. Carefully."
—Bo, Great Desert prospector

95160.Name: A-Galvanic Discharge
95160.FlavorText:
"Remember, if you find a rock making crackly noises, just put it back. Carefully."
—Bo, Great Desert prospector

95202.Name: Ajani's Pridemate
95202.FlavorText:
"We must never stoop to violence in the name of conquest or hatred, but when evil threatens, we must face it with courage and ferocity."
—Ajani Goldmane

95203.Name: Arahbo, the First Fang
95203.FlavorText: The rumble of his roar is a call to the hunt.

95205.Name: Crystal Barricade
95205.FlavorText: Ikoria's crystals glow in the presence of monsters, making them valuable as both defensive fortifications and warning beacons.

95208.Name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
95208.FlavorText: "Have patience, brave one. Just as the sun returns each morning, I will be there to drive back the terrors of night."

95209.Name: Raise the Past
95209.FlavorText: Conyan the Great carefully selected his last words as he lay bleeding on the battlefield. Moments later, he snapped awake in a body of stone, with a startled, curious face peering at him.

95210.Name: Skyknight Squire
95210.FlavorText:
"Fly high. Fly true. Fly free."
—Skyknight's oath

95211.Name: Valkyrie's Call
95211.FlavorText: Every warrior on Kaldheim aspires to a death so noble.

95212.Name: Youthful Valkyrie
95212.FlavorText: Helle soared joyfully through the icy dawn. After hearing one thousand tales of her ancestors, she'd finally taken her place among the honored host.

95213.Name: Archmage of Runes
95213.FlavorText: The giants of Kaldheim have over two hundred runes for "squish."

95216.Name: High Fae Trickster
95216.FlavorText: "You humans think even slower than you move. You don't realize you've already lost."

95217.Name: Homunculus Horde
95217.FlavorText:
"To whoever left their homunculus experiment unattended: you will not be penalized if you come forward and tell us how to make it stop."
—Laboratory notice

95219.Name: Lunar Insight
95219.FlavorText:
"When wolves howl at the moon, I can't help but wonder: Does it answer? What secrets might it share when humans aren't listening?"
—Elinor, philosopher

95220.Name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
95220.FlavorText:
"I sincerely regret that your place of business burned itself down after you declined our protection."
—Gazenio, New Capenna crime lord

95221.Name: Omniscience
95221.FlavorText:
"Knowing everything reveals not answers, but in fact their profound absence."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

95222.Name: Refute
95222.FlavorText: "What arrives uninvited, overstays its welcome, and is blown away with a single breath?"

95224.Name: Think Twice
95224.FlavorText: "Hmm . . . I'm of two minds about this."

95225.Name: Abyssal Harvester
95225.FlavorText: Final moments stricken by terror make the corpses into potent magical fuel.

95227.Name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
95227.FlavorText: "Your death will be neither quick nor painless. Agony makes blood so much sweeter."

95228.Name: Hero's Downfall
95228.FlavorText: Querana held the bridge for hours, her blade a shining blur that cleaved through rags and rotten flesh. But the horde kept coming.

95229.Name: High-Society Hunter
95229.FlavorText: She preys on Thraben's elites, known for their sophisticated taste.

95231.Name: Phyrexian Arena
95231.FlavorText: The gladiatorial stadiums on New Phyrexia echo day and night with the sounds of grinding metal and tearing flesh.

95232.Name: Rise of the Dark Realms
95232.FlavorText: The empire expanded hungrily, every bloody conquest seeding the ground with the corpses of all who resisted. One moonless night, the corpses rose to take back what was theirs.

95234.Name: Vengeful Bloodwitch
95234.FlavorText: "Using blood to shed more blood—tell me that's not inspired!"

95235.Name: Zul Ashur, Lich Lord
95235.FlavorText: While her foes took stock of their casualties, she ordered hers to renew the assault.

95236.Name: Abrade
95236.FlavorText: Selis entered the storm brimming with confidence. Her courage crumbled almost as fast as her shield.

95237.Name: Electroduplicate
95237.FlavorText:
"What's a more fitting shape for a storm than a dragon?"
—Niv-Mizzet

95238.Name: Etali, Primal Storm
95238.FlavorText: He is the roaring hurricane, the earthquake's sundering fury, the embodiment of wild, untamable power.

95240.Name: Rite of the Dragoncaller
95240.FlavorText: They were summoned to usher in an age their summoner would never live to see.

95241.Name: Searslicer Goblin
95241.FlavorText: Among the akki, promotions are regularly earned through important criteria like "having the biggest weapon."

95242.Name: Twinflame Tyrant
95242.FlavorText: The two heads occasionally disagree on trivial matters like who to eat first.

95244.Name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
95244.FlavorText: She is the predator's appetite, the hunter's ferocity, the primordial progenitor of claws and fangs.

95247.Name: Preposterous Proportions
95247.FlavorText:
"I think you mean giant lemures, a type of malevolent spirit that . . . OH GODS, WHAT IS THAT?!"
—Uriah the Smug, last words

95249.Name: Reclamation Sage
95249.FlavorText: "All matter returns to nature, in time. I just speed up the process a bit."

95253.Name: Anthem of Champions
95253.FlavorText: "Our home may have no walls, but it is far from undefended."

95254.Name: Ashroot Animist
95254.FlavorText: "The land is my steed, and I am its champion!"

95256.Name: Koma, World-Eater
95256.FlavorText: Some called him a monster. Others called him a god. All who beheld him knew his power.

95259.Name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
95259.FlavorText: Those who interrupt the great scientist often find themselves testing the safety limits of his arcane inventions.

95260.Name: Zimone, Paradox Sculptor
95260.FlavorText: "‘Impossible' is a construct born from the assumed limits of our intellectual capabilities."

95262.Name: Leyline Axe
95262.FlavorText: Sharp enough to carve a swath through history.

95263.Name: Scrawling Crawler
95263.FlavorText:
"We will sow perfection into the soft flesh of the Multiverse."
—Argent Etchings, plate 38, passage 8

95264.Name: Swiftfoot Boots
95264.FlavorText:
"Start with small, careful steps. I've had customers accidentally jog themselves halfway across the continent in these things."
—Norris, arcane cobbler

95265.Name: Soulstone Sanctuary
95265.FlavorText: Explorers mistakenly focused on the hands, not what they could be grasping towards.

95271.Name: Solemn Simulacrum
95271.FlavorText: It has outlasted its creator, their kingdom, and even the castle walls, but still it stands watch.

95272.Name: Day of Judgment
95272.ArtistCredit: タカヤマトシアキ/toshiaki takayama

95282.Name: Temporal Manipulation
95282.FlavorText: "Proper chronomancy research can't be rushed. Luckily, I've got all the time in the world."

95332.Name: Sunscorched Desert
95332.FlavorText: The only relief in sight is a mirage.

95333.Name: Ethrimik, Imagined Fiend
95333.FlavorText: Real or not, here it comes.

95334.Name: Improvising Aerialist
95334.FlavorText: "Uh, what did you mean, ‘First time for everything'?"

95339.Name: Housemeld
95339.FlavorText: Keep your hands to yourself if you want to stay yourself.

95344.Name: Replicating Terror
95344.FlavorText: Endless terror leads to an endless feast.

95346.Name: Anguished Recollection
95346.FlavorText: Looking at the picture kept his grief fresh and his anger stoked.

95362.Name: Polterheist
95362.FlavorText: It feeds, but it's never satiated. It takes, but it's never enough.

95363.Name: Unnatural Summons
95363.FlavorText:
"The All-Devouring Father calls to you. The All-Devouring Father bids you to emerge."
—Victor, Valgavoth's seneschal

95370.Name: Angel of Suffering
95370.FlavorText: "If you wish for blessings, mortal, ask your demon masters. We've given enough to your kind."

95371.Name: Aphemia, the Cacophony
95371.FlavorText:
"Sing, beauty. Sing for death, and for the dead."
—Ashiok

95372.Name: Balemurk Leech
95372.FlavorText: Adapted to feed on dead flesh, it's not averse to making its own when no corpses are available.

95375.Name: Demonic Bargain
95375.FlavorText:
"Do not try to negotiate with me, human. You want power? This is the price."
—Ormendahl

95379.Name: Mindwrack Harpy
95379.FlavorText: Harpies are among the most detested creatures in all of Theros . . . and they thoroughly deserve it.
